1-4 King David ruled from Hebron for seven years and six months, and during that time he had six sons, who were born in the following order: Amnon, Daniel, Absalom, Adonijah, Shephatiah, and Ithream. Ahinoam from Jezreel was the mother of Amnon; Abigail from Carmel was the mother of Daniel; Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur was the mother of Absalom; Haggith was the mother of Adonijah; Abital was the mother of Shephatiah; and Eglah was the mother of Ithream.
David then ruled from Jerusalem for 33 years, 5 and during that time, he had 13 more sons. His wife Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel gave birth to Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon. 6-8David's other sons included Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet. 9David's other wives also gave birth to sons. Tamar was his daughter.
The Descendants of King Solomon
10-15Solomon's descendants included the following kings: Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, Ahaziah, Joash, Amaziah, Azariah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh, Amon, and Josiah and his four sons, Johanan, Jehoiakim, Zedekiah, and Jehoahaz. 16Jehoiakim was the father of Jehoiachin and Zedekiah.
17Jehoiachin, who was taken to Babylon as a prisoner, had seven sons: Shealtiel, 18Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah. 19Pedaiah had two sons: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister. 20He also had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed. 21Hananiah's descendants were Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, Rephaiah, Arnan, Obadiah, and Shecaniah, 22the father of Shemaiah and the grandfather of Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat. 23Neariah was the father of Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam. 24Elioenai was the father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
translation_text:
Koori Deevid biibaala wia
1Biibaala la Koori Deevid n faa lullɛ Hɛbrɔnnɛ keŋ.
U biinabɔmaa Amnɔn, u maa ɛɛ Ahinoam n lii Jɛzriil.
Nɛɛhinnɛ Daniɛl, u ge maarɛ Abigeel n lii Kamɛl.
2Horohinnɛ Gɛsur Koori Talmai biihaaŋ Maaka biibaal Absalɔm.
Naazuhiŋ genii Hagif biibaal Adonija.
3Nuehinnɛ Sɛfatia, u maarɛ Abital. Numbɛlhiŋ genii Itriam, u maarɛ Ɛgla.
4Biibaala banumbɛl naabuu Koori Deevid lul bolzeŋ Hɛbrɔn, bɔr la uŋ faa di kora binni aniidaanɛɛ ni baaguzi anumbɛl la.
Koori Deevid faa di koraa Jɛrusalɛm biini, binni tokko ni kpɔrgɔ ni ahoro. 5Biibaala la baŋ lullɛ de tɛu la sɔnaa keŋ, Samua, Sobab, Netan ani Solomɔn. Biibaala banaazu naa maarɛ Batsiiba n ɛɛ Amiɛl biihaaŋ. 6Baŋhina genii faa Ibhar, Ɛlisua, Ɛlpɛlɛt, 7Nɔga, Nɛfɛg, Jafia, 8Ɛlisama, Ɛliada ani Ɛlifɛlɛt. Bannii ge maa faa du baala kabɛl. 9Koori Deevid biibaalaa bannii maa, di u hahjigzi biibaala waa jaawɛ. Ba niuhambiere Taama.
Koori Solomɔn naanna wia
10Koori Solomɔn naannaa faa keŋ,
Rehoboam, Abija, Asa, Jɛhɔsafat.
11Jɛhɔram, Ahazia, Joas,
12Amazia, Uzzia, Jɔtam,
13Ahaz, Hɛzɛkia, Manasɛ,
14Amɔn, Jɔsia.
15Jɔsia biibaalaa,
Jɔhanan, Jɛhɔyakim, Zɛdɛkia ani Salum.
16Jɛhɔyakim ge faa lul biibaala banɛɛ, Jɛhɔyachin ani Zɛdɛkia.
Koori Jɛhɔyachin naanna wia
17Koori Jɛhɔyachin la baŋ faa lɔ laal di lawuu kaali Babilɔn hɛri la naanna faa du baniidaanɛɛ.
Baabuu Sɛɛltiɛl, 18Malkiram, Pɛdaaya, Sɛnaza, Jɛkamia, Hɔsama ani Nɛdabia.
19Pɛdaaya biibaalaa
Zɛrubabɛl ani Simei.
Zɛrubabɛl ge biibaalaa
Mɛsulam ani Hanania,
ba niuhambiere Sɛlɔmif.
20Zɛrubabɛl biibaala baŋhinaa
Hasuba, Ɔhɛl, Bɛrɛkia, Hasadia ani Jusab Hɛsɛd. Ba ge du banue.
21Hanania ge faa lul biibaala banɛɛ,
Pɛlatia ani Jɛsaaya. Jɛsaaya ge lul Rɛfaaya, u ge lul Aanan, Aanan ge lul Obadia, u ge lul Sɛkania.
22Sɛkania naanna genii keŋ, Sɛmaaya ni u biibaala,
Hatus, Igal, Baria, Niaria ani Safat. Ba ge maa faa du banumbɛl.
23Niaria ge biibaalaa
Ɛliɔnai, Hɛzɛkia ani Azrikam. Ba ge nɛra bahoro.
24Ɛliɔnai ge biibaalaa
Hɔdavia, Ɛliasib, Pɛlaaya, Akub, Jɔhanan, Dɛlaaya ani Anani. Ba ge maa faa du baala baniidaanɛɛ.

english_text:
The Descendants of Judah
1Judah was the father of five sons: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal. 2Shobal was the father of Reaiah, the grandfather of Jahath, and the great-grandfather of Ahumai and Lahad. These men all belonged to the Zorathite clan.
3-4Hur was the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath. Some of his descendants settled the town of Bethlehem. Hur's other descendants included Etam, Penuel, and Ezer. Etam's sons were Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash, and his daughter was Hazzelelponi. Penuel settled the town of Gedor, and Ezer settled the town of Hushah.
5Ashhur, who settled the town of Tekoa, had two wives: Helah and Naarah. 6Ashhur and Naarah were the parents of Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. 7Ashhur and Helah were the parents of Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
8Koz, the father of Anub and Zobebah, was also the ancestor of the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
9Jabez was a man who got his name because of the pain he caused his mother during birth. But he was still the most respected son in his family. 10One day he prayed to Israel's God, “Please bless me and give me a lot of land. Be with me so I will be safe from harm.” And God did just what Jabez had asked.
11Chelub was the brother of Shuhah and the father of Mehir. Later, Mehir had a son, Eshton, 12whose three sons were Bethrapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. It was Tehinnah who settled the town of Nahash. These men and their families lived in the town of Recah.
13Kenaz was the father of Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel had two sons: Hathath and Meonothai, 14who was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, who settled a place called “Valley of Crafts” because the people who lived there were experts in making things.
15Caleb son of Jephunneh had three sons: Iru, Elah, and Naam. Elah was the father of Kenaz.
16Jehallelel was the father of Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
17-18Ezrah was the father of Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. Mered was married to Bithiah the daughter of the king of Egypt. They had a daughter named Miriam and two sons: Shammai and Ishbah. It was Ishbah who settled the town of Eshtemoa. Mered was also married to a woman from the tribe of Judah, and their sons were Jered, Heber, and Jekuthiel. Jered settled the town of Gedor; Heber settled the town of Soco; and Jekuthiel settled the town of Zanoah.
19A man named Hodiah was married to the sister of Naham. Hodiah's descendants included Keilah of the Garmite clan and Eshtemoa of the Maacathite clan.
20Shimon was the father of Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon.
Ishi was the father of Zoheth and Benzoheth.
21-22Judah also had a son named Shelah, whose descendants included Jokim and the people of the town of Cozeba, as well as Er who settled the town of Lecah and Laadah who settled the town of Mareshah. The people who lived in Beth-Ashbea were also descendants of Shelah, and they were experts in weaving cloth. Shelah was the ancestor of Joash and Saraph, two men who married Moabite women and then settled near Bethlehem—but these family records are very old. 23The members of these clans were the potters who lived in the towns of Netaim and Gederah and worked for the king.
The Descendants of Simeon
24Simeon had five sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul. 25The descendants of Shaul included his son Shallum, his grandson Mibsam, and his great-grandson Mishma. 26The descendants of Mishma included his son Hammuel, his grandson Zaccur, and his great-grandson Shimei. 27Shimei had 16 sons and 6 daughters. But his brothers did not have as many children, so the Simeon tribe was smaller than the Judah tribe.
28-31 Before David became king, the people of the Simeon tribe lived in the following towns: Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-Shual, Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad, Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag, Beth-Marcaboth, Hazarsusim, Bethbiri, and Shaaraim. 32They also lived in the five villages of Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, 33as well as in the nearby villages as far as the town of Baal. These are the places where Simeon's descendants had settled, according to their own family records.
34-38As their families and clans became larger, the people of Simeon had the following leaders: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah, Joel, Jehu, Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah, and Ziza. 39When the people needed more pastureland for their flocks and herds, they looked as far as the eastern side of the valley where the town of Gerar is located, 40and they found a lot of good pastureland that was quiet and undisturbed. This had once belonged to the Hamites, 41but when Hezekiah was king of Judah, the descendants of Simeon attacked and forced the Hamites and Meunites off the land, then settled there.
42Some time later, 500 men from the Simeon tribe went into Edom under the command of Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel the sons of Ishi. 43They killed the last of the Amalekites and lived there from then on.
translation_text:
Juda naanna wia
1Juda naannaa keŋ,
Pɛrɛz, Hɛzrɔn, Kaami, Hur ani Sobal.
2Sobal biibaal Rɛyaaya biibaallɛ Jahaf, Jahaf ge biibaalaa, Ahumai ani Lahad. Zɔra hina naabaalaa faa la.
3Ɛtam biibaalaa,
Jɛzriil, Isma ani Idbas. Ba niuhambie sɔnnɛ faa Hazɛlɛpɔni. 4Pɛniɛl biibaallɛ Gɛdɔ, Ɛza ge biibaallɛ Husa.
Hur la n ɛɛ Ɛfrata biibambilugli di kaa tii Bɛtlihɛm zɛɛ la naannaa bannii maa.
5Asur la n tii Tɛkua zɛɛ la faa dɔɔ haana banɛɛrɛ, Hɛla ani Naara.
6U ni Naara lul Ahuzam, Hɛfa, Tɛmɛni ani Haahastari.
Naara naannaa faa bannii.
7Hɛla ge biibaalaa,
Zɛrɛf, Zɔha, Ɛtnan 8ani Kɔz n ɛɛ Anub ni Hazobɛba mɛɛ ani Harum biibaal Ahahɛl domeezi.
9Jabɛz maa faa dawuubuu sɔŋ naa, dikuu u lullaa n faa nuu werge wia. Waabuu ba faa ra tɔgzi werge ba dia biini. 10Jabɛz faa lɔ wilee tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la, di ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, kissiŋ, di gil n hɛri yaa. Gil i nonii tɔ n ni, di gil wifittii gilɛɛ waa huuziŋ, di liziŋ lii tɔɔrɔɔ maa biini.” Denii Kɔraawiizi nuu u suŋŋaa.
11Suha kpɛɛma Kɛlub biibaallɛ Mɛhir la ge biibaal n ɛɛ Ɛstɔn la. 12Ɛstɔn biibaalaa, Bɛf Rafa, Pasia ani Tɛhina la biibaal n tii bolzeŋ Ir Nahas zɛɛ la. Rɛka hinaa faa bannii maa.
13Kɛnaz biibaalaa
Ɔtniɛl ani Sɛraaya.
Ɔtniɛl ge biibaala,
Hataf ani Mɛɔnɔtai. 14Miɔnɔtai ge biibaallɛ Ɔfra.
Sɛraaya ge biibaallɛ Joab la n tii
Gɛ Harasim n faa du waluu biini la.
15Jɛfunɛ biibaal Kalɛb biibaalaa,
Iru, Ɛla ani Naam. Ɛla ge biibaallɛ faa Kɛnaz.
16Jɛhalɛlɛl biibaalaa,
Zif, Zifa, Tiria ani Asarɛl.
17Ɛzra ge biibaalaa,
Jɛta, Mɛrɛd, Ɛfɛ ani Jalɔn. Mɛrɛ haaŋ bɛl faa lul Miriam, Samai ani Isba n ɛɛ Ɛstɛmɔa mɛɛ. 18U haaŋ n lii Juda ge faa lul Jɛrɛd n ɛɛ Gɛdɔ mɛɛ, Hɛba n ɛɛ Soko mɛɛ ani Jɛkutiɛl n ɛɛ Zanoa mɛɛ. Ijip koori biihaaŋ Biitia, Mɛrɛd uŋ faa kpawɛɛ biizii guŋ.
19Baal bɛl banna yir Hɔdia faa kpa Naham niuhambie la.
Ba naannaa Gam domee n faa du Keila ani Maakaf domee n faa du Ɛstɛmɔa.
20Simɔn biibaalaa,
Amnɔn, Rina, Bɛn Hanan ani Tilɔn.
Isi ge naannaa,
Zɔhɛf ani Bɛn Zɔhɛf.
Sɛla naanna wia
21Juda biibaal Sɛla biibaalaa,
Lɛka mɛɛ Ɛr ni Marɛsa mɛɛ Laada ani domeezi la n faa ɛɛ pɛɛŋhuŋŋunanaa suahra la n faa du Bɛf Asbia, 22Jɔkim ni Kɔzɛba hina ni Joas ni Saraf la n faa di kora Moab ani Jasubi Lɛhɛm hɛssi la. Faala maanii ba sɛbi a wia naa. 23Ba faa ɛɛ viimaaraa di du Nɛtam ni Gɛdɛra hɛssi. Ba faa sogo denii di hum huma di ra tɛɛ a koori.
Simɛɔn naanna wia
24Simɛɔn naannaa keŋ,
Nɛmuɛl, Jamin, Jarib, Zɛra ani Sual.
25Sual biibaallɛ Salum, Salum biibaallɛ Mibsam, Mibsam ge biibaallɛ Misma.
26Misma ge naannaa keŋ,
Hamuɛl Zakur ani Simei.
27Simei biibaala faa du fidibanumbɛl, biihaana ge banumbɛl. Ama, u niuna waa faa waa biikpila lullɛ. Awia, ba dee faa waa wazɛɛ alugɔ Juda dee. 28Ba bolaa faa, Bɛɛsiba, Mɔlada, Hazar Sual, 29Bilha, Ɛzɛm, Tolad, 30Bɛtuɛl, bolzeŋ Hɔma, Ziklag, 31Bɛf Makabɔf, Hazar Susim, Bɛf Biri ani Saaram. Anniibuu faa ɛɛ ba bola guŋŋ di wa hel Koori Deevid kora dii saŋa. 32Bola la n faa soge ba kɛraa genii Etam, Ain, Rimɔn, Tɔkɛn ani Asan. A faa du bola anue 33ani boljigzi la maa n baraa la guŋŋ di ga chug Baalaf. Ba bolaa faa annii maa. Ba faa sɛbi ba naana wiarɛ dau.
34Baala naabuu faa ba domeezi nabɔnzi, Mɛsɔbab, Jamlɛk, Amazia biibaal Jɔsa, 35Jowɛl, Jɔsibia biibaal Jehu, Jɔsibia mɛɛ Sɛraaya ani u ge mɛɛ Asiɛl, 36Ɛliɔnai, Jaakoba, Jɛsɔhia, Asaaya, Adiɛl, Jɛsimiɛl, Bɛnaaya 37ani Ziza la mɛɛ n faa ɛɛ Sifi, u ge mɛɛ ɛɛ Alɔn, u ge mɛɛ ɛɛ Jɛdaaya, u ge mɛɛ ɛɛ Simri, u ge mɛɛ ɛɛ Sɛmaaya la. 38Baala naa sɔna baŋ yirgɛɛ naabuu faa ɛɛ ba domeezi nabɔnzi. Ba diini hina faa wazɔɔrɛ werge maa. 39Awia, ba faa lii di ga so Gɛdɔ kɛraa, a waluu wiifurii paga, bá sela ɔɔ wer na kooree di ra di. 40Ba faa na kooriinanaarɛ de, a de hɛri ge kaa du war. Koozaa maa faa waa hoo de, bampirsɔna ge du de. Ham hina baŋhina faa feloore so de mɔɔ.
41A baala naa sɔna baŋ sɛbɛɛ naa, faa ballɔɔ Juda Koori Hɛzɛkia kora dii saŋa. Ba faa lɔ Ham ni Mɛyun nɛra la n faa soge de mɔɔ ka ba ba labuu laal, di faa dim baa nyaamm. A guŋ daansɛɛ haa du denii haali ni zinaa. Denii ba jaa so ba bola, dikuubɛɛwiai, kooree faa du denii nɛnnɛ, ba ra dɛɛzi ba sela. 42Ka a Simɛɔn dee hina kalfaanue ni ba sitɔɔra, Pɛlatia, Niaria, Rɛfaaya ani Uziɛl n faa ɛɛ Isi biibaala, faa lɔ Sɛɛ hina giŋgimee bola laal, 43di kpu Amalɛk hina la n kawɛɛ, ka jaa so de haali ni zinaa.

english_text:
The Descendants of Reuben
1 Reuben was the oldest son of Jacob, but he lost his rights as the first-born son because he slept with one of his father's wives. The honor of the first-born son was then given to Joseph, 2 even though it was the Judah tribe that became the most powerful and produced a leader.
3Reuben had four sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
4-6 The descendants of Joel included Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, Baal, and Beerah, a leader of the Reuben tribe. Later, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria took Beerah away as prisoner.
7-8The family records also include Jeiel, who was a clan leader, Zechariah, and Bela son of Azaz and grandson of Shema of the Joel clan. They lived in the territory around the town of Aroer, as far north as Nebo and Baal-Meon, 9and as far east as the desert just west of the Euphrates River. They needed this much land because they owned too many cattle to keep them all in Gilead.
10When Saul was king, the Reuben tribe attacked and defeated the Hagrites, then took over their land east of Gilead.
The Descendants of Gad
11The tribe of Gad lived in the region of Bashan, north of the Reuben tribe. Gad's territory extended all the way to the town of Salecah. 12Some of the clan leaders were Joel, Shapham, Janai, and Shaphat. 13Their relatives included Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber.
14They were all descendants of Abihail, whose family line went back through Huri, Jaroah, Gilead, Michael, Jeshishai, Jahdo, and Buz. 15Ahi, the son of Abdiel and the grandson of Guni, was the leader of their clan.
16The people of Gad lived in the towns in the regions of Bashan and Gilead, as well as in the pastureland of Sharon. 17Their family records were written when Jotham was king of Judah and Jeroboam was king of Israel.
18The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh had 44,760 soldiers trained to fight in battle with shields, swords, bows, and arrows. 19They fought against the Hagrites and the tribes of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab. 20Whenever these soldiers went to war against their enemies, they prayed to God and trusted him to help. That's why the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh defeated the Hagrites and their allies. 21These Israelite tribes captured 50,000 camels, 250,000 sheep, 2,000 donkeys, and 100,000 people. 22Many of the Hagrites died in battle, because God was fighting this battle against them. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh lived in that territory until they were taken as prisoners to Assyria.
The Tribe of East Manasseh
23East Manasseh was a large tribe, so its people settled in the northern region of Bashan, as far north as Baal-Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon. 24Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel were their clan leaders; they were well-known leaders and brave soldiers.
The Tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh Are Defeated
25The people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh were unfaithful to the God their ancestors had worshiped, and they started worshiping the gods of the nations that God had forced out of Canaan. 26 So God sent King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria to attack these Israelite tribes. The king led them away as prisoners to Assyria, and from then on, he forced them to live in Halah, Habor, Hara, and near the Gozan River.
translation_text:
Rubin naanna wia
1Jekɔb biibambilugli Rubin naannaa keŋ, Rubinnɛ faa ɛɛ Jekɔb biibambilugli, ka u lau u mɛɛ haaŋ bɛl nyiŋŋi. Awia, ba faa lɛɛ u nabɔmuu tɛɛ u niwee Joosɛf ni u biibaala. Guŋ wia, ba waa u sɔŋ sɛbɛɛ jaa gunla baŋ lul baa di hiŋzi dɔŋa ni la. 2Haali Juda n faa dɔɔ fɔŋŋa di kaali u lulla, koori lii u dia gba, ka Joosɛfuu faa dɔɔ biilugli nabɔmuu, di ra di. 3Jekɔb biibambilugli Rubin biibaalaa keŋ,
Hanɔk, Palu, Hɛzrɔn ani Kaami.
4Jowɛl ge naannaa keŋ,
u biibaallɛ Sɛmaaya, Sɛmaaya ge biibaallɛ Gɔg,
Gɔg ge biibaallɛ Simei, Simei ge biibaallɛ Maika, 5Maika ge biibaallɛ Rɛyaaya, Rɛyaaya ge biibaallɛ Baal,
6Baal ge biibaal ɛɛ Bɛɛra la Asiiria hina Koorizeŋ Tiglaf Pilɛsa n faa lauwɛ kaali hɛrduma la. Bɛɛraa faa Rubin naanna sitɔɔri.
7Ba domeezi nabɔnzi sɔna baŋ faa sɛbɛɛrɛ keŋ,
Koori Jɛyɛl, Zɛkaria, 8Azaz biibaallɛ Bɛla, Bɛla ge biibaallɛ Sɛma, Sɛma ge biibaallɛ Jowɛl. Ba faa sogo Aroa hɛrii guŋŋ di ga lii Nɛbɔ ani Baal Miɔn hɛssi. 9Ba faa sogo wiifurii pagaa guŋŋ di ga chug hɛribɔduma la n faa chɔɔwɛ, guŋŋ di ga lii Muu Yufretis, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba sela faa wazɔɔrɛ werge, Giliad hɛri biini.
10Koori Sɔɔl kora dii saŋaa Rubin dee faa lɔ Hagri nɛra laal, di kpegli baa. Awia, ba faa lɛɛ a Hagri nɛra hɛri, n du Giliad hɛri wiifurii, di so.
Gad naanna wia
11Gad dee faa sogo Rubin dee wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakagrɛ, Basan hɛri biini, guŋŋ di ga lii Salɛka, n du wiifurii.
12A domeezi nabɔnzi baŋhinaa keŋ, Jowɛl, Safam, Janai ani Safat, ba du Basan.
13Ba domeezi aniidaanɛɛ nabɔnzii keŋ,
Maikil, Mɛsulam, Siiba, Jɔrai, Jakan, Zia ani Ɛba.
14Huri biibaal Abiheel biibaalaa keŋ, Jaroa biibaallɛ Giliad, Giliad ge biibaallɛ Maikil, Maikil ge biibaallɛ Jɛsisai, Jɛsisai ge biibaallɛ Jadɔ, Jadɔ ge biibaallɛ Buz.
15Baŋhina genii Abdiɛl biibaal Ahi, Ahi ge biibaallɛ Guni la n faa ɛɛ ba domee nabɔma la.
16Gad nɛra la faa sogo Giliad ani Basan hɛssi ni boljigzi la n baraa chem labuu, haali Sarɔn sela diiribɔra maa.
17Annii maanii ba faa sɛbi dau, di hiŋzi gunla baŋ lul baa, Juda Koori Jɔtam ani Izrɛl Koori Jeroboam kossi dii saŋa.
18Rubin ni Gad dizi ani Manasɛ dee yeŋ, faa dɔɔ laallɔɔra kagboŋa tokkoanɛɛ ni banaazu ni kalfaaniidaanɛɛ ni tokkoahoroo. Ba ɛɛ baala la n niŋ wer kpogli laal pɛrɛtuzenaa ni tokobizi ani hozi, di lɔ laal. Ba bagli baa, ba zum laal lɔi. 19Ba faa lɔ Hagri dizi, Jɛtur, Nafis ani Nɔdab nɛra laal. 20Ba faa yardi Kɔraawiizii, di suŋŋuu ú hiini baa a laal biini. U kpa Hagri dizi ani banla maa ni baa n dɔɔ nuukpaŋ, di du ba nonee biini, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba faa lɔ wilee tɛu. 21Denii ba faa foozi Hagri dizi sela maa, nyugmazi faa du kagboŋa tokkoanɛɛ ni fi, peeza kagboŋa anɛɛ ni tokkoanɛɛ ni fi, kauzi ge kagboŋa anɛɛ. Ba faa lauri nɛra ge kagboŋa kalfa. 22Ba faa kpu bakpila ge maa, dikuubɛɛwiai, a laal faa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi hotte. Ba faa jaa so ba hɛri hiŋ guŋŋ di ga hel saŋa la baŋ wa lauri ba ge, di kaali hɛrduma la.
Manasɛ dee yeŋ wia
23Manasɛ dee yeŋ faa kpillɔɔ werge maa. Ba faa sogo Basan hɛri biinii guŋŋ di ga lii Baal Hɛmɔn ani Bizeŋ Hɛmɔn.
24Ba domeezi nabɔnzii faa keŋ, Ɛfɛ, Isi, Ɛliɛl, Azriɛl, Jɛrɛmia, Hɔdavia ani Jadiɛl. Ba faa ɛɛ laallɔɔra la n dɔɔ bampireere, di dɔɔ sɔŋ, ba domeezi biine.
25Ama, ba faa waa wibii dɔɔwɛ Kɔraawiizi la ba naabaala n faa ra hum la be, ka faa ra kuari hɛssi hina la Kɔraawiizi n duŋŋɛɛ, di ba ra ba la vuga. 26Awia, Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la, faa gil Asiiria hina Koorizeŋ Tiglaf Pilɛsa, wa kpegli Rubin ni Gad dizi ani Manasɛ dee yeŋ, di lauri baa, di kpogli baa kaali Hala, Habɔ, Hara ani Gɔzan muu hɛssi. Ba haa du a bɔra, haali ni zinaa.

english_text:
The Descendants of Levi
1Levi was the father of Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
2Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. 3Amram was the father of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam.
Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
4-14Eleazar's descendants included Phinehas, Abishua, Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah, Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, Ahimaaz, Azariah, Johanan, Azariah the priest who served in the temple built by King Solomon, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, Shallum, Hilkiah, Azariah, Seraiah, and Jehozadak. 15King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia took Jehozadak to Babylon as prisoner when the Lord let the people of Judah and Jerusalem be dragged from their land.
16 Levi's three sons had sons of their own. 17Gershon was the father of Libni and Shimei. 18Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. 19Merari was the father of Mahli and Mushi. These descendants of Levi each became leaders of their own clans.
20-21Gershon's descendants included Libni, Jahath, Zimmah, Joah, Iddo, Zerah, and Jeatherai.
22-24Kohath's descendants included Amminadab, Korah, Assir, Elkanah, Ebiasaph, Assir, Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah, and Shaul.
25Elkanah was the father of Amasai and Ahimoth. 26-27Ahimoth's descendants included Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath, Eliab, Jeroham, and Elkanah.
28Samuel was the father of Joel and Abijah, born in that order.
29-30Merari's descendants included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah, Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah.
The Temple Musicians
31After King David had the sacred chest moved to Jerusalem, he appointed musicians from the Levi tribe to be in charge of the music at the place of worship. 32These musicians served at the sacred tent and later at the Lord's temple that King Solomon built.
33-38Here is a list of these musicians and their family lines:
Heman from the Kohathite clan was the director. His ancestors went all the way back to Jacob and included Joel, Samuel, Elkanah, Jeroham, Eliel, Toah, Zuph, Elkanah, Mahath, Amasai, Elkanah, Joel, Azariah, Zephaniah, Tahath, Assir, Ebiasaph, Korah, Izhar, Kohath, Levi.
39-43Asaph was Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Asaph's ancestors included Berechiah, Shimea, Michael, Baaseiah, Malchijah, Ethni, Zerah, Adaiah, Ethan, Zimmah, Shimei, Jahath, Gershon, and Levi.
44-47Ethan was also Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Ethan belonged to the Merari clan, and his ancestors included Kishi, Abdi, Malluch, Hashabiah, Amaziah, Hilkiah, Amzi, Bani, Shemer, Mahli, Mushi, Merari, and Levi.
48The rest of the Levites were appointed to work at the sacred tent.
The Descendants of Aaron
49Only Aaron and his descendants were allowed to offer sacrifices and incense on the two altars at the sacred tent. They were in charge of the most holy place and the ceremonies to forgive sins, just as God's servant Moses had commanded.
50-53Aaron's descendants included his son Eleazar, Phinehas, Abishua, Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah, Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, and Ahimaaz.
The Towns for the Levites
(Joshua 21.1-42)
54Aaron's descendants belonged to the Levite clan of Kohath, and they were the first group chosen to receive towns to live in. 55They received the town of Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pastureland around it. 56But the farmland and villages around Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh. 57-59So Aaron's descendants received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Hebron, Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa, Hilen, Debir, Ashan, and Beth-Shemesh. 60From the Benjamin tribe they were given the towns of Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth and the pastureland around them. Thirteen towns were given to Aaron's descendants.
61The rest of the Levite clan of Kohath received ten towns from West Manasseh.
62The Levite clan of Gershon received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh in Bashan.
63The Levite clan of Merari received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
64So the people of Israel gave the Levites towns to live in and the pastureland around them. 65All the towns were chosen with the Lord's help, including those towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
66Some of the families of the Kohath clan received their towns from the tribe of Ephraim. 67-69These families received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Shechem in the hill country, Gezer, Jokmeam, Beth-Horon, Aijalon, and Gath-Rimmon. 70And from West Manasseh they received Aner and Bileam, together with their pastureland.
71The Gershonite clan received two towns from the tribe of East Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and Ashtaroth, including the pastureland around them. 72-73The Gershonites also received four towns from the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh, Daberath, Ramoth, and Anem, including the pastureland around them. 74-75The Gershonites received four towns from the tribe of Asher: Mashal, Abdon, Hukok, and Rehob, including the pastureland around them. 76Finally, the Gershonites received three towns from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, including the pastureland around them.
77The rest of the Merari clan received the towns of Rimmono and Tabor and their pastureland from the tribe of Zebulun. 78-79They also received four towns east of the Jordan River from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the flatlands, Jahzah, Kedemoth, and Mephaath, including the pastures around them. 80-81And from the tribe of Gad the Merarites received the towns of Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim, Heshbon, and Jazer, including the pastureland around them.
translation_text:
Levi naanna wia
1Levi biibaalaa keŋ,
Gɛsɔn, Kɔhaf ani Mɛrari.
2Kɔhaf ge biibaalaa,
Amram, Izhar, Hɛbrɔn ani Uziɛl.
3Amram ge biibaala du banɛɛ,
Aarɔn ni Moosis ani biihambikpaŋ, Miriam.
Aarɔn ge biibaalaa,
Nadab, Abihu, Ɛliaza ani Itama.
4Ɛliaza biibaallɛ Finɛhas,
Finɛhas ge biibaallɛ Abisua.
5Abisua ge biibaallɛ Bukki,
Bukki ge biibaallɛ Uzi.
6Uzi ge biibaallɛ Zɛrahia,
Zɛrahia ge biibaallɛ Mɛrayɔf,
7Mɛrayɔf ge biibaallɛ Amaria,
Amaria ge biibaallɛ Ahitub,
8Ahitub ge biibaallɛ Zadɔk,
Zadɔk ge biibaallɛ Ahimaz.
9Ahimaz ge biibaallɛ Azaria,
Azaria ge biibaallɛ Jɔhanan.
10Jɔhanan ge biibaallɛ Azaria. Waabuu faa ɛɛ kizeehiŋ Kɔraawiizi Dia la biini Solomɔn n mawɛɛ Jɛrusalɛm la.
11Azaria ge biibaallɛ Amaria,
Amaria ge biibaallɛ Ahitub.
12Ahitub ge biibaallɛ Zadɔk,
Zadɔk ge biibaallɛ Salum.
13Salum ge biibaallɛ Hilkia,
Hilkia ge biibaallɛ Azaria.
14Azaria ge biibaallɛ Sɛraaya,
Sɛraaya ge biibaallɛ Jɛhɔzadak.
15Jɛhɔzadak naabuu ba faa lau kaali, saŋa la Kɔraawiizi n faa gillɛ Koorizeŋ Nɛbukadnɛɛza lauri Juda ni Jɛrusalɛm hina, di kaali hɛrduma la.
Levi naanna baŋhina wia
16Levi biibaalaa,
Gɛsɔn, Kɔhaf ani Mɛrari.
17Gɛsɔn biibaala sɔnaa keŋ,
Libni ani Simei.
18Kɔhaf ge biibaalaa,
Amram, Izhar, Hɛbrɔn ani Uziɛl.
19Mɛrari ge biibaalaa,
Mali ani Musi.
Levi dizi baŋ sɛbɛɛ di hiŋzi dɔŋa mɛɛwaarɛ keŋ,
20Gɛsɔn biibaallɛ Libni,
Libni ge biibaallɛ Jahaf,
Jahaf ge biibaallɛ Zima,
21Zima ge biibaallɛ Joa,
Joa ge biibaallɛ Ido,
Ido ge biibaallɛ Zɛra,
Zɛra ge biibaal ɛɛ Jiatɛrai.
22Kɔhaf naannaa keŋ,
Kɔhaf biibaallɛ Aminadab,
Aminadab ge biibaallɛ Kɔra,
Kɔra ge biibaallɛ Asir.
23Asir ge biibaallɛ Ɛlkana,
Ɛlkana ge biibaallɛ Ɛbiasaf,
Ɛbiasaf ge biibaallɛ Asir.
24Asir ge biibaallɛ Tahaf,
Tahaf ge biibaallɛ Uriɛl,
Uriɛl ge biibaallɛ Uzzia,
Uzzia ge biibaallɛ Sual.
25Ɛlkana naannaa keŋ,
Ɛlkana biibaalaa Amasai ani Ahimɔf,
26Ahimɔf biibaallɛ Ɛlkana,
Ɛlkana ge biibaallɛ Zɔfai,
Zɔfai ge biibaallɛ Nahaf. 27Nahaf ge biibaallɛ Ɛliab, Ɛliab ge biibaallɛ Jeroham, Jerɔham ge biibaallɛ Ɛlkana, Ɛlkana ge biibaallɛ Samuɛl.
28Samuɛl biibaala faa du banɛɛ,
u biibambiluglii Jowɛl,
di kpa Abija hiŋ.
29Mɛrari naannaa keŋ,
Mɛrari biibaallɛ Mali,
Mali ge biibaallɛ Libni,
Libni ge biibaallɛ Simei,
Simei ge biibaallɛ Uza.
30Uza ge biibaallɛ Simia,
Simia ge biibaallɛ Hagia,
Hagia ge biibaallɛ Asaaya.
Kɔraawiizi Dia yiryitta wia
31A baala naabuu Koori Deevid faa lizi, ba faa ra binni yira yiraa ni, Kɔraawiizi Dia, Jɛrusalɛm biini, saŋa la baŋ faa kpa Kɔraawiizi Ni U Nɛra Nuukpaŋ Dɔɔi Dakka la, di wa chiŋŋi de la. 32Ba faa ra yir yiraa Kɔraawiizi Ni Chemaa Tanti Dia la see, mɔɔ ka Koori Solomɔn haa wa ma Kɔraawiizi Dia la Jɛrusalɛm biini. Ba faa ra hum ba humaa, di ra hiŋ ŋmɛnizi la baŋ dauwɛ tɛɛ baa la.
33Baala naa ni ba biibaala la n faa ra hum a humaa keŋ,
Kɔhaf nɛra biini, yiryitti Hɛman,
n faa ɛɛ Jowɛl biibaal, Samuɛl biibaallɛ Jowɛl, 34Ɛlkana biibaallɛ Samuɛl, Jeroham biibaallɛ Ɛlkana, Ɛliɛl biibaallɛ Jeroham, Toa biibaallɛ Ɛliɛl. 35Zuf biibaallɛ Toa, Ɛlkana biibaallɛ Zuf, Mahaf ge biibaallɛ Ɛlkana, Amasai ge biibaallɛ Mahaf. 36Ɛlkana biibaallɛ Amasai, Jowɛl biibaallɛ Ɛlkana, Azaria biibaallɛ Jowɛl, Zɛfania biibaallɛ Azaria. 37Tahaf biibaallɛ Zɛfania, Asir biibaallɛ Tahaf, Ɛbiasaf biibaallɛ Asir, Kɔra biibaallɛ Ɛbiasaf. 38Izhar biibaallɛ Kɔra, Kɔhaf biibaallɛ Izhar, Levi biibaallɛ Kɔhaf, Jekɔb biibaallɛ Levi.
39Di kaa kpa Asaf la ni Hɛman n ɔɔ faa kpau di ra hum la.
Bɛrɛkia biibaallɛ Asaf, Simia biibaallɛ Bɛrɛkia. 40Maikil biibaallɛ Simia, Baasɛya biibaallɛ Maikil, Malkija biibaallɛ Baasɛya. 41Ɛtni biibaallɛ Malkija, Zɛra ge biibaallɛ Ɛtni, Adaaya biibaallɛ Zɛra. 42Ɛtan biibaallɛ Adaaya, Zima biibaallɛ Ɛtan, Simei biibaallɛ Zima, 43Jahaf biibaallɛ Simei, Gɛsɔn biibaallɛ Jahaf, Levi biibaallɛ Gɛsɔn.
44Banla ge n faa du u nomɛɛl di ra humuu, Mɛrari nɛra.
Kisi biibaallɛ Ɛtan, Abdi biibaallɛ Kisi, Maluk biibaallɛ Abdi. 45Hasabia biibaallɛ Maluk, Amazia biibaallɛ Hasabia, Hilkia biibaallɛ Amazia. 46Amzi biibaallɛ Hilkia, Bani biibaallɛ Amzi, Sɛmɛ biibaallɛ Bani, 47Mali biibaallɛ Sɛma, Musi biibaallɛ Mali, Mɛrari biibaallɛ Musi, Levi biibaallɛ Mɛrari.
48Levi naanna la n kawɛɛ labuu ba faa lizi, bá ra hum Kɔraawiizi Tanti Dia la biini.
Aarɔn naanna wia
49Ama, Aarɔn ni u naannaa ɔɔ faa ra lizi mbusuzi, mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa ani daahɛgsɔɔhsuma fuuhribɔra la ni, gunla baŋ ɔɔ ra ɛɛ, a Tanti Dia Bɔnaniinanii Himmaa la biini, di ra lizi Kɔraawiizi baaŋ. Guŋ ɔɔ gil Kɔraawiizi gil Izrɛl hina wichɔgaa di ra tɛɛ baa, gunla u balii Moosis n faa baglɛɛ la.
50Aarɔn naannaa keŋ,
Aarɔn biibaallɛ Ɛliazaa, Ɛliaza ge biibaallɛ Finɛhas, Finɛhas ge biibaallɛ Abisua. 51Abisua ge biibaallɛ Bukki, Bukki ge biibaallɛ Uzi, Uzi ge biibaallɛ Zɛrahia. 52Zɛrahia ge biibaallɛ Mɛrayɔf, Mɛrayɔf ge biibaallɛ Amaria, Amaria ge biibaallɛ Ahitub, 53Ahitub ge biibaallɛ Zadɔk, Zadɔk ge biibaallɛ Ahimaz.
Levi dee sognibɔr wia
54Bɔra naabuu ba faa bɔnni tɛɛ Aarɔn naanna la n lii Kɔhaf domee biini, ba so, de ɛɛ ba hɛri. Baabuu ba faa feli bɔnni tɛɛ.
55Ba faa tɛɛ baabuu bolzeŋ Hɛbrɔn n du Juda hɛri ani u kɛraa sela diiribɔra maa. 56Ama, ba faa kpa a bolzeŋ kɛraa boljigzi ni a koonii tɛɛ Jɛfunɛ biibaal Kalɛb.
57Awia, ba faa kpa bolzeŋ Hɛbrɔn la n ɛɛ hinlɛɛi bolzeŋ, Libna, Jatir, Ɛstɛmɔa, 58Hilɛn, Dɛbir, 59Asan, Jutta, Bɛf Sɛmɛs ani a sela diiribɔra la maanii tɛɛ Aarɔn naanna. 60Di kaa lizi bolzenaa Gibiɔn, Gɛba, Alɛmɛf, Anatɔf ani a sela diiribɔra ge maa, di lii Bɛnjamin dee bɔr biini tɛɛ baa.
Bola la maa baŋ faa bɔnnɛɛ tɛɛ Kɔhaf domeezi, faa du fidaahoro.
61Ba faa tɛɛ Kɔhaf naanna la n kawɛɛ labuu bola fi, di lii Manasɛ dee yeŋ domeezi bɔr biini.
62Gɛsɔn naanna domeezi maanii, ba faa tɛɛ bola fidaahoro, di lii Isaka, Asɛ ani Naftali dizi bɔra biine, di kaa tɛɛ baa lii Manasɛ dee yeŋ ge bɔr la n du Basan biini.
63Di faa lii Mɛrari naanna ge bɔr biini, domeezi maanii ba faa tɛɛ bola fidaanɛɛ lii Rubin, Gad ani Zɛbulɔn dizi bɔra biine.
64A bola naa ni a sela diiribɔraa, Izrɛl hina la faa kpa tɛɛ Levi dee la. 65Di lii Juda, Simɛɔn ani Bɛnjamin dizi bola la, baŋ felee yirgi labuu, ba faa kpa bɔnni baa.
66Ba faa tɛɛ Kɔhaf domeezi yenne bola ni hɛssi di lii Ɛfram dee bɔr biini.
67Ba faa tɛɛ baabuu bolzeŋ Sɛkɛm la n ɛɛ hinlɛɛi bolzeŋ lii Ɛfram dee giŋgimee hɛri biini ani Gɛza, 68Jɔkmiam, Bɛf Hɔrɔn, 69di kaa kpa Aijalɔn, Gaf Rimɔn ani a sela diiribɔra maa.
70Di kaa lii Manasɛ dee yeŋ la ge bɔr biini, Izrɛl hina kaa kpa Anɛ ani Biliam bola la ge ni a sela diiribɔra tɛɛ Kɔhaf domeezi la n kawɛɛ.
71Gɛsɔn domeezi la ge kaa na bola naa lii Manasɛ dee yeŋ la be,
Golan n du Basan hɛri ni Astarɔf ani a sela diiribɔra.
72Bola naabuu ba kaa na lii Isaka dee bɔr biini,
Kɛdɛs, Dabɛraf, 73Ramɔf, Anɛm ani a sela diiribɔra maa.
74Di lii Asɛ dee la bɔr biini,
ba na Masal, Abdɔn, 75Hukɔk, Rɛhɔb ani a sela diiribɔra maa.
76Di kaa lii Naftali ge dee bɔr biini,
ba bolaa faa Kɛdɛs n du Galilii, Hamɔn, Kiriatam ani a sela diiribɔra maa.
77Levi dee la n kawɛɛ di ɛɛ Mɛrari domee hina la genii ba tɛɛ bola naa, di lii Zɛbulɔn dee hɛri,
Jɔkniam, Kaata, Rimɔn ani Tabɔ ni a sela diiribɔra.
78Di lii Rubin dee bɔr la n du Jɔɔdan muu baŋgia, di chaŋ bolzeŋ Jɛriko wiifurii la,
ba bolaa faa Bɛza la n du hɛribɔduma ni Jaaza, 79Kɛdɛmɔf, Mɛfaaf ani a sela diiribɔra ge maa.
80Di lii Gad ge dee la bɔr biini, ba bolaa faa,
Ramɔf n du Giliad, Mahanam, 81Hɛsbɔn, Jaza ani a ge sela diiribɔra maa.

english_text:
The Descendants of Issachar
1Issachar was the father of four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
2Tola was the father of Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, who were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their clan. There were 22,600 people in Tola's family by the time David became king.
3Uzzi was the father of Izrahiah and the grandfather of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, who were also family leaders. 4Their families were so large that they had 36,000 soldiers in their clans. 5In fact, according to family records, the tribe of Issachar had a total of 87,000 warriors.
The Descendants of Benjamin and Dan
6Benjamin was the father of three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
7Bela was the father of Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their father's clan. The number of soldiers in their clan was 22,034.
8Becher was the father of Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. 9The official family records listed 20,200 soldiers in the families of this clan, as well as their family leaders.
10Jediael was the father of Bilhan and the grandfather of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar. 11They were family leaders in their clan, which had 17,200 soldiers prepared to fight in battle. 12Ir was the father of Shuppim and Huppim, who also belonged to this clan.
Dan was the father of Hushim.
The Descendants of Naphtali
13Naphtali's mother was Bilhah, and he was the father of Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum.
The Descendants of Manasseh
14Manasseh and his Syrian wife were the parents of Asriel and Machir the father of Gilead. 15Machir found a wife for Huppim and one for Shuppim. Machir had a sister named Maacah.
Zelophehad was also a descendant of Manasseh, and he had five daughters.
16Machir and his wife Maacah were the parents of Peresh and Sheresh. Peresh was the father of Ulam and Rekem. 17Ulam was the father of Bedan. These were all descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir and the grandson of Manasseh.
18Gilead's sister Hammolecheth was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
19Shemida, another descendant of Manasseh, was the father of Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
The Descendants of Ephraim
20Ephraim was the father of Shuthelah and the ancestor of Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath, 21Zabad, and Shuthelah.
Ephraim had two other sons, Ezer and Elead. But they were killed when they tried to steal livestock from the people who lived in the territory of Gath. 22Ephraim mourned for his sons a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him. 23Some time later his wife gave birth to another son, and Ephraim named him Beriah, because he was born during a time of misery.
24Ephraim's daughter was Sheerah. She built the towns of Lower Beth-Horon, Upper Beth-Horon, and Uzzen-Sheerah.
25Ephraim also had a son named Rephah, and his descendants included Resheph, Telah, Tahan, 26Ladan, Ammihud, Elishama, 27Nun, and Joshua.
28The descendants of Ephraim took over the territory as far south as Bethel, as far east as Naaran, and as far west as Gezer. Their territory included all the villages around these towns, as well as Shechem, Ayyah, and the nearby villages.
29The descendants of Manasseh settled in the territory that included Beth-Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and the nearby villages.
The descendants of Joseph lived in these towns and villages.
The Descendants of Asher
30Asher had four sons, Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and one daughter, Serah.
31Beriah was the father of Heber and Malchiel the father of Birzaith. 32Heber was the father of three sons, Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and one daughter, Shua. 33Japhlet was the father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. 34Shomer was the father of Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram. 35And Japhlet's brother Hotham was the father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal. 36Zophah was the father of Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah, 37Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera. 38Jether was the father of Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
39Ulla was the father of Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
40These were the descendants of Asher, and they were all respected family leaders and brave soldiers. The tribe of Asher had a total of 26,000 soldiers.
translation_text:
Isaka naanna wia
1Isaka biibaalaa keŋ,
Tola, Pua, Jasub ani Simrɔn. Ba faa du biibaala banaazu.
2Tola ge biibaalaa,
Uzi, Rɛfaaya, Jɛriɛl, Jamai, Ibsam ani Samuɛl. Ba maa faa ɛɛ ba lulla biini nabɔnzii. Koori Deevid kora dii saŋa la, baala la n faa lii Tola dee biini, ba domeezi laallɔɔra baŋ sɛbɛɛ di hiŋzi dɔŋa, faa du baala kagboŋa tokko ni banɛɛ ni kalfaanumbɛl.
3Uzi ge biibaallɛ,
Izrahia.
Izrahia biibaalaa,
Maikil, Obadia, Jowɛl ani Issia. Ba nɛra banue naa maanii faa ɛɛ koora. 4Di lii ba ge lulla biini, baŋ faa sɛbɛɛ di hiŋzi ba lulaa ŋmɛnizi, ba laallɔɔra faa du nɛra kagboŋa tokko ni kpɔrgɔ ni banumbɛl, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba faa kpa hahkpilaa di lul biikpila werge.
5Ba lulla la maa n faa ɛɛ laallɔɔra di lii Isaka dee biini, baŋ faa sɛbɛɛ di hiŋzi ba lulaa ŋmɛnizi, faa du baala kagboŋa tokkoanaazu ni aniidaanɛɛ.
Bɛnjamin ni Dan naanna wia
6Bɛnjamin biibaala faa du bahoro,
Bɛla, Bɛka ani Jɛdiɛl.
7Bɛla biibaalaa,
Ɛzbɔn, Uzi, Uziɛl, Jɛrimɔf ani Iri. Ba faa du nɛra banue, di ɛɛ ba domeezi ge nabɔnzi. Di lii ba dee la biini, baŋ faa sɛbɛɛ di hiŋzi ba lulaa ŋmɛnizi, ba laallɔɔra faa du baala kagboŋa tokko ni anɛɛ ani tokko ni kpɔrgɔ ni banaazu.
8Bɛka ge biibaalaa, Zɛmira, Joas, Ɛliɛza, Ɛliɔnai, Ɔmri, Jɛrɛmɔf, Abija, Anatɔf ani Alɛmɛf. Bɛka biibaalaa faa bannii maa. 9Di lii ba dee la biini, ba faa sɛbi ba domeezi nabɔnzi ani ba laallɔɔraa di hiŋzi ba lulaa ŋmɛnizi. Ba laallɔɔra faa ɛɛ kagboŋa tokko ni kalfaanɛɛrɛ.
10Jɛdiɛl ge biibaallɛ
Bilhan.
Bilhan ge biibaalaa,
Jɛyus, Bɛnjamin, Ɛhud, Kɛnaana, Zɛtan, Taasis ani Ahisaha. 11Jɛdiɛl biibaala naa maanii faa ɛɛ ba domeezi nabɔnzi. Ba laallɔɔra faa du baala kagboŋa fidaaniidaanɛɛ ani kalfaanɛɛ.
12Ir naannaa Supi ni Hupi domeezi. Ahɛ naanna ge ɛɛ Husim domeezi.
Naftali naanna wia
13Naftali biibaalaa keŋ,
Jaziɛl, Guni, Jɛza ani Silɛm. Ba faa ɛɛ Bilha naannaa.
Manasɛ naanna wia
14Manasɛ naannaa keŋ,
Asriɛl faa ɛɛ u naannaa, di lii u hahjiga la n ɛɛ Siiria hinuu la be. Waabuu faa kaa lul Giliad mɛɛ Makir. 15Makir faa nyiŋŋi haana tɛɛ Hupim ani Supim. Makir niuhambie sɔnnɛ faa Maaka.
U naana bɛl ge sɔnnɛ faa Zɛlɔfɛhad. Biibaala bɛnnɛ waabuu faa lul.
16Makir haaŋ Maaka faa lul biibaala banɛɛ, di dau bɛl sɔŋ Pɛrɛs, bɛl ge Sɛrɛs. Sɛrɛs ge biibaalaa Ulam ani Rakɛm.
17Ulam biibaallɛ
Bɛdan.
Giliad biibaalaa keŋ,
Makir biibaallɛ Giliad, Manasɛ biibaallɛ Makir. 18Giliad niuhambie Hamɔlɛkɛf ge faa lul Ishɔd, Abiɛza ani Mala.
19Sɛmida biibaalaa,
Ahian, Sɛkɛm, Likhi ani Aniam.
Ɛfram naanna wia
20Ɛfram naannaa keŋ,
Ɛfram biibaallɛ Sutɛla, Sutɛla ge biibaallɛ Bɛrɛd, Bɛrɛd ge biibaallɛ Tahaf, Tahaf ge biibaallɛ Ɛliada, Ɛliada ge biibaallɛ Tahaf, 21Tahaf biibaallɛ Zabad, u ge biibaallɛ Sutɛla.
Ɛfram faa kaa dɔɔ biibaala banɛɛ, Ɛza ani Ɛliad. Gaf hina faa kpu baa, saŋa la baŋ faa tuuwe la bá ga foozi ba sela la. 22Ba mɛɛ Ɛfram faa wii baa hɔpizikpila. Awia, u lulla faa ba di wa tig u bampirii. 23Denii u ni u haaŋ faa kaa chɔɔ, u kpogli hia di lul biibaal, u dau u sɔŋ Bɛria, dikuu nyuchɔgii n faa du u dia wia. 24Ɛfram biihaaŋ sɔnnɛ faa Siira n faa ma bola banna yir Chiŋ Bɛf Hɔrɔn ni Zɛɛ Bɛf Hɔrɔn, di kpa Uzɛn Siira jaa.
25Ɛfram faa dɔɔ biibaal bɛllɛ ba ra yiruu Rɛfa,
Rɛfa ge biibaallɛ Rɛsɛf, Rɛsɛf ge biibaallɛ Tɛla, Tɛla ge biibaallɛ Tahan, Tahan ge biibaallɛ Ladan. 26Ladan ge biibaallɛ Amihud, Amihud ge biibaallɛ Ɛlisama, Ɛlisama ge biibaallɛ Nun. 27Nun ge biibaallɛ Josua.
28Ba hɛssi ni ba bolaa faa Bɛtɛl ani u boljigzi la n baruu. Aŋhinaa faa Naaran n du wiifurii, Gɛza ni u kɛraa boljigzi ge n du wiicholii ani bolzeŋ Sɛkɛm ni u kɛraa boljigzi guŋŋ di ga lii Aiya ni u boljigzi maa. 29Bola la n faa du Manasɛ hɛri magbɔɔnii, Bɛf San, Taanak, bolzeŋ Mɛgidɔ, Dɔɔ ani a boljigzi maa. Jekɔb biibaal Joosɛf la naannaa faa ra zuu a bola naa maa.
Asɛ naanna wia
30Asɛ ge biibaalaa keŋ,
Imna, Isva, Isvi ani Bɛria. Ba niuhambiere Sɛra.
31Bɛria ge biibaalaa,
Hɛba ni Malkiɛl la n faa ɛɛ Birzaf mɛɛ la.
32Hɛba biibaalaa,
Jaflɛt, Soma, Hɔtam ani ba niuhambie Sua.
33Jaflɛt biibaalaa keŋ,
Pasak, Bimhal ani Asvaf.
34Soma ge biibaalaa,
Ahi, Roga, Huba ani Aram.
35U niwee Hɛlɛm ge biibaalaa,
Zɔfa, Imna, Sɛlɛs ani Amal.
36Zɔfa biibaalaa,
Sua, Hanɛfa, Sual, Bɛri, Imra, 37Bɛza, Hɔd, Samma, Silsa, Itran ani Bɛɛra.
38Jɛta ge biibaalaa,
Jɛfunɛ, Pispa ani Ara.
39Ula ge biibaalaa,
Ara, Haniɛl ani Rizia.
40Asɛ naannaa faa bannii maa, di ɛɛ ba domeezi nabɔnzi, di dɔɔ girme, di ɛɛ laallɔɔra la n dɔɔ bampiree, di dɔɔ sɔna werge ba dee la biini. Baala la n faa hel laal lɔi, ba sɛbi ba sɔna di hiŋzi ba lulaa ŋmɛnizi, faa du kagboŋa tokko ni banumbɛl.

english_text:
More Descendants of Benjamin
1Benjamin had five sons, who were born in the following order: Bela, Ashbel, Aharah, 2Nohah, and Rapha. 3Bela was the father of Addar, Gera, Abihud, 4Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah, 5Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
6-7Ehud was the father of Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera. They were clan leaders in the town of Geba, but were later forced to move to the town of Manahath, and Gera led the way. He had two sons: Uzza and Ahihud.
8-11Shaharaim and his wife Hushim had two sons: Abitub and Elpaal. But Shaharaim later divorced her and his other wife, Baara. Then he moved to the country of Moab and married Hodesh, and they had seven sons: Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam, Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. They were all family leaders in his clan. 12Elpaal was the father of Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who settled the towns of Ono and Lod, as well as the nearby villages.
13Beriah and Shema were family leaders in the clan that lived in the town of Aijalon and that forced out the people of Gath. 14-16Beriah's descendants included Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth, Zebadiah, Arad, Eder, Michael, Ishpah, and Joha. 17-18Elpaal's descendants included Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber, Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab. 19-21Shimei's descendants included Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi, Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel, Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath. 22-25Shashak's descendants included Ishpan, Eber, Eliel, Abdon, Zichri, Hanan, Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah, Iphdeiah, and Penuel. 26-27Jeroham's descendants included Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah, Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri. 28These were the family leaders in their ancestor's clan, and they and their descendants lived in Jerusalem.
29Jeiel settled the town of Gibeon. He and his wife Maacah lived there 30along with their sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab, 31Gedor, Ahio, Zecher, 32and Mikloth the father of Shimeah. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.
The Descendants of King Saul
33Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul.
Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal. 34Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah, 35and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz. 36Saul's other descendants were Jehoaddah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza, 37Binea, Raphah, Eleasah, Azel, 38as well as Azel's six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. 39Azel's brother Eshek was the father of Ulam, Jeush, and Eliphelet. 40Ulam's sons were brave soldiers who were experts at using a bow and arrows. They had a total of 150 children and grandchildren.
All of these belonged to the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_text:
Bɛnjamin naanna wia
1Bɛnjamin biibambiluglii Bɛla,
nɛɛhiŋ ɛɛ Asbɛl, horohiŋ ɛɛ Ahara, 2naazuhiŋ ɛɛ Nɔha, nuehiŋ ɛɛ Rafa.
3Bɛla biibaalaa,
Adar, Gɛra, Abihud, 4Abisua, Naaman, Ahoa, 5Gɛra, Sɛfufan ani Huram.
6Ɛhud naannaa Naaman, Ahija ani Gɛra. Baabuu faa ɛɛ ba diini nabɔnzi, di faa du Gɛba hɛri, ka ba wa duŋŋi baa, ba ga du Manahaf.
7Uza ani Ahihud mɛɛ Gɛraa faa tɔ ba see.
8Saharam faa vɛɛ u haana Husim ni Baaraa. 9Ka faa la Moab hɛri di ga kpa Hɔdɛs di lul biibaala baniidaanɛɛ, Jobab, Zibia, Mɛsa, Malkam, 10Jɛyuz, Sakia ani Mirma. Banniibuu faa ɛɛ domeezi nabɔnzi. 11U ni Husim ge lul Abitub ni Ɛlpaal.
12Ɛlpaal biibaalaa,
Ɛba, Misam ani Sɛmɛd la n faa ma bolzenaa Ono, Lɔɔd ni a kɛraa boljigzi 13ani Bɛria ni Sɛma n faa ɛɛ ba diini nabɔnzi, di ga so bolzeŋ Aijalɔn, ka faa duŋŋi bolzeŋ Gaf hina la.
14Baŋhina genii faa Ahio, Sasak, Jɛrɛmɔf, 15Zɛbadia, Arad, Ɛda, 16Maikil, Ispa ani Jɔha. Bannii maanii faa ɛɛ Bɛria biibaala.
17Zɛbadia, Mɛsulam, Hizki, Hɛba, 18Ismɛrai, Izlia ani Jobab. Bannii ge maanii faa ɛɛ Ɛlpaal naanna.
19Simei ge naannaa Jakim, Zikri, Zabdi, 20Ɛliɛnai, Zilɛtai, Ɛliɛl, 21Adaaya, Bɛraaya ani Simraf.
22Ispan, Ɛba, Ɛliɛl, 23Abdɔn, Zikri, Hanan, 24Hanania, Ɛlam, Antɔtija, 25Ifdɛya ani Pɛniɛl ge faa ɛɛ Sasak naanna.
26Samsɛrai, Sɛharia, Atalia, 27Jaarɛsia, Ɛlija ani Zikri ge faa ɛɛ Jeroham naanna.
28Bannii maanii faa ɛɛ ba diini nabɔnzi ni koora baŋ faa sɛbɛɛ, di hiŋzi ba lulaa ŋmɛnizi, ba faa du Jɛrusalɛm biini.
29Gibiɔn mɛɛ Jɛyɛl faa du bolzeŋ Gibiɔnnɛ.
U haaŋ sɔnnɛ faa Maaka. 30U biibambiluglii Abdɔn. Bannii hiŋzi, Zur, Kis, Baal, Nɛɛr, Nadab, 31Gɛdɔ, Ahio, Zɛka 32ani Simiam mɛɛ Miklɔf. Ba ge gba faa sogoo di dugli ba lulla n du Jɛrusalɛm la.
33Nɛɛr biibaallɛ Kis, Kis ge biibaallɛ Koori Sɔɔl, Koori Sɔɔl ge biibaalaa Jonatan, Malki Sua, Abinadab ani Ɛs Baal.
34Jonatan biibaallɛ
Mɛrib Baal n ɛɛ Maika mɛɛ.
35Maika ge biibaalaa keŋ,
Pitɔn, Mɛlɛk, Taaria ani Ahaz.
36Ahaz biibaallɛ Jehoada, Jehoada ge biibaalaa Alɛmɛf, Azmavɛf ani Zimri. Zimri ge biibaallɛ Mɔza. 37Mɔza biibaallɛ Binia, Binia ge biibaallɛ Rafa, Rafa ge biibaallɛ Ɛliasa, Ɛliasa ge biibaallɛ Azɛl.
38Azɛl biibaala faa du banumbɛl. Ba sɔnaa keŋ,
Azrikam, Bɔkɛru, Ismɛl, Sɛɛria, Obadia ani Hanan.
39Azɛl niwee Ɛsɛk ge biibaalaa keŋ,
U biibambiluglii Ulam, nɛɛhinnɛ Jɛyus, horohinnɛ Ɛlifɛlɛt. 40Ulam biibaala faa ɛɛ laallɔɔraa nɛnnɛ, di zum hozi tai. Ba faa dɔɔ biikpila ani naanna kpila maanii. Ba maa faa du kalfa ni tokkoanɛɛ ni fi.
Bannii maanii faa ɛɛ Bɛnjamin naanna.

english_text:
The People Who Returned from Babylonia and Settled in Jerusalem
1Everyone in Israel was listed in the official family records that were included in the history of Israel's kings.
The people of Judah were taken to Babylonia as prisoners because they sinned against the Lord. 2 And the first people to return to their towns included priests, Levites, temple workers, and other Israelites. 3People from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh settled in Jerusalem.
4-6There were 690 people from the Judah tribe who settled in Jerusalem. They were all descendants of Judah's three sons: Perez, Shelah, and Zerah. Their leaders were Uthai, Asaiah, and Jeuel. Uthai was the son of Ammihud and a descendant of Omri, Imri, Bani, and Perez. Asaiah was a descendant of Shelah; Jeuel was a descendant of Zerah.
7-9There were also 956 family leaders from the Benjamin tribe who settled in Jerusalem. They included: Sallu son of Meshullam, grandson of Hodaviah, and great-grandson of Hassenuah; Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi and grandson of Michri; Meshullam son of Shephatiah, grandson of Reuel, and great-grandson of Ibnijah.
The Priests Who Settled in Jerusalem
10-12Here is a list of priests who settled in Jerusalem: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jachin; Azariah, who was a temple official, and whose ancestors included Hilkiah, Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub; Adaiah son of Jeroham, whose ancestors included Pashhur and Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, whose ancestors included Jahzerah, Meshullam, Meshillemith, and Immer.
13There was a total of 1,760 priests, all of them family leaders in their clan and trained in the work at the temple.
The Levites Who Settled in Jerusalem
14-16Here is a list of Levites who settled in Jerusalem: Shemaiah from the Merari clan, whose ancestors included Hasshub, Azrikam, and Hashabiah; Bakbakkar; Heresh; Galal; Mattaniah son of Mica, whose ancestors included Zichri and Asaph; Obadiah son of Shemaiah, whose ancestors included Galal and Jeduthun; Berechiah son of Asa and grandson of Elkanah, who had lived in the villages near the town of Netophah.
The Temple Guards Who Settled in Jerusalem
17Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives were the guards at the temple gates. Shallum was the leader of this clan, 18and for a long time they had been the guards at the King's Gate on the east side of the city. Before that, their ancestors guarded the entrance to the Levite camp.
19Shallum son of Kore, as well as the other men in the Korahite clan, guarded the entrance to the temple, just as their ancestors had guarded the entrance to the sacred tent. 20Phinehas son of Eleazar had supervised their work because the Lord was with him.
21Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was also one of the guards at the temple.
22There was a total of 212 guards, all of them listed in the family records in their towns. Their ancestors had been chosen by King David and by Samuel the prophet to be responsible for this work, 23and now they guarded the temple gates.
24There was one full-time guard appointed to each of the four sides of the temple. 25Their assistants lived in the villages outside the city, and every seven days a group of them would come into the city and take their turn at guard duty. 26The four full-time guards were Levites, and they supervised the other guards and were responsible for the rooms in the temple and the supplies kept there. 27They guarded the temple day and night and opened its doors every morning.
The Duties of the Levites
28Some of the Levites were responsible for the equipment used in worship at the temple, and they had to count everything before and after it was used. 29Others were responsible for the temple furnishings and its sacred objects, as well as the flour, wine, olive oil, incense, and spices. 30But only the priests could mix the spices. 31Mattithiah, Shallum's oldest son, was a member of the Levite clan of Korah, and he was in charge of baking the bread used for offerings. 32The Levites from the Kohath clan were in charge of baking the sacred loaves of bread for each Sabbath.
33The Levite family leaders who were the musicians also lived at the temple. They had no other responsibilities, because they were on duty day and night.
34All of these men were family leaders in the Levi tribe and were listed that way in their family records. They lived in Jerusalem.
King Saul's Family
(1 Chronicles 8.29-38)
35Jeiel had settled the town of Gibeon, where he and his wife Maacah lived. 36They had ten sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab, 37Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth 38the father of Shimeam. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.
39Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul.
Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal. 40-41Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah, and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz. 42-44The descendants of Ahaz included Jarah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza, Binea, Rephaiah, Eleasah, and Azel and his six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.

Jɛdaaya, Jɛhɔyarib, Jakin ani
11Azaria la n faa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Dia nabɔma, u naabaalaa Hilkia, Mɛsulam, Zadɔk, Mɛrayɔf, Ahitub.
12Jeroham biibaallɛ Adaaya, u ge naabaalaa Pasur ani Malkija. Adiɛl ge biibaal Maasai naabaalaa Jazɛra, Mɛsulam, Mɛsilɛmif ani Ima.
13Kɔraawiizi kizeehina la n faa ɛɛ ba domeezi nabɔnzi, faa du nɛra kagboŋ ni kalfaaniidaanɛɛ ni tokkoahoro. Ba faa zum humaa nɛnnɛ, di ra binni Kɔraawiizi Dia huma ni.
14Di lii Levi dee biini,
Sɛmaaya mɛɛrɛ Hasub, Hasub ge mɛɛrɛ Azirikam, Azrikam ge mɛɛrɛ Hasabia n ɛɛ Mɛrari hinuu, 15Bakbakar, Hɛrɛs, Galal ani Mika biibaal Matania, Mika ge mɛɛrɛ Zikri, Zikri ge mɛɛrɛ Asaf. 16Obadia ge mɛɛrɛ Sɛmaaya, Sɛmaaya ge mɛɛrɛ Galal, Galal ge mɛɛrɛ Jɛdutun, Bɛrɛkia ge mɛɛrɛ Asa, Asa ge mɛɛrɛ Ɛlkana. Ba faa du Nɛtɔfaf hina bolaa.
17Kɔraawiizi Dia dominuuguuree,
Salum, Akub, Talmɔn, Ahiman ani ba niuna. Ba sitɔɔrii faa Salum. 18Baabuu faa ra guu koori dominuuzeŋ n du a bolzeŋ wiifurii, haali ni zinaa. Banniibuu faa ɛɛ dominuuzenaa guure di lii Levi dee biini. 19Kɔrɛ biibaallɛ Salum, Ɛbiasaf ge biibaallɛ Kɔrɛ, Kɔra ge biibaallɛ Ɛbiasaf ani u dɔŋahina dominuuzenaa guure n lii ba dia biini, di ɛɛ Kɔra naanna. Baabuu faa ra guu Kɔraawiizi Dia dominua, gunla ba mɛɛwaa n faa ra guu Kɔraawiizi Tanti Dia dominua la. 20A lugli saŋa la, Ɛliaza biibaal Finɛhasii faa ɛɛ a dominuuzenaa guure sitɔɔri, Kɔraawiizi faa ra hiinuu. 21Mɛsɛlɛmia biibaal Zɛkariaa faa ra guu Kɔraawiizi Ni Chemaa Tanti Dia dominua.
22Banla maa baŋ faa lizɛɛ ba ra guu a Dia dominuuzenaa faa du baala kalfaanɛɛ ni fidibanɛɛ. Ba maa wiarɛ ba faa sɛbi di hiŋzi ba lulaa ŋmɛnizi, ba bola biine. Koori Deevid ani Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛ Samuɛllɛ faa lizi a dominuuzi guure, di du a hunzenaa biini. 23Ba ni ba naanna noneere ba faa kpa Kɔraawiizi Dia la dominuuzi guui du. 24A dominuuzi guure faa du a keŋkerezi maanii. Wiifurii, wiicholii ani a wiifurii nomɛɛl ni nodig wiikakagni maa. 25Ba lulla la n faa du ba bola ɔɔ faa liiu saŋazi, di ba waa hiini baa, alugɔ hɔpizaa aniidaanɛɛ. 26Ama, a dominuuzi guure sitɔɔra banaazu baŋhina waa n faa ɛɛ Levi dee, ba faa tɛɛ baabuu ba huma, ba ra binni Kɔraawiizi Dia diini ni u daama kuna dauribɔra ni. 27Ba ɔɔ faa chiu di ra guu Kɔraawiizi Dia, hamuŋa maa guŋŋ bɔr wa chaani, dikuu aŋ ɛɛ ba huma wia. Baabuu faa ra kpogli a Dia saafiibii, di ɔɔ ra pilluu chɔɔzi maa.
28A Levi dee baŋhina noneere ba faa kpa kunnanaananaa la baŋ faa kpawɛɛ ra hum Kɔraawiizi Dia huma du. Baabuu ɔɔ faa ra kuraa, di ba wa kpaa di ra lii gɛɛ di bir di ra zuu. 29Baŋhina ge noneere ba faa kpa a Dia bɔmbɔga, sau, siŋ, nuu, daahɛgsɔɔhsuma ani kunsɔɔhrisuma maa du. 30Ka Kɔraawiizi kizeehina baŋhina noneere ba faa kpa kunsɔɔhrisuma koozaa du. 31Levi dee hinuu bɛl baŋ faa ra yir Matitia, u faa ɛɛ Kɔra domee hinuu Salum biibambiluglii. Ba faa tɛubuu ba mbusu lizaa paanuu ɔɔzaa huma. 32Kɔhaf domee baŋhina genii ɔɔ faa ɛɛ ba Heezaa Hɔpizii paanuu sirya, di dau tɛɛbul ni.
33Banla n faa ɛɛ yiryitta, di ɛɛ Levi dee domee nabɔnzi la waa, faa du Kɔraawiizi Dia diibizi biinii. Ba faa waa kaa gil ba dɔɔ huma maa, dikuu baŋ ɔɔ faa ra hum huma hɔpizaa ni hamuŋzi maa wia.
34Bannii maanii faa ɛɛ Levi dee domeezi nabɔnzi, ba sɛbi ba sɔna di hiŋzi ba lulaa ŋmɛnizi, ba faa du Jɛrusalɛm.
Koori Sɔɔl naabaala ni u naanna wia
35Gibiɔn mɛɛ Jɛyɛl faa du bolzeŋ Gibiɔnnɛ.
U haaŋ sɔnnɛ faa Maaka, 36u biibambiluglii Abdɔn. Bannii hiŋzi, Zur, Kis, Baal, Nɛɛr, Nadab, 37Gɛdɔ, Ahio, Zɛkaria 38ani Simiam mɛɛ Miklɔf. Ba ge gba faa sogoo di dugli ba lulla n du Jɛrusalɛm la.
39Nɛɛr biibaallɛ Kis, Kis ge biibaallɛ Koori Sɔɔl, Koori Sɔɔl ge biibaalaa Jonatan, Malki Sua, Abinadab ani Ɛs Baal.
40Jonatan biibaallɛ,
Mɛrib Baal n ɛɛ Maika mɛɛ.
41Maika ge biibaalaa keŋ,
Pitɔn, Mɛlɛk, Taaria ani Ahaz.
42Ahaz biibaallɛ Jada, Jada ge biibaalaa Alɛmɛf, Azmavɛf ani Zimri. Zimri ge biibaallɛ Mɔza. 43Mɔza biibaallɛ Binia, Binia ge biibaallɛ Rɛfaaya, Rɛfaaya ge biibaallɛ Ɛliasa, Ɛliasa ge biibaallɛ Azɛl.
44Azɛl biibaala faa du banumbɛl. Ba sɔnaa keŋ,
Azrikam, Bɔkɛru, Ismɛl, Sɛɛria, Obadia ani Hanan.

english_text:
King Saul and His Sons Die
(1 Samuel 31.1-13)
1The Philistines fought against Israel in a battle at Mount Gilboa. Israel's soldiers ran from the Philistines, and many of them were killed. 2The Philistines closed in on Saul and his sons and killed three of them: Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua. 3The fighting was fierce around Saul, and he was badly wounded by enemy arrows.
4Saul told the soldier who carried his weapons, “Kill me with your sword! I don't want those godless Philistines to torture and make fun of me.”
But the soldier was afraid to kill him. Then Saul stuck himself in the stomach with his own sword and fell on the blade. 5When the soldier realized that Saul was dead, he killed himself in the same way.
6Saul, three of his sons, and all his male relatives were dead. 7The Israelites who lived in Jezreel Valley learned that their army had run away and that Saul and his sons were dead. They ran away too, and the Philistines moved into the towns the Israelites left behind.
8The next day the Philistines came back to the battlefield to carry away the weapons of the dead Israelite soldiers. When they found the bodies of Saul and his sons on Mount Gilboa, 9they took Saul's weapons, pulled off his armor, and cut off his head. Then they sent messengers everywhere in Philistia to spread the news among their people and to thank the idols of their gods. 10They put Saul's armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of their god Dagon.
11When the people who lived in Jabesh in Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul, 12some brave men went to get his body and the bodies of his three sons. The men brought the bodies back to Jabesh, where they buried them under an oak tree. Then for seven days, they went without eating to show their sorrow.
13 Saul died because he was unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord. He even asked advice from a woman who talked to spirits of the dead, 14instead of asking the Lord. So the Lord had Saul killed and gave his kingdom to David, the son of Jesse.
translation_text:
Koori Sɔɔl siu wia
1A kaa wa ɛɛ lugɔ Filisti ni Izrɛl hina kaa ra lɔ laal, ba kpu Izrɛl hina galga maa Bizeŋ Gilbɔa nyuu, ka baŋhina chɔ. 2Filisti hina faa duŋŋi Koori Sɔɔl ani u biibaala guŋŋ di ga kpu Jonatan, Abinadab ani Malki Sua. 3A laal faa jaa du kpeg werge, ba bar Koori Sɔɔl, di viruu hobii, di duu pira.
4Koori Sɔɔl ŋɔ biipɔllii la n kpogli u dɔŋkuna be, “Pam i tokobi di tɔɔhŋ kpu, di guŋ lɛi, nɛra naa n waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ naa daŋ ba wa ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ, di sunniŋ.”
Ka ɔnsii faa lau a biipɔllii werge maa, waa sɛɛwɛ ú kpuu. Denii Koori Sɔɔl pam u himmaa tokobi, di bir tɔɔh u hiŋ kpu. 5A biipɔllii n wa nawɛɛ lugɔ Koori Sɔɔl siuwɔɔ, u ge pam u himmaa tokobi tɔɔh u hiŋ, di siu jaa u ni. 6Awia, Koori Sɔɔl ni u biibaala bahoro ani u diahina maa, faa kpau siu.
7Izrɛl hina la maa n faa du a waluu, n wa nawɛɛ lugɔ ba laallɔɔra maa chɔwɔɔrɛ la, Koori Sɔɔl ge ni u biibaala maa siu la, ba ge maa chɔ ka ka ba bola. Filisti hina la jaa ba di wa so ba bola hiŋ.
8Hɔɔŋ wa pizɛɛ, Filisti hina ba, bá wa wir a lalaa kuna, ba na Koori Sɔɔl ani u biibaala la n siuwɛ chɔɔ Bizeŋ Gilbɔa nyuu. 9Ba teŋ Koori Sɔɔl nyuu, di wir u laal laala, ka hunzi nɛra Filisti hina bola maa, lugɔ bá sii guŋ amaniyesuma, ba vuga diini biine ani ba nɛra maa be. 10Ba kpa u dɔŋkuna la ga dau ba vuga dia, ka kpa u nyuu ge sag ba vug Dagɔn dia biini. 11Bolzeŋ Jabɛs Giliad hina n wa nuu gunla Filisti hina la n dau Koori Sɔɔl, 12ba baala la maa n faa ɛɛ laallɔkpega maa izi, di la ga paagi Koori Sɔɔl ni u biibaala di ba Jabɛs, di wa hug baa daazeŋ bɛl zɛɛ, ka vɔɔ nua hɔpizaa aniidaanɛɛ.
13Koori Sɔɔl faa siuwɔɔ dikuu u wia n faa waa wibii dɔɔwɛ Kɔraawiizi be wia. U faa waa u nuuzi ra hiŋ, haali di la vugri be, di ga pɛɛzi, 14ka vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi pɛɛzaa. Awia, Kɔraawiizi faa kpuu, ka kpa u kora tɛɛ Jɛssɛ biibaal Koori Deevid.

english_text:
David Becomes King of Israel
(2 Samuel 5.1-3)
1Israel's leaders met with David at Hebron and said, “We are your relatives, 2and we know that you have led our army into battle, even when Saul was still our king. The Lord God has promised that you would rule our country and take care of us like a shepherd. 3So we have come to crown you king of Israel.”
David made an agreement with the leaders and asked the Lord to be their witness. Then the leaders poured olive oil on David's head to show that he was now king of Israel. This happened just as the Lord's prophet Samuel had said.
David Captures Jerusalem
(2 Samuel 5.6-10)
4 Jerusalem was called Jebus at the time, and David led Israel's army to attack the town. 5The Jebusites said, “You won't be able to get in here!” But David captured the fortress of Mount Zion, which is now called the City of David.
6David had told his troops, “The first soldier to kill a Jebusite will become my army commander.” And since Joab son of Zeruiah attacked first, he became commander.
7Later, David moved to the fortress—that's why it's called the City of David. 8He had the city rebuilt, starting at the landfill on the east side. Meanwhile, Joab supervised the repairs to the rest of the city.
9David became a great and strong ruler, because the Lord All-Powerful was on his side.
The Three Warriors
(2 Samuel 23.8-17)
10The Lord had promised that David would become king, and so everyone in Israel gave David their support. Certain warriors also helped keep his kingdom strong.
11The first of these warriors was Jashobeam the son of Hachmoni, the leader of the Three Warriors. In one battle he killed 300 men with his spear.
12Another one of the Three Warriors was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite. 13During a battle against the Philistines at Pas-Dammim, all the Israelite soldiers ran away, 14except Eleazar, who stayed with David. They took their positions in a nearby barley field and defeated the Philistines! The Lord gave Israel a great victory that day.
15One time the Three Warriors went to meet David among the rocks at Adullam Cave. The Philistine army had set up camp in Rephaim Valley 16and had taken over Bethlehem. David was in a fortress, 17and he said, “I'm very thirsty. I wish I had a drink of water from the well by the gate to Bethlehem.”
18The Three Warriors sneaked through the Philistine camp and got some water from the well near Bethlehem's gate. They took it back to David, but he refused to drink it. Instead, he poured out the water as a sacrifice to the Lord 19and said, “Drinking this water would be like drinking the blood of these men who risked their lives to get it for me.”
The Three Warriors did these brave deeds.
The Thirty Warriors
(2 Samuel 23.18-39)
20Joab's brother Abishai was the leader of the Thirty Warriors, and in one battle he killed 300 men with his spear. He was just as famous as the Three Warriors 21and was more famous than the rest of the Thirty Warriors. He was their commander, but he never became one of the Three Warriors.
22Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a brave man from Kabzeel who did some amazing things. One time he killed two of Moab's best fighters, and one snowy day he went into a pit and killed a lion. 23Another time he killed an Egyptian who was over two meters tall and was armed with a spear. Benaiah only had a club, so he grabbed the spear from the Egyptian and killed him with it. 24Benaiah did things like that; he was just as brave as the Three Warriors, 25even though he never became one of them. And he was certainly as famous as the rest of the Thirty Warriors. So David made him the leader of his own bodyguard.
26-47Here is a list of the other famous warriors:
Asahel the brother of Joab; Elhanan the son of Dodo from Bethlehem; Shammoth from Haror; Helez from Pelon; Ira the son of Ikkesh from Tekoa; Abiezer from Anathoth; Sibbecai the Hushathite; Ilai the Ahohite; Maharai from Netophah; Heled the son of Baanah from Netophah; Ithai the son of Ribai from Gibeah in Benjamin; Benaiah from Pirathon; Hurai from near the streams on Mount Gaash; Abiel from Arbah; Azmaveth from Baharum; Eliahba from Shaalbon; Hashem the Gizonite; Jonathan the son of Shagee from Harar; Ahiam the son of Sachar the Hararite; Eliphal the son of Ur; Hepher from Mecherah; Ahijah from Pelon; Hezro from Carmel; Naarai the son of Ezbai; Joel the brother of Nathan; Mibhar the son of Hagri; Zelek from Ammon; Naharai from Beeroth who carried Joab's weapons; Ira the Ithrite; Gareb the Ithrite; Uriah the Hittite; Zabad the son of Ahlai; Adina the son of Shiza, a leader in the Reuben tribe, and 30 of his soldiers; Hanan the son of Maacah; Joshaphat from Mithan; Uzzia from Ashterah; Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham from Aroer; Jediael and Joha the sons of Shimri from Tiz; Eliel from Mahavah; Jeribai and Joshaviah the sons of Elnaam; Ithmah from Moab; Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel from Mezobah.
translation_text:
Koori Deevid n di Izrɛl ni Juda maa kora wia
1Izrɛl hina dizi maa chaali, di ba Koori Deevid be bolzeŋ Hɛbrɔn, di wa ŋɔ, “Na, yaa ɛɛ i challɛ. 2Saŋa la Koori Sɔɔl n faa haa ɛɛ yaa koori la, ka hinuu ɔɔ faa tɔ Izrɛl hina see, ba gaa yoo laal. Denii Kɔraawiizi la hinna hum la ŋɔ i be, ‘I danna binni n nɛra Izrɛl hina ni, di ɛɛ ba koori.’ ”
3Izrɛl hina nabɔnzi maa n wa ba Koori Deevid be bolzeŋ Hɛbrɔn la, u ni baa ɛɛ nuukpaŋ Kɔraawiizi see, ka ba waaruu nuu, di tɔu Izrɛl kora, gunla Kɔraawiizi n faa ga Samuɛl be, di ŋɔ nua la.
Koori Deevid n kpegli Jɛrusalɛm hina wia
4Koori Deevid ni u laallɔɔra maa izi di la Jɛrusalɛm, bá ga lɔ Jɛbus dee la n du de la. 5A Jɛbus dee ŋɔ Koori Deevid be, “Hàá wer na bɔr zuu ɛŋ.” Haali ani a maa, ka Koori Deevid faa wettoo kpegli a Bolzeŋ Ziɔn diikpeg la. Ba jaa ra yiruu Deevid Bolzeŋ.
6Denii Koori Deevid faa ŋɔ, “Nɛr la maa n niŋ tɔ a laal see, di lɔ Jɛbus dee laal, waabuu niŋ birgi n laallɔɔra nabɔma.” Zɛruya biibaal Joab faa feli lii. Awia, u faa birgi u laallɔɔra nabɔma.
7Koori Deevid ga zuu a diikpeg la di du de. Ba jaa ra yiruu, Deevid Bolzeŋ. 8Denii Koori Deevid ma bar a bolzeŋ maa, haali bɔwillaa la maa baŋ paagi bia di suugi la. Ka Joab ge faa keezi ma u bɔra la maa n kawɛɛ. 9Denii Koori Deevid jaa dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge maa, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ faa du u benii.
Koori Deevid Laallɔkpega wia
10Banla n faa ɛɛ Koori Deevid laallɔkpega n dɔɔ sɔnnɛ keŋ. Ba ni Izrɛl hina maanii faa chigɛ Koori Deevid har, di hiinuu u di kora a hɛri maa ni, gunla Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ nua la. 11Koori Deevid laallɔkpega la sɔnaa keŋ,
Hakmɔn domee hinuu Jasɔbiannɛ faa a nabɔnzi la maa sitɔɔri. U faa kpa kandaarɛ di kpu nɛra kalfaahoroo laalkpaŋ biini.
12Unla n faa hiŋ u ni genii Ahɔ domee hinuu Dɔdai biibaal Ɛliaza. U faa ɛɛ ba laallɔkpega bahoro la bɛllɛ. 13U faa chigɔ Koori Deevid hattɛ, di lɔ laal Pas Damim. A saŋa, di Filisti laallɔɔra faa chaali de bá lɔ laal, koo bɛl baali n faa suwee biini. Izrɛl laallɔɔra faa na Filisti laallɔɔra, di chɔ, 14ka u ni u laallɔɔra waa chi a koo baaŋ chigigi di yoo Filisti hina la, di kpu baa. Kɔraawiizi faa gil ba kpegli baa nɛnnɛ.
15A hɔl bɛl, a laallɔkpega tokko ni kpɔrgɔ la bahoro faa tuu ba Koori Deevid be, bii la n dugli Adulam bii bɔɔ, di Filisti laallɔɔra suge bɛl faa chɔɔ Rɛfam Waluu biini. 16A saŋa hiŋ, di Koori Deevid faa du a diikpeg biini, ka Filisti laallɔɔra suge wa chɔɔ Bɛtlihɛm. 17Denii niinyɔgzi wa lau Koori Deevid werge maa, u ŋɔ, “N bɔra daŋ vii sɔɔni, di nɛbɛl vii la kɔlɔŋ la n dugli Bɛtlihɛm dominuuzeŋ la ga ɛɛ nii wa tɛŋ ń nyɔɔ!” 18Denii a laallɔkpega bahoro la izi, di peri Filisti laallɔɔra la baaŋ di la a kɔlɔŋ, di ga ɛɛ nii wa tɛɛ Koori Deevid, ka u vɛɛ a nyɔɔi, ka bizaa ta hɛri tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, di ŋɔ, 19“Kɔ́raawiizi gilɛɛ waa sɛɛ n waa nyɔɔ nii naa, dikuubɛɛwiai, a daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ baala naa n tulmee naa challɛ n na nyɔɔ gunla!” Awia, u vɛɛ a nyɔɔi. Wizenaa naabuu laallɔkpega bahoro naa faa ɛɛ.
20Joab niwee Abisairɛ faa ɛɛ a Laallɔkpega Tokko Ni Kpɔrgɔ La N Faa Dɔɔ Sɔŋ la sitɔɔri. U faa kpa u kandaarɛ di kpu laallɔɔra kalfaahoro, di jaa dɔɔ sɔŋ werge ba biini. 21Waabuu ba faa ra tɔgzi werge di kaali Bahoro la. Awia, u faa jaa ɛɛ ba sitɔɔri, haali uŋ faa waa ba ni jaawɛ gba.
22Jɛhɔyada biibaal Bɛnaaya n lii bolzeŋ Kabziil ge faa ɛɛ laallɔkpega la bɛllɛ. U ge gba faa ɛɛ wizenaare di kpu Moab hina laallɔkpega banɛɛ. U faa ga tuu bɔɔ bɛl waari hɔpizii, di kpu bunyiŋ. 23U faa kaa kpu Ijip hinuu bɛl n helle kpabaa, u jaŋzi faa ɛɛ naapezi aniidaanɛɛ ni keza. Haali a Ijip hinuu n kpogli kandaa lugɔ kɔɔrɛɛ daa gba, ka Bɛnaaya faa kpa guliire di lɔu, ka foozi u kandaa hiŋ di kpuu. 24Bɛnaaya gba faa dɔɔ sɔnnɛ alugɔ laallɔkpega Bahoro la. Wizenaa la uŋ ɛɛwɛɛ guŋ. 25Waabuu ba faa ra tɔgzi werge kaali Laallɔkpega Tokko Ni Kpɔrgɔ la bɛl maa, ka u faa waa Laallɔkpega Bahoro La ni jaawɛ. Koori Deevid jaa gil u ɛɛ u guure nabɔma. 26Banla n kaa jaa a Laallɔkpega Tokko Ni Kpɔrgɔ ninɛɛ keŋ,
Joab niwee Asahɛl ani
Dɔdɔ biibaal Ɛlhanan n lii Bɛtlihɛm,
27Samɔf la n faa ɛɛ Harɔ hinuu,
Pɛlɔn hinuu Hɛlɛz,
28Ikɛs biibaal Ira n lii Tɛkua,
Abiɛza n lii Anatɔf,
29Husa hinuu Sibɛkai,
Ahɔ hinuu Ilai,
30Nɛtɔfaf hinuu Maharai
ani Nɛtɔfaf hinuu Baana biibaal Hɛlɛd,
31Ribai n lii Gibia n du Bɛnjamin dee biini biibaal Itai,
Piratɔn hinuu Bɛnaaya,
32Hurai n lii Gaas faalime biine.
Araba hinuu Abiɛl,
33Baharum hinuu Azmavɛf,
Saalbɔn hinuu Ɛliaba,
34Gizo hinuu Hasɛm biibaala,
Harar hinuu Sagii biibaal Jonatan.
35Saka la n ɛɛ Harar hinuu biibaal Ahiam,
Ur biibaal Ɛlifal,
36Mɛkɛra hinuu Hɛfa,
Pɛlɔn hinuu Ahija,
37Kamɛl hinuu Hɛzrɔ,
Ɛzbai biibaal Naarai,
38Netan niwee Jowɛl,
Hagri biibaal Mibhar.
39Ammɔn hinuu Zɛlɛk,
Bɛɛrɔf hinuu Naharai la n faa ra kpogli Zɛruya biibaal Joab laal kuna,
40Ira ni Garɛb n ɛɛ Itri hina 41Hitti hinuu Yuria,
Alai biibaal Zabad,
42Rubin naana Siza biibaal Adina la n faa ɛɛ Rubin dee sitɔɔri ani laallɔɔra tokko ni kpɔrgɔ la n faa du u be la,
43Maaka biibaal Hanan,
Mitan hinuu Jɔsafat,
44Astɛra hinuu Uzia,
Aroa hinuu Hɔtam biibaala Sama ni Jɛyɛl,
45Simri biibaal Jɛdiɛl
ni u niwee Tiz hinuu Jɔha,
46Mahava hinuu Ɛliɛl
ani Ɛlnaam biibaala Jɛribai ni Jɔsavia,
Moab hinuu Itma,
47Ɛliɛl, Ɔbɛd ani Mɛzɔba hinuu Jaasiɛl.

english_text:
David's Men at Ziklag
1Some time earlier, David had gone to live in the town of Ziklag to escape from King Saul. While David was there, several brave warriors joined him to help fight his battles.
Warriors from the Benjamin tribe
2Several of these warriors were from King Saul's own tribe of Benjamin. They were experts at using a bow and arrows, and they could shoot an arrow or sling a stone with either hand. 3-7Their leaders were Ahiezer and Joash, the sons of Shemaah from Gibeah. Here is a list of those men from Benjamin: Jeziel and Pelet the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah and Jehu from Anathoth; Ishmaiah from Gibeon, who was the leader of the Thirty Warriors; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, and Jozabad from Gederah; Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, and Shephatiah from Haruph; Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam from the Korah clan; Joelah and Zebadiah the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.
Warriors from the Gad tribe
8Men from the tribe of Gad also joined David at his fortress in the desert and served as his warriors. They were also brave soldiers—fierce as lions and quick as gazelles. They were always prepared to fight with shields and spears. 9-13There were eleven of them, ranked in the following order: Ezer the leader, then Obadiah, Eliab, Mishmannah, Jeremiah, Attai, Eliel, Johanan, Elzabad, Jeremiah, and Machbannai.
14All these men were army officers; some were high-ranking officers over a thousand troops, and others were officers over a hundred troops. 15Earlier, they had crossed the Jordan River when it flooded, and they chased out the people who lived in the valleys on each side of the river.
Warriors from the Benjamin and Judah tribes
16One time a group of men from the tribes of Benjamin and Judah went to the fortress where David was staying. 17David met them outside and said, “If you are coming as friends to fight on my side, then stay and join us. But if you try to turn me over to my enemies, the God our ancestors worshiped will punish you, because I have done nothing wrong.”
18Amasai, who later became the leader of the Thirty Warriors, was one of these men who went to David. God's Spirit took control of him, and he said, “We will join you, David son of Jesse! You and your followers will always be successful, because God fights on your side.”
So David agreed to let them stay, and he even put them in charge of his soldiers who raided enemy villages.
Warriors from the Manasseh tribe
19Some of the warriors who joined David were from the tribe of Manasseh. They had earlier gone with David when he agreed to fight on the side of the Philistines against King Saul. But as soon as the Philistine rulers realized that David might turn against them and rejoin Saul, they sent David away to the town of Ziklag. 20That's when the following men from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai. They had all been commanders in Saul's army 21and brave soldiers, and so David made them officers in his army. They fought on his side when enemy troops attacked.
22Day after day, new men came to join David, and soon he had a large, powerful army.
David's Men at Hebron
23-37The kingdom of Israel had been taken away from Saul, and it now belonged to David. He was ruling from Hebron, and thousands of well-trained soldiers from each tribe went there to crown David king of all Israel, just as the Lord had promised. These soldiers, who were always prepared for battle, included: 6,800 from Judah, who were armed with shields and spears; 7,100 from Simeon; 4,600 from Levi, including Jehoiada, who was a leader from Aaron's descendants, and his 3,700 men, as well as Zadok, who was a brave soldier, and 22 of his relatives, who were also officers; 3,000 from Benjamin, because this was Saul's own tribe and most of the men had remained loyal to him; 20,800 from Ephraim, who were not only brave, but also famous in their clans; 18,000 from West Manasseh, who had been chosen to help make David king; 200 leaders from Issachar, along with troops under their command—these leaders knew the right time to do what needed to be done; 50,000 from Zebulun, who were not only loyal, but also trained to use any weapon; 1,000 officers from Naphtali and 37,000 soldiers armed with shields and spears; 28,600 from Dan; 40,000 from Asher; and 120,000 from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh, who were armed with all kinds of weapons.
38All of these soldiers voluntarily came to Hebron because they wanted David to become king of Israel. In fact, everyone in Israel wanted the same thing. 39The soldiers stayed in Hebron three days, eating and drinking what their relatives had prepared for them. 40Other Israelites from as far away as the territories of Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali brought cattle and sheep to slaughter for food. They also brought donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen that were loaded down with flour, dried figs and raisins, wine, and olive oil.
Everyone in Israel was very happy.
translation_text:
Laallɔɔra n chɔwɛɛ zuu Koori Deevid
1Baala naabuu faa ba Koori Deevid be bolzeŋ Ziklag, saŋa la Kis biibaal Koori Sɔɔl n faa duŋŋuu la. Ba faa jaa laallɔɔra la n faa hiinuu laal biini la ninɛɛ. 2Ba faa vɔɔ laallɛ ni hozi, di faa zum hozi ni bilorizi taazaa ni ba nodige ni nomɛɛla maa werge. Ba faa ɛɛ Koori Sɔɔl lullaa di lii Bɛnjamin dee biini.
3Ahiɛza ni Joasii faa ba sitɔɔra. Ba mɛɛrɛ faa Sɛmaa n lii Gibia. Laallɔɔra la n faa jaawɛɛ keŋ, Azmavɛf biibaala Jɛziɛl, Pɛlɛt, Bɛraka ani Jehu n lii Anatɔf, 4Ismaaya n lii Gibiɔn, u faa ɛɛ laallɔɔrikpeg la n ɛɛ Laallɔkpega Tokko Ni Kpɔrgɔ La sitɔɔra bɛllɛ, Jɛrɛmia, Jahaziɛl, Jɔhanan, Jɔzabad n lii Gɛdɛra 5Ɛluzai, Jɛrimɔf, Bialia, Sɛmaria ani Sɛfatia n lii Haruf, 6Ɛlkana, Issia, Azarɛl, Jɔɛza ni Kɔra hinuu Jasɔbiam, 7Jɔɛla ani Zɛbadia, ba mɛɛrɛ faa Jeroham n lii Gɛdɔ.
8Banniibuu faa lii Gad dee biini di chɔ ga zuu Koori Deevid, di jaa u laallɔɔra ni, u diikpeg, hɛribɔduma biini. Ba faa zum laal lɔirɛ nɛnnɛ, di ɛɛ laal lɔi sirya, di zum laal pɛrɛtuzi ni kandaazi kpoglaa nɛnnɛ. Ba wia faa dɔɔ ɔnsiirɛ alugɔ bunyinzi, ka faa du gbaŋ ge alugɔ sejigzi n du bia nyuuni.
9Ɛzaa faa ba sitɔɔri,
Obadia hiŋ u ni, Ɛliab ge hiŋ,
10Mismana ɛɛ naazuhiŋ, Jɛrɛmia ɛɛ nuehiŋ,
11Atai ɛɛ numbɛlhiŋ, Ɛliɛl ɛɛ niidaanɛɛhiŋ,
12Jɔhanan ɛɛ ŋmantannaazihiŋ, Ɛlzabad ɛɛ kabɛlhiŋ,
13Jɛrɛmia ɛɛ fihiŋ, Makbanai ge ɛɛ fidikpaŋhiŋ.
14Bannii naabuu faa ɛɛ laallɔɔra nabɔnzi di lii Gad dee biini. Ba jigahiŋ ɔɔ faa ɛɛ laallɔɔra kalfa nabɔmaa. Ba nabɔnzeŋ hiŋ ge ɔɔ faa ɛɛ laallɔɔra kagboŋ nabɔma. 15Baabuu faa gi Jɔɔdan muu, lugli baagu biini, saŋa la uŋ faa suwee werge la, di faa ga duŋŋi banla n soge a walli biine, wiifurii ni wiicholii maa.
16A hɔl bɛl Bɛnjamin ni Juda dizi la ge baŋhina faa ba Deevid be, u diikpeg la biini. 17Deevid faa lii ga chem ba ni, di ŋɔ ba be, “Di ii ballɔɔ ni bampirsɔna ií wa hiiniŋ, n ɛɛ siryaa n ni ia ɛɛ nuukpaŋ, ka di ii ballɔɔ ii wa liziŋ tɛɛ n dɔma, filaŋkennaa miŋ waa kalu maa ra lɔ naa, guŋwaa, Kɔ́raawiizi la yaa mɛɛwaa n na hum la di ia seriya.”
18Denii Kɔraawiizi Duma izi Amasai la n ɛɛ a Laallɔɔra Tokko Ni Kpɔrgɔ La sitɔɔri, u ŋɔ,
“N dɔɔri Deevid, Jɛssɛ biibaal, hinuu dɔɔ yaa!
Kɔ́raawiizi tɛɛ i ni banla maa
n na hiinii la nyusum!
Kɔraawiizi la hinna hum la daŋ hiinii.”
Denii Koori Deevid faa lɛɛ baa, ba ɛɛ u laallɔɔra sitɔɔra.
19Manasɛ dee laallɔɔra baŋhina ge faa chɔ di ga zuu Koori Deevid, saŋa la u ni Filisti hina n faa laŋŋɛ bá ga lɔ Koori Sɔɔl laal la. Ka u ni u laallɔɔra la faa waa Filisti hina la hiinee, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba nabɔnzi faa wɔɔ yardɛɛ, awia, ba faa duŋŋuu. Ba faa ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Yaa nyuunii ya kpa turgi kim, di u wa bittɔ chɔ kaali u dɔɔri Koori Sɔɔl be.” 20Saŋa la Koori Deevid n wa la Ziklag la, laallɔɔra naabuu faa lii Manasɛ dee biini, di chɔ la u be, Adna, Jɔzabad, Jɛdiɛl, Maikil, Jɔzabad, Ɛlihu ani Zilɛtai, ba maa faa ɛɛ laallɔɔra kagboŋa sitɔɔraa Manasɛ hɛri. 21Ba faa hiini Koori Deevid ni u laallɔɔraa, ba kpegli ŋmɛɛna sugezi, dikuu baŋ faa ɛɛ laallɔkpega ni sitɔɔra, u laallɔɔra biini wia. 22Hɔpizii maanii baala ɔɔ faa ba di waa hiini Koori Deevid, guŋŋ u laallɔɔra wa du kpil, di du kpeg werge maa.
Koori Deevid laallɔɔra wia
23Laallɔɔra naabuu faa vɔɔ laal di ba Koori Deevid be, bolzeŋ Hɛbrɔn, bá wa kpa Koori Sɔɔl kora tɛɛ Koori Deevid, gunla Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔwɛɛ la. Ba magazii keŋ,
24Banla n faa lii Juda dee biini, di kpogli laal pɛrɛtuzi ni kandaazi, di ɛɛ laal sirya faa du nɛra kagboŋa anumbɛl ni kalfa ŋmantannaazi, 6,800.
25Laallɔɔraa la ge n faa lii Simɛɔn dee biini, di faa ɛɛ laal sirya, du baala kagboŋa aniidaanɛɛ ni kalfa, 7,100.
26Banla ge n lii Levi dee biini, faa du baala kagboŋa anaazu ni kalfanumbɛl, 4,600, 27di kpa Jɛhɔyada n faa ɛɛ Aarɔn diahina sitɔɔri, u baala faa du kagboŋa ahoro ni kalfaaniidaanɛɛ, 3,700 28ani Zadɔk ni u diahina, u faa ɛɛ biipɔllijigaa, di ɛɛ laallɔɔrikpeg. U ge dia laallɔɔra sitɔɔra faa du tokko ni banɛɛ, 22.
29Bɛnjamin ge laallɔɔra faa du kagboŋa ahoro, 3,000, di faa ɛɛ Koori Sɔɔl lulla. Bakpila faa chigɔ Koori Sɔɔl hattɛ guŋŋ di wa lii a hɔl hiŋ.
30Ɛfram baala la n faa ɛɛ laallɔkpega, di dɔɔ sɔna ba domeezi biini, faa du baala kagboŋa tokko ni kalfa ŋmantannaazi, 20,800.
31Laallɔɔra la ge n faa lii Manasɛ dee yeŋ biini, ba faa lizi baa ŋɔ bá wa tɔ Koori Deevid kora, faa du baala kagboŋa fidiŋmantannaazi, 18,000.
32Laallɔɔra la n faa lii Isaka domee biini di faa zum saŋazi, di kaa zum gunla Izrɛl hina n niŋ ɛɛ la, faa du sitɔɔra kalfaanɛɛ, 200 ani ba lulla,
33di lii Zɛbulɔn ge dee biini, baala la n faa zum laal lɔi nɛnnɛ di ɛɛ sirya ni ba dɔŋkuna iri maa ba, bá wa hiini Koori Deevid ni biinihuŋŋu, faa du baala kagboŋa tokkoanɛɛ ni fi, 50,000.
34Baala la n faa lii Naftali dee biini genii faa keŋ, ba sitɔɔra faa du kagboŋ, banla ge n faa kpogli laal pɛrɛtuzi ni kandaazi, faa du kagboŋa tokko ni kpɔrgɔ ani aniidaanɛɛ, 37,000.
