16Brutal enemies attack me
like a pack of dogs,
tearing at my hands
and my feet.
17I can count all my bones,
and my enemies just stare
and sneer at me.
18 They took my clothes
and gambled for them.
19Don't stay far away, Lord!
My strength comes from you,
so hurry and help.
20Rescue me from enemy swords
and save me from those dogs.
21Don't let lions eat me.
You rescued me from the horns
of wild bulls,
22 and when your people meet,
I will praise you, Lord.
23All who worship the Lord,
now praise him!
You belong to Jacob's family
and to the people of Israel,
so fear and honor the Lord!
24The Lord doesn't hate
or despise the helpless
in all of their troubles.
When I cried out, he listened
and did not turn away.
25When your people meet,
you will fill my heart
with your praises, Lord,
and everyone will see me
keep my promises to you.
26The poor will eat and be full,
and all who worship you
will be thankful
and live in hope.
27Everyone on this earth
will remember you, Lord.
People all over the world
will turn and worship you,
28because you are in control,
the ruler of all nations.
29All who are rich
and have more than enough
will bow down to you, Lord.
Even those who are dying
and almost in the grave
will come and bow down.
30In the future, everyone
will worship and learn
about you, our Lord.
31People not yet born
will be told,
“The Lord has saved us!”
translation_text:
Biinichɔg wile ani chɔlaa yir
Koori Deevid yir
1Kɔraawiizi la minna hum,
ɛrɛɛ i giliŋ ta gunnɛi?
N lɔ biinichɔg wilee, di uuri ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa,
ka haŋ hiinee.
2N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bɔchaaŋ maga,
aŋ lɔ wilee tɛi,
ka i siigi,
di lɔu hamuŋa ni,
maa ɔɔ siigi.
3Hinuu di kora di ɛɛ Dɔɔrinaniinanii,
di ɛɛ unla Izrɛl hina n na chɔli.
4Hinuu yaa naabaala faa yardi,
ba dɛlliibuu, i lɛɛ baa.
5Ba faa lɔ wilee tɛi, i lɛɛ baa,
hinuu ba faa yardi,
haa gillɛ ba biine chɔgi.
6Ka miŋwaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ sandul, maa lugɔ newee,
nɛr maa hahŋ di ra gbɛlliŋ.
7Banla maa n naŋ ɔɔ ra ɛɛmbuu chɛɛtɛ,
di ra chagziŋ,
ka ra viigi ba nyuuni,
8di ra ŋɔ, “I yardi Kɔraawiizii,
awia, ú lɛɛi.
Gil u hiinii,
dikuu uŋ nɔŋŋii wia.”
9Ka hinuu hiini n maa u luliŋ,
miŋ faa ɛɛ biifula la,
i guumbuu.
10Hinuu n dɛlli di lii a hɔl la maa baŋ luliŋ la,
i ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la
minna humuu saŋa maa.
11Awia, gilɛɛ giliŋ ta,
tɔɔrɔɔ duglɔɔrɛ,
ka nɛr maa waa hoo ú hiiniŋ.
12N dɔma kpila maa barimbuu alugɔ nabala,
ba barimbuu
alugɔ Basan hɛri nabalkpega.
13Ba haa nuuzii alugɔ bunyinzi,
di ra wii, di ra nyiŋŋi n lawaa.
14N fɔŋŋa tunnɔɔ,
alugɔ baŋ fug nii ta hɛri.
N bɔra huah,
n bampirii ge
ɛɛ lugɔ kel n ŋmɛɛrɛɛ.
15N loobii hillɔɔ alugɔ keŋlii,
n nuuzuŋŋi ge mari n dasama.
I gilimbuu ta bumburi biini ń siu.
16Wichɔgɛɛra barimbuu
alugɔ nuuzihina,
di ra chuuri n nonee
ni n naapezi.
17N daŋ wer kur n hoga maa,
n dɔma ra mamiŋ,
di ra ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ.
18Ba kpa n laalaa bɔnni dɔŋa,
ka ta kuna n tagtajaŋ wia.
19N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gilɛɛ du bɔɔnɛɛ,
hinuu n kpegzi,
ba manaŋ wa lɛɛŋ!
20Lɛɛŋ lii n dɔma tokobi be,
di lɛɛ n miibɔɔ lii nɛra
n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ nuuzihina naa be.
21Lɛɛŋ lii bunyinzi naa be,
di lɛɛŋ lii pirnauna
naa nyigzi be.
22N daŋ bagli i wiɛɛlaa wia tɛɛ n lulla,
di chɔlii bá chaalaa biini.
23“Ii banla n na ɔm Kɔraawiizi, ií ra chɔluu!
Jekɔb dee maa, ií ra tɔgzuu!
Izrɛl hina, ií ra ɔmuu!
24Waa unla n na di tɔɔrɔɔ la vɛɛwɛ
gɛɛ di ra gbɛlluu,
waa har bittɛ kpuu,
ka u nuu u wile la uŋ lɔwɛɛ
ŋɔ u hiinuu labuu.”
25I wiɛɛlaarɛ gillɛ n na chɔlii nɛkpila la n na jaamii la biini,
banla n na ɔmii la seere,
ń lizi mbusuzi lizaa kuna la
miŋ ŋɔ nua lugɔ
n daŋ tɛi la.
26Nyaara daŋ di di piŋ,
banla n na jaami
Kɔraawiizi daŋ chɔluu.
Gil ba nyɛɛli, saŋaa saŋa maa!
27Gil durnya hina maa ra liizi Kɔraawiizi wia,
di ra chɔluu.
Gil hɛssi maa hina
ra jaamuu,
28dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ koorii,
di ra di kora hɛssi maa ni.
29Nɛra la maa n na jigsi daŋ giŋŋi u see jaamuu,
newea maa daŋ giŋŋi
u see jaamuu.
30Banla ban niŋ haa lul danna humuu,
di bagli u wia
tɛɛ ba ge har hina.
31Ba daŋ ŋɔ u wideŋlaa wia
tɛɛ banla baŋ haa waa lullɛ,
lugɔ Kɔraawiizii lɛɛ u nɛra.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
The Good Shepherd
1You, Lord, are my shepherd.
I will never be in need.
2 You let me rest in fields
of green grass.
You lead me to streams
of peaceful water,
3and you refresh my life.
You are true to your name,
and you lead me
along the right paths.
4I may walk through valleys
as dark as death,
but I won't be afraid.
You are with me,
and your shepherd's rod
makes me feel safe.
5You treat me to a feast,
while my enemies watch.
You honor me as your guest,
and you fill my cup
until it overflows.
6Your kindness and love
will always be with me
each day of my life,
and I will live forever
in your house, Lord.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ penɔɔni
Koori Deevid yir
1Kɔraawiizi ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ penɔɔni,
di ra binniŋ,
maa kummaa nyaawɛ.
2U gillɔɔ n chɔɔ kooriilɛɛri biini,
di kpogliŋ la bɔr la
niiri n chɔɔwɛ bɔɔiih.
3U tɛmbuu fɔŋŋafalii.
Di gil n na ɛɛ wia la deŋlee,
dikuu u sɔŋ wia.
4Haali minna vol
bɔbiri limpiriŋ biini gba,
ka maa wichɔgii maa ra ɔm,
dikuu hiŋ du n be wia,
i penɔɔni gulii ni daŋkpala
ra guumbuu.
5I daali diuzenaare tɛŋ
n dɔma see.
I yiili nuu waari n nyuu,
n libee ge su
di ra ta.
6Wibii maa, winanaa ni nɔŋŋaa danna hiŋiŋ,
n de dui biini saŋa maa,
ń jaa du Kɔraawiizi Dia
saŋaa saŋa maa.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
Who Can Enter the Lord's Temple?
1 The earth and everything on it,
including its people,
belong to the Lord.
The world and its people
belong to him.
2The Lord placed it all
on the oceans and rivers.
3Who may climb the Lord's hill
or stand in his holy temple?
4 Only those who do right
for the right reasons,
and don't worship idols
or tell lies under oath.
5The Lord God, who saves them,
will bless and reward them,
6because they worship and serve
the God of Jacob.
7Open the ancient gates,
so that the glorious king
may come in.
8Who is this glorious king?
He is our Lord, a strong
and mighty warrior.
9Open the ancient gates,
so that the glorious king
may come in.
10Who is this glorious king?
He is our Lord,
the All-Powerful!
translation_text:
Koorizeŋ la wia
Koori Deevid yir
1Kɔraawiizii dɔɔ hɛri
ni kuna la maa n du u biini.
Haali newea maa,
2dikuubɛɛwiai, waabuu
mau hɔŋ a muuni ni,
di gil u zɛɛ chi a vile zɛɛzi.
3Anɛɛ n niŋ wer tinni Kɔraawiizi giŋgimii la nyuu,
di zuu u Diinaniinanii lai?
4Waabuu unla n waa wichɔgaa dɔɔwɛ,
u bampirii ge
huuhzi paratata,
waa vuga ra kuari
gɛɛ di hɛɛhzi,
ka ra kanni kara la.
5Kɔraawiizi daŋ kissuu,
ú na giltɛɛi lii
u Lɛɛri Kɔraawiizi be.
6Gunnɛ banla n na ba Kɔraawiizi be la du,
baabuu ɔɔ ra ba
Kɔraawiizi la Jekɔb
n na hum la see.
7Ií pilli dominuuzenaa la, á yaa,
ií pilli faa maa
dominuuzenaa la,
Koori la n dɔɔ girme werge la
wa zuu.
8Anɛɛ a koori naa n dɔɔ girme werge naanɛi?
Waabuu Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa
ni zenni maa hiŋ,
di ɛɛ laallɔkpeg la.
9Ií pilli dominuuzenaa la, á yaa,
ií pilli faa maa
dominuuzenaa la,
Koori la n dɔɔ girme werge la,
wa zuu.
10Anɛɛ a Koori naa n dɔɔ girme werge naanɛi?
Waabuu Kɔraawiizi
Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la
n dɔɔ girme la.

english_text:
(By David.)
A Prayer for Guidance and Help
1I offer you my heart, Lord God,
2and I trust you.
Don't make me ashamed
or let enemies defeat me.
3Don't disappoint any
of your worshipers,
but disappoint all
deceitful liars.
4Show me your paths
and teach me to follow;
5guide me by your truth
and instruct me.
You keep me safe,
and I always trust you.
6Please, Lord, remember,
you have always
been patient and kind.
7Forget each wrong I did
when I was young.
Show how truly kind you are
and remember me.
8You are honest and merciful,
and you teach sinners
how to follow your path.
9You lead humble people
to do what is right
and to stay on your path.
10In everything you do,
you are kind and faithful
to everyone who keeps
our agreement with you.
11Be true to your name, Lord,
by forgiving each one
of my terrible sins.
12You will show the right path
to all who worship you.
13Then they will have plenty,
and their children
will receive the land.
14Our Lord, you are the friend
of your worshipers,
and you make an agreement
with all of us.
15I always look to you,
because you rescue me
from every trap.
16I am lonely and troubled.
Show that you care
and have pity on me.
17My awful worries keep growing.
Rescue me from sadness.
18See my troubles and misery
and forgive my sins.
19Look at all my enemies!
See how much they hate me.
20I come to you for shelter.
Protect me, keep me safe,
and don't disappoint me.
21I obey you with all my heart,
and I trust you, knowing
that you will save me.
22Our God, please save Israel
from all its troubles.
translation_text:
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi baglaa ni guui wia
Koori Deevid yir
1Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, hinuu n suŋŋi,
2hinuu n yardi.
Gilɛɛ gil n di hiihzi,
di gil n dɔma dɔɔ fɔŋŋa n ni.
3Nɛr la maa n yardii ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá di hiihzi,
ka banla waa maa
n dɔɔ dignikpega,
daŋ di hiihzi.
4N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bagliŋ i ŋmɛnizi,
di gil n zumaa.
5Bagliŋ, di gil n zum i wibii, di ra hiŋuu,
dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu
Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ n Lɛɛri,
hinuu n yardi saŋa maa.
6N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a liizi i nɛsunaa
ni i nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia,
i baglaabuu biŋkpila
maa n bɛrɛɛ biine.
7Gilɛɛ ra liizi n pɔlaa saŋa wichɔgaa
ni n dignikpega la wia.
N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i nɛnɔŋŋaa la wia,
a liizi n wia,
dikuubɛɛwiai, i wia wessoo.
8Kɔraawiizi wia wessoo, u wia deŋli,
awia, ɔɔ ra bagli
wichɔgɛɛraa u ŋmɛnizi.
9U ɔɔ hiini sisɔna hinaa ba ra ɛɛ wia la n deŋlee,
di ɔɔ ra bagli baa u ŋmɛnizi.
10Kɔraawiizi ŋmɛnizi maanii ɛɛ nɔŋŋaa ni wibii
tɛɛ banla n na hiŋ
u ni baa nuukpaŋ
widaulaa la.
11N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, dikuu i sɔŋ la wia,
gil n wichɔgaa tɛŋ,
haali aŋ kannɛ werge gba.
12Banla n na ɔm Kɔraawiizi,
daŋ helli lii u be,
ŋmɛnizi la ban ninna hiŋ.
13Ba daŋ nyɛɛli ba de dui saŋa,
ba naanna di a hɛri kapɛttɛ.
14Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ lau banla
n na hiŋ u nuuzii dammunaa,
di gil ba zum u ni baa
nuukpaŋ dɔɔi la wia.
15N dɛlli Kɔraawiizii saŋa maa,
dikuubɛɛwiai, u bɛnnɛ
niŋ wer liziŋ
lii siaahmu biini.
16N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bir n be di na n sinyɛna,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n ɛɛ n bɛnnɛ,
maa fɔŋŋa maa dɔɔwɛ.
17Lɛɛŋ lii n tɔɔrɔɔ biini,
liziŋ lii n biinichɔg biini.
18Binni n tɔɔrɔɔ ni n dɔgnya,
ka gil n wichɔgaa maa tɛŋ.
19Na gunla n dɔma n kpillɛ mag
ni gunla baŋ hahŋ werge maa.
20A binni n ni di lɛɛŋ,
gilɛɛ gil n di hiihzi,
dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu n guuri.
21Jaande maa, gil n winanaa ni n wideŋlaa lɛɛŋ ta,
dikuubɛɛwiai, i benii
n tamii du.
22N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛ Izrɛl hina
lii ba tɔɔrɔɔ maa biini.

english_text:
(By David.)
The Prayer of an Innocent Person
1Show that I am right, Lord!
I stay true to myself,
and I have trusted you
without doubting.
2Test my thoughts and find out
what I am like.
3I never forget your kindness,
and I am always faithful
to you.
4I don't spend my time
with worthless liars
5or go with evil crowds.
6I wash my hands, Lord,
to show my innocence,
and I worship at your altar,
7while gratefully singing
about your wonders.
8I love the temple
where you live, and where
your glory shines.
9Don't sweep me away,
as you do sinners.
Don't punish me with death
as you do those people
who are brutal
10or full of meanness
or who bribe others.
11I stay true to myself.
Be kind and rescue me.
12Now I stand on solid ground!
And when your people meet,
I will praise you, Lord.
translation_text:
Nɛnanii wiisuŋŋaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bagli lugɔ maa wichɔgii maa dɔɔwɛ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n na ɛɛ
wia la n deŋleere.
N yardiibuu nɛnnɛ.
2N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ɛɛŋ na,
di pessi n biini
ni n nfɛrɛ na,
3dikuubɛɛwiai, i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la
ra baglimbuu ŋmɛnɛɛ,
n na hiŋ i wibii ŋmɛnɛɛ
saŋa maa.
4N ni karkanna waa so,
gɛɛ n ni nɛfugze ra kpau.
5N hah wichɔgɛɛra bɔkpaurɛ,
maa ɔɔ sɛɛ n ni
biinikpola hina ge ra so.
6N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n sam n noneere,
di ra bagli lugɔ
maa wichɔgii maa ɛɛwɛ,
ka vol di ra bar
i mbusu lizibɔr la,
di ra jaamii,
7di ra yir yira werge di ra chɔlii,
di ra bagli
i nuukpuuri wia la wia.
8N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
n nɔŋŋi Dia la hin duwɛɛ labuu,
denii i girme du.
9Gilɛɛ waa kpuŋ di ra jaa wichɔgɛɛra ni
gɛɛ di waa kpuŋ
di ra jaa nɛkpuura ni,
10baabuu banla n na ɛɛ
wichɔgaa saŋa maa,
di ɔɔ ɛɛ sirya saŋa maa,
bá ra lɛɛ kuna la.
11Ka miŋwaa ra ɛɛ wia la n deŋleere,
awia, na n sinyɛna,
di lɛɛŋ.
12N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n naazi chigɔ bɔnaniirɛ,
nɛkpila la n ɔɔ chaali
di ra jaami la biini,
n daŋ chɔlii.

english_text:
(By David.)
A Prayer of Praise
1You, Lord, are the light
that keeps me safe.
I am not afraid of anyone.
You protect me,
and I have no fears.
2Brutal people may attack
and try to kill me,
but they will stumble.
Fierce enemies may attack,
but they will fall.
3Armies may surround me,
but I won't be afraid;
war may break out,
but I will trust you.
4I ask only one thing, Lord:
Let me live in your house
every day of my life
to see how wonderful you are
and to pray in your temple.
5In times of trouble, Lord,
you will protect me.
You will hide me in your tent
and keep me safe
on top of a mighty rock.
6You will let me defeat
all my enemies.
Then I will celebrate,
as I enter your tent
with animal sacrifices
and songs of praise.
7Please listen when I pray!
Have pity. Answer my prayer.
8My heart tells me to pray.
I am eager to see your face,
9so don't hide from me.
I am your servant, Lord,
and you have helped me.
Don't turn from me in anger.
You alone keep me safe.
Don't reject or desert me.
10Even if my father and mother
should desert me,
you will take care of me.
11Teach me to follow, Lord,
and lead me on the right path
because of my enemies.
12Don't let them do to me
what they want.
People tell lies about me
and make violent threats,
13but I know I will live
to see how kind you are.
14Trust the Lord!
Be brave and strong
and trust the Lord.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi chɔlaa wiisuŋŋaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1Kɔraawiizi ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ fintina di ra chaaniŋ,
di ɛɛ n Lɛɛri,
anɛɛ ń kaa ra ɔmɛi?
Kɔraawiizi ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ n diikpeg ń de dui biini,
anɛɛ seere ń kaa chi di ra ɔmɛi?
2Di wichɔgɛɛra waa nyiŋŋi ba fɔɔŋ,
di kpuŋ,
ba daŋ lɔɔzi naazi chogli.
3Haali laallɔɔra fɔɔŋ gba,
ka n banchule wàá ra lɔ.
Di ba kpa laal wa pigiŋ gba,
aawaa saŋaa ń dɔɔ bɔkpega.
4N suŋŋi Kɔraawiizii wikpaŋ,
waabuu keŋ,
dí n na zuu u Dia ń de dui biini maa,
di ɔɔ ra binni u wessi,
ń nua kpu,
di ra nyiŋŋi u bɔr, ú Dia biini.
5Dikuubɛɛwiai, u daŋ tɔ n ni tɔɔrɔɔ saŋa,
di kpaŋ du u Tanti Dia, di lɛɛŋ.
Di kpaŋ chiŋŋi
bɔr la min niŋ na n hiŋ.
6Awia, n daŋ kpegli n dɔma la n bariŋ la,
di ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna,
di ra lizi mbusuzi u Tanti Dia biini,
di yir yira di ra chɔluu.
7N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a nuu,
di n wa lɔ wile yirii,
na n sinyɛna,
ka lɛɛ n wiisuŋŋaa.
8Hiŋ faa ŋɔwɛɛ, “Ba wa jaamiŋ.”
N faa sɛɛwɔɔ, di ŋɔ,
“N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
n daŋ ba,
9gilɛɛ bir har kpuŋ!
Gilɛɛ kpa baaŋ
di duŋŋi i balii ta,
hinuu ɛɛ n hiini.
Gilɛɛ vɛɛŋ gɛɛ di kiziŋ ta,
N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
hinuu n Lɛɛri.
10Di n mɛɛ ni n maa gba daŋ kiziŋ ta,
ka Kɔraawiizi daŋ binni n ni.
11N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bagliŋ i ŋmɛnizi,
tɔ n see ŋmɛnideŋlii biini,
dikuu n dɔma wia.
12Gilɛɛ giliŋ tɛɛ n dɔma,
dikuu baŋ kanni kara
di ra chugiŋ,
di kpa kalu ra huuziŋ wia.
13N zummɔ lugɔ n daŋ du de di na
Kɔraawiizi winanaa ɛɛi,
ń de dui naa biini.
14Ií gil ya yardi Kɔraawiizi,
di dɔɔ bɔkpega,
di gilɛɛ gil yaa bɔra ra huah.
Ií gil ya yardi Kɔraawiizi.”

english_text:
(By David.)
A Prayer for Help
1Only you, Lord,
are a mighty rock!
Don't refuse to help me
when I pray.
If you don't answer me,
I will soon be dead.
2Please listen to my prayer
and my cry for help,
as I lift my hands
toward your holy temple.
3Don't drag me away, Lord,
with those cruel people,
who speak kind words,
while planning trouble.
4 Treat them as they deserve!
Punish them for their sins.
5They don't pay any attention
to your wonderful deeds.
Now you will destroy them
and leave them in ruin.
6I praise you, Lord,
for answering my prayers.
7You are my strong shield,
and I trust you completely.
You have helped me,
and I will celebrate
and thank you in song.
8You give strength
to your people, Lord,
and you save and protect
your chosen ones.
9Come save us and bless us.
Be our shepherd and always
carry us in your arms.
translation_text:
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hinuu ra guuŋ,
a nuu n wile naa
miŋ lɔwɛɛ ra tɛi naa.
Di i siigɔɔ,
n daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ banla baŋ hukke.
2A nuu n wile, di n wa yirii ŋɔ i hiiniŋ,
di lalli n nonee chaŋ
i Diinaniinanii la
di ra suŋŋii.
3Gilɛɛ gil n chol seriya biini,
di jaa biinikpola hina ni,
di jaa banla
n na ɛɛ wichɔgaa la ni.
Baabuu banla n ɔɔ ŋɔ bɔsɔna wia di ra tɛɛ ba dɔŋahina,
ka ba biine suugi
ni hahzi la.
4Turgi baa ba wiɛɛlaa
ni ba wichɔgaa la kim,
di turgi baa ba wiɛɛlaa la kim,
gunla maa n dɛkkɛ.
5Baŋ waa Kɔraawiizi huma la uŋ hummɛ,
gɛɛ kuna la uŋ tawɛɛ la
ra tɔgzi wia,
u daŋ tɔɔri baa,
di chɔgi baa kɔrai.
6Ií gil ya chɔli Kɔraawiizi,
dikuu uŋ nuu n wiraa
di suŋ n ni wia.
7Kɔraawiizii ɛɛ n fɔŋŋa ani n guuri,
waabuu n yardi.
U hiinimbuu, n bɔra sɔɔni,
n na chɔluu ni bɔsɔna yira.
8Kɔraawiizii ra guu u nɛra,
waabuu ɔɔ guu,
di lɛɛ koori la
uŋ lizɛɛ tɛɛ u hiŋ la.
9N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛ i nɛra,
di kissi banla maa
n ɛɛ i hora la.
A binni baa alugɔ penɔɔni,
di ra du ba tau saŋaa saŋa maa.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
The Voice of the Lord in a Storm
1 All you angels in heaven,
honor the glory and power
of the Lord!
2Honor the wonderful name
of the Lord,
and worship the Lord
most holy and glorious.
3The voice of the Lord
echoes over the oceans.
The glorious Lord God
thunders above the roar
of the raging sea,
4and his voice is mighty
and marvelous.
5The voice of the Lord
destroys the cedar trees;
the Lord shatters cedars
on Mount Lebanon.
6God makes Mount Lebanon
skip like a calf
and Mount Hermon
jump like a wild ox.
7The voice of the Lord
makes lightning flash
8and the desert tremble.
And because of the Lord,
the desert near Kadesh
shivers and shakes.
9The voice of the Lord
makes deer give birth
before their time.
Forests are stripped of leaves,
and the temple is filled
with shouts of praise.
10The Lord rules on his throne,
king of the flood forever.
11Pray that our Lord
will make us strong
and give us peace.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi loobikpeg wia
Koori Deevid yir
1Kuna la maa n du chiŋ, ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi,
ií ra chɔli u girme
ni u fɔŋŋa la.
2Ií ra sii lugɔ Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ dɔɔ girmee,
ií ra togni unla
n ɛɛ Nɛnaniinanii la,
di u wa ballɔ.
3Ba ra nuu Kɔraawiizi loobiire muuni ni,
Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ girme hiŋ
ra pogzuu lugɔ dooŋ,
u loobii tɔ muuni ni.
4Kɔraawiizi loobii dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa,
u loobii ra bagli
u zenni ni u girmee.
5Kɔraawiizi loobii ɔɔ weruu kuugi hɛriŋkpola,
haali Lɛbanɔn hɛriŋkpola gba.
6U gillɔɔ Lɛbanɔn bizenaa la ra zaahzi alugɔ nabizi,
di gil Bizeŋ Hɛmɔn
ra zaahzi alugɔ nabalee.
7Kɔraawiizi loobii ɔɔ giluu
dooŋ ra nyɛgzi.
8U loobii ɔɔ giluu hɛribɔduma ra zigli,
di gil Kadɛs
hɛribɔduma ra zigli.
9Kɔraawiizi loobii ɔɔ giluu daakpega ra ziigi,
di gil kɔr daazi
paŋhoori maa war.
Ka nɛra la maa n du Kɔraawiizi Dia la ra chaasi, di ra ŋɔ,
“Ií ra tɔgzi Kɔraawiizi!”
10Kɔraawiizi ra di koraa muuni vile ni,
u ra di koraa
saŋaa saŋa maa.
11Kɔraawiizi tɛɛ u nɛraa fɔŋŋa,
di ra kissi baa,
bá dɔɔ bampirsɔna.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the dedication of the temple.)
A Prayer of Thanks
1I will praise you, Lord!
You saved me from the grave
and kept my enemies
from celebrating my death.
2I prayed to you, Lord God,
and you healed me,
3saving me from death
and the grave.
4Your faithful people, Lord,
will praise you with songs
and honor your holy name.
5Your anger lasts a little while,
but your kindness lasts
for a lifetime.
At night we may cry,
but when morning comes
we will celebrate.
6I felt secure and thought,
“I'll never be shaken!”
7You, Lord, were my friend,
and you made me strong
as a mighty mountain.
But when you hid your face,
I was crushed.
8I prayed to you, Lord,
and in my prayer I said,
9“What good will it do you
if I am in the grave?
Once I have turned to dust,
how can I praise you
or tell how loyal you are?
10Have pity, Lord! Help!”
11You have turned my sorrow
into joyful dancing.
No longer am I sad
and wearing sackcloth.
12I thank you from my heart,
and I will never stop
singing your praises,
my Lord and my God.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ tɛɛi wiisuŋŋaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n na chɔliibuu,
dikuubɛɛwiai, i lɛɛmbuu,
haa gillɛ n dɔma
bɔra sɔɔni dikuu n wia.
2Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, n lɔ wilee tɛi ŋɔ i hiiniŋ,
i ba wa chaaŋ,
3di lɛɛŋ lii siu be.
A ka tama bá vii hugiŋ,
ka i bir tɛŋ miibɔɔ.
4Kɔraawiizi nɛra maa, ií yir yira di ra tɛu,
di ra chɔli u sɔnnaniinanii la.
5U baaŋ waa birgi ka ra sɔɔni,
u winanaa ɛɛi
waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
I daŋ wer di ra wii hamuŋa ni,
ka hɔɔ daŋ waa pizi,
di bɔsɔna bɛnnɛ.
6Di n sogaa wa wesso, aŋ ŋɔu,
“N ŋmɛnɛ maa
wàá chol.”
7N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hiŋ faa ɛɛŋ nɛnnɛ la,
i faa gillɔɔ n chi chigigi
alugɔ bizeŋ,
ka hiŋ wa bir har kpuŋ la,
ɔnsii lawiŋ werge maa.
8N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hinuu n lɔ wile tɛɛ,
di ra suŋŋii ŋɔ i hiiniŋ.
9“Beedee tɔnaa í na n siu biinei?
Bɛɛ tɔnaa í na,
di ba huginnei?
Lalaa daŋ wer chɔlii?
Ba daŋ wer sii
i winanaa ɛɛi la
n waa tunaa
dɔɔwɛ la wiaa?
10N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a nuu n be di na n sinyɛna!
Hiiniŋ, n Dɔɔri!”
11Hinuu gillɛ n biinichɔg birgi bɔsɔna,
n na sa.
I lizi n biinichɔgrɛ,
ka tɛŋ bɔsɔna.
12Awia, màá siigi, n daŋ yir yira di chɔlii.
Kɔraawiizi la minna hum,
n danna jaamii
saŋaa saŋa maa.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for Protection
1I come to you, Lord,
for protection.
Don't let me be ashamed.
Do as you have promised
and rescue me.
2Listen to my prayer
and hurry to save me.
Be my mighty rock
and the fortress
where I am safe.
3You, Lord God,
are my mighty rock
and my fortress.
Lead me and guide me,
so that your name
will be honored.
4Protect me from hidden traps
and keep me safe.
5 You are faithful,
and I trust you
because you rescued me.
6I hate the worshipers
of worthless idols,
but I trust you, Lord.
7I celebrate and shout
because you are kind.
You saw all my suffering,
and you cared for me.
8You kept me from the hands
of my enemies,
and you set me free.
9Have pity, Lord!
I am hurting and almost blind.
My whole body aches.
10I have known only sorrow
all my life long, and I suffer
year after year.
I am weak from sin,
and my bones are limp.
11My enemies insult me.
Neighbors are even worse,
and I disgust my friends.
People meet me on the street,
and they turn and run.
12I am completely forgotten
like someone dead.
I am merely a broken dish.
13I hear the crowds whisper,
“Everyone is afraid!”
They are plotting and scheming
to murder me.
14But I trust you, Lord,
and I claim you as my God.
15My life is in your hands.
Save me from enemies
who hunt me down.
16Smile on me, your servant.
Have pity and rescue me.
17I pray only to you.
Don't disappoint me.
Disappoint my cruel enemies
until they lie silent
in their graves.
18Silence those proud liars!
Make them stop bragging
and insulting your people.
19You are wonderful,
and while everyone watches,
you store up blessings for all
who honor and trust you.
20You are their shelter
from harmful plots,
and you are their protection
from vicious gossip.
21I will praise you, Lord,
for showing great kindness
when I was like a city
under attack.
22I was terrified and thought,
“They've chased me
far away from you!”
But you answered my prayer
when I shouted for help.
23 All who belong to the Lord,
show how you love him.
The Lord protects the faithful,
but he severely punishes
everyone who is proud.
24All who trust the Lord,
be cheerful and strong.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi yardaa wiisuŋŋaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n ba i benii í guuŋ,
gilɛɛ gil n ŋmɛnɛ maa
waa di hiihzi,
lɛɛŋ dikuu i wideŋlaa la wia.
2A nuu n be
di lɛɛŋ manaŋ.
Ɛɛ lugɔ n bɔsuahlii,
di guuŋ,
di ɛɛ lugɔ diikpeg,
di lɛɛŋ.
3Hiŋ ɛɛwɛ lugɔ n bɔsuahlii ni n guuri la wia,
tɔ n see
di ra bagliŋ ŋmɛnɛɛ,
dikuu i sɔŋ la wia.
4Lɛɛŋ lii sidɛɛ la baŋ heŋ la ni,
dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu ɛɛwɛ
lugɔ n bɔsuahlii.
5N kpa n dumaa di ra du i nonee biini,
n Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
i ɛɛ wibii hinnɛ, lɛɛŋ.
6N hah banla n na kuari vuga n waa tɔna dɔɔwɛɛ,
ka yardii.
7N bɔra daŋ sɔɔni di ra pur, dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la wia,
i na n dɔgnyaa,
di zum gunla
minna di tɔɔrɔɔrɛ.
8Haŋ kpawɛɛ du n dɔma nonee biini,
ka gil n na vol
bɔr la maa n pariŋ.
9N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, na n sinyɛna,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n du
siaahmu biinii,
n siwee ra wiiu dikuu wiraa werge wia,
n bɔra huah.
10N kuuhwɔɔ, dikuu n biini n chɔkkɛ wia,
màá birgi, dikuu wiraa wia.
N fɔŋŋa maanii tunnɛ, dikuu dɔgnya wia,
n na kɔgi.
11N birgi chɛɛtɛ kunnɛ n dɔma be,
haali n ni banla n duwɛɛ
gba ra gbɛlliŋ.
N dammuzi jaa ra ɔmiŋ,
di ba wa naŋ ŋmɛnizenaa,
a ba ra chɔu.
12Nɛr maanii jaa suuh n wia alugɔ miŋ siuwɛ,
n jaa ɛɛ lugɔ kumpɛɛ.
13N na nuu n dɔma kpila maa
n na munni n wiarɛ.
Ɔnsii werge barimbuu,
ba ra ta jina,
di ra nyiŋŋi n kpui ŋmɛnɛɛ.
14Ka n yardiibuu,
hinuu Kɔraawiizi la
minna hum.
15N saŋazi du i nonee biinii,
lɛɛŋ lii n dɔma ni
banla n gillɛ
n na di tɔɔrɔɔ la be.
16A suŋ i balii ni, di lɛɛŋ,
dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la n waa
tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia.
17N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gilɛɛ gil n di hiihzi,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n wiiwoo tɛi.
Gil biinikpola hina la di hiihzi,
di gil ba chɔɔ sirititi,
ba ŋmama biine.
18Gil karkanna naa nuuzi mar,
baabuu banla
n na jigsi di kpoŋ,
di ɔɔ ŋɔ wia ra gbɛlli
banla wia n deŋlee la.
19I winanaa kannɔɔ werge maa,
i dau tɛɛ banla n na ɔmii.
I ɛɛabuu nɛra see tɛɛ banla
n na nyiŋŋi i guu baa la,
20I see ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ lɔɔ, i kpa baa suah
lii nɛchɔgaa
jinachɔgaa tai be.
Ba na bahinaarɛ i duuribɔr,
ba dɔma wàá ka wer
kpa wia chug baa.
21Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi,
dikuubɛɛwiai, u baglimbuu
u nɔŋŋaa werge maa,
saŋa la miŋ du bolzeŋ la
baŋ fɔɔwɛ biini la.
22N ɔnsii werge la biini,
n faa fɛwɔɔrɛ lugɔ
u duŋŋimbuu ta,
ka u nuu n wilee,
saŋa la miŋ faa lɔ wile
ŋɔ u hiiniŋ la.
23Ií nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizi, ii banla maa n ɛɛ u nɛra la.
Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ guu banla maa
wia n dɔɔ wibiire,
ka ɔɔ tɛrgi banla maa
n na jigsi la dignaa,
gunla n dɛg baa.
24Ií chi nɛnnɛ di dɔɔ bɔkpega,
ii banla maa
n dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi tamii la.

english_text:
(A special psalm by David.)
The Joy of Forgiveness
1 Our Lord, you bless everyone
whose sins you forgive
and wipe away.
2You bless them by saying,
“You told me your sins,
without trying to hide them,
and now I forgive you.”
3Before I confessed my sins,
my bones felt limp,
and I groaned all day long.
4Night and day your hand
weighed heavily on me,
and my strength was gone
as in the summer heat.
5So I confessed my sins
and told them all to you.
I said, “I'll tell the Lord
each one of my sins.”
Then you forgave me
and took away my guilt.
6We worship you, Lord,
and we should always pray
whenever we find out
that we have sinned.
Then we won't be swept away
by a raging flood.
7You are my hiding place!
You protect me from trouble,
and you put songs in my heart
because you have saved me.
8You said to me,
“I will point out the road
that you should follow.
I will be your teacher
and watch over you.
9Don't be stupid
like horses and mules
that must be led with ropes
to make them obey.”
10All kinds of troubles
will strike the wicked,
but your kindness shields those
who trust you, Lord.
11And so your good people
should celebrate and shout.
translation_text:
Chɔgri sɛɛi ni gil tɛɛi wia
Koori Deevid yir
1Nɛr la maa Kɔraawiizi n gil u wichɔgaa tɛu,
di lizaa u ni la,
nuu sumaa.
2Nɛr la maa Kɔraawiizi
n wàá pɛɛzuu u wichɔgaa wia,
ani unla ge n waa daraa dɔɔwɛ,
nuu sumaa.
3Di maa haŋ wa sɛɛ chɔgri dikuu n wichɔgaa wia,
a ɔɔ ɛɛmbuu bɔhuaih,
n na wii
hɔpizaa maa biini.
4Hɔpizaa ni hamuŋa maa,
ɛɛ ra tɔɔrimbuu.
N fɔŋŋa maanii tunnɛ
alugɔ lumaŋwiizi
n gillɛ nii hiihzi la.
5Awiarɛ n bagli n wichɔgaa tɛi,
màá kpawɛɛ suah i ni.
N bagli n wichɔgaarɛ tɛi,
i gil a maa tɛŋ.
6Awia, gil banla maa n nɔŋŋii la ra suŋŋii bá anuula saŋa,
di tɔɔrɔɔ lugɔ niizenaa
suwoo pal di ra ba,
ka wàá hel baa.
7I ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ n bɔsuahlii,
i daŋ guŋŋ lii tɔɔrɔɔ biini.
Ń yir yira,
dikuu hiŋ lɛɛŋ
lii tɔɔrɔɔ biini wia.
8Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“N daŋ baglii ŋmɛnɛɛ la
hin ninna hiŋ,
di ŋɔ wia hiinii,
di ra binni i ni.
9Gilɛɛ gɛni alugɔ zagu gɛɛ kawee la
baŋ ɔɔ kpa kabarga du u nua,
guŋ gil u ra sɛɛ dɔɔra la.”
10Biinikpola hina tɔɔrɔɔ kannɔɔ werge maa,
ka banla waa
n yardi Kɔraawiizi,
u nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la,
ra guu baabuu
saŋaa saŋa maa.
11Ií banla wia n deŋlee Kɔraawiizi be la,
ii gil ii bɔra sɔɔni,
dikuu gunla uŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia.
Ií banla n na hiŋ u nua,
ií ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna!

english_text:
Sing Praises to the Lord
1You are the Lord's people.
Obey him and celebrate!
He deserves your praise.
2Praise the Lord with harps!
Use harps with ten strings
to make music for him.
3Sing a new song. Shout!
Play beautiful music.
4The Lord is truthful;
he can be trusted.
5He loves justice and fairness,
and he is kind to everyone
everywhere on earth.
6The Lord made the heavens
and everything in them
by his word.
7He scooped up the ocean
and stored the water.
8Everyone in this world
should worship and honor
the Lord!
9As soon as he spoke
the world was created;
at his command,
the earth was formed.
10The Lord destroys the plans
and spoils the schemes
of the nations.
11But what the Lord has planned
will stand forever.
His thoughts never change.
12The Lord blesses each nation
that worships only him.
He blesses his chosen ones.
13The Lord looks at the world
14from his throne in heaven,
and he watches us all.
15The Lord gave us each a mind,
and nothing we do
can be hidden from him.
16 Mighty armies alone
cannot win wars for a king;
great strength by itself
cannot keep a soldier safe.
17In war the strength of a horse
cannot be trusted
to take you to safety.
18But the Lord watches over
all
who honor him
and trust his kindness.
19He protects them from death
and starvation.
20We depend on you, Lord,
to help and protect us.
21You make our hearts glad
because we trust you,
the only God.
22Be kind and bless us!
We depend on you.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi chɔlaa yir
1Ií banla wia n deŋlee,
ií ra yir yira ni bɔsɔna
di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi,
a dɛkkɔɔ banla wia n deŋlee la
n na chɔluu.
2Ií lɔ kem di ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi,
ií lɔ janjalaŋ di yir yira
di ra chɔluu.
3Ií yir yirfalii tɛu,
di ra lɔ kem nɛnnɛ,
di ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna.
4Wibii maa, Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii deŋloore,
u wiɛɛlaa maa ge dɔɔ wibii.
5U nɔŋŋi wideŋlaa ni wibii dii wiarɛ,
u nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ
yaari hɛri naa maanii.
6Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ wiarɛ, chiŋ du de,
u wiŋɔɔliirɛ gillɛ
wiizi, baagu
ani chinchiŋwilaa
maa du de.
7U chaali muuni niirii du bɔkpaŋ,
di kpa a vile dau dia la biini
unna dau kuna la.
8Ií gil durnya hina maa ra ɔm Kɔraawiizi!
Ií gil ba maa ra tɔgzuu!
9Dikuu uŋ ŋɔ wia di ta durnya,
di gil u chi chigigi wia.
10Kɔraawiizi chɔgi a hɛssi hina jinazii,
di tɔ bá winyiŋŋaa ŋmɛnizi.
11Ka Kɔraawiiziwaa jinazi chigɔɔ chigigi, di hanna la,
u kipar du denii,
saŋaa saŋa maa.
12Hɛri la hina n na hum Kɔraawiizi, nuu sumaa,
baabuu nɛra la uŋ lizɛɛ
ba ɛɛ u hora la!
13Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ du chinne ka binni,
di na newea maa
durnya naa biini.
14U sogo ú koorikara ninɛɛ,
ka ra binni
hɛri naa zuura maa.
15Waabuu tɛɛ nɛr maa nfɛrɛ,
di zum bɛl maa wiɛɛlaa.
16Laallɔɔrakpila lɛi niŋ wer lɛɛ koori,
laallɔɔri ge himmaa
fɔŋŋa werge lɛi
niŋ wer lɛɛu.
17Gilɛɛ salli i laal zagu ni ú lɛɛi,
haali un dɔɔ
fɔŋŋa werge gba,
ka wàá wer lɛɛi.
18Kɔraawiizi ra binni banla maa n na hiŋ u nuarɛ,
baabuu banla
n dɔɔ u nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ
tamii la.
19Ú lɛɛ baa lii siu be,
di tɛɛ baa miibɔɔ,
lɔchɔgii saŋa.
20Kɔraawiizi ninɛɛ yaa tamii du,
waabuu ɛɛ yaa guuri
ni yaa hiini.
21Yaa bɔra sɔɔnɔɔrɛ u wia,
yaa yardi
u sɔnnaniinanii labuu.
22N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
gil i nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la,
du yaa be,
dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa tamii maa
du i ninɛɛ.

english_text:
(Written by David when he pretended to be crazy in front of Abimelech, so that Abimelech would send him away, and David could leave.)
Honor the Lord
1 I will always praise the Lord.
2With all my heart,
I will praise the Lord.
Let all who are helpless,
listen and be glad.
3Honor the Lord with me!
Celebrate his great name.
4I asked the Lord for help,
and he saved me
from all my fears.
5Keep your eyes on the Lord!
You will shine like the sun
and never blush with shame.
6I was a nobody, but I prayed,
and the Lord saved me
from all my troubles.
7If you honor the Lord,
his angel will protect you.
8 Discover for yourself
that the Lord is kind.
Come to him for protection,
and you will be glad.
9Honor the Lord!
You are his special people.
No one who honors the Lord
will ever be in need.
10Young lions may go hungry
or even starve,
but if you trust the Lord,
you will never miss out
on anything good.
11Come, my children, listen
as I teach you
to respect the Lord.
12 Do you want to live
and enjoy a long life?
13Then don't say cruel things
and don't tell lies.
14Do good instead of evil
and try to live at peace.
15If you obey the Lord,
he will watch over you
and answer your prayers.
16But God despises evil people,
and he will wipe them all
from the earth,
till they are forgotten.
17When his people pray for help,
he listens and rescues them
from their troubles.
18The Lord is there to rescue
all
who are discouraged
and have given up hope.
19The Lord's people
may suffer a lot,
but he will always
bring them safely through.
20 Not one of their bones
will ever be broken.
21Wicked people are killed
by their own evil deeds,
and if you hate God's people
you will be punished.
22The Lord saves the lives
of his servants.
Run to him for protection,
and you won't be punished.
translation_text:
Koori Deevid ni Koori Abimɛlɛk wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N danna jaami Kɔraawiizi saŋa maa,
màá gil u chɔlaa maa.
2N danna jigsi dikuu Kɔraawiizi wia,
ií gil banla maa
banna sunni nuu guŋ,
bá bɔra sɔɔni!
3Ií gil n ni ia ra sii Kɔraawiizi zenni wia,
ií gil ya kpau
di ra chɔli u sɔŋ!
4N suŋŋi Kɔraawiizii, u nuu n wiisuŋŋaa,
di lɛɛŋ lii ɔnsii maa biini.
5Banla maa n dɛlluu, bɔra ɔɔ sɔɔnuu,
hiihzi ŋmɛnɛ maa
wàá kpu baa.
6Dɔgnya hina ɔɔ lɔ wilee, Kɔraawiizi nuu ba be,
di lɛɛ baa lii
ba tɔɔrɔɔ maa biini.
7Kɔraawiizi mɛlika ɔɔ ra guu banla maa n na tɔgzuubuu,
di lɛɛ baa
lii siaahmu biini.
8Ií daŋ, di na gunla Kɔraawiizi wia n wesse.
Nɛra la maa
n chɔwɛɛ zuu Kɔraawiizi,
nuu sumaa.
9Ií ra ɔm Kɔraawiizi, ii banla n ɛɛ u nɛra la,
banla n na hiŋ u nua,
waa kummaa nyaawɛ.
10Saŋa bɛl, bunyinzi ɔɔ nyaa diweere, lɔzi ra kpua, a ra bɛɛli,
ka banlawaa
n na hiŋ Kɔraawiizi nua,
waa kunnanii maa nyaawɛ.
11N biizi, ií ba waa nuu n be,
n daŋ bagli ia gunla
Kɔraawiizi ɔmaa n duwɛɛ.
12Ii ra nyiŋŋi iihinaa diirea?
Ii ra kɛlli miibɔɔjaŋ
ani bɔsɔnaa?
13Guŋwaa, ií gilɛɛ ra ŋɔ wikuna,
di gilɛɛ ra dar nɛra.
14Ií bir har kpu wichɔgaa, ka ra ɛɛ winanaa,
di aah siwii
di ra nyiŋŋi nuukpaŋ dɔɔi.
15Kɔraawiizi ra du nɛra la wia n deŋlee taurɛ,
di ɔɔ ra nuu ba wile,
16ka ra naa banla n na ɛɛ wichɔgaa,
di ba wa siuwɔ,
bá suuh ba wia manaŋ.
17Di nɛra la wia n deŋlee wa lɔ wile,
Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ nuuu,
di lɛɛ baa lii
ba tɔɔrɔɔzi maa biine.
18Kɔraawiizi dugli banla biine n chɔkkɛ labuu,
di ɔɔ ra lɛɛ banla bɔra n huahwɛ.
19Nɛr la wia n deŋlee daŋ wer ra di tɔɔrɔɔ kpila,
ka Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ lɛɛubuu
lii a maa biine.
20Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ guuubuu nɛnnɛ,
ba wàá ku u hog maa.
21Wikunaa niŋ kpu biinikpola hina,
Ba daŋ tɛr banla ge
n hah nɛra
la wia n deŋlee, digna.
22Kɔraawiizi daŋ lɛɛ u nɛra ta,
banla n niŋ chɔ ga zuuu,
daŋ na bahinaa.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
A Prayer for Protection from Enemies
1Fight my enemies, Lord!
Attack my attackers!
2Shield me and help me.
3Aim your spear at everyone
who hunts me down,
but promise to save me.
4Let all who want to kill me
be disgraced
and put to shame.
Chase away and confuse
all who plan to harm me.
5Send your angel after them
and let them be like straw
in the wind.
6Make them run in the dark
on a slippery road,
as your angel chases them.
7I did them no harm,
but they hid a net
to trap me,
and they dug a deep pit
to catch and kill me.
8 Surprise them with disaster!
Trap them in their own nets
and let them fall and rot
in the pits they have dug.
9I will celebrate and be joyful
because you, Lord,
have saved me.
10Every bone in my body
will shout:
“No one is like the Lord!”
You protect the helpless
from those in power;
you save the poor and needy
from those who hurt them.
11Liars accuse me of crimes
I know nothing about.
12They repay evil for good,
and I feel all alone.
13When they were sick,
I wore sackcloth
and went without food.
I truly prayed for them,
14as I would for a friend
or a relative.
I was in sorrow and mourned,
as I would for my mother.
15I have stumbled,
and worthless liars
I don't even know
surround me and sneer.
16Worthless people make fun
and never stop laughing.
17But all you do is watch!
When will you do something?
Save me from the attack
of those vicious lions.
18And when your people meet,
I will praise you
and thank you, Lord,
in front of them all.
19 Don't let my brutal enemies
be glad because of me.
They hate me for no reason.
Don't let them wink
behind my back.
20They say hurtful things,
and they lie to people
who want to live in peace.
21They are quick to accuse me.
They say, “You did it!
We saw you ourselves.”
22You see everything, Lord!
Please don't keep silent
or stay so far away.
23Fight to defend me, Lord God,
24and prove that I am right
by your standards.
Don't let them laugh at me
25or say to each other,
“Now we've got what we want!
We'll gobble him up!”
26Disappoint and confuse
all who are glad
to see me in trouble;
disgrace and embarrass
my proud enemies who say to me,
“You are nothing!”
27Let all who want me to win
be happy and joyful.
From now on let them say,
“The Lord is wonderful!
God is glad when all goes well
for his servant.”
28Then I will shout all day,
“Praise the Lord God!
He did what was right.”
translation_text:
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ɛɛ banla n ɛɛ n dɔma dɔm,
di ra yoo banla n na yooŋ.
2Kpa i laal kuna,
di wa lɛɛŋ.
3Lalli i kandaa ni i laal kpaŋfɔ,
di yoo banla
n na duŋŋiŋ la.
Ŋɔ nua tɛŋ
lugɔ i daŋ lɛɛŋ.
4Gil banla n na nyiŋŋi bá kpuŋ la
chol di di hiihzi!
Gil banla n na ta n kpui jina la
bir har di bugmi.
5Gil bá ɛɛ lugɔ zɔga, peu lɔa di ra kaali,
Kɔ́raawiizi mɛlika duŋŋaa
di ra kaali.
6Gil ba ŋmɛnibee biri, di ra hɛhrgi,
saŋa la Kɔraawiizi mɛlika
n na duŋŋi baa la.
7Dikuubɛɛwiai, maa wiimaa ɛɛwɛ,
ka ba heŋ sidɛɛ,
di ki bɔɔluŋ
ń chol u biini.
8Gil tɔɔrɔɔ chɔgii pirgi baa,
di gil sidɛɛ la
baŋ hewee la
bir lau baa,
bá chol a bɔɔluŋ biini,
bá wia chɔgi.
9Denii ń bɔra jaa sɔɔni, dikuu Kɔraawiizi wia,
n bɔra daŋ sɔɔni
dikuu uŋ lɛɛŋ la wia.
10Awia, n daŋ ŋɔ ni n biini maa,
“N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
anɛɛ n lugɔinɛi?
I lɛɛ gɛrgaa lii kpeglega be,
di lɛɛ nyaara
ni anuula hina,
lii banla n na fini
baa la be.”
11Nɛchɔgaa kanni karaa chugiŋ,
di ra pɛɛziŋ wia la
miŋ waa zummɛ.
12Ba kpa wichɔgaarɛ turgi n winanaa kim,
guŋ gil n biini chɔg werge.
13Ka miŋwaa, wiila n wa lau baa, n laali gbɔglɔnnɛ,
di vɔɔ nua, di suŋŋi wiizi
14gunla min niŋ
suŋŋi wiizi tɛɛ
n dammu gɛɛ n kpɛɛma,
di vol di ra bar alugɔ nɛr
n na wii u maa lee la.
15Ka miŋ wa du tɔɔrɔɔ biini,
ba maa bɔra faa sɔɔnɔɔrɛ,
ba chaali bariŋ, di ra ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ,
hɔɔhra ra lɔɔziŋ.
16Ba ra ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ alugɔ banla n waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ,
di hee nyina ra duŋ.
17N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ɛrɛɛ magaa i binni guŋ birgi magɛi?
Lɛɛŋ lii ba nonee biini,
di lɛɛŋ lii n dɔma la
n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ
bunyinzi naa be!
18Denii n jaa jaamii, i nɛra n chaalɛɛ la biini,
di chɔlii ba maa sibɔɔ.
19Gilɛɛ gil n dɔma bɔra sɔɔni,
dikuu n tɔɔrɔɔ dii wia.
Gilɛɛ gil banla n hahŋ pɛɛpɛɛ la ra gɛɛniŋ,
dikuu n biinichɔg wia.
20Ba waa bampirsɔna wiŋɔzi ra ŋɔ,
ka ɔɔ kanni kara
di ra chug
banla n du a hɛri,
ba waa hagzi la.
21Ba ɔɔ aah siwiire kpa wia ra chugiŋ,
di ra ŋɔ,
“Ahaah! Ahaah!
Yaa himmaa
siwee nawɔɔrɛ!”
22Ka hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi na gunnɛ,
awia, gilɛɛ siigi,
gilɛɛ lii n be
kaali bɔɔnɛɛ!
23Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, izi chiŋ,
di naa lɛɛŋ.
24N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i wia deŋloore,
gilɛɛ gil n di bilchɔg,
di gilɛɛ gil
n dɔma ra ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ.
25Gilɛɛ gil bá ra ŋɔ, “Tibaarikala, yaa na yaa kipattɛ!”
Gɛɛ di ŋɔ,
“Yaa tuŋ u wiarɛ!”
26Gil banla bɔra n sɔɔnɛɛ n tɔɔrɔɔ dii wia la,
di hiihzi di bugmi.
Gil banla n na fɛ lugɔ ba ɛɛ nɛnanaarɛ kaaliŋ la,
di hiihzi, di ŋmaabi.
27Gil banla n na nyiŋŋi lugɔ n lii bilchɔg biini la
ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna,
di ra ŋɔ saŋa maa,
“Kɔraawiizi zenni kannɔɔ,
u bɔra ɔɔ sɔɔnuu,
di u balii bampirii
wa chɔɔ bɔkpaŋ.”
28Denii ń jaa sii Kɔraawiizi wideŋlaa wia,
di ra chɔluu
hɔpizaa maa biini.

english_text:
(For the music leader by David, the Lord's servant.)
Human Sin and God's Goodness
1 Sinners don't respect God;
sin is all they think about.
2They like themselves too much
to hate their own sins
or even to see them.
3They tell deceitful lies,
and they don't have the sense
to live right.
4Those people stay awake,
thinking up mischief,
and they follow the wrong road,
refusing to turn from sin.
5Your love is faithful, Lord,
and even the clouds in the sky
can depend on you.
6Your decisions are always fair.
They are firm like mountains,
deep like the sea,
and all people and animals
are under your care.
7Your love is a treasure,
and everyone finds shelter
in the shadow of your wings.
8You give your guests a feast
in your house,
and you serve a tasty drink
that flows like a river.
9The life-giving fountain
belongs to you,
and your light gives light
to each of us.
10Our Lord, keep showing love
to everyone who knows you,
and use your power to save all
whose thoughts please you.
11Don't let those proud
and merciless people
kick me around
or chase me away.
12Look at those wicked people!
They are knocked down,
never to get up again.
translation_text:
Newee biinikpola wia
Koori Deevid yir
1Kɔraawiizi amaniye du n bampiriire,
di ra bagli wichɔgɛɛra manni,
ba waa Kɔraawiizi ra ɔm.
2Dikuu baŋ ɔɔ ra kpa bahinaa zenni werge wia,
ba ɔɔ fɛu lugɔ
Kɔraawiizi wàá na ba wichɔgaa,
di ŋmaabi baa.
3Ba wiŋɔzi maa ɔɔ ɛɛ kara ni biinikpola wiŋɔzii,
awia, ba gil nunzuma
ni winanaa ɛɛirɛ.
4Haali ba ɔɔ chɔɔ ba chɔɔribɔraa, di ra ta wichɔgaa ɛɛi jina,
di ɛɛ wichɔgaa ɛɛi sirya,
ba waa wichɔgaa maa
ɛɛi ra vɛɛ.
5N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la,
kannɔɔ werge kaali kummaa,
gunnɛ i wibii dɔɔi gba du.
6I wideŋlaa kannɔɔ alugɔ bizenaa,
i wibii dii ge du luŋ alugɔ
muuzenaa vile.
Hinuu ra binni newea ni sela maa ni.
7I nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la dɔɔ tɔnaa werge!
I ra guu yaabuu
alugɔ zal n ɔɔ yaa u keeri tɔ
u biizi ni la.
8Ba ɔɔ ra di i dia diuzenaa labuu,
i winanaa ɔɔ ra paluu
alugɔ muu, ba ra nyɔɔ.
9I benii miibɔɔ du,
i bɔchaaŋ biinii
yaa ra na bɔr.
10Gil i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la du banla n na hiŋii la be,
di ɛɛ winanaa ra tɛɛ
banla wia n deŋlee la.
11Gilɛɛ gil banla n na jigsi la waa fɔɔŋ,
gɛɛ di gil
biinikpola hina waa duŋŋiŋ.
12Na gunla wichɔgɛɛra n choglee chɔɔgi,
ba chogloore,
ba wàá ka wer izi.

english_text:
(By David.)
Trust the Lord
1Don't be annoyed by anyone
who does wrong,
and don't envy them.
2They will soon disappear
like grass without rain.
3Trust the Lord and live right!
The land will be yours,
and you will be safe.
4Do what the Lord wants,
and he will give you
your heart's desire.
5Let the Lord lead you
and trust him to help.
6Then it will be as clear
as the noonday sun
that you were right.
7Be patient and trust the Lord.
Don't let it bother you
when all goes well for those
who do sinful things.
8Don't be angry or furious.
Anger can lead to sin.
9All sinners will disappear,
but if you trust the Lord,
the land will be yours.
10Sinners will soon disappear,
never to be found,
11 but the poor will take the land
and enjoy a big harvest.
12Merciless people make plots
against good people
and snarl like animals,
13but the Lord laughs and knows
their time is coming soon.
14The wicked kill with swords
and shoot arrows to murder
the poor and the needy
and all who do right.
15But they will be killed
by their own swords,
and their arrows
will be broken.
16It is better to live right
and be poor
than to be sinful and rich.
17The wicked will lose all
of their power,
but the Lord gives strength
to everyone who is good.
18Those who obey the Lord
are daily in his care,
and what he has given them
will be theirs forever.
19They won't be in trouble
when times are bad,
and they will have plenty
when food is scarce.
20Wicked people are enemies
of the Lord
and will vanish like smoke
from a field on fire.
21An evil person borrows
and never pays back;
a good person is generous
and never stops giving.
22Everyone the Lord blesses
will receive the land;
everyone the Lord curses
will be destroyed.
23If you do what the Lord wants,
he will make certain
each step you take is sure.
24The Lord will hold your hand,
and if you stumble,
you still won't fall.
25As long as I can remember,
good people have never
been left helpless,
and their children have never
gone begging for food.
26They gladly give and lend,
and their children
turn out good.
27If you stop sinning
and start doing right,
you will keep living
and be secure forever.
28The Lord loves justice,
and he won't ever desert
his faithful people.
He always protects them,
but destroys the children
of the wicked.
29God's people will own the land
and live here forever.
30Words of wisdom come
when good people speak
for justice.
31They remember God's teachings,
and they never take
a wrong step.
32The wicked try to trap
and kill good people,
33but the Lord is on their side,
and he will defend them
when they are on trial.
34Trust the Lord and follow him.
He will give you the land,
and you will see
the wicked destroyed.
35I have seen brutal people
abuse others and grow strong
like trees in rich soil.
36Suddenly they disappeared!
I looked, but they were gone
and no longer there.
37Think of the bright future
waiting for all the families
of honest, innocent,
and peace-loving people.
38But not a trace will be left
of the wicked
or their families.
39The Lord protects his people,
and they can come to him
in times of trouble.
40The Lord helps his people
and saves them from the wicked
because they run to him.
translation_text:
Yardi Kɔraawiizi
Koori Deevid yir
1Ií gilɛɛ gil biinikpola hina wia tir ia,
gɛɛ di gil ii bɔra ra wii
dikuu wichɔgɛɛra wia.
2A wàá birgi ka bá siuzi alugɔ kooree,
di siuzi alugɔ paŋhoori
n ɔɔ war la.
3Ií yardi Kɔraawiizi, di ra ɛɛ winanaa,
di du a hɛri, di dɔɔ iihinaa.
4Ii ra nyiŋŋi bɔsɔna Kɔraawiizi be,
gunnɛ ú tɛɛ ia ii kipar kuna.
5Ií kpa iihinaa tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi,
di yarduu, u daŋ hiini ia.
6U daŋ gil ii wideŋlaa ra chaani lugɔ hɔpizaa,
ii wibii dii ge ra chaani
lugɔ wibaŋwiizi.
7Ií dɔɔ kanyitti di ra kpaŋ Kɔraawiizi,
di gilɛɛ gil banla
n na nyɛɛli wia tir ia
gɛɛ banla wichɔgaa jinazi
n ɔɔ wa ɛɛ wibii la.
8Ií gil baaŋfuuih ni biinichɔg wia,
a ra ba tɔɔrɔɔ ninɛɛ.
9Banla n yardi Kɔraawiizi la,
baabuu niŋ dɔɔ a hɛri,
ka bá duŋŋi
biinikpola hina waa.
10A ka tama, ka biinikpola hina wia tuŋ kɔrai,
di ii ra nyiŋŋi
ii na baa gba,
ka ba wàá du de.
11Ka banla n dɔɔ sisɔna labuu niŋ dɔɔ a hɛri,
di dɔɔ daama
ni bɔsɔna werge.
12Biinikpola hiŋ ɔɔ ra ta nɛra la wia n deŋlee chɔgri jinaa,
di ra fiili baa ani hahzi.
13Ka Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra mam biinikpola hinaa,
dikuubɛɛwiai, u zummɔɔ lugɔ
ba chɔgaa hɔpizii helloo.
14Biinikpola hina panzi ba tokobizii,
di lalli ba hozi,
bá kpu nyaara, anuula hina
ni banla n na ɛɛ wideŋlaa,
15ka ba himmaa tokobizii niŋ bir kpu baa,
bá hozi ge kuugi.
16Tama la nɛnanii n dɔɔwɛɛ
bɔ daama werge la
biinikpola hina n dɔɔwɛ,
17dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi daŋ chɔgi biinikpola hina fɔŋŋa,
ka guu nɛnanaa waa.
18Kɔraawiizi ra du banla maa
n waa chɔgri dɔɔwɛ taurɛ,
ba hɛri daŋ du de di hanna la.
19Ba wàá di tɔrɔɔ hɛhchɔg saŋa,
lɔchɔgii ge saŋa,
ba daŋ dɔɔ diwee werge.
20Ka biinikpola hina waa wia daŋ tuŋ,
banla n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi dɔma
wia daŋ tuŋ
alugɔ fiiri n wattɛ chogli,
di kaali alugɔ nyɔɔzi
n kaali chiŋ la.
21Biinikpola hiŋ ɔɔ kimuu, ka vɛɛ turgaa,
ka nɛnanii waa dɔɔ bunyaa.
22Banla Kɔraawiizi n kisseere niŋ dɔɔ a hɛri,
ka duŋŋi banlawaa
uŋ see nua lii de.
23Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra bagli nɛraa ŋmɛnizi la ban ninna hiŋ,
di ra guu banla wia n paruu.
24Di ba lɔɔzi naazi gba, ka ba wàá chogli,
dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi
lauri ba noneere kpogli.
25N ɛɛ bazɛŋaa filaŋkeŋ, di di biŋkpila,
ka n ŋmɛnɛ maa
haa waa nawɛɛ
Kɔraawiizi n vɛɛ nɛnanaa ta,
gɛɛ di na ba biizi
n na suŋŋi diwee.
26Ba ɔɔ dɔɔ bunyaa saŋa maa,
di kpa kuna
ra kim nɛra pɛɛpɛɛ,
ba biizi daŋ nuu suma.
27Ií gil wichɔgaa ɛɛi, ka ra ɛɛ winanaa,
denii ii du a hɛri di hanna la,
28dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi nɔŋŋi wia la n deŋleere,
wàá vɛɛ u wibii hina ta.
U daŋ guu baa di hanna la,
ka u daŋ duŋŋi
biinikpola hina
waa lii a hɛri biini.
29Banla wia n deŋlee daŋ dɔɔ a hɛri,
di ra zuu de
saŋaa saŋa maa.
30Nunzuma wia ɔɔ ra lii nɛra la wia deŋlee nuuzii,
ba nuuzi ge ɔɔ ra di wibiire.
31Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la gbɔg du ba bampireere,
ba waa har bittɛ ra kpuu.
32Biinikpola hina ɔɔ chɔɔu guu nɛra la wia n deŋleere,
di ra nyiŋŋi ba kpui,
33ka Kɔraawiizi wàá gil baa du ba nonee biine,
gɛɛ di gil
bá di baa seriya bá chol.
34Ií yardi Kɔraawiizi,
di ra hiŋ u widaulaa.
U daŋ kpa tɔgzi, di gil ii dɔɔ a hɛri,
di u waa duŋŋi
biinikpola hina,
ii siwee daŋ na.
35N ŋmɛnɛ faa zum biinikpola hiŋ bɛl n waa nɛra ni ra suŋ,
ka u sogaa faa du wer
lugɔ daa n chigɛ hɛrnanii
di lɔɔ nɛnnɛ,
36ka a harbɔɔ, n faa ga de di u siuwɔ,
n binni u bɔr, ka mɔɔ nawɛɛ.
37Ií ra fɛ banla n waa wichɔgaa dɔɔwɛ la wia,
di ra binni banla wia n deŋlee,
bampirsɔna hina daŋ dɔɔ naanna,
38ka wichɔgɛɛra maa daŋ siuzi,
bá naanna dim.
39Kɔraawiizii ɔɔ lɛɛ nɛra la wia n deŋleere,
di ɔɔ ra guu baa tɔɔrɔɔ saŋa.
40U ɔɔ hiini baabuu di lɛɛ baa,
di lɛɛ baa lii
biinikpola hina be,
dikuubɛɛwiai, ba ɔɔ la
u benii ŋɔ ú guu baa.

english_text:
(A psalm by David to be used when an offering is made.)
A Prayer in Times of Trouble
1When you are angry, Lord,
please don't punish me
or even correct me.
2You shot me with your arrows,
and you struck me
with your hand.
3My body hurts all over
because of your anger.
Even my bones are in pain,
and my sins 4are so heavy
that I am crushed.
5Because of my foolishness,
I am covered with sores
that stink and spread.
6My body is twisted and bent,
and I groan all day long.
7Fever has my back in flames,
and I hurt everywhere.
8I am worn out and weak,
moaning and in distress.
9You, Lord, know every one
of my deepest desires,
and my noisy groans
are no secret to you.
10My heart is beating fast.
I feel weak all over,
and my eyes are red.
11Because of my sickness,
no friends or neighbors
will come near me.
12All who want me dead
set traps to catch me,
and those who want
to harm and destroy me
plan and plot all day.
13I am not able to hear
or speak a word;
14I am completely deaf
and can't make a sound.
15I trust you, Lord God,
and you will do something.
16I said, “Don't let them laugh
or brag when I slip and fall.”
17I am about to collapse
from constant pain.
18I told you my sins,
and I am sorry for them.
19Many deadly and powerful
enemies hate me,
20and they repay evil for good
because I try to do right.
21You are the Lord God!
Stay nearby
and don't desert me.
22You are the one who saves me.
Please hurry and help.
translation_text:
Nɛr la n na di tɔɔrɔɔ wiisuŋŋaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gilɛɛ hau n ni i baaŋfuuih,
gɛɛ di wàá tɛr n digni
ni i baaŋfuuih werge la!
2I virimbuu i hobee duŋ pira,
di lɔŋ ta.
3Dikuu i baaŋfuuih werge la wia, n bɔra waa sum,
n hoga ra wii,
dikuu n wichɔgaa wia.
4N wichɔgaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nii n suwee di ra diŋ,
a ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ
buntɔga werge maa tɛŋ.
5N gɛnni wia,
n ŋmɛra ra lii niirɛ,
di ra sɔɔhri werge.
6N bɔdaabii wiila nyaŋŋɔɔrɛ, màá ka wer chi chiŋ,
hɔpizaa maanii anna wii
alugɔ nɛr n na wii lee la.
7N fuuh ra wii, di ra baari,
maa alaanfia dɔɔwɛ.
8N fɔŋŋa maanii tunnɛ, n bɔra maa ɛɛ vɔlkɔti,
n biini chɔgi, n na him.
9N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i zum wii la minna nyiŋŋuu,
n himaa waa suahwɛ i be.
10N banchule ra lɔu, n fɔŋŋa maa ge tuŋ,
n siwee waa kaa du a duula,
a waa kaa ra na nɛnnɛ.
11N dammuzi ani n nɛra kizimbuu ta,
dikuu n wiila hiŋ wia,
haali n lulla himmaa
gba vɛɛmbuu ta.
12Banla n na nyiŋŋi bá lizi n miibɔɔ la hembuu sidɛɛzi.
Banla ge n na nyiŋŋi
ba duŋ pira la
ra ŋɔ n chɔgaa wiarɛ,
di ɔɔ ra ta
n chɔgaa jina saŋa maa.
13N ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ gɛnii, n waa wia ra nuu,
n wàá wer haa nua.
14N ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nɛr la n waa wia ra nuu,
n nua ge wàá wer haa.
15Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, n daŋ yardii,
dikuubɛɛwiai, i daŋ nuu n be.
16N na suŋŋiibuu, gilɛɛ gil n dɔma bɔra sɔɔni,
dikuu n biinichɔg wia,
gilɛɛ gil ba ra di bahinaa,
di n wa lɔ naa.
17N cholaa helloo,
n bɔra wiila ge waa tuŋ.
18N sɛɛ chɔgrii, dikuu n wichɔgaa wia,
n biini chɔgi a wia.
19N dɔma la n aah siwii n kpui wia kpillɔɔ,
banla ge n hahŋ pɛɛpɛɛ
la gba kpillɔɔ.
20Banla n kpa wichɔgaa di ra turgi n winanaa kim labuu
kii n wia, dikuu minna nyiŋŋi
winanaa ɛɛi wia.
21Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, gilɛɛ giliŋ ta,
gilɛɛ kaali bɔɔnɛɛ ka kaŋ!
22N Lɛɛri Kɔraawiizi,
ba manaŋ wa hiiniŋ!

english_text:
(A psalm by David for Jeduthun, the music leader.)
A Prayer for Forgiveness
1I told myself, “I'll be careful
not to sin by what I say,
and I'll muzzle my mouth
when evil people are near.”
2I kept completely silent,
but it did no good,
and I hurt even worse.
3I felt a fire burning inside,
and the more I thought,
the more it burned,
until at last I said:
4“Please, Lord,
show me my future.
Will I soon be gone?
5You made my life short,
so brief that the time
means nothing to you.
“Human life is but a breath,
6and it disappears
like a shadow.
Our struggles are senseless;
we store up more and more,
without ever knowing
who will get it all.
7“What am I waiting for?
I depend on you, Lord!
8Save me from my sins.
Don't let fools sneer at me.
9You treated me like this,
and I kept silent,
not saying a word.
10“Won't you stop punishing me?
You have worn me down.
11You punish us severely
because of our sins.
Like a moth, you destroy
what we treasure most.
We are as frail as a breath.
12“Listen, Lord, to my prayer!
My eyes are flooded with tears,
as I pray to you.
I am merely a stranger
visiting in your home
as my ancestors did.
13Stop being angry with me
and let me smile again
before I am dead and gone.”
translation_text:
Nɛr la n na di tɔɔrɔɔ chɔgri sɛɛi wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N danna du n wiɛɛlaa tau,
ń wiŋɔzi gilɛɛ wa gil
n na ɛɛ wichɔgaa.
N daŋ lau n nua,
di nɛchɔgaa wa dugliŋ.”
2Ka miŋ faa siigɛɛ di ɛɛ kirkir,
maa wiimaa ra ŋɔ gba,
ka n biinichɔg
faa ra nyaŋŋuu.
3N biini faa jaa ra di niŋ werge maa,
minna fɛ nfɛrɛ la,
aawaa saŋaa a nyaŋŋi.
Denii n faa jaa ŋɔ,
4“N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil n zum n saŋa ni n hɔpizaa maga,
di gil n zum lugɔ
n miibɔɔ waa jaŋ.
5I gillɔɔ n miibɔɔ du kpurii!
N de dui ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ
waa kummaa ɛɛwɛ i be.
Wibii maa, newee maa miibɔɔ
ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ heeza kakpaŋ,
6di ɛɛ lugɔ laalii,
ba wiɛɛlaa maa ɛɛ pɛɛrɛ.
Ba ɔɔ chaali daamaa di ra dau,
ka ba waa zum nɛr la
n niŋ wa dia!
7N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bɛɛ tamiirɛ n jaa dɔɔ filaŋkennei?
I benii n tamii du.
8Lɛɛŋ lii n wichɔgaa maa biini,
gilɛɛ gil n birgi
gɛnaa chɛɛtɛkuŋ.
9N daŋ siigi, màá haa nua,
dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu
gillɛ n na di tɔɔrɔɔ keŋ.
10Gil n viiraa,
i nonii siili n ninɛɛ.
11I ɔɔ hau nɛra ninɛɛ di tɛr ba digna, dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia,
di ɔɔ chɔgi ba kundɔɔlaa
alugɔ kunjigzi.
Wibii maa, newee maa ɛɛwɔɔ
lugɔ heeza kakpaŋ!
12N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a nuu n wiisuŋŋaa,
keŋŋi digni di ra nuu n wiraa,
wa hiiniŋ di n waa wii.
Dikuubɛɛwiai, n ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ hɔɔhri i be, hɛri naa biini,
gunla n naabaala
n faa ɛɛwɛ la.
13Giliŋ pɛrɛtɛ, ka n wer dɔɔ bɔsɔna,
mɔɔ ka siu, n wia tuŋ.”

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for Help
1I patiently waited, Lord,
for you to hear my prayer.
You listened 2and pulled me
from a lonely pit
full of mud and mire.
You let me stand on a rock
with my feet firm,
3and you gave me a new song,
a song of praise to you.
Many will see this,
and they will honor and trust
you, the Lord God.
4You bless all of those
who trust you, Lord,
and refuse to worship idols
or follow false gods.
5You, Lord God, have done
many wonderful things,
and you have planned
marvelous things for us.
No one is like you!
I would never be able to tell
all you have done.
6 Sacrifices and offerings
are not what please you;
gifts and payment for sin
are not what you demand.
But you made me willing
to listen and obey.
7And so, I said, “I am here
to do what is written
about me in the book,
where it says,
8‘I enjoy pleasing you.
Your Law is in my heart.’ ”
9When your people worshiped,
you know I told them,
“Our Lord always helps!”
10When all your people met,
I did not keep silent.
I said, “Our Lord is kind.
He is faithful and caring,
and he saves us.”
11You, Lord, never fail
to have pity on me;
your love and faithfulness
always keep me secure.
12I have more troubles
than I can count.
My sins are all around me,
and I can't find my way.
My sins outnumber
the hairs on my head,
and I feel weak.
13Please show that you care
and come to my rescue.
Hurry and help me!
14Disgrace and confuse
all who want me dead;
turn away and disgrace
all who want to hurt me.
15Embarrass and shame
everyone who says,
“Just look at you now!”
16Our Lord, let your worshipers
rejoice and be glad.
They love you for saving them,
so let them always say,
“The Lord is wonderful!”
17I am poor and needy,
but, Lord God,
you care about me,
and you come to my rescue.
Please hurry and help.
translation_text:
Chɔlaa yir
Koori Deevid yir
1N di kanyittii, di kpaŋ Kɔraawiizi,
u nuu n wiraa,
di na n sinyɛna.
2U lizimbuu lii siaahmu biini,
di lɛɛŋ lii siu n faa lugɔ
bɔɔchuma biini,
di tɛŋ bɔsɔna n dɔɔ n hiŋ,
n na bɔnanii chi nɛnnɛ.
3U kpa yirfaliirɛ du n nua,
Kɔraawiizi la
yaa n na hum la
chɔlaa yittɛ.
Nɛkpila maa daŋ na guŋ, di bir ba nfɛssi,
di yardi Kɔraawiizi.
4Banla n yardi Kɔraawiizi,
ba waa vuga ra kuari,
gɛɛ di ra hiŋ banla
n na kuari vuga la,
nuu sumaa.
5Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum,
i ɛɛ nuukpuuri wia
kpilaa tɛɛ yaa.
Nɛr maa waa hoo lugɔi!
I ta nuukpuuri wia kpila
jinaa tɛɛ yaa,
n ŋmɛnɛ maa
wàá wer bagli a wia maa,
dikuubɛɛwiai, a kpillɔɔ werge!
6Mbusu lizaa kuna ni kuna fuuih lɛi i ra nyiŋŋi,
ka i furgi n dignaa.
Haa mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa ni wichɔgaa mbusuzi
lizaa kuna kaa ra nyiŋŋi.
7Denii n ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, minuu keŋ, n ballɔɔ.
Ba sɛbi i widaulaarɛ
i Gbɔg Hɔŋ la biini tɛŋ.
8N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n na nyiŋŋuu ń na ɛɛ i kipar,
i Gbɔg la du
n bampiriire.”
9N sii i lɛɛi amaniyesuma la wiarɛ
tɛɛ nɛkpila la n chaalɛɛ la.
N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
i zummɔɔ miŋ waa
n nua tɔwɛɛ.
10Maa i lɛɛi amaniyesuma la wia kpoglee n bɛŋ,
ka n ɔɔ ra ŋɔ i wibii dɔɔi
ni i nɛra lɛɛi la wiarɛ saŋa maa.
Maa i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ
ni i wibii la wia kpawɛɛ suah
nɛkpila la n chaalɛɛ la ni.
11N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gilɛɛ waa vɛɛ n ni sunaa,
gil i nɔŋŋaa
ni i wibii dɔɔi la guuŋ.
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa wia
12Tɔɔrɔɔkpila barimbuu,
n wichɔgaa ge nyaŋiŋ,
maa kaa ra na.
A kpillɔɔ werge kaali n nyuhuna,
awia, n bɔra jaa huah.
13N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ!
Jaande maa, ba manaŋ
wa hiiniŋ!
14Gil banla n na nyiŋŋi ba kpuŋ la,
di hiihzi di bugmi.
Gil banla n na nyiŋŋi ba duŋ pira la,
bir har di di hiihzi.
15N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil banla n na ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ la hɔrmi,
dikuu hiŋ kpegli baa,
ba di hiihzi wia.
16Ama, gil banla waa maa n na jaamii la,
dɔɔ bɔsɔna i be,
di gil banla n nɔŋŋi i nɛra lɛɛi wia la ɔɔ ra ŋɔ saŋa maa,
“Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!”
17Miŋwaa ɛɛ anuula hiŋ ni nyaarii,
a liizi n wia.
Hinuu ɛɛ n hiini ni n Lɛɛri,
Kɔraawiizi la minna hum,
gilɛɛ waa birgi!

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer in Time of Sickness
1You, Lord God, bless everyone
who cares for the poor,
and you rescue those people
in times of trouble.
2You protect them
and keep them alive.
You make them happy here
in this land,
and you don't hand them over
to their enemies.
3You always heal them
and restore their strength
when they are sick.
4I prayed, “Have pity, Lord!
Heal me, though I have sinned
against you.”
5My vicious enemies ask me,
“When will you die
and be forgotten?”
6When visitors come,
all they ever bring
are worthless words,
and when they leave,
they spread gossip.
7My enemies whisper about me.
They think the worst,
8and they say,
“You have some fatal disease!
You'll never get well.”
9 My most trusted friend
has turned against me,
though he ate at my table.
10Have pity, Lord! Heal me,
so I can pay them back.
11Then my enemies
won't defeat me,
and I will know
that you really care.
12You have helped me
because I am innocent,
and you will always
be close to my side.
13 You, the Lord God of Israel,
will be praised forever!
Amen and amen.
translation_text:
Wiila hiŋ wiisuŋŋaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1Nɛr la n na du anuula hina tau,
nuu sumaa.
Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ lɛɛubuu
tɔɔrɔɔ saŋa.
2Kɔraawiizi daŋ guu a hiŋ, di gil ú dɔɔ miibɔɔ,
u daŋ kissuu a hɛri biini,
waa kpau du u dɔma
nonee biini, bá ɛɛu ba kipar.
3Kɔraawiizi daŋ hiinuu, di u wàá wii,
di chaau.
4N ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
na n sinyɛna ka chaaŋ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n ɛɛibuu
wichɔgaa.”
5N dɔma kpa hahzii ra ŋɔ n wia,
di ra ŋɔ,
“Saŋa bɛɛ ú siu,
u sɔŋ dimei?”
6Di bɛl haŋ wa ba u wa naŋ,
u wia waa ɔɔ dɔɔ wibii,
ɔɔ liiu di ŋɔ wichɔgaa
di ra du n ni,
di ra tɛɛ nɛr maa.
7Banla maa n ɛɛ n haahra la,
munni n wiarɛ
di ra tɛɛ dɔŋa,
di fɛ nfɛrchɔgaa
di ra du n ni.
8Ba ɔɔ ra ŋɔu, “Wiilchɔgii dawuubuu,
wàá ka piri
u chɔɔi naa biini.”
9Haali n badɔŋ la miŋ yardɛɛ werge,
n nuu kpau di ra di la gba
bittɔɔ chɔɔ hɛri,
di vir hɛɛhraa du n siwee.
10N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
na n sinyɛna
ka tɛŋ alaanfia,
ń wer turgi n dɔma
bá wichɔgaa kim.
11N zummɔ lugɔ n wia pariibuu,
dikuu n dɔm
n waa wette kpegliŋ wia.
12Minna hiŋii ni wibii la wia,
i lɛɛmbuu, di gil
n du i be saŋa maa.
13Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la,
di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa.
Ami! Ami!

english_text:
BOOK II
(Psalms 42–72)
(A special psalm by the clan of Korah and for the music leader.)
Longing for God
1As a deer gets thirsty
for streams of water,
I truly am thirsty
for you, my God.
2In my heart, I am thirsty
for you, the living God.
When will I see your face?
3Day and night my tears
are my only food,
as everyone keeps asking,
“Where is your God?”
4Sorrow floods my heart,
when I remember
leading the worshipers
to your house.
I can still hear them shout
their joyful praises.
5Why am I discouraged?
Why am I restless?
I should trust you, Lord.
I will praise you again
because you help me,
6and you are my God.
I am deeply discouraged,
and so I think about you
here where the Jordan begins
at Mount Hermon
and at Mount Mizar.
7Your vicious waves
have swept over me
like an angry ocean
or a roaring waterfall.
8Every day, you are kind,
and at night
you give me a song
as my prayer to you,
the God of my life.
9You are my mighty rock.
Why have you forgotten me?
Why must enemies mistreat me
and make me sad?
10Even my bones are in pain,
while all day long
my enemies sneer and ask,
“Where is your God?”
11Why am I discouraged?
Why am I restless?
I trust you, Lord!
And I will praise you again
because you help me,
and you are my God.
translation_text:
Yira hɔŋ nɛɛhiŋ
(Yira 42—72)
Nɛr n du hɛrduma wiisuŋŋaa wia
Kora domee biibaala yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gunla chɛɛh n ɔɔ hɛg,
di ra nyiŋŋi nii la,
gunnɛ n na nyiŋŋi i wia.
2Gunla niinyɔgzi
n ɔɔ ra kpu nɛr
u ra nyiŋŋi nii la,
gunnɛ n na nyiŋŋi
hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la
n du de saŋa maa la wia.
Saŋa bɛɛ ń du i be
di ra jaamiinɛi?
3N siniire birgi n diwee,
hɔpizaa ni
hamuŋa maa.
Saŋa maa,
n dɔma ɔɔ ra pɛɛzimbuu,
“Lee Kɔraawiizi la
hinna hum la duɛi?”
4A ɔɔ ɛɛmbuu biinichɔg,
di n wa liizi a wia naa.
Gunla n ni nɛkpila n ɔɔ faa la i Dia,
n tɔ ba see,
ba ra yir yira
di ra chaasi,
ba bɔra sɔɔni,
ba ra chɔlii la.
5Bɛɛ wiarɛ n biini chɔgi wergei?
Bɛɛ wiarɛ
n na di tɔɔrɔɔ wergei?
N daŋ kpa n tamii du i ni,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n daŋ
haa ra chɔlii,
hinuu n Lɛɛri
6ni Kɔraawiizi la
minna hum.
N biini chɔkkɔɔ werge,
awia, n daŋ liizi i wia,
Bizenaa Hɛmɔn
ni Miza nyuuni,
Jɔɔdan muu n faarɛɛ la.
7I gillɔɔ n biini chɔgi lugɔ nii n suwee di ra lɔŋ,
di ra kɔɔ lugɔ chuurunchu,
di pal fɔŋŋa ni,
di ra nyiŋŋi n dii.
8Hɔpizaa saŋa, Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ bagli u nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛɛ,
guŋ gil hamuŋa ni,
n na yir yira,
di ra suŋŋi
Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ n miibɔɔ la.
9N ŋɔwɔɔrɛ tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ n guuri,
“Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ
i suuh n wiai?
Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ń na di dɔgnya
dikuu n dɔma
biinikpola wiai?”
10N hoga maanii ra wii,
dikuu, n dɔma
chɛɛtɛ wia,
ba ɔɔ ra pɛɛziŋ saŋa maa,
“Lee Kɔraawiizi la
hinna hum la duɛi?”
11Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ n biini chɔgi wergei?
Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ n na
di tɔɔrɔɔ wergei?
N daŋ kpa n tamii du Kɔraawiizi ni,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n daŋ
haa ra chɔluu,
waabuu n Lɛɛri ni
Kɔraawiizi la minna hum.

english_text:
A Prayer in Times of Trouble
1Show that I am right, God!
Defend me against everyone
who doesn't know you;
rescue me from each
of those deceitful liars.
2I run to you for protection.
Why do you turn me away?
Why must enemies mistreat me
and make me sad?
3Send your light and your truth
to guide me.
Let them lead me to your house
on your sacred mountain.
4Then I will worship
at your altar because you
make me joyful.
You are my God,
and I will praise you.
Yes, I will praise you
as I play my harp.
5Why am I discouraged?
Why am I restless?
I trust you, Lord!
And I will praise you again
because you help me,
and you are my God.
translation_text:
Nɛr n du hɛrduma wiisuŋŋaa wia
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hɔɔ n nua tɛŋ,
ka hiiniŋ lii banla
n wɛɛ zummɛ la be,
di lɛɛŋ lii karkanna
ni wichɔgɛɛra be.
2Hinuu n guuri,
Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i giliŋ tai?
Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ n vol di ra di tɔɔrɔɔ,
dikuu n dɔma
n na firiŋ wiai?
3Gil i bɔchaaŋ ni i wibii la,
wa tɔ n see,
di kpogliŋ la
i bizennaniinanii la nyuu,
bɔr la hiŋ duwɛɛ la.
4Denii ń jaa la i mbusu lizibɔr la,
hinuu ra tɛŋ
bɔsɔna werge.
N daŋ lɔ kem di yir yira chɔlii,
Kɔraawiizi la minna hum.
5Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ n biini chɔgi wergei?
Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ
n biini ra koozinnei?
N daŋ kpa n tamii du i ni,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n daŋ
kaa ra chɔlii,
hinuu n Lɛɛri ni
Kɔraawiizi la minna hum.

english_text:
(A special psalm by the clan of Korah and for the music leader.)
A Prayer for Help
1Our God, our ancestors told us
what wonders you worked
and we listened carefully.
2You chased off the nations
by causing them trouble
with your powerful arm.
Then you let our ancestors
take over their land.
3Their strength and weapons
were not what won the land
and gave them victory!
You loved them and fought
with your powerful arm
and your shining glory.
4You are my God and King,
and you give victory
to the people of Jacob.
5By your great power,
we knocked our enemies down
and trampled on them.
6I don't depend on my arrows
or my sword to save me.
7But you saved us
from our hateful enemies,
and you put them to shame.
8We boast about you, our God,
and we are always grateful.
9But now you have rejected us;
you don't lead us into battle,
and we look foolish.
10You made us retreat,
and our enemies have taken
everything we own.
11You let us be slaughtered
like sheep,
and you scattered us
among the nations.
12You sold your people
for little or nothing,
and you earned no profit.
13You made us look foolish
to our neighbors;
people who live nearby
insult us and sneer.
14Foreigners joke about us
and shake their heads.
15I am embarrassed every day,
and I blush with shame.
16But others mock and sneer,
as they watch my enemies
take revenge on me.
17All this happened to us,
though we didn't forget you
or break our agreement.
18We always kept you in mind
and followed your teaching.
19But you crushed us,
and you covered us
with deepest darkness
where wild animals live.
20We did not forget you
or lift our hands in prayer
to foreign gods.
21You would have known it
because you discover
every secret thought.
22 We face death all day for you.
We are like sheep on their way
to be slaughtered.
23Wake up! Do something, Lord!
Why are you sleeping?
Don't desert us forever.
24Why do you keep looking away?
Don't forget our sufferings
and all our troubles.
25We are flat on the ground,
holding on to the dust.
26Do something! Help us!
Show how kind you are
and come to our rescue.
translation_text:
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi guui wia
Kora domee biibaala yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, yaa himmaa digna nuabuu,
yaa naabaala
ŋɔ yaa benii,
hunzenaa la hiŋ hummɛ ba saŋa la
ni faala maa,
2gunla i himmaa n duŋŋi a hɛssi la hina ba lii,
ka gil i himmaa nɛra
so ba hɛri,
gunla hiŋ tɛr a hɛssi hina digna,
ka gil i nɛra nyɛɛli la.
3A waa lugɔ ba kpegli a hɛri hinaa ni ba tokobizi
gɛɛ di kpegli baa
ni ba himmaa fɔŋŋa.
Ka i fɔŋŋa, i kpegzi ani hiŋ ŋɔ nua lugɔ
i daŋ du ba be
labuu baglɛɛ lugɔ
i nɔŋŋi baabuu.
4Hinuu ɛɛ n Koori ni Kɔraawiizi la minna hum,
hinuu gillɛ Izrɛl hina
kpegli ba dɔma.
5I benii yaa ga kpegli yaa dɔma,
i sɔŋ biinii
yaa fɛrgi baa ni naazi.
6Maa n hoo
gɛɛ n tokobi
yardɛɛ a lɛɛŋ,
7ka i lɛɛ yaabuu lii yaa dɔma be,
di gil yaa haahra
ge di hiihzi.
8N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, yaa daŋ ɔɔ ra chɔlii,
di ra jaamii
saŋaa saŋa maa.
9Ka filaŋkeŋwaa, i bir hattɛ kpu yaa,
ba kpegli yaa,
haa kaa du yaa laallɔɔra
di ra la laal.
10I gillɔɔ yaa chɔ lii yaa dɔma be,
haali ba foozi
kuna la maa
yaa n dɔɔwɛ laal biini.
11I gillɔɔ ba kpu yaa lugɔ peeza,
di gil yaa
yaari hɛrdumazi biine.
12I kpa i himmaa nɛraa yoo harha,
alugɔ baŋ waa tɔna dɔɔwɛ la.
13Yaa dɔŋahina na gunla hiŋ ɛɛ yaabuu,
ba ra ɛɛ yaa chɛɛtɛ
di ra mam yaa.
14I gillɔɔ yaa birgi mɔmɔsia nɛra a hɛssi hina be,
ba ra ɛɛ yaa chɛɛtɛ
di ra viigi ba nyuuni.
15Hɔpizii maa, hiihzi ɔɔ ra kpumbuu,
n willi n nyuu,
16dikuu n chɛɛtɛ ɛɛra chagzaa
ni n dɔma hahzi wia.
17Annii maanii wa huuzi yaa,
haali yaa n haa waa
i wia suuhwɛ
gɛɛ di chɔgi nuukpaŋ la
yaa nii n ɛɛwɛ la.
18Yaa bampiree haa lawiibuu,
yaa waa i widaulaa vɛɛwɛ ta.
19Ka i vɛɛ yaabuu ta hohobiazi biini,
di gil bɔbiri kilɛŋkilɛŋ tɔ yaa ni.
20Di yaa vii vɛɛ hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la wiarɛ,
ka ra kuari
hɛrduma hina vug,
21i daŋ faa zum,
dikuubɛɛwiai, i zum
wia la maa
n du yaa biinee.
22Yaa ɔɔ du siu biinii saŋa maa, dikuu i wia,
yaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ peeza la,
baŋ lizɛɛ bá kɔrgaa la.
23N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, izi chiŋ! Gilɛɛ ra chɔɔ dɔɔ.
Kazi bɔra!
Gilɛɛ vɛɛ yaa ta kɔrai!
24Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i bir har kpu yaai?
Gilɛɛ suuh yaa dɔgnya
ni yaa tɔɔrɔɔ wia!
25Ba lɔ yaabuu ta hɛri,
yaa gɛrgi chɔɔ hɛɛhraa biini.
26Izi wa hiini yaa!
Lɛɛ yaa, dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia.

english_text:
(A special psalm by the clan of Korah and for the music leader. To the tune “Lilies.” A love song.)
For a Royal Wedding
1My thoughts are filled
with beautiful words
for the king,
and I will use my voice
as a writer would use
pen and ink.
2No one is as handsome as you!
Your words are always kind.
That is why God
will always bless you.
3Mighty king, glorious ruler,
strap on your sword
4and ride out in splendor!
Win victories for truth
and mercy and justice.
Do fearsome things
with your powerful arm.
5Send your sharp arrows
through enemy hearts
and make all nations fall
at your feet.
6 You are God, and you will rule
forever as king.
Your royal power
brings about justice.
7You love justice and hate evil.
And so, your God chose you
and made you happier
than any of your friends.
8The sweet aroma of the spices
myrrh, aloes, and cassia
covers your royal robes.
You enjoy the music of harps
in palaces decorated
with ivory.
9Daughters of kings are here,
and your bride stands
at your right side,
wearing a wedding gown
trimmed with pure gold.
10Bride of the king,
listen carefully to me.
Forget your own people
and your father's family. 11The king adores you.
He is your master,
so do what he desires.
12All of the richest people
from the city of Tyre
will try to influence you
13with precious treasures.
Your bride, my king,
has inward beauty,
and her wedding gown is woven
with threads of gold.
14Wearing the finest garments,
she is brought to you,
followed by her young friends,
the bridesmaids.
15Everyone is excited,
as they follow you
to the royal palace.
16Your sons and your grandsons
will also be kings
as your ancestors were.
You will make them rulers
everywhere on earth.
17I will make your name famous
from now on,
and you will be praised
forever and ever.
translation_text:
Koori haŋfalii kpai yir
Kora domee biibaala yir
1Wiŋɔnanaa su n nuarɛ,
min niŋ kpaa yir yir naa
tɛɛ koori.
N nuuzuŋŋi ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ
nɛr la n zum
sɛbaa nɛnnɛ kunsɛbii.
2Hinuu ɛɛ bunɔɔŋ kaali baal maa,
i zum wiŋɔzii nɛnnɛ,
Kɔraawiizi kissiibuu
saŋaa saŋa maa.
3Koorizeŋ, ɛɛ i tokobi sirya,
i dɔɔ girme ni zennii.
4Tinni i zagu ni i zenni, di kpegli i dɔma,
dikuu wibii ni
wideŋlaa ɛɛi wia,
í fɔŋŋa werge la gil
i kpegli i dɔmaa nɛnnɛ.
5I hobee ra diu nɛnnɛ,
a yagzi i dɔma
bampireere furgi,
hɛssi hina chogli i see.
6Kora la Kɔraawiizi n tɛi la,
daŋ ɔɔ chi
di hanna la saŋa maa.
Wibiire i kpa
di ra binni i nɛra ni.
7I nɔŋŋi wideŋlaare ka hah wichɔgaa,
awiarɛ Kɔraawiizi la
hinna hum la lizii,
di tɛi bɔsɔna
kaali i dɔŋahina la.
8I laala maanii ra sɔɔhri mɛr,
alozi ani kasia la.
Yiryitta ra deŋŋi i siwee
kooridiini la baŋ kpa
bala nyina bɔg la biine.
9Koora biihaana jaa haana la n du i dia biini ninɛɛ,
ka haŋfalii la chi
i koorikara nodig barii,
di laali salinnanaa bɔmbɔga.
10Koori haŋfalii, keŋŋi digni di ra nuu gunla min niŋ ŋɔ,
suuh i nɛra ni i mɛɛ lulla wia.
11I toloorii niŋ gil a koori ra nyiŋŋii,
waabuu ɛɛ i dɔɔri,
a tɔgzuu.
12Bolzeŋ Taaya hina daŋ wa sunzii kuna,
dɔɔna kpila
danna nyiŋŋi ba wia parii.
13A koori haŋfalii du u kooridiarɛ, u toloori dɔŋ waa hoo,
saliŋ koozi gessi la
baŋ kpawɛɛ suah
u tagtajaŋ la ninɛɛ.
14U bɔg kunnanaarɛ,
baŋ tɔɔhzɛɛ ba duu
di ra ba koori be.
U dɔŋahina suŋgure la
hiŋuu di ra ba,
ba kpogli ba maa
di wa tɛi.
15Bɔsɔna ni biinihuŋŋuu
ba kpa di wa zuu i dia.
16Jara, i daŋ dɔɔ biizi,
bá ɛɛ nabɔnzi,
di ra binni
hɛri naa maa ni.
17N yir naa daŋ gil i dɔɔ sɔŋ jiminizi maa biine,
nɛr maa ge ra chɔlii
saŋaa saŋa maa.

english_text:
(A special song by the clan of Korah and for the music leader.)
God Is Our Mighty Fortress
1God is our mighty fortress,
always ready to help
in times of trouble.
2And so, we won't be afraid!
Let the earth tremble
and the mountains tumble
into the deepest sea.
3Let the ocean roar and foam,
and its raging waves
shake the mountains.
4A river and its streams
bring joy to the city,
which is the sacred home
of God Most High.
5God is in that city,
and it won't be shaken.
He will help it at dawn.
6Nations rage! Kingdoms fall!
But at the voice of God
the earth itself melts.
7The Lord All-Powerful
is with us.
The God of Jacob
is our fortress.
8Come! See the fearsome things
the Lord has done on earth.
9God brings wars to an end
all over the world.
He breaks the arrows,
shatters the spears,
and burns the shields.
10Our God says, “Calm down,
and learn that I am God!
All nations on earth
will honor me.”
11The Lord All-Powerful
is with us.
The God of Jacob
is our fortress.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi du yaa benii
Kora domee biibaala yir
1Kɔraawiizii ɛɛ yaa guuri ni yaa fɔŋŋa,
u ɔɔ ɛɛ siryaa saŋa maa,
ú hiini yaa tɔɔrɔɔ saŋa.
2Awia, ɔnsii wàá lau yaa, haali di hɛri naa ra zigli,
bizenaa purgi di ra chogli
muuzeŋ biini gba,
3haali muuni niiri gba ra lɔ, di ra kɔɔ,
bizenaa ra ziigi,
dikuu a muuni koozaa wia gba.
4Muu bɛl gɔŋa gillɔɔ bɔsɔna du Kɔraawiizi bolzeŋ,
bɔnaniinanii la
Kɔraawiizi La
N Kaali Kummaa la
n duwɛɛ la.
5Kɔraawiizi du a bolzenne, u ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá wer puri,
chɔɔzimpikke ni,
u daŋ wa hiini
a bol hina.
6Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ giluu ɔnsizeŋ chol hɛssi ni, kossi chogli,
u pozi, hɛri ge ŋmɛɛri.
7Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ du yaa benii,
Kɔraawiizi la
Jekɔb n na hum
labuu ɛɛ yaa guuri.
8Ií ba wa na huma la Kɔraawiizi n hummɛ,
di na nuukpuuri wia la
uŋ ɛɛwɛ hɛri naa biini.
9U gillɔɔ laal lɔi tuŋ durnya maa biini,
u kuugi hozi ni kandaazii,
ka fuuh laal pɛrɛtuzenaa.
10Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ií gil naari,
ka zum lugɔ
minuu Kɔraawiizi.
Minuu kaali kummaa hɛssi maa biine,
di kaali kummaa
durnya naa biini.”
11Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la du yaa benii,
Kɔraawiizi la
Jekɔb n na hum
labuu ɛɛ yaa guuri.

english_text:
(A psalm by the clan of Korah and for the music leader.)
God Rules the Nations
1All of you nations,
clap your hands and shout
joyful praises to God.
2The Lord Most High is fearsome,
the ruler of all the earth.
3God has put every nation
under our power,
4and he chose for us the land
that was the pride of Jacob,
his favorite.
5God goes up to his throne,
as people shout
and trumpets blast.
6Sing praises to God our King,
7the ruler of all the earth!
Praise God with songs.
8God rules the nations
from his sacred throne.
9Their leaders come together
and are now the people
of Abraham's God.
All rulers on earth
surrender their weapons,
and God is greatly praised!
translation_text:
Koorizeŋ wia
Kora domee biibaala yir
1Nɛra maa, ií ra lɔ kpaa ni bɔsɔna!
Ií ra yir yira bombombom,
di ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!
2Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la dɛkkɔɔ banna ɔmuu werge,
waabuu ɛɛ koorizeŋ
durnya maa biini!
3U gillɔɔ yaa kpegli hɛssi hina,
di ra di kora ba ni.
4U lizi a hɛrii u ɛɛ yaa kapɛttɛ kuŋ,
u nɛra Izrɛl hina
un nɔŋŋɛɛ la yɛɛzi kunnɛ.
5Kɔraawiizi ra lau ú ga so u koorikara ni,
unna la la,
ba ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna,
di ra huuh bensunozi.
6Ií yir yira di ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi,
ií yir yira di ra darguu,
waabuu koori!
7Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ durnya maa koorii,
ií yir yira di ra darguu!
8Kɔraawiizi sogo u koorikarnaniinanii ninɛɛ,
di ra di kora
hɛssi hina maa ni.
9A hɛssi koora ni
Kɔraawiizi la Abraham
n na hum la nɛra chaalɔɔrɛ.
U fɔŋŋa kaali laallɔɔra maanii,
waabuu ra di kora
kummaa ni.

english_text:
(A song and a psalm by the clan of Korah.)
The City of God
1The Lord God is wonderful!
He deserves all praise
in the city where he lives.
His holy mountain,
2 beautiful and majestic,
brings joy to all on earth.
Mount Zion, truly sacred,
is home for the Great King.
3God is there to defend it
and has proved to be
its protector.
4Kings joined forces
to attack the city,
5but when they saw it,
they were terrified
and ran away.
6They trembled all over
like women giving birth
7or like seagoing ships
wrecked by eastern winds.
8We had heard about it,
and now we have seen it
in the city of our God,
the Lord All-Powerful.
This is the city that God
will let stand forever.
9Our God, here in your temple
we think about your love.
10You are famous and praised
everywhere on earth,
as you win victories
with your powerful arm.
11Mount Zion will celebrate,
and all Judah will be glad,
because you bring justice.
12Let's walk around Zion
and count its towers.
13We will see its strong walls
and visit each fortress.
Then you can say
to future generations,
14“Our God is like this forever
and will always guide us.”
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi Bolzeŋ Ziɔn wia
Kora domee biibaala yir
1Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ sɔnnɛ werge,
di dɛg chɔlaa werge maa,
u bolzeŋ la biini,
u Bizennaniinanii la nyuu.
2Kɔraawiizi Bizeŋ Ziɔn la chinne,
di du wer werge maa,
a koorizeŋ bolzeŋ la
ɔɔ ra tɛɛ
durnya maanii bɔsɔna.
3Kɔraawiizi baglɔɔrɛ lugɔ hinnai du u benii,
u bolzeŋ diikpega la biini.
4Koora ni ba laallɔɔra chaalɔɔrɛ ra ba,
bá wa fɔɔ
Bizeŋ Ziɔn la.
5Ka baŋ wa nau,
ba nuuzi kpu kakpaŋ,
ɔnsii chol ba ni,
ba bir chɔ.
6Bɔsai ani bɔwiila chol ba ni
alugɔ hilula n lɔ haaŋ,
7di kaa ɛɛ lugɔ pekpeg
n lii wiifurii la,
di wa lɔ muugberzenaa,
di chɔgaa.
8Gunla yaa n nuuwɛ la, gunnɛ yaa na,
Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la
yaa n na hum, bolzeŋ la biini.
U daŋ gil u bolzeŋ hiŋ
chi nɛnnɛ saŋaa saŋa maa.
9N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, yaa ɔɔ ra fɛ i nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la nfɛrɛɛ,
i Dia biini.
10Gunla i sɔŋ n kannɛ la,
gunnɛ ba ra chɔlii
hɛri naa maa biini.
I ra di koraa ni wibii.
11Gil Bizeŋ Ziɔn nɛra bɔra sɔɔni,
di gil Juda boljigzi
nɛra bɔra sɔɔni,
dikuu hinna di seriyazi
ni wibii wia!
12Kɔraawiizi nɛra, ií vol di bar Bolzeŋ Ziɔn,
di kur u diijaŋra la,
13di pessi u koŋlaa, di binni u diikpega la,
gunnɛ ii wa wer
bagli a wia tɛɛ
jiminizi la n niŋ
haa ba nɛra.
14Kɔraawiizii yaa ra hum, saŋaa saŋa maa,
waabuu ninna tɔ yaa see,
saŋaa saŋa maa.

english_text:
(A psalm by the clan of Korah and for the music leader.)
Don't Depend on Wealth
1Everyone on this earth,
now listen to what I say!
2Listen, no matter who you are,
rich or poor.
3I speak words of wisdom,
and my thoughts make sense.
4I have in mind a mystery
that I will explain
while playing my harp.
5Why should I be afraid
in times of trouble,
when I am surrounded
by vicious enemies?
6They trust in their riches
and brag about
all their wealth.
7You cannot buy back your life
or pay off God!
8It costs far too much
to buy back your life.
You can never pay God enough
