9to stay alive forever
and safe from death.
10 We see that wise people die,
and so do stupid fools.
Then their money is left
for someone else.
11The grave will be their home
forever and ever,
although they once had land
of their own.
12Our human glory disappears,
and, like animals, we die.
13Here is what happens to fools
and to those who trust
the words of fools:
14They are like sheep
with death as their shepherd,
leading them to the grave.
In the morning God's people
will walk all over them,
as their bodies lie rotting
in their home, the grave.
15But God will rescue me
from the power of death.
16Don't let it bother you
when others get rich
and live in luxury.
17Soon they will die
and all their wealth
will be left behind.
18We humans are praised
when we do well,
and all of us are glad
to be alive.
19But we each will go down
to our ancestors,
never again to see
the light of day.
20Our human glory disappears,
and, like animals, we die.
translation_text:
Gɛnniirɛ nɛr la n yardi daama
Kora domee biibaala yir
1Nɛra maa, ií ra nuu!
Durnya hina,
2nɛzenaa, banla banna sunni,
dɔɔna ani nyaara maa,
ií ra nuu!
3N daŋ ŋɔ nunzuma wia,
wia la min niŋ ŋɔ
daŋ chaani nɛnnɛ.
4N daŋ bir n laakal du sɛɛliizi ni,
di lɔ kem bagli a zɛɛzi.
5Di tɔɔrɔɔ saŋa wa ballɔ,
di biinikpola hina ni
6banla n yardi ba daama,
di ra jigsi a wia la,
wa bariŋ, ka maa ɔm.
7Nɛr maa wàá wer turgi di lɛɛ u dɔŋhiŋ
gɛɛ di wer turgi
Kɔraawiizi u miibɔɔ kim,
8dikuubɛɛwiai, u miibɔɔ yoola kpolloo werge maa,
kunla un niŋ kpa
turgi wàá hel,
9á wer gil u dɔɔ miibɔɔ
di hanna la, wàá siu.
10Nɛr maanii zummɛ lugɔ nunzunna ni bambugee maanii ɔɔ siu,
ka gil ba daama
tɛɛ nɛra baŋhina.
11Ba ŋmama daŋ birgi ba diini,
di ɛɛ ba duuribɔra
saŋa maa,
haali baŋ faa dɔɔ
ba himmaa hɛssi la gba.
12Newea ni ba daama maa, ka ba wàá wer vɛɛ siu,
ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ
sela n niŋ siu,
bá wia tuŋ.
13Kenne niŋ huuzi banla n na tɔgzi bahinaa
ni banla maa n na hiŋ baa,
di ra nuu ba wiŋɔzi la.
14Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ peeza n niŋ siu,
bá hug baa, bá pɔɔh.
Di Kɔraawiizi wa lɛɛ banla wia deŋlee,
ba daŋ di kora ba ni,
ka bá pɔɔh ŋmama biine,
ba wàá ka dugli
ba kooridiizenaa la.
15Ka Kɔraawiizi daŋ lɛɛŋ,
u daŋ lɛɛŋ lii
siu fɔŋŋa be.
16Gilɛɛ gil a tirii, di nɛbɛl wa birgi daama hiŋ
gɛɛ di u daama ra wazi,
17dikuubɛɛwiai, di u wa siuwɔ,
wàá kpa kummaa kaali,
u daama wàá hiŋuu tuu bɔɔ.
18Saŋa la uŋ du de la, u ra yir u hinnɛ bɔsɔna hiŋ,
ba ra chɔluu,
dikuu uŋ nyɛɛlɛɛ wia,
19u daŋ la ga jaa u naabaala ni,
bɔr la u ŋmɛnɛ maa
n wàá ka na bɔchaaŋ.
20Nɛr la maa n dɔɔ daama, ka waa wia zɛɛ zummɛ,
daŋ siu alugɔ
sela n ɔɔ siu la.

english_text:
(A psalm by Asaph.)
What Pleases God
1From east to west,
the powerful Lord God
has been calling together
everyone on earth.
2God shines brightly from Zion,
the most beautiful city.
3Our God approaches,
but not silently;
a flaming fire comes first,
and a storm surrounds him.
4God comes to judge his people.
He shouts to the heavens
and to the earth,
5“Call my followers together!
They offered me a sacrifice,
and we made an agreement.”
6The heavens announce,
“God is the judge,
and he is always honest.”
7My people, I am God!
Israel, I am your God.
Listen to my charges
against you.
8Although you offer sacrifices
and always bring gifts,
9I won't accept your offerings
of bulls and goats.
10Every animal in the forest
belongs to me,
and so do the cattle
on a thousand hills.
11I know all the birds
in the mountains,
and every wild creature
is in my care.
12If I were hungry,
I wouldn't tell you,
because I own the world
and everything in it.
13I don't eat the meat of bulls
or drink the blood of goats.
14I am God Most High!
The only sacrifice I want
is for you to be thankful
and to keep your word.
15Pray to me in time of trouble.
I will rescue you,
and you will honor me.
16But to the wicked I say:
“You don't have the right
to mention my laws or claim
to keep our agreement!
17You refused correction
and rejected my commands.
18You made friends
with every crook you met,
and you liked people who break
their wedding vows.
19You talked only about violence
and told nothing but lies;
20you sat around gossiping,
ruining the reputation
of your own relatives.”
21When you did all this,
I didn't say a word,
and you thought,
“God is just like us!”
But now I will accuse you.
22You have ignored me!
So pay close attention
or I will tear you apart,
and no one can help you.
23The sacrifice that honors me
is a thankful heart.
Obey me, and I, your God,
will show my power to save.
translation_text:
Jaamaa la n na par Kɔraawiizi
Asaf yir
1Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la n kpekke werge la,
chaali durnya hina maanii
lii wiifurii
di ga chug wiicholii.
2Kɔraawiizi girme ra chaanuu alugɔ niŋ,
di lii u Bolzeŋ Ziɔn la
n wesse werge la biini.
3Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la ra bau,
waa suahwɛ di ra ba,
ninlauzeŋ du u seere,
pekpeg baruu.
4U ɔɔ yir chiŋ ni hɛri maanii
alugɔ nɛra, á di daansɛɛ,
ka ú di u nɛra seriya,
5di ŋɔ, “N nɛnanaa,
ií chaali n see.
Ii banla n lizi mbusu lizaa kuna tɛŋ,
n ni ia ɛɛ nuukpaŋ la.”
6Chinchiŋ kuna maa baglɔɔrɛ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi wia deŋloore,
dí u himmaanii
ɛɛ seriya diiri.
7Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ,
“Ií ra nuu, n nɛra Izrɛl hina,
ka n ŋɔ wia,
n daŋ tɛɛ ia bilchɔg.
Minuu ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la
iinna hum.
8Maa ii ni ra hau dikuu ii mbusuzi lizaa kuna
ni mbusuzi lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa
iiŋ lizɛɛ di ra tɛŋ
saŋa maa la wia.
9Maa ii liga nabala ra nyiŋŋi
gɛɛ ii lonni buuna,
10dikuubɛɛwiai, sela la maa n du kɔr biini ani nauna
la maa n du giŋgimee kagboŋa
nyuuni la, ɛɛ n horaa.
11Zumbizi maa ni kunnyinee maa,
n du kooni, ɛɛ n horaa.
12Di lɔzi faa ra kpuŋ, ka maa ŋɔ ii tɛŋ diwee,
dikuubɛɛwiai, durnya
ani kuna la maa
n du u biini ɛɛ n horaa.
13N na hee nabala olaa
gɛɛ di ra nyɔɔ buuna challia?
14Ií kpa jaaŋ ú ɛɛ ii mbusu lizaa kuna, di ra tɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi,
ií ra ɛɛ gunla iiŋ ŋɔ nua la,
di ra tɛɛ Miŋ Kɔraawiizi La
N Kaali Kummaa la,
15di ra yir n sɔŋ, di ii wa du tɔɔrɔɔ biini,
n daŋ lɛɛ ia,
ii jaa ra tɔgziŋ.”
16Ka Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ biinikpola hina waa benii,
“Bɛɛ ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ ii dɔɔi,
ií ra kurgi n Gbɔgnɛi?
Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ii ra ŋɔ
yaa nuukpaŋ dɔɔi wiai?
17Ii hah n baglaarɛ,
di vɛɛ n wiŋɔzi la ge ta.
18Ii birgi ŋmɛɛŋ la maa iiŋ nawɛɛ dammuu,
ii ni sɛnsɛnna ge ra kpau.
19Ii ɔɔ ɛɛ siryaa saŋa maa ii ŋɔ wichɔgaa,
di yali siwee ra kanni kara.
20Saŋa maanii ii ɔɔ kpa wia ra chug ii lulla,
di ra chɔgi ii himmaa
maa biizi sɔna.
21Annii maanii ii ɛɛ, ka n sigli,
awia, ii ra fɛu lugɔ
n ni ia ɛɛ kpannɛ.
Ka filaŋkeŋwaa, n daŋ jaa hau ii ni,
ka chaani a wia siwee tɛɛ ia.
22Ií ra du tau, ii banla n suuh n wia la, di guŋ lɛi,
n daŋ chuuri ia alugɔ bunyiŋ n chuuri sel,
ka nɛr maa wàá du de di lɛɛ ia.
23Nɛr la n kpa jaaŋ
u ɛɛ mbusu lizaa kuŋ
di ra tɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi,
ra tɔgzimbuu.
Nɛr la n na hiŋ n ŋmɛnizi nɛnnɛ,
n daŋ lɛɛu.”

english_text:
(For the music leader. A psalm by David when the prophet Nathan came to him after David had been with Bathsheba.)
A Prayer for Forgiveness
1 You are kind, God!
Please have pity on me.
You are always merciful!
Please wipe away my sins.
2Wash me clean from all
of my sin and guilt.
3I know about my sins,
and I cannot forget
the burden of my guilt.
4 You are really the one
I have sinned against;
I have disobeyed you
and have done wrong.
So it is right and fair for you
to correct and punish me.
5I have sinned and done wrong
since the day I was born.
6But you want complete honesty,
so teach me true wisdom.
7Wash me with hyssop
until I am clean
and whiter than snow.
8Let me be happy and joyful!
You crushed my bones,
now let them celebrate.
9Turn your eyes from my sin
and cover my guilt.
10Create pure thoughts in me
and make me faithful again.
11Don't chase me away from you
or take your Holy Spirit
away from me.
12Make me as happy as you did
when you saved me;
make me want to obey!
13I will teach sinners your Law,
and they will return to you.
14Keep me from any deadly sin.
Only you can save me!
Then I will shout and sing
about your power to save.
15Help me to speak,
and I will praise you, Lord.
16Offerings and sacrifices
are not what you want.
17The way to please you
is to be truly sorry
deep in our hearts.
This is the kind of sacrifice
you won't refuse.
18Please be willing, Lord,
to help the city of Zion
and to rebuild its walls.
19Then you will be pleased
with the proper sacrifices,
and we will offer bulls
on your altar once again.
translation_text:
Wichɔgaa giltɛɛi wiisuŋŋaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, na n sinyɛna,
dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ
ani i nɛsunaa werge la wia,
dinzi n wichɔgaa ta.
2Sɔ n wichɔgaa maa ta,
di gil á lii n ni.
3N zum n wichɔgaarɛ,
a ɔɔ chɔɔ n seere saŋa maa.
4Hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi bɛnnɛ n ɛɛ wichɔgaa,
di ɛɛ wia la
n ɛɛ wichɔgaa i be.
Awia, i hor summɔɔ hin diŋ seriya,
i hor ɔɔ deŋluu,
di i waa di seriya.
5Wibii maa, ba lulimbuu ni wichɔgaa,
di lii saŋa la maa,
n maa n kpogli n hia la.
6Na, wibii dii ni biinihuŋŋuu i ra nyiŋŋi,
awia, tɛŋ nunzuma
n nfɛrɛ biini.
7Sɔŋ, n wichɔgaa lii, n ɛɛ nɛnanii,
sɔŋ, n huuhzi kaali gonni.
8Gil n nuu bɔsɔna ni bɔpuraa wia,
haali hiŋ lɔŋ ta
n hoga kuugi la gba,
ka n daŋ kaa dɔɔ bɔsɔna.
9Bir i har kpu n wichɔgaa,
ka dinzi a maa.
10N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, tɛŋ biinihuŋŋu,
di tɛŋ mananaa.
11Gilɛɛ duŋŋiŋ lii i be
gɛɛ di lizi i Duma
lii n ni.
12Kaa gil i lɛɛi bɔsɔna la du n be,
di gil n sɛɛ di ra hiŋ i nua.
13Denii ń jaa bagli wichɔgɛɛra i widaulaa,
bá bir ba i be.
14N dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ lii nɛkpui bilchɔg biini!
Hinuu ɛɛ n Lɛɛri,
n danna yir
i wideŋlaa wia yira.
15N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, pilli n nua,
ń wer di ra dargii.
16Haa mbusu lizaa kuna ra nyiŋŋi,
di i faa ra nyiŋŋuu,
n daŋ vii lizaa tɛi,
mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa gba
wia wɛɛ ra par.
17N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, mbusu lizaarɛ sisɔna dɔɔi,
hàá vɛɛ nɛr la n dɔɔ sisɔna,
di ra sɛɛ chɔgri,
dikuu u wichɔgaa wia.
18N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
suŋ Bolzeŋ Ziɔn hina ni,
di hiini baa, kaa bir ma
Jɛrusalɛm koŋlaa la
n faa baruu la.
19Denii i bɔra sɔɔni mbusu lizaa la n deŋlee
ni yaa mbusu lizaa
kuŋfuuhlaa wia,
bá jaa kpa nabala
di lizi mbusu,
i mbusu lizibɔr la ni.

english_text:
(A special psalm by David for the music leader. He wrote this when Doeg from Edom went to Saul and said, “David has gone to Ahimelech's house.”)
God Is in Control
1 You people may be strong
and brag about your sins,
but God can be trusted
day after day.
2You plan brutal crimes,
and your lying words cut
like a sharp razor.
3You would rather do evil
than good, and tell lies
than speak the truth.
4You love to say cruel things,
and your words are a trap.
5God will destroy you forever!
He will grab you and drag you
from your homes.
You will be uprooted
and left to die.
6When good people see
this fearsome sight,
they will laugh and say,
7“Just look at them now!
Instead of trusting God,
they trusted their wealth
and their cruelty.”
8But I am like an olive tree
growing in God's house,
and I can count on his love
forever and ever.
9I will always thank God
for what he has done;
I will praise his good name
when his people meet.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi seriya dii ni u nɛsunaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1Fɔŋŋa hiŋ, ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i ra jigsi dikuu i wichɔgaa wiai?
Kɔraawiizi wia dɔɔ wibiire,
saŋaa saŋa maa.
2I ɔɔ ra ta nɛra chɔgaa jinaa,
i wiŋɔzi ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ fuŋ,
hinla n na dar nɛra.
3I nɔŋŋi wichɔgaarɛ kaali winanaa,
di nɔŋŋi kara kaali wibii.
4I nɔŋŋi wiŋɔzi la n na chɔgi nɛraa,
nɛdattii hiŋ!
5Awia, Kɔraawiizi daŋ chɔgii di hanna la,
u daŋ lawii, di vɛzii lii i dia,
di lizii lii nɛnyinee biini.
6Banla wia n deŋlee daŋ na guŋ, ɔnsii lau baa,
ba danna mamii,
di ra ŋɔ,
7“Na, baal naabuu waa Kɔraawiizi dɛllɛɛ ú lɛɛu,
ka dɛlli u daama
un dɔɔwɛ werge ni,
di chɔgi nɛra,
di ra na fɔŋŋa!”
8Ka miŋwaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ ɔlivi daa,
n na hel
Kɔraawiizi Dia biini.
N yardi u nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ labuu,
saŋaa saŋa maa.
9N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n danna chɔlii saŋa maa,
dikuu gunla hiŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia.
Di dɔɔ tamii,
dikuu i sɔnnanii la wia,
di ɔɔ chi i nɛra see
di ra chɔlii.

english_text:
(A special psalm by David for the music leader. To the tune “Mahalath.”
)
No One Can Ignore God
1 Only a fool would say,
“There is no God!”
People like that are worthless!
They are heartless and cruel
and never do right.
2From heaven God
looks down to see
if anyone is wise enough
to search for him.
3But all of them
are crooked and corrupt.
Not one of them does right.
4Won't you lawbreakers learn?
You refuse to pray,
and you gobble up
the people of God.
5But you will be terrified
worse than ever before.
God will scatter the bones
of his enemies,
and you will be ashamed
when God rejects you.
6I long for someone from Zion
to come and save Israel!
Our God, when you bless
your people again,
Jacob's family will be glad,
and Israel will celebrate.
translation_text:
Newea biinikpola wia
Koori Deevid yir
1Gɛnaa ɔɔ ŋɔu ba biine,
“Kɔraawiizi waa hoo.”
Ba waa wibii dɔɔwɛ, ba maa ɛɛ wichɔgɛɛraa,
bɛl maa waa
winanaa ra ɛɛ.
2Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ du chinne, ka ra binni newea ú na,
di baŋhina du denii
di zum wia zɛɛ
gɛɛ di ra nyiŋŋi u bɔrɛi.
3Ba maa leuwoo.
Ba maanii ɛɛ wichɔgɛɛra,
bɛl maa waa hoo di ra ɛɛ winanaa.
Akai! Kpaŋkpaŋ maa waa hoo.
4Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ba waa zummɛa?
Wichɔgɛɛra naa gɛnnɔɔwaa?
Ba ra fini n nɛraa
ka ba wanna jaami.”
5Ka ɔnsii werge la,
ba ŋmɛnɛ maa
n haa waa nawɛɛ,
daŋ lau baa, dikuubɛɛwiai,
Kɔraawiizi daŋ yaari
u nɛra dɔma hoga.
U vɛɛ baabuu,
awia, Izrɛl hina
daŋ kpegli baa nɛnnɛ.
6N na suŋŋi wiizii Izrɛl hina na lɛɛi
lii Bolzeŋ Ziɔn.
Izrɛl hina bɔra daŋ sɔɔni
di Kɔraawiizi wa gillɔ
ba bir nyɛɛli.

english_text:
(For the music leader. Use with stringed instruments. A special psalm that David wrote when the people of Ziph went to Saul and said, “David is hiding here with us.”)
Trusting God in Times of Trouble
1 Save me, God, by your power
and prove that I am right.
2Listen to my prayer
and hear what I say.
3Cruel strangers have attacked
and want me dead.
Not one of them cares
about you.
4You will help me, Lord God,
and keep me from falling;
5you will punish my enemies
for their evil deeds.
Be my faithful friend
and destroy them.
6I will bring a gift
and offer a sacrifice
to you, Lord.
I will praise your name
because you are good.
7You have rescued me
from all my troubles,
and my own eyes have seen
my enemies fall.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizii n hiini
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ ni i fɔŋŋa,
di gil n dɔɔ n hiŋ
i kpegzi la wia!
2N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a nuu n suŋŋaa,
keŋŋi digni
di ra nuu n wiŋɔzi!
3Hɔɔhra ra bau bá wa fɔɔŋ,
sikpegii hina ge
ra nyiŋŋi ba kpuŋ,
nɛra la baga
n waa hoo i ni la.
4Wibii maa, hinuu n hiini,
hinuu ra guuŋ.
5N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil n dɔma wichɔgaa laŋŋi ba ni,
di chɔgi baa
dikuu i wibii wia.
6N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n daŋ sunzii,
di dargii,
dikuu hiŋ wesse wia.
7I lɛɛmbuu lii tɔɔrɔɔzi maa biini,
n siwee na
n dɔma cholaa.

english_text:
(A special psalm by David for the music leader. Use with stringed instruments.)
Betrayed by a Friend
1Listen, God, to my prayer!
Don't reject my request.
2Please listen and help me.
My thoughts are troubled,
and I keep groaning
3because my enemies attack
with loud shouts.
They treat me terribly
and hold angry grudges.
4My heart is racing fast,
and I am afraid of dying.
5I am trembling with fear,
completely terrified.
6I wish I had wings
like a dove,
so I could fly far away
and be at peace.
7I would go and live
in some distant desert.
8I would quickly find shelter
from howling winds
and raging storms.
9Confuse my enemies, Lord!
Upset their plans.
Cruelty and violence
are all I see in the city,
10and they are like guards
on patrol day and night.
The city is full of trouble,
evil, 11and corruption.
Troublemakers and liars
freely roam the streets.
12My enemies are not the ones
who sneer and make fun.
I could put up with that
or even hide from them.
13But it was my closest friend,
the one I trusted most.
14We enjoyed being together,
when we went with others
to your house, our God.
15All who hate me are controlled
by the power of evil.
Sentence them to death
and send them down alive
to the world of the dead.
16I ask for your help, Lord God,
and you will keep me safe.
17Morning, noon, and night
you hear my concerns
and my complaints.
18I am attacked from all sides,
but you will rescue me
unharmed by the battle.
19You have always ruled,
and you will hear me.
You will defeat my enemies
because they won't turn
and worship you.
20My friend turned against me
and broke his promise.
21His words were smoother
than butter, and softer
than olive oil.
But hatred filled his heart,
and he was ready to attack
with a sword.
22Our Lord, we belong to you.
We tell you what worries us,
and you won't let us fall.
23But what about those people
who are cruel and brutal?
You will throw them down
into the deepest pit
long before their time.
I trust you, Lord!
translation_text:
Nɛr la u dammu n ɛɛu sɔsɔgɔ wiisuŋŋaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a nuu n wiisuŋŋaa,
di gilɛɛ bir luŋ kpuŋ!
2A nuu n be, di sɛɛ tɛŋ,
n biini ra tɔɔrimbuu,
n ɛɛ kinchaŋ,
3dikuu n dɔma wiŋɔzi ni
biinikpola hina
sunnaa wia.
Ba ra tɔɔrimbuu werge,
ba baana ra fuuh n ni,
ba hahŋ.
4N biini chɔgimbuu werge maa,
n banchule ra lɔ
dikuu siu wia.
5Ɔnsii ni bɔsai chol n ni,
ɔnsii werge lawiŋ.
6N ŋɔ, “Di n vii dɔɔ keerii lugɔ komma,
n daŋ vii zaah
kaali yembɛl,
di ga heezi.
7N daŋ vii zaah kaali bɔɔnɛɛ,
di ga du hɛribɔduma biini.
8N daŋ vii yali siwee ga nyiŋŋi duuribɔr,
n ni pekpeg ni dooŋ peu
gilɛɛ dugli dɔŋa.”
9N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
gil n dɔma bugmi
ba wiŋɔzi biini!
N na naari ni kaluzii a bolzeŋ biini,
10wibaŋzi ni hamuŋzi maa.
Ba ɔɔ ra guuzi u koŋlaa ni,
di ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa
ni tɔɔrɔɔ wia u biini.
11Dɔŋa chɔgaa du bɔr maanii,
nɛsunnaa ni finaa
su a bolzeŋ ŋmɛnizi.
12Di n haahri faa ra gbɛlliŋ di ra ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ,
n daŋ vii wer di kanyitti,
gɛɛ di kpa n hiŋ suah u ni.
13Ka hìŋ́ n badɔnnɛ,
nɛr la miŋ yardɛɛ werge.
14Waabuu nɛr la n nuu n na ta jina,
di kpau ra jaami
Kɔraawiizi, u Dia biini.
15N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil n dɔma siu
di ba saŋa haa waa helle,
di gil hɛri di baa
di ba haa ra nyiŋ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, wichɔgaa du ba
diini ni ba bampireere.
16Ka n daŋ yir hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi,
í lɛɛŋ.
17Chɔɔzi, wibaŋa ani hamuŋa maanii
aŋ nuumi di ra tɛi,
i ɔɔ nuu.
18I daŋ bir kpogliŋ ba ni bɔsɔna,
di lii laalzi la maa
n ni n dɔma kpila
n na yoo la biini.
19Ka hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la n na di kora saŋa maa la,
daŋ nuu tɛŋ, di kpegli baa,
dikuubɛɛwiai, ba waa
nyiŋŋi ba bir ba nfɛssi,
ba wɛɛ ra ɔm.
20N ni n badɔŋ la n faa ra vol ga fɔɔ u dammuzii,
di chɔgi nuuzi la
uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ baa la.
21U nua faa summɔɔ lugɔ yazi,
ka hahzi faa du u bampirii.
U wiŋɔzi faa pɛssɔɔrɛ lugɔ nuu,
ka ra mɔŋ ge lugɔ tokobidiilii.
22Awia, wia la maa n na tir ia, ii kpaa ra bagli Kɔraawiizi,
u daŋ guu ia,
u ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá gil
banla wia n deŋlee la chol.
23Ka hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi waa daŋ gil biinikpola hina
tuu ba ŋmama biine.
Nɛkpuura ni karkanna
saŋa wàá hel,
ka ba siu.
Ka miŋwaa daŋ yardii.

english_text:
(For the music leader. To the tune “A Silent Dove in the Distance.”
A special psalm by David when the Philistines captured him in Gath.)
A Prayer of Trust in God
1 Have pity, God Most High!
My enemies chase me all day.
2Many of them are pursuing
and attacking me,
3but even when I am afraid,
I keep on trusting you.
4I praise your promises!
I trust you and am not afraid.
No one can harm me.
5Enemies spend the whole day
finding fault with me;
all they think about
is how to do me harm.
6They attack from ambush,
watching my every step
and hoping to kill me.
7They won't get away
with these crimes, God,
because when you get angry,
you destroy people.
8You have kept record
of my days of wandering.
You have stored my tears
in your bottle
and counted each of them.
9When I pray, Lord God,
my enemies will retreat,
because I know for certain
that you are with me.
10I praise your promises!
11I trust you and am not afraid.
No one can harm me.
12I will keep my promises
to you, my God,
and bring you gifts.
13You protected me from death
and kept me from stumbling,
so that I would please you
and follow the light
that leads to life.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi yardaa wiisuŋŋaa
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, na n sinyɛna,
dikuubɛɛwiai, ba fɔɔmbuu,
n dɔma ra tɔɔrimbuu
saŋa maa.
2N chɔgra ɔɔ ra duŋŋimbuu hɔpizii maa,
bakpila kpa jigsii
di ra fɔɔŋ.
3Di ɔnsii wa lawiŋ,
n daŋ yardii.
4N yardiibuu, awia maa ɔm,
n na chɔliibuu,
dikuu nua la
hiŋ ŋɔwɛɛ wia.
Bɛɛ newee wer ɛɛnnɛi?
5Hɔpizii maanii n dɔma ɔɔ ra koozi wia di ra du n ni,
ba ɔɔ ra ta jinaa
gunla ban niŋ ɛɛ
duŋ pira!
6A ba suahzuu ra ta jinachɔɔgaa,
di ra kpaŋ,
di ra binni wia la
maa minna ɛɛ,
di ra nyiŋŋi ba kpuŋ.
7Awia, n Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, tɛr ba digna,
dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia.
Kpa i baaŋfuuih
kpegli baa!
8I na gunla n tɔɔrɔɔ n makkɛɛ,
di zum gunla
miŋ wiiwe mag.
Guŋ waa hoo
i hɔŋ biiniaa?
9A hɔl la min niŋ yirii,
n dɔma daŋ bir har.
N zum gunnɛ,
i chigɔ n hattɛ.
10I wiŋɔzii n na chɔli!
I nuuŋɔɔlaarɛ n na chɔli.
11Hinuu n yardi, maa kaa ra ɔm,
awia, bɛɛ newee,
wer ɛɛnnɛi?
12N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
n daŋ lizi nuuzi la
miŋ lɛɛwɛ la tɛi,
n daŋ lizi jaaŋ
kunsunzaa tɛi,
13dikuubɛɛwiai, i lɛɛmbuu
lii siu be,
haa gillɛ n dɔma kpegliŋ.
Awia, n danna vol i see,
bɔchaaŋ la n na tɛɛ
newea miibɔɔ la biini.

english_text:
(For the music leader. To the tune “Don't Destroy.”
A special psalm by David when he was in the cave while running from Saul.)
Praise and Trust in Times of Trouble
1 God Most High, have pity on me!
Have mercy. I run to you
for safety.
In the shadow of your wings,
I seek protection
till danger dies down.
2I pray to you, my protector.
3You will send help from heaven
and save me,
but you will bring trouble
on my attackers.
You are faithful,
and you can be trusted.
4My enemies are fierce,
much worse than lions!
They have spears and arrows
instead of teeth,
and they have sharp swords
instead of tongues.
5May you, my God, be honored
above the heavens;
may your glory be seen
everywhere on earth.
6 Enemies set traps for my feet
and struck me down.
They dug a pit in my path,
but fell in it themselves.
7I am faithful to you,
and you can trust me.
I will sing and play music
for you, my God.
8I feel wide awake!
I will wake up my harp
and wake up the sun.
9I will praise you, Lord,
for everyone to hear,
and I will sing hymns to you
in every nation.
10Your love reaches higher
than the heavens;
your loyalty extends
beyond the clouds.
11May you, my God, be honored
above the heavens;
may your glory be seen
everywhere on earth.
translation_text:
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, na n sinyɛna,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n ba i benii
ŋɔ i lɛɛŋ.
A guuŋ alugɔ zal n ɔɔ yaa u keeri tɔ u biizi ni la,
di ra ba saŋa la hɛhchɔg la
n niŋ wa bɛri.
2N wiiwoo di ra du hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la,
hinuu ɛɛ wiimaa di ra tɛŋ.
3I daŋ nuu lii chiŋ di lɛɛŋ,
di kpegli banla n na sunniŋ la.
I daŋ bagliŋ i nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la
ani i wibii dɔɔi.
4N dɔma barimbuu,
ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bunyinzi la
lɔzi n na kpu,
a ra nyiŋŋi nɛra a hee.
Ba nyina ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ kandaazi ni hobee,
ba nuuzuŋŋa ɛɛ lugɔ
tokobizi n na di nɛnnɛ.
5N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a bagli i zenni chiŋ,
di gil i girme la su hɛri ge maa.
6N dɔma he sidɛɛrɛ bá lawiŋ,
bɔhuaih lawimbuu werge maa.
Ba ki bɔɔlunne n ŋmɛnɛɛ,
ka ba himmaa
bir chogli u biini.
7N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
n bampirii lauwɔɔ nɛnnɛ,
n daŋ yir yira di chɔlii!
8N daŋ feli izi,
di lɔ n kem ni janjalaŋ mɔɔ,
ka wiizi fur.
9N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n danna chɔlii hɛssi maa biine,
di yir yira di ra chɔlii
nɛra maa biini.
10I nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la
kannɔɔ werge di bɛri chiŋ,
i wibii dɔɔi la gba
gaa chug chiŋ wia.
11N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bagli i zenni lii chiŋ,
di gil i girme la su hɛri ge maa.

english_text:
(A special psalm by David for the music leader. To the tune “Don't Destroy.”
)
A Prayer When All Goes Wrong
1Do you mighty people talk
only to oppose justice?
Don't you ever judge fairly?
2You are always planning evil,
and you are brutal.
3You have done wrong and lied
from the day you were born.
4Your words spread poison
like the bite of a cobra
5that refuses to listen
to the snake charmer.
6My enemies are fierce
as lions, Lord God!
Shatter their teeth.
Snatch out their fangs.
7Make them disappear
like leaking water,
and make their arrows miss.
8Let them dry up like snails
or be like a child that dies
before seeing the sun.
9Wipe them out quicker
than a pot can be heated
by setting thorns on fire.
10Good people will be glad
when they see the wicked
getting what they deserve,
and they will wash their feet
in their enemies' blood.
11Everyone will say, “It's true!
Good people are rewarded.
God does indeed rule the earth
with justice.”
translation_text:
Biinikpola hina dignitɛraa wiisuŋŋaa
Koori Deevid yir
1Koora, ii ra ŋɔ wiarɛ ni wibiia?
Ií ra di nɛra seriyaa ni wibiia?
2Akai! Wichɔgaa la iin niŋ ɛɛ bɛnnɛ ii ɔɔ ra fɛ ii biine,
di ɔɔ ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa,
di ra naa nɛra a hɛri biini.
3Wichɔgɛɛra ra lewuu ba de dui biini saŋa maa,
di ra kanni kara lii a hɔl la
baŋ lul baa la.
4Ba wiŋɔzi ɛɛwɔɔ alugɔ hɛrikuŋ siri,
di ɛɛ lugɔ dundugu
digna n tɔɔgɛɛ la,
5ba waa kaa ra nuu hɛrikuŋ tagzi hiŋ loobii
gɛɛ u yirsuma gba.
6N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, kuugi n dɔma naa nyina
n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ
bunyinzi nyinvazi naa!
7Gil ba leu alugɔ nii n pallɛ kaali,
di ba wa kpa ba hozi,
gil ba hobee gbul.
8Gil ba hil lugɔ konti,
gɛɛ lugɔ biifula la
baŋ lullɛ u bir,
di waa wiizi nawɛɛ la.
9Ba daŋ waa hassi, di ba ŋmɛnni baa ta alugɔ kooree.
N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
i daŋ kpa i baaŋ la
heuzi baa ta,
di ba haa ra nyiŋ.
10Banla wia n deŋlee bɔra daŋ sɔɔni,
di ba wa na
banna tɛr wichɔgɛɛra digna,
ba daŋ vol
biinikpola hina challi biini.
11Denii nɛra ra ŋɔ,
“Wibii maa, banla wia
n deŋlee na ba kinturgaare.
Kɔraawiizi du denii wibii maa,
di ra di durnya seriya.”

english_text:
(For the music leader. To the tune “Don't Destroy.”
A special psalm by David when Saul had David's house watched so that he could kill him.)
A Prayer for Protection
1 Save me, God! Protect me
from enemy attacks!
2Keep me safe from brutal people
who want to kill me.
3Merciless enemies, Lord,
are hiding and plotting,
hoping to kill me.
I have not hurt them
in any way at all.
4But they are ready to attack.
Do something! Help me!
Look at what's happening.
5 Lord God All-Powerful,
you are the God of Israel.
Punish the other nations
and don't pity those terrible
and rebellious people.
6My enemies return at evening,
growling like dogs
roaming the city.
7They curse, and their words
cut like swords,
as they say to themselves,
“No one can hear us!”
8You, Lord, laugh at them
and sneer at the nations.
9You are my mighty fortress,
and I depend on you.
10You love me and will let me
see my enemies defeated.
11Don't kill them,
or everyone may forget!
Just use your mighty power
to make them tremble
and fall.
You are a shield
for your people.
12My enemies are liars!
So let them be trapped
by their boastful lies.
13Get angry and destroy them.
Leave them in ruin.
Then all the nations will know
that you rule in Israel.
14Those liars return at evening,
growling like dogs
roaming the city.
15They search for scraps of food,
and they snarl
until they are stuffed.
16But I will sing about
your strength, my God,
and I will celebrate
because of your love.
You are my fortress,
my place of protection
in times of trouble.
17I will sing your praises!
You are my mighty fortress,
and you love me.
translation_text:
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi guui
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ lii n dɔma be.
A guŋŋ lii banla
n izee chi n ni la be!
2Lɛɛŋ lii a wichɔgɛɛra be,
di lɛɛŋ lii a nɛkpuura be!
3Na! Ba sogo n sagaa!
Nɛchɔgaa suahwɔɔ
di ta jinachɔgaa n wia,
ka a waa lugɔ wichɔgaa
gɛɛ wii bɛllɛ n ɛɛ leu.
4Maa wiimaa ɛɛwɛ leu,
ka ba ɛɛ sirya bá pigiŋ,
izi wa lɛɛŋ, na n dɔgnya!
5Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, izi wa hiiniŋ,
í himmaa na,
Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina
n na hum!
Izi chiŋ, di tɛr nɛra la n wɛɛ ra hum la digna,
gilɛɛ waa suŋ biinikpola hina la
n ɛɛ sɔsɔgɔ hina la ni!
6Duana maa, ba ɔɔ biruu ba di waa uuhri,
alugɔ nuuzihina
di ra bar a bolzeŋ.
7A nuu huuhni ani ba nɛɔnzaa wiŋɔzi.
Ba nuuzuŋŋa ɛɛwɔɔ
lugɔ tokobizi,
ka ba ra fɛ lugɔ
nɛr maa waa ba wia ra nuu.
8Ka n Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hiŋwaa ra mam baabuu,
di ra ɛɛ banla
n wɛɛ ra jaami la chɛɛtɛ.
9Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ,
i siweere n na binni,
hinuu ɛɛwɛ lugɔ n diikpeg,
Kɔraawiizi la n nɔŋŋiŋ.
10I daŋ tɔ n see,
di gil n na n dɔma cholaa,
n bɔra sɔɔni.
11N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gilɛɛ waa kpuuzi baa,
di guŋ ɛɛwɔ,
n nɛra daŋ suuh.
Kpa i fɔŋŋa di gil ba yaari, di kpegli baa,
hinuu ɛɛ yaa guuri.
12Wichɔgaa du ba nuuzii, ba wiŋɔzi maa ɛɛ wichɔgaa,
gil ba jigsi la laŋŋi ba ni!
Dikuu banna see nɛra nuuzi di ra kanni kara wia,
13kpa baaŋfuuihchɔgaa
di chɔgi baa,
bá wia tuŋ kɔrai.
Denii nɛr maa zum lugɔ hinuu di Izrɛl hina kora,
i kora ge yaari durnya maa.
14Duana maa, ba ɔɔ biruu ba di waa uuhri,
alugɔ nuuzihina
di ra bar a bolzeŋ,
15di ra nyiŋŋi diwee, di ba waa haŋ wa piŋ,
ba ɔɔ ra wozuu lugɔ nuuzihina.
16Ka miŋwaa daŋ yir yira dikuu i kpegzi wia,
chɔɔzi maa, n daŋ ɔɔ yir yira,
dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ wia.
Dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu ɛɛwɛ lugɔ
n diikpeg
ni n suahribɔr, tɔɔrɔɔ saŋa.
17Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ,
n yir yiraa di ra chɔlii,
hinuu ɛɛwɛ lugɔ n diikpeg,
Kɔraawiizi la n nɔŋŋiŋ.

english_text:
(For the music leader. To the tune “Lily of the Promise.” A special psalm by David for teaching. He wrote it during his wars with the Arameans of northern Syria,
when Joab came back and killed twelve thousand Edomites
in Salt Valley.)
You Can Depend on God
1 You, God, are angry with us!
We are rejected and crushed.
Make us strong again!
2You made the earth shake
and split wide open;
now heal its wounds
and stop its trembling.
3You brought hard times
on your people,
and you gave us wine
that made us stagger.
4You gave a signal to those
who worship you,
so they could escape
from enemy arrows.
5Answer our prayers, God!
Use your powerful arm
and give us victory.
Then the people you love
will be safe.
6Our God, you solemnly promised,
“I would gladly divide up
the city of Shechem
and give away Succoth Valley
piece by piece.
7The lands of Gilead
and Manasseh are mine.
Ephraim is my war helmet,
and Judah is the symbol
of my royal power.
8Moab is merely my washbasin.
Edom belongs to me,
and I shout in triumph
over the Philistines.”
9Our God, who will bring me
to the fortress,
or lead me to Edom?
10Have you rejected us
and deserted our armies?
11Help us defeat our enemies!
No one else can rescue us.
12You will give us victory
and crush our enemies.
translation_text:
Lɛɛi wiisuŋŋaa
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i baaŋ fuuh yaa ninɛɛ werge maa,
i bir har kpu yaa, di vɛɛ yaa ta,
ka filaŋkeŋwaa,
kaa bir ba yaa be!
2I gillɔɔ yaa hɛri zigli, di pergi,
bir tɔɔgi u bɔpergaa la,
dikuubɛɛwiai, u maanii ra zigli.
3I gillɔɔ i nɛra di tɔɔrɔɔ werge maa,
yaa ra jiŋli alugɔ
yaa n nyɔɔ siŋ di ra dɛɛzi.
4I karfi banla n na tɔgzii labuu,
bá chɔ lii siu be.
5Kpa i fɔŋŋazeŋ la lɛɛ yaa,
guŋ gil banla
hiŋ nɔŋŋɛɛ la na bahinaa.
6Kɔraawiizi du u Dia la biinii, di ŋɔ,
“N kpegloore, awia,
n daŋ bargi bolzeŋ Sɛkɛm,
di kpa Sukɔf Waluu
bɔnni n nɛra.
7Giliad ni Manasɛ maa ɛɛ n horaa,
Ɛfram ɛɛ lugɔ n lugbii kahuro,
Juda ɛɛ lugɔ n koori daŋkpala.
8Moab ɛɛ n niisannileere,
n daŋ kpa n gawa
ta Ɛdɔm ni,
di ra bagli lugɔ u ɛɛ n hotte.
Ka chaasi du Filisti hina ni,
dikuu miŋ kpegli baa wia.”
9N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, anɛɛ n niŋ kpogliŋ,
ba bolzeŋ la
baŋ ma koŋlii bar lai?
Anɛɛ n niŋ tɔ n see
la Ɛdɔmɛi?
10N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hiŋ lɛi vɛɛ yaa,
haa kaa du yaa laallɔɔra
di ra la laal bɔraa?
11Hiini yaa yá kpegli yaa dɔma,
newee waa hiinaa ɛɛ pɛɛrɛ.
12Hiŋ du yaa be la wia, yaa daŋ kpegli baa,
i daŋ kpegli yaa dɔma
tɛɛ yaa.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader. Use with stringed instruments.)
Under the Protection of God
1Please listen, God,
and answer my prayer!
2I feel hopeless,
and I cry out to you
from a faraway land.
Lead me to the mighty rock
high above me.
3You are a strong tower,
where I am safe
from my enemies.
4Let me live with you forever
and find protection
under your wings, my God.
5You heard my promises,
and you have blessed me,
just as you bless everyone
who worships you.
6Let the king have a long
and healthy life.
7May he always rule
with you, God, at his side;
may your love and loyalty
watch over him.
8I will sing your praises
forever, God, and will always
keep my promises.
translation_text:
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi guui
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, nuu n wiraa,
di nuu n wiisuŋŋaa!
2Biinichɔg lawimbuu werge maa,
n du hɛri tunazi di ra yirii!
Wa tɔ n see, di ga kpaŋ
chiŋŋi bɔr la
min niŋ na n hiŋ,
3dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu
ɛɛ n guuri,
di ɛɛ lugɔ n diijaŋ la
n kpekke, n dɔma be.
4Gil n du i Dia la biini, n de dui maa biini,
di ra guŋŋ alugɔ zal n ɔɔ yaa
u keeri tɔ u biizi ni la.
5N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i nuu n nuuzi la miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛi labuu,
di tɛŋ kuna la n ɛɛ
banla n na tɔgzii hora la.
6Tɛɛ a koori miibɔɔjaŋ,
di gil u di biŋkpila werge maa!
7N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil ú di a kora i see di hanna la,
di kpa i nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la
ani i wibii dɔɔi la,
di ra binni u ni.
8Gunnɛ ń jaa ra yir yira saŋa maa di ra chɔlii,
gunla miŋ ŋɔ nua
di ra ɛɛ hɔpizi biimaa la.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for Jeduthun, the music leader.)
God Is Powerful and Kind
1Only God can save me,
and I calmly wait for him.
2God alone is the mighty rock
that keeps me safe
and the fortress
where I am secure.
3I feel like a shaky fence
or a sagging wall.
How long will all of you
attack and assault me?
4You want to bring me down
from my place of honor.
You love to tell lies,
and when your words are kind,
hatred hides in your heart.
5Only God gives inward peace,
and I depend on him.
6God alone is the mighty rock
that keeps me safe,
and he is the fortress
where I feel secure.
7God saves me and honors me.
He is that mighty rock
where I find safety.
8Trust God, my friends,
and always tell him
each of your concerns.
God is our place of safety.
9We humans are only a breath;
none of us are truly great.
All of us together weigh less
than a puff of air.
10Don't trust in violence
or depend on dishonesty
or rely on great wealth.
11I heard God say two things:
“I am powerful,
12 and I am very kind.”
The Lord rewards each of us
according to what we do.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi nɛguui yardaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N na kpaŋ Kɔraawiizii ú wa lɛɛŋ,
u bɛŋ ninɛɛ n dɛlli.
2U bɛnnɛ ra binniŋ di ra lɛɛŋ,
waabuu ɛɛ n guuri,
awia màá chol maa.
3Ɛrɛɛ ii maa pig nɛr di birgi mag,
unla n gɛrgɛɛ
alugɔ koŋlii n gɛrgɛɛnɛi?
4Ii ɔɔ ra ta jinaa ii ɛɛu, ú lii u girme bɔr chol,
kara kannaa ɔɔ par iabuu.
Ii ɔɔ kpa ii nuuzii di ra kissi nɛra,
ka ra see baa nuuzi ii biine.
5Kɔraawiizi bɛŋ ninɛɛ n dɛlli,
n tamii maa du u ninɛɛ.
6U bɛnnɛ ra binniŋ di ra lɛɛŋ,
waabuu ɛɛ n guuri,
awia, màá chol maa.
7N lɛɛi ni n girme du Kɔraawiizi benii,
waabuu ɛɛ n guurikpeg,
di jaari n ni.
8Awia, n nɛra, ií yarduu saŋa maa,
di kpa ii witittaa maa
di ra bagluu,
dikuubɛɛwiai, waabuu
ɛɛ yaa suahribɔr.
9Newee maa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ heeza kakpaŋ!
Ba maanii ɛɛ kumpɛɛri.
Di ba ŋɔ ba mɛgzi ba tɔgzi,
ba maa fukkɔɔ
kaali heeza.
10Ií gilɛɛ yardi nɛfoozaa,
di gilɛɛ kpa ii tamii
ra du ŋmɛɛri ni.
Haali di ii daama wa wazɔɔ gba,
ka ii gilɛɛ waa dɛllaa.
11N nuuwɔ hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ bukpila maa lugɔ,
hinuu dɔɔ fɔŋŋa,
12dí i nɔŋŋaa
waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
Wibii maa, hinuu niŋ turgi
nɛr maa, u wiɛɛlaa kim.

english_text:
(A psalm by David when he was in the desert of Judah.)
God's Love Means More than Life
1 You are my God. I worship you.
In my heart, I long for you,
as I would long for a stream
in a scorching desert.
2I have seen your power
and your glory
in the place of worship.
3Your love means more
than life to me,
and I praise you.
4As long as I live,
I will pray to you.
5I will sing joyful praises
and be filled with excitement
like a guest at a banquet.
6I think about you, God,
before I go to sleep,
and my thoughts turn to you
during the night.
7You have helped me,
and I sing happy songs
in the shadow of your wings.
8I stay close to you,
and your powerful arm
supports me.
9All who want to kill me
will end up in the ground.
10Swords will run them through,
and wild dogs will eat them.
11Because of you, our God,
the king will celebrate
with your faithful followers,
but liars will be silent.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi nai du n bampiriire
Koori Deevid yir
1Kɔraawiizi la minna hum,
n na nyiŋŋi i nairɛ
siaahmu maa ni.
Di ra nyiŋŋii alugɔ niinyɔgzi hiŋ
n na nyiŋŋi nii la
gɛɛ n du hɛribɔduma la,
nii waa hoo de la.
2Gil ń nai, i Dia la biini,
di na gunla i fɔŋŋa
ani i girme la n duwɛɛ.
3Dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la n kaali miibɔɔ wia,
n danna chɔlii.
4Awia, n danna chɔlii n de du maa biini,
di lalli n nonee chiŋ
di ra suŋŋii.
5N daŋ yir bɔsɔna yira, n bɔra ra pur alugɔ nɛr n di diuzenaa piŋ,
di yir bɔsɔna yira di ra chɔlii.
6Di n wa chɔɔ n kunchɔɔrikuŋ ni, anna liizi i wiarɛ,
hamuŋa maa,
i wia ɔɔ du n bampiriire,
7dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu ɛɛ n hiini,
a guuŋ alugɔ zal n ɔɔ yaa
u keeri tɔ u biizi ni gunla,
ń na yir yira ni bɔsɔna.
8N faamiibuu kiŋkiŋ,
i banonii la lawiŋ kpogli.
9Ka banla waa, n na nyiŋŋi bá kpuŋ la,
ba daŋ kpu baa,
bá tuu kaali lalaa bol.
10Ba daŋ kpu baa laal biini,
hohobiazi hee baa.
11Ama, a koori waa daŋ dɔɔ bɔsɔna Kɔraawiizi be,
banla ge maa n kpa
Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ hɛɛhzi la,
danna chɔluu,
ka ba daŋ tɔɔgi
karkanna waa nuuzi.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
Celebrate because of the Lord
1Listen to my concerns, God,
and protect me
from my enemies' threats.
2Keep me safe from secret plots
of corrupt and evil gangs.
3Their words cut like swords,
and their cruel remarks
sting like sharp arrows.
4They fearlessly ambush
and shoot innocent people.
5They are determined to do evil,
and they tell themselves,
“Let's set traps!
No one can see us.”
6They make evil plans and say,
“We'll commit a perfect crime.
No one knows our thoughts.”
7But God will shoot his arrows
and quickly wound them.
8They will be destroyed
by their own words,
and everyone who sees them
will tremble with fear.
9They will be afraid and say,
“Look at what God has done
and keep it all in mind.”
10May the Lord bless his people
with peace and happiness
and let them celebrate.
translation_text:
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi guui
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a nuu n wiisuŋŋaa,
ɔnsii lawimbuu n dɔma wia,
lɛɛŋ lii ba be!
2Kpaŋ suah lii jinachɔgaa la
biinikpola hina n na ta la ni
ani wichɔgɛɛra la n chaalɛɛ
di ra kɔɔ la be.
3Ba nuuzi ra diu alugɔ tokobizi baŋ sazɛɛ,
ba wiŋɔzi ge chum
lugɔ hobichɔgaa.
4Ba so saga di ra taazi nɛra la n waa wiimaa ɛɛwɛ hobee,
kakpaŋ, di ba ra taazi baa,
ba waa ɔm.
5Ba ɔɔ ra du dɔŋaa bɔkpega wichɔgaa ɛɛi jinazi tai biini,
di ɔɔ ra ŋɔ bɔra la
ban niŋ he ba sidɛɛzi wia.
Di ɔɔ ra ŋɔ,
“Anɛɛ n niŋ na yaai?”
6Ba ɔɔ ta wichɔgaa jinazii di ra ŋɔ,
“Yaa ta jinaa,
u du wer nɛnnɛ!”
Wibii, newee nfɛrɛ
ani u biini dɔɔ daraarɛ.
7Ka Kɔraawiizi daŋ taazi baa u hobee,
ba na pira kakpaŋ.
8U daŋ chɔgi baa, dikuu ba wiŋɔzi wia,
banla maa n niŋ na baa
danna gbɛlli baa.
9Denii newea maa jaa ra ɔm,
bá sii Kɔraawiizi
huŋhunnaa wia,
di ra fɛ gunla uŋ ɛɛwɛ wia.
10Gil banla maa wia n deŋlee dɔɔ bɔsɔna Kɔraawiizi be,
di na bahinaa,
di gil banla maa wia
n deŋlee ra chɔluu!

english_text:
(A psalm by David and a song for the music leader.)
God Answers Prayer
1Our God, you deserve praise
in Zion, where we keep
our promises to you.
2Everyone will come to you
because you answer prayer.
3When our sins get us down,
you forgive us.
4You bless your chosen ones,
and you invite them
to live near you
in your temple.
We will enjoy your house,
the sacred temple.
5Our God, you save us,
and your fearsome deeds answer
our prayers for justice!
You give hope to people
everywhere on earth,
even those across the sea.
6You are strong,
and your mighty power
put the mountains in place.
7You silence the roaring waves
and the noisy shouts
of the nations.
8People far away marvel
at your fearsome deeds,
and all who live under the sun
celebrate and sing
because of you.
9You take care of the earth
and send rain to help the soil
grow all kinds of crops.
Your rivers never run dry,
and you prepare the earth
to produce abundant grain.
10You water all its fields
and level the lumpy ground.
You send showers of rain
to soften the soil
and help the plants sprout.
11Wherever your footsteps
touch the earth,
a rich harvest is gathered.
12Desert pastures blossom,
and mountains celebrate.
13Meadows are filled
with sheep and goats;
valleys overflow with grain
and echo with joyful songs.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi chɔlaa ni jaaŋ tɛɛi yir
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a dɛkkɔɔ yaa n na chɔlii Bolzeŋ Ziɔn biini,
di ra hiŋ nuuzi la
yaa n ŋɔwɛɛ tɛi la,
2dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu ra nuu nɛra wiisuŋŋaa.
Nɛra daŋ lii yemmaa
di ra ba i be,
3dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia.
Yaa wichɔgaa n wa nyaŋŋi yaa,
hinuu gilaa tɛɛ yaa.
4Banla hiŋ lizɛɛ,
di gil ba wa du i Dia la,
nuu sumaa!
I Dia kunnanaa la n ɛɛ kissaa la,
daŋ gil yaa bɔra sɔɔni.
5N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i ɔɔ nuu yaa wiisuŋŋaarɛ, di gil yaa kpegli,
di ɔɔ ɛɛ nuukpuuri wia
lɛɛ yaa.
Durnya nɛra maa ani banla n du
muuni baŋgizi
bɔɔnɛɛ maa, yardiibuu.
6I fɔŋŋaa i kpa chiŋŋi bizenaa a chignibɔra,
di ra bagli i kpegzi la
n kannɛ werge la.
7I gillɔɔ muuni niiri
ni a nii a lɔi,
kɔɔi siigi kirkirkir,
di gil hɛssi hina ge gil kɔɔi.
8Guŋ gil durnya hina maa banchulli ra lɔ,
dikuu nuukpuuri wia la
hiŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia.
I wiɛɛlaa gillɔɔ nɛra la maa n du hɛri yemmaa,
ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna.
9Hɛri naa wia tiriibuu,
i ɔɔ giluu dooŋ ba u ni,
u du sum.
I gillɔɔ gɔŋa suugi niiri,
i tɛɛ nɛra pattikuna.
Kenne i ra ɛɛ,
10i ɔɔ giluu dooŋ ba kooni werge,
di gil a maa sɔɔni nɛnnɛ.
I ɔɔ giluu donii pɛssi hɛri nɛnnɛ,
di gil pattikuna ra hel.
11I winanaa ɔɔ giluu pattikuna pur,
bɔr la maa hiŋ laŋŋɛ,
kuna ɔɔ pur denii.
12Sela diiribɔra maanii suugi sela,
bɔsɔna du a giŋgimee kɛraa.
13A pire maanii suugi peeza,
a walli maa ge suugi mia.
Kummaa bɔra sɔɔni,
a ra yir yira ni bɔsɔna,
alugɔ newea.

english_text:
(A song and a psalm for the music leader.)
Shout Praises to God
1Tell everyone on this earth
to shout praises to God!
2Sing about his glorious name.
Honor him with praises.
3Say to God, “Everything you do
is fearsome,
and your mighty power makes
your enemies come crawling.
4You are worshiped by everyone!
We all sing praises to you.”
5Come and see the fearsome things
our God has done!
6 When God made the sea dry up,
our people walked across,
and because of him,
we celebrated there.
7His mighty power rules forever,
and nothing the nations do
can be hidden from him.
So don't turn against God.
8All of you people,
come praise our God!
Let his praises be heard.
9God protects us from death
and keeps us steady.
10Our God, you tested us,
just as silver is tested.
11You trapped us in a net
and gave us heavy burdens.
12You sent war chariots
to crush our skulls.
We traveled through fire
and through floods,
but you brought us
to a land of plenty.
13I will bring sacrifices
into your house, my God,
and I will do what I promised
14when I was in trouble.
15I will sacrifice my best sheep
and offer bulls and goats
on your altar.
16All who worship God,
come here and listen;
I will tell you everything
God has done for me.
17I prayed to the Lord,
and I praised him.
18If my thoughts had been sinful,
he would have refused
to hear me.
19But God did listen
and answered my prayer.
20Let's praise God!
He listened when I prayed,
and he is always kind.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi chɔlaa ni u jaaŋ tɛɛi yir
1Nɛra maa, ií ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna di ra yir yira,
di ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!
2Ií ra yir u sɔŋ tɔgzaa yira,
ií gil u chɔlaa dɔɔ girme.
3Ií ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi be, “I wiɛɛlaa wia ra kpu nuarɛ!
I fɔŋŋa ge kannɔɔ werge,
ɔnsii werge ɔɔ lau i dɔma,
ba giŋŋi i see.
4Durnya nɛra maanii ra jaamii,
di yir yira ra chɔlii,
di yir yira ra dargii.”
5Ií wa na gunla Kɔraawiizi n ɛɛwɛ,
uŋ kuu newea wia
di ɛɛ wizenaa.
6U faa gillɔɔ muuzeŋ birgi hɛrhilii,
yaa naabaala vol giu.
Ií ba, yaa bɔra sɔɔni werge,
dikuu gunla uŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia.
7U di koraa saŋaa saŋa maa ani u fɔŋŋa,
di ra binni hɛssi hina maa ni,
nɛra gilɛɛ waa dɔɔ
dignikpega u be.
8Hɛssi maa hina, ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la,
ií gil ba ra nuu u chɔlaa.
9Waabuu gillɛ yaa ra nyiŋ,
waa sɛɛwɛ yaa chol.
10N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i ɛɛ yaabuu na
gunla baŋ ɔɔ kpa niŋ
ŋmɛɛri saliŋhuŋŋu,
u doŋa lii la.
11I gillɔɔ sidɛɛ lau yaa,
di kpa buntɔga
sagzi yaa nyaŋa.
12I gillɔɔ yaa dɔma fɛrgi yaa ni naazi,
di gil yaa di tɔɔrɔɔ
alugɔ banla niŋ ni nii
n chɔgi ba kuna la.
Ka filaŋkeŋwaa, i jaa biruu kpa yaa
ba bɔr la n dɔɔ bɔsɔna.
13N daŋ kpa mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa wa zuu i Dia,
di lizi nuuzi la
miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛi la.
14N daŋ tɛi kunla miŋ faa du tɔɔrɔɔ biini,
di ŋɔ nua lugɔ n daŋ tɛi la.
15N daŋ kpa peeza lizi mbusu, di fuuah tɛi,
i mbusu lizibɔr la ni.
N daŋ kpu nabala ni buuna,
lizi mbusu i be,
á nyɔɔzi kaali chiŋ.
16Ií banla maa n na tɔgzi Kɔraawiizi, ií ba wa nuu,
ń bagli ia gunla uŋ ɛɛwɛ tɛŋ.
17N lɔ wilee tɛu ŋɔ ú hiiniŋ,
n yir yiraa chɔluu.
18Di n faa kpa wichɔgaarɛ suah n biini,
Kɔraawiizi vii wàá nuu tɛŋ.
19Ka Kɔraawiizi nuuwɔɔ tɛŋ,
wibii maa,
u nuu n wiisuŋŋaarɛ.
20N na chɔli Kɔraawiizii,
dikuu uŋ waa
n wiisuŋŋaa vɛɛwɛ
gɛɛ di vɛɛ n nɔŋŋaa wia.

english_text:
(A psalm and a song for the music leader. Use with stringed instruments.)
Tell the Nations To Praise God
1Our God, be kind and bless us!
Be pleased and smile.
2Then everyone on earth
will learn to follow you,
and all nations will see
your power to save us.
3Make everyone praise you
and shout your praises.
4Let the nations celebrate
with joyful songs,
because you judge fairly
and guide all nations.
5Make everyone praise you, God,
and shout your praises.
6Our God has blessed the earth
with a wonderful harvest!
7Pray for his blessings
to continue
and for everyone on earth
to worship our God.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ tɛɛi yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, suŋ yaa ni di kissi yaa,
di ra hiini yaa ni winanaa,
2gúnnɛ durnya hina maa wer zum i kipar,
hɛssi maa hina ge
wer zum i nɛlɛɛi wia.
3N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil nɛra ra chɔlii,
gil bá maa ra chɔlii,
wibii maa.
4Gil hɛssi hina bɔra sɔɔni, bá ra yir yira ni bɔsɔna,
dikuubɛɛwiai, i ɔɔ ra di
nɛra seriyaa ni wibii,
di ra tɔ durnya naa
hɛssi hina maa see.
5N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil nɛra ra chɔlii,
gil ba maa ra chɔlii, wibii maa.
6Gunnɛ a hɛri pattikuna lɛɛ,
Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la
daŋ kissi yaa.
7Kɔraawiizi daŋ kissi yaa,
durnya hina maa
danna jaamuu.

english_text:
(A psalm and a song by David for the music leader.)
God Will Win the Battle
1Do something, God!
Scatter your hateful enemies.
Make them turn and run.
2Scatter them like smoke!
When you come near,
make them melt
like wax in a fire.
3But let your people be happy
and celebrate because of you.
4Our God, you are the one
who rides on the clouds,
and we praise you.
Your name is the Lord,
and we celebrate
as we worship you.
5Our God, from your sacred home
you take care of orphans
and protect widows.
6You find families
for those who are lonely.
You set prisoners free
and let them prosper,
but all who rebel will live
in a scorching desert.
7You set your people free,
and you led them
through the desert.
8 God of Israel,
the earth trembled,
and rain poured down.
You alone are the God
who rules from Mount Sinai.
9When your land was thirsty,
you sent showers
to refresh it.
10Your people settled there,
and you were generous
to everyone in need.
11You gave the command, Lord,
and a chorus of women told
what had happened:
12“Kings and their armies
retreated and ran,
and everything they left
is now being divided.
13And for those who stayed back
to guard the sheep,
there are metal doves
with silver-coated wings
and shiny gold feathers.”
14God All-Powerful, you scattered
the kings like snow falling
on Mount Zalmon.
15Our Lord and our God,
Bashan is a mighty mountain
covered with peaks.
16Why is it jealous of Zion,
the mountain you chose
as your home forever?
17When you, Lord God, appeared
to your people at Sinai,
you came with thousands
of mighty chariots.
18 When you climbed
the high mountain,
you took prisoners with you
and were given gifts.
Your enemies didn't want you
to live there,
but they gave you gifts.
19We praise you, Lord God!
You treat us with kindness
day after day,
and you rescue us.
20You always protect us
and save us from death.
21Our Lord and our God,
your terrible enemies
are ready for war,
but you will crush
their skulls.
22You promised to bring them
from Bashan
and from the deepest sea.
23Then we could wash our feet
in their blood,
and our dogs could chew
on their bones.
24We have seen crowds marching
to your place of worship,
our God and King.
25Singers come first,
and then the musicians,
surrounded by young women
playing tambourines.
26They come shouting,
“People of Israel,
praise the Lord God!”
27The small tribe of Benjamin
leads the way,
followed by the leaders
from Judah.
Then come the leaders
from Zebulun and Naphtali.
28Our God, show your strength!
Show us once again.
29Then kings will bring gifts
to your temple
in Jerusalem.
30Punish that animal
that lives in the swamp!
Punish that nation
whose leaders and people
are like wild bulls.
Make them come crawling
with gifts of silver.
Scatter those nations
that enjoy making war.
31Force the Egyptians to bring
gifts of bronze;
make the Ethiopians hurry
to offer presents.
32Now sing praises to God!
Every kingdom on earth,
sing to the Lord!
33Praise the one who rides
across the ancient skies;
listen as he speaks
with a mighty voice.
34Tell about God's power!
He is honored in Israel,
and he rules the skies.
35The God of Israel is fearsome
in his temple,
and he makes us strong.
Let's praise our God!
translation_text:
Hɛri bɛl hina n kpegli ba dɔma yir
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, izi chiŋ, di gil i dɔma yaari,
banla maa n haih, chɔ yaari.
2Gunla peu n ɔɔ lɔ nyɔɔzi a kaali la,
gunnɛ í duŋŋi baa, bá kaali.
Gunla kel n ɔɔ dugli niŋ di ŋmɛɛri la,
gunnɛ biinikpola hina
wia tuŋ i see.
3Ama, gil banlawaa wia n deŋlee,
dɔɔ bɔsɔna i be,
bá bɔra sɔɔni, bá ra chaasi.
4Ií yir yira di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi,
ií yir yira di ra chɔluu.
Ií kuari ŋmɛnɛɛ di ra tɛu,
waabuu unla n tinni baamazi
di ra ba,
u sɔnnɛ Kɔraawiizi,
ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni u see!
5Kɔraawiizi la n du u Diinaniinanii labuu
ra binni lalbiizi
ni luhaana ni.
6Kɔraawiizii ra tɛɛ nɛr la n nyaa nɛra zuuribɔr,
di ra lizi banla baŋ tɔɔgɛɛ diini,
ba ra dɔɔ bɔsɔna,
ka banla digna n kpekke waa,
u gillɔɔ ba ra zuu hɛribɔduma biini.
7N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, saŋa la hiŋ faa tɔ i nɛra see la,
ba vol di wa ga hɛribɔduma la,
8hɛri faa zigloore,
baamazi ge faa ra bizi dooŋ
Bizeŋ Sinaai Kɔraawiizi la see,
Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina
n na hum la see.
9I gillɔɔ dooŋ nɛɛ nɛnnɛ,
di gil i hɛri la n siuwɛ la bir du sum.
10I nɛra sogo u biinii,
dikuu i wia n wesse la wia,
i tɛɛ nyaaraa ba kunnyiŋŋaa.
11Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ wiarɛ,
hahkpila maa siia, di ra ŋɔ,
12“Koora ni laallɔɔra
hahzoore chɔ ra kaali,
ka haana la n du bol
kpa kuna la
baŋ foozee laal biini,
di ra bɔnni dɔŋa.
13Banla n chɔɔwɛ di ra binni peeza la,
na lugbia kommazi baŋ kpa,
saliŋhuŋŋu tɔ a ni,
saliŋ ge tɔ a huna ni,
di ra nyɛgzi la.”
14Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la n wa duŋŋi koora a hɛri la,
a faa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ dobia
n chol Bizeŋ Zalmɔn ni.
15Basan hɛri bizeŋ la kannɔɔ werge maa,
di dɔɔ nyukpila,
a la chiŋ werge!
16Bizenaa la n dɔɔ nyukpila, ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ii ra binni
bizeŋ la Kɔraawiizi n lizɛɛ
ú di kora de,
bɔr la u himmaa
n niŋ du saŋaa saŋa maa
ni bɔwii alugɔ nɛr bɔra
n na wiiyɛi?
17Kɔraawiizi lii Bizeŋ Sinaairɛ di ra ba u Dia la
ni torkozenaa kagboŋa,
18di tinni chiŋ ra kaali.
U lauri laal yomaa hiŋ u hiŋ,
di ra na sunzaazi kpila
ra lii dignikpega hina be.
Kɔraawiizi daŋ so de.
19Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ yaa Lɛɛri la,
waabuu lɛɛ yaa buntɔga
di ra chi hɔpizi biimaa.
20Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum labuu ra lɛɛ nɛra,
waabuu ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi La
N Kaali Kummaa la,
n lɛɛ nɛra di ra lii siu biini la.
21Wibii maa, Kɔraawiizi daŋ purgi u dɔma nyuuni,
u daŋ purgi banla
n na ɛɛ wichɔgaa la nyuuni.
22Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“N daŋ kpogli ii dɔma lii
Basan hɛri bir ba,
n daŋ kpogli baa lii
muuzeŋ vile bir ba,
23guŋ gil ii ra vol ba challi ni,
ii nuuzihina ge
lennaa piŋ.”
24N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, nɛra maanii ra na i volaa,
Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ
n Koorizeŋ ni u nɛra
n ta chɔŋ
di ra zuu u Dia la.
25Yiryitta tɔ see, kunlɔɔra du harbɔɔ,
ka suŋgure du ba baambaaŋ
di ra yigzi kuna.
26Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi bɔr la u ni u nɛra n chemme,
ií ra chɔluu,
Izrɛl hina maa!
27Bɛnjamin dee la n du tama a dizi maa biinii tɔ see,
Juda dee sitɔɔra hiŋ,
ka Zɛbulɔn ni Naftali ge
dizi sitɔɔra ra hiŋ.
28Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bagli i fɔŋŋa,
fɔŋŋa la hiŋ faa
bagli yaa la.
29Dikuu i Dia la n du Jɛrusalɛm wia,
koora daŋ kpa kuna
wa sunzii.
30Izi hau Ijip hina la n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ sechuma,
n du nii nua kooree biini la ni.
Tɛr hɛssi la hina la n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ nabalkpila ni nabizi la digna,
di ra ba saŋa la ba maa
n niŋ wa togni i see,
di kpa ba saliŋhuŋŋa sunzii!
Duŋŋi banla maa
n nɔŋŋi laal la, bá yaari.
31Nabɔnzi la n chigɛ tɛɛ Ijip hina daŋ ba,
Itiopia hina ge kpa bahinaa
wa tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi.
32Durnya kossi maa, ií yir yira di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi,
ií yir yira di ra chɔluu,
33waabuu soge baamazi ni faala maa la.
Ií keŋŋi digna
di ra nuu u pogzaa.
34Ií ra sii Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa wia,
u zenni tɔ Izrɛl hina ninɛɛ,
u fɔŋŋa ge du chiŋ.
35Di Kɔraawiizi wa lii u Dia la di ra ba,
u wia ɔɔ dɔɔ ɔnsiirɛ werge.
Waabuu Izrɛl hina ra hum, u ra tɛɛ baa kpegzi.
Ií ra chɔluu!

english_text:
(By David for the music leader. To the tune “Lilies.”)
God Can Be Trusted
1Save me, God!
I am about to drown.
2I am sinking deep in the mud,
and my feet are slipping.
I am about to be swept under
by a mighty flood.
3I am worn out from crying,
and my throat is dry.
I have waited for you
till my eyes are blurred.
4 There are more people
who hate me for no reason
than there are hairs
on my head.
Many terrible enemies
want to destroy me, God.
Am I supposed to give back
something I didn't steal?
5You know my foolish sins.
Not one is hidden from you.
6 Lord God All-Powerful,
ruler of Israel,
don't let me embarrass anyone
who trusts and worships you.
7It is for your sake alone
that I am insulted
and blush with shame.
8I am like a stranger
to my relatives
and like a foreigner
to my own family.
9 My love for your house
burns in me like a fire,
and when others insult you,
they insulted me as well.
10I cried and went without food,
but they still insulted me.
11They sneered at me
for wearing sackcloth
to show my sorrow.
12Rulers and judges gossip
about me,
and drunkards make up songs
to mock me.
13But I pray to you, Lord.
So when the time is right,
answer me and help me
with your wonderful love.
14Don't let me sink in the mud,
but save me from my enemies
and from the deep water.
15Don't let me be
swept away by a flood
or drowned in the ocean
or swallowed by death.
16Answer me, Lord!
You are kind and good.
Pay attention to me!
You are truly merciful.
17Don't turn away from me.
I am your servant,
and I am in trouble.
Please hurry and help!
18Come and save me
from my enemies.
19You know how I am insulted,
mocked, and disgraced;
you know every one
of my enemies.
20I am crushed by insults,
and I feel sick.
I had hoped for mercy and pity,
but there was none.
21 Enemies poisoned my food,
and when I was thirsty,
they gave me vinegar.
22 Make their table a trap
for them and their friends.
23Blind them with darkness
and make them tremble.
24Show them how angry you are!
Be furious and catch them.
25 Destroy their camp
and don't let anyone live
in their tents.
26They cause trouble for people
you have already punished;
their gossip hurts those
you have wounded.
27Make them guiltier than ever
and don't forgive them.
28 Wipe their names from the book
of the living;
remove them from the list
of the innocent.
29I am mistreated and in pain.
Protect me, God,
and keep me safe!
30I will praise the Lord God
with a song
and a thankful heart.
31This will please the Lord
better than offering an ox
or a full-grown bull.
32When those in need see this,
they will be happy,
and the Lord's worshipers
will be encouraged.
33The Lord will listen
when the homeless cry out,
and he will never forget
his people in prison.
34Heaven and earth
will praise our God,
and so will the oceans
and everything in them.
35God will rescue Jerusalem,
and he will rebuild
the towns of Judah.
His people will live there
on their own land,
36and when the time comes,
their children will inherit
the land.
Then everyone who loves God
will also settle there.
translation_text:
Wile di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ!
N tɔɔrɔɔ ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ
nii n suwee hel n baŋaa.
2A ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ minna nir kpɛchɛgaa la n luŋŋe biinii,
bɔhilii waa hoo ń chi.
N hel ville,
nii lɔ di ra nyiŋŋi u diŋ.
3N wiiwoo nyiŋŋi hiinaa guŋŋ wa kuuh,
n loobii maa hil,
n siwee waa
kaa ra na nɛnnɛ,
dikuu miŋ wiiwe
di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa
i be wia.
4Banla n hahŋ pɛɛpɛɛ,
kpillɔɔ di kaali n nyuhuna.
N dɔma kanni karaa chugiŋ,
ba dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa
di ra nyiŋŋi ba kpuŋ.
Kuna la miŋ waa ŋmɛɛwɛ,
ka ba ɔɔ firimbuu n turgaa.
5N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i zum n gɛnaa wiarɛ,
n wichɔgaa waa
i ni suahwɛ.
6Kɔraawiizi La N Ɛɛ Koora Maa Koori,
di ɛɛ Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la,
gilɛɛ gil banla
n dɔɔ i tamii la,
wàá di hiihzi,
dikuu n wia!
Gilɛɛ gil n kpa hiihzi kpu banla n na jaamii la,
Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina
n na hum!
7I wiarɛ ba ra chagziŋ,
hiihzi ge ra kpuŋ.
8N jaa ɛɛu lugɔ famaruu n mɛɛ biizi be,
di birgi lugɔ hɛrduma hinuu
n maa biizi be.
9I Dia wiarɛ aah n siwii werge maa,
chagzaa la banna chagzii la ge
bir di ra chugiŋ.
10Di n waa wii, di vɔɔ nua,
nɛra ɔɔ ra chagzimbuu,
ka n lau n hiŋ.
11Di n wa laali gbɔglɔŋ,
n ɔɔ birgi chɛɛtɛ kunnɛ.
12Banla n ɔɔ so a bol dominuuzi,
ɔɔ ra ɛɛmbuu chɛɛtɛ,
banla n nyɔɔ siŋ
di ra dɛɛzi ge
kpaŋ birgi ba yira kuŋ.
13N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ka miŋwaa ra suŋŋiibuu,
nuu n suŋŋaa,
saŋa la n parii,
dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la n kannɛ werge
ani hiŋ ŋɔ nua lugɔ
i daŋ lɛɛŋ la wia.
14Lɛɛŋ lii n tɔɔrɔɔ n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ
kpɛchɛgaa n luŋŋe,
n na nyiŋŋi
n nir a biini la.
Lɛɛŋ lii banla n hahŋ be,
di gilɛɛ gil niivile diŋ.
15Gilɛɛ gil a niizenaa wa tɔ n ni,
di gilɛɛ gil a niivile diŋ
gɛɛ ŋmama diŋ.
16N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, nuu n suŋŋaa,
dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia,
i nɛsunaa n kannɛ la wia,
nuu n be.
17Gilɛɛ bir i har kpu i balii,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n du
tɔɔrɔɔ werge biinii,
nuu n wiisuŋŋaa manaŋ!
18Ba n be wa lɛɛŋ,
wa lɛɛŋ lii n dɔma be.
19I zum gunla nɛra n na ɛɛmbuu chɛɛtɛ,
gunla miŋ di hiihzi,
di nyaa girme.
I ra na n dɔma ge maanii.
20Chɛɛtɛ gillɔɔ n biini chɔgi,
n bɔra maa ge huah.
N na ɛɛ bampirtigaa tamiirɛ, ka maa nawɛɛ,
di ra nyiŋŋi banla
n niŋ tig n bampirii,
ka maa bɛl maa nawɛɛ.
21Lɔzi n waa kpuŋ, ba kpa kpolle du n diwee biini,
niinyɔgzi ge n wa lawiŋ,
ba kpa sinnyɛgrɛ tɛŋ.
22Di ba wa chaalɔɔ, ba bɔra sɔɔni ba ra di,
gil á birgi wia tɛɛ baa
alugɔ sidɛɛ, di lau baa,
bá kɛŋli, bá wichɔgaa
laŋŋi ba ni.
23Gil ba siwee biri, bá na bɔr huhzi.
Gil ba gɛrgi di hanna la!
24Gil i baaŋ fuuh ba ni werge,
di kpa i baaŋfuuih la wia
n dɔɔ ɔnsii la
di chɔgi baa.
25Gil ba diini birgi diiwooni,
nɛr maa wàá ka
du a biine,
26dikuubɛɛwiai, ba ra sunni banla hiŋ du pira labuu,
di ra ŋɔ
ba bɔra wiila wia.
27Sɛbi ba wichɔgaa maa dau,
di gilɛɛ gil ba waa jaa
i nɛra lɛɛi la biini.
28Dinzi ba sɔna lii banla sɔna baŋ sɛbɛɛ
du miibɔɔ hɔŋ biini,
di gilɛɛ gil ba waa jaa
banla wia n deŋlee la biini.
29N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n bɔra ra wiiu, n tamii tuŋ,
lalliŋ chiŋ, di lɛɛŋ!
30N daŋ yir yir darguu,
di kpa jaaŋ tɛu girme.
31Gunnɛ niŋ par Kɔraawiizi,
kaali miŋ kpa navarga
lizi mbusu u be
gɛɛ miŋ kpa nabal
n helle werge
lizi mbusu u be.
32Di banla banna sunni la wa na guŋ, ba bɔra daŋ sɔɔni,
banla ge n na jaami
Kɔraawiizi la
daŋ dɔɔ bɔkpega.
33Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra nuu nyaara wiisuŋŋaarɛ,
waa ɔɔ ra suuh
u nɛra la
baŋ tɔɔgɛɛ diini wia.
34Gil kuna la maa n du chiŋ, hɛri
ani muuni biine
ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi,
35dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi
daŋ lɛɛ Jɛrusalɛm hina,
di bir ma
Juda bolzenaa la maa.
U nɛra daŋ du de, di dɔɔ a hɛri.
36U balaa biizi
daŋ kpau birgi ba kuŋ,
banla maa n nɔŋŋuu la
jaa du de.

english_text:
(By David for the music leader. To be used when an offering is made.)
God Is Wonderful
1Save me, Lord God!
Hurry and help.
2Disappoint and confuse
all who want to kill me.
Turn away and disgrace
all who want to hurt me.
3Embarrass and shame those
who say, “We told you so!”
4Let your worshipers celebrate
and be glad because of you.
They love your saving power,
so let them always say,
“God is wonderful!”
5I am poor and needy,
but you, the Lord God,
care about me.
You are the one who saves me.
Please hurry and help!

Koori Deevid yir

english_text:
A Prayer for God's Protection
1I run to you, Lord,
for protection.
Don't disappoint me.
2You do what is right,
so come to my rescue.
Listen to my prayer
and keep me safe.
3Be my mighty rock, the place
where I can always run
for protection.
Save me by your command!
You are my mighty rock
and my fortress.
4Come and save me, Lord God,
from vicious and cruel
and brutal enemies!
5I depend on you,
and I have trusted you
since I was young.
6I have relied on you
from the day I was born.
You brought me safely
through birth,
and I always praise you.
7Many people think of me
as something evil.
But you are my mighty protector,
8and I praise and honor you
all day long.
9Don't throw me aside
when I am old;
don't desert me
when my strength is gone.
10My enemies are plotting
because they want me dead.
11They say, “Now we'll catch you!
God has deserted you,
and no one can save you.”
12Come closer, God!
Please hurry and help.
13Embarrass and destroy
all who want me dead;
disgrace and confuse
all who want to hurt me.
14I will never give up hope
or stop praising you.
15All day long I will tell
the wonderful things you do
to save your people.
But you have done much more
than I could possibly know.
16I will praise you, Lord God,
for your mighty deeds
and your power to save.
17You have taught me
since I was a child,
and I never stop telling about
your marvelous deeds.
18Don't leave me when I am old
and my hair turns gray.
Let me tell future generations
about your mighty power.
19Your deeds of kindness
are known in the heavens.
No one is like you!
20You made me suffer a lot,
but you will bring me
back from this deep pit
and give me new life.
21You will make me truly great
and take my sorrow away.
22I will praise you, God,
the Holy One of Israel.
You are faithful.
I will play the harp
and sing your praises.
23You have rescued me!
I will celebrate and shout,
singing praises to you
with all my heart.
24All day long I will announce
your power to save.
I will tell how you disgraced
and disappointed those
who wanted to hurt me.
translation_text:
Bazɛŋa wiisuŋŋaa wia
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n chɔwɔɔrɛ wa zuui,
ŋmɛnɛ maa, gilɛɛ wa gil
n na di hiihzi!
2I wia n deŋlee la wia, hiiniŋ di lɛɛŋ,
nuu n be, di lɛɛŋ!
3Ɛɛ lugɔ bikpeg la min niŋ ɔɔ chɔ
ga suah u biini saŋa maa.
Ŋɔ bá lɛɛŋ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu
ɛɛwɛ lugɔ n bii
ni n diikpeg.
4Kɔraawiizi la minna hum,
lɛɛŋ lii
biinikpola hina be,
di lɛɛŋ lii
sikpegii hina la
n ɛɛ wichɔgɛɛra la be.
5Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa,
n kpa n tamiirɛ
du i ni,
n pɔlaa saŋa maanii
n yardii.
6Hinuu n dɛlli lii n lulaa saŋa maa,
hinuu gillɛ n maa luliŋ.
N danna chɔlii saŋa maa.
7N de dui ɛɛ daansɛɛrɛ tɛɛ nɛkpila maa,
dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu
ɛɛ n guuri.
8Hɔpizii maanii n na chɔlii,
di ra sii i girme wia.
9Gilɛɛ waa vɛɛŋ di ra ta, di n wa zɛŋŋɔ,
gilɛɛ wa vɛɛŋ di ra ta,
di n wa gɛrgɔɔ,
10dikuubɛɛwiai, n dɔma ra ŋɔ n wiarɛ,
banla n suahzɛɛ
di ra ta n kpui jina.
11Ba ra ŋɔu, “Kɔraawiizi vɛɛubuu ta,
ya duŋŋuu di lawuu,
dikuubɛɛwiai, nɛr maa
waa hoo ú lɛɛu.”
12N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gilɛɛ vɛɛŋ ta ka kaali bɔɔnɛɛ,
ba manaŋ wa lɛɛŋ!
13Chɔgi banla n kpa wia di ra chugiŋ la, bá di hiihzi,
di gil banla n na nyiŋŋi
ba duŋ pira la,
birgi chɛɛtɛ kuna,
di ŋmaabi.
14Ka miŋwaa daŋ kpa n tamii maa du i ni saŋa maa,
di ra chɔlii werge maa.
15N danna ŋɔ i wideŋlaa wia,
di ra ŋɔ
i nɛlɛɛi wia hɔpizii maa,
haali miŋ waa
u zɛɛ zummɛ
di ga tuŋ gba.
16Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la,
n daŋ zuu i Dia
di sii i
nuukpuuri wia ɛɛi wia,
di sii i bɛmbɛŋ
wideŋlaa wia.
17N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n pɔlaa saŋa maanii i bagliŋ wia,
n haa ra ŋɔ
i nuukpuuri wia la
hiŋ ɛɛwɛ la wiarɛ.
18N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, haali miŋ zɛŋŋɛ,
n nyuu huuhzi naa gba,
gilɛɛ wa vɛɛŋ di ra ta,
guŋŋ n wa bagli i fɔŋŋa wia tɛɛ banla ban niŋ haa lul la,
i zenni wia
tɛɛ banla maa
ban niŋ haa ba la.
19N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i wideŋlaa kannɔɔ werge,
i ɛɛ wizenaare werge maa,
nɛr maa waa hoo lugɔi.
20Haali hiŋ gillɛ n na tɔɔrɔɔkpila n kpolle gba,
ka i daŋ bir kuari n de dui wia,
hàá gil n zuu ŋmam biini.
21I daŋ bir gil n dɔɔ girme jaa,
di kaa tig n bampirii.
22Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, n daŋ lɔ kem chɔlii,
dikuu i wibii dɔɔi wia.
N daŋ kpa janjalaŋ yir yira chɔlii,
Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la.
23N danna chaasi ni bɔsɔna,
di n wa yir yira
di ra chɔlii,
dikuu hiŋ lɛɛŋ la wia.
24N danna ŋɔ i wideŋlaa wia,
hɔpizii maa,
dikuubɛɛwiai, banla n na nyiŋŋi ba duŋ pira la,
cholloo di hiihzi.

english_text:
(By Solomon.)
A Prayer for God To Guide and Help the King
1Please help the king
to be honest and fair
just like you, our God.
2Let him be honest and fair
with all your people,
especially the poor.
3Let peace and justice rule
every mountain and hill.
4Let the king defend the poor,
rescue the homeless, and crush
everyone who hurts them.
5Let the king live forever
like the sun and the moon.
6Let him be as helpful as rain
that refreshes the meadows
and the ground.
7Let the king be fair
with everyone,
and let there be peace
until the moon
falls from the sky.
8 Let his kingdom reach
from sea to sea,
from the Euphrates River
across all the earth.
9Force the desert tribes
to accept his rule,
and make his enemies
crawl in the dirt.
10Force the rulers of Tarshish
and of the islands
to pay taxes to him.
Make the kings of Sheba
and of Seba bring gifts.
11Make other rulers bow down
and all nations serve him.
12Do this because the king
rescues the homeless
when they cry out,
and he helps everyone
who is poor and in need.
13The king has pity
on the weak and the helpless
and protects those in need.
14He cares when they hurt,
and he saves them from cruel
and violent deaths.
15Long live the king!
Give him gold from Sheba.
Always pray for the king
and praise him each day.
16Let cities overflow with food
and hills be covered with grain,
just like Mount Lebanon.
Let the people in the cities
prosper like wild flowers.
17May the glory of the king
shine brightly forever
like the sun in the sky.
Let him make nations prosper
and learn to praise him.
18 Lord God of Israel,
we praise you.
Only you can work miracles.
19We will always praise
your glorious name.
Let your glory be seen
everywhere on earth.
Amen and amen.
20This ends the prayers
of David, the son of Jesse.
translation_text:
Wiisuŋŋaa tɛɛ koori wia
Koori Solomɔn yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bagli a koori
gunla hinna di
seriya ni wibii,
bagluu i himmaa
wibii dii la,
2guŋ gil u wer di ra di kora i nɛra ni, ni wibii,
di ra binni banla
banna sunni la,
ni wideŋlaa.
3Gil a hɛri dɔɔ tɔna tɛɛ a nɛra,
di gil ba wia deŋli
a hɛri biini.
4Gil a koori ra di nyaara seriya ni wibii,
di ra hiini dɔgnya hina,
ka chɔgi banla ge
n na sunni baa la.
5Gil a koori du de saŋa maa,
alugɔ wiizi ni baagu.
6Gil a koori ɛɛ lugɔ dooŋ n na nɛɛ kooni,
di ɛɛ lugɔ donii
n na chol hɛri.
7Gil wideŋlaa du de, u de dui saŋa,
di gil daama du de
di hanna la,
saŋa la maa
baagu n ninna chaani.
8U kora daŋ chi muuzeŋ bɛl di ga hel bɛlhiŋ,
di lii Muu Yufretis
ga hel hɛri tuna.
9Gil hɛribɔduma dizi maa wa giŋŋi u see,
ú dɔma ge wa chɔɔ hɛri.
10Taasis hɛri koora ni koora la n du muu baaŋ hɛssi la
daŋ lizi hɛri kuna
di waa tɛu.
Siiba ni Sɛba hɛssi koora
waa sunzuu kuna.
11Koora maa daŋ waa sɛɛu dɔɔra,
hɛssi hina maa
waa humuu.
12Dikuubɛɛwiai, u daŋ waa lɛɛ anuula hina la
n niŋ waa wii
di ra du u ni,
di ra lɛɛ dɔgnya hina la
n waa hiini maa dɔɔwɛ la.
13U danna suŋ gɛrga ni dɔgnya hina ni,
di ɔɔ ra lɛɛ dɔgnya hina
di ra lii siu be.
14U daŋ ɔɔ lɛɛ baa lii tɔɔraa ni firaa werge biini,
dikuubɛɛwiai, ba miibɔɔni
ɛɛ kumpazii tɛu.
15N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, tɛɛ a koori miibɔɔjaŋ!
Gil ba kpa saliŋ
lii Siiba wa tɛu.
Gil nɛra suŋŋi wiizi di ra tɛu saŋa maa,
di ra kissuu
saŋaa saŋa maa!
16Gil mia su a hɛri,
pattikuna tɔ
giŋgimee nyuuni,
di lɛɛ lugɔ
Lɛbanɔn hɛri
pattikuna la.
Gil nɛra wazi a bolzenaa biine,
alugɔ pir n ɔɔ su
ni kooree la.
17Gil a koori sɔŋ du de di hanna la,
di gil u dɔɔ nyuu,
gunla wiizi
n du de saŋa maa la.
A hɛssi hina maa danna suŋŋi Kɔraawiizi,
dí u kissi baa gunla
uŋ kissi a koori la.
18Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la dɛg chɔlaarɛ!
U bɛnnɛ ra ɛɛ wizenaa.
19Ií ra dargi u sɔŋ la n dɔɔ girme saŋa maa la!
Gil u girme la su
durnya naa maa.
Ami! Ami!
20Jɛssɛ biibaal Koori Deevid suŋŋaa tunaa keŋ.

english_text:
BOOK III
(Psalms 73–89)
(A psalm by Asaph.)
God Is Good
1God is truly good to Israel,
especially to everyone
with a pure heart.
2But I almost stumbled and fell,
3because it made me jealous
to see proud and evil people
and to watch them prosper.
4They never have to suffer,
they stay healthy,
5and they don't have troubles
like everyone else.
6Their pride is like a necklace,
and they commit sin more often
than they dress themselves.
7Their eyes bulge with fat,
and their minds are flooded
with foolish thoughts.
8They sneer and say cruel things,
and because of their pride,
they make violent threats.
9They dare to speak against God
and to order others around.
10God will bring his people back,
and they will drink the water
he so freely gives.
11Only evil people would say,
“God Most High cannot
know everything!”
12Yet all goes well for them,
and they live in peace.
13What good did it do me
to keep my thoughts pure
and refuse to do wrong?
14I am sick all day,
and I am punished
each morning.
15If I had said evil things,
I would not have been loyal
to your people.
16It was hard for me
to understand all this!
17Then I went to your temple,
and there I understood
what will happen
to my enemies.
18You will make them stumble,
never to get up again.
19They will be terrified,
suddenly swept away
and no longer there.
20They will disappear, Lord,
despised like a bad dream
the morning after.
21Once I was bitter
and brokenhearted.
22I was stupid and ignorant,
and I treated you
as a wild animal would.
23But I never really left you,
and you hold my right hand.
24Your advice has been my guide,
and later you will welcome me
in glory.
25In heaven I have only you,
and on this earth
you are all I want.
26My body and mind may fail,
but you are my strength
and my choice forever.
27All-Powerful Lord God,
those who stay far from you
will be lost,
and you will destroy those
who are unfaithful.
28It is good for me
to be near you.
I choose you as my protector,
and I will tell about
your wonderful deeds.
translation_text:
Yira hɔŋ horohiŋ
(Yira 73—89)
Kɔraawiizi wibii dii yir
Asaf yir
1Wibii maa, Kɔraawiizi wia wessoo tɛɛ Izrɛl hina,
di tɛɛ banla n dɔɔ biinihuŋŋu.
2Ka miŋwaa, a ka tama n tamii vii tuŋ,
di ka tama
n yarda ge tuŋ,
3dikuubɛɛwiai, n bɔra faa ra wiiu banla n na jigsi
ni biinikpola hina la
wia n na kuari la wiarɛ.
4Ba waa tɔɔrɔɔ ra di,
ka dɔɔ alaanfia ni fɔŋŋa.
5Ba waa dɔgnya ra di alugɔ nɛra baŋhina n na diu la,
gɛɛ di ra wii wiila la
newea n na wii la.
6Awia, ba jigsi ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ ba baŋaa kuna,
kalu ge ɛɛ lugɔ ba tagtazenaa.
7Wichɔgaa ra lii ba bampiree biinii,
ba nfɛrchɔgaa ge
waa maga dɔɔwɛ.
8Ba ɔɔ ra mam nɛraa, di ŋɔ wichɔgaa di ra du ba ni,
di ra jigsi, di ra ta jina
bá sunni nɛra.
9Ba ɔɔ ŋɔ wichɔgaarɛ di ra du Kɔraawiizi la n du chiŋ ninɛɛ,
di kpa jigsi
di dau wia ra tɛɛ
nɛra hɛri naa biini.
10Guŋ wia, Kɔraawiizi nɛra ɔɔ biruu di ra chɔli baa,
di yardi ba wiŋɔzi
maa manaŋ.
11Ba ɔɔ ra ŋɔu, “Kɔraawiizi wàá zum,
Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa
la wàá na.”
12Gunnɛ biinikpola hina du la,
ba ɔɔ dɔɔ kunaa werge,
ka ɔɔ haa na aŋhina
di ra jaa.
13Pɛɛpɛɛrɛ n gil n biini huuhzi, wibii maa,
pɛɛpɛɛrɛ miŋ waa
wichɔgaa ge ra ɛɛ.
14N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi
ɔɔ giluu n na di
tɔɔrɔɔ hɔpizii maa,
chɔɔzi maanii
u ɔɔ tɛr n digni.
15Di n vii ŋɔ a guŋ widɔŋaa,
guŋwaa, n faa waa
u biizi wiɛɛlaa la ra ɛɛ.
16N ɛɛ aniaa ń zum a wia naa zɛɛ,
ka a faa du kpol tɛŋ,
17ka miŋ wa zuu u Dia biini labuu,
n jaa zum wia la n niŋ wa
huuzi biinikpola hina.
18Wibii maa, u daŋ kpa baa du bɔra la n na hɛhrgi,
di gil ba chogli,
bá wia chɔgi!
19Ba daŋ kpu baa kakpaŋ,
ba laba chum.
20Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ deeza la hɔɔ n ɔɔ pizi ba suuah la,
di Kɔraawiizi
wa izi chiŋ,
ba ɔɔ lewuu.
21Saŋa la n biini n wa chɔkkɛ,
n bɔra huah la,
22n faa gɛnnɔɔ lugɔ sel,
maa u wiɛɛlaa zɛɛ zummɛ.
23Ka n haa du u benii saŋa maa,
u lau n nodig kpogli.
24U ra baglimbuu gunla min ninna hiŋuu,
a tuna, ú jaa lɛɛŋ ni girme.
25U bɛnnɛ n dɔɔ chiŋ, maa kaa dɔɔ kummaa de,
maa kummaa ra nyiŋŋi
hɛri naa, di waa lɛi.
26N nfɛrɛ ni n bɔra daŋ wer gɛrgi,
ka Kɔraawiizii
ɛɛ n kpegzi,
u bɛnnɛ ɛɛ kunla
miŋ dɔɔwɛ,
saŋaa saŋa maa.
27Banla n vɛɛu la daŋ siu, bá wia tuŋ,
u daŋ chɔgi banla ge wia
n waa wibii dɔɔwɛ u be la.
28Ka miŋwaa, a wessoo miŋ dugluu.
N kpa Kɔraawiizi La
N Kaali Kummaa labuu
ɛɛ lugɔ n diikpeg,
n daŋ sii
u wiɛɛlaa maa wia.

english_text:
(A special psalm by Asaph.)
A Prayer for the Nation in Times of Trouble
1Our God, why have you
completely rejected us?
Why are you so angry
with the ones you care for?
2Remember the people
you rescued long ago,
the tribe you chose
for your very own.
Think of Mount Zion,
your home;
3walk over to the temple
left in ruins forever
by those who hate us.
4Your enemies roared like lions
in your holy temple,
and they have placed
their banners there.
5It looks like a forest
chopped to pieces.
6They used axes and hatchets
to smash the carvings.
7They burned down your temple
and badly disgraced it.
8They said to themselves,
“We'll crush them!”
Then they burned every one
of your meeting places
all over the country.
9There are no more miracles
and no more prophets.
Who knows how long
it will be like this?
10Our God, how much longer
will our enemies sneer?
Won't they ever stop
insulting you?
11Why don't you punish them?
Why are you holding back?
12Our God and King,
you have ruled
since ancient times;
you have won victories
everywhere on this earth.
13 By your power you made a path
through the sea,
and you smashed the heads
of sea monsters.
14 You crushed the heads
of the monster Leviathan,
then fed him to wild creatures
in the desert.
15You opened the ground
for streams and springs
and dried up mighty rivers.
16You rule the day and the night,
and you put the moon
and the sun in place.
17You made summer and winter
and gave them to the earth.
18Remember your enemies, Lord!
They foolishly sneer
and won't respect you.
19You treat us like pet doves,
but they mistreat us.
Don't keep forgetting us
and letting us be fed
to those wild animals.
20Remember the agreement
you made with us.
Violent enemies are hiding
in every dark corner
of the earth.
21Don't disappoint those in need
or make them turn from you,
but help the poor and homeless
to shout your praises.
22Do something, God!
Defend yourself.
Remember how those fools
sneer at you all day long.
23Don't forget the loud shouts
of your enemies.
translation_text:
Izrɛl hina lɛɛi wiisuŋŋaa wia
Asaf yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i gil yaa ta kennei?
I baaŋ danna fuuh i nɛra ninɛɛ
di hanna la gɛɛ?
2A liizi nɛra la hiŋ lɛɛwɛ faa maa la wia,
dee la hiŋ lizɛɛ,
ba ɛɛ i himmaa nɛra la.
A liizi Bizeŋ Ziɔn la n faa ɛɛ
i duuribɔr la wia.
3Vol koŋlaa naa baŋ purgee nyaamm naa ni na,
yaa dɔma chɔgi
i Dia biini kuna la maanii.
4I dɔma ra chaasuu werge i Dia biini,
di kpa ba tuutazi baŋzi de,
guŋ ɛɛ kpeglaa daansɛɛ.
5Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ daateŋra n du kɔr biini,
di lalli ba kpaŋfɔzi
bá teŋri daazi.
6Ba kpa kpaŋfɔzi ni silaarɛ,
di ra chɔgi daapiahni la maa,
baŋ kpawɛɛ mɛɛri
u biini la.
7Ba fuuh i Dia labuu,
di doŋ bɔr la
banna jaamii la.
8Ba ŋɔwɔɔrɛ ba biine, “Yaa daŋ chɔgi baa nyaamm!”
Ba fuuh bɔra la maa
banna jaamii labuu, a hɛri biini.
9Yaa waa kaa ra na i wizenaa daansɛɛ maa,
i dɔgtɛɛ maa waa kawɛɛ.
Yaa bɛl maa waa zum gunla
a kennaa wia naa
n niŋ birgi mag.
10N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
ɛrɛɛ yaa dɔma mamii
di birgi magɛi?
Gunnɛ ba ra chɔgi i sɔŋ
di hanna laa?
11Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i vɛɛ yaa hiinaai?
Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i kpa i nonee
di bar i harɛi?
12Ka hinuu yaa koori faala maa,
di lɛɛ yaa saŋa kpila maa.
13I fɔŋŋazeŋ la biini,
i faa gillɔɔ
a muuzeŋ bargi bɔra anɛɛ,
di faa purgi
a nii biini sechɔgii nyuuni.
14I faa purgi muuzeŋ sechɔgii Lɛviatan la nyuunii,
di kpau tɛɛ
hɛribɔduma sela a di.
15Hinuu faa gillɛ bulli ni gɔŋa ra pal,
di gil muuni la n na pal
saŋa maa la hiihzi.
16Hinuu dɔɔ hɔpizaa ni hamuŋa maa,
di chigni wiizi ni baagu
a chignibɔra.
17Hinuu dauri hɛri magbɔɔni maa,
di dau yuu ni lumaŋa saŋazi.
18N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
a liizi gunla i dɔma n na mamii
ni gunla gɛnaa n na chɔgi i sɔŋ.
19Gilɛɛ waa vɛɛ i nɛra la n gɛrgɛɛ,
di ra du ba dɔma la
n dɔɔ sikpegii la nonee biini.
Gilɛɛ waa suuh i nɛra la
banna tɔɔri la wia.
20A liizi nuukpaŋ la i ni yaa n ɛɛwɛ la wia.
Nɛfiraa werge su
a hɛri naa bɔbiri maanii.
21Gilɛɛ gil banla banna sunni la bir har di hiihzi,
gil nyaara ni dɔgnya hina
ra chɔlii.
22N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, izi chiŋ,
di bagli i dɔma lugɔ
i hor summɔɔ!
A liizi gunla gɛnaa
n na mamii hɔpizii maa.
23Gilɛɛ waa suuh gunla i dɔma baana n faa ra fuuh,
ba ra kɔɔ saŋa maa la wia.

english_text:
(A psalm and a song by Asaph for the music leader. To the tune “Don't Destroy.”
)
Praise God for All He Has Done
1Our God, we thank you
for being so near to us!
Everyone celebrates
your wonderful deeds.
2You have set a time
to judge with fairness.
3The earth trembles,
and its people shake;
you alone keep
its foundations firm.
4You tell every bragger,
“Stop bragging!”
And to the wicked you say,
“Don't boast of your power!
5Stop bragging! Quit telling me
how great you are.”
6Our Lord and our God,
victory doesn't come
from the east or the west
or from the desert.
7You are the one who judges.
You can take away power
and give it to others.
8You hold in your hand
a cup filled with wine,
strong and foaming.
You will pour out some
for every sinful person
on this earth,
and they will have to drink
until it is gone.
9But I will always tell about
you, the God of Jacob,
and I will sing your praise.
10Our Lord, you will destroy
the power of evil people,
but you will give strength
to those who are good.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizii seriya diiri
Asaf yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
yaa ra tɛibuu jaaŋ!
Yaa ra sii gunla
i zenni n kannɛ maguu,
di ra ŋɔ nuukpuuri wia la
hiŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia.
2I ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N dau seriya dii saŋaa,
minuu ra di
seriya ni wibii.
3Di hɛri waa zigli,
nɛra bɔra ra sa,
n daŋ lau u zɛɛ ligee
di kpogli kiŋkiŋ.
4N ŋɔ jigsi hina benii, ‘Ií gilɛɛ ra jigsi,’
di ŋɔ biinikpola hina ge be,
‘Ií gilɛɛ ra bagli ii kpegzi.
5Ií gilɛɛ ra bagli ii kpegzi la chinchiŋ ni,
di gilɛɛ ra ŋɔ wia,
di ra ta barabara.’ ”
6Nɛra seriya dii waa wiifurii
gɛɛ wiicholii
gɛɛ hɛribɔduma liwɛɛ.
7Ka Kɔraawiizii ra di seriya,
u ɔɔ tɛɛ baŋhinaa bilchɔg,
ka tɛɛ baŋhina wibii.
8Kɔraawiizi kpogli u libeere,
u su ni u baaŋfuuih
alugɔ siŋkpeg.
Ú fugaa tɛɛ,
biinikpola hina maa,
bá nyɔɔa, a wa tuŋ kɔrai.
9Ka miŋwaa wàá gil
Kɔraawiizi la Jekɔb
n na hum la wia sii,
n daŋ yir yira
di ra chɔluu.
10U daŋ chɔgi biinikpola hina fɔŋŋa,
ka gil banla waa wia
n deŋlee, fɔŋŋa jaa.

english_text:
(A song and a psalm by Asaph for the music leader. Use stringed instruments.)
God Always Wins
1You, our God,
are famous in Judah
and honored in Israel.
2Your home is on Mount Zion,
the city of peace.
3There you destroyed
fiery arrows, shields, swords,
and all the other weapons.
4You are more glorious than
the eternal mountains.
5Brave warriors were robbed
of what they had taken,
and now they lie dead,
unable to lift an arm.
6God of Jacob, when you roar,
enemy chariots and horses
drop dead in their tracks.
7Our God, you are fearsome,
and no one can oppose you
when you are angry.
8From heaven you announced
your decisions as judge!
And all who live on this earth
were terrified and silent
9when you took over as judge,
ready to rescue
everyone in need.
10Even the most angry people
will praise you
when you are furious.
11Everyone, make your promises
to the Lord your God
and do what you promise.
The Lord is fearsome,
and all his servants
should bring him gifts.
12God destroys the courage
of rulers and kings
and makes cowards of them.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizii kpegleg
Asaf yir
