1Juda hina zum Kɔraawiizii,
u sɔŋ ge du kaŋ
Izrɛl hina biini.
2U dia du Bizeŋ Ziɔn nyuurɛ,
Jɛrusalɛm biini.
3Denii u kuugi u dɔma hobee,
ba laal pɛrɛtuzenaa,
ba tokobizi
ani ba laal kuna maa.
4N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i dɔɔ girmee!
I dɔɔ girmee
di lii bizenaa nyuuni,
bɔr la hiŋ kpegli i dɔma,
ka lii de di ra tuu la.
5Ba foozi ba laallɔkpega kuna maanii,
ka ba siu chɔɔ,
ba bɛl maa wàá ka wer
lalli u nonii.
6Kɔraawiizi la Jekɔb n na hum,
saŋa la hiŋ hau ba ni la,
ba zagra ni a tinna maanii
choglee, di siu.
7N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i bɛnnɛ dɛg ɔmaa,
anɛɛ n niŋ wer chi i see,
di i baaŋ wa fuuhwoi?
8Chinne i du ka di seriya,
ɔnsii lau durnya hina,
ba siigi,
9dikuu hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi n izee í di seriya,
di lɛɛ banla maa
banna sunni la wia.
10Wibii maa, i baaŋ fuuih nɛra ni
gillɔɔ ba ra chɔlii.
Banla n lii a baaŋfuuih biini
ɔɔ lau bahinaarɛ.
11Ií ŋɔ nuuzi tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la,
di hiŋaa.
Ií gil hɛssi la maa hina n bar ia la,
kpa kuna wa sunzi
unla n dɛg ɔmaa la.
12Waabuu ɔɔ gil hɛri nabɔnzi hɔrmi,
durnya koora ge ra ɔmuu.

english_text:
(A psalm by Asaph for Jeduthun, the music leader.)
In Times of Trouble God Is with His People
1I pray to you, Lord God,
and I beg you to listen.
2In days filled with trouble,
I search for you.
And at night I tirelessly
lift my hands in prayer,
refusing comfort.
3When I think of you,
I feel restless and weak.
4Because of you, Lord God,
I can't sleep.
I am restless
and can't even talk.
5I think of times gone by,
of those years long ago.
6Each night my mind
is flooded with questions:
7“Have you rejected me forever?
Won't you be kind again?
8Is this the end of your love
and your promises?
9Have you forgotten
how to have pity?
Do you refuse to show mercy
because of your anger?”
10Then I said, “God Most High,
what hurts me most
is that you no longer help us
with your mighty arm.”
11Our Lord, I will remember
the things you have done,
your miracles of long ago.
12I will think about each one
of your mighty deeds.
13Everything you do is right,
and no other god
compares with you.
14You alone work miracles,
and you have let nations
see your mighty power.
15With your own arm you rescued
your people, the descendants
of Jacob and Joseph.
16The ocean looked at you, God,
and it trembled deep down
with fear.
17Water flowed from the clouds.
Thunder was heard above
as your arrows of lightning
flashed about.
18Your thunder roared
like chariot wheels.
The world was made bright
by lightning,
and all the earth trembled.
19You walked through the water
of the mighty sea,
but your footprints
were never seen.
20You guided your people
like a flock of sheep,
and you chose Moses and Aaron
to be their leaders.
translation_text:
Biinichɔg saŋa bampirtigaa wia
Asaf yir
1N ɔɔ lɔ wilee tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, ú hiiniŋ,
n ɔɔ lɔ wilee tɛu,
ú nuu n be.
2Tɔɔrɔɔ saŋa, n ɔɔ suŋŋi Kɔraawiizii,
hamuŋa maanii n ɔɔ lalli
n nonee di ra suŋŋuu,
ka maa ɔɔ wer dɔɔ bɔsɔna.
3Di n wa liizi Kɔraawiizi wia, n ɔɔ ra himuu,
di n wa sogo
di ra pessi u wia ge,
n bɔra ɔɔ huah.
4U gillɔɔ màá wer chɔɔ dɔɔ,
n biini chɔgi werge maa,
màá ka wer ŋɔ wia.
5Anna liizi hɔpizaa aŋhina n bɛrɛɛ wiarɛ,
di ra liizi
faala maa binni wia.
6Hamuŋa maa, anna fɛ nfɛrɛɛ,
di n wa pessi i wia di na,
kenne aŋ pɛɛzi n hiŋ,
7“Kɔraawiizi daŋ vɛɛ yaa di hanna laa?
U ŋmɛnɛ maa
wàá ka suŋ yaa nii?
8U nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la tunnɔɔ di hanna laa?
U nua la uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ yaa la
waa kaa hoo gɛɛ?
9Kɔraawiizi suuh u nɛsunaa dɔɔi la wiarɛ gɛɛ?
U baaŋfuuih gillɔɔ
waa kaa ra na
nɛra sinyɛnaa?”
10Denii n ŋɔ, “Wii la n chɔgi n biini wergee keŋ,
Kɔraawiizi waa kaa dɔɔ fɔŋŋa
ú lɛɛ yaaa?”
11N danna liizi Kɔraawiizi wiɛɛlaa wia,
n danna liizi
wizenaa la uŋ ɛɛwɛ,
faala maa la wia.
12N danna liizi wia la maa uŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia,
n danna lɔ
nuukpuuri wia la
maa uŋ ɛɛwɛ la nfɛrɛ.
13N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
wia la hiŋ ɛɛwɛ ɛɛ winanaananaarɛ.
Vug maa waa hoo
di du kpeg lugɔi.
14Hinuu ra ɛɛ wizenaa,
i bagli i fɔŋŋaa
hɛssi hina biini.
15I kpa i fɔŋŋaa lɛɛ i nɛra,
Jekɔb ni Joosɛf naanna.
16N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
saŋa la niiri n wa nai la,
ɔnsii faa lawaabuu,
muuzeŋ vile maa ge ra ziigi.
17Baamazi nɛɛ doonne,
nazaa pozi chiŋ,
ka dooŋ na nyɛgzi
bɔr maa.
18Ba nuu i nazaa pozaare vem biini,
u nyɛgzaa ge
faa chaani durnya maa,
hɛri maa faa ziigi,
di zigli.
19I dau ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ muuzeŋ biini,
di dau ŋmɛnɛɛ
niizenaa biine,
ka nɛr maa waa
i naazi nawɛɛ.
20I faa ga Moosis ni Aarɔn ninɛɛ,
di tɔ i nɛra see
alugɔ penɔɔni.

english_text:
(A special psalm by Asaph.)
What God Has Done for His People
1My friends, I beg you
to listen as I teach.
2 I will give instruction
and explain the mystery
of what happened long ago.
3These are things we learned
from our ancestors,
4and we will tell them
to the next generation.
We won't keep secret
the glorious deeds
and the mighty miracles
of the Lord.
5God gave his Law
to Jacob's descendants,
the people of Israel.
And he told our ancestors
to teach their children,
6so that each new generation
would know his Law
and tell it to the next.
7Then they would trust God
and obey his teachings,
without forgetting anything
God had done.
8They would be different
from their ancestors,
who were stubborn, rebellious,
and unfaithful to God.
9The warriors from Ephraim
were armed with arrows,
but they ran away
when the battle began.
10They broke their agreement
with God,
and they turned their backs
on his teaching.
11They forgot all he had done,
even the mighty miracles
12 he did for their ancestors
near Zoan in Egypt.
13 God made a path in the sea
and piled up the water
as he led them across.
14 He guided them during the day
with a cloud,
and each night he led them
with a flaming fire.
15 God made water flow
from rocks he split open
in the desert,
and his people drank freely,
as though from a lake.
16He made streams gush out
like rivers from rocks.
17But in the desert,
the people of God Most High
kept sinning and rebelling.
18 They stubbornly tested God
and demanded from him
what they wanted to eat.
19They challenged God by saying,
“Can God provide food
out here in the desert?
20It's true God struck the rock
and water gushed out
like a river,
but can he give his people
bread and meat?”
21When the Lord heard this,
he was angry and furious
with Jacob's descendants,
the people of Israel.
22They had refused to trust him,
and they had doubted
his saving power.
23But God gave a command
to the clouds,
and he opened the doors
in the skies.
24 From heaven he sent grain
that they called manna.
25He gave them more than enough,
and each one of them ate
this special food.
26God's mighty power
sent a strong wind
from the southeast,
27and it brought birds
that covered the ground,
like sand on the beach.
28Then God made the birds fall
in the camp of his people
near their tents.
29God gave his people
all they wanted,
and each of them ate
until they were full.
30But before they had swallowed
the last bite,
31God became angry and killed
the strongest and best
from the families of Israel.
32But the rest kept on sinning
and would not trust
God's miracles.
33So he cut their lives short
and made them terrified.
34After he killed some of them,
the others turned to him
with all their hearts.
35They remembered God Most High,
the mighty rock
that kept them safe.
36But they tried to flatter God,
and they told him lies;
37 they were unfaithful
and broke their promises.
38Yet God was kind.
He kept forgiving their sins
and didn't destroy them.
He often became angry,
but never lost his temper.
39God remembered that they
were made of flesh
and were like a wind
that blows once
and then dies down.
40While they were in the desert,
they often rebelled
and made God sad.
41They kept testing him
and caused terrible pain
for the Holy One of Israel.
42They forgot about his power
and how he had rescued them
from their enemies.
43God showed them all kinds
of wonderful miracles
near Zoan in Egypt.
44 He turned the rivers of Egypt
into blood,
and no one could drink
from the streams.
45 He sent swarms of flies
to pester the Egyptians,
and he sent frogs
to cause them trouble.
46 God let worms and grasshoppers
eat their crops.
47 He destroyed their grapevines
and their fig trees
with hail and floods.
48Then he killed their cattle
with hail
and their other animals
with lightning.
49God was so angry and furious
that he went into a rage
and caused them great trouble
by sending swarms
of destroying angels.
50God released his anger
and slaughtered them
in a terrible way.
51 He killed the first-born son
of each Egyptian family.
52 Then God led his people
out of Egypt
and guided them in the desert
like a flock of sheep.
53 He led them safely along,
and they were not afraid,
but their enemies drowned
in the sea.
54 God brought his people
to the sacred mountain
that he had taken
by his own power.
55 He made nations run
from the tribes of Israel,
and he let the tribes
take over their land.
56 But the people tested
God Most High,
and they refused
to obey his laws.
57They were as unfaithful
as their ancestors,
and they were as crooked
as a twisted arrow.
58God demanded all their love,
but they made him angry
by worshiping idols.
59So God became furious
and completely rejected
the people of Israel.
60 Then he deserted his home
at Shiloh, where he lived
here on earth.
61 He let enemies capture
the sacred chest
and let them dishonor him.
62God took out his anger
on his chosen ones
and let them be killed
by enemy swords.
63Fire destroyed the young men,
and the young women were left
with no one to marry.
64Priests died violent deaths,
but their widows
were not allowed to mourn.
65Finally the Lord woke up,
like a soldier
startled from a drunken sleep.
66God scattered his enemies
and made them ashamed
forever.
67Then the Lord decided
not to make his home
with Joseph's descendants
in Ephraim.
68Instead he chose the tribe
of Judah,
and he chose Mount Zion,
the place he loves.
69There he built his temple
as lofty as the mountains
and as solid as the earth
he made to last forever.
70 The Lord God chose David
to be his servant and took him
from tending sheep
71and from caring for lambs.
Then God made him the leader
of Israel, his own nation.
72David treated the people fairly
and guided them with wisdom.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi ni u nɛra wia
Asaf yir
1N nɛra, ií ra nuu n baglaa,
ií keŋŋi digna
di ra nuu n wiŋɔzi.
2N wiŋɔzi daŋ ɛɛ sɛɛliizi.
N daŋ ŋɔ wia aŋhina
n faa suahwɛ
durnya luglaa guŋŋ
di wa hel zinaa.
3Wia la yaa n nuuwɛ di zumaa,
wia la yaa naabaala
n ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ yaa.
4Yaa wàá kpaa suah yaa biizi ni,
yaa daŋ ŋɔa tɛɛ banla
ban niŋ haa lul,
Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa ni u nuukpuuri wia
uŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia.
5U du Gbɔgni ni nuuzii tɛɛ Izrɛl hina,
n ɛɛ Jekɔb dee la.
U tɛɛ yaa naabaalaa loobii,
dí ba ra bagli
ba biizi u Gbɔgni,
6guŋ gil banla ban niŋ wa lul la zumaa,
di ge bagli ba biizi.
7Gunnɛ niŋ gil ba wer yardi Kɔraawiizi,
di gilɛɛ waa suuh
u wiɛɛlaa wia,
ka wer di ra hiŋ u nuuzi,
8di gilɛɛ kaa wàá du lugɔ ba naabaala la
n faa ɛɛ dignikpega hina
ani nɛkpoŋlaa la.
Ba faa waa Kɔraawiizi yardɛɛ,
di kpa bahinaa tɛu.
9Ɛfram laallɔɔra faa vɔɔ laallɛ ani hozi,
ka bir chɔ a laal lɔi hɔpizii la.
10Ba faa chɔgi ba ni
Kɔraawiizi nuukpaŋ dɔɔi la wiarɛ,
di faa vɛɛ u Gbɔgni hiŋaa.
11Ba faa suuh wia la uŋ ɛɛwɛ
ani nuukpuuri wia la
uŋ ɛɛwɛ la wiarɛ.
12Kɔraawiizi faa ɛɛ wizenaare ba naabaala see,
Zoan lɛl n du Ijip hɛri biini.
13U faa bargi muuzenne bɔra anɛɛ,
di gil ba ga hɛrhilii gi,
u faa gillɔɔ a muuzeŋ nii maa
chi bɔra anɛɛ alugɔ koŋlaa.
14Hɔpizaa saŋa, u ɔɔ faa giluu baama
tɔ ba see,
hamuŋa ge u gil
ninlau tɔ ba see,
di ra chaani baa.
15U pergi biarɛ hɛribɔduma biini,
di tɛɛ baa nii werge
alugɔ muuni.
16U gillɔɔ nii lii bii ni,
di ra pal alugɔ muuni.
17Ka ba haa vɛɛ di ra ɛɛu wichɔgaa,
di ra vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi La
N Kaali Kummaa la nua,
a hɛribɔduma biini.
18Di kutti ɛɛu ra na,
di ra suŋŋi diwee la
banna kɛlli werge.
19Di ŋɔ wia ra du Kɔraawiizi ni,
di ra ŋɔ,
“Kɔraawiizi daŋ wer tɛɛ yaa
diwee hɛribɔduma naa?
20U yag biirɛ, nii pozi lii,
gɔŋa ra pal werge.
Ka u daŋ wer tɛɛ yaa diwee
gɛɛ di wer tɛɛ yaa olaa?”
21Kɔraawiizi n wa nuu guŋ,
u baaŋ faa fuuh ba ni alugɔ niŋ,
u baaŋfuuihchɔgii nyaŋŋi ba ni,
22dikuubɛɛwiai, ba wɔɔ yardɛɛ,
di sɛɛ lugɔ u daŋ wer lɛɛ baa.
23Haali annii naa maa n ɛɛwɛ gba,
ka u ŋɔ wiarɛ tɛɛ chiŋ,
u pilli lugɔ gbera,
24diwee aŋhina, lii chiŋ chol, ba di.
Kɔraawiizi bol miarɛ guŋ.
25Awia, ba faa di mɛlikazi diweere,
u faa tɛɛ baabuu ba di piŋ.
26U faa gillɔɔ wiifurii peu lii chiŋ di ta,
di kpa u fɔŋŋa tɔ
wiikakag keŋkere bɛl peu see.
27U faa tɛɛ u nɛraa ol alugɔ hɛɛhraa,
di tɛɛ baa zumbizi
alugɔ muu nua hɛɛhriichaa.
28U faa gillɔɔ a chogli ba chɔɔribɔr biini,
di yaari ba tanti diini
kɛraa maa.
29Denii a nɛra di di piŋ nɛnnɛ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, u tɛɛ baabuu
diwee la banna kɛlli werge.
30Ka ba faa haa waa diwee, ba kɛkɛluu tuŋ,
ba faa haa ra diu,
31ka Kɔraawiizi baaŋ faa fuuh ba ni,
u kpu ba fɔŋŋa hina,
Izrɛl hina biipɔllaa la.
32Haali annii naa maa n ɛɛwɛ gba, ka ba faa haa ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ,
haali uŋ ɛɛ nuukpuuri
wia la maa gba,
ka ba faa wɔɔ yardɛɛ.
33Awia, u faa gillɔɔ ba hɔpizaa tuŋ alugɔ heeza kakpaŋ,
ba laba chum.
34Di Kɔraawiizi haŋ wa kpu baŋhina,
banla n kawɛɛ la
ɔɔ biruu
di ra nyiŋŋi u bɔr.
Ba ɔɔ giluu ba wichɔgaa wia chɔgi ba biine,
ba ra suŋŋuu nɛnnɛ.
35Ba ɔɔ liizuu lugɔ Kɔraawiizii ɛɛ ba guuri,
di liizi lugɔ Kɔraawiizi La
N Kaali Kummaa labuu
ɛɛ ba Lɛɛri.
36Ka ba faa ra daruubuu ni ba nuuzi,
ba wiŋɔzi ɛɛ kara.
37Ba bampiree faa wɔɔ lauwɛ,
ba waa u ni baa
nuukpaŋ dɔɔi la yardɛɛ.
38Ka Kɔraawiizi faa na u nɛra sinyɛnaa,
di gil ba wichɔgaa tɛɛ baa,
waa baa kpuwɛɛ.
Saŋa kpila maanii u ɔɔ lau u hiŋ,
waa ɔɔ gil
u baaŋ maa izi.
39U faa liizoore lugɔ ba ɛɛ kuna la n niŋ siwuu,
di ɛɛ lugɔ pechule n kaalɛɛ,
wàá ka bir ba la.
40Saŋa kpila maa, ba ɔɔ faa ɛɛ
dignikpega hinaa
hɛribɔduma biini,
di gil u biini chɔgi!
41Ba ɔɔ tuuzuubuu, di ɛɛu ra na,
di gil Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la
baaŋ ɔɔ ra fuuh.
42Ba faa suuh u fɔŋŋa ani
hɔpizii la uŋ lɛɛ baa
lii ba dɔma
nonee biini
43ani nuukpuuri wia uŋ ɛɛwɛ
Zoan lɛl n du
Ijip hɛri la wiarɛ.
44U faa gillɔɔ ba muuni birgi chal,
Ijip hina faa waa
kaa dɔɔ niinyɔɔlii.
45U faa gillɔɔ nakɛɛhzi su ba hɛri maa, di ra tɔɔri baa,
sampussi ge chɔgi ba hɛri.
46U faa gil lotorozi wa chɔgi ba pattikuna
ni ba kooni.
47U faa gillɔɔ dobia wa chɔgi ba grepu
ni ba fig daazi.
48Di faa gil dobia kpu ba nauna,
nazaa ge kpu ba peeza.
49Kɔraawiizi baaŋ faa fuuhwoo werge,
u ra fuuri,
di gil mɛlikazi
kpa tɔɔrɔɔzeŋ
wa kpu baa.
50U faa waa u hiŋ lauwɛ,
u baaŋfuuih hiŋ biini,
di lɛɛ baa lii siu be,
ka gil wiilchɔgii kpu baa.
51U faa kpu Ijip hina
dia maa biibambiluglii.
52Ka jaa kpogli u nɛra,
lii alugɔ penɔɔni,
di tɔ ba see
di ga hɛribɔduma biini.
53U faa guu baabuu nɛnnɛ,
awia, ɔnsii faa
waa baa lauwɛ,
ka a muuzeŋ faa di
ba dɔma waa maa.
54Ka faa jaa kpogli baa
ba u hɛrnaniinanii la,
giŋgimee hɛri hina la
u himmaa n kpeglee,
ka lɛɛ la.
55U faa duŋŋi a hɛssi hinaa ba lii,
saŋa la u nɛra
n faa ra ba la,
ka kpa ba hɛri bɔnni Izrɛl hina dizi,
di kpa ba diini tɛɛ u nɛra.
56Ka ba faa kpoŋŋoo,
di ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi La
N Kaali Kummaa la na.
Ba faa waa u nuuzi la ra hiŋ,
57ka faa dɔɔ dignikpega,
di nyaa wibii alugɔ ba mɛɛwaa.
Hàá wer dɛlli ba ni
alugɔ hoo la n chɔkkɛ.
58Ba vuga kuaribɔra faa gillɔɔ
Kɔraawiizi baaŋ fuuh,
di gil u zoma izi
dikuu a wia.
59Kɔraawiizi n wa na ba wiɛɛlaa,
u baaŋ faa fuuh,
u vɛɛ Izrɛl hina kɔrai.
60U faa lii u Tanti Dia la n du Silo,
bɔr la uŋ faa duwɛɛ
ba biini la.
61Di faa gil yaa dɔma wa foozi,
u ni yaa
Nuukpaŋ Dɔɔi Dakka la,
n faa ra bagli u fɔŋŋa
ni u girme la.
62U baaŋ faa fuuh u nɛra ninɛɛ,
u gil ba dɔma kpu baa.
63Ba faa kpu ba biipɔllaarɛ laal biini,
guŋ wia, ba suŋgure
wàá ka na baala yuu.
64Ba faa kpu Kɔraawiizi kizeehina,
ka ba waa sɛɛwɛ
ba luhaana wii.
65Denii Kɔraawiizi faa jaa izi alugɔ uŋ izi dɔɔ,
di ɛɛ lugɔ nɛr
n nyɔɔ siŋ di dɛɛzi,
ka u siwee
jaa ra chaani la.
66Di duŋŋi u dɔma,
di kpa hiihzi la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ
kpu baa.
67U faa vɛɛ Joosɛf naannaa,
u faa waa
Ɛfram dee lizɛɛ,
68ka faa lizi Juda dee
ni Bizeŋ Ziɔn la
un nɔŋŋɛɛ werge la.
69Denii u faa ma u Dia la u du alugɔ
u bol n du chiŋ,
di gil u chi nɛnnɛ,
waa ziigi lugɔ hɛri,
saŋaa saŋa maa.
70Denii u faa lizi u balii Deevid,
di lizuu lii peeza diiribɔr,
71bɔr la uŋ faa ra nɔɔni peeza,
u waa binni
u nɛra Izrɛl hina la
n ɛɛ u kapɛttɛ kuna la ni
lugɔ penɔɔni.
72Deevid faa ra binni
a nɛra ninɛɛ
ni biinihuŋŋu,
di tɔ ba see nɛnnɛ.

english_text:
(A psalm by Asaph.)
Have Pity on Jerusalem
1 Our God, foreign nations
have taken your land,
disgraced your temple,
and left Jerusalem in ruins.
2They have fed the bodies
of your servants
to flesh-eating birds;
your loyal people are food
for savage animals.
3All Jerusalem is covered
with their blood,
and there is no one left
to bury them.
4Every nation around us
sneers and makes fun.
5Our Lord, will you keep on
being angry?
Will your angry feelings
keep flaming up like fire?
6Get angry with those nations
that don't know you
and won't worship you!
7They have gobbled up
Jacob's descendants
and left the land in ruins.
8 Don't make us pay for the sins
of our ancestors.
Have pity and come quickly!
We are completely helpless.
9Our God, you keep us safe.
Now help us! Rescue us.
Forgive our sins
and bring honor to yourself.
10Why should nations ask us,
“Where is your God?”
Let us and the other nations
see you take revenge
for your servants who died
a violent death.
11Listen to the prisoners groan!
Let your mighty power save all
who are sentenced to die.
12Each of those nations sneered
at you, our Lord.
Now let others sneer at them,
seven times as much.
13Then we, your people,
will always thank you.
We are like sheep
with you as our shepherd,
and all generations
will hear us praise you.
translation_text:
Izrɛl hina lɛɛi wia wiisuŋŋaa
Asaf yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, nɛra la n wɛɛ zummɛ ballɔɔ,
di wa foozi i hɛri.
Ba chɔg i Diinaniinanii labuu,
di puri Jɛrusalɛm.
2Ba kpu i balaarɛ ta,
di tɛɛ duuni á di,
i nɛra bɔra
di tɛɛ pir sela á di.
3I nɛra hiŋ challi ra pal alugɔ nii
Jɛrusalɛm biini maa,
ka nɛr maa waa hoo,
ú hug baa.
4Hɛssi la hina n bar yaa la ra chagzi yaabuu,
di ra mam yaa,
di ra lɔ yaa mɔmɔsia.
5N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
i baaŋ daŋ fuuuh
di hanna la gɛɛ?
I baaŋ danna diu
lugɔ ninlau gɛɛ?
6Gil i baaŋ la izi hɛssi la hina
n wɛɛ zummɛ,
kossi ani nɛra la
n wɛɛ ra jaami la ni,
7dikuubɛɛwiai, ba kpu i nɛraa
di chɔgi i hɛri.
8Gilɛɛ kpa yaa naabaala wichɔgaa kim,
di turgi yaa.
Na yaa sinyɛna filaŋkeŋ,
yaa waa kaa dɔɔ
tamii maa.
9N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hiini yaa di lɛɛ yaa,
lɛɛ yaa, di gil
yaa wichɔgaa tɛɛ yaa,
dikuu i himmaa
girme la wia.
10Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ a hɛssi hina ra pɛɛzi,
“Lee Kɔraawiizi la
banna hum la duɛi?”
Gil ya na gunla hin niŋ tɛr a hɛssi hina digna,
dikuu baŋ kpu
i balaa wia.
11A nuu banla baŋ tɔwɛɛ dia uuraa.
I fɔŋŋazeŋ la biini,
gil banla baŋ di seriya
ba dɛg lugɔ ba siu la,
bir na bahinaa.
12N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
bir turgi a
hɛssi hina naa buniidaanɛɛ,
dikuu baŋ chagzii la wia.
13Denii yaa banla n ɛɛ i nɛra, di ɛɛ lugɔ i peeza,
jaa ra jaamii,
saŋaa saŋa maa.
Di lii jimini bɛl
di ra la bɛl,
yaa danna chɔlii.

english_text:
(A psalm by Asaph for the music leader. To the tune “Lilies of the Agreement.”)
Help Our Nation
1 Shepherd of Israel, you lead
the descendants of Joseph,
and you sit on your throne
above the winged creatures.
Listen to our prayer
and let your light shine
2for the tribes of Ephraim,
Benjamin, and Manasseh.
Save us by your power.
3Our God, make us strong again!
Smile on us and save us.
4 Lord God All-Powerful,
how much longer
will the prayers of your people
make you angry?
5You gave us tears for food,
and you made us drink them
by the bowlful.
6Because of you,
our enemies who live nearby
laugh and joke about us.
7Our God, make us strong again!
Smile on us and save us.
8We were like a grapevine
you brought out of Egypt.
You chased other nations away
and planted us here.
9Then you cleared the ground,
and we put our roots deep,
spreading over the land.
10Shade from this vine covered
the mountains.
Its branches climbed
the mighty cedars
11and stretched to the sea;
its new growth reached
to the river.
12Our Lord, why have you
torn down the wall
from around the vineyard?
You let everyone who walks by
pick the grapes.
13Now the vine is gobbled up
by pigs from the forest
and other wild animals.
14God All-Powerful,
please do something!
Look down from heaven
and see what's happening
to this vine.
15With your own hands
you planted its roots,
and you raised it
as your very own.
16Enemies chopped the vine down
and set it on fire.
Now show your anger
and destroy them.
17But help the one who sits
at your right side,
the one you raised
to be your very own.
18Then we will never turn away.
Put new life into us,
and we will worship you.
19 Lord God All-Powerful,
make us strong again!
Smile on us and save us.
translation_text:
Izrɛl hina kuarisogaa wia wiisuŋŋaa
Asaf yir
1Izrɛl hina Penɔɔni,
keŋŋi digni di nuu yaa be,
hinla n ɛɛ i nɛra sitɔɔri
alugɔ penɔɔni la,
hìŋ́ unla n soge i koorikara ni
chɛrubzi baambaaŋ la.
2Kpa i hiŋ bagli Ɛfram,
Bɛnjamin ani Manasɛ dizi.
Bagli yaa i fɔŋŋa,
di wa lɛɛ yaa!
3N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bir wa lɛɛ yaa!
Suŋ yaa ni,
yá wer na lɛɛi!
4Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ,
ɛrɛɛ i baaŋ ra fuuh
di birgi mag,
i nɛra wiisuŋŋaa la wiai?
5I gillɔɔ biinichɔg birgi lugɔ yaa diwee,
sinii ge birgi lugɔ
yaa niinyɔɔlii.
6I gillɔɔ hɛssi la n bar yaa la,
ra naa dikuu yaa hɛri wia,
yaa dɔma jaa ra chagzi yaa.
7Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ,
bir kuari yaa soŋŋi!
Suŋ yaa ni,
ya wer na lɛɛi!
8I kpogli i nɛraa lugɔ grepu daa
lii Ijip ba,
di wa duŋŋi hɛssi la hina,
ka kpau chɔɔzi.
9I par bɔruu di tɛu ú wer hel,
di du lunne,
di talmi tɔ a hɛri maa.
10U talmi bizenaa nyuuni, u bɔsɔŋ tɔ a maa,
di talmi tɔ hɛriŋkpola
daazenaa la maa ni.
11U talmɔɔrɛ ga hel Muuzeŋ Mɛditerenɛn la,
di kaa kpa guŋŋ ga hel
Muu Yufretis gba.
12Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i purgi koŋlii la
n baruu chem,
guŋ gil nɛr la maa n ga de ra kaali,
jaa ra tɔrgi u nɔnai?
13Heri lii kɔr biinii di waa chɔguu,
pir sela ge waa diu.
14Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, bir ba yaa be!
Binni yaa di lii chiŋ!
A binni grepu daa naa n chigɛ tɛɛ Izrɛl hina naa ni,
15daa la hiŋ kpa i himmaa
fɔŋŋa di chɔɔzi,
u ɛɛ lugɔ biibaal la
hiŋ dɛɛzɛɛ tɛɛ i hiŋ la!
16Yaa dɔma ŋmɛnnuubuu ta, di duu niŋ,
hau ba ni, di chɔgi baa!
17A guu nɛra la hiŋ lizɛɛ tɛɛ i hiŋ,
di gil ba du kpeg la.
18Yaa ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka bir har kpui,
bir tɛɛ yaa fɔŋŋa,
ya ra dargii.
19Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ,
bir kuari yaa soŋŋi.
Suŋ yaa ni,
ya wer na lɛɛi.

english_text:
(By Asaph for the music leader.
)
God Makes Us Strong
1Be happy and shout to God
who makes us strong!
Shout praises to the God
of Jacob.
2Sing as you play tambourines
and the lovely sounding
stringed instruments.
3 Sound the trumpets and start
the New Moon Festival.
We must also celebrate
when the moon is full.
4This is the law in Israel,
and it was given to us
by the God of Jacob.
5The descendants of Joseph
were told to obey it,
when God led them out
from the land of Egypt.
In a voice unknown to me,
I heard someone say:
6“I lifted the burden
from your shoulder
and took the heavy basket
from your hands.
7 When you were in trouble,
I rescued you,
and from the thunderclouds,
I answered your prayers.
Later I tested you
at Meribah Spring.
8“Listen, my people,
while I, the Lord,
correct you!
Israel, if you would only
pay attention to me!
9 Don't worship foreign gods
or bow down to gods
you know nothing about.
10I am the Lord your God.
I rescued you from Egypt.
Just ask, and I will give you
whatever you need.
11“But, my people, Israel,
you refused to listen,
and you would have nothing
to do with me!
12So I let you be stubborn
and keep on following
your own advice.
13“My people, Israel,
if only you would listen
and do as I say!
14I, the Lord, would quickly
defeat your enemies
with my mighty power.
15Everyone who hates me
would come crawling,
and that would be the end
of them.
16But I would feed you
with the finest bread
and with the best honey
until you were full.”
translation_text:
Hɔpizizeŋ dii yir
Asaf yir
1Ií ra yir yira ni bɔsɔna,
di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la
n ɛɛ yaa fɔŋŋa la.
Ií ra chaasi werge,
di ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la
Jekɔb n na hum!
2Ií faari di ra yir yira, di ra yigzi kuna.
Ií kpa janjalanzi ni kem,
di lɔ yirsuma ra tɛu.
3Ií huuh bensunoniina, di faari Baagufalii Hɔpizizeŋ dii,
di kaa huuuh,
di a baagu wa ɛɛ bir.
4Izrɛl hina widauliirɛ keŋ,
Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina
n na hum,
labuu dau a wii naa.
5Saŋa la uŋ faa pig Ijip hina, di lɔ baa labuu,
u faa dawuu
tɛɛ Izrɛl hina.
Denii n nuu loobii bɛl n na ŋɔ,
6“Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi lɛɛ ii buntɔgaa
lii ii baŋaazi,
di gil ii nonee heezi.
7Iiŋ faa du tɔɔrɔɔ biini di lɔ wile tɛŋ,
n wa lɛɛ iabuu.
N faa lii n suahribɔr nazaa biinii, di nuu ii be,
di faa ɛɛ ia na
Mɛriba bulli la bɔr.
8N nɛra, ií ra nuu n karfaa,
Izrɛl hina, n bɔra daŋ vii sɔɔni,
di ii vii nuuwɔ tɛŋ!
9Ií gilɛɛ kaa wàá dɔɔ vug maa ii biini,
ií gilɛɛ waa tognaa.
10Minuu Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum,
unla n kpogli ia
lii Ijip hɛri la.
Di ii wia dɔɔ wibii, n daŋ kissi ia.
11Ka n nɛra faa waa nuuwɛ tɛŋ,
Izrɛl hina faa waa sɛɛwɛ,
bá ra hiŋ n ŋmɛnizi la.
12Awia, n faa gil baabuu,
ba ra ɛɛ
ba dignikpega wiɛɛlaa,
di ra ɛɛ ba kipar.
13Di n nɛra daŋ vii nuu ra tɛŋ,
di Izrɛl hina
daŋ vii ra hiŋ n ŋmɛnizi,
14n daŋ vii kpegli ba dɔma manaŋ,
di tɔɔri baa!
15Banla n hah mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la,
daŋ wa togni
n see ni ɔnsii.
Ba dignitɛraa daŋ du de,
di hanna la
saŋaa saŋa maa.
16Ka n daŋ kpa huutinanaa dɛɛzi iawaa,
di gil ii ɔɔ di
huuhnuunanaa piŋ.”

english_text:
(A psalm by Asaph.)
Please Do Something, God!
1When all the other gods
have come together,
the Lord God judges them
and says:
2“How long will you
keep judging unfairly
and favoring evil people?
3Be fair to the poor
and to orphans.
Defend the helpless
and everyone in need.
4Rescue the weak and homeless
from the powerful hands
of heartless people.
5“None of you know
or understand a thing.
You live in darkness,
while the foundations
of the earth tremble.
6 “I, the Most High God, say
that all of you are gods
and also my own children.
7But you will die,
just like everyone else,
including powerful rulers.”
8Do something, God!
Judge the nations of the earth;
they belong to you.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizii koorizeŋ
Asaf yir
1Kɔraawiizi sogo u nabɔmbɔttɛ chiŋ,
a chaalizeŋ biini,
di ra di u balaa seriya,
di ra ŋɔ,
2“Ɛrɛɛ ii lɛɛ nɛra la wia n waa deŋlee nuuzi,
di birgi magɛi, di lɛɛ ra jaa
biinikpola hina ninɛi?
3Ií ra lɛɛ nyaara ani lalbiizi nuuzi,
di lɛɛ wibii
ra tɛɛ dɔgnya hina
ni banla banna sunni.
4Ií ra lɛɛ baa
di ra lii biinikpola hina
nonee biini.
5Ii waa wiimaa zummɛ! Ii gɛnnɔɔ!
Ii ɔɔ ra lɛɛ kunaa,
wibii dii tuŋ
durnya biini.
6N ŋɔ, ‘Ii bɛl maa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi,
ii maa ɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La
N Kaali Kummaa la biizii.’
7Ka ii maanii niŋ siuzi alugɔ newea,
ii maa miibɔɔni tuŋ
alugɔ koora gba
n ɔɔ wa siuzi la.”
8N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, izi chiŋ di di durnya maa seriya,
dikuubɛɛwiai, hɛssi
hina maa ɛɛ i horaa.

english_text:
(A song and a psalm by Asaph.)
God Rules All the Earth
1Our God, don't just sit there,
silently doing nothing!
2Your hateful enemies
are turning against you
and rebelling.
3They are sly, and they plot
against those you treasure.
4They say, “Let's wipe out
the nation of Israel
and make sure that no one
remembers its name!”
5All of them fully agree
in their plans against you,
and among them are
6Edom and the Ishmaelites;
Moab and the Hagrites;
7Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek;
Philistia and Phoenicia.
8Even Assyria has joined forces
with Moab and Ammon.
9 Our Lord, punish all of them
as you punished Midian.
Destroy them, as you destroyed
Sisera and Jabin
at Kishon Creek 10near Endor,
and let their bodies rot.
11 Treat their leaders as you did
Oreb and Zeeb,
Zebah and Zalmunna.
12All of them said, “We'll take
God's valuable land!”
13Our God, scatter them around
like dust in a whirlwind.
14Just as flames destroy forests
on the mountains,
15pursue and terrify them
with storms of your own.
16Make them blush with shame,
until they turn and worship
you, our Lord.
17Let them be forever ashamed
and confused.
Let them die in disgrace.
18Make them realize that you
are the Lord Most High,
the only ruler of earth!
translation_text:
Izrɛl hina dɔma kpeglaa wiisuŋŋaa
Asaf yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gilɛɛ siigi,
gilɛɛ sigli,
gilɛɛ ɛɛ kirkir!
2Na! I dɔma ra ta jinaa,
banla ge n haih la
birgi nɛkpoŋlaa.
3Ba suahzɔɔrɛ di ra ta,
i nɛra la
hinna guu la jina.
4Ba ra ŋɔu, “Ií ba ya chɔgi baa, bá dim,
nɛra wàá ka liizi
Izrɛl sɔŋ ŋmɛnɛ maa.”
5Ba ta jinaa,
di ɛɛ nuukpaŋ bá yooi,
6baabuu, Ɛdɔm, Ismɛl,
Moab ani Hagri hina,
7di kaa kpa Gɛbal, Ammɔn, Amalɛk,
Filisti ani Taaya hina.
8Asiiria hina gba jaa ba ninɛɛ,
bá tɛɛ Lɔt naanna Ammɔn
ni Moab hina,
fɔŋŋa di jaa.
9Ɛɛ baa gunla hiŋ faa ɛɛ Midian hina
ani Sisɛra ni Jabin la
n faa ɛɛ
ba laallɔɔra nabɔnzi,
Muu Kisɔn la.
10Ba faa siu Ɛndɔ biinii
di ɛɛ lugɔ kpaga.
11Ɛɛ ba nabɔnzenaa ge
gunla hiŋ faa ɛɛ
Koora Ɔrɛb ani Ziib la,
di kpegli ba sitɔɔra maa
gunla hiŋ faa ɛɛ
Koora Zɛba ani Zalmuna la
12n faa ŋɔwɛɛ, “Ií gil ya lɛɛ
Kɔraawiizi hɛri la,
ú birgi yaa hor.”
13N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
gil ba yaari lugɔ paŋhoohilaa,
lugɔ zɔga peu n kpawɛɛ.
14Ɛɛ lugɔ niŋ n na fuuh kɔr,
di ɛɛ lugɔ ninlau
n na lau
bizenaa nyuuni la,
15kpa dooŋ pekpeg duŋŋi baa, bá kaali,
di kpa i pekpeg la wia
n dɔɔ ɔnsii werge
di ɔnzi baa.
16N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
gil hiihzi kpu baa
werge maa,
di gil ba zum
i fɔŋŋa wia.
17Gil ba kpegli baa,
ɔnsii lau baa,
saŋaa saŋa maa,
di gil ba siu
ni hiihzi werge.
18Gil ba zum lugɔ i bɛnnɛ Kɔraawiizi,
di ɛɛ durnya naa
maa Koorizeŋ.

english_text:
(For the music leader.
A psalm by the clan of Korah.)
The Joy of Worship
1 Lord God All-Powerful,
your temple is so lovely!
2Deep in my heart I long
for your temple,
and with all that I am
I sing joyful songs to you.
3 Lord God All-Powerful,
my King and my God,
sparrows find a home
near your altars;
swallows build nests there
to raise their young.
4You bless everyone
who lives in your house,
and they sing your praises.
5You bless all who depend
on you for their strength
and all who deeply desire
to visit your temple.
6When they reach Dry Valley,
springs start flowing,
and the autumn rain fills it
with pools of water.
7Your people grow stronger,
and you, the God of gods,
will be seen in Zion.
8 Lord God All-Powerful,
the God of Jacob,
please answer my prayer!
9You are the shield
that protects your people,
and I am your chosen one.
Won't you smile on me?
10One day in your temple
is better than a thousand
anywhere else.
I would rather serve
in your house,
than live in the homes
of the wicked.
11Our Lord and our God,
you are like the sun
and also like a shield.
You treat us with kindness
and with honor,
never denying any good thing
to those who live right.
12 Lord God All-Powerful,
you bless everyone
who trusts you.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi Dia wia du n bampiriire
Kora domee biibaala yir
1Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ,
i Dia wia du
n bampiriire werge maa.
2N bɔra daŋ sɔɔni di n vii du de!
N na nyiŋŋuu
n du i Dia la biini,
di yir bɔsɔna yira di ra tɛɛ hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la n du de saŋa maa,
n de dui biini maa.
3Jooga dɔɔ daŋaa, koŋkoroŋbizi gba dɔɔ a diini
di ɔɔ du a biizi dugli
i mbusu lizibɔr.
Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la
minna hum,
hinuu n koori.
4Banla maa n du i Dia,
di ɔɔ yir yira
ra chɔlii, nuu sumaa.
5Banla maa fɔŋŋa n lii Kɔraawiizi be,
ba aah siwii
bá la ga na Bizeŋ Ziɔn,
nuu sumaa.
6Baŋ waa ga Baka Waluu biini la,
guŋ faa gillɔɔ
u birgi bulli,
yuuliŋ dooŋ ge
faa gil u vile suugi.
7Ba fɔŋŋa danna jaau guŋŋ,
ka bɛl maa
wa chi Kɔraawiizi see,
Bizeŋ Ziɔn nyuu.
8Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ,
a nuu n wiisuŋŋaa.
Kɔraawiizi la Jekɔb n na hum,
keŋŋi digni di nuu n be.
9N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
kissi koori la
hiŋ lizɛɛ ŋɔ
u ra guu yaa la.
10Nɛr n du i Dia hɔpizikpannɛ bɔ,
uŋ di hɔpizaa
kagboŋ yembɛl.
Miŋ ɛɛ i Dia dominua binnii bɔ,
min du
biinikpola hina diini.
11Kɔraawiizii koori la
n ɛɛ girme hiŋ,
di ra guu yaa.
U ɔɔ ra kissi yaabuu ni winanaa ni girme,
wàá sɛɛ kpolli
banla maa n na ɛɛ
wideŋlaa u be,
winanii maa.
12Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ,
banla maa n yardii,
nuu sumaa.

english_text:
(A psalm by the clan of Korah for the music leader.)
A Prayer for Peace
1Our Lord, you have blessed
your land
and made all go well
for Jacob's descendants.
2You have forgiven the sin
and taken away the guilt
of your people.
3Your fierce anger is no longer
aimed at us.
4Our Lord and our God,
you save us!
Please bring us back home
and don't be angry.
5Will you always be angry
with us and our families?
6Won't you give us fresh life
and let your people be glad
because of you?
7Show us your love
and save us!
8I will listen to you, Lord God,
because you promise peace
to those who are faithful
and no longer foolish.
9You are ready to rescue
everyone who worships you,
so that you will live with us
in all your glory.
10Love and loyalty
will come together;
goodness and peace
will unite.
11Loyalty will sprout
from the ground;
justice will look down
from the sky above.
12Our Lord, you will bless us;
our land will produce
wonderful crops.
13Justice will march in front,
making a path
for you to follow.
translation_text:
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi bampirsɔna wia
Kora domee biibaala yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
i faa suŋ i hɛri hina ninɛɛ,
di gil ba wia kaa kuari.
2I gil i nɛra wichɔgaarɛ tɛɛ baa,
di gil wia la maa
baŋ ɛɛwɛ leu la tɛɛ baa.
3I gillɔɔ i baaŋ waa kaa ra fuuh ba ni,
i di baa kanyitti.
4N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ yaa Lɛɛri,
bir wa lɛɛ yaa,
di gilɛɛ ka gil
yaa wia
ra chɔgi i biini.
5I baaŋ daŋ fuuh yaa ninɛɛ di hanna la gɛɛ?
I baaŋ ŋmɛnɛ maa
wàá sɔɔniaa?
6Kaa bir tɛɛ yaa fɔŋŋa,
guŋ gil ya ra chɔlii.
7N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bagli yaa i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la,
di hiini yaa,
di lɛɛ yaa.
8N na nuu gunla Kɔraawiizi n na ŋɔu,
u ŋɔ nuarɛ
bampirsɔna wia,
di ra tɛɛ yaa banla n ɛɛ u nɛra,
di yaa wàá ka bir har
di gaa ɛɛ gɛnni wia.
9Wibii maa, u ɛɛ siryaa,
ú lɛɛ banla n na tɛu girme,
ú girme su yaa hɛri.
10Nɔŋŋaa ani wibii daŋ kpau alugɔ dammuzi,
wideŋlaa ge ni
bampirsɔna ɛɛ kpaŋ.
11Wibii dii daŋ lii durnya hina be,
di la Kɔraawiizi be,
wideŋlaa ge lii Kɔraawiizi be,
di ba durnya hina be.
12Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil ya nyɛɛli,
di gil yaa hɛri du sum,
kuna lɛɛ nɛnnɛ.
13Kɔraawiizi wideŋlaa daŋ tɔ u see,
alugɔ nɛr,
di wa kuari ŋmɛnɛɛ dawuu.

english_text:
(A prayer by David.)
A Prayer for Help
1Please listen, Lord,
and answer my prayer!
I am poor and helpless.
2Protect me and save me
because you are my God.
I am your faithful servant,
and I trust you.
3Be kind to me!
I pray to you all day.
4Make my heart glad!
I serve you,
and my prayer is sincere.
5You willingly forgive,
and your love is always there
for those who pray to you.
6Please listen, Lord!
Answer my prayer for help.
7When I am in trouble, I pray,
knowing you will listen.
8No other gods are like you;
only you work miracles.
9 You created each nation,
and they will all bow down
to worship and honor you.
10You perform great wonders
because you alone are God.
11Teach me to follow you,
and I will obey your truth.
Always keep me faithful.
12With all my heart I thank you.
I praise you, Lord God.
13Your love for me is so great
that you protected me
from death and the grave.
14Proud and violent enemies,
who don't care about you,
have ganged up to attack
and kill me.
15But you, the Lord God,
are kind and merciful.
You don't easily get angry,
and your love
can always be trusted.
16I serve you, Lord,
and I am the child
of one of your servants.
Look on me with kindness.
Make me strong and save me.
17Show that you approve of me!
Then my hateful enemies
will feel like fools,
because you have helped
and comforted me.
translation_text:
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, keŋŋi digni di nuu n wiisuŋŋaa,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n nyaawɔɔ
di ɛɛ anuula hiŋ.
2Lɛɛŋ lii siu be, dikuubɛɛwiai, n kpa n hinnɛ tɛi.
Hinuu Kɔraawiizi la
minna hum, lɛɛ i balii
la n yardii.
3N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, na n sinyɛna,
dikuubɛɛwiai, hɔpizaa maanii
anna suŋŋii.
4N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil i balii bɔra sɔɔni,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n na suŋŋiibuu
ni biinihuŋŋu.
5I wia wessoo, i ɔɔ gil yaa wichɔgaarɛ ra tɛɛ yaa.
I nɔŋŋaa la n
waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la
du banla maa
n na suŋŋii benii.
6N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a nuu n wiisuŋŋaa,
a nuu n wile
di na n sinyɛna.
7N tɔɔrɔɔ hɔpizii, n daŋ yirii,
dikuu hin niŋ nuu tɛŋ wia.
8N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
vug maa waa hoo
di du kpeg lugɔi.
I bɛnnɛ ra ɛɛ wizenaa.
9Hɛssi la maa hiŋ tawɛɛ la hina,
daŋ ba i see
di waa jaamii,
ba daŋ waa dargii,
10dikuubɛɛwiai, i ɛɛ nɛzenne.
I bɛnnɛ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi
di ra ɛɛ nuukpuuri wia.
11N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bagliŋ i ŋmɛnɛɛ,
n na hiŋ i wibii la,
tɛŋ bampirkpaŋ,
n na tɔgzii.
12N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
n danna chɔlii
ni n biini maa,
n danna dargii
saŋaa saŋa maa.
13Dikuu i nɔŋŋaa hiŋ nɔŋŋiŋ saŋa maa,
n kannɛ werge maa wia,
i lɛɛmbuu lii siu be.
14N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, banla n na jigsi izoore chi n ni,
sikpegii hina
ra nyiŋŋuu ba kpuŋ,
ba baga lɛi i wia.
15Ka hìŋ́ N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi waa ra suŋ nɛra ninɛɛ di nɔŋŋi baa.
I baaŋ waa fuuh manaŋ,
i nɔŋŋaa ni
i wibii dɔɔi ge du kaŋ.
16Bir n be di na n sinyɛna,
tɛɛ mìŋ́ i balii fɔŋŋa,
di lɛɛŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai,
n humiibuu gunla
n maa n humii la.
17Gil n na i winanaa daansɛɛ wii,
ń dɔma na guŋ,
hiihzi kpu baa,
dikuubɛɛwiai, hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi hiinimbuu,
di tig n bampirii.

english_text:
(A psalm and a song by the clan of Korah.)
The Glory of Mount Zion
1Zion was built by the Lord
on the holy mountain,
2and he loves that city
more than any other place
in all of Israel.
3Zion, you are the city of God,
and wonderful things
are told about you.
4Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia,
Phoenicia, and Ethiopia
are some of those nations
that know you,
and their people all say,
“I was born in Zion.”
5God Most High will strengthen
the city of Zion.
Then everyone will say,
“We were born here too.”
6The Lord will make a list
of his people,
and all who were born here
will be included.
7All who sing or dance will say,
“I too am from Zion.”
translation_text:
Jɛrusalɛm chɔlaa wia
Kora domee biibaala yir
1Kɔraawiizi ma u bolzenne Jɛrusalɛm,
bizennaniinanii la nyuu.
2U nɔŋŋuubuu
kaali Izrɛl hɛri
bolzenaa maa.
3Kɔraawiizi bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm,
ba ra ŋɔ i girme wiarɛ.
4Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Di n waa kur hɛssi la hina
n na sɛɛ n nuuzi,
Ijip ni Babilɔn hina daŋ jaa.
Filisti, Taaya ani Itiopia hina ge gba daŋ jaa,
ka ń jaa ŋɔ,
‘Bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛmnɛ
ba lul unnii.’ ”
5Wibii maa, ba daŋ ŋɔ bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm wia
“Denii hɛssi maa hina lii,
Kɔraawiizi La
N Kaali Kummaa la
daŋ gil u du kpeg.”
6Kɔraawiizi daŋ sɛbi hɛssi maa nɛra sɔna hɔŋ biini, dí,
ba maa ɛɛ
Jɛrusalɛm hinaa.
7Ba danna sa di ra yir yira, di ra ŋɔ,
“Bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm biinii yaa
kissaa maa lii.”

english_text:
(A song and a psalm by the clan of Korah for the music leader. To the tune “Mahalath Leannoth.”
A special psalm by Heman the Ezrahite.)
A Prayer When You Can't Find the Way
1You keep me safe, Lord God.
So when I pray at night,
2please listen carefully
to each of my concerns.
3I am deeply troubled
and close to death;
4I am as good as dead
and completely helpless.
5I am no better off
than those in the grave,
those you have forgotten
and no longer help.
6You have put me in the deepest
and darkest grave;
7your anger rolls over me
like ocean waves.
8You have made my friends turn
in horror from me.
I am a prisoner
who cannot escape,
9and I am almost blind
because of my sorrow.
Each day I lift my hands
in prayer to you, Lord.
10Do you work miracles
for the dead?
Do they stand up
and praise you?
11Are your love and loyalty
announced in the world
of the dead?
12Do they know of your miracles
or your saving power
in the dark world below
where all is forgotten?
13Each morning I pray
to you, Lord.
14Why do you reject me?
Why do you turn from me?
15Ever since I was a child,
I have been sick
and close to death.
You have terrified me
and made me helpless.
16Your anger is like a flood!
And I am shattered
by your furious attacks
17that strike each day
and from every side.
18My friends and neighbors
have turned against me
because of you,
and now darkness
is my only companion.
translation_text:
Wiraa di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa
Kora domee biibaala yir
1Kɔraawiizi la n na lɛɛŋ,
hɔpizaa ni hamuŋa maa,
anna wiiu í see.
2Gil n wiisuŋŋaa helii,
keŋŋi digni di ra nuu
n wiraa, di hiiniŋ.
3Tɔɔrɔɔzi huuzimbuu werge maa,
haali n dugli siu.
4Ba kurimbuu jaa lalaa ni,
n ɛɛ lugɔ nɛr la
n waa fɔŋŋa dɔɔwɛ.
5Ba gilimbuu ta lalaa biini,
n ɛɛ lugɔ
nɛra la baŋ kpuwɛɛ,
ba chɔɔ ba ŋmama biine,
banla hiŋ suuh ba wia kɔrai,
ba wàá ka na i hiinaa la.
6I dawimbuu ŋmam la n luŋŋe biini,
bɔɔluŋ la
n biree werge biini.
7I baaŋ siili n ninɛɛ,
u duwɔɔrɛ lugɔ
nii lɔi n wa tɔ n ni.
8I gillɔɔ n badɔŋa vɛɛŋ ta,
di gil n birgi
kuŋkiilii ba be.
N ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nɛr baŋ tɔ dia,
màá wer chɔ.
9Maa na nɛnnɛ,
dikuu n sinii ni
n biinichɔg wia.
N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hɔpizi biimaanii n na yirii,
di ɔɔ lalli n nonee chiŋ
di ra suŋŋii.
10I ɛɛ nuukpuuri wiarɛ di ra bagli lalaa?
Ba ɔɔ weruu izi chiŋ di ra chɔliii?
11Ba ra ŋɔ i nɔŋŋaa wiarɛ ŋmam biini
gɛɛ di ra ŋɔ
i wibii dɔɔi wia
lalaa bolaa?
12Ba ra zum i nuukpuuri wiarɛ bɔbiri,
gɛɛ di ra zum i wideŋlaa ɛɛi wia,
bɔr la baŋ suuh wiimaa wiaa?
13N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ka miŋwaa ɔɔ wiiu,
di ra tɛi ŋɔ i hiiniŋ,
chɔɔzi maanii anna suŋŋii.
14N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i vɛɛŋ tai?
Ɛrɛɛ i bir
i har kpunnɛi?
15Di lii n bichalli saŋa maa,
n di tɔɔrɔɔrɛ
di dugli siu.
N bɔra maanii huahwɛ,
maa kaa dɔɔ fɔŋŋa
dikuu i dignitɛraa wia.
16I baaŋ la nyaŋŋimbuu,
i tɔɔrichɔgaa la
chɔgiŋ kɔrai.
17Hɔpizaa maa, ba fɔɔmbuu alugɔ nii n suwee
lii keŋkere maa.
18I gillɔɔ n badɔŋa
ni n nɔŋŋa vɛɛŋ ta,
bɔbiri bɛnnɛ ɛɛ n dammu.

english_text:
(A special psalm by Ethan the Ezrahite.)
The Lord's Agreement with David
1 Our Lord, I will sing
of your love forever.
Everyone yet to be born
will hear me praise
your faithfulness.
2I will tell them, “God's love
can always be trusted,
and his faithfulness lasts
as long as the heavens.”
3You said, “David, my servant,
is my chosen one,
and this is the agreement
I made with him:
4 David, one of your descendants
will always be king.”
5Our Lord, let the heavens
now praise your miracles,
and let all your angels
praise your faithfulness.
6None who live in the heavens
can compare with you.
7You are the most fearsome
of all who live in heaven;
all the others fear
and greatly honor you.
8You are Lord God All-Powerful!
No one is as loving
and faithful as you are.
9You rule the roaring sea
and calm its waves.
10You crushed the monster Rahab,
and with your powerful arm
you scattered your enemies.
11The heavens and the earth
belong to you.
And so does the world
with all its people
because you created them
12and everything else.
Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon
gladly praise you.
13You are strong and mighty!
14Your kingdom is ruled
by justice and fairness
with love and faithfulness
leading the way.
15Our Lord, you bless those
who join in the festival
and walk in the brightness
of your presence.
16We are happy all day
because of you,
and your saving power
brings honor to us.
17Your own glorious power
makes us strong,
and because of your kindness,
our strength increases.
18Our Lord and our King,
the Holy One of Israel,
you are truly our shield.
19In a vision, you once said
to your faithful followers:
“I have helped a mighty hero.
I chose him from my people
and made him famous.
20 David, my servant, is the one
I chose to be king,
21and I will always be there
to help and strengthen him.
22“No enemy will outsmart David,
and he won't be defeated
by any hateful people.
23I will strike down and crush
his troublesome enemies.
24He will always be able
to depend on my love,
and I will make him strong
with my own power.
25I will let him rule the lands
across the rivers and seas.
26He will say to me,
‘You are my Father
and my God,
as well as the mighty rock
where I am safe.’
27 “I have chosen David
as my first-born son,
and he will be the ruler
of all kings on earth.
28My love for him will last,
and my agreement with him
will never be broken.
29“One of David's descendants
will always be king,
and his family will rule
until the sky disappears.
30Suppose some of his children
should reject my Law
and refuse my instructions.
31Or suppose they should disobey
all of my teachings.
32Then I will correct
and punish them
because of their sins.
33But I will always love David
and faithfully keep all
of my promises to him.
34“I won't break my agreement
or go back on my word.
35I have sworn once and for all
by my own holy name,
and I won't lie to David.
36His family will always rule.
I will let his kingdom last
as long as the sun 37and moon
appear in the sky.”
38You are now angry, Lord,
and you have turned your back
on your chosen king.
39You broke off your agreement
with your servant, the king,
and you completely destroyed
his kingdom.
40The walls of his city
have been broken through,
and every fortress
now lies in ruins.
41All who pass by
take what they want,
and nations everywhere
joke about the king.
42You made his enemies powerful
and let them celebrate.
43But you forced him to retreat
because you did not fight
on his side.
44You took his crown
and threw his throne
in the dirt.
45You made an old man of him
and put him to shame.
46How much longer, Lord?
Will you hide forever?
How long will your anger
keep burning like fire?
47Remember, life is short!
Why did you empty our lives
of all meaning?
48No one can escape the power
of death and the grave.
49Our Lord, where is the love
you have always shown
and that you promised
so faithfully to David?
50Remember your servant, Lord!
People make jokes about me,
and I suffer many insults.
51I am your chosen one,
but your enemies chase
and make fun of me.
52Our Lord, we praise you
forever. Amen and amen.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi ni Koori Deevid nuukpaŋ wia
Ɛzra domee hinuu Ɛtan yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n daŋ ɔɔ yir yira,
di ra bagli i nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia.
N danna sii i wibii dɔɔi wia,
saŋaa saŋa maa.
2N danna ŋɔ i nɔŋŋaa la n du de,
waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia
saŋa maa.
I wibii dɔɔi ge du de,
alugɔ chiŋ n du de
saŋa maa la.
3I faa ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N ni nɛra la miŋ lizɛɛ la ɛɛ nuukpannɛ,
n ŋɔ nuarɛ tɛɛ
n balii Koori Deevid, di ŋɔ,
4‘N daŋ gil i dee chi nɛnnɛ,
di gil i kora chi nɛnnɛ,
di hanna la
saŋaa saŋa maa.’ ”
5N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, chiŋ kunnyinee maa, ra chɔli nuukpuuri wia la hiŋ ɛɛwɛ labuu,
mɛlikazi ge ra bagli
i wibii dɔɔi wia.
6Nɛr maa waa hoo chiŋ lugɔ hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi.
I ni bɛl maa waa mɛgzɛɛ.
7Mɛlikazi maa chaalɛɛ i be, ra ɔmiibuu werge,
i wiarɛ dɔɔ ɔnsii werge
kaali a maa.
8Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, bɛl maa waa fɔŋŋa dɔɔwɛ lugɔi,
i wia dɔɔ wibiire
wiimaa biini.
9Hinuu ra di kora muuzeŋ fɔŋŋa ni,
di ɔɔ gil u nii lɔi siigi.
10I faa chɔgi muuzeŋ biini sechɔgii Rahab labuu, di kpuu,
di kpa i fɔŋŋazeŋ la
di kpegli i dɔma.
11Chiŋ ni hɛri maanii ɛɛ i hora,
hinuu ta durnya ni kuna la maa
n du u biini.
12Hinuu ta wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag ni wiifurii nodig wiikakag,
Bizenaa Tabɔ ni Hɛmɔn
ra yir yiraa ni bɔsɔna
alugɔ nɛra, i sɔŋ wia.
13I dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa werge maa!
I kpegzi kannɔɔ werge!
14I kora chigɔ wideŋlaa ani wibii dii ninɛɛ,
nɔŋŋaa ani wibii dɔɔi ge
du i wiɛɛlaa maa biini.
15Banla maa n yir yira di ra jaamii,
di du i see
bɔchaaŋ la biini,
nuu sumaa!
16Hɔpizaa maanii ba bɔra ɔɔ ra pur i sɔŋ wia,
ba ra chɔlii
dikuu i wideŋlaa wia.
17Hinuu gillɛ yaa ra kpegli yaa dɔma laalkpega biini,
i nɔŋŋaa wia,
i gillɔɔ yaa ra kpegli baa.
18N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hinuu lizi yaa guuri tɛɛ yaa,
Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la
banna hum,
hinuu tɛɛ yaa koori.
Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ nua tɛɛ Koori Deevid wia
19Saŋa la, i faa ŋɔ wiarɛ lugɔ deeza biini
tɛɛ i nɛra la
wia n dɔɔ wibii,
di ŋɔ,
“N tɛɛ laallɔɔrii fɔŋŋa,
di kpa a kora
tɛɛ nɛr la miŋ lizɛɛ
lii a nɛra biini.
20N lizi n balii Deevidii u ɛɛ koori,
n yiili nuunaniirɛ
waari u nyuu,
di lizuu.
21N fɔŋŋa daŋ du u be saŋa maa,
wibii maa,
n daŋ tɛu fɔŋŋa
ú du kpeg.
22U dɔm maa wàá wer gil u turgi hɛri kuna,
biinikpola hiŋ maa ge
wàá wer sunnuu.
23N daŋ chɔgi u dɔma maa n du u see,
di ŋmɛnni banla maa ge
n hauh la ta hɛri.
24N daŋ nɔŋŋuu ni wibii,
di gil u du kpeg,
dikuu n fɔŋŋa wia.
25N daŋ gil u kora diiribɔr wazi,
di lii Muuzeŋ Mɛditerenɛn
guŋŋ di ga hel Muu Yufretis.
26Koori Deevid daŋ yiriŋ di ŋɔ,
‘Hinuu ɛɛ n mɛɛ ni
Kɔraawiizi la minna hum,
di ɛɛ n guuri ni n Lɛɛri.’
27N daŋ gil u ɛɛ n biilugli,
di ɛɛ koorizeŋ
di kaali durnya naa
koora maa.
28N daŋ hiŋ nua la miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛu la,
yaa nuukpaŋ la
daŋ du de
di hanna la.
29U domee daŋ haŋ du de di hanna la,
u kora ge du de gunla
chiŋ n du de la.
30Ka di u naanna waa kaa wàá hiŋ n Gbɔg,
ba waa kaa wàá hiŋzi
n ŋmɛnizi la ge,
31di ba wa vɛɛ n baglaa
ani n widaulaa hiŋaa,
32n daŋ tɛrgi ba digna dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia,
di gil ba di tɔɔrɔɔ
dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia.
33Ka màá gil Deevid nɔŋŋaa
gɛɛ di vɛɛ nuuzi la
miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛu la di ta.
34Màá gil n nuu nuukpaŋ la chɔgi
gɛɛ di vɛɛ nuuzi la
miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛu la
kpaŋkpaŋ maa.
35Kakpannɛ n kpa n sɔnnanii la di hɛɛhzi,
awia, n ŋmɛnɛ maa
wàá kanni kara
tɛɛ Koori Deevid.
36U domee daŋ du de di hanna la,
ú kora ge du n see,
gunla wiizi
n du de saŋa maa la.
37U kora daŋ du de di hanna la,
gunla baagu n du chiŋ
di ra chaani la.”
Biinichɔg yir dikuu baŋ kpegli Koori wia
38Ka i baaŋ fuuh koori la hiŋ lizɛɛ la ninɛɛ,
i vɛɛubuu di giluu ta.
39I vɛɛ i ni i balii nuukpaŋ labuu ta,
di pilli u koorikahuro ha hɛri.
40I purgi u bolzeŋ koŋlaare,
di purgi u diikpega,
41banla maa n na ga de ɔɔ ra ŋmɛɛ u kunaa,
u birgi u dɔŋahina chɛɛtɛkuŋ.
42I gillɔɔ u dɔma kpegluu,
ba bɔra jaa sɔɔni.
43I gillɔɔ u dɔŋkuna bir pɛɛ,
di gil ba kpegluu laal biini.
44I lɛɛ u koori daŋkpalaa lii u nonee,
di taa u kora ha hɛri.
45I gillɔɔ biinichɔg gil u zɛŋ kakpaŋ,
di gil u di hiihzi.
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi lɛɛi wia
46N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i daŋ bir i har kpu yaa di hanna laa?
Ɛrɛɛ i baaŋ fuuh yaa ni,
alugɔ niŋ, di birgi magɛi?
47A liizi lugɔ n miibɔɔ waa jaŋ,
i ta newea maanii,
ba ɛɛ kunsiwaa!
48Anɛɛ n du de, u ŋmɛnɛ wàá siwɛi?
Anɛɛ n niŋ wer lɛɛ
u hiŋ lii ŋmam biinei?
49N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lee i nɔŋŋaa werge la duɛi?
Unla hiŋ faa kpa
i wibii dɔɔi,
di hɛɛhzi tɛɛ
Koori Deevid lai?
50A liizi gunla baŋ ɛɛ i balii chɛɛtɛ,
ni gunla miŋ di kanyitti,
dikuu hɛssi hina
chɛɛtɛ ɛɛi wia.
51N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i dɔma ra chagzi koori la hiŋ lizɛɛ labuu,
di ra ɛɛu chɛɛtɛ,
bɔr la maa uŋ laŋŋɛ.
52Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi, saŋaa saŋa maa!
Ami! Ami!

english_text:
BOOK IV
(Psalms 90–106)
(A prayer by Moses, the man of God.)
God Is Eternal
1Our Lord, in all generations
you have been our home.
2You have always been God—
long before the birth
of the mountains,
even before you created
the earth and the world.
3At your command we die
and turn back to dust,
4 but a thousand years
mean nothing to you!
They are merely a day gone by
or a few hours in the night.
5You bring our lives to an end
just like a dream.
We are merely tender grass
6that sprouts and grows
in the morning,
but dries up by evening.
7Your furious anger frightens
and destroys us,
8and you know all our sins,
even those we do in secret.
9Your anger is a burden
each day we live,
then life ends like a sigh.
10 We can expect seventy years,
or maybe eighty,
if we are healthy,
but even our best years
bring trouble and sorrow.
Suddenly our time is up,
and we disappear.
11No one knows the full power
of your furious anger,
but it is as great as the fear
that we owe to you.
12Teach us to use wisely
all the time we have.
13Help us, Lord! Don't wait!
Pity your servants.
14When morning comes,
let your love satisfy
all our needs.
Then we can celebrate
and be glad for what time
we have left.
15Make us happy for as long
as you caused us trouble
and sorrow.
16Do wonderful things for us,
your servants,
and show your mighty power
to our children.
17Our Lord and our God,
treat us with kindness
and let all go well for us.
Please let all go well!
translation_text:
Yira hɔŋ naazuhiŋ
(Yira 90—106)
Kɔraawiizi balii Moosis wiisuŋŋaa wia
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hinuu yaa duuribɔr,
di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa.
2Mɔɔ ka i ta bizenaa ni durnya,
hinuu Kɔraawiizi la n waa
luglaa ani tunaa dɔɔwɛ,
hinuu Kɔraawiizi,
saŋaa saŋa maa.
3I ɔɔ giluu newee bir birgi hɛɛhraa,
di ɔɔ ŋɔ, “Newea biizi,
ií bir zuu hɛɛhraa biini.”
4Binni kagboŋ ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ hɔpizikpaŋ i be,
gɛɛ hamuŋa karfizi n na bɛri
di i waa chɔɔ dɔɔ la.
5I ɔɔ gbaari neweare kaali saŋa la banna chɔɔgi siu dɔɔ,
ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ
chɔɔzi kooriifalaa,
6di ɔɔ ra fur chɔɔzi ni di ɛɛ afalaa,
ka di bɔr waa duani
a hil di siu.
7I baaŋfuuih chɔgi yaabuu,
ɔnsii lau yaa, yaa bɔra ra sa,
dikuu i baaŋ wia.
8I kpa yaa wichɔgaarɛ dau i see,
anla yaa n suahwɛ ɛɛ,
di dau bɔr la
hin niŋ wer naa.
9Yaa miibɔɔni kpussoo,
dikuu i baaŋfuuih wia,
a ɔɔ tunuu alugɔ himaa.
10Yaa miibɔɔni jaŋzi maa ɛɛ
binni tokkoahoro ni fii.
Banla n dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa ra di binni tokkoanaazu,
ka a maa biini,
tɔɔrɔɔ ni biinichɔg bɛnnɛ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, a ɔɔ
kaaluu manaŋ, yaa wia tuŋ.
11Anɛɛ n zum i baaŋ fɔŋŋa magai?
Dikuu i baaŋfuuihchɔgii
la wia, i dɛg ɔmaarɛ.
12Awia, bagli yaa, ya zum yaa hɔpizaa maga,
di wer dɔɔ nunzuma.
13N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
ɛrɛɛ i baaŋ fuuh yaa ni
di birgi magɛi?
Na i balaa sinyɛna!
14Chɔɔzi maa, ɔɔ́ gil i nɔŋŋaa la, n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la kukki yaa,
guŋ gil ya wer yir yira
di dɔɔ bɔsɔna,
yaa de dui biini maa.
15Gil yaa bɔra sɔɔni, alugɔ hɔpizaa la maga hiŋ tɔɔri yaa,
ani biŋkpila la maa
yaa n di tɔɔrɔɔ la.
16Gil i balaa na i wizenaa,
bá biizi ge na i girme.
17Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, kissi yaa,
di gil yaa wiɛɛlaa maa kuari.

english_text:
The Lord Is My Fortress
1Live under the protection
of God Most High
and stay in the shadow
of God All-Powerful.
2Then you will say to the Lord,
“You are my fortress,
my place of safety;
you are my God,
and I trust you.”
3The Lord will keep you safe
from secret traps
and deadly diseases.
4He will spread his wings
over you
and keep you secure.
His faithfulness is like
a shield or a city wall.
5You won't need to worry
about dangers at night
or arrows during the day.
6And you won't fear diseases
that strike in the dark
or sudden disaster at noon.
7You will not be harmed,
though thousands fall
all around you.
8And with your own eyes
you will see the punishment
of the wicked.
9The Lord Most High
is your fortress.
Run to him for safety,
10and no terrible disasters
will strike you
or your home.
11 God will command his angels
to protect you
wherever you go.
12 They will carry you
in their arms,
and you won't hurt your feet
on the stones.
13 You will overpower
the strongest lions
and the most deadly snakes.
14The Lord says, “If you love me
and truly know who I am,
I will rescue you
and keep you safe.
15When you are in trouble,
call out to me.
I will answer and be there
to protect and honor you.
16You will live a long life
and see my saving power.”
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizii yaa guuri
1Nɛr la maa n du Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la lɔɔ biini,
daŋ na heezaa
Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ
chunchugli biini.
2U daŋ wer ŋɔ u be, “Hinuu ɛɛwɛ lugɔ n suahribɔr ani n diikpeg.
Kɔraawiizi la minna hum,
hinuu n yardi.”
3U daŋ lɛɛi lii tɔɔrɔɔzi alugɔ sidɛɛzi,
baŋ suahzɛɛ he la be
ani wiilchɔgaa
maa biini.
4U daŋ guui,
alugɔ zal n ɔɔ yaa u keeri
tɔ u biizi ni la,
i dɔɔ suahribɔr u be,
u wibii dɔɔi daŋ guui di lɛɛi.
5Hàá kaa ra ɔm wiimaa hamuŋa ni
gɛɛ hobii la ban niŋ ta bɔchaaŋ
6gɛɛ wiilchɔgaa la n niŋ lawii bɔbiri
gɛɛ anla n na kpu wibaŋa ni.
7Nɛra kagboŋ daŋ chogli i kɛra di siu,
nɛra kagboŋa fi chogli
di siu barii,
ka hiŋwaa wàá na pira
tama maa.
8I daŋ binni di na gunla
banna tɛr biinikpola
hina digna.
9I kpa Kɔraawiizii di birgi i Lɛɛri,
Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali
Kummaa la ɛɛ i guuri.
10Awia, hɛhchɔg maa, wàá chol i ni
kaluchɔgii maa ge
wàá zuu i dia.
11Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil u mɛlikazi du i tau,
di ra binnii
bɔr la maa hinna la.
12A daŋ lallii chiŋ,
í gilɛɛ wa kpa i naa
di ra lɔ bii.
13N tɛibuu fɔŋŋa i wer fɛrgi hɛrikuna, di kpegli bunyinzi, haali hɛrikuna la
n dɔɔ siri werge
ani bunyinchɔgaa gba.
14Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N daŋ lɛɛ banla maa n nɔŋŋiŋ,
di guu banla maa
n zummɛ lugɔ
minuu Kɔraawiizi.
15Di ba wa lɔ wile tɛŋ, n daŋ nuu tɛɛ baa.
Di ba wa du tɔɔrɔɔ biini,
n daŋ du ba be,
n daŋ lɛɛ baa
di kpa baa girme.
16N daŋ gil ba dɔɔ miibɔɔjaŋ,
n daŋ lɛɛ baa.”

english_text:
(A psalm and a song for the Sabbath.)
Sing Praises to the Lord
1It is wonderful to be grateful
and to sing your praises,
Lord Most High!
2It is wonderful each morning
to tell about your love
and at night to announce
how faithful you are.
3I enjoy praising your name
to the music of harps,
4because everything you do
makes me happy,
and I sing joyful songs.
5You do great things, Lord.
Your thoughts are too deep
6 for an ignorant fool
to know or understand.
7Though the wicked sprout
and spread like grass,
they will be pulled up
by their roots.
8But you will rule
over all of us forever,
9and your hateful enemies
will be scattered
and then destroyed.
10You have given me
the strength of a wild ox,
and you have chosen me
to be your very own.
11My eyes have seen,
and my ears have heard
the doom and destruction
of my evil enemies.
12Good people will prosper
like palm trees,
and they will grow strong
like the cedars of Lebanon.
13They will take root
in your house, Lord God,
and they will do well.
14They will be like trees
that stay healthy and fruitful,
even when they are old.
15And they will say about you,
“The Lord always does right!
God is our mighty rock.”
translation_text:
Heezaa Hɔpizii yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a wessoo ya ra chɔlii,
di yir yira di ra dargi
Kɔraawiizi La
N Kaali Kummaa la,
2di ɔɔ ra ŋɔ i nɔŋŋaa la wia chɔɔzi ni,
di ra ŋɔ i wibii dɔɔi ge
wia hamuŋa ni,
3di kpa janjalaŋ ni kem
di ra yir yira.
4Dikuubɛɛwiai, hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi hunzenaa la gillɔɔ n bɔra sɔɔni,
n na yir yirsuma.
5N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i wiɛɛlaa kannɔɔ werge,
wia la hinna fɛ ge,
zɛɛ zumaa du kpol!
6Nfɛrnyaari wàá wer zumaa,
gɛnii ge wàá wer zum a zɛɛzi.
7Biinikpola hina daŋ wer fur alugɔ kooree,
wichɔgɛɛra ge nyɛɛli,
ka ba daŋ chɔgi baa, ba wia tuŋ.
8Ka hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ girmee saŋa maa.
9Yaa zummɔ lugɔ i dɔma maa daŋ siu,
wichɔgɛɛra maa yaari.
10I gillɔɔ n dɔɔ fɔŋŋa alugɔ pir nabal,
di kissiŋ, di gil n dɔɔ bɔsɔna.
11N siwee nawɔɔrɛ n dɔma n cholle,
n digna ge nuu
biinikpola hina
n na chɛɛhgi.
12Banla wia n deŋlee daŋ hel alugɔ kube daa,
di hel alugɔ
Lɛbanɔn hɛriŋkpol daa.
13Ba ɛɛwɔɔ alugɔ daazi baŋ chɔɔzɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Dia,
a lɔɔ nɛnnɛ Kɔraawiizi la
yaa n na hum la Dia biini.
14A ɔɔ haa ra nɔŋ nɔna, haali di a wa binɔɔ,
a paŋhoori ɔɔ haa biri,
a dɔɔ fɔŋŋa.
15Kenna bagluu lugɔ Kɔraawiizi wia dɔɔ wibiire,
n guuri waa
wichɔgii maa dɔɔwɛ.

english_text:
The Lord Is King
1Our Lord, you are King!
Majesty and power
are your royal robes.
You put the world in place,
and it will never be moved.
2You have always ruled,
and you are eternal.
3The ocean is roaring, Lord!
The sea is pounding hard.
4Its mighty waves are majestic,
but you are even more majestic,
and you rule over all.
5Your decisions are firm,
and your temple will always
be beautiful and holy.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizii Koori
1Kɔraawiizii koori, u bɔkkɔɔ alugɔ koori,
di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge.
U gillɔɔ hɛri chi chigigi,
waa ziigaa dɔɔwɛ.
2I koorikara chigɔɔ di lii faala maa,
i du denii mɔɔ
ka kummaa haa wa du de.
3N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, muuzenaa vile ra lɔu,
a ra lɔu, di ra kɔɔ werge,
di lalli a nii lɔi la.
4Kɔraawiizi di koraa chiŋ,
u fɔŋŋa kaali muuzenaa lɔi,
di du kpeg kaali
u nii lɔɔlaa.
5N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
i Gbɔgni du denii di hanna la.
I Dia ɛɛ naniinaniirɛ
di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa.

english_text:
The Lord Punishes the Guilty
1 Lord God, you punish
the guilty.
Show what you are like
and punish them now.
2You judge the earth.
Come and help us!
Pay back those proud people
for what they have done.
3How long will the wicked
celebrate and be glad?
4All of those cruel people
strut and boast,
5and they crush and wound
your chosen nation, Lord.
6They murder widows,
foreigners, and orphans.
7Then they say,
“The Lord God of Jacob
doesn't see or know.”
8Can't you fools see?
Won't you ever learn?
9God gave us ears and eyes!
Can't he hear and see?
10God instructs the nations
and gives knowledge to us all.
Won't he also correct us?
11 The Lord knows how useless
our plans really are.
12Our Lord, you bless everyone
that you instruct and teach
by using your Law.
13You give them rest
from their troubles,
until a pit can be dug
for the wicked.
14You won't turn your back
on your chosen nation.
15Justice and fairness
will go hand in hand,
and all who do right
will follow along.
16Who will stand up for me
against those cruel people?
17If you had not helped me, Lord,
I would soon have gone
to the land of silence.
18When I felt my feet slipping,
you came with your love
and kept me steady.
19And when I was burdened
with worries,
you comforted me
and made me feel secure.
20But you are opposed
to dishonest lawmakers
21who gang up to murder
innocent victims.
22You, Lord God, are my fortress,
that mighty rock
where I am safe.
23You will pay back my enemies,
and you will wipe them out
for the evil they did.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizii newea maa seriya diiri
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi la n na turgi nɛra wichɔgaa kim,
gil i baaŋ lii chaaŋ!
2Izi chiŋ, hɛri naa Seriya Diiri,
di turgi banla n na jigsi
gunla n dɛg baa!
3N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
ɛrɛɛ magaa biinikpola hina
birgi mag,
ɛrɛɛ bá di bahinaa
di birgi magɛi?
4Wichɔgɛɛra ra ŋɔ barabara wiŋɔzii,
di ra jigsi.
5Ba du i nɛraa pira,
di ra sunni banla n ɛɛ i hora.
6Ba kpu luhaana ni lalbiizii,
di kaa kpu hɔɔhra la
n du yaa hɛri la ge.
7Ba ra ŋɔu, “Kɔraawiizi waa yaa ra na,
Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na
hum la waa yaa ra hagzi.”
8Ií ra du tau, ii nfɛrnyaara la n du a nɛra biini,
gɛnaa, saŋa bɛɛ
ii dɔɔ nunzumai?
9Kɔraawiizii tɛɛ yaa digna, waa wia ra nuuwaa?
Waabuu tɛɛ yaa siwee,
waa naa?
10Waabuu nyɛgi a hɛssi hina ni, wàá tɛr ba dignaa?
Waabuu ɛɛ nɛr maa bagli,
waa wia zummɛaa?
11Kɔraawiizi zum newee nfɛssii,
a ɛɛ wipɛɛrii.
12N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
nɛr la maa
hiŋ tɛr u digni,
nɛr la hiŋ bagli wia
di lii i Gbɔg biini,
nuu suma.
13I ɔɔ lizuubuu lii tɔɔrɔɔ biini,
guŋŋ ka ba wa ki bɔɔ
dau biinikpola hina.
14Kɔraawiizi wàá vɛɛ u nɛra ta,
u ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá vɛɛ baa ta.
15Seriya dii ni wibii dii daŋ kaa du de,
banla maa wia n deŋlee la
ra hiŋ guŋ.
16Anɛɛ n niŋ lɛɛ n nua
di huuzi biinikpola hinai?
Anɛɛ n niŋ lɛɛ n nua
di huuzi wichɔgɛɛrai?
17Di Kɔraawiizi faa wan hiinee,
keŋ n vii siuwɔ.
18Miŋ wa ŋɔ, “N hɛhrɔɔrɛ,”
hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi
nɔŋŋaa lawimbuu.
19Di kafɔŋ wa lawiŋ werge,
i bampirii tigaa
ɔɔ tɛmbuu bɔsɔna.
20I ni seriya diire la n waa wibii ra di, wàá wer di dammunaa,
banla widaulaa
n na ba biinichɔg ni.
21A ba suahzuu di ra ta jinachɔɔgaa,
bá chɔgi banla wia n deŋlee,
di ɔɔ di banla n waa
wichɔgaa maa dɔɔwɛ seriya,
di ŋɔ ba kpu baa.
22Ka Kɔraawiizi ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ n diikpeg,
Kɔraawiizi la minna hum la
ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bii
miŋ chɔwɛɛ ga waa.
23U daŋ turgi baa ba wichɔgaa kim,
di chɔgi baa
dikuu ba biinikpola wia.
Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la
daŋ chɔgi baa.

english_text:
Worship and Obey the Lord
1Sing joyful songs to the Lord!
Praise the mighty rock
where we are safe.
2Come to worship him
with thankful hearts
and songs of praise.
3The Lord is the greatest God,
king over all other gods.
4He holds the deepest part
of the earth in his hands,
and the mountain peaks
also belong to him.
5The ocean is the Lord's
because he made it,
and with his own hands
he formed the dry land.
6Bow down and worship
the Lord our Creator!
7 The Lord is our God,
and we are his people,
the sheep he takes care of
in his own pasture.
Listen to God's voice today!
8 Don't be stubborn and rebel
as your ancestors did
at Meribah and Massah
out in the desert.
9For forty years
they tested God and saw
the things he did.
10Then God got tired of them
and said,
“You never show good sense,
and you don't understand
what I want you to do.”
11 In his anger, God told them,
“You people will never enter
my place of rest.”
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi chɔlaa yir
1Ií ba ya yir yira ni bɔsɔna di chɔli Kɔraawiizi,
ií gil ya chaasi werge
tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la
n na guu yaa.
2Ií gil ya ba u see di yir yira, di ra tɛu jaaŋ,
di yir yirsuma di ra chɔluu.
3Dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ
fɔŋŋa maa hinnɛ,
di ɛɛ Koorizeŋ
kaali vuga maa.
4Hɛri bɔluŋe du u noneere,
bizenaa nyuuni ge ɛɛ u hora.
5Waabuu dɔɔ muuzeŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, waabuu tau,
waabuu ta hɛri gba.
6Ií ba ya togni di jaamuu,
ií gil ya giŋŋi Kɔraawiizi la
n ta yaa la see!
7Waabuu ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum,
yaabuu ɛɛ u nɛra,
u ra binni yaa, alugɔ penɔɔni
n na binni u peeza.
Ii ra nuu wia la Kɔraawiizi n na ŋɔ ii be zinaa.
8“Ií gilɛɛ waa vɛɛ,
di ɛɛ dignikpega hina,
alugɔ ii naabaala
n faa ɛɛwɛ Mɛriba,
gunla baŋ faa ɛɛwɛ,
Massa n du hɛribɔduma,
a hɔl la.
9Denii ba faa ɛɛŋ di na,
haali baŋ faa na wia la
miŋ ɛɛwɛ gba.
10Binni tokkoanɛɛrɛ n baaŋ faa fuuh ba ni,
n ŋɔ, ‘Ba bampiree
ɔɔ dar baabuu
ba ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa,
ba waa n ŋmɛnizi zummɛ.’
11N baaŋ n faa fuuhwe la wiarɛ n ŋɔ,
‘Ba wàá na heezaa la dee
min niŋ faa tɛɛ baa la.’ ”

english_text:
Sing a New Song to the Lord
1Sing a new song to the Lord!
Everyone on this earth,
sing praises to the Lord,
2sing and praise his name.
Day after day announce,
“The Lord has saved us!”
3Tell every nation on earth,
“The Lord is wonderful
and does marvelous things!
4The Lord is great and deserves
our greatest praise!
He is the only God
worthy of our worship.
5Other nations worship idols,
but the Lord created
the heavens.
6Give honor and praise
to the Lord,
whose power and beauty
fill his holy temple.”
7 Tell everyone of every nation,
“Praise the glorious power
of the Lord.
8He is wonderful! Praise him
and bring an offering
into his temple.
9Everyone on earth, now tremble
and worship the Lord,
majestic and holy.”
10Announce to the nations,
“The Lord is King!
The world stands firm,
never to be shaken,
and he will judge its people
with fairness.”
11Tell the heavens and the earth
to be glad and celebrate!
Command the ocean to roar
with all its creatures
12and the fields to rejoice
with all their crops.
Then every tree in the forest
will sing joyful songs
13to the Lord.
He is coming to judge
all people on earth
with fairness and truth.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizii Koorizeŋ
1Ií yir yirfalii tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi!
Durnya hina maa,
ií yir yir tɛu, di ra darguu!
2Ií ra sii hɔpizi biimaa,
amaniyesuma la n na
bagli ii lɛɛi wia la.
3Ií ra sii u girme la wia ra tɛɛ hɛssi maa hina
ani u nuukpuuri wia la wia,
di ra tɛɛ nɛra maa.
4Kɔraawiizi zenni kannɔɔ, di dɛg chɔlaa werge maa.
Waabuu dɛg ɔmaa
kaali vuga maa.
5A hɛssi maa vuga ɛɛ kuna la baŋ kuarɛɛnɛ,
ka Kɔraawiizii ta chiŋ.
6Girme ni zenni du u benii,
fɔŋŋa ni girme su u Dia.
7Hɛri naa hina maa, ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi.
Ií ra chɔli u girme
ani u fɔŋŋa la.
8Ií ra dargi Kɔraawiizi la n dɔɔ girme la.
Ií kpa sunzaa kuna
di wa zuu u Dia la.
9Ií ra giŋŋi unla n ɛɛ Dɔɔrinaniinanii la, di u wa ballɔ,
durnya hina maa,
ií gil ɔnsii lau ia,
ii bɔra ra sa u sibɔɔ!
10Ií ŋɔ hɛssi maa hina be, “Kɔraawiizii koori!
Waabuu gillɛ hɛri chi nɛnnɛ,
waa ziigi la,
u daŋ di nɛr maa seriya
ni wibii.”
11Chiŋ ni hɛri, ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni!
Muuzeŋ ni kunnyinee la maa
n du i biini la,
ií ge gba ra ɛɛ guŋ,
12kooni ni kuna la maa n du ii biine,
ií ra di iihinaa!
Kɔr daazi maa ge daŋ yir yira ni bɔsɔna,
13a daŋ yir yira
Kɔraawiizi see, di u wa ballɔ.
U ra bau ú wa di durnya naa seriya.
U daŋ di durnya hina maa
seriya ni wibii gunla n dɛkkɛ.

english_text:
The Lord Brings Justice
1The Lord is King!
Tell the earth to celebrate
and all islands to shout.
2Dark clouds surround him,
and his throne is supported
by justice and fairness.
3Fire leaps from his throne,
destroying his enemies,
4and his lightning is so bright
that the earth sees it
and trembles.
5Mountains melt away like wax
in the presence of the Lord
of all the earth.
6The heavens announce,
“The Lord brings justice!”
Everyone sees God's glory.
7Those who brag about
the useless idols they worship
are terribly ashamed,
and all the false gods
bow down to the Lord.
8When the people of Zion
and of the towns of Judah
hear that God brings justice,
they will celebrate.
9The Lord rules the whole earth,
and he is more glorious
than all the false gods.
10Love the Lord
and hate evil!
God protects his loyal people
and rescues them
from violence.
11If you obey and do right,
a light will show you the way
and fill you with happiness.
12You are the Lord's people!
So celebrate and praise
the only God.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizii Koora Maa Koori
1Kɔraawiizii koori, gil hɛri hina bɔra sɔɔni!
Gil muuzenaa baambaana
hɛssi hina ge bɔra sɔɔni!
2Baamazi ani bɔbiri werge baruubuu chem,
u kora chigɔ wideŋlaa
ani wibii ninɛɛ.
3Ninlau tɔ u seere,
di ra fuuh u dɔma la
n baruu la.
4U nyɛgzaa chaani durnya maanii,
hɛri hina na, ba bɔra ra sa.
5Bizenaa ra ŋmɛɛruu alugɔ kel,
Kɔraawiizi la n na di kora
hɛssi maa nɛra ni la see.
6Chinchiŋ kuna maa baglɔɔrɛ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi wia deŋloore,
hɛssi hina maa ge na u girme.
7Banla maa n na kuari vuga di hiihzii,
banla n na jigsi dikuu vuga wia,
ií ra jaamuu,
vuga maa, ií ra jaamuu!
8Bolzeŋ Ziɔn hina nuuwɔɔ, ba bɔra sɔɔni,
Juda bolzenaa maa bɔra sɔɔni,
dikuu hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi
seriya dii wia.
9Hinuu du chiŋ di kaali kummaa,
di dɔɔ zenni
di kaali vuga maa.
10Gil banla n nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizi hah wichɔgaa,
dikuubɛɛwiai, u ɔɔ ra guu banla
wia n dɔɔ wibiire,
di ɔɔ ra lɛɛ baa di ra lii
biinikpola hina nonee biini.
11Bɔchaaŋ ɔɔ ra chaani banla wia n deŋlee ninɛɛ,
biinihuŋŋu hina
ge dɔɔ bɔsɔna.
12Ii banla maa wia n deŋlee, ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni Kɔraawiizi wia,
di ra dargi u sɔnnaniinanii la.

english_text:
The Lord Works Miracles
1Sing a new song to the Lord!
He has worked miracles,
and with his own powerful arm,
he has won the victory.
2The Lord has shown the nations
that he has the power to save
and to bring justice.
3God has been faithful
in his love for Israel,
and his saving power is seen
everywhere on earth.
4Tell everyone on this earth
to sing happy songs
in praise of the Lord.
5Make music for him on harps.
Play beautiful melodies!
6Sound the trumpets and horns
and celebrate with joyful songs
for our Lord and King!
7Command the ocean to roar
with all its creatures,
and the earth to shout
with all its people.
8Order the rivers
to clap their hands,
and all the hills
to sing together.
9Let them worship the Lord!
He is coming to judge
everyone on the earth,
and he will be honest
and fair.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizii durnya koori
Koori Deevid yir
1Ií yir yirfalii tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi,
u ɛɛ wizenaare werge maa!
Kɔraawiizi himmaa fɔŋŋa ani u kpegzi biini,
u kpegli u dɔmaa.
2Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ ba zum u nɛra lɛɛi wia,
di pilli u wideŋlaa wia
bagli hɛssi hina.
3U liizi u nɔŋŋaa
ani u wibii dɔɔi wiarɛ
Izrɛl hina be.
Hɛssi hina maa na Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la
nɛra lɛɛi wiarɛ.
4Hɛri naa hina maa, ií ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi,
ií ra yir yira ni bɔpuraa, di ra sa.
5Ií yir yira, di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi,
ií lɔ kem di ra yir yira.
6Ií huuh bensunozi, di ra chaasi ani bɔsɔna,
di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la
n ɛɛ koori la.
7Muuzeŋ ani kunnyinee la maa n du i biini,
ií ra kɔɔ werge,
hɛri hina ani kuna la
maa n du u ni la,
ií ra yir yira.
8Muuni, ií ra lɔ kpaa,
bizenaa, ií ge ra yir yira guŋ
ani bɔsɔna,
9gil a ra yir yira Kɔraawiizi see,
dikuubɛɛwiai, u ra bau
ú wa di hɛri seriya.
U daŋ wa di durnya nɛra seriya ni wibii
gunla n dɛkkɛ.

english_text:
Our Lord Is King
1 Our Lord, you are King!
You rule from your throne
above the winged creatures,
as people tremble
and the earth shakes.
2You are praised in Zion,
and you control all nations.
3Only you are God!
And your power alone,
so great and fearsome,
is worthy of praise.
4You are our mighty King,
a lover of fairness,
who sees that justice is done
everywhere in Israel.
5Our Lord and our God,
we praise you
and kneel down to worship you,
the God of holiness!
6Moses and Aaron were two
of your priests.
Samuel was also one of those
who prayed in your name,
and you, our Lord,
answered their prayers.
7 You spoke to them
from a thick cloud,
and they obeyed your laws.
8Our Lord and our God,
you answered their prayers
and forgave their sins,
but when they did wrong,
you punished them.
9We praise you, Lord God,
and we worship you
at your sacred mountain.
Only you are God!
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizii Koora Maa Koori
1Kɔraawiizii koori,
gil nɛra maa bɔra ra sa.
U sogo u koorikara ninɛɛ chɛrubzi baambaaŋ,
di gil hɛri ra zigli.
2Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa kannɔɔ Bolzeŋ Ziɔn biini,
waabuu kaali durnya
hɛssi hina maa.
3Nɛr maa danna dargi u sɔnzeŋ la n dɔɔ girme la.
U ɛɛ naniinaniirɛ!
4U ɛɛ Koorizenne, di nɔŋŋi wideŋlaa.
U gillɔɔ wibii dii du Izrɛl,
di gil wideŋlaa ani gunla
n dɛg ɛɛi du de.
5Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la,
ií ra jaamuu,
u koorikara la see!
U ɛɛ naniinaniirɛ!
6Moosis ni Aarɔn faa ɛɛ u kizeehinaa,
Samuɛl faa ɛɛ nɛr la bɛl
n suŋŋi Kɔraawiizii,
ba faa yir Kɔraawiizii,
u nuu tɛɛ baa.
7Kɔraawiizi faa ŋɔ wiarɛ tɛɛ baa lii baama n du miriti di la chiŋ biini.
Ba faa ra hiŋ u Gbɔgni
ani u widaulaa la
uŋ tɛɛ baa labuu.
8Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum,
i nuu i nɛra wiisuŋŋaarɛ.
I bagli gunla hiŋ gil nɛra wichɔgaarɛ ra tɛɛ baabuu,
haali hiŋ ɔɔ ra tɛr ba digna,
dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia gba.
9Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la,
di ra jaamuu
u bizennaniinanii la nyuu.
Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la
ɛɛ naniinaniirɛ.

english_text:
(A psalm of praise.)
The Lord Is God
1Shout praises to the Lord,
everyone on this earth.
2Be joyful and sing
as you come in
to worship the Lord!
3You know the Lord is God!
He created us,
and we belong to him;
we are his people,
the sheep in his pasture.
4Be thankful and praise the Lord
as you enter his temple.
5 The Lord is good!
His love and faithfulness
will last forever.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi chɔlaa yir
1Durnya hina maa, ií yir yira ni bɔsɔna,
di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi!
2Ií ra jaami Kɔraawiizi ni bɔsɔna,
ií ɔɔ ba u be
di waa yir bɔsɔna yira!
3Ií zum lugɔ waabuu Kɔraawiizi.
Waabuu ta yaa,
yaa ɛɛ u hora,
yaa ɛɛ u nɛraa,
di ɛɛ lugɔ u peeza.
4Ií ɔɔ ga Kɔraawiizi Dia dominuuzi
di zuu ra jaamuu,
di zuu u biini di ra chɔluu,
ií ra tɛu jaaŋ
di ra darguu.
5Kɔraawiizi wia wessoo, u nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ,
u wibii dɔɔi ge du de,
di hanna la
saŋaa saŋa maa.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
A King and His Promises
1I will sing to you, Lord!
I will celebrate your kindness
and your justice.
2Please help me learn
to do the right thing,
and I will be honest and fair
in my own kingdom.
3I refuse to be corrupt
or to take part
in anything crooked,
4and I won't be dishonest
or deceitful.
5Anyone who spreads gossip
will be silenced;
no one who is conceited
will be my friend.
6I will find trustworthy people
to serve as my advisors;
only an honest person
will serve as an official.
7No one who cheats or lies
will have a position
in my royal court.
8Each morning I will silence
any lawbreakers I find
in the countryside
or in the city of the Lord.
translation_text:
Koori nuuŋɔɔlii wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n daŋ yir yir di ra bagli i nɔŋŋaa ni i wibii dii wia,
di yir di ra chɔlii.
2N danna du tau, n gilɛɛ waa dɔɔ chɔgri,
saŋa bɛɛ i ba n benei?
N daŋ dɔɔ biinihuŋŋu n dia biini,
3n ŋmɛnɛ maa
wàá sɛɛ wichɔgaa wia.
N hah banla n waa hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi
ŋmɛnɛɛ ra hiŋ wiɛɛlaarɛ,
n ni baa wàá kpau
wiimaa biini.
4N wia daŋ dɔɔ wibii,
màá ra nyiŋŋi
wichɔgaa wia.
5N daŋ duŋŋi nɛr la maa n suahzɛɛ,
ra chɔg u dɔŋhiŋ sɔŋ
n be.
Màá sɛɛ nɛr la maa
n na jigsi di kpoŋ wia.
6N daŋ nɔŋŋi Izrɛl hina la wia
n dɔɔ wibii hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi be,
di gil ba du n kooridia.
Banla wia n dɔɔ wibii nɛnnɛ,
daŋ ɛɛ n huŋhunna.
7Karkanni maa, wàá du n dia,
nɛfugzi maa ge
wàá ka du n be.
8Hɔpizii maanii ń na kpu
biinikpola hina, a hɛri biini.
Di ra kpu wichɔgɛɛra,
i bolzeŋ la biini.

english_text:
(A prayer for someone who hurts and needs to ask the Lord for help.)
A Prayer in Time of Trouble
1I pray to you, Lord!
Please listen.
2Don't hide from me
in my time of trouble.
Pay attention to my prayer
and quickly give an answer.
3My days disappear like smoke,
and my bones are burning
as though in a furnace.
4I am wasting away like grass,
and my appetite is gone.
5My groaning never stops,
and my bones can be seen
through my skin.
6I am like a lonely owl
in the desert
7or a restless sparrow
alone on a roof.
8My enemies insult me all day,
and they use my name
for a curse word.
9Instead of food,
I have ashes to eat
and tears to drink,
10because you are furious
and have thrown me aside.
11My life fades like a shadow
at the end of day
and withers like grass.
12Our Lord, you are King forever
and will always be famous.
13You will show pity to Zion
because the time has come.
14We, your servants,
love each stone in the city,
and we are sad to see them
lying in the dirt.
15Our Lord, the nations
will honor you,
and all kings on earth
will praise your glory.
16You will rebuild
the city of Zion.
Your glory will be seen,
17and the prayers of the homeless
will be answered.
18Future generations must also
praise the Lord,
so write this for them:
19“From his holy temple,
the Lord looked down
at the earth.
20He listened to the groans
of prisoners,
and he rescued everyone
who was doomed to die.”
21All Jerusalem should praise
you, our Lord,
22when people from every nation
meet to worship you.
23I should still be strong,
but you, Lord, have made
an old person of me.
24You will live forever!
Years mean nothing to you.
Don't cut my life in half!
25 In the beginning, Lord,
you laid the earth's foundation
and created the heavens.
26They will all disappear
and wear out like clothes.
You change them,
as you would a coat,
but you last forever.
27You are always the same.
You are God for all time.
28Every generation of those
who serve you
will live in your presence.
translation_text:
Biipɔllii biinichɔg wiisuŋŋaa wia
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a nuu n wiisuŋŋaa,
di ra nuu miŋ lɔ wile
ŋɔ i hiiniŋ!
2Di n wa du tɔɔrɔɔ biini,
gilɛɛ wa bir har
di ra kpuŋ!
Keŋŋi digna di ra nuu,
di n wa yirii,
nuu n be manaŋ!
3N miibɔɔ ra tunuu manaŋ
alugɔ nyɔɔzi n na kaali,
n bɔra ra baari
alugɔ niŋ n na fuuhŋ.
4N cholloo di chɔɔ alugɔ kooriihilaa,
diwee gba
waa kaa ra kɛlliŋ.
5Dikuu n uuraa werge wia,
n kɔkkɔɔ di jaa ka hoga
ani hɔŋ bɛŋ.
6N ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ hɛribɔduma kikiu,
di ɛɛ lugɔ kikiu
n du diŋgela.
7N chɔɔwɔɔ di ra nyiŋ,
di ɛɛ lugɔ zumbikpaŋ
n togni sal.
8Hɔpizaa maanii n dɔma ra chagziŋ,
banla n na ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ ge,
kpa n sɔŋ
di birgi nuuseerikuŋ.
9Hɔɔhrii jaa birgi n diwee,
n sinii ge koozi
n niinyɔɔlii ni,
10dikuu i baaŋfuuih werge la wia,
i lallimbuu
di kpaŋ ta kɛrii.
11N miibɔɔ ra tunuu manaŋ,
alugɔ wiicholii laalii
n na kaali la,
n na yɔl ge alugɔ kooree.
12Ka hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ koorii saŋa maa,
i sɔŋ du jiminizi
maa biine.
13I daŋ izi di wa suŋ Bolzeŋ Ziɔn hina ni,
ba sinyɛna nai
saŋa helloo,
saŋa la hiŋ
dauwɛ la helloo.
14I balaa nɔŋŋi a bolzenne,
haali uŋ chɔkkɛ la gba,
ba ra suŋ u ninɛɛ,
haali uŋ puree la gba.
15A hɛssi maa hina danna ɔm hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi,
hɛri naa koorizenaa maa
ra tɔgzii.
16Saŋa la hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi n niŋ kaa bir ma Bolzeŋ Ziɔn la,
i daŋ bagli i zenni.
17I daŋ nuu dɔgnya hina wiisuŋŋaa,
hàá vɛɛ baa ta.
18A dɛkkɔɔ jimini maa hina
ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi,
awia, ií sɛbi u wiɛɛlaa
dau tɛɛ baa.
19“Kɔraawiizi du u duuribɔr labuu ka liŋŋi hɛri,
u du chinne
ka binni hɛri,
20ú nuu banla baŋ tɔ dia uuraa,
di lɛɛ banla baŋ di
ba seriya, ba chol,
ba ŋɔ ba kpu baa la.”
21Awia, ba danna yir Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ Bolzeŋ Ziɔn biini,
di ra chɔluu de,
22saŋa la a hɛssi hina
ni kossi maa n niŋ chaali,
di ra chɔluu la.
23Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ n gɛrgi, di n haa waa zɛŋŋɛ,
di gil n miibɔɔ ɛɛ kpurii.
24Awia, n ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
gilɛɛ waa teŋ n miibɔɔ,
di n haa waa zɛŋŋɛ.
N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i du denii,
saŋaa saŋa maa.
25A lugli la maanii i chiŋŋi hɛri zɛɛ,
chiŋ gba ɛɛ i nonee humaa.
26A chiŋ ni hɛri daŋ ŋmɛnɛ chɔgi,
ka hiŋwaa du denii di ra la.
A daŋ siuzi alugɔ wɛjɛ n ɔɔ siu la,
í chɛraa alugɔ laala,
di kpaa ta.
27Ka hiŋwaa daŋ ɔɔ du gunla hiŋ faa duwɛɛ la,
i binni wàá dɔɔ maga.
28Yaa biizi daŋ du ni bɔsɔna,
i guu ba naanna,
bá chi nɛnnɛ.”

english_text:
(By David.)
The Lord's Wonderful Love
1With all my heart
I praise the Lord,
and with all that I am
I praise his holy name!
2With all my heart
I praise the Lord!
I will never forget
how kind he has been.
3The Lord forgives our sins,
heals us when we are sick,
4and protects us from death.
His kindness and love
are a crown on our heads.
5Each day that we live,
he provides for our needs
and gives us the strength
of a young eagle.
6For all who are mistreated,
