the Lord brings justice.
7He taught his Law to Moses
and showed all Israel
what he could do.
8 The Lord is merciful!
He is kind and patient,
and his love never fails.
9The Lord won't always be angry
and point out our sins;
10he doesn't punish us
as our sins deserve.
11How great is God's love for all
who worship him?
Greater than the distance
between heaven and earth!
12How far has the Lord taken
our sins from us?
Farther than the distance
from east to west!
13Just as parents are kind
to their children,
the Lord is kind
to all who worship him,
14because he knows
we are made of dust.
15We humans are like grass
or wild flowers
that quickly bloom.
16But a scorching wind blows,
and they quickly wither
to be forever forgotten.
17The Lord is always kind
to those who worship him,
and he keeps his promises
to their descendants
18who faithfully obey him.
19God has set up his kingdom
in heaven, and he rules
the whole creation.
20All of you mighty angels,
who obey God's commands,
come and praise your Lord!
21All of you thousands
who serve and obey God,
come and praise your Lord!
22All of God's creation
and all that he rules,
come and praise your Lord!
With all my heart
I praise the Lord!
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi nɔŋŋaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N na chɔli Kɔraawiizii!
N kpa n biini maanii
di ra dargi u sɔnnanii la!
2N na chɔli Kɔraawiizii,
màá suuh
u winanaa la maa wia.
3U ɔɔ gil n wichɔgaa maanii ra tɛŋ,
di chaa n wiila ge maa.
4U lɛɛmbuu lii ŋmam biini,
di tɛŋ nɛnɔŋŋaa
ni sisɔna.
5U ra tɛmbuu kunnanaa n de dui saŋa,
guŋ gil n ɛɛ biipɔllii,
di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa alugɔ chig.
6Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ di seriyaa,
di kpa wibii ra tɛɛ
banla banna sunni.
7U kpa u ŋmɛnizii di bagli Moosis,
di gil Izrɛl hina
na u wiɛɛlaa.
8Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ nɛsunaa ni sinyɛnaa werge.
U baaŋ waa
fuuh manaŋ,
u nɔŋŋaa ge waa tuŋ.
9Waa ɔɔ ra hau nɛra ni di hanna la,
u baaŋ ge waa fuuhwe
di hanna la.
10Waa yaa digna ra tɛrgi di mag gunla n dɛg yaa,
gɛɛ di ra turgi yaa,
yaa wichɔgaa kim
gunla n dɛkkɛ.
11Gunla chiŋ ni hɛri n nɛɛwɛ dɔŋa ni la,
gunnɛ Kɔraawiizi
nɔŋŋaa la n waa
tunaa dɔɔwɛ la du kaŋ,
banla n na ɔmuu la be.
12Gunla wiifurii ani wiicholii n nɛɛwɛ dɔŋa ni la,
gunnɛ ɔɔ lizi
yaa wichɔgaa,
a wàá ka dugli yaa la.
13Gunla bie mɛɛ n ɔɔ ra suŋ u ni la,
gunnɛ Kɔraawiizi
ɔɔ ra suŋ banla maa
n na ɔmuu ni.
14U zum kunla uŋ kpawɛɛ kuari yaabuu,
u ra liizuu lugɔ
yaa ɛɛ hɛɛhraarɛ.
15Newee ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ kooree.
U wessi maa ɛɛ alugɔ
kooree nyuuni,
16di peu wa ta a ni, a yɔl di siu,
a nyuuni chogli,
nɛr maa wàá ka naa.
17Ka Kɔraawiizi nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la waa,
du denii di hanna la
saŋaa saŋa maa,
di tɛɛ banla
n na ɔmuu la.
U wideŋlaa ge du denii
tɛɛ jiminizi maa,
18di tɛɛ banla n na hiŋ u nuukpaŋ la,
ani banla maa n na sɛɛ
u nuuzi la, ni wibii.
19Kɔraawiizi di koraa chiŋ,
di ra di kora kummaa ni.
20Kɔraawiizi mɛlikazi, ií ra chɔluu,
iabuu fɔŋŋazeŋ hina la
n na humuu,
di ra hiŋ u wiŋɔzi la.
21Ii banla maa n du chiŋ, ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi,
ii banla n ɛɛ u balaa
di ra ɛɛ u kipar la.
22Kuna la maa Kɔraawiizi n tawɛɛ,
a du bɔr la maa
uŋ di kora,
ií ra chɔluu.
N danna chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

english_text:
The Lord Takes Care of His Creation
1I praise you, Lord God,
with all my heart.
You are glorious and majestic,
dressed in royal robes
2and surrounded by light.
You spread out the sky
like a tent,
3and you built your home
over the mighty ocean.
The clouds are your chariot
with the wind as its wings.
4 The winds are your messengers,
and flames of fire
are your servants.
5You built foundations
for the earth, and it
will never be shaken.
6You covered the earth
with the ocean that rose
above the mountains.
7Then your voice thundered!
And the water flowed
8down the mountains
and through the valleys
to the place you prepared.
9Now you have set boundaries,
so that the water will never
flood the earth again.
10You provide streams of water
in the hills and valleys,
11so that the donkeys
and other wild animals
can satisfy their thirst.
12Birds build their nests nearby
and sing in the trees.
13From your home above
you send rain on the hills
and water the earth.
14You let the earth produce
grass for cattle,
plants for our food,
15wine to cheer us up,
olive oil for our skin,
and grain for our health.
16Our Lord, your trees
always have water,
and so do the cedars
you planted in Lebanon.
17Birds nest in those trees,
and storks make their home
in the fir trees.
18Wild goats find a home
in the tall mountains,
and small animals can hide
between the rocks.
19You created the moon
to tell us the seasons.
The sun knows when to set,
20and you made the darkness,
so the animals in the forest
could come out at night.
21Lions roar as they hunt
for the food you provide.
22But when morning comes,
they return to their dens,
23then we go out to work
until the end of day.
24Our Lord, by your wisdom
you made so many things;
the whole earth is covered
with your living creatures.
25But what about the ocean
so big and wide?
It is alive with creatures,
large and small.
26 And there are the ships,
as well as Leviathan,
the monster you created
to splash in the sea.
27All of these depend on you
to provide them with food,
28and you feed each one
with your own hand,
until they are full.
29But when you turn away,
they are terrified;
when you end their life,
they die and rot.
30You created all of them
by your Spirit,
and you give new life
to the earth.
31Our Lord, we pray
that your glory
will last forever
and that you will be pleased
with what you have done.
32You look at the earth,
and it trembles.
You touch the mountains,
and smoke goes up.
33As long as I live,
I will sing and praise you,
the Lord God.
34I hope my thoughts
will please you,
because you are the one
who makes me glad.
35Destroy all wicked sinners
from the earth
once and for all.
With all my heart
I praise you, Lord!
I praise you!
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi la n ta kummaa chɔlaa yir
1N na chɔli Kɔraawiizii!
N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
i zenni kannɔɔ werge.
I dɔɔ girme ani zennii
alugɔ koorizeŋ,
2i kpa bɔchaannɛ tɔ i hiŋ alugɔ wɛjɛ,
di yaa chiŋ alugɔ tanti dia,
3di ma i bol
u bɛri chiŋ ni.
I gillɔɔ baamazi ɛɛ alugɔ i torko,
peu kpai ra kaali.
4I gillɔɔ i mɛlikazi ɛɛ lugɔ,
peu ni ninlau.
5I gillɔɔ hɛri chi u zɛɛ ni chigigi,
u ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá wer ziigi.
6I kpa muuzenne tɔ u ni lugɔ tagtajaŋ,
niiri ge tɔɔgi bizenaa ni.
7Di i wa hau a niiri ni, a maanii ɔɔ yaari,
di a wa nuu i pozaa ge,
a ɔɔ chɔu ra kaali.
8A pallɔɔ lii a bizenaa nyuuni,
di tuu walli, bɔra la
hiŋ kuarɛɛ tɛɛa la.
9I dau magaa tɛɛa, a wàá wer gilluu,
di kaa wa tɔ hɛri maa ni.
10I gillɔɔ bulli pogzi a faalime biine,
di ra pal
a giŋgimee baambaana.
11Aabuu ra tɛɛ pir sela maa niinyɔɔlii,
di ra kpu
pir kauzi niinyɔgzi.
12A kɛraa daazi nyuunii zumbizi ra du a daŋa,
di togni a kela ni
ra wii.
13I ɔɔ giluu dooŋ nɛɛ a giŋgimee nyuuni,
di gil hɛri du sum.
14I gillɔɔ kooree fur tɛɛ nauna,
di tɛɛ newee ge pattikuna,
u ɔɔ par di ra na diwee,
15siŋ, a ra tɛu bɔsɔna,
ɔlivi nuu, a ra kuari u siwee
ani diwee,
a ra tɛu fɔŋŋa.
16Lɛbanɔn hɛriŋkpol daazi la
Kɔraawiizi himmaa n duuwe
a ɛɛ u hora la,
na doniirɛ nɛnnɛ.
17A ninɛɛ zumbizi du a daŋa,
niilaaraazi ge du a daŋa
daananaa nyuuni.
18A bizenaa nyuunii sejigzi du,
kachazi ge ra zuu
a bia bɔɔni.
19Hinuu kuari baagu, u ra bagli saŋazi,
wiizi ge zum saŋa la unna chol.
20Hinuu kuari hamuŋa, bɔr ɔɔ biri,
kɔr biini sechɔgaa maa
ɔɔ lii di ra di.
21Bunyinzi ɔɔ ra wiiu,
di ra nyiŋŋi kunla
an niŋ lau,
di ra nyiŋŋi
a diwee
hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi be.
22Di wiizi wa futtɔ,
a ɔɔ biruu la
a chɔɔribɔra,
di ga chɔɔgi.
23Denii newea ɔɔ jaa la ba huma bɔra,
di ga hum guŋŋ
bɔr wa duani.
24N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
i ta kuŋkpilaa
werge maa!
Nunzumaa i kpa di ta a maa!
I kuntaalaa su
hɛri naa maanii.
25Muuzeŋ du denii di du kaŋ,
di du war werge maa,
kunnyinee kpila maa du u biini,
a zenaa ni a jigzi
maanii du de.
26Muugberzenaa ra vol u ninɛɛ,
muuzeŋ sechɔgii la ge
hiŋ tawɛɛ la,
du u biini di ra dua.
27Annii maanii dɛlli i ni,
i ra tɛɛa diwee
saŋa la anna nyiŋŋaa.
28Di hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi wa tɛɛa diwee,
a ɔɔ chaalaabuu,
di i wa pilli i nonii tɛɛa,
a ɔɔ piŋuu nɛnnɛ.
29Di i wa bir i har kpua,
ɔnsii werge ɔɔ lawaabuu.
Di i wa lɛɛ a heeza lii a be,
a ɔɔ siuzuu di birgi hɛɛhraa.
30Ka di i wa tɛɛa heeza,
a falaa ɔɔ liiu du de,
di gil hɛri naa birgi ufalii.
31Kɔ́raawiizi girme du de,
di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa.
Ú bɔra sɔɔni,
dikuu u kuntaalaa wia.
32U ɔɔ binni hɛrii, u zigli,
di u wa gbɔgzi
bizenaa ge,
a ra lii nyɔɔzi.
33N daŋ yir yira ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi,
ń de dui biini maa,
di yir yira di ra chɔli
Kɔraawiizi la
minna hum.
34Gil gunla minna lɔ u wiŋɔzi fasani la paruu,
dikuubɛɛwiai, u benii
n dɔɔ bɔsɔna.
35Gil ba chɔgi wichɔgɛɛra maa,
durnya naa biini,
di gil biinikpola hina
ge dim kɔrai.
N na chɔli Kɔraawiizii!
Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

english_text:
The Lord Can Be Trusted
1 Praise the Lord
and pray in his name!
Tell everyone
what he has done.
2Sing praises to the Lord!
Tell about his miracles.
3Celebrate and worship
his holy name
with all your heart.
4Trust the Lord
and his mighty power.
5Remember his miracles
and all his wonders
and his fair decisions.
6You belong to the family
of Abraham, his servant;
you are his chosen ones,
the descendants of Jacob.
7The Lord is our God,
bringing justice
everywhere on earth.
8He will never forget
his agreement or his promises,
not in thousands of years.
* 9 God made an eternal promise
10 to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob,
11when he said, “I'll give you
the land of Canaan.”
12At the time there were
only a few of us,
and we were homeless.
13We wandered from nation
to nation, from one country
to another.
14 God did not let anyone
mistreat our people.
Instead he protected us
by punishing rulers
15and telling them,
“Don't touch my chosen leaders
or harm my prophets!”
16 God kept crops from growing
until food was scarce
everywhere in the land.
17 But he had already sent Joseph,
sold as a slave into Egypt,
18 with chains of iron
around his legs and neck.
19Joseph remained a slave
until his own words
had come true,
and the Lord had finished
testing him.
20 Then the king of Egypt
set Joseph free
21 and put him in charge
of everything he owned.
22Joseph was in command
of the officials,
and he taught the leaders
how to use wisdom.
23 Jacob and his family
came and settled in Egypt
as foreigners.
24 They were the Lord's people,
so he let them grow stronger
than their enemies.
25They served the Lord,
and he made the Egyptians plan
hateful things against them.
26 God sent his servant Moses.
He also chose and sent Aaron
27to his people in Egypt,
and they worked miracles
and wonders there.
28 Moses and Aaron obeyed God,
and he sent darkness
to cover Egypt.
29 God turned their rivers
into streams of blood,
and the fish all died.
30 Frogs were everywhere,
even in the royal palace.
31 When God gave the command,
flies and gnats
swarmed all around.
32 In place of rain,
God sent hailstones
and flashes of lightning.
33He destroyed their grapevines
and their fig trees,
and he made splinters
of all the other trees.
34 God gave the command,
and more grasshoppers came
than could be counted.
35They ate every green plant
and all the crops that grew
in the land of Egypt.
36 Then God took the life
of every first-born son.
37 When God led Israel from Egypt,
they took silver and gold,
and no one was left behind.
38The Egyptians were afraid
and gladly let them go.
39 God hid them under a cloud
and guided them by fire
during the night.
40 When they asked for food,
he sent more birds
than they could eat.
41 God even split open a rock,
and streams of water
gushed into the desert.
42God never forgot
his sacred promise
to his servant Abraham.
43When the Lord rescued
his chosen people from Egypt,
they celebrated with songs.
44 The Lord gave them the land
and everything else
the nations had worked for.
45He did this so that his people
would obey all his laws.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi ni u nɛra wia
1Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi, di ra sii u zenni wia.
Ií gil hɛssi maa hina
zum u wiɛɛlaa wia.
2Ií yir yira di ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi,
di ra bagli wizenaa la
uŋ ɛɛwɛ.
3Ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni dikuu yaa n ɛɛ u hora wia,
di gil banla maa
n na jaamuu la
bɔra ra pur.
4Ií dɛlli Kɔraawiizi ni u fɔŋŋazeŋ la,
di ra binni
u siwee saŋa maa.
5Ií ra liizi nuukpuuri wia la uŋ ɛɛwɛ.
Aabuu u wizenaa
ani seriyazi la
uŋ diwee wia.
6Kɔraawiizi balii Abraham naanna,
Jekɔb biibaala la uŋ lizɛɛ
tɛɛ u hiŋ la.
7Waabuu Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum,
u widaulaa ɛɛ
durnya maa horaa.
8U ra liizi u ni newea nuukpaŋ dɔɔi la wiarɛ saŋa maa.
U ŋɔ nuarɛ tɛɛ
jiminizi kagboŋa nɛra.
9Nuukpaŋ naabuu u ni Abraham faa ɛɛ la,
nua la uŋ faa ŋɔwɛɛ
tɛɛ Aizik la.
10Kɔraawiizi ni Jekɔb ɛɛ nuukpannɛ,
nuukpaŋ la n niŋ du de
di hanna la.
11U ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N daŋ kpa Keenan hɛri tɛi,
ú ɛɛ i kapɛttɛ.”
12Kɔraawiizi nɛra n faa haa waa kpil,
di ɛɛ hɔɔhra du
Keenan hɛri la,
13ba faa ra juuruu, di ɔɔ lii hɛri naa di ga lii unnii,
di lii kora naa di ga zuu
bɛl biini.
14Ka Kɔraawiizi faa waa gillɛ nɛr maa sunni baa.
Uŋ faa ra nyiŋŋi
u guu baa la wia,
u hau koora ninɛɛ,
15di ŋɔ, “Ií gilɛɛ waa gbɔgzi banla miŋ lizɛɛ tɛɛ n hiŋ la,
di gilɛɛ waa du
n dɔgtɛɛ maa pira.”
16Kɔraawiizi faa gillɔɔ lɔchɔgii chol ba hɛri,
di chɔg ba diwee maa.
17Ka u faa gillɔɔ baal bɛl tɔ ba see,
u sɔnnɛ faa Joosɛf,
ba faa yooubuu,
u birgi yom.
18Ba faa kpa yɔlɔzii du u naazi,
ni u baŋaa,
19guŋŋ wii la Joosɛf n ŋɔwɛɛ la wa ɛɛ wibii.
Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii la ge
wa gil u wia dɔɔ wibii.
20Ijip koori la n faa ɛɛ hɛssi maa koori la
faa gillɔɔ ba pilluu,
u dɔɔ u hiŋ.
21U faa gillɔɔ u ɛɛ u hɛri nabɔma,
di ra binni
u kundɔɔlaa maa ni.
22U ra di nabɔmuu u nabɔnzi ni,
di ra bagli
u nabɔnzi nunzuma.
23Denii Jekɔb la Ijip hɛri,
di faa ga so de,
di ɛɛ hɔɔhri.
24Kɔraawiizi faa gil u nɛra wazi,
di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa
kaali ba dɔma.
25U faa gillɔɔ Ijip hina hah u nɛra,
di faa ra sunni baa.
26Denii u faa hum u balii Moosis
ni Aarɔn la
uŋ faa lizɛɛ la.
27Ba faa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi wizenaare,
di ɛɛ nuukpuuri wia gba,
Ijip hɛri.
28Kɔraawiizi faa gillɔɔ bɔbiri werge
limpiriŋ chol a hɛri,
ka a Ijip hina
faa vɛɛ u nua hiŋaa.
29U faa gillɔɔ ba niiri birgi chal,
a biine nyinni maa siu.
30Ba hɛri maanii faa su sampussi,
haali a faa su
ba kooridia gba.
31U faa ŋɔ wiarɛ,
a hɛri maa su
nakɛɛhzi ni kundunzaa.
32Di gil dooŋ birgi dobia,
dooŋ na nyɛgzi,
di ra pogzi, ba hɛri maa.
33U faa chɔgi ba grepu ni fig daazi kooni,
di kuugi ba hɛri
daazi maa.
34U faa gillɔɔ lotorozi ba,
a waa maga dɔɔwɛ,
35di wa di ba hɛri kunlɛɛri ni
ba pattikuna maa.
36U faa kpuuzi Ijip hina
dia maa biibambiluglii.
37Denii Kɔraawiizi jaa tɔ Izrɛl hina see,
ba lii Ijip hɛri,
di chi ba
saliŋhuŋŋa ni saliŋ,
ba maa faa dɔɔ
alaanfia ani fɔŋŋa.
38A Ijip hina faa jaa ra ɔm baabuu,
baŋ liwɛɛ la,
ba bɔra jaa sɔɔni.
39Kɔraawiizi faa gillɔɔ
baama tɔ u nɛra ni
hɔpizaa saŋa,
di gil niŋ ge
ra chaani baa
hamuŋa ni.
40Ba faa suŋŋuubuu diwee,
u faa tɛɛ baabuu
zaahra ba hee,
di tɛɛ baa diwee ge
lii chiŋ, ba di piŋ.
41U faa gillɔɔ bii peri, nii pozi di ra lii,
di ra pal
a hɛribɔduma biini
alugɔ muu.
42Dikuu uŋ faa ra liizi nuuŋɔɔlinaniinanii la,
uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ
u balii Abraham la wia.
43Gunnɛ a faa du, u tɔ u nɛra la uŋ lizɛɛ tɛɛ u hiŋ la see lii Ijip,
ba ra yir yira
di ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna.
44U faa kpa nɛdumazi hɛrii tɛɛ baa,
ba kooni birgi
ba kundɔɔlaa,
45guŋ wer gil á nɛra ra hiŋ u baglaazi,
di ra hiŋ u Gbɔgni.
Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

english_text:
A Nation Asks for Forgiveness
1 We will celebrate
and praise you, Lord!
You are good to us,
and your love never fails.
2No one can praise you enough
for all the mighty things
you have done.
3You bless those people
who are honest and fair
in everything they do.
4Remember me, Lord,
when you show kindness
by saving your people.
5Let me prosper with the rest
of your chosen ones,
as they celebrate with pride
because they belong to you.
6We and our ancestors
have sinned terribly.
7 When they were in Egypt,
they paid no attention
to your marvelous deeds
or your wonderful love.
And they turned against you
at the Red Sea.
8But you were true to your name,
and you rescued them to prove
how mighty you are.
9 You said to the Red Sea,
“Dry up!”
Then you led your people across
on land as dry as a desert.
10You saved all of them
11and drowned every one
of their enemies.
12 Then your people trusted you
and sang your praises.
13But they soon forgot
what you had done
and rejected your advice.
14 They became greedy for food
and tested you there
in the desert.
15So you gave them
what they wanted,
but later you destroyed them
with a horrible disease.
16 Everyone in camp was jealous
of Moses and of Aaron,
your chosen priest.
17Dathan and Abiram rebelled,
and the earth opened up
and swallowed them.
18Then fire broke out
and destroyed all
of their followers.
19 At Horeb your people
made and worshiped the statue
20of a bull, instead of you,
their glorious God.
21You worked powerful miracles
to save them from Egypt,
but they forgot about you
22and the fearsome things
you did at the Red Sea.
23You were angry and started
to destroy them,
but Moses, your chosen leader,
begged you not to do it.
24 They would not trust
you, Lord,
and they did not like
the promised land.
25They would not obey you,
and they grumbled
in their tents.
26So you threatened them
by saying, “I'll kill you
out here in the desert!
27 I'll scatter your children
everywhere in the world.”
28 Your people became followers
of a god named Baal Peor,
and they ate sacrifices
offered to the dead.
29They did such terrible things
that you punished them
with a deadly disease.
30But Phinehas helped them,
and the sickness stopped.
31Now he will always
be highly honored.
32 At Meribah Spring
they turned against you
and made you furious.
33Then Moses got into trouble
for speaking in anger.
34 Our Lord, they disobeyed you
by refusing to destroy
the nations.
35Instead they were friendly
with those foreigners
and followed their customs.
36Then they fell into the trap
of worshiping idols.
37 They sacrificed their sons
and their daughters to demons
38 and to the gods of Canaan.
Then they poured out the blood
of these innocent children
and made the land filthy.
39By doing such gruesome things,
they also became filthy.
40 Finally, Lord, you were angry
and terribly disgusted
with your people.
41So you put them in the power
of nations that hated them.
42They were mistreated and abused
by their enemies,
43but you saved them
time after time.
They were determined to rebel,
and their sins caused
their downfall.
44You answered their prayers
when they were in trouble.
45You kept your agreement
and were so merciful
46that their enemies
had pity on them.
47 Save us, Lord God!
Bring us back
from among the nations.
Let us celebrate and shout
in praise of your holy name.
48 Lord God of Israel,
you deserve to be praised
forever and ever.
Let everyone say, “Amen!
Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi wessoo tɛɛ u nɛra
1Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!
Ií ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, u wia wessoo.
U nɔŋŋaa
waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
2Anɛɛ n niŋ wer bagli Kɔraawiizi hunzenaa la wia,
gɛɛ di wer chɔluu
gunla n dɛkkɛnɛi?
3Banla n na hiŋ u baglaa,
di ra ɛɛ wideŋlaa
saŋa maa, nuu sumaa.
4N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a liizi n wia, di i waa suŋ i nɛra ni,
di hiiniŋ,
di i waa lɛɛ baa.
5Gil n na i nɛra nyɛɛlaa,
ń bɔra sɔɔni
dikuu i hɛri wia.
N ni banla n ɛɛ i hora,
bɔra sɔɔni, ya ra jigsi.
6Yaa ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ lugɔ yaa naabaala.
Yaa dɔɔ biinikpolaa
di ɛɛ nɛchɔgaa.
7Saŋa la yaa naabaala n faa du Ijip la,
ba faa waa
nuukpuuri wia la
hiŋ ɛɛwɛ la zɛɛ zummɛ,
ba faa waa i nɔŋŋŋaa la hiŋ bagli baa
saŋakpila maa la
wia ra liizi,
ka dɔɔ dignikpega,
Muuzeŋaahmu la kɛrii.
8Ka i faa lɛɛ baabuu, dikuu hiŋ ŋɔ nua di tɛɛ baa la wia,
í bagli i fɔŋŋazeŋ la
hiŋ dɔɔwɛ la wia.
9I faa hau a Muuzeŋaahmu ninɛɛ, u hil kakpaŋ,
i tɔ ba see
di ga hɛrhilii gi.
10I faa lɛɛ baabuu lii banla n hah baa,
di ɛɛ ba dɔma la be.
11Ka a nii faa di ba dɔma la waa maa,
kpaŋkpaŋ maa
faa waa kawɛɛ.
12Denii i nɛra hiŋ faa jaa yardi i nuuŋɔɔlaa la,
di yir yira di ra chɔlii.
13A waa birgee, ka ba faa suuh i wiɛɛlaa la,
ba waa kaa ra nuu
i baglaa.
14Awia, ba faa dɔɔ kɛkɛluurɛ, di ɛɛ hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi na,
a hɛribɔduma biini,
15i faa tɛɛ baa kunla baŋ suŋŋɛɛ,
ka faa gil wiila la
n na kɔgi nɛr werge
chol ba ni.
16Ka a hɛribɔduma biini, a nɛra bɔra faa ra wii
Moosis ni Aarɔn la
baŋ faa sɔwɛɛ lizi ba doŋa,
ba ɛɛ nɛnanaananaa
tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la wiarɛ.
17Denii hɛri faa peri, di di Datan,
di kaa di Abiram ge
ni u harbɔɔhiŋra maa.
18Niŋ ge lii chiŋ, di wa chol ba harbɔɔhiŋra ni,
di fuuh a guŋ
biinikpola hina.
19Ba faa kpa saliŋ di kuari nabii, Bizeŋ Sinaai zɛɛ,
u ɛɛ ba vug
ba ra kuaruu.
20Ba faa kpa i girmee ra chɛr
vug n li nabalee
n na di kooree.
21Ba faa suuh hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ wizenaa,
di lɛɛ baa
Ijip hɛri la wiarɛ.
22I faa ɛɛ wizenaare a de!
Di ɛɛ ɔnsii werge wia
Muuzeŋaahmu la kɛrii.
23Guŋ wia, i faa ŋɔ lugɔ
i daŋ chɔgi baa.
Ka i balii Moosis la hiŋ faa lizɛɛ la izi chi,
di suŋŋii, i baaŋ sɔɔni,
haa kaa chɔgi baa.
24Denii ba faa vɛɛ hɛrnanii la ta,
dikuu baŋ waa
hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi
nuuŋɔɔlii la yardɛɛ wia.
25Ba faa du ba tanti diini biini di ra nuumi,
di faa vɛɛ
i nua hiŋaa.
26Awia, i faa hɛɛhzi di ŋɔ lugɔ,
i daŋ gil ba siu
a hɛribɔduma biini,
27di duŋŋi ba dee, ba yaari hɛrdumazi hina biine,
di siuzi hɛhjaŋa.
28Baŋ wa hel Bizeŋ Pɛɔ, ba ra kuari vug Baal la,
di ra di kuna la
baŋ kpawɛɛ lizi mbusu
ra tɛɛ vuga la
n waa miibɔɔ dɔɔwɛ.
29Ba wiɛɛlaa faa gillɔɔ hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi baaŋ fuuh,
awia, i faa gil
wiilchɔgaa chol ba ni.
30Denii Finɛhas faa izi tɛr a wichɔgɛɛra digna,
a wiilchɔgaa tuŋ.
31Guŋ gillɔɔ ba zum lugɔ u wia deŋloore,
di ra liizi u wia
jiminizi maa biine.
32Baŋ wa hel Mɛriba bulli la,
ba kaa fuuh
i baaŋ de,
Moosis faa di tɔɔrɔɔ
werge maa,
dikuu ba wia.
33Ba faa gillɔɔ Moosis baaŋ fuuh werge maa,
u ŋɔ wia di waa zummɛ.
34Ba faa waa a hɛssi la hina kpuwɛɛ
gunla hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi
n faa ŋɔ ba ɛɛ la,
35ka ba ni baa faa ra paa dɔŋa haana,
di ra ɛɛ
a nɛra naana wia.
36I nɛra faa ra kuari a hɛssi hina vuga,
a guŋ birgi lugɔ
sidɛɛzi tɛɛ baa.
37Ba faa lauri ba biibaala ni ba biihaanaa
di lizi mbusuzi ra tɛɛ
Keenan hina vuga.
38Ba faa kpu ba biizi n waa chɔgri maa dɔɔwɛɛ,
di lizi mbusu tɛɛ
Keenan hina vuga,
ba chal chɔgi a hɛri maa.
39Ba wiɛɛlaa faa gillɔɔ ba chɔgi bahinaa,
ba wia waa kaa dɔɔ wibii
tɛɛ hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi.
40Denii i baaŋ faa fuuh i nɛra ni,
i kii ba wia.
41I faa kpa baabuu du
a hɛssi la hina
n ɛɛ ba dɔma la
nonee biine,
ba dɔɔ ba fɔŋŋa,
di ra di kora ba ni.
42Ba dɔma faa ra fir baa werge maa,
ba birgi ba balaa di ra hum baa.
43Saŋa kpila maanii
i ɔɔ faa lɛɛ baa,
ka ba ra gbɛllii,
ba wichɔgaa gil ba ra siuzi.
44Ka i ɔɔ faa nuu ba wilee,
di na ba sinyɛna.
45I faa kuu ba wiarɛ liizi i ni baa nuukpaŋ la wia,
di na ba sinyɛna,
dikuu i nɔŋŋaa werge wia.
46I faa gillɔɔ banla maa n na sunni baa,
bir na ba sinyɛna.
47Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum, chaali yaa,
di lɛɛ yaa lii hɛssi hina nonee biine,
ya kaa waa jaamii,
di ra dargi
i sɔnnaniinanii la,
yaa bɔra sɔɔni
i chɔlaa biini.
48Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la
dɛg chɔlaarɛ!
Ií ra chɔluu filaŋkeŋ,
di ra chɔluu
saŋaa saŋa maa!
Ií gil nɛr maa ŋɔ, “Ami!”
Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

english_text:
BOOK V
(Psalms 107–150)
The Lord Is Good to His People
1 Shout praises to the Lord!
He is good to us,
and his love never fails.
2Everyone the Lord has rescued
from trouble
should praise him,
3everyone he has brought
from the east and the west,
the north and the south.
4Some of you were lost
in the scorching desert,
far from a town.
5You were hungry and thirsty
and about to give up.
6You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
7At once he brought you
to a town.
8You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
9To everyone who is thirsty,
he gives something to drink;
to everyone who is hungry,
he gives good things to eat.
10Some of you were prisoners
suffering in deepest darkness
and bound by chains,
11because you had rebelled
against God Most High
and refused his advice.
12You were worn out
from working like slaves,
and no one came to help.
13You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
14He brought you out
of the deepest darkness
and broke your chains.
15You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
16He breaks down bronze gates
and shatters iron locks.
17Some of you had foolishly
committed a lot of sins
and were in terrible pain.
18The very thought of food
was disgusting to you,
and you were almost dead.
19You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
20By the power of his own word,
he healed you and saved you
from destruction.
21You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
22You should celebrate
by offering sacrifices
and singing joyful songs
to tell what he has done.
23Some of you made a living
by sailing the mighty sea,
24and you saw the miracles
the Lord performed there.
25At his command a storm arose,
and waves covered the sea.
26You were tossed to the sky
and to the ocean depths,
until things looked so bad
that you lost your courage.
27You staggered like drunkards
and gave up all hope.
28You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
29He made the storm stop
and the sea be quiet.
30You were happy because of this,
and he brought you to the port
where you wanted to go.
31You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
32Honor the Lord
when you and your leaders
meet to worship.
33If you start doing wrong,
the Lord will turn rivers
into deserts,
34 flowing streams
into scorched land,
and fruitful fields
into beds of salt.
35But the Lord can also turn
deserts into lakes
and scorched land
into flowing streams.
36If you are hungry,
you can settle there
and build a town.
37You can plant fields
and vineyards that produce
a good harvest.
38The Lord will bless you
with many children
and with herds of cattle.
39Sometimes you may be crushed
by troubles and sorrows,
until only a few of you
are left to survive.
40But the Lord will take revenge
on those who conquer you,
and he will make them wander
across desert sands.
41When you are suffering
and in need,
he will come to your rescue,
and your families will grow
as fast as a herd of sheep.
42You will see this because
you obey the Lord,
but everyone who is wicked
will be silenced.
43Be wise! Remember this
and think about the kindness
of the Lord.
translation_text:
Yira hɔŋ nuehiŋ
(Yira 107—150)
Kɔraawiizi winanaa ɛɛi chɔlaa yir
1Ií ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai,
u wia wessoo,
u nɔŋŋaa waa
tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
2Ii banla maa Kɔraawiizi n lɛɛwɛ la,
ií ra ŋɔ wia naa,
ii banla uŋ lɛɛwɛ
lii ii dɔma be,
3di chaali ia lii hɛhjaŋa,
wiifurii, wiicholii,
wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag
ani wiifurii nodig wiikakag la.
4Baŋhina faa juuri hɛribɔduma biinii guŋŋ,
ka ba waa ŋmɛnɛɛ nawɛɛ
bá la ga so bolzeŋ.
5Lɔzi ni niinyɔgzi faa lau baabuu,
ba tamii maa tuŋ.
6Denii ba faa lɔ wile tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi,
bá tɔɔrɔɔ hiŋ biini,
u lɛɛ baa lii
a biinichɔg hiŋ biini.
7U kpa baa di ga ŋmɛnideŋlii
ga hel bolzeŋ la
ban niŋ wer so.
8A dɛkkɔɔ ba ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ,
dikuu u nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ
ani nuukpuuri wia la
uŋ ɛɛwɛ tɛɛ baa la wia.
9U ɔɔ tɛɛ banla niinyɔgzi n na kpuu nii ba nyɔɔ,
di tɛɛ lɔzima ge
diunanaa ba di piŋ.
10Baŋhina faa du biinichɔg ni bɔbiri biinii,
ba tɔ baa dia, di du baa yɔlɔzi,
11dikuu baŋ faa dɔɔ dignikpega,
Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali
Kummaa la be
ani baŋ vɛɛ u baglaa wia.
12Ba faa gɛrgɔɔrɛ, dikuu humkpega wia,
di chogli hɛri,
ka nɛr maa faa waa hoo,
ú hiini baa.
13Denii ba faa lɔ wile tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi,
bá tɔɔrɔɔ hiŋ biini,
u lɛɛ baa lii
a biinichɔg biini,
14di faa kaa lizi baa lii a biinichɔg
ani bɔbiri werge biini,
ka chaahzi ba yɔlɔzi la.
15A dɛkkɔɔ ba ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ,
dikuu u nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ
ani nuukpuuri wia la
uŋ ɛɛwɛ tɛɛ baa la wia.
16U faa kuugi danyɛ gbessii,
di kuugi lugbidaazi la ge
baŋ kpawɛɛ karaa la.
17Baŋhina faa ɛɛ gɛnaarɛ di ra di tɔɔrɔɔ,
dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia.
18Ba faa kii diwii maanii,
di dugli siu.
19Denii ba faa lɔ wile tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi,
bá tɔɔrɔɔ hiŋ biini,
u lɛɛ baa lii
a biinichɔg biini.
20U faa ŋɔ wiarɛ ba na alaanfia,
di lɛɛ baa lii ŋmam biini.
21A dɛkkɔɔ bá ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ,
dikuu u nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la,
ani nuukpuuri wia la
uŋ ɛɛwɛ tɛɛ baa la wia.
22A dɛkkɔɔ baŋ lizi jaaŋ kuna di ra tɛu,
ka yir bɔsɔna yira
di ra bagli
u wiɛɛlaa maa wia.
23Baŋhina faa du muugberzenaa biinii,
a muuzenaa ni, di ra yoo kuna.
24Ba na Kɔraawiizi wiɛɛlaa
ni u nuukpuuri wiarɛ
a muuzenaa ni.
25Dikuubɛɛwiai, u faa ŋɔ wiarɛ pezeŋ izi,
di gil a muuzeŋ
nii ra lɔ werge.
26A nii lɔi faa gillɔɔ a muugbessi
ra la chiŋ, di ra tuu zɛɛ,
siaahmu faa zuu a nɛra,
ba tamii maa tuŋ.
27Ba faa ra jiŋli alugɔ sinnyɔɔra,
ba zumaa maa tuŋ.
28Denii ba faa lɔ wile tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi,
bá tɔɔrɔɔ hiŋ biini,
u lɛɛ baa lii
a biinichɔg biini.
29U faa gillɔɔ a pezeŋ teŋ,
a nii lɔi ge siigi.
30Ba bɔra faa sɔɔnɔɔrɛ, dikuu aŋ teŋŋe wia,
u faa kpogli baa gi,
di la bɔr la banna nyiŋŋi.
31A dɛkkɔɔ ba ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ,
dikuu u nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ,
ani nuukpuuri wia la
uŋ ɛɛwɛ tɛɛ baa la wia.
32Gil ba ra sii u zenni wia,
di a nɛra wa chaalɔɔ
Kɔraawiizi Dia biini,
di ba nabɔnzi ge wa chaalɔɔ,
bá ra chɔluu.
33Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ giluu muuni hiihzi,
di gil bulli ge birgi bɔhilaa.
34U ɔɔ giluu hɛrsum sɛbzi,
dikuu banla n du u biini la
biinikpola wia.
35U ɔɔ kaa giluu poljigzi chɔɔ hɛribɔduma,
di gil bulli
ge chɔɔ hɛrhilii.
36Denii u gil lɔzima so,
di ma ba bolzeŋ de
di ra zuu,
37di par daazi la n na nɔŋ kooni,
di kum kuna werge maa.
38U faa kissi baabuu ba wazi werge maa,
waa gillɛ
ba nauna ge ra tuŋ.
39Baŋ faa kpegli Kɔraawiizi nɛra, di ra sunni baa,
ba faa ra di tɔɔrɔɔ
ni mɔmɔsia la,
40u faa hah ba dɔma hinnɛ,
di gil ba ra juuri
hɛribɔdumazi,
ba faa waa ba nyuu
chaŋribɔr zummɛ.
41Ka u ɔɔ lizi nyaaraa
lii ba dɔgnya biini,
di gil ba domeezi wazi
alugɔ peeza.
42Banla wia n deŋlee ɔɔ na gunnɛ,
ba bɔra sɔɔni,
biinikpola hina ge
maa nuuzi tɔɔgi.
43Gil nɛr la maa n dɔɔ nunzuma
ra liizi wia naa.
Gil nɛr maa ra fɛ Kɔraawiizi nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia.

english_text:
(A song and a psalm by David.)
With God on Our Side
1Our God, I am faithful to you
with all my heart,
and you can trust me.
I will sing
and play music for you
with all that I am.
2I will start playing my harps
before the sun rises.
3I will praise you, Lord,
for everyone to hear;
I will sing hymns to you
in every nation.
4Your love reaches higher
than the heavens,
and your loyalty extends
beyond the clouds.
5Our God, may you be honored
above the heavens;
may your glory be seen
everywhere on earth.
6Answer my prayers
and use your powerful arm
to give us victory.
Then the people you love
will be safe.
7Our God, from your holy place
you made this promise:
“I will gladly divide up
the city of Shechem
and give away Succoth Valley
piece by piece.
8The lands of Gilead
and Manasseh are mine.
Ephraim is my war helmet,
and Judah is my symbol
of royal power.
9Moab is merely my washbasin,
and Edom belongs to me.
I shout with victory
over the Philistines.”
10Our God, who will bring me
to the fortress
or lead me to Edom?
11Have you rejected us?
You don't lead our armies.
12Help us defeat our enemies!
No one else can rescue us.
13Only you give us victory
and crush our enemies.
translation_text:
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa dikuu dɔma wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n bampirii chɔɔ bɔkpannɛ!
N daŋ yir yira di chɔlii
ni n biini maa!
2N daŋ feli izi,
di lɔ n kem
ni janjalaŋ mɔɔ,
ka wiizi fur.
3N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n danna chɔlii hɛssi maa biine,
di yir yira di ra chɔlii
nɛra maa biini.
4Dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la
n ga bɛri chiŋ,
i wibii dɔɔi la gba
gaa chug chiŋ wia.
5N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a bagli i zenni chiŋ,
di gil i girme tɔ
hɛri naa maa ni.
6Kpa i fɔŋŋazeŋ la lɛɛ yaa,
guŋ gil banla
hiŋ nɔŋŋɛɛ la na bahinaa.
7Kɔraawiizi du u Diinaniinanii la biinii, di ŋɔ,
“N kpegloore, awia,
n daŋ bargi
bolzeŋ Sɛkɛm,
di kpa Sukɔf Waluu
bɔnni n nɛra.
8Giliad ni Manasɛ maa ɛɛ n horaa,
Ɛfram ɛɛ lugɔ
n lugbii kahuro,
Juda ɛɛ lugɔ
n koori daŋkpala.
9Moab ɛɛ n niisannileere,
n daŋ kpa n gawa
ta Ɛdɔm ni,
di ra bagli lugɔ
u ɛɛ n hotte.
Ka chaasi du Filisti hina ni,
dikuu miŋ kpegli
baa wia.”
10N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, anɛɛ n niŋ kpogliŋ
ba bolzeŋ la
baŋ ma koŋlii bar lai?
Anɛɛ n niŋ tɔ n see
di la Ɛdɔmɛi?
11N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hiŋ lɛi vɛɛ yaa,
haa kaa du yaa laallɔɔra
di ra la laal bɔr laa?
12Hiini yaa ya kpegli yaa dɔma,
newee waa hiinaa
ɛɛ pɛɛrɛ.
13Hiŋ du yaa be la wia, yaa daŋ kpegli baa,
i daŋ kpegli yaa dɔma
tɛɛ yaa.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1I praise you, God!
Don't keep silent.
2Destructive and deceitful lies
are told about me,
3and hateful things are said
for no reason.
4I had pity and prayed
for my enemies,
but their words to me
were harsh and cruel.
5For being friendly and kind,
they paid me back
with meanness and hatred.
6My enemies said,
“Find some worthless fools
to accuse him of a crime.
7Try him and find him guilty!
Consider his prayers a lie.
8 Cut his life short
and let someone else
have his job.
9Make orphans of his children
and a widow of his wife;
10make his children beg for food
and live in the slums.
11“Let the people he owes
take everything he owns.
Give it all to strangers.
12Don't let anyone be kind to him
or have pity on the children
he leaves behind.
13Bring an end to his family,
and from now on let him be
a forgotten man.
14“Don't let the Lord forgive
the sins of his parents
and his ancestors.
15Don't let the Lord forget
the sins of his family,
or let anyone remember
his family ever lived.
16He was so cruel to the poor,
homeless, and discouraged
that they died young.
17“He cursed others.
Now place a curse on him!
He never wished others well.
Wish only trouble for him!
18He cursed others more often
than he dressed himself.
Let his curses strike him deep,
just as water and olive oil
soak through to our bones.
19Let his curses surround him,
just like the belt and clothes
he wears each day.”
20Those are the cruel things
my enemies wish for me.
Let it all happen to them!
21Be true to your name, Lord God!
Show your great kindness
and rescue me.
22I am poor and helpless,
and I have lost all hope.
23I am fading away
like an evening shadow;
I am tossed aside
like a crawling insect.
24I have gone without eating,
until my knees are weak,
and my body is bony.
25 When my enemies see me,
they say cruel things
and shake their heads.
26Please help me, Lord God!
Come and save me
because of your love.
27Let others know that you alone
have saved me.
28I don't care if they curse me,
as long as you bless me.
You will make my enemies fail
when they attack,
and you will make me glad
to be your servant.
29You will cover them with shame,
just as their bodies
are covered with clothes.
30I will sing your praises
and thank you, Lord,
when your people meet.
31You help everyone in need,
and you save them from death.
translation_text:
Nɛr la n du tɔɔrɔɔ biini nuumaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n na chɔliibuu,
gilɛɛ siigi,
2dikuubɛɛwiai, biinikpola hina ani
karkanna ra ŋɔ n wiarɛ,
di kanni kara
ra chugiŋ.
3Ba ŋɔ wichɔgaarɛ ra du n ni,
di ra yooŋ pɛɛpɛɛ.
4Ba kpa chɔgrii di ra turgi n winanaa kim,
haali miŋ nɔŋŋi baa,
di suŋŋi wiizi
di ra tɛɛ baa la gba.
5Ba kpa chɔgrii di ra turgi n winanaa kim,
di kpa hahzi di ra turgi
n nɔŋŋaa kim.
6Ba ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Lizi biinikpola hiŋ, ú diu seriya,
di gil u himmaa haahri
kpa wia chuguu.
7Di ba wa diu seriya, gil u chol,
di gil u wiisuŋŋaa gba
birgi wichɔgaa!
8Gil u miibɔɔ ɛɛ kpurii,
nɛduma kpa u huma!
9Gil u biizi ɛɛ lalbiizi,
u haaŋ ge birgi luhaaŋ!
10Gil u biizi gaagi di ra suŋŋi,
di gil ba duŋŋi baa
lii ba diikɔgni biine!
11Gil nɛr la kim un diwee foozi u kundɔɔlaa maa,
di gil hɔɔhra wa foozi
u kuuhni kuna maa.
12Gilɛɛ gil nɛr maa wàá ɛɛu winanaa
gɛɛ di wàá suŋ u lalbiizi ni.
13Gil u dee dim,
di gil ba suuh u sɔŋ
jimini maa biini.
14Kɔ́raawiizi ra liizi u naabaala wichɔgaa,
di ŋmɛnɛ maa
gilɛɛ wa gil
u maa wichɔgaa
ra tɛu.
15Kɔ́raawiizi ɔɔ ra liizi ba wichɔgaa wia saŋa maa,
di gil nɛra suuh
ba wia kɔrai!
16U ŋmɛnɛ maa faa waa liizee lugɔ ú ɛɛ winanaa,
ka faa ra tɔɔri,
di ra kpu nyaara,
anuula hina
ani dɔgnya hina.
17U faa nɔŋŋi nɛra nuuzi seeire,
gil nuuseei diu.
U faa hah nɛra kissaare,
gilɛɛ waa kissuu.
18U faa kpa nuuseeire birgi lugɔ u laala,
a pɔɔh u bɔra alugɔ nii,
di zuu u hoga biini
alugɔ nuu.
19Gil a ɔɔ tɔ u ni alugɔ uŋ tɔ wɛjɛ,
di ɔɔ vɔɔu alugɔ kirsɔɔ,
saŋa maa!”
20N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, tɛr n dɔma digna guŋ,
banla maa n ŋɔ
a guŋ wichɔgaa
di ra du n ni la.
21Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa,
wa hiiniŋ gunla
hiŋ ŋɔ nua la, di lɛɛŋ,
dikuu i nɔŋŋaa
winanaa wia.
22N nyaawɔɔ, maa kummaa dɔɔwɛ,
n biini chɔgi werge maa.
23N na nyiŋŋuu ń leu alugɔ duaniŋ chunchugli,
peu kpaŋ di ra kaali
alugɔ fɛfɛgɛ.
24N naahiine yɔɔrɔɔrɛ, dikuu nuuvɔɔi wia,
n ka hoga bɛŋ.
25N birgi mɔmɔsia kunnɛ tɛɛ n dɔma,
ba ɔɔ nambuu di ra mamiŋ.
26N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, wa hiiniŋ,
dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa
dɔɔwɛ la wia,
wa lɛɛŋ!
27Gil n dɔma zum lugɔ
hinuu ra lɛɛŋ.
28Ba danna seeŋ nua, ka hiŋwaa ra kissiŋ,
di ba waa yooŋ,
ba daŋ di hiihzi,
ka i balii
waa dɔɔ bɔsɔna.
29Gil n dɔma di hiihzi werge,
gil ba di hiihzi
alugɔ baŋ laali tagtajaŋ.
30N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n danna jaamii werge,
n danna chɔlii
nɛra chaalaa biini,
31dikuubɛɛwiai, i ɔɔ hiini nyaarii,
di lɛɛu lii banla
n na nyiŋŋi ba kpuu be.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
The Lord Gives Victory
1 The Lord said to my Lord,
“Sit at my right side,
until I make your enemies
into a footstool for you.”
2The Lord will let your power
reach out from Zion,
and you will rule
over your enemies.
3Your glorious power
will be seen on the day
you begin to rule.
You will wear the sacred robes
and shine like the morning sun
in all of your strength.
4 The Lord has made a promise
that will never be broken:
“You will be a priest forever,
just like Melchizedek.”
5The Lord is at your right side,
and when he gets angry
he will crush
the other kings.
6He will judge the nations
and crack their skulls,
leaving piles of dead bodies
all over the earth.
7He will drink from any stream
that he chooses, while winning
victory after victory.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi ni koori la uŋ lizɛɛ wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n Dɔɔri be,
“So n nabɔmbɔr naa,
ka ń gil i dɔma
birgi i yoma.”
2N daŋ gil i kora chi Bolzeŋ Ziɔn,
di ra yaa,
í du i dɔma baambaaŋ
di ra di kora.
3A hɔl la hin niŋ ŋɔ i lɔ i dɔma laal,
a daŋ par i laallɔɔra, bá lii.
Gunla ŋmɛnii n ɔɔ chol chɔɔzimpikke ni la,
gúnnɛ i biipɔllaa ba i be,
a bizennanaananaa la nyuuni.
4Kɔraawiizi hɛɛhzɔɔrɛ,
wàá ka bir u nua,
“I daŋ ɛɛ n kizeehiŋ di hanna la saŋa maa
lugɔ Mɛlkizɛdɛk
ni u naanna.”
5Kɔraawiizi du i nodig keŋkeree,
u daŋ kpegli koora
u baaŋ hɔpizii.
6U daŋ di hɛssi hina seriya,
di kpu nɛra yaari bɔr maa,
di kpegli durnya maa koora.
7A koori daŋ nyɔɔ ŋmɛnikɛraa gɔŋa niiri,
di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa
di wer kpegli u dɔma.

english_text:
Praise the Lord for All He Has Done
1Shout praises to the Lord!
With all my heart
I will thank the Lord
when his people meet.
2The Lord has done
many wonderful things!
Everyone who is pleased
with God's marvelous deeds
will keep them in mind.
3Everything the Lord does
is glorious and majestic,
and his power to bring justice
will never end.
4The Lord God is famous
for his wonderful deeds,
and he is kind and merciful.
5He gives food to his worshipers
and always keeps his agreement
with them.
6He has shown his mighty power
to his people
and has given them the lands
of other nations.
7God is always honest and fair,
and his laws can be trusted.
8They are true and right
and will stand forever.
9God rescued his people,
and he will never break
his agreement with them.
He is fearsome and holy.
10 Respect and obey the Lord!
This is the first step
to wisdom and good sense.
God will always be respected.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi chɔlaa yir
1Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!
N danna jaami Kɔraawiizi werge ni n biini maa,
u nɛra chaalaa biini.
2Kɔraawiizi wiɛɛlaa ɛɛ wizenaare werge maa,
banla maa bɔra
n sɔɔnɛɛ a wia,
ɔɔ aah siwiire
di ra nyiŋŋi
ba zum a zɛɛ nɛnnɛ.
3U wiɛɛlaa dɔɔ girme ani zennii werge,
u wideŋlaa ge
waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
4Kɔraawiizi wàá gil nɛra suuh u nuukpuuri wia,
u dɔɔ winanaarɛ
di ra na nɛra sinyɛna.
5U ɔɔ ra tɛɛ banla n na kpaubuu girme diwee,
di ra liizi u ni
baa nuukpaŋ la wia.
6U bagli u nɛraa u wiɛɛlaa fɔŋŋa,
di lii uŋ kpa hɔɔhra hɛssi
tɛɛ baa la biini.
7U wiɛɛlaa maa deŋloore di dɔɔ wibii,
u widaulaa ge
dɛg yardaa.
8A du denii di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa,
u dawaabuu a deŋli
di dɔɔ wibii.
9U gillɔɔ u nɛra na bahinaa,
u ni baa ɛɛ nuukpaŋ la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
U sɔŋ ɛɛ naniinaniirɛ,
di dɛg ɔmaa werge!
10Nunzuma dɔɔi faaraarɛ Kɔraawiizi ɔmaa,
banla maa
n na hiŋ u widaulaa,
dɔɔ wia zɛɛ
zumaarɛ nɛnnɛ.
Ií ra chɔluu saŋa maa.

english_text:
God Blesses His Worshipers
1Shout praises to the Lord!
The Lord blesses everyone
who worships him and gladly
obeys his teachings.
2Their descendants will have
great power in the land,
because the Lord blesses
all who do right.
3They will get rich and prosper
and will always be remembered
for their fairness.
4They will be so kind
and merciful and good,
that they will be a light
in the dark for others
who do the right thing.
5Life will go well for those
who freely lend
and are honest in business.
6They won't ever be troubled,
and the kind things they do
will never be forgotten.
7Bad news won't bother them;
they have decided
to trust the Lord.
8They are dependable
and not afraid,
and they will live to see
their enemies defeated.
9 They will always be remembered
and greatly praised,
because they were kind
and freely gave to the poor.
10When evil people see this,
they angrily bite their tongues
and disappear.
They will never get
what they really want.
translation_text:
Nɛnanii bɔsɔna wia
1Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!
Nɛr la maa n na ɔm Kɔraawiizi nuu sumaa,
unla bɔra
n ɔɔ sɔɔni werge,
dikuu u widaulaa wia.
2U biizi daŋ dɔɔ fɔŋŋa hɛri naa biini,
ú naanna na kissaa.
3U domee daŋ dɔɔ kuna, di ɛɛ daama hina,
ú nyɛɛli, di ra la saŋa maa.
4Haali bɔbiri biini, bɔr ɔɔ chaanuu tɛɛ banla wia n deŋlee
ni banla n na
ɛɛ winanaa,
di ra suŋ nɛra ni,
di dɔɔ wibii.
5Nɛr la n na kim nɛra ni bunya,
di ra hum u huma
ni wibii, nuu sumaa.
6Nɛr la wia n deŋlee, ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá leu,
ba daŋ ɔɔ ra liizi u wia
saŋaa saŋa maa.
7U banchule wàá lɔ, di u wa nuu amaniyechɔgaa.
U bampirii lau Kɔraawiizii,
u yarduu nɛnnɛ.
8Wia wɔɔ titte gɛɛ u ra ɔm,
u zummɔɔ nɛnnɛ lugɔ
u daŋ na u dɔma cholaa.
9U bɔnni u kunaa ra tɛɛ nyaara.
U winanaa wàá tuŋ maa.
U daŋ dɔɔ fɔŋŋa ni girme.
10Biinikpola hina na guŋ, bá baana ra fuuh,
bá ra binnuu tiiih
ni hahzi, bá wia tuŋ,
bá tamii tuŋ
saŋaa saŋa maa.

english_text:
The Lord Helps People in Need
1Shout praises to the Lord!
Everyone who serves him,
come and praise his name.
2Let the name of the Lord
be praised now and forever.
3From dawn until sunset
the name of the Lord
deserves to be praised.
4The Lord is far above
all of the nations;
he is more glorious
than the heavens.
5No one can compare
with the Lord our God.
His throne is high above,
6and he looks down to see
the heavens and the earth.
7God lifts the poor and needy
from dust and ashes,
8and he lets them take part
in ruling his people.
9When a wife has no children,
he blesses her with some,
and she is happy.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi winanaa ɛɛi chɔlaa wia
1Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!
Ií banla n ɛɛ u balaa, ií ra chɔluu,
ií ra darguu!
2Ií ra darguu filaŋkeŋ
ani saŋa maa.
3Di lii wiifurii di wa kaali wiicholii,
ií ra dargi Kɔraawiizi!
4Waabuu ra di kora hɛssi maa ni,
u girme bɛri
chinchiŋ gba ninɛɛ.
5Anɛɛ n lugɔ Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na humɛi,
unla n soge ú koorikara ni
chinchiŋ lai,
6di ɔɔ willi,
ú binni chiŋ ani hɛri maa lai?
7U ɔɔ giluu nyaara wia kuari,
di lizi baa lii dɔgnya biini,
8di gil ba ni sitɔɔra ra kpau,
sitɔɔra la n ɛɛ ú himmaa nɛra.
9U ɔɔ tɛɛ hahbaraa girme u dia,
di tɛu biizi, u dɔɔ bɔsɔna.
Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

english_text:
The Lord Works Wonders
1 God brought his people
out of Egypt, that land
with a strange language.
2He made Judah his holy place
and ruled over Israel.
3 When the sea looked at God,
it ran away,
and the Jordan River
flowed upstream.
4The mountains and the hills
skipped around like goats.
5Ask the sea why it ran away
or ask the Jordan
why it flowed upstream.
6Ask the mountains and the hills
why they skipped like goats!
7Earth, you will tremble,
when the Lord God of Jacob
comes near,
8 because he turns solid rock
into flowing streams
and pools of water.
translation_text:
Gillikaali dii wia yir
1A hɔl la Izrɛl hina n lii Ijip,
a hɔl la Jekɔb naanna
n lii hɛrduma la,
2Juda hinaa faa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi nɛnanaananaa,
Izrɛl hina ge ɛɛ
u himmaa kundɔɔlaa.
3A Muuzeŋaahmu faa bargi, ba sibɔɔ,
Jɔɔdan muu ge palaa faa teŋ.
4Bizenaa faa ra zaahzi alugɔ pebala,
giŋgimee gba ra zaahzi
alugɔ pebizi.
5Muuzeŋaahmu, bɛɛ ɛɛi, i bargɛi?
Jɔɔdan muu,
bɛɛ n baani i gil palaai?
6Bizenaa, ɛrɛɛ ii ra zaahzi alugɔ pebalai?
Giŋgimee, ɛrɛɛ ii ge
ra zaahzi alugɔ pebizei?
7Hɛri, zigli Kɔraawiizi see,
Kɔraawiizi la Jekɔb n na hum la see,
8U ɔɔ giluu bii birgi pol,
di gil bikpega birgi bulli.

english_text:
The Lord Deserves To Be Praised
1We don't deserve praise!
The Lord alone deserves
all of the praise,
because of his love
and faithfulness.
2 Why should the nations ask,
“Where is your God?”
3Our God is in the heavens,
doing as he chooses.
4 The idols of the nations
are made of silver and gold.
5They have a mouth and eyes,
but they can't speak or see.
6Their ears can't hear,
and their noses can't smell.
7Their hands have no feeling,
their legs don't move,
and they can't make a sound.
8Everyone who made the idols
and all who trust them
are just as helpless
as those useless gods.
9People of Israel,
you must trust the Lord
to help and protect you.
10Family of Aaron the priest,
you must trust the Lord
to help and protect you.
11All of you worship the Lord,
so you must trust him
to help and protect you.
12The Lord will not forget
to give us his blessing;
he will bless all of Israel
and the family of Aaron.
13 All who worship the Lord,
no matter who they are,
will receive his blessing.
14I pray that the Lord
will let your family
and your descendants
always grow strong.
15May the Lord who created
the heavens and the earth
give you his blessing.
16The Lord has kept the heavens
for himself,
but he has given the earth
to us humans.
17The dead are silent
and cannot praise the Lord,
18but we will praise him
now and forevermore.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi kpannɛ du de u wia dɔɔ wibii
1Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
dikuu i nɔŋŋaa
ani i wibii dɔɔi wia,
a dɛkkɔɔ banna tɛi girme.
Yaa lɛi dɛkkɛ.
2Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ hɛssi hina ra pɛɛzi yaa,
“Lee Kɔraawiizi la
iinna hum la duɛi?”
3Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la du chinne,
di ra ɛɛ
gunla maa n paruu.
4Saliŋhuŋŋa ni salinnɛ ɛɛ baawaa vuga,
neweare kuaraa.
5A dɔɔ nuuzii, ka a wàá ŋɔ wia,
di dɔɔ siwee,
ka a wàá wer na.
6Di dɔɔ digna, ka a wàá nuu wia,
di dɔɔ miizizi,
ka a wàá nuu sɔɔh.
7Di dɔɔ nonee, ka a wàá wer gbɔgzi kummaa,
di dɔɔ naazi,
ka a wàá wer vol,
a waa gbɔgza maa
ge dɔɔwɛ.
8Nɛra la maa n kuaraa daŋ ɛɛ lugɔa,
gunnɛ banla maa
n yardaa gba du.
9Izrɛl hina, ií yardi Kɔraawiizi,
waabuu ra hiini ia,
di ra guu ia.
10Kɔraawiizi kizeehina, ií yardi Kɔraawiizi,
waabuu ra hiini ia,
di ra guu ia.
11Ii banla maa n na ɔm Kɔraawiizi la,
ií yarduu, waabuu ra hiini ia,
di ra guu ia.
12Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra liizi yaa wiarɛ,
u daŋ kissi yaa.
U daŋ kissi Izrɛl hina
ni u kizeehina maa.
13Kɔraawiizi daŋ kissi banla maa n na ɔmuu,
nɛzenaa ni nɛdumazi maa.
14Kɔ́raawiizi gil ii wazi,
ii ni ii biizi maa!
15Kɔ́raawiizi kissi ia,
unla n ta chiŋ ni hɛri la.
16Chinchiŋ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi bɛŋ hotte,
ka u kpa hɛri ge
tɛɛ newea.
17Nɛr maa wàá wer chɔlii, di u siuwɔ,
nɛr maa wàá chɔlii
ŋmam biini.
18Ka yaa banla n na nyiŋ la,
danna chɔli Kɔraawiizi,
di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa.
Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

english_text:
When the Lord Saves You from Death
1I love you, Lord!
You answered my prayers.
2You paid attention to me,
and so I will pray to you
as long as I live.
3Death attacked from all sides,
and I was captured
by its painful chains.
But when I was really hurting,
4I prayed and said, “Lord,
please don't let me die!”
5You are kind, Lord,
so good and merciful.
6You protect ordinary people,
and when I was helpless,
you saved me
7and treated me so kindly
that I don't need
to worry anymore.
8You, Lord, have saved
my life from death,
my eyes from tears,
my feet from stumbling.
9Now I will walk at your side
in this land of the living.
10 I was faithful to you
when I was suffering,
11though in my confusion I said,
“I can't trust anyone!”
12What must I give you, Lord,
for being so good to me?
13I will pour out an offering
of wine to you,
and I will pray in your name
because you
have saved me.
14I will keep my promise to you
when your people meet.
15You are deeply concerned
when one of your loyal people
faces death.
16I worship you, Lord,
just as my mother did,
and you have rescued me
from the chains of death.
17I will offer you a sacrifice
to show how grateful I am,
and I will pray.
18I will keep my promise to you
when your people
19gather at your temple
in Jerusalem.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Nɛbɛl Kɔraawiizi n lɛɛwɛ lii siu be, chɔlaa yir
1N nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizii, dikuubɛɛwiai,
u nuu n loobii
ani n wiisuŋŋaarɛ.
2U ɔɔ keŋŋi dignii di ra nuu n be,
awia, n danna yiruu
n de dui maa biini.
3Siu ŋmɛnni faa gargimbuu,
ɔnsii chol n ni,
ɔnsii faa lawiŋ werge,
n bɔra ra sa.
4Denii n lɔ wile tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, di ŋɔ,
“N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ!”
5Kɔraawiizi ra suŋ nɛra ninɛɛ, u wia deŋloore.
Kɔraawiizi la
yaa n na hum la
ra na nɛra sinyɛnaa.
6Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra hiini gɛrgaa,
miŋ faa du siaahmu biini,
u lɛɛmbuu.
7Awia, n daŋ kaa bir dɔɔ bɔkpega,
dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi
ɛɛmbuu nɛnnɛ.
8U lɛɛmbuu lii siu be,
di fiizi n sinii.
Waa gillɛ n na lɔɔzi naazi.
9Awia, n danna hiŋ u nua,
durnya naa biini.
10N yardɔɔrɛ. Awiarɛ n ŋɔ,
“N biini chɔkkɔɔ werge maa.”
11N ɔnsii werge biini, n faa ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Nɛr maa ɛɛ karkannii.”
12Bɛɛ ń wer kpa turgi Kɔraawiizi,
dikuu u winanaa la maa
uŋ ɛɛwɛ tɛŋ wiai?
13N daŋ ta siŋ tɛu,
di jaamuu
dikuu uŋ lɛɛŋ wia.
14N daŋ lizi nuuzi la maa miŋ lɛɛwɛ la tɛu,
u nɛra maa see.
15A ɔɔ wii Kɔraawiizi ninɛɛ,
di u nɛr siuwɔ.
16N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n ɛɛ i baliirɛ,
n danna humii
gunla n maa n humii la.
Hinuu lɛɛŋ lii siu be.
17N daŋ lizi jaaŋ kuna tɛi,
ka ra suŋŋii.
18Di lizi nuuzi la maa miŋ lɛɛwɛ la tɛi,
i nɛra maa see,
19i Dia la n du Jɛrusalɛm biini.
Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

english_text:
Come Praise the Lord
1 All of you nations,
come praise the Lord!
Let everyone praise him.
2God's love for us is wonderful;
his faithfulness never ends.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi chɔlaa yir
1Hɛssi hina maa, ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!
Nɛra maa, ií ra chɔluu.
2U nɔŋŋaa kannɔɔ tɛɛ yaa,
u wibii dɔɔi ge waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

english_text:
The Lord Is Always Merciful
1 Tell the Lord
how thankful you are,
because he is kind
and always merciful.
2Let Israel shout,
“God is always merciful!”
3Let the family of Aaron
the priest shout,
“God is always merciful!”
4Let every true worshiper
of the Lord shout,
“God is always merciful!”
5When I was really hurting,
I prayed to the Lord.
He answered my prayer,
and took my worries away.
6 The Lord is on my side,
and I am not afraid
of what others can do to me.
7With the Lord on my side,
I will defeat
my hateful enemies.
8It is better to trust the Lord
for protection
than to trust anyone else,
9including strong leaders.
10Nations surrounded me,
but I got rid of them
by the power of the Lord.
11They attacked from all sides,
but I got rid of them
by the power of the Lord.
12They swarmed around like bees,
but by the power of the Lord,
I got rid of them
and their fiery sting.
13Their attacks were so fierce
that I nearly fell,
but the Lord helped me.
14 My power and my strength
come from the Lord,
and he has saved me.
15From the tents of God's people
come shouts of victory:
“The Lord is powerful!
16With his mighty arm
the Lord wins victories!
The Lord is powerful!”
17And so my life is safe,
and I will live to tell
what the Lord has done.
18He punished me terribly,
but he did not let death
lay its hands on me.
19Open the gates of justice!
I will enter and tell the Lord
how thankful I am.
20Here is the gate of the Lord!
Everyone who does right
may enter this gate.
21I praise the Lord
for answering my prayers
and saving me.
22 The stone that the builders
tossed aside
has now become
the most important stone.
23The Lord has done this,
and it is amazing to us.
24This day belongs to the Lord!
Let's celebrate
and be glad today.
25 We'll ask the Lord to save us!
We'll sincerely ask the Lord
to let us win.
26 God bless the one who comes
in the name of the Lord!
We praise you from here
in the house of the Lord.
27The Lord is our God,
and he has given us light!
Start the celebration!
March with palm branches
all the way to the altar.
28The Lord is my God!
I will praise him and tell him
how thankful I am.
29Tell the Lord
how thankful you are,
because he is kind
and always merciful.
translation_text:
Izrɛl hina dɔma kpeglaa jaaŋ wiisuŋŋaa
1Ií ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, u wia wessoo,
u nɔŋŋaa ge
waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
2Izrɛl hina, ií ŋɔ,
“U nɔŋŋaa
waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.”
3Gil Kɔraawiizi kizeehina la n ɛɛ Aarɔn naanna ŋɔ,
“U nɔŋŋaa
waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.”
4Banla maa n na ɔm Kɔraawiizi, ií ŋɔ,
“U nɔŋŋaa
waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.”
5N biinichɔg werge saŋa, n yir Kɔraawiizii,
u nuu, di lɛɛŋ ta.
6Kɔraawiizi du n benii,
awia, maa ɔm.
Bɛɛ newee
kaa wer ɛɛnnɛi?
7Waabuu ra hiiniŋ,
awia, n daŋ kpegli
n dɔma.
8Hiŋ yardi Kɔraawiizi,
aabuu bɔmbɔ
hiŋ dɛlli newee.
9Hiŋ yardi Kɔraawiizi,
aabuu bɔmbɔ,
hiŋ dɛlli newea sitɔɔra.
10N dɔma kpila faa barimbuu,
ka Kɔraawiizi tɛŋ fɔŋŋa,
n chɔgi ba maa!
11Ba faa barimbuu alugɔ huuh,
ka Kɔraawiizi tɛŋ fɔŋŋa,
n chɔgi ba maa!
12Ba faa milimbuu alugɔ huuh,
ka siuzi manaŋ alugɔ niŋ
n fuuh sɔɔhri la,
Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋaa
n kpa di chɔgi baa.
13Ba faa taambuu n la har, di ra nyiŋŋi bá kpegliŋ,
ka Kɔraawiizi hiiniŋ.
14Kɔraawiizi tɛmbuu kpegzi ani fɔŋŋa,
waabuu lɛɛŋ.
15Ií ra nuu Kɔraawiizi nɛra n kpegli ba dɔma, di ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna,
ba tanti diini biine.
“Kɔraawiizii kpa u banonii di ɛɛ guŋ!
16U lalli u banoniire chiŋ,
yaa kpegli yaa dɔma,
laal biini!”
17Màá siu, n daŋ du de,
di ra sii wia la
Kɔraawiizi n ɛɛwɛ.
18Kɔraawiizi tɛr n dignii werge maa,
ka waa gillɛ n siu.
19Ií pilli Kɔraawiizi Dia dominuuzi tɛŋ,
ń zuu jaami Kɔraawiizi!
20Kɔraawiizi Dia dominuarɛ keŋ,
banla wia n deŋlee bɛnnɛ
niŋ wer ga de zuu.
21N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n na chɔliibuu,
dikuu hiŋ nuu n wiisuŋŋaa,
di gil n kpegli n dɔma wia.
22Bii la maara n faa vɛɛwɛ ha labuu jaa ɛɛ
bikpeg la baŋ kpawɛɛ
di ra faari dia zɛɛ.
23Kɔraawiizi wiɛɛliirɛ guŋ.
A tir yaabuu werge.
24A hɔpizii naabuu Kɔraawiizi lizi di bagli u kpegzi,
ií gil yaa bɔra sɔɔni,
ya ra di yaa hinaa.
25N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛ yaa!
Gil yaa wia kuari!
26Tibaarikala! Unla n kpa Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ
di ra ba la, nuu sumaa!
Ii banla maa ge
n du Kɔraawiizi Dia,
ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni.
27Kɔraawiizi kpaŋkpaŋ bɛnnɛ du de,
waabuu ɛɛ winanaa
di ra tɛɛ yaa.
Ií kpogli abɛ paŋhoori di ra di iihinaa,
di ta gɔɔri di bar
mbusu lizibɔr la.
28I bɛnnɛ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la minna hum,
n danna tɛi jaaŋ,
di ra sii i zenni wia.
29Ií ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai,
u wia wessoo,
u nɔŋŋaa
waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

english_text:
In Praise of the Law of the Lord
1Our Lord, you bless everyone
who lives right
and obeys your Law.
2You bless all those
who follow your commands
from deep in their hearts
3and who never do wrong
or turn from you.
4You have ordered us always
to obey your teachings;
5I don't ever want to stray
from your laws.
6Thinking about your commands
will keep me from doing
some foolish thing.
7I will do right and praise you
by learning to respect
your perfect laws.
8I will obey all of them!
Don't turn your back on me.
9Young people can live
a clean life
by obeying your word.
10I worship you
with all my heart.
Don't let me walk away
from your commands.
11I treasure your word
above all else;
it keeps me from sinning
against you.
12I praise you, Lord!
Teach me your laws.
13With my own mouth,
I tell others the laws
that you have spoken.
14Obeying your instructions
brings as much happiness
as being rich.
15I will study your teachings
and follow your footsteps.
16I will take pleasure
in your laws
and remember your words.
17Treat me with kindness, Lord,
so that I may live
and do what you say.
18Open my mind
and let me discover
the wonders of your Law.
19I live here as a stranger.
Don't keep me from knowing
your commands.
20What I want most
and at all times
is to honor your laws.
21You punish those boastful,
worthless nobodies who turn
from your commands.
22Don't let them sneer
and insult me
for following you.
23I keep thinking about
your teachings, Lord,
even if rulers plot
against me.
24Your laws are my greatest joy!
I follow their advice.
25I am at the point of death.
Let your teachings
breathe new life into me.
26When I told you my troubles,
you answered my prayers.
Now teach me your laws.
27Help me to understand
your teachings,
and I will think about
your marvelous deeds.
28I am overcome with sorrow.
Encourage me,
as you have promised to do.
29Keep me from being deceitful,
and be kind enough
to teach me your Law.
30I am determined to be faithful
and to respect your laws.
31I follow your rules, Lord.
Don't let me be ashamed.
32I am eager to learn all
that you want me to do;
help me to understand more.
33Point out your rules, Lord,
and I won't disobey
even one of them.
34Help me to understand your Law;
I promise to obey it
with all my heart.
35Direct me by your commands!
I love to do what you say.
36Make me want to obey you,
rather than to be rich.
37Take away my foolish desires,
and let me find life
by walking with you.
38I am your servant!
Do for me what you promised
to those who worship you.
39Your wonderful teachings
protect me from the insults
that I hate so much.
40I long for your teachings.
Be true to yourself
and let me live.
41Show me your love
and save me, Lord,
as you have promised.
42Then I will have an answer
for everyone who insults me
for trusting your word.
43I rely on your laws!
Don't take away my chance
to speak your truth.
44I will keep obeying your Law
forever and ever.
45I have gained perfect freedom
by following your teachings,
46and I trust them so much
that I tell them to kings.
47I love your commands!
They bring me happiness.
48I love and respect them
and will keep them in mind.
49Don't forget your promise
to me, your servant.
I depend on it.
50When I am hurting,
I find comfort in your promise
that leads to life.
51Conceited people sneer at me,
but I obey your Law.
52I find true comfort, Lord,
because your laws have stood
the test of time.
53I get furious when evil people
turn against your Law.
54No matter where I am,
your teachings
fill me with songs.
55Even in the night
I think about you, Lord,
and I obey your Law.
56You have blessed me
because I have always followed
your teachings.
57You, Lord, are my choice,
and I will obey you.
58With all my heart
I beg you to be kind to me,
just as you have promised.
59I pay careful attention
as you lead me,
and I follow closely.
60As soon as you command,
I do what you say.
61Evil people may set a trap,
but I obey your Law.
62Your laws are so fair
that I wake up and praise you
in the middle of the night.
63I choose as my friends
everyone who worships you
and follows your teachings.
64Our Lord, your love is seen
all over the world.
Teach me your laws.
65I am your servant, Lord,
and you have kept your promise
to treat me with kindness.
66Give me wisdom and good sense.
I trust your commands.
67Once you corrected me
for not obeying you,
but now I do obey.
68You are kindhearted,
and you do good things,
so teach me your laws.
69My reputation is being ruined
by conceited liars,
but with all my heart
I follow your teachings.
70Those liars have no sense,
but I find happiness
in your Law.
71When you corrected me,
it did me good
because it taught me
to study your laws.
72I would rather obey you
than to have a thousand pieces
of silver and gold.
73You created me
and put me together.
Make me wise enough to learn
what you have commanded.
74Your worshipers will see me,
and they will be glad
that I trust your word.
75Your decisions are correct,
and you were right
to punish me.
76I serve you, Lord.
Comfort me with your love,
just as you have promised.
77I love to obey your Law!
Have mercy and let me live.
78Put down those proud people
who hurt me with their lies,
because I have chosen
to study your teachings.
79Let your worshipers come to me,
so they will learn
to obey your rules.
80Let me truly respect your laws,
so I won't be ashamed.
81I long for you to rescue me!
Your word is my only hope.
82I am worn out from waiting
for you to keep your word.
When will you have mercy?
83My life is wasting away
like a dried-up wineskin,
but I have not forgotten
your teachings.
84I am your servant!
How long must I suffer?
When will you punish
those troublemakers?
85Those proud people reject
your teachings,
and they dig pits
for me to fall in.
86Your laws can be trusted!
Protect me from cruel liars.
87They have almost killed me,
but I have been faithful
to your teachings.
88Show that you love me
and let me live,
so that I may obey
your commands.
89Our Lord, you are eternal!
Your word will last as long
as the heavens.
90You remain faithful
in every generation,
and the earth you created
will keep standing firm.
91All things are your servants,
and the laws you made
are still in effect today.
92If I had not found happiness
in obeying your Law,
I would have died in misery.
93I won't ever forget
your teachings,
because you give me new life
when I follow them.
94I belong to you,
and I have respected your laws,
so keep me safe.
95Brutal enemies are waiting
to ambush and destroy me,
but I obey your rules.
96Nothing is completely perfect,
except your teachings.
97I deeply love your Law!
I think about it all day.
98Your laws never leave my mind,
and they make me much wiser
than my enemies.
99Thinking about your teachings
gives me better understanding
than my teachers,
100and obeying your laws
makes me wiser than those
who have lived a long time.
101I obey your word
instead of following a way
that leads to trouble.
102You have been my teacher,
and I won't reject
your instructions.
103Your teachings are sweeter
than honey.
104They give me understanding
and make me hate all lies.
105Your word is a lamp
that gives light
wherever I walk.
106Your laws are fair,
and I have given my word
to respect them all.
107I am in terrible pain!
Save me, Lord,
as you have promised.
108Accept my offerings of praise
and teach me your laws.
109I never forget your teachings,
although my life is always
in danger.
110Some merciless people
are trying to trap me,
but I never turn my back
on your teachings.
111They will always be
my most prized possession
and my source of joy.
112I have made up my mind
to obey your laws forever,
no matter what.
113I hate anyone
whose loyalty is divided,
but I love your Law.
114You are my place of safety
and my shield.
Your word is my only hope.
115All you worthless people,
get away from me!
I am determined to obey
the commands of my God.
116Be true to your word, Lord.
Keep me alive and strong;
don't let me be ashamed
because of my hope.
117Keep me safe and secure,
so that I will always
respect your laws.
118You reject all deceitful liars
because they refuse
your teachings.
119As far as you are concerned,
evil people are garbage,
and so I follow your rules.
120I tremble all over
when I think of you
and the way you judge.
121I did what was fair and right!
Don't hand me over to those
who want to mistreat me.
122Take good care of me,
your servant,
and don't let me be harmed
by those conceited people.
123My eyes are weary from waiting
to see you keep your promise
to come and save me.
124Show your love for me,
your servant,
and teach me your laws.
125I serve you,
so let me understand
your teachings.
126Do something, Lord!
They have broken your Law.
127Your laws mean more to me
than the finest gold.
128I follow all your commands,
but I hate anyone
who leads me astray.
129Your teachings are wonderful,
and I respect them all.
130Understanding your word
brings light to the minds
of ordinary people.
131I honestly want to know
everything you teach.
132Think about me and be kind,
just as you are to everyone
who loves your name.
133Keep your promise
and don't let me stumble
or let sin control my life.
134Protect me from abuse,
so I can obey your laws.
135Smile on me, your servant,
and teach me your laws.
136When anyone disobeys you,
my eyes overflow with tears.
137Our Lord, you always do right,
and your decisions are fair.
138All your teachings are true
and trustworthy.
139It upsets me greatly
when my enemies neglect
your teachings.
140Your word to me, your servant,
is like pure gold;
I treasure what you say.
141Everyone calls me a nobody,
but I remember your laws.
142You will always do right,
and your teachings are true.
143I am in deep distress,
but I love your teachings.
144Your rules are always fair.
Help me to understand them
and live.
145I pray to you, Lord!
Please answer me.
I promise to obey your laws.
146I beg you to save me,
so I can follow your rules.
147Even before sunrise,
I pray for your help,
and I put my hope
in what you have said.
148I lie awake at night,
thinking of your promises.
149Show that you love me, Lord,
and answer my prayer.
Please do the right thing
and save my life.
150People who disobey your Law
have made evil plans
and want to hurt me,
151but you are with me,
and all your commands
can be trusted.
152From studying your laws,
I found out long ago
you made them to last forever.
153I have not forgotten your Law!
Look at the trouble I am in,
and rescue me.
154Be my defender and protector!
Remember your promise
and save my life.
155Evil people won't obey you,
and so they have no hope
of being saved.
156You are merciful, Lord!
Please do the right thing
and save my life.
157I have a lot of brutal enemies,
but still I never turn
from your laws.
158Those unfaithful people
who refuse to obey you
are disgusting to me.
159Remember how I love your laws,
and show your love for me
by keeping me safe.
160All you say can be trusted;
your teachings are true
and will last forever.
161Rulers are cruel to me
for no reason.
But with all my heart
I respect your words,
162because they bring happiness
like treasures taken in war.
163I can't stand liars,
but I love your Law.
164I praise you seven times a day
because your laws are fair.
165You give peace of mind
to all who love your Law.
Nothing can make them fall.
166You are my only hope
for being saved, Lord,
and I do all you command.
167I love and obey your laws
with all my heart.
168You know everything I do.
You know I respect every law
you have given.
169Please, Lord, hear my prayer
and give me the understanding
that comes from your word.
170Listen to my concerns
and keep me safe,
just as you have promised.
171If you will teach me your laws,
I will praise you 172and sing
about your promise,
because all your teachings
are what they ought to be.
173Be ready to protect me
because I have chosen
to obey your laws.
174I am waiting for you
to save me, Lord.
Your Law makes me happy.
175Keep me alive,
so I can praise you,
and let me find help
in your teachings.
176I am your servant,
but I have wandered away
like a lost sheep.
Please come after me,
because I have not forgotten
your teachings.

Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg wia
1Banla n waa chɔgri maa dɔɔwɛ,
baabuu ra hiŋ
Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg la,
ba nuu sumaa.
2Banla maa n na hiŋ u widaulaa,
di ra sɛɛ u wia
ani ba biine maa,
ba nuu sumaa.
3Ba waa wichɔgaa ra ɛɛ,
ka ra hiŋ u ŋmɛnizi.
4N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
i tɛɛ yaabuu i Gbɔgni,
di ŋɔ ya ra hiŋaa
ni wibii.
5A vii ɛɛ lugɔ n wettoo
di ra hiŋ
i widaulaa la nɛnnɛ!
6Gunnɛ maa wer di hiihzi,
di n na hiŋ
i widaulaa nɛnnɛ.
7Minna helli i seriyazi dii n deŋlee la wia,
n daŋ chɔlii ani biinihuŋŋu.
8N danna hiŋ i Gbɔgni la!
Gilɛɛ wa vɛɛŋ ta kɔrai!
Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg hiŋaa wia
9Ɛrɛɛ biipɔllii wia wer ɛɛ di deŋlei?
See unna hiŋ i widaulaa.
10N kpa n biini maanii ra hiŋii,
gilɛɛ gil n waa leu,
i widaulaa la hiŋaa biini.
11N kpa i Gbɔgrɛ du n biini,
ń gilɛɛ kaa wàá
ɛɛ wichɔgii maa
di ra zuu i ni.
12N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n daŋ chɔlii,
bagliŋ i ŋmɛnizi.
13N daŋ kuari ŋɔ i Gbɔgni la maa
hiŋ tɛɛ yaa la wia.
14N bɔra sɔɔnɔɔrɛ minna hiŋ i Gbɔgni la,
di kaali
daama werge dɔɔi.
15N daŋ helli i widaulaa la,
di ra pessi
i baglaa la ge nɛnnɛ.
16I Gbɔgni wia ra parimbuu werge,
màá suuh
i widaulaa ge wia.
Bɔsɔna la n du Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg biini wia
17Ɛɛŋ winanii, mìŋ́ i balii wer dɔɔ miibɔɔ,
guŋ gil ń wer hiŋ i nua.
18Pilli n siwee ń wer na
nuukpuuri wia la n du
i Gbɔg biini la.
19N ɛɛ hɔɔhrii hɛri naa biini,
awia, gilɛɛ kpa
i widaulaa la
suah n ni.
20N na kɛlli i Gbɔgni ninɛɛ
di ra nyiŋŋi
n zumaa saŋa maa.
21I ɔɔ hau banla n na jigsi ninɛɛ,
di see banla n vɛɛ
i widaulaa hiŋaa nua.
22Lɛɛŋ lii ba huuhni ni ba chɛɛtɛ ɛɛi be,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n na hiŋ
i widaulaarɛ.
23Haali koora n soge di ra ta n jina gba,
ka n danna helli
i baglaazi la.
24I baglaa labuu ra pariŋ,
aabuu ra biriŋ liize.
Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg hiŋaa siaahmu ni wia
25N na nyiŋŋi siwaarɛ,
bir tɛŋ fɔŋŋa gunla
hiŋ ŋɔ nua la.
26N bagli wia la maa miŋ ɛɛwɛɛ tɛi, i nuu tɛŋ,
awia, bagliŋ i widaulaa.
27Bagliŋ n zum i Gbɔgni la zɛɛzi,
di wer a lɔ
i nuukpuuri wia fasani.
28N bɔra maanii huahwɛ ni biinichɔg,
gil n dɔɔ fɔŋŋa gunla
hiŋ ŋɔ nua la.
29Gilɛɛ gil n waa leu,
suŋ n ni, di bagliŋ i Gbɔg la.
30N sɛɛ wibii ŋmɛnɛɛ hiŋaarɛ,
n bampirii ge lau i Gbɔgni la.
31N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
n hiŋ i baglaa labuu,
gilɛɛ gil n waa di hiihzi!
32N daŋ aah siwii di ra hiŋ i baglaazi,
dikuubɛɛwiai, i daŋ gil
n dɔɔ wia zɛɛ
zumaa werge.
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi wia zɛɛ zumaa
33N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bagliŋ i Gbɔgni la zɛɛzi,
ń wer ra hiŋaa saŋa maa.
34Tɛŋ wia zɛɛ zumaa, ń zum i Gbɔg la,
di wer a hiŋaa ni n biini maa.
35Bagliŋ i widaulaa ŋmɛnɛɛ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, aabuu
ra tɛŋ bɔsɔna.
36Bir n bampirii du i Gbɔgni ni,
ka u gilɛɛ waa
du kundɔɔi ni.
37Lizi n laakal lii kumpɛɛri ni,
ka ra guuŋ n de dui biini,
gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua la.
38Hiŋ nua la hiŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ i balii la,
guŋ gil bá ra ɔmii.
39Lɛɛŋ lii hiihzi la minna ɔm la biini,
dikuubɛɛwiai, i Gbɔgni wessoo.
40N na kɛlli i nuuzi ninɛɛ werge!
Awia, guu n miibɔɔ,
dikuu i wideŋlaa wia.
Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg yardaa wia
41N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bagliŋ gunla hiŋ nɔŋŋiŋ mag,
ka lɛɛŋ gunla
hiŋ ŋɔ nua la.
42Denii n jaa wer ŋɔ wia tɛɛ banla n na chagziŋ la,
dikuu miŋ yardi
i wiŋɔzi wia.
43Hiiniŋ, ń wer di ra ŋɔ wibii saŋa maa,
dikuu n tamii maa n du
i widaulaa la ni wia.
44N daŋ ɔɔ ra hiŋ i Gbɔg,
saŋaa saŋa maa.
45N daŋ jaa so ni bampirsɔna nɛnnɛ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n ɛɛ aniaa
di hiŋ i baglaazi.
46N daŋ sii i widaulaa la koora see,
ka màá di hiihzi.
47I widaulaa hiŋaa parimbuu,
dikuu min nɔŋŋaa wia.
48N na tɔgzi i widaulaa labuu, di nɔŋŋaa
n danna fɛ a wia.
Kɔraawiizi Gbɔgni yardaa wia
49N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
a liizi nua la hiŋ ŋɔwɛɛ
tɛɛ i balii la,
u gillɔɔ n dɔɔ tamii.
50Haali n tɔɔrɔɔ dii gba biini,
ka n dɔɔ bɔsɔnaa,
dikuubɛɛwiai, i nuuŋɔɔlii la
tɛmbuu miibɔɔ.
51Banla n kpoŋŋe la ra ɛɛmbuu chɛɛtɛ,
ka maa i Gbɔg la vɛɛwɛ ta.
52N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, di n wa liizi i faala maa Gbɔgni la wia,
a ɔɔ ra tɛmbuu bɔsɔna.
53Di n wa na biinikpola hina
n na chɔgi i Gbɔg la,
n baaŋ ɔɔ fuuuh werge maa.
54N durnya biini de dui saŋa,
n yir yiraa di bagli
i widaulaa la wia.
55N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, anna liizi i wiarɛ hamuŋa ni,
di ra fɛ i Gbɔg la wia.
56N na n bɔsɔnaa
lii i widaulaa la hiŋaa biini.
Kɔraawiizi Gbɔgni hiŋaa siaahmu ni wia
57N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hinuu kunla maa min dɔɔwɛ,
n ŋɔ nuarɛ lugɔ
n danna hiŋ i Gbɔgni la.
58N na suŋŋiibuu ni n biini maa
lugɔ i na n sinyɛna,
gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua la.
59N pessi n wiɛɛlaarɛ,
di ŋɔ nua lugɔ
n danna hiŋ
i baglaazi la.
60N daŋ yali siwee,
di ra hiŋ i widaulaa la.
61Biinikpola hina hembuu sidɛɛzi,

wia suuhwɛ.
62Aŋ izuu hɛhhɛɛhzi ni di ra chɔlii,

63Banla maa n na ɔmii

ɛɛ n dammuzii.
64N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la, su hɛri naa maanii,

Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg tɔna wia
65N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i hiŋ i nuuŋɔɔlii labuu,

66Tɛŋ nunzuma ni sichaana,

i widaulaarɛ.
67N faa ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ, i tɛr n digni,

n jaa ra hiŋ i widaulaarɛ.
68I wia wessoo, i wiɛɛlaa ge du wer,

69Banla n kpoŋŋe kanni karaa di ra chugiŋ,

ni n biini maa.
70Ba waa wia zɛɛ zumaa dɔɔwɛ,
ka i Gbɔg wia parimbuu.
71Hiŋ faa tɛr n digni la, guŋ wessoo tɛŋ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, guŋ gillɔɔ
n helli i widaulaa la.
72I Gbɔg la wessoo tɛŋ,
di kaali saliŋ
ni saliŋhuŋŋa kagboŋa.
Gunla Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg wia n dɔɔ wibii
73Hinuu taŋ di ra guuŋ,
awia, tɛŋ wia zɛɛ zumaa
ń helli i widaulaa.
74Banla n na tɛi girme la daŋ naŋ, bá bɔra sɔɔni,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n yardi
i nuuŋɔɔlii labuu.
75N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n zummɔ lugɔ i seriya dii deŋloore.

dikuu i wia
n dɔɔ wibii wia.
76Gil i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la tɛŋ bɔsɔna,
gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua
tɛɛ mìŋ́ i balii la.
77Suŋ n ni n wer du de,
dikuubɛɛwiai, i Gbɔg
labuu ra tɛŋ bɔsɔna.
78Gil banla n na gbɛllii la di hiihzi,
dikuu baŋ kanni kara
di ra chugiŋ pɛɛpɛɛ wia,
ka miŋwaa danna lɔ

79Gil banla maa n na ɔmii

i widaulaa zɛɛzi ba n be.
80Gil n na hiŋ i widaulaa la nɛnnɛ,
gunnɛ màá di hiihzi.
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi lɛɛi wia
81N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n bɔra maanii huahwɛ,
dikuu minna kpaŋii
i lɛɛŋ wia.

82N siwee waa kaa ra na nɛnnɛ,

ŋmɛnɛɛ wia.

85Banla n kpoŋŋe ki bɔɔnii bá lawiŋ,
ba waa i Gbɔg ra hiŋ.
86I widaulaa maa dɛg yardaarɛ nɛnnɛ,
nɛra kanni karaa

87A ka tama ka ba tuŋ n wia durnya naa biini,
ka maa i widaulaa la
vɛɛwɛ ta.

lɛɛŋ, ń wer di ra hiŋ
i baglaazi la.
Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg yardaa wia
89N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i wiŋɔɔlii du denii saŋa maa,
u du chinne chigigi.
90I wibii dɔɔi du denii di ra la jimini maa.

91Hinuu gillɛ kummaa du de di wa lii ni zinaa,
dikuubɛɛwiai, a maanii
ra humii.
92Di i Gbɔg la faa wanna tɛɛ bɔsɔna,
keŋ n vii siuwɔ

93N ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá suuh i baglaazi la wia,
dikuubɛɛwiai, aabuu

94N ɛɛ i hotte, lɛɛŋ!

i widaulaa la.
95Biinikpola hina sogo sagaa, bá chɔgi n wia,
ka n daŋ fɛ
i Gbɔgni la nfɛrɛ.
96N zummɔɔ lugɔ kummaanii dɔɔ tunaa,
ka i widaulaa la waa
du denii di hanna la.
Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg nɔŋŋaa wia
97N nɔŋŋi i Gbɔg labuu nɛnnɛ!
Anna fɛ u nfɛrɛɛ
hɔpizii maa.
98I widaulaa la gillɔɔ
n dɔɔ nunzuma
di kaali n dɔma,
dikuu aŋ du n be
saŋa maa wia.
99N dɔɔ wia zɛɛ zumaarɛ di kaali n bagla,
dikuubɛɛwiai, anna lɔ
i baglaazi la fasanii.
100N dɔɔ nunzumaa kaali nɛbinaa,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n na hiŋ
i baglaazii.
101N na ɛɛ aniaa n gilɛɛ waa lɔ naachɔgii maa,
dikuu minna
nyiŋŋi n hiŋ
i wiŋɔɔlii wia.
102Maa i widaulaa la vɛɛwɛ ta,
dikuubɛɛwiai, i himmaanii
ɛɛ n bagli.
103I wiŋɔzi hiŋaa summɔɔ tɛŋ,
a summɔɔ
kaali huuhnuu.
104N dɔɔ nunzumaa di lii i baglaazi la biini,
awia, n hah
machɔgaa maanii.

105I wiŋɔɔlii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ fintina,
di ra chaani n ŋmɛnɛɛ.
106N hɛɛhzɔɔrɛ di ŋɔ nua lugɔ
n danna hiŋ i Gbɔgni la

107N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n tɔɔrɔɔ kannɔɔ werge,
tɛŋ miibɔɔfalii
gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua la.
108N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛ n wiisuŋŋaa,
ka bagliŋ i Gbɔgni la.
109Maa ɔɔ suuh i baglaazi la wia,
haali miŋ ɔɔ du
siaahmu biini gba.
110Biinikpola hina hembuu sidɛɛ,
ka maa i widaulaa la
hiŋaa vɛɛwɛ.
111I Gbɔgni la ɛɛ n daamaa saŋaa saŋa maa,
aabuu ra tɛŋ bɔsɔna
n biini.
112N aah siwiire ń hiŋ i widaulaa,
di ra ba hɔpizii la
min niŋ siu.
Hindɔɔi n du Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg biini wia
113N hah banla n wɛɛ ra hiŋ ni wibii labuu,
ka miŋwaa nɔŋŋi i Gbɔgrɛ.
114Hinuu n duuribɔr ni n guuri,
n tamii du i nuuŋɔɔlii la ninɛɛ.
115Wichɔgɛɛra, ií lii n be,
ka giliŋ n na hiŋ Kɔraawiizi la
minna hum la widaulaa!
116Tɛŋ fɔŋŋa gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua la, ń dɔɔ miibɔɔ,
gilɛɛ gil n tamii bir pɛɛ.
117Lawiŋ, ń wer na lɛɛi,
di ɔɔ ra hiŋ
i widaulaa la.
118I ɔɔ vɛɛ banla maa n waa i Gbɔgni ra hiŋ labuu ta,
ba nɛdaraa la
maa bir pɛɛ.
119I ɔɔ ra ɛɛ hɛri naa
biinikpola hina
maanii alugɔ zɔga,
guŋ wia, n nɔŋŋi
i baglaazii.
120N bɔra ra sau dikuu minna ɔmii wia,
ɔnsii lawiŋ werge maa,
dikuu i Gbɔgni wia.
Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg hiŋaa wia
121N ɛɛ wideŋlaa ani winanaarɛ,
awia, gilɛɛ giliŋ
tɛɛ n dɔma.
122Ŋɔ nua lugɔ i daŋ hiini mìŋ́ i balii,
gilɛɛ gil banla
n kpoŋŋe la ra sunniŋ.
123N siwee waa kaa ra na nɛnnɛ, dikuu minna binni i lɛɛi ni
i wideŋlaa nuuŋɔɔlii
ŋmɛnɛɛ wia.
124Ɛɛŋ gunla i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ n na bagli,
di bagliŋ i widaulaa la.
125N ɛɛ i baliirɛ,
awia, tɛŋ wia zɛɛ zumaa,
ń wer zum i baglaazi la.
126N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, saŋa jaa heluu lugɔ i ɛɛ wii bɛl,
dikuubɛɛwiai, nɛra
ra chɔgi i Gbɔg labuu.
127Ka miŋwaa nɔŋŋi i widaulaa labuu kaali saliŋ,
di kaali
salinnanaa himmaa.
128Awia, n na hiŋ i baglaazi maanii,
ka hah
wichɔgii maa ŋmɛnɛɛ.
Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg hiŋaa nyiŋŋaa wia
129I baglaazi la ɛɛ wizenaare,
awia, n na hiŋaabuu
ni n biini maa.
130I baglaazi wia zɛɛ pillaa ra ba bɔchaaŋ ninɛɛ,
di ra tɛɛ bambuguu
wia zɛɛ zumaa.
131N na hɛguu
dikuu i widaulaa wia.
132A nuu n be, di na n sinyɛna,
gunla hiŋ ɔɔ ra ɛɛ
banla n nɔŋŋii la.
133Gilɛɛ gil n wàá lɔ naa, gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua la,
di gilɛɛ gil wichɔgii maa
wàá di kora n ni.
134Lɛɛŋ lii nɛra la n na sunniŋ be,
ń wer di ra hiŋ
i widaulaa la.
135Bir i siwee chaŋ n be,
di bagliŋ i Gbɔgni.
136N sinii ra paluu alugɔ muu,
dikuu nɛra n waa
i Gbɔg la ra hiŋ wia.
Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg wibii dɔɔi wia
137N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i wia deŋloore,
i Gbɔgni ge dɔɔ wibii.
138I widaulaa la deŋloore,
a waa bilaa dɔɔwɛ.
139N baaŋ na fuuuh werge,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n dɔma
suuh i wiŋɔɔlaarɛ.
140I nuuŋɔɔlii waa ɛɛwɛ ra huhzi!
Na gunla miŋ nɔŋŋaa!
141Nɛdumaa miŋ, ba ra gbɛlliŋ,
ka maa
i baglaazi la vɛɛwɛ.
142I wideŋlaa du denii ra la,
i Gbɔg ge dɔɔ wibii.
143Tɔɔrɔɔ ni biinichɔg werge lawimbuu,
ka i widaulaa la ɛɛ
n bɔsɔna kunaa.
144I baglaazi ɔɔ deŋluu saŋa maa,
awia, tɛŋ wia zɛɛ zumaa,
ń wer dɔɔ miibɔɔ.
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi lɛɛi wia
145N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n na yiriibuu ni n biini maa,
a nuu n be,
ka n jaa ra hiŋ
i widaulaa la!
146N lɔ wilee tɛi, lɛɛŋ,
ka n jaa ra hiŋ
i baglaazi la.
147Aŋ izuu chɔɔzimpikke ni, di lɔ wile di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa,
n tamii maa du
i nuuŋɔɔlii la ninɛɛ.
148Hamuŋa maa, n siwii waa ɔɔ tɔ,
ka n ɔɔ ra lɔ
i nuuŋɔɔlaa la fasanii.
149N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, nuu n be, dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia,
bagliŋ i nɛsunaa dɔɔi la,
di ra guuŋ!
150Banla n na ta jinachɔgaa la duglɔɔrɛ,
ka ba ni i Gbɔg la
waa nɛɛwɔɔ dɔŋa ni.
151N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i duglimbuu,
i widaulaa la maa
ge ɛɛ wibii.
152N helli i baglaazi la wiarɛ birgi,
di jaa zum lugɔ
i dawaabuu,
á du de di ra la.
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa wia
153Binni n tɔɔrɔɔ ka lɛɛŋ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, maa i Gbɔg la
wia suuhwɛ.
154Ŋɔ wia lɛɛŋ,
a guuŋ gunla
hiŋ ŋɔ nua la.
155Biinikpola hina wàá wer na lɛɛi,
dikuubɛɛwiai, ba waa
i Gbɔgni la ra hiŋ.
156N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i nɛsunaa dɔɔi kannɔɔ werge.
Awia, na n sinyɛna
di lɛɛŋ.
157N dɔɔ dɔma kpila n na sunnimbuu,
ka maa i Gbɔgni la
hiŋaa vɛɛwɛ.
158Anna binni yarda nyaara ni hahzii,
dikuubɛɛwiai, ba waa
i wiŋɔɔlii la ra hiŋ.
159N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, na gunla minna nyiŋŋi i baglaazi la wia,
i nɔŋŋaa
waa birgaa dɔɔwɛ,
awia, lɛɛŋ!
160I wiŋɔɔlaa maa ɛɛ wibiire,
i Gbɔgni la n deŋlee
la ge du denii
di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa.
Kɔraawiizi Gbɔgni hiŋaa ni wibii wia
161Fɔŋŋa hina ra tɔɔrimbuu gunla n waa dɛkkɛ,
ka n na tɔgzi
i Gbɔg labuu.
162N bɔra sɔɔnɔɔrɛ i nuuŋɔɔlii la wia
alugɔ nɛr n kpaani
daama kuŋ.
163N hah karaa, di kii a wia,
ka n nɔŋŋi
i Gbɔg labuu.
164Hɔpizii maa, aŋ jaamiibuu buniidaanɛɛ,
dikuu i widaulaa
n deŋlee wia.
165Banla n nɔŋŋi i Gbɔg la dɔɔ bampirsɔnaa werge maa,
kummaa wàá wer gil
ba lɔ naa.
166N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n na kpaŋiibuu lugɔ i lɛɛŋ,
n na hiŋ i widaulaarɛ.
167N na hiŋ i baglaazi labuu,
dikuu miŋ nɔŋŋaa
ni n biini maa wia.
168N na hiŋ i widaulaa ni i baglaazi labuu,
i zum n wiɛɛlaa maanii.
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa wia
169N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil n wile naa helii,
í tɛŋ wia zɛɛ zumaa
gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua la.
170A nuu n wiisuŋŋaa,
di lɛɛŋ gunla
hiŋ ŋɔ nua la!
171N danna chɔlii saŋa maa,
dikuubɛɛwiai, i ra baglimbuu
i Gbɔgni la hiŋaa.
172N danna yir i Gbɔgni la wia yira, dikuubɛɛwiai,
