i widaulaa deŋloore.
173Ɛɛ sirya di ra hiiniŋ saŋa maa,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n na hiŋ
i baglaazi labuu.
174N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n na kpaŋiibuu lugɔ i lɛɛŋ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, i Gbɔg
labuu ra tɛŋ bɔsɔna.
175Tɛŋ miibɔɔ, ń wer di ra chɔlii,
gil i baglaazi la tɛŋ fɔŋŋa.
176N leuwoo di ra juuri alugɔ peezi n leuwe,
n ɛɛ i baliirɛ, nyiŋŋiŋ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, maa
i Gbɔgni vɛɛwɛ ta.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1When I am in trouble, I pray,
2“Come and save me, Lord,
from deceitful liars!”
3What punishment is fitting
for you deceitful liars?
4Your reward should be
sharp and flaming arrows!
5But I must live as a foreigner
among the people of Meshech
and in the tents of Kedar.
6I have spent too much time
living among people
who hate peace.
7I am in favor of peace,
but when I speak of it,
all they want is war.
translation_text:
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa wia
1N tɔɔrɔɔ biini, n yir Kɔraawiizii,
u nuu n wiisuŋŋaa.
2N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ lii karkanna
ni nɛdatta be.
3Karkanna, ɛrɛɛ Kɔraawiizi dau iai?
Ɛrɛɛ ú tɛr ii dignai?
4Laallɔɔra hobidiilaa
ni niŋhɔlaa
u kpa tɔɔri ia!
5Ii be sogaa chummɔɔ alugɔ miŋ soge Mɛsɛk
ni Kɛda hina n ɛɛ
biinikpola hina biini.
6N zuu nɛra la n hah bampirsɔna benii
di birgi werge.
7Di n waa ŋɔ bampirsɔna wia,
laal wiarɛ ba ge ɔɔ ra ŋɔ.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Will Protect His People
1I look to the hills!
Where will I find help?
2It will come from the Lord,
who created heaven and earth.
3The Lord is your protector,
and he won't go to sleep
or let you stumble.
4The protector of Israel
doesn't doze
or ever get drowsy.
5The Lord is your protector,
there at your right side
to shade you from the sun.
6You won't be harmed
by the sun during the day
or by the moon at night.
7The Lord will protect you
and keep you safe
from all dangers.
8The Lord will protect you
now and always
wherever you go.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizii yaa guuri
1N lalli n siweere di ra binni bizenaa nyuuni.
Lee n hiinaa
lii banɛi?
2N hiinaa daŋ lii Kɔraawiizi be,
waabuu ta chiŋ ni hɛri.
3Wàá sɛɛ i chol,
i guuri waa dɔɔ ra chɔɔ.
4Unla n na binni Izrɛl hina ni
waa daari gɛɛ
di ra chɔɔ dɔɔ.
5Kɔraawiizii ɛɛ ii guuri.
U du ii benii
di ra binni ia.
6Wiizi wàá baari ia hɔpizaa saŋa,
baagu gba wàá ɛɛ ia
wiimaa hamuŋa ni.
7Kɔraawiizi daŋ lɛɛ ia lii wichɔgii maa biini.
U daŋ kpa
u nonii tɔ ii ni.
8Kɔraawiizi daŋ guu ia, di ii waa lii gɛɛ di ii waa zuu,
di lii filaŋkeŋ,
di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa.

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
A Song of Praise
1It made me glad when they said,
“Let's go to the house
of the Lord!”
2Jerusalem, we are standing
inside your gates.
3Jerusalem, what a strong
and beautiful city you are!
4Every tribe of the Lord
obeys him and comes to you
to praise his name.
5David's royal throne is here
where justice rules.
6Jerusalem, we pray
that you will have peace,
and that all will go well
for those who love you.
7May there be peace
inside your city walls
and in your palaces.
8Because of my friends
and my relatives,
I will pray for peace.
9And because of the house
of the Lord our God,
I will work for your good.
translation_text:
Bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm chɔlaa yir
Koori Deevid yir
1N bɔra faa sɔɔnɔɔrɛ,
saŋa la baŋ wa ŋɔ n be,
“Gil ya la
Kɔraawiizi Dia la.”
2Yaa naazi jaa chi Jɛrusalɛm
dominuuzenaa labuu filaŋkeŋ!
3Ba ma bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛmnɛ nɛnnɛ,
u diini far dɔŋa,
di du wer werge.
4Denii a nɛra dizi la maa ɔɔ ra ba,
Izrɛl hina dizi la,
di waa tɛɛ
Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ,
di ra darguu,
gunla uŋ bagli baa la.
5Denii Koori Deevid domee koora ɔɔ faa so,
di ra di nɛra seriya.
6Ií suŋŋi bampirsɔna ra tɛɛ bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm, di ra ŋɔ,
“Gil banla maa
n nɔŋŋii nyɛɛli!
7Gil bampirsɔna du i biini,
koozaa ge gilɛɛ du
i kooridiini.”
8Dikuu n lulla ni n dammuzi wia,
n ŋɔ Jɛrusalɛm benii,
“Bampirsɔna du i biini.”
9Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi Dia wiarɛ
n suŋŋi nyɛɛlaa
di ra tɛi la.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for Mercy
1Our Lord and our God,
I turn my eyes to you,
on your throne in heaven.
2Servants look to their master,
but we will look to you,
until you have mercy on us.
3Please have mercy, Lord!
We have been insulted
more than we can stand,
4and we can't take more abuse
from those proud,
conceited people.
translation_text:
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi nɛra nisunaa wia
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
hinuu n na binni chiŋ,
bɔr la hiŋ di kora la.
2Gunla balii n ɔɔ ra dɛlli u dɔɔri bɛŋ ni la,
gúnnɛ n dɛllii,
di ra ba saŋa la
hin niŋ wa na
yaa sinyɛna.
3N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, suŋ yaa ni,
dikuubɛɛwiai, nɛra hah
yaabuu birgi.
4Dɔɔna lɔ yaabuu mɔmɔsia birgi,
banla n na jigsi ge
gbɛlli yaa birgi.

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
Thanking the Lord for Victory
1The Lord was on our side!
Let everyone in Israel say:
2“The Lord was on our side!
Otherwise, the enemy attack
3would have killed us all,
because it was furious.
4We would have been swept away
in a violent flood
5of high and roaring waves.”
6Let's praise the Lord!
He protected us from enemies
who were like wild animals,
7and we escaped like birds
from a hunter's torn net.
8The Lord made heaven and earth,
and he is the one
who sends us help.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizii u nɛra guuri
Koori Deevid yir
1Di Kɔraawiizi faa waa yaa be duwɛɛ,
ɛrɛɛ ii ŋɔi, Izrɛl hina?
2Di Kɔraawiizi lɛi faa du yaa be,
yaa dɔma
n faa izi yaa ni la,
3ba daŋ faa lil yaa nyinee,
saŋa la ba baana
n faa fuuh yaa ni la,
4a niizenaa daŋ faa paagi yaa kaali,
a niilɔkpega daŋ faa wa
tɔ yaa ni,
5a niilɔkpega hiŋ daŋ faa paa yaa kaali.
6Ií gil ya ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ,
dikuu uŋ waa
yaa kpawɛɛ tɛɛ
yaa dɔma
ba chuuri wia.
7Yaa foozoore alugɔ sidɛɛ n lau zumbee u foozi.
A sidɛɛ kuwoore,
yaa na yaa hinaa.
8Yaa hiinaa lii Kɔraawiizi la
n ta chiŋ ni hɛri benii.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord's People Are Safe
1Everyone who trusts the Lord
is like Mount Zion
that cannot be shaken
and will stand forever.
2Just as Jerusalem is protected
by mountains on every side,
the Lord protects his people
by holding them in his arms
now and forever.
3He won't let the wicked
rule his people
or lead them to do wrong.
4Let's ask the Lord to be kind
to everyone who is good
and completely obeys him.
5When the Lord punishes
the wicked,
he will punish everyone else
who lives an evil life.
Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi nɛra hindɔɔi wia
1Banla n yardi Kɔraawiizi la ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ Bizeŋ Ziɔn
n waa ziigaa dɔɔwɛ,
ka chi chigigi
saŋa maa la.
2Gunla a bizenaa n bar Jɛrusalɛm,
di guuu la,
gúnnɛ Kɔraawiizi bar
u nɛra saŋaa saŋa maa.
3Biinikpola hina wàá di kora,
banla wia
n deŋlee hɛri ni,
di gunna ɛɛ, aŋhinabe, banla wia n deŋlee la
gba daŋ birgi wichɔgɛɛra.
4N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ɛɛ winanaa tɛɛ banla wia n wesse
ni banla n ɛɛ
biinihuŋŋu hina.
5Ka di i waa tɛr biikpola hina digna,
tɛr banla ge n vɛɛ
i ŋmɛnizi hiŋaa la digna.
Izrɛl hina, Kɔ́raawiizi tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna!

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Celebrating the Harvest
1It seemed like a dream
when the Lord brought us back
to the city of Zion.
2We celebrated with laughter
and joyful songs.
In foreign nations it was said,
“The Lord has worked miracles
for his people.”
3And so we celebrated
because the Lord had indeed
worked miracles for us.
4Our Lord, we ask you to bless
our people again,
and let us be like streams
in the Southern Desert.
5We cried as we went out
to plant our seeds.
Now let us celebrate
as we bring in the crops.
6We cried on the way
to plant our seeds,
but we will celebrate and shout
as we bring in the crops.
translation_text:
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi lɛɛi wia
1Saŋa la Kɔraawiizi n bir yaa ni
ba Jɛrusalɛm la,
a faa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ deeza.
2Yaa faa mammɔɔ, di yir bɔsɔna yira.
Denii hɛrdumazi nɛra
faa ŋɔ yaa wia keŋ,
“Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ
wizenaare tɛɛ baa.”
3Wibii maa, u ɛɛ wizenaare tɛɛ yaa,
yaa bɔra sɔɔni werge maa!
4N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, kaa gil ya nyɛɛli,
gunla dooŋ n ɔɔ ba,
nii su gɔmbɔɔhilaa la.
5Gil banla n na duu ka ra wii la,
kpa ba kuna ni bɔsɔna.
6Banla n chigɛ kundee
di lii ra la bá ga duu,
ka ra wii la,
daŋ bir ba,
di ra yir yira ni bɔsɔna,
dikuu kuna la
baŋ kpawɛɛ
di ra ba la wia.

english_text:
(A song by Solomon for worship.)
Only the Lord Can Bless a Home
1Without the help of the Lord
it is useless to build a home
or to guard a city.
2It is useless to get up early
and stay up late
in order to earn a living.
God takes care of his own,
even while they sleep.
3Children are a blessing
and a gift from the Lord.
4Having a lot of children
to take care of you
in your old age
is like a warrior
with a lot of arrows.
5The more you have,
the better off you will be,
because they will protect you
when your enemies
attack you in court.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi winanaa ɛɛi chɔlaa yir
Koori Solomɔn yir
1Di Kɔraawiizi waa dia mawɛɛ,
u maara
ra kuuuh pɛɛ.
Di waa bolzeŋ ge guuwe,
u guure chigɔɔ pɛɛ.
2Wipɛɛrii lugɔ i ra kpu i hiŋ,
di ra hum huma
ra binni i hiŋ,
di feli izaa,
di waa chɔɔ saŋkara,
dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizii ɔɔ ra tɛɛ banla uŋ nɔŋŋɛɛ kuna,
haali banna
chɔɔgi dɔzi gba.
3Biizi ɛɛ sunzaarɛ lii Kɔraawiizi be,
ba ɛɛ kissaa himmaanii.
4Baal pɔlaa saŋa biibaala
ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ hobee,
laallɔɔri nonee biini.
5Baal la dee n dɔɔ a hobee naa kpila,
nuu sumaa.
Di u wa chem u dɔma ni,
ba wàá wer kpegluu maa.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Rewards His Faithful People
1The Lord will bless you
if you respect him
and obey his laws.
2Your fields will produce,
and you will be happy—
all will go well.
3Your wife will be as fruitful
as a grapevine,
and just as an olive tree
is rich with olives,
your home will be rich
with healthy children.
4This is how the Lord will bless
everyone who respects him.
5I pray that the Lord
will bless you from Zion
and let Jerusalem prosper
as long as you live.
6May you live long enough
to see your grandchildren.
Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi hiŋaa kinturgaa wia
1Banla n na ɔm Kɔraawiizi,
di ra hiŋ u widaulaa,
nuu sumaa.
2I huma daŋ tɛi kuna la wia n tirii,
í nyɛɛli, i bɔra sɔɔni.
3I haaŋ daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ daa la n na nɔŋ nɛnnɛ,
í biibaala ɛɛ alugɔ
daapɔla n na nɔŋ,
di bar i diiribɔr.
4Baal la maa n na hiŋ Kɔraawiizi nua,
u daŋ kissuu guŋ.
5Kɔ́raawiizi kissii lii Ziɔn!
Ú gil i na Jɛrusalɛm nyɛɛlaa,
i de dui saŋa,
6di gil i dɔɔ miibɔɔjaŋ,
di na i naanna!
Izrɛl hina, Kɔ́raawiizi tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna!

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for Protection
1Since the time I was young,
enemies have often attacked!
Let everyone in Israel say:
2“Since the time I was young,
enemies have often attacked!
But they have not defeated me,
3though my back is like a field
that has just been plowed.”
4The Lord always does right,
and he has set me free
from the ropes
of those cruel people.
5I pray that all who hate
the city of Zion
will be made ashamed
and forced to turn and run.
6May they be like grass
on the flat roof of a house,
grass that dries up
as soon as it sprouts.
7Don't let them be like wheat
gathered in bundles.
8And don't let anyone
who passes by say to them,
“The Lord bless you!
I give you my blessing
in the name of the Lord.”
translation_text:
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi lugɔ Kɔ́raawiizi kpegli Izrɛl hina dɔma wia
1Ba sunnimbuu werge di lii n pɔlaa saŋa maa.
Gil Izrɛl ŋɔ,
2“Di lii n pɔlaa saŋa maa, n dɔma sunnimbuu werge,
ka ba waa wette kpegliŋ.
3Ba faa ŋmɛnni n harbɔɔrɛ,
a ŋmɛra du luŋ
alugɔ tiraata n par bɔr.
4Ka Kɔraawiizi la wia n deŋlee la
lɛɛmbuu lii yonni biini.”
5Gil ba kpegli banla maa n hah Ziɔn,
bá bir har.
6Kɔ́raawiizi gil ba ɛɛ lugɔ sal kooree
n waa ɔɔ hel, ka siu la.
7Nɛr maa waa ɔɔ chaalaa
gɛɛ di vɔɔzaa chi kaali.
8Nɛr la maa n ga de di ra kaali, wàá ŋɔ,
“Kɔ́raawiizi kissii
gɛɛ yaa ra kissiibuu
Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ biini!”

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Trusting the Lord in Times of Trouble
1From a sea of troubles
I cry out to you, Lord.
2Won't you please listen
as I beg for mercy?
3If you kept record of our sins,
no one could last long.
4But you forgive us,
and so we will worship you.
5With all my heart,
I am waiting, Lord, for you!
I trust your promises.
6I wait for you more eagerly
than a soldier on guard duty
waits for the dawn.
Yes, I wait more eagerly
than a soldier on guard duty
waits for the dawn.
7Israel, trust the Lord!
God is always merciful
and has the power to save you.
8 Israel, the Lord will save you
from all your sins.
translation_text:
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa wia
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
n biini chɔkkɔɔ lugɔ
miŋ chol vil biini,
di wii ra yirii.
2A nuu n wile,
keŋŋi digna nuu,
ka suŋ n ni.
3N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, di i faa sɛbi newee wichɔgaa ra dau,
anɛɛ n wàá di bilchɔgɛi?
4Ka i gil yaa wichɔgaarɛ tɛɛ yaa,
guŋ gil ya ra ɔmii werge.
5N na kɛlli Kɔraawiizi hiinaa ninɛɛ werge,
n yardi u wiŋɔɔlaarɛ.
6N na kpaŋ Kɔraawiizii
kaali tauduura n ɔɔ ra
kpaŋ lugɔ hɔpizi manaŋ la.
7Izrɛl hina, ií yardi Kɔraawiizi,
dikuubɛɛwiai, u nɔŋŋaa
waa tuŋ,
u ɛɛ siryaa saŋa maa ú lɛɛ ia.
8U daŋ lɛɛ u nɛra Izrɛl hina
di lii ba wichɔgaa maa biini.

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
Trust the Lord!
1I am not conceited, Lord,
and I don't waste my time
on impossible schemes.
2But I have learned to feel safe
and satisfied,
like a young child
in its mother's arms.
3People of Israel,
you must trust the Lord
now and forever.
translation_text:
Sisɔna wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n gil n jigsaa labuu,
di bir har kpu n kpoŋaa la.
Wizenaa gɛɛ witittaa wia lɛi tiriŋ.
2Ka n siwii suwoore, n bampirii sɔɔni.
Gunla bichala
n ɔɔ chɔɔ u maa naazi
ni bɔɔiih la,
gunnɛ n banchule
waa kaa ra lɔ la.
3Izrɛl hina, ií yardi Kɔraawiizi filaŋkeŋ
ani saŋaa saŋa maa.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Is Always with His People
1Our Lord, don't forget David
and how he suffered.
2Mighty God of Jacob,
remember how he promised:
3“I won't go home
or crawl into bed
4or close my eyelids,
5until I find a home for you,
the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
6 When we were in Ephrath,
we heard that the sacred chest
was somewhere near Jaar.
7Then we said, “Let's go
to the throne of the Lord
and worship at his feet.”
8Come to your new home, Lord,
you and the sacred chest
with all its power.
9Let victory be like robes
for the priests;
let your faithful people
celebrate and shout.
10David is your chosen one,
so don't reject him.
11 You made a solemn promise
to David, when you said,
“I, the Lord, promise
that someone in your family
will always be king.
12If they keep our agreement
and follow my teachings,
then someone in your family
will rule forever.”
13You have gladly chosen Zion
as your home, our Lord.
14You said, “This is my home!
I will live here forever.
15I will bless Zion with food,
and even the poor will eat
until they are full.
16Victory will be like robes
for the priests,
and its faithful people
will celebrate and shout.
17 I will give mighty power
to the kingdom of David.
Each of my chosen kings
will shine like a lamp
18and wear a sparkling crown.
But I will disgrace
their enemies.”
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi Dia chɔlaa wia
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gilɛɛ waa suuh Koori Deevid
ani dɔgnya la maa
un diwee la wia.
2N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a liizi u nuuŋɔɔlaa la maa,
uŋ faa hɛɛhzɛɛ ŋɔ tɛɛ
hìŋ́ Fɔŋŋa Hiŋ la
Jekɔb n na hum la, di ŋɔ,
3“Màá la dia gɛɛ di waa chɔɔ dɔɔ,
4màá heezi gɛɛ
di chɔɔ dɔɔ,
5di maa bɔr mawɛɛ tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi,
ú ɛɛ Fɔŋŋa Hiŋ la
Jekɔb n na hum la Dia.”
6Yaa faa nuu Kɔraawiizi Ni U Nɛra Nuukpaŋ Dɔɔi Dakka la wiarɛ lii Bɛtlihɛm,
di wa nau Jiarim hina kooni.
7Denii yaa ŋɔ, “Ií gil ya la Kɔraawiizi Dia,
di ga chi u koorikara see
di jaamuu.
8Awia, n Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
izi í ni i Nɛra Nuukpaŋ Dɔɔi Dakka
la n na bagli i fɔŋŋa la,
wa du i Dia naa biini.
9Gil i kizeehina ra ɛɛ wideŋlaa,
di gil i nɛra ra chaasi,
dikuu ba bɔra n sɔɔnɛɛ wia!”
10Dikuu i balii Koori Deevid wia,
gilɛɛ waa vɛɛ koori la
hiŋ lizɛɛ, ba waaruu nuu la.
11I faa ŋɔ nuarɛ tɛɛ i balii Koori Deevid,
nua la hiŋ ŋmɛnɛ maa
n wàá bir la, di ŋɔ,
“N daŋ gil i biibaal bɛl, kpa i gawa, di di kora,
di i wa siuwɔ.
12Di ba ra hiŋ n ni baa nuukpaŋ
ni widaulaa la miŋ tɛɛ baa la,
ba biibaala gba danna di a kora,
saŋaa saŋa maa.”
13Kɔraawiizii lizi Ziɔn,
ú kpau birgi u bol.
14U ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ɛnnɛ ń so di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa,
ɛnnɛ n na nyiŋŋi n so
di ra di kora.
15N daŋ tɛɛ Ziɔn hina ba kunnyiŋŋaa maa nɛnnɛ,
di tɛɛ ba nyaara diwee
bá di piŋ.
16N daŋ kissi ba kizeehina,
ba wiɛɛlaa maa biini.
Ú nɛra ra yir yira,
di ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna.
17Denii ń gil Koori Deevid naanna la bɛl di kora,
di ɛɛ koorizeŋ,
di gil koori la miŋ lizɛɛ la
kora chi, di hanna la.
18N daŋ gil u dɔma di hiihzi werge,
ka u kora lawaa daŋ nyɛɛli,
di yaa.”

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Living Together in Peace
1It is truly wonderful
when the people of God
live together in peace.
2It is as beautiful as olive oil
poured on Aaron's head
and running down his beard
and the collar of his robe.
3It is like the dew
from Mount Hermon,
falling on Zion's mountains,
where the Lord has promised
to bless his people
with life forevermore.
translation_text:
De dui ni bampirsɔna chɔlaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1A wessoo werge maa di ɛɛ bɔsɔna,
di Kɔraawiizi nɛra
du dɔŋa be,
di dɔɔ nuukpaŋ!
2Guŋ ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nuu la yoola n kpolle,
baŋ kpawɛɛ waari
Aarɔn nyuu,
a pal ra tuu u taŋhuna,
di gaa zuu
u tagta baŋaa ni.
3U ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ Bizeŋ Hɛmɔn nyuu ŋmɛnii,
n pallɛ tuu
Ziɔn giŋgimee ni.
Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ nua lugɔ u daŋ kissi baa
ni miibɔɔ la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Praising the Lord at Night
1Everyone who serves the Lord,
come and offer praises.
Everyone who has gathered
in his temple tonight,
2lift your hands in prayer
toward his holy place
and praise the Lord.
3The Lord is the Creator
of heaven and earth,
and I pray that the Lord
will bless you from Zion.
translation_text:
Nɛra yiraa bá wa chɔli Kɔraawiizi wia
1Kɔraawiizi balaa, ií ra chɔluu,
ii banla maa n na hum
u Dia biini hamuŋa ni la,
ií ra chɔluu.
2Ií lalli ii nonee,
Kɔraawiizi Dia la biini, di chɔluu!
3Kɔ́raawiizi la n ta chiŋ ni hɛri,
kissi ia lii Ziɔn!

english_text:
In Praise of the Lord's Kindness
1Shout praises to the Lord!
You are his servants,
so praise his name.
2All who serve in the temple
of the Lord our God,
3come and shout praises.
Praise the name of the Lord!
He is kind and good.
4He chose the family of Jacob
and the people of Israel
for his very own.
5The Lord is much greater
than any other god.
6He does as he chooses
in heaven and on earth
and deep in the sea.
7The Lord makes the clouds rise
from far across the earth,
and he makes lightning
to go with the rain.
Then from his secret place
he sends out the wind.
8The Lord killed the first-born
of people and animals
in the land of Egypt.
9God used miracles and wonders
to fight the king of Egypt
and all of his officials.
10He destroyed many nations
and killed powerful kings,
11including King Sihon
of the Amorites
and King Og of Bashan.
He conquered every kingdom
in the land of Canaan
12and gave their property
to his people Israel.
13The name of the Lord
will be remembered forever,
and he will be famous
for all time to come.
14The Lord will bring justice
and show mercy to all
who serve him.
15 Idols of silver and gold
are made and worshiped
in other nations.
16They have a mouth and eyes,
but they can't speak or see.
17They are completely deaf,
and they can't breathe.
18Everyone who makes idols
and all who trust them
will end up as helpless
as their idols.
19Everyone in Israel,
come praise the Lord!
All the family of Aaron
20and all the tribe of Levi,
come praise the Lord!
All of his worshipers,
come praise the Lord.
21Praise the Lord from Zion!
He lives here in Jerusalem.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Chɔlaa yir
1Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!
Kɔraawiizi balaa, ií ra darguu,
2ii banla n na hum Kɔraawiizi Dia la, ií ra chɔluu.
3Ií ra chɔluu, dikuubɛɛwiai,
u wia wessoo.
Ií yir yira di ra darguu,
dikuubɛɛwiai, u wia wessoo.
4Waabuu lizi Jekɔb naanna,
Izrɛl hina, bá ɛɛ u hora.
5N zummɔ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa
kaali vuga maa.
6Wii la maa n paruu,
waabuu u ra ɛɛ chiŋ ni hɛri
ani muuni vile maa biine.
7Ɔɔ giluu baamazi la n na ba dooŋ ni la lii bɔr maa,
di gil a ra nyɛgzi.
Dia la biini unna dau kuna la,
denii ɔɔ gil peu lii.
8U faa kpu Ijip hɛri
newea ni sela maa biiluglaa.
9U faa ɛɛ wizenaa ni nuukpuuri wiarɛ de,
ú tɛr ba koori ni
u nabɔnzenaa maa digna.
10U faa chɔgi durnya hɛssi kpilaa,
di kpu koora la
n faa dɔɔ fɔŋŋazi werge la.
11Baabuu, Amɔri hina Koori Sihɔn,
Basan hina Koori Ɔɔg
ani koora la maa
n faa du Keenan hɛri la.
12Ka faa kpa ba hɛssi
tɛɛ u nɛra Izrɛl hina,
á ɛɛ ba kapɛttɛ kuna.
13N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
i sɔŋ waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ,
jimini maa hina
danna liizi i wia.
14Kɔraawiizi daŋ ŋɔ wia lɛɛ u nɛra,
di suŋ u balaa ni.
15Saliŋ ni saliŋhuŋŋaa ɛɛ hɛssi hina vuga,
neweare kuaraa.
16A dɔɔ nuuzii, ka a wàá wer ŋɔ wia,
di dɔɔ siwee,
ka a wàá na.
17Di dɔɔ digna, ka a wàá wer nuu wia,
a wàá heezi gba.
18Nɛra la maa n kuaraa daŋ ɛɛ lugɔa,
gúnnɛ banla maa
n yardaa gba du.
19Izrɛl hina, ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!
Ii banla n ɛɛ u kizeehina,
ií ra chɔluu!
20Levi dee, ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi,
ií banla maa n na jaamuu,
ií ra chɔluu!
21Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi Ziɔn biini,
u bol Jɛrusalɛm biini.
Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

english_text:
God's Love Never Fails
1 Praise the Lord! He is good.
God's love never fails.
2Praise the God of all gods.
God's love never fails.
3Praise the Lord of lords.
God's love never fails.
4Only God works great miracles.
God's love never fails.
5 With wisdom he made the sky.
God's love never fails.
6 The Lord stretched the earth
over the ocean.
God's love never fails.
7 He made the bright lights
in the sky.
God's love never fails.
8He lets the sun rule each day.
God's love never fails.
9He lets the moon and the stars
rule each night.
God's love never fails.
10 God struck down the first-born
in every Egyptian family.
God's love never fails.
11 He rescued Israel from Egypt.
God's love never fails.
12God used his great strength
and his powerful arm.
God's love never fails.
13 He split the Red Sea apart.
God's love never fails.
14The Lord brought Israel safely
through the sea.
God's love never fails.
15He destroyed the Egyptian king
and his army there.
God's love never fails.
16The Lord led his people
through the desert.
God's love never fails.
17Our God defeated mighty kings.
God's love never fails.
18And he killed famous kings.
God's love never fails.
19 One of them was Sihon,
king of the Amorites.
God's love never fails.
20 Another was King Og of Bashan.
God's love never fails.
21God took away their land.
God's love never fails.
22He gave their land to Israel,
the people who serve him.
God's love never fails.
23God saw the trouble we were in.
God's love never fails.
24He rescued us from our enemies.
God's love never fails.
25He gives food to all who live.
God's love never fails.
26Praise God in heaven!
God's love never fails.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ tɛɛi yir
1Ií ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, u wia wessoo.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
2Ií ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n dɔɔ fɔŋŋa kaali vuga maa la jaaŋ.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
3Ií ra tɛɛ dɔɔra maa Dɔɔri la jaaŋ.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
4U bɛnnɛ ra ɛɛ wizenaa.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
5U nunzumaa u kpa ta chiŋ.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
6Waabuu yaa hɛri pɛ niiri ni.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
7Waabuu ta wiizi ni baagu.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
8U gillɔɔ wiizi ra chaani hɔpizaa.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
9Baagu ni chinchiŋwilaa ra chaani hamuŋa.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
10Waabuu faa kpu Ijip hina biibambilugla la.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
11Waabuu kpogli Izrɛl hina lii Ijip hɛri.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
12U fɔŋŋazenne u kpa lɛɛ baa.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
13Waabuu gillɛ Muuzeŋaahmu bargi.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
14U kpogli u nɛra giu.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
15U faa gillɔɔ u nii di Ijip koori ni u laallɔɔra.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
16Waabuu kpogli u nɛra ga hɛribɔduma.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
17Waabuu kpu koorikpega la.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
18Waabuu kpu koora la n dɔɔ sɔŋ la.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
19Waabuu kpu Amɔri hina Koori Sihɔn.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
20Waabuu kpu Basan Koori Ɔɔg.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
21Waabuu kpa ba hɛssi tɛɛ u nɛra.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
22U kpaabuu tɛɛ u balaa Izrɛl hina.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
23U faa waa yaa wia suuhwɛ yaa tɔɔrɔɔ saŋa.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
24U faa lɛɛ yaabuu lii yaa dɔma nonee biini.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
25Waabuu ra tɛɛ kunnyinii maa diwee.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
26Ií ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi La N Na Di Kora Chiŋ la jaaŋ.
U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

english_text:
A Prayer for Revenge
1Beside the rivers of Babylon
we thought about Jerusalem,
and we sat down and cried.
2We hung our small harps
on the willow trees.
3Our enemies had brought us here
as their prisoners;
now they wanted us to sing
and entertain them.
They insulted us and shouted,
“Sing about Zion!”
4Here in a foreign land,
how can we sing
about the Lord?
5Jerusalem, if I forget you,
let my right hand go limp.
6Let my tongue stick
to the roof of my mouth,
if I don't think about you
above all else.
7Our Lord, punish the Edomites!
On the day Jerusalem fell,
they shouted,
“Completely destroy the city!
Tear down every building!”
8 Babylon, you are doomed!
I pray the Lord's blessings
on anyone who punishes you
for what you did to us.
9May the Lord bless everyone
who beats your children
against the rocks!
translation_text:
Izrɛl hina biinichɔg yir
1Babilɔn hɛri muuni kɛraarɛ yaa faa so di wii,
saŋa la yaa n liizi
Ziɔn wia la.
2Daajaŋra la n faa chigɛ de la ninɛɛ,
yaa faa kpa yaa kemzi sagzi.
3Banla n faa kpegli yaa di lauri yaa, la ŋɔ,
“Ií yir yira
di deŋŋi yaa siwee.
Ií yir di ra bagli Ziɔn wia!”
4Ɛrɛɛ ya ɛɛ yir yir tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi,
hɛrduma biinei?
5Jɛrusalɛm, di n wa suuh i wia,
Kɔ́raawiizi gilɛɛ gil
n kaa waa lɔ kem,
6di gilɛɛ kaa wàá yir yira maa,
di maa kaa waa liizi i wia,
lugɔ hinuu ra tɛŋ
bɔsɔna werge!
7N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
a liizi wia la Ɛdɔm hina n ɛɛwɛ,
a hɔl la Babilɔn hina n kpegli Jɛrusalɛm hina la, ba faa ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Ií purguu,
di wigzi u zɛɛ maa!”
8Ba daŋ chɔgi ia, Babilɔn hina.
Banla n niŋ turgi
ia yaa kim,
dikuu wii la iiŋ kpawɛɛ
dau yaa la wia,
nuu sumaa.
9Baabuu banla n niŋ wa kpa
ii biifulli viiri bia.

english_text:
(By David.)
Praise the Lord with All Your Heart
1With all my heart
I praise you, Lord.
In the presence of angels
I sing your praises.
2I worship at your holy temple
and praise you for your love
and your faithfulness.
You were true to your word
and made yourself more famous
than ever before.
3When I asked for your help,
you answered my prayer
and gave me courage.
4All kings on this earth
have heard your promises, Lord,
and they will praise you.
5You are so famous
that they will sing about
the things you have done.
6Though you are above us all,
you care for humble people,
and you keep a close watch
on everyone who is proud.
7I am surrounded by trouble,
but you protect me
against my angry enemies.
With your own powerful arm
you keep me safe.
8You, Lord, will always
treat me with kindness.
Your love never fails.
You have made us what we are.
Don't give up on us now!
translation_text:
Jaaŋ tɛɛi wiisuŋŋaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n na jaamiibuu ni n biini maa,
n yir yiraa
di ra chɔlii vuga see.
2Aŋ chiu, di bir n siwee chaŋ i Diinaniinanii la,
di willi n nyuu di ra dargii,
dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ
ani i wibii dɔɔi la wia,
dikuu hiŋ baglɛɛ lugɔ i sɔŋ
ni i widaulaarɛ
kaali kummaa la wia.
3Miŋ faa yirii, i sɛɛwɔɔ,
di kpa i fɔŋŋa duŋ bɔkpega.
4Durnya koora maa daŋ dargii,
dikuu baŋ nuu
i nuuŋɔɔlaa wia.
5Ba danna yir yira di ra bagli i wiɛɛlaa
ani i girme la
n kannɛ werge wia.
6Haali hiŋ du chinchiŋ werge maa la gba,
ka i ra du banla
n ɛɛ nɛsunne taurɛ,
banla n na jigsi ge,
wàá wer suah i ni.
7Di n dɔma wa bariŋ,
ɛɛ giluu n na n hiŋ.
Ɛɛ jugmi n dɔma la baana n na fuuh n ninɛɛ,
ka kpa i fɔŋŋazeŋ la lɛɛŋ.
8Wia la maa hiŋ ŋɔ nua
lugɔ i daŋ ɛɛ, i daŋ ɛɛa.
N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
i nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
Huma la hiŋ faarɛɛ la,
ɛɛa tuŋ!

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
The Lord Is Always Near
1You have looked deep
into my heart, Lord,
and you know all about me.
2You know when I am resting
or when I am working,
and from heaven
you discover my thoughts.
3You notice everything I do
and everywhere I go.
4Before I even speak a word,
you know what I will say,
5and with your powerful arm
you protect me
from every side.
6I can't understand all of this!
Such wonderful knowledge
is far above me.
7Where could I go to escape
from your Spirit
or from your sight?
8If I were to climb up
to the highest heavens,
you would be there.
If I were to dig down
to the world of the dead
you would also be there.
9Suppose I had wings
like the dawning day
and flew across the ocean.
10Even then your powerful arm
would guide and protect me.
11Or suppose I said, “I'll hide
in the dark until night comes
to cover me over.”
12But you see in the dark
because daylight and dark
are all the same to you.
13You are the one
who put me together
inside my mother's body,
14and I praise you because of
the wonderful way
you created me.
Everything you do is marvelous!
Of this I have no doubt.
15Nothing about me
is hidden from you!
I was secretly woven together
out of human sight,
16but with your own eyes you saw
my body being formed.
Even before I was born,
you had written in your book
everything about me.
17 Your thoughts are far beyond
my understanding,
much more than I
could ever imagine.
18I try to count your thoughts,
but they outnumber the grains
of sand on the beach.
And when I awake,
I will find you nearby.
19How I wish that you would kill
all cruel and heartless people
and protect me from them!
20They are always rebelling
and speaking evil of you.
21You know I hate anyone
who hates you, Lord,
and refuses to obey.
22They are my enemies too,
and I truly hate them.
23Look deep into my heart, God,
and find out everything
I am thinking.
24Don't let me follow evil ways,
but lead me in the way
that time has proven true.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi zum nɛr maanii di ra du u tau
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i pessimbuu,
di zumiŋ.
2Wia la maa minna ɛɛ, i zumaabuu.
I du bɔɔnɛɛrɛ,
ka zum n biini wia maa.
3Di n na humuu gɛɛ di n na heezuu,
ka i ra na n wiɛɛlaa maanii.
4Mɔɔ ka n ŋɔ wia gba,
di i teŋ zum wia la
minna nyiŋŋi n ŋɔu.
5I gombuu di ra guuŋ
ni i fɔŋŋa.
6I zumimbuu di ga bɛri,
a guŋ tiriŋ werge.
7Lee ń la, hàá wer lawinnɛi?
Lee ń la, di suah i ninɛi?
8Di n la chiŋ, i du denii,
di n chɔɔ lalaa bol gba,
ka i du denii.
9Di n kaali wiifurii bɔɔnɛɛ,
gɛɛ di ga du wiicholii bɔɔnɛɛ,
10ka i daŋ du de,
di tɔ n see hiiniŋ.
11N daŋ wer ŋɔ bɔr biri n suah,
gɛɛ bɔchaaŋ birgi
hamuŋa n suah,
12ka bɔbiri gba waa biree i be,
hamuŋa ge ɛɛ lugɔ bɔchaaŋ,
bɔbiri ni bɔchaaŋ maa
ɛɛ kpannɛ i be.
13Hinuu kuari n yemmaa,
di kpaa choŋŋi dɔŋa ni,
n maa hia biini.
14N na chɔliibuu, dikuubɛɛwiai, i dɛg ɔmaarɛ.
I wiɛɛlaa maa ge ɛɛ
witittaa ni wizenaa.
A maanii n zum nɛnnɛ.
15Hiŋ faa ra kuari n hoga,
di kpaa choŋŋi
dɔŋa ni bɔɔiih,
n maa hia biini,
n faa suah di ra hel de la,
i faa zum n wiarɛ de.
16I faa nambuu ka ba luliŋ,
hɔpizaa la maga
hiŋ dauwɛ tɛŋ,
a maanii ba sɛbi du i hɔŋ biini,
ka a hɔpizii bɛl maa
haa faari.
17N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i biini wia zumaa kpolloo!
A kpillɔɔ werge!
18Di n kuraa, a daŋ kaali hɛɛhriichaa.
Di n wa izi dɔɔ,
ka n haa du i benii.
19N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a daŋ faa pariŋ, di i kpu biinikpola hina!
Di pariŋ, di banla n na
nyiŋŋi wichɔgaa ɛɛi la,
giliŋ pɛrɛtɛ!
20Ba ŋɔ biinikpola wiarɛ di ra du i ni,
di ra ŋɔ wichɔgaa
di ra chɔgi i sɔŋ.
21N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n hah banla n haih labuu!
Banla n na dii mmɔri la,
n kii ba wiarɛ!
22N hah baabuu ni n biini maa,
di kpa baa birgi n dɔma.
23N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, pessiŋ nɛnnɛ, di zum n biini wia,
ɛɛŋ na, di zum wia la
n du n biini.
24Binniŋ na, di n dɔɔ wichɔgii n biini,
ka bagliŋ ŋmɛnɛɛ la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ,
n na la i be la.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1Rescue me from cruel
and violent enemies, Lord!
2They think up evil plans
and always cause trouble.
3 Their words bite deep
like the poisonous fangs
of a snake.
4Protect me, Lord, from cruel
and brutal enemies,
who want to destroy me.
5Those proud people have hidden
traps and nets
to catch me as I walk.
6You, Lord, are my God!
Please listen to my prayer.
7You have the power to save me,
and you keep me safe
in every battle.
8Don't let the wicked succeed
in doing what they want,
or else they might never
stop planning evil.
9They have me surrounded,
but make them the victims
of their own vicious lies.
10Dump flaming coals on them
and throw them into pits
where they can't climb out.
11Chase those cruel liars away!
Let trouble hunt them down.
12Our Lord, I know that you
defend the homeless
and see that the poor
are given justice.
13Your people will praise you
and will live with you
because they do right.
translation_text:
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi guui wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ lii wichɔgɛɛra be,
di lɛɛŋ lii banla
n na nyiŋŋi kalu be.
2Saŋa maa, wichɔgaa ɛɛi jinaa ba ɔɔ ra ta,
di chugzi nɛra
ra du dɔŋa ni,
saŋa maa.
3Ba nuuzuŋŋa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ duŋkpola siri,
ba wiŋɔzi ge ɛɛ lugɔ
dundugu siri.
4N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ lii biinikpola hina nonee biini.
Guuŋ lii banla
n na nyiŋŋi kalu,
di ra ta jina,
bá taaŋ ta la be.
5Banla n na jigsi la hembuu sidɛɛ,
ba he ba sidɛɛzii
hiŋzi dɔŋa ni
n ŋmɛnɛɛ, bá lawiŋ.
6N na ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi benii, “Hinuu Kɔraawiizi la minna hum.”
A nuu n wile, di hiiniŋ!
7Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa, hinuu n Lɛɛrikpeg,
i guumbuu laal biini.
8N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gilɛɛ waa tɛɛ biinikpola hina bá winyiŋŋaa.
Gilɛɛ gil ba jinazi la
banna ta la, wa ɛɛ wibii,
bá ra jigsi.
9Gilɛɛ gil n dɔma kpegliŋ.
Gil ɔnzaa la banna ɔnziŋ la,
laŋŋi ba ni.
10Gil niŋhɔla chogli ba ni,
di kpa baa ta bɔɔ la
baŋ wàá wer lii maa la biini.
11Gil banla n kanni kara di ra chug nɛra, wia gilɛɛ waa la see.
Gil wichɔgaa kpegli banla
n na nyiŋŋi a ɛɛi la,
di chɔgi baa.
12N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n zummɔ lugɔ i ɔɔ lɛɛ wibiire di ra tɛɛ nyaara,
di ra hiini anuula hina.
13Banla wia n deŋlee, danna chɔlii wibii maa,
di du i see.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Protection
1I pray to you, Lord!
Please listen when I pray
and hurry to help me.
2 Think of my prayer
as sweet-smelling incense,
and think of my lifted hands
as an evening sacrifice.
3Help me to guard my words
whenever I say something.
4Don't let me want to do evil
or waste my time doing wrong
with wicked people.
Don't let me even taste
the good things they offer.
5Let your faithful people
correct and punish me.
My prayers condemn the deeds
of those who do wrong,
so don't let me be friends
with any of them.
6Everyone will admit
that I was right
when their rulers are thrown
down a rocky cliff,
7and their bones lie scattered
like crushed rocks
on top of a grave.
8You are my Lord and God,
and I look to you for safety.
Don't let me be harmed.
9Protect me from the traps
of those violent people,
10and make them fall
into their own traps
while you help me escape.
translation_text:
Duana wiisuŋŋaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n na yiriibuu, hiiniŋ filaŋkeŋ!
Di n wa yirii, nuu n be.
2Lɛɛ n wiisuŋŋaa alugɔ daahɛgsɔɔhsuma,
gil n nonee la
miŋ lallɛɛ chiŋ la,
ɛɛ lugɔ duana mbusu lizaa.
3N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hiiniŋ, ń wer di ra lau n nua,
di gilɛɛ ra ŋɔ wichɔgaa.
4Hiiniŋ, ń gilɛɛ ra nyiŋŋi wichɔgaa ɛɛi,
gɛɛ di waa jaa nɛchɔgaa ni,
di ra ɛɛ biinikpola wia.
Gilɛɛ gil n waa jaa ba ni,
di ra di ba diuzenaa.
5Nɛnanaa daŋ wer tɛrgi n digna, di jugmiŋ ni nɔŋŋaa,
ka màá sɛɛ
nɛchɔgaa waa ra tɔgziŋ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n ɔɔ ra
suŋŋi Kɔraawiizii,
bá wichɔgaa gilɛɛ waa na bɔr.
6Di ba chigɔ bizenaa nyuuni, ka lauri ba sitɔɔra di ha hɛri,
a nɛra daŋ sɛɛ lugɔ
n wiŋɔɔlaa ɛɛ wibiire.
7Gunla baŋ ɔɔ pergi daa, di ŋmɛnnuu jigzi jigzi la,
gúnnɛ ba yaari ba hoga,
ŋmam nua.
8Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la, n haa yardiibuu,
di ra nyiŋŋi i guuŋ,
gilɛɛ gil n siu.
9Lɛɛŋ lii sidɛɛzi la baŋ heŋ la be,
aabuu wichɔgɛɛra sidɛɛzi la.
10Gil wichɔgɛɛra sidɛɛzi bir lauri ba himmaa,
ka ń na bɔr kaali,
di wiimaa waŋ ɛɛwɛ.

english_text:
(A special psalm and a prayer by David when he was in the cave.)
A Prayer for Help
1 I pray to you, Lord.
I beg for mercy.
2I tell you all my worries
and my troubles,
3and whenever I feel low,
you are there to guide me.
A trap has been hidden
along my pathway.
4Even if you look,
you won't see anyone
who cares enough
to walk beside me.
There is no place to hide,
and no one who really cares.
5I pray to you, Lord!
You are my place of safety,
and you are my choice
in the land of the living.
Please answer my prayer.
I am completely helpless.
6Help! They are chasing me,
and they are too strong.
7Rescue me from this prison,
so I can praise your name.
And when your people notice
your wonderful kindness to me,
they will rush to my side.
translation_text:
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N yir Kɔraawiizii di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa.
N na suŋŋuubuu.
2N witittaa maanii aŋ kpa ba u be,
di bagli n tɔɔrɔɔzi la
minna di tɛu.
3Di n wa ɛɛ sirya ń ŋɔ lugɔ a nyaŋŋimbuu,
u ɔɔ baglimbuu
gunla min niŋ ɛɛ.
N dɔma suahzɔɔrɛ heŋ sidɛɛ,
ŋmɛnɛɛ la minna vol la biini.
4Di n binni n kɛra,
nɛr maa waa hoo,
ú hiiniŋ gɛɛ di guuŋ.
Nɛr maa baga lɛi n wia.
5N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hinuu n wii ra du, í hiiniŋ,
hinuu n guuri.
I bɛnnɛ n na nyiŋŋi
í ɛɛ n hor,
n de dui naa biini.
6A nuu n wile, di hiiniŋ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n jullɔɔ,
n bɔra huah.
Lɛɛŋ lii n dɔma be,
ba kpekkoo
werge kaaliŋ.
7Lɛɛŋ lii n biinichɔg biini,
denii ń wer chɔlii
i nɛra biini,
di ba wa chaalɔɔ,
dikuu hiŋ ɛɛ winanaa
tɛŋ wia.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
A Prayer in Time of Danger
1Listen, Lord, as I pray!
You are faithful and honest
and will answer my prayer.
2 I am your servant.
Don't try me in your court,
because no one is innocent
by your standards.
3My enemies are chasing me,
crushing me in the ground.
I am in total darkness,
like someone long dead.
4I have given up hope,
and I feel numb all over.
5I remember to think about
the many things you did
in years gone by.
6Then I lift my hands in prayer,
because my soul is a desert,
thirsty for water from you.
7Please hurry, Lord,
and answer my prayer.
I feel hopeless.
Don't turn away
and leave me here to die.
8Each morning let me learn
more about your love
because I trust you.
I come to you in prayer,
asking for your guidance.
9Please rescue me
from my enemies, Lord!
I come to you for safety.
10You are my God. Show me
what you want me to do,
and let your gentle Spirit
lead me in the right path.
11Be true to your name, Lord,
and keep my life safe.
Use your saving power
to protect me from trouble.
12I am your servant.
Show how much you love me
by destroying my enemies.
translation_text:
Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a nuu n wiisuŋŋaa!
Dikuu i wideŋlaa wia, a nuu n wiisuŋŋaa,
nuu tɛŋ, dikuu i wibii wia!
2Gilɛɛ waa di mìŋ́ i balii seriya,
dikuubɛɛwiai, nɛr maa wia
waa deŋlee i be.
3N dɔma duŋŋi n lugee,
di kpeliŋ.
Ba tɔmbuu diibiri,
n ɛɛ lugɔ banla
n siuwɛ saŋa maa la.
4Awia, n ɛɛ siryaa n ta n hiŋ.
N biini chɔkkɔɔ werge.
5N na liizi hɔpizaa la n bɛrɛɛ la wiarɛ,
di ra liizi wia la
maa hiŋ ɛɛwɛ.
I wiɛɛlaa maa wia
du n nyuurɛ.
6Aŋ lalli n noneere di ra suŋŋii,
gunla bɔhilii
n ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi nii la,
gunnɛ n na nyiŋŋii.
7N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, nuu tɛŋ!
N tamii maa tunnɔɔ.
Gilɛɛ kpa i hiŋ suah n ni,
guŋ gil n waa jaa
banla n na la
lalaa bol la ni.
8Ɛɛ́ ra liiziŋ chɔɔzi maa, i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia,
dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu n yardi.
N wiisuŋŋaazi ra la i benii,
bagliŋ ŋmɛnɛɛ la
min ninna hiŋ.
9N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i benii aŋ ba, i guuŋ,
lɛɛŋ lii n dɔma be.
10Hinuu Kɔraawiizi la minna hum,
bagliŋ, n na ɛɛ i kipar.
A ɛɛŋ nɛnnɛ, di bagliŋ, ń na hiŋ ŋmɛninanii.
11N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua la,
dikuu i winanaa wia,
lɛɛŋ lii n tɔɔrɔɔ biini.
12Dikuu hiŋ nɔŋŋiŋ wia, kpu n dɔma,
di chɔgi banla maa
n na sunniŋ la,
dikuubɛɛwiai, i baliirɛ miŋ.

english_text:
(By David.)
A Prayer for the Nation
1I praise you, Lord!
You are my mighty rock,
and you teach me
how to fight my battles.
2You are my friend, my fortress,
where I am safe.
You are my shield,
and you made me the ruler
of our people.
3 Why do we humans mean anything
to you, our Lord?
Why do you care about us?
4We disappear like a breath;
we last no longer
than a faint shadow.
5Open the heavens like a curtain
and come down, Lord.
Touch the mountains
and make them send up smoke.
6Use your lightning as arrows
to scatter my enemies
and make them run away.
7Reach down from heaven
and set me free.
Save me from the mighty flood
8of those lying foreigners
who never tell the truth.
9In praise of you, our God,
I will sing a new song,
while playing my harp.
10By your power, kings win wars,
and your servant David is saved
from deadly swords.
11Won't you keep me safe
from those lying foreigners
who never tell the truth?
12Let's pray that our young sons
will grow like strong plants
and that our daughters
will be as lovely as columns
in the corner of a palace.
13May our barns be filled
with all kinds of crops.
May our fields be covered
with sheep by the thousands,
14and every cow have calves.
Don't let our city be captured
or any of us be taken away,
and don't let cries of sorrow
be heard in our streets.
15Our Lord and our God,
you give these blessings
to all who worship you.
translation_text:
Sitɔɔri wiisuŋŋaa wia
Koori Deevid yir
1Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ n guuri!
Waabuu ɔɔ ra bagliŋ
laal lɔi wia,
di ɛɛŋ sirya, ń yoo laal.
2Waabuu n guuri ni n Lɛɛri
ani n duuribɔr la miŋ yardɛɛ,
ń wer na n hiŋ.
Waabuu ɔɔ kpegli hɛssi hina tɛŋ.
3N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, beedee newee i ra liizi u wiai,
kunsiwii naa,
i ra du u tauwɛi?
4U ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ heeza kakpaŋ,
u hɔpizaa ge ɛɛ lugɔ
laalii n na kaali.
5N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil chiŋ peri, í ga de tuu ba,
di wa gbɔgzi bizenaa,
nyɔɔzi ra lii a ni.
6Kpa nazaa duŋŋi i dɔma yaari,
di ta baa i hobee,
bá ra chɔ.
7Gil i nonii lii chiŋ di wa laaŋ
lii niivile biini,
ń na n hiŋ.
Lɛɛŋ di lii hɔɔhra fɔŋŋa be,
8banla n waa ɔɔ ra ŋɔ wibii,
di ɔɔ hɛɛhzi,
ka ra kanni kara la.
9N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n daŋ yir yirfalii tɛi.
N danna lɔ kem,
di yir yira ra chɔlii.
10Hinuu ɔɔ gil Izrɛl koora kpegli ba dɔma,
di ɔɔ lɛɛ i balii
Koori Deevid.
11Lɛɛŋ lii hɔɔhra fɔŋŋa be,
banla n waa ɔɔ ra
ŋɔ wibii, di ɔɔ hɛɛhzi,
ka ra kanni kara la.
12Kɔ́raawiizi gil yaa biipɔllaa
ɛɛ lugɔ daazi la
baŋ chɔɔzɛɛ,
di binnaa nɛnnɛ,
a hel di du kpeg la.
Yaa biihambizi ge ɛɛ lugɔ baŋ ɔɔ zɛuzi
kooridia silminti ligee,
a gil u du wer la.
13Kɔ́raawiizi gil yaa buugazi su ni mia maa iri.
Yaa peeza lul
biizi kagboŋa fifi
yaa laŋgarazi biine.
14Gil yaa nauna lul werge,
di gilɛɛ waa mizi gɛɛ
a biizi waa siuzi.
Gilɛɛ gil biinichɔg wiraa waa du yaa ŋmɛnizenaa.
15Hɛri la maa hina
annii n na ɛɛ ba biini,
nuu sumaa.
Nɛra la n na
hum Kɔraawiizi,
nuu sumaa.

english_text:
(By David for praise.)
The Lord Is Kind and Merciful
1I will praise you,
my God and King,
and always honor your name.
2I will praise you each day
and always honor your name.
3You are wonderful, Lord,
and you deserve all praise,
because you are much greater
than anyone can understand.
4Each generation will announce
to the next your wonderful
and powerful deeds.
5I will keep thinking about
your marvelous glory
and your mighty miracles.
6Everyone will talk about
your fearsome deeds,
and I will tell all nations
how great you are.
7They will celebrate and sing
about your matchless mercy
and your power to save.
8You are merciful, Lord!
You are kind and patient
and always loving.
9You are good to everyone,
and you take care
of all your creation.
10All creation will thank you,
and your loyal people
will praise you.
11They will tell about
your marvelous kingdom
and your power.
12Then everyone will know about
the mighty things you do
and your glorious kingdom.
13Your kingdom will never end,
and you will rule forever.
Our Lord, you keep your word
and do everything you say.
14When someone stumbles or falls,
you give a helping hand.
15Everyone depends on you,
and when the time is right,
you provide them with food.
16By your own hand you satisfy
the desires of all who live.
17Our Lord, everything you do
is kind and thoughtful,
18and you are near to everyone
whose prayers are sincere.
19You satisfy the desires
of all your worshipers,
and you come to save them
when they ask for help.
20You take care of everyone
who loves you,
but you destroy the wicked.
21I will praise you, Lord,
and everyone will respect
your holy name forever.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi chɔlaa yir
Koori Deevid yir
1Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, ɛɛ n koori, n daŋ sii i zenni wia.
N daŋ chɔlii, di hanna la
saŋaa saŋa maa.
2Hɔpizi biimaa, n danna jaamii,
di ra chɔlii
saŋaa saŋa maa.
3N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i dɛg chɔlaarɛ,
dikuu i zenni wia,
i zenni kaali yaa nfɛssii.
4Jimini maa hina danna chɔlii,
dikuu i wiɛɛlaa wia.
Ba daŋ sii i wizenaa la
hiŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia.
5Ba danna ŋɔ i girme ni i zenni wia,
ń ge ra lɔ i wizenaa la
hiŋ ɛɛwɛ la fasani.
6Nɛra daŋ ŋɔ i wizenaa la hiŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia,
ń ge sii i zenni wia.
7Nɛra daŋ ŋɔ i winanaa maa wia,
di yir yira di ra bagli
i nɛsunaa dɔɔi wia.
8Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ nɔŋŋaa ni nɛsunaare.
U baaŋ waa fuuh manaŋ,
di dɔɔ nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
9Nɛr maanii u ra ɛɛ winanaa,
di ra na kuna la maa
uŋ tawɛɛ la sinyɛna.
10N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i kuntaalaa maa daŋ chɔlii,
í nɛra maa ge ra tɛi jaaŋ.
11Ba danna ŋɔ i kora girme
ani i fɔŋŋa wia,
12nɛr maa wer zum i wizenaa la hiŋ ɛɛwɛ
ani i kora girmezeŋ la la wia.
13I kora waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ,
i ɛɛ koorii saŋaa saŋa maa.
I dɔɔ wibiire ni i nuuŋɔɔlaa maa,
di dɔɔ nɛsunaa
i wiɛɛlaa maa biini.
14I ɔɔ ra hiini banla maa n du tɔɔrɔɔ biinii,
di ra lalli banla
n choglee chiŋ.
15Kunyinee maa ra binni i siweere ni tamii,
í ra tɛɛa diwee
saŋa la anna nyiŋŋaa.
16I ɔɔ tɛɛabuu, a kukkaa,
a maa kuŋnyiŋŋaare
ɛɛ tɛɛa.
17N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i wiɛɛlaa maa deŋloore,
i dɔɔ nɛsunaa
i wiɛɛlaa maa biini.
18I dugli banla maa n na yirii
ni biinihuŋŋuu,
19di ra tɛɛ banla maa n na kpai girme, ba kunyiŋŋaa,
di ɔɔ nuu ba wile,
di lɛɛ baa.
20Nɛr la maa n nɔŋŋii, ɛɛ guuubuu,
ka biinikpola hina waa,
i daŋ chɔgi baa.
21N daŋ ɔɔ ra chɔlii.
Gil i kuntaalaa maa
ra dargii,
dikuu i sɔnnaniinanii la wia,
saŋaa saŋa maa.

english_text:
Shout Praises to the Lord
1Shout praises to the Lord!
With all that I am,
I will shout his praises.
2I will sing and praise
the Lord God
as long as I live.
3You can't depend on anyone,
not even a great leader.
4Once they die and are buried,
that will be the end
of all their plans.
5The Lord God of Jacob blesses
everyone who trusts him
and depends on him.
6 God made heaven and earth;
he created the sea
and everything else.
God always keeps his word.
7He gives justice to the poor
and food to the hungry.
The Lord sets prisoners free
8and heals blind eyes.
He gives a helping hand
to everyone who falls.
The Lord loves good people
9and looks after strangers.
He defends the rights
of orphans and widows,
but destroys the wicked.
10The Lord God of Zion
will rule forever!
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Yaa Lɛɛri Kɔraawiizi chɔlaa yir
1Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!
N danna chɔli Kɔraawiizi
ni n biini maa!
2N danna chɔli Kɔraawiizi la minna hum,
ń de dui biini maa,
di yir yira
di ra chɔluu saŋa maa.
3Gilɛɛ yardi newea sitɔɔra,
newee maa wàá wer lɛɛi.
4Di ba wa siuzɔɔ, ba ɔɔ biruu zuu hɛɛhraa biini.
A hɔl hiŋ, ba jinazi maa
baŋ tawɛɛ ɔɔ bir pɛɛrɛ.
5Banla maa n dɛlli Kɔraawiizi la Jekɔb n na hum la,
nuu sumaa.
6Waabuu ta chiŋ, hɛri, muuzeŋ
ani kuna la maa
n du a biine.
U ɔɔ ɛɛ wii la maa uŋ ŋɔ nua
lugɔ u daŋ ɛɛu.
7U ɔɔ di seriyaa tɛɛ banla banna sunni la bilii,
di ɔɔ tɛɛ banla lɔzi
n na kpu la diwee.
Kɔraawiizii ɔɔ lizi banla baŋ tɔɔgɛɛ diinii,
8di ra pilli nyuŋŋa siwee.
Waabuu ɔɔ lalli banla n choglee chiŋ,
u nɔŋŋi u nɛra la
wia n deŋleere.
9U ɔɔ ra guu hɔɔhra la n du yaa hɛrii,
di ra hiini luhaana
ni lalbiizi,
ka u ɔɔ giluu biinikpola
hina wia chɔgi.
10Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ koorii saŋaa saŋa maa,
Ziɔn Koori Kɔraawiizi
di koraa saŋaa saŋa maa.
Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

english_text:
Sing and Praise the Lord
1Shout praises to the Lord!
Our God is kind,
and it is right and good
to sing praises to him.
2The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem
and brings the people of Israel
back home again.
3He renews our hopes
and heals our bodies.
4He decided how many stars
there would be in the sky
and gave each one a name.
5Our Lord is great and powerful!
He understands everything.
6The Lord helps the oppressed,
but he smears the wicked
in the dirt.
7Celebrate and sing!
Play your harps
for the Lord our God.
8He fills the sky with clouds
and sends rain to the earth,
so that the hills
will be green with grass.
9He provides food for cattle
and for the young ravens,
when they cry out.
10The Lord doesn't care about
the strength of horses
or powerful armies.
11The Lord is pleased only
with those who worship him
and trust his love.
12Everyone in Jerusalem,
come and praise
the Lord your God!
13He makes your city gates strong
and blesses your people.
14God lets you live in peace,
and he gives you
the very best wheat.
15As soon as God speaks,
the earth obeys.
16He covers the ground with snow
like a blanket of wool,
and he scatters frost
like ashes on the ground.
17God sends down hailstones
like chips of rocks.
Who can stand the cold?
18At his command the ice melts,
the wind blows,
and streams begin to flow.
19God gave his laws and teachings
to the descendants of Jacob,
the nation of Israel.
20But he has not given his laws
to any other nation.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ chɔlaa yir
1Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!
A wessoo ya yir yira di ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum.
U chɔlaa parimbuu,
di dɛg guŋ.
2Kɔraawiizi kaa biruu ra ma Jɛrusalɛm,
di bir gil Izrɛl hina la
baŋ laurɛɛ
kaali hɛrdumazi la,
bir di ra ba.
3U ra tig banla biine n chɔkkɛ bampireere,
di ra chag ba ŋmɛra.
4Waabuu dau chinchiŋwilaa maga,
di zum bɛl maa sɔŋ.
5Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la zenni ni u fɔŋŋa kannɔɔ werge,
u nunzuma waa
maga dɔɔwɛ.
6U ɔɔ lalli sisɔna hinaa chiŋ,
ka lɔ biinikpola hina
ha hɛri.
7Ií yir yira ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi,
ií lɔ kem ra tɛɛ
Kɔraawiizi la
yaa n na hum la.
8Waabuu ɔɔ yaa baamazi tɔ chiŋ,
di gil dooŋ nɛɛ, hɛri na nii,
kooree fur giŋgimee nyuuni.
9Waabuu ra tɛɛ sela a diwee,
di ra dɛɛzi gaaliŋgaa biizi,
di a wa yittɔ.
10Zagkpega wia lɛi ra sɔɔni u bɔra
gɛɛ laallɔkpega
wia lɛi ra paruu,
11see banla n na tɔgzuu,
di dɔɔ u nɔŋŋaa la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la tamii.
12Banla maa n du Jɛrusalɛm, ií wa chɔli Kɔraawiizi!
Ziɔn hina, ií ra chɔli
Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la!
13Waabuu ɔɔ gil ii dominuuzenaa du kpeg,
di ra kissi nɛra la
n du ii biini.
14Waabuu ɔɔ guu ii magbɔɔni, ɔnsii waa kaa hoo,
di kpa huuti la
n wesse di ra dɛɛzi ia.
15Waabuu ɔɔ dau wii tɛɛ hɛri,
guŋ ɛɛ manaŋ.
16Waabuu ɔɔ gil dobia pɛ hɛri lugɔ kita,
di gil kɔɔl tɔ lugɔ nyɔɔ.
17U ɔɔ giluu dobia ra chogli lugɔ muu loglogbia.
Nɛr maa waa ɔɔ wer
ú dɔɔ u hiŋ,
dikuu waari la
uŋ ɔɔ bɔɔni la wia!
18Denii u ŋɔ wia, a dobia ŋmɛɛri,
peu ɔɔ ta,
a nii pal di ra kaali.
19U kpa u amaniyee tɛɛ Jekɔb naanna,
u widaulaa ni u Gbɔgni ge
tɛɛ u nɛra Izrɛl hina.
20Waa guŋ ɛɛwɛ tɛɛ hɛssi hina la n kawɛɛ,
ba waa u Gbɔgni zummɛ.
Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

english_text:
Come Praise the Lord
1Shout praises to the Lord!
Shout the Lord's praises
in the highest heavens.
2All of you angels,
and all who serve him above,
come and offer praise.
3Sun and moon,
and all of you bright stars,
come and offer praise.
4Highest heavens, and the water
above the highest heavens,
come and offer praise.
5Let all things praise
the name of the Lord,
because they were created
at his command.
6He made them to last forever,
and nothing can change
what he has done.
7All creatures on earth,
you obey his commands,
so come praise the Lord!
8Sea monsters and the deep sea,
fire and hail, snow and frost,
and every stormy wind,
come praise the Lord!
9All mountains and hills,
fruit trees and cedars,
10every wild and tame animal,
all reptiles and birds,
come praise the Lord!
11Every king and every ruler,
all nations on earth,
12every man and every woman,
young people and old,
come praise the Lord!
13All creation, come praise
the name of the Lord.
Praise his name alone.
The glory of God is greater
than heaven and earth.
14Like a bull with mighty horns,
the Lord protects
his faithful nation Israel,
because they belong to him.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi kuntaalaa maa, ií ra chɔluu!
1Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!
Chiŋ kuna maa,
ií ra chɔluu de!
2Mɛlikazi maa, ií ra chɔluu!
U laallɔɔra maa n du chiŋ,
ií ra chɔluu!
3Wiizi ni baagu, ií ra chɔluu!
Chinchiŋwilaa la maa
n na nyɛgzi,
ií ra chɔluu!
4Kɔraawiizi bol tuna
ni niiri la n du chiŋ,
ií ra chɔluu!
5Ií gil a maa ra dargi Kɔraawiizi!
Waabuu ŋɔ wia,
a lii di du de.
6U wiŋɔɔlaarɛ gillɛ a maa du a duuribɔra,
di hanna la
saŋaa saŋa maa.
A wàá wer vɛɛ u nua.
7Hɛri naa kuna, ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!
Sechɔgaa la maa
n du muuzeŋ vile biine,
8nazaa, dobia, baamazi,
ani dooŋ pekpega la maa
n na hiŋ u nua,
ií ra chɔluu!
9Bizenaa, giŋgimee,
daazi la n na nɔŋ
ani kɔrni,
ií ra chɔluu!
10Bol sela, pir sela, kuntuuzaa
ani zumbizi,
ií ra chɔluu!
11Koora, nɛra maa, sitɔɔra maa,
12suŋgure, biipɔllaa,
nɛzɛŋzi ani bichalli gba,
ií ra chɔluu!
13Ií gil a maa ra dargi Kɔraawiizi!
U sɔnnɛ kaali sɔna maa,
u girme ge guali hɛri
ni chiŋ maa ni.
14U gillɔɔ u hɛri nɛra du kpeg,
guŋ gil u nɛra maa ra chɔluu,
baabuu Izrɛl hina la
n ɛɛ u siwii la.
Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

english_text:
A New Song of Praise
1Shout praises to the Lord!
Sing him a new song of praise
when his loyal people meet.
2People of Israel, rejoice
because of your Creator.
People of Zion, celebrate
because of your King.
3Praise his name by dancing
and playing music on harps
and tambourines.
4The Lord is pleased
with his people,
and he gives victory
to those who are humble.
5All of you faithful people,
praise our glorious Lord!
Celebrate and worship.
6 Praise God with songs
on your lips
and a sword in your hand.
7Take revenge and punish
the nations.
8Put chains of iron
on their kings and rulers.
9Punish them as they deserve;
this is the privilege
of God's faithful people.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi chɔlaa yir
1Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!
Ií yir yirfalii tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi!
Ií ra chɔluu u nɛra la wia
n dɔɔ wibii chaalaa biini!
2Izrɛl hina, ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni, dikuu ii Taari Kɔraawiizi wia!
Ziɔn hina,
ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni,
dikuu ii koori wia!
3Ií sa di ra darguu,
di yigzi kuna di lɔ kem,
di ra chɔluu.
4Kɔraawiizi nɛra wia ra paruubuu,
u ɔɔ ra tɔgzi banla
n dɛlli u ni,
di kpegli ba dɔma
ra tɛɛ baa.
5Gil Kɔraawiizi nɛra bɔra sɔɔni, dikuu baŋ kpegli ba dɔma wia.
Bá chɔɔgi
ba kunchɔɔrikuna ni,
di ra yir yira ni bɔsɔna.
6Gil ba ra chaasi, di ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi,
ka kpogli ba tokobizi la
n dɔɔ nuuzi anɛɛgaa,
di ra di werge,
7bá kpegli hɛssi hina,
di tɛr ba nɛra digna,
8di kpa yɔlɔzi di vɔɔzi
ba koora ni ba sitɔɔra,
9bá tɛrgi hɛssi hina digna, gunla Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔwɛɛ la.
Kɔraawiizi nɛra
dɔma kpeglaarɛ guŋ.
Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

english_text:
The Lord Is Good to His People
1Shout praises to the Lord!
Praise God in his temple.
Praise him in heaven,
his mighty fortress.
2Praise our God!
His deeds are wonderful,
too marvelous to describe.
3Praise God with trumpets
and all kinds of harps.
4Praise him with tambourines
and dancing,
with stringed instruments
and woodwinds.
5Praise God with cymbals,
with clashing cymbals.
6Let every living creature
praise the Lord.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!
1Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!
Ií ra chɔluu u Dia biini!
Ií ra chɔli
u fɔŋŋa la
un dɔɔwɛ chiŋ la!
2Ií ra chɔluu dikuu wizenaa la uŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia.
Ií ra chɔli u zenni la
n waa dɔŋ dɔɔwɛ la.
3Ií huuh bensunozi di ra chɔluu.
Ií lɔ janjalanzi
ni kemzi
di ra chɔluu.
4Ií lɔ sia di sa, di ra chɔluu.
Ií lɔ kemzi,
di huuh tiitoraa
di ra chɔluu.
5Ií kpa kuŋyigzaa di ra yigzi,
á ra wii werge,
di ra chɔluu!
6Kunnyinee maa,
ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!
Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

english_text:
How Proverbs Can Be Used
1 These are the proverbs
of King Solomon of Israel,
the son of David.
2Proverbs will teach you
wisdom and self-control
and how to understand
sayings with deep meanings.
3You will learn what is right
and honest and fair.
4From these, an ordinary person
can learn to be smart,
and young people can gain
knowledge and good sense.
5If you are already wise,
you will become even wiser.
And if you are smart,
you will learn to understand
6proverbs and sayings,
as well as words of wisdom,
and all kinds of riddles.
7 Respect and obey the Lord!
This is the beginning
of knowledge.
Only a fool rejects wisdom
and good advice.
Warnings against Bad Friends
8My child, obey the teachings
of your parents,
9and wear their teachings
as you would a pretty hat
or a lovely necklace.
10Don't be tempted by sinners
or listen 11when they say,
“Come on! Let's gang up
and kill somebody,
just for the fun of it!
12They're well and healthy now,
but we'll finish them off
once and for all.
13We'll take their valuables
and fill our homes
with stolen goods.
14If you join our gang,
you'll get your share.”
15Don't follow anyone like that
or do what they do.
16They are in a big hurry
to commit some crime,
perhaps even murder.
17They are like a bird
that sees the bait,
but ignores the trap.
18They gang up to murder someone,
but they are the victims.
19The wealth you get from crime
robs you of your life.
Wisdom Speaks
20 Wisdom shouts in the streets
wherever crowds gather.
21She shouts in the marketplaces
and near the city gates
as she says to the people,
22“How much longer
will you enjoy
being stupid fools?
Won't you ever stop sneering
and laughing at knowledge?
23Listen as I correct you
and tell you what I think.
24You completely ignored me
and refused to listen;
25you rejected my advice
and paid no attention
when I warned you.
26“So when you are struck
by some terrible disaster,
27or when trouble and distress
surround you like a whirlwind,
I will laugh and make fun.
28You will ask for my help,
but I won't listen;
you will search,
but you won't find me.
29No, you would not learn,
and you refused
to respect the Lord.
30You rejected my advice
and paid no attention
when I warned you.
31“Now you will eat the fruit
of what you have done,
until you are stuffed full
with your own schemes.
32Sin and self-satisfaction
bring destruction and death
to stupid fools.
33But if you listen to me,
you will be safe and secure
without fear of disaster.”
translation_text:
Sɛɛliizi tɔna wia
1Koori Deevid biibaal Solomɔn la n faa di kora Izrɛl hɛri labuu ta sɛɛliizi naa.
2A sɛɛliizi tɔnaa lugɔ á ra tɛɛ nɛra nunzuma ni baglinanaa,
di hiini baa
ba zum nunzunna
wiŋɔzi zɛɛzi.
3Nɛra daŋ chi sɛɛliizi naa baglaa biini,
di zum bahinaa lawaa,
di dɔɔ mananaa,
di ra ɛɛ wia la n deŋlee
di ra di wibii ni a ŋmɛnɛɛ.
4Sɛɛliizi naa daŋ gil nɛr la nfɛrɛ n waa kaŋ, dɔɔ nunzuma.
A daŋ tɛɛ biipɔllaa
ni suŋgure
nfɛrɛ ni sichaana.
5A daŋ gil banla n dɔɔ nunzuma keŋŋi digna di nuua,
di dɔɔ nunzuma jaa,
di gil banla
n na nuu wia zɛɛ
wer na baglaa,
6bá wer zum sɛɛliizi zɛɛzi,
nunzunna wiŋɔzi
ani daraa.
7Nunzuma dɔɔi faaraarɛ Kɔraawiizi ɔmaa.
Gɛnaa bɛnnɛ ra gbɛlli
nunzuma ani baglinanaa.
Mɛɛ baglaa n na tɛɛ nunzuma
8N bie, a nuu i mɛɛ
ni i maa baglaa.
9Ba baglaa hiŋ daŋ gil i manni du wer
alugɔ namunanii
n bɔɔri i nyuu,
gɛɛ saliŋ baŋaa kunnanii
ge n du i baŋaa,
i du wer la.
10N bie, gilɛɛ waa nuu
wichɔgɛɛra daraa.
11Aŋhinabe, ba daŋ ŋɔ,
“Ba ya suah guu
di kpu nɛr la
n waa wiimaa ɛɛwɛ!
12Haali baŋ dɔɔ alaanfia di du nɛnnɛ gba,
ka yaa daŋ chɔgi baa
gunla hɛri
n ɔɔ ra di nɛra la.
13Yaa daŋ paagi ba kundɔɔlaa maa,
di ga suugi
yaa diini lugɔ
baŋ lɔ baa laal.
14Wa jaa yaa ni,
yaa nii bɔnni kuna la
yaa n paagɛɛ la.”
15N bie, gilɛɛ waa hiŋ baa,
di wàá ɛɛ ba wiɛɛlaa.
16Ba ɔɔ hahzuu ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa,
di du gbaŋ ni nɛkpui.
17Di i ra nyiŋŋi zumbee lawaa,
haa sidɛɛ ra he u sibɔɔ.
18Ka guŋ hina ra he bahinaarɛ sidɛɛ,
ka waa niŋ lau baa,
bá siuzi.
19Gunnɛ niŋ huuzi banla maa n na ɛɛ guŋ,
ba wichɔgaa
daŋ kpu baa.
Ba hah bahinaarɛ.
Nunzuma vɛɛi wia
20Nunzuma ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nɛr n chigɛ ŋmɛnɛɛ
ni bossibaana di gbooli
di ra yirgi nɛra.
21U ra siiu bol biini ŋmɛnizenaa ni bolzeŋ dominuuzenaa,
bɔra la nɛra
n ɔɔ ra chaali la,
di ra ŋɔ,
22“Nfɛrnyaara! Ɛrɛɛ ií nyaa nfɛrɛ di birgi magɛi?
Ɛrɛɛ chɛɛtɛ ɛɛra
ɛɛ chɛɛtɛ di birgi magɛi?
Gɛnaa hah nunzuma
di birgi magɛi?
23Di ii faa nuu n karfaa,
n daŋ faa ŋɔ n biini wia tɛɛ ia,
di gil ii dɔɔ nunzuma.
Bie la n na nuu baglaa
waa lewaa dɔɔwɛ.
24N yir iabuu digiidigii, ka ii vɛɛ,
di yaa n nonee ń lɛɛ ia,
ka ii waŋ hagzɛɛ.
25Ii vɛɛ n nua
ni n baglaa maanii.
26Di wia wa huuzi ia, n daŋ mam ia,
di ɛɛ ia chɛɛtɛ,
di siaahmu chɔgii
wa chol ii ni.
27Di siaahmu chɔgii wa chol ii ni alugɔ dooŋ peu,
hɛhchɔg chol
ii ni alugɔ vem,
denii biinichɔg
ni tɔɔrɔɔ werge
jaa chol ii ni.
28Denii ii yiriŋ, ka màá sɛɛ,
di nyiŋŋi n bɔr yemmaa.
Ka ii wàá naŋ.
29Dikuu iiŋ hah nunzuma
di vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ɔmaa wia.
30Ii vɛɛ n nua ni
n baglaa maanii.
31Awia, ii daŋ na wii la iinna nyiŋŋi,
ii himmaa wiɛɛlaa
laŋŋi ii ni.
32Gɛnaa daŋ siu dikuu baŋ vɛɛ nunzuma wia,
bá bambugri chɔgi baa.
33Ka banla n na nuu n be, daŋ du de ni bɔsɔna,
tɔɔrɔɔ maa wàá huuzi baa.”

english_text:
Wisdom and Bad Friends
1My child, you must follow
and treasure my teachings
and my instructions.
2Keep in tune with wisdom
and think what it means
to have common sense.
3Beg as loud as you can
for good common sense.
4Search for wisdom
as you would search for silver
or hidden treasure.
5Then you will understand
what it means to respect
and to know the Lord God.
6 All wisdom comes from the Lord,
and so do common sense
and understanding.
7God gives helpful advice
to everyone who obeys him
and protects those
who live as they should.
8God sees that justice is done,
and he watches over everyone
who is faithful to him.
9With wisdom you will learn
what is right
and honest and fair.
10Wisdom will control your mind,
and you will be pleased
with knowledge.
11Sound judgment and good sense
will watch over you.
12Wisdom will protect you
from evil schemes
and from those liars
13who turned from doing good
to live in the darkness.
14Most of all they enjoy
being mean and deceitful.
15They are dishonest themselves,
and so are all their deeds.
Wisdom and Sexual Purity
16Wisdom will protect you
from the smooth talk
of a sinful woman,
17who breaks her wedding vows
and leaves the man she married
when she was young.
18The road to her house leads
down
to the dark world
of the dead.
19Visit her, and you will never
find the road to life again.
20Follow the example
of good people
and live an honest life.
21If you are honest and innocent,
you will keep your land;
22if you do wrong
and can never be trusted,
you will be rooted out.
translation_text:
Nunzuma tɔnazi wia
1N bie, di i ra nuu n baglaa,
di kpaa du ii biini,
2di keŋŋi digna ra nuu nunzuma wia,
di ra ɛɛ ania,
í zum a zɛɛ,
3di i suŋŋi hiinaa
ni wia zɛɛ zumaa,
4pigzi di nyiŋŋaa alugɔ kebee n leuwe
gɛɛ daama n suahwɛ,
5denii í zum gunla Kɔraawiizi ɔmaa zɛɛ n na bagli,
di dɔɔ u nunzuma.
6Kɔraawiizii ra tɛɛ nunzuma!
U benii sichaana
ni wia zɛɛ zumaa ra lii.
7Waabuu ra hiini nɛra la wia n deŋlee, ba dɔɔ wibii.
Waabuu ra guu baa.
8Waabuu ra binni nɛra la n na ɛɛ ba dɔŋahina nɛnnɛ,
di ra guu banla wia
n dɔɔ wibii u be.
9Denii í zum wideŋlaa, wibii dii ani wia la n dɛkkɛ zɛɛ,
di wer zum gunla
n dɛkkɛ í ra ɛɛ saŋa maa.
10I daŋ dɔɔ nunzuma,
í sichaana tɛi bɔsɔna.
11I wia zɛɛ zumaa
ani i nunzuma daŋ guui.
12Nunzuma daŋ lɛɛi lii biinikpola hina be,
di lɛɛi lii nɛra la
n na koozi wia be.
13Nɛra naa bir ba haraa kpu wideŋlaa,
ka ra vol bɔbiri
di ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa.
14Wileulaa ɛɛi ra pur ba bɔraa,
wijagazi ɛɛi ge
ra sɔɔni ba bɔra.
15Ba wiɛɛlaa ni ba hiŋaazi waa ɔɔ deŋli,
di ɛɛ nɛra la
baŋ wàá wer yardi.
16Nunzuma daŋ lɛɛi lii hahjaga
ni hahsɛnsɛnni
nuusum be.
17U vɛɛ u jaari ni nuukpaŋ la
u nuu n ɛɛwɛ
Kɔraawiizi be labuu.
18Haaŋ naa dee dia zuui ra ba siu ninɛɛ,
de ɛɛ lalaa bol ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ.
19Baal la n na la u be wia chɔkkɔɔ.
U ŋmɛnɛ maa
wàá na miibɔɔ.
20Awia, a hiŋ nɛnanaa
ni nɛra la wia
n deŋlee wiɛɛlaa.
21Dikuubɛɛwiai, banla wia n deŋlee
ni banla wia n dɔɔ wibii
bɛnnɛ niŋ du a hɛri.
22Ka Kɔraawiizi daŋ lizi biinikpola hina a hɛri biini,
di kpu nɛchɔgaa.

english_text:
Trust God
1My child, remember
my teachings and instructions
and obey them completely.
2They will help you live
a long and prosperous life.
3Let love and loyalty
always show like a necklace,
and write them in your mind.
4 God and people will like you
and hold you in high esteem.
5With all your heart
you must trust the Lord
and not your own judgment.
6Always let him lead you,
and he will clear the road
for you to follow.
7 Don't ever think that you
are wise enough,
but respect the Lord
and stay away from evil.
8This will make you healthy,
and you will feel strong.
9Honor the Lord by giving him
your money and the first part
of all your crops.
10Then you will have
more grain and grapes
than you will ever need.
11 My child, don't turn away
or become bitter
when the Lord corrects you.
12 The Lord corrects
everyone he loves,
just as parents correct
a child they dearly love.
The Value of Wisdom
13God blesses everyone
who has wisdom
and common sense.
14Wisdom is worth more
than silver;
it makes you much richer
than gold.
15Wisdom is more valuable
than precious jewels;
nothing you want
compares with her.
16In her right hand
Wisdom holds a long life,
and in her left hand
are wealth and honor.
17Wisdom makes life pleasant
and leads us safely along.
18Wisdom is a life-giving tree,
the source of happiness
for all who hold on to her.
19By his wisdom and knowledge
the Lord created
heaven and earth.
20By his understanding
he let the ocean break loose
and clouds release the rain.
21My child, use common sense
and sound judgment!
Always keep them in mind.
22They will help you to live
a long and beautiful life.
23You will walk safely
and never stumble;
24you will rest without a worry
and sleep soundly.
25So don't be afraid
of sudden disasters
or storms that strike
those who are evil.
26You can be sure that the Lord
will protect you from harm.
27 Do all you can for everyone
who deserves your help.
28Don't tell your neighbor
to come back tomorrow,
if you can help today.
29Don't try to be mean
to neighbors who trust you.
30Don't argue just to be arguing,
when you haven't been hurt.
31Don't be jealous
of cruel people
or follow their example.
32The Lord doesn't like
anyone who is dishonest,
but he lets good people
be his friends.
33He places a curse on the home
of everyone who is evil,
but he blesses the home
of every good person.
34 The Lord sneers at those
who sneer at him,
but he is kind to everyone
who is humble.
35You will be praised
if you are wise,
but you will be disgraced
if you are a stubborn fool.
translation_text:
Yardi Kɔraawiizi
1N bie, gilɛɛ waa suuh gunla miŋ baglii la ŋmɛnɛ maa.
Gil a du i bampirii nɛnnɛ,
2dikuubɛɛwiai, a daŋ tɛi
miibɔɔjaŋ, í nyɛɛli.
3Dɔɔ nɛnɔŋŋaa ni wibii dii!
Laalaa lugɔ baŋaakuŋ,
di gil a du i bampirii.
4Denii í wia par Kɔraawiizi ni newea,
í dɔɔ sɔnnanii.
5Yardi Kɔraawiizi ni i biini maa,
ka gilɛɛ waa salli
i himmaa zumaa ni.
6A liizi u wia í wiɛɛlaa maa biini,
u daŋ baglii
ŋmɛnizi la n dɛkkɛ.
7Gilɛɛ waa tɔgzi i hiŋ,
a ɔm Kɔraawiizi,
di gil wichɔgaa ɛɛi.
8Denii i dɔɔ alaanfia
ni fɔŋŋa nɛnnɛ.
9Ɛɛ kpa i daama ni i pattikuna la n wesse nɛnnɛ,
di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi,
di ra tɔgzuu.
10Denii ú gil i buugazi suugi ni mia,
í golaa ge suugi ni siŋ,
di ra ta.
11N bie, di Kɔraawiizi tɛr i digni, gilɛɛ waa binni guŋ pɛɛ,
gɛɛ di u wa hau i ni,
gilɛɛ gil i bɔra wàá huah,
12dikuubɛɛwiai, banla un nɔŋŋɛɛ dignaa u ra tɛrgi
alugɔ mɛɛ n ɔɔ tɛrgi
u biinɔŋŋaa digna la.
13Nɛr la n dɔɔ nunzuma ni wia zɛɛ zumaa,
nuu sumaa.
14Nunzuma tɔnaa bɔ saliŋhuŋŋu,
u kinturgaa ge
du wer kaali saliŋ.
15U wesso kaali rubizi la,
hàá wer kpa kunla maa
hinna nyiŋŋi di mɛgzuu.
16Nunzuma ra tɛibuu miibɔɔjaŋ,
di ra tɛi daama ni zenni.
17U ɔɔ giluu i de dui du sum,
di tɔ i see, i na i hiŋ.
18Banla n dɔɔ nunzuma,
ɔɔ dɔɔ bɔsɔna
ni miibɔɔjannɛ.
19Nunzumaa Kɔraawiizi kpa ta hɛri,
di kpa wia zɛɛ zumaa
kuari chiŋ.
20U nunzumaa gillɛ muuni ra pal,
di gil baamazi
ra ba dooŋ ni.
21N bie, kpogli nunzuma ni wia zɛɛ zumaa,
gil a du i biini saŋa maa,
22dikuubɛɛwiai, a daŋ tɛi miibɔɔjaŋ,
di gil i de dui du wer.
23A daŋ gil i ra vol nɛnnɛ,
hàá ra lɔɔzi naazi.
24Ɔnsii wàá lawii, di i wa chɔɔwɔ,
i daŋ ɔɔ ra deezi deezinanaa.
25Ɔnsii wàá lawii di wipirgaa
gɛɛ hɛhchɔg wa chol
biinikpola hina ni,
26dikuu Kɔraawiizi n ɛɛ i guuri wia,
wàá gil i zuu wia biini.
27Gilɛɛ waa vɛɛ banla n dɛg winanaa, winanaa ɛɛi,
di i wa dɔɔ guŋ fɔŋŋa.
28Di i daŋ wer hiini i dɔŋhiŋ filaŋkeŋ,
gilɛɛ waa ŋɔ,
“Bir ba kɛrɛ ń hiinii.”
29Gilɛɛ waa fɛ nfɛrɛ lugɔ i ɛɛ banla n soge duglii wichɔgaa,
ba yardiibuu.
30Gilɛɛ wa kpa wia di ra sag nɛr la
n wɛɛ ɛɛwɛ wiimaa ni.
31Gilɛɛ waa zom nɛchɔgaa ni
gɛɛ di wàá ɛɛ ba wiɛɛlaa,
32dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi hah nɛchɔgaarɛ,
ka banla wia n deŋlee
ɛɛ ú dammuzii.
33U ɔɔ see biinikpola hiŋ diarɛ nua,
ka kissi nɛr la wia
n deŋlee hor.
34U ɔɔ giluu chɛɛtɛ ɛɛra di hiihzi,
ka ra hiini
sisɔna hina waa.
35Nunzunna daŋ na girme,
gɛnaa ge horuu hiihzi!

english_text:
Advice to Young People
1My child, listen closely
to my teachings
and learn common sense.
2My advice is useful,
so don't turn away.
3When I was still very young
and my mother's favorite child,
my father 4said to me:
“If you follow my teachings
and keep them in mind,
you will live.
5Be wise and learn good sense;
remember my teachings
and do what I say.
6“If you love Wisdom
and don't reject her,
she will watch over you.
7The best thing about Wisdom
is Wisdom herself;
good sense is more important
than anything else.
8If you value Wisdom
and hold tightly to her,
great honors will be yours.
9It will be like wearing
a glorious crown
of beautiful flowers.”
The Right Way and the Wrong Way
10My child, if you listen
and obey my teachings,
you will live a long time.
11I have shown you the way
that makes sense;
I have guided you
along the right path.
12Your road won't be blocked,
and you won't stumble
when you run.
13Hold firmly to my teaching
and never let go.
It will mean life for you.
14Don't follow the bad example
of cruel and evil people.
15Turn aside and keep going.
Stay away from them.
16They can't sleep or rest
until they do wrong or harm
some innocent victim.
17Their food and drink
are cruelty and wickedness.
18The lifestyle of good people
is like sunlight at dawn
that keeps getting brighter
until broad daylight.
19The lifestyle of the wicked
is like total darkness,
and they will never know
what makes them stumble.
20My child, listen carefully
to everything I say.
21Don't forget a single word,
but think about it all.
22Knowing these teachings
will mean true life
and good health for you.
23Carefully guard your thoughts
because they are the source
of true life.
24Never tell lies or be deceitful
in what you say.
25Keep looking straight ahead,
without turning aside.
26 Know where you are headed,
and you will stay
on solid ground.
27Don't make a mistake by turning
to the right or the left.
translation_text:
Nunzuma tɔnazi wia
1N biizi, ií nuu n be, di ra nuu ii mɛɛ baglaa.
Ií keŋŋi digna,
di dɔɔ wia zɛɛ zumaa.
2Winanaarɛ n na bagli ia la.
Ií gilɛɛ waa suuh
gunla minna
bagli ia naa.
3Miŋ faa ɛɛ bichala,
di faa ɛɛ biikpaŋ
n maa be la,
4n mɛɛ ɔɔ faa baglimbuu di ŋɔ,
“Gil n wiŋɔzi naa
du i bampirii,
di i hiŋaa,
i daŋ dɔɔ miibɔɔ.
5Dɔɔ nunzuma ni wia zɛɛ nuui,
di gilɛɛ waa suuh
gɛɛ di waa vɛɛ
n wiŋɔzi naa.
6Gilɛɛ wa bir luŋ di ra kpu nunzuma,
dikuu un niŋ guui wia.
Nɔŋŋuu, u daŋ guui.
7Nunzuma dɔɔirɛ ɛɛ kunzeŋ werge maa di kaali kummaa.
Wii la maa hin niŋ ɛɛ,
dɔɔ wia zɛɛ zumaa.
8Di i ra tɔgzi nunzuma werge, u daŋ lallii chiŋ.
Faamuu, u daŋ tɛi girme.
9Nunzuma daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ kahuronanii tɛi,
í du wer di dɔɔ girme.”
10N bie, aah siwii di ra nuu n be,
di dɔɔ miibɔɔjaŋ.
11N bagliibuu nunzuma ŋmɛnizi,
di kpoglii ga ŋmɛnideŋlaa.
12Di i waa vol, hàá gargi kuna,
di i waa chɔ ge,
hàá lɔ naa di jiŋli.
13Ɛɛ ra liizi wia naa miŋ baglii naa,
di gilɛɛ waa suuah.
Gil a du i bampirii,
aabuu i miibɔɔ.
14Gilɛɛ waa la bɔr la biinikpola hina n na la
gɛɛ di wàá hiŋzi
ba ŋmɛnizi.
15Gil a hiŋaa
ka ra hiŋ i hor,
16dikuubɛɛwiai, di wichɔgɛɛra waa wichɔgaa ɛɛwɛ, ba wàá chɔɔ.
Di ba waa gillɛ
nɛbɛl lɔ naa di jiŋli,
ba wàá heezi.
17Biinikpolaa ba diwee,
nɛfiraa werge ge
ɛɛ ba niinyɔɔlii.
18Nɛra la wia n deŋlee ŋmɛnɛɛ ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bɔr n na chaani chɔɔzi ni,
di ra chaani werge
guŋŋ di ra ba
hɔpizaa nɛnnɛ.
19Ka biinikpola hina ŋmɛnɛɛ ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bɔbiri himmaa.
Ba waa ɔɔ zum kuna la
n gillɛ ba ra lɔɔzi naazi.
20N bie, a nuu gunla minna ŋɔ naa nɛnnɛ.
Keŋŋi digna di nua nɛnnɛ.
21Gilɛɛ waa suuh n wiŋɔzi naa.
Gil a du i bampirii nɛnnɛ,
22dikuubɛɛwiai, a ra tɛɛ nɛra la maa
n nuuabuu miibɔɔ
ni alaanfiarɛ nɛnnɛ.
23A du i biini wia tau nɛnnɛ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, aabuu
niŋ buu i de dui
wiɛɛlaa maa.
24Gilɛɛ waa ŋɔ wia la n waa wibii ɛɛwɛ
gɛɛ di wàá dar nɛr.
25A binni bɔr la i siwee n chaŋŋɛ,
di ra na wia la
n chɔɔ i see.
26Ɛɛ vɔɔ i wiɛɛlaa maa jina nɛnnɛ,
guŋ daŋ gil
i wiɛɛlaa maa deŋli.
27Gilɛɛ waa leu,
di wàá ɛɛ wichɔgaa.

english_text:
Be Faithful to Your Wife
1My son, if you listen closely
to my wisdom and good sense,
2you will have sound judgment,
and you will always know
the right thing to say.
3The words of an immoral woman
may be as sweet as honey
and as smooth as olive oil.
4But all that you really get
from being with her
is bitter poison and pain.
5If you follow her,
she will lead you down
to the world of the dead.
6She has missed the path
that leads to life
and doesn't even know it.
7My son, listen to me
and do everything I say.
8Stay away from a bad woman!
Don't even go near the door
of her house.
9You will lose your self-respect
and end up in debt
to some cruel person
for the rest of your life.
10Strangers will get your money
and everything else
you have worked for.
11When it's all over,
your body will waste away,
as you groan 12and shout,
“I hated advice and correction!
13I paid no attention
to my teachers,
14and now I am disgraced
in front of everyone.”
15You should be faithful
to your wife,
just as you take water
from your own well.
16And don't be like a stream
from which just any woman
may take a drink.
17Save yourself for your wife
and don't have sex
with other women.
18Be happy with the wife
you married
when you were young.
19She is beautiful and graceful,
just like a deer;
you should be attracted to her
and stay deeply in love.
20Don't go crazy over a woman
who is unfaithful
to her own husband!
21The Lord sees everything,
and he watches us closely.
22Sinners are trapped and caught
by their own evil deeds.
23They get lost and die
because of their foolishness
and lack of self-control.
translation_text:
Sɛnsɛŋ karfaa wia
1N bie, a nuu nunzuma wiŋɔzi naa nɛnnɛ.
A nuu n sichaana
wibaglaa naa nɛnnɛ.
2Denii í dɔɔ mananaa,
í wiŋɔzi ra bagli lugɔ
i dɔɔ sichaanaa.
3Hahsɛnsɛnni wiŋɔzi summɔɔ lugɔ huuhnuu,
u nua pɛssi kaali nuu.
4Ka a tuna du kpol alugɔ kpol,
di ra di alugɔ tokobi
n dɔɔ nuuzi anɛɛ.
5U ŋmɛnivollaa ɛɛ siu ŋmɛnizii,
di deŋli ra la ŋmam biini.
6U baga lɛi miibɔɔ ŋmɛnɛɛ wia.
U ŋmɛnizi waa deŋlee,
ka waa zummɛ.
7Awia, n biibaala, ii ra nuu n be filaŋkeŋ,
ii ŋmɛnɛ maa
gilɛɛ waa vɛɛ
gunla minna nyiŋŋi
n ŋɔ naa.
8Ií chɔ lii u be!
Ií gilɛɛ waa dugli
u dia dominua gba!
9Ka di guŋ lɛi, ii daŋ nyaa girme la iiŋ faa dɔɔwɛ la,
sikpegii hina kpu ia,
ii pɔlaa saŋa.
10Wibii maa, hɔɔhra daŋ di ii daama kuna,
nɛbɛl ge di
kuna la maa
iiŋ keeni wem
di na la suma.
11A guŋ tuna,
ii danna uuri di kɔgi
ii miibɔɔni tunaa saŋa.
12Denii ii ŋɔ, “N faa vɛɛ baglaarɛ!
Ka ra hiŋ n himmaa
kipar wiɛɛlaa!
13N faa vɛɛ n bagla nuarɛ.
Maa digna keŋŋee
nuu ba be.
14Kakpaŋ, n jaa di hiihzi nɛra maa see.”
15A chɔɔ i haaŋ bɛŋ,
gunla hiŋ ɔɔ ra nyɔɔ
i himmaa dia
niinyɔɔrivii biini nii la.
16Gilɛɛ ɛɛ lugɔ
gɔŋ la haaŋ maa
n niŋ tuu di ra dɔɔ.
17Gil i ni i haaŋ bɛŋ ra chɔɔ.
Gilɛɛ kpa i hiŋ
di ra tɛɛ hahdumazi.
18Gil i haaŋ wia su i siwii.
Gil i bɔra sɔɔni
i bichalhaaŋ wia.
19U wessoo alugɔ wiluu,
nɔŋŋuu, di gil u wia
du i bampirii.
20Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ í ra chugli
dikuu baal bɛl haaŋ wia
n waa wibii dɔɔwɛi?
21Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra na gunla maa newee n na ɛɛu,
di zum u ŋmɛnivollaa maa.
22Wichɔgɛɛri himmaa wichɔgaarɛ ɔɔ vɔɔzuu.
A ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ ŋmɛnni
di ɔɔ vɔɔzuu kiŋkiŋ.
23U daŋ siu dikuu uŋ waa wette ra lau u hiŋ wia,
di leu dikuu u gɛnaa wia.

english_text:
Don't Be Foolish
1 My child, suppose you agree
to pay the debt of someone,
who cannot repay a loan.
2Then you are trapped
by your own words,
3and you are now in the power
of someone else.
Here is what you should do:
Go and beg for permission
to call off the agreement.
4Do this before you fall asleep
or even get sleepy.
5Save yourself, just as a deer
or a bird tries to escape
from a hunter.
6You lazy people can learn
by watching an anthill.
7Ants don't have leaders,
8but they store up food
during harvest season.
9How long will you lie there
doing nothing at all?
When are you going to get up
and stop sleeping?
10 Sleep a little. Doze a little.
Fold your hands
and twiddle your thumbs.
11Suddenly, everything is gone,
as though it had been taken
by an armed robber.
12Worthless liars go around
13 winking and giving signals
to deceive others.
14They are always thinking up
something cruel and evil,
and they stir up trouble.
15But they will be struck
by sudden disaster
and left without a hope.
16There are six or seven
kinds of people
the Lord doesn't like:
17Those who are too proud
or tell lies or murder,
18those who make evil plans
or are quick to do wrong,
19those who tell lies in court
or stir up trouble
in a family.
20Obey the teaching
of your parents—
21always keep it in mind
and never forget it.
22Their teaching will guide you
when you walk,
protect you when you sleep,
and talk to you
when you are awake.
23The Law of the Lord is a lamp,
and its teachings
shine brightly.
Correction and self-control
will lead you through life.
24They will protect you
from the flattering words
of someone else's wife.
25Don't let yourself be attracted
by the charm and lovely eyes
of someone like that.
26A woman who sells her love
can be bought for as little
as the price of a meal.
But making love
to another man's wife
will cost you everything.
27If you carry burning coals,
you burn your clothes;
28if you step on hot coals,
you burn your feet.
29And if you go to bed
with another man's wife,
you pay the price.
30We don't put up with thieves,
not even with one who steals
for something to eat.
31And thieves who get caught
must pay back
seven times what was stolen
and lose everything.
32But if you go to bed
with another man's wife,
you will destroy yourself
by your own stupidity.
33You will be beaten
and forever disgraced,
34because a jealous husband
can be furious and merciless
when he takes revenge.
35He won't let you pay him off,
no matter what you offer.
translation_text:
Gɛnaa karfaa wia
1N bie, di i wa sɛɛwɔ di daansɛɛ
di tɛɛ nɛr la
hiŋ waa zummɛ
u di kim,
di u wa turgoo
ra huhzi,
2i wiŋɔzi ni i nuuŋɔɔlaa waa dii,
3guŋwaa, n bie, ɛɛ keŋ manaŋ!
Hiŋ chol i dɔŋhiŋ wia
biini wia,
la ga chol u naazi
di suŋŋuu ú gil tɛi.
4Gilɛɛ waa chɔɔ dɔɔ,
di gilɛɛ waa daari gba.
5Lɛɛ i hiŋ alugɔ sel gɛɛ zumbee n chɔwɛɛ
di ra lii kpaaŋ be la.
6Yaara hina, ií la minni be
di ga helli nunzuma,
di dɔɔu.
7Haali aŋ waa koori gɛɛ nabɔma
gɛɛ sitɔɔri dɔɔwɛ gba,
8ka a ɔɔ aah siwiire di chaali diwee lumaŋa ni
di dau ra kpaŋ yuu.
9Yaara hiŋ, ɛrɛɛ í chɔɔ dɔɔ di birgi magɛi?
Saŋa bɛɛ í izei?
10I daŋ ŋɔ, “N daŋ daari di chɔɔ dɔɔ tama,
di kɔrgi n bɔra
heezi tama.”
11Ka hinna chɔɔ dɔɔ la,
nyaari daŋ chol i ni
alugɔ ŋmɛɛŋchɔgii.
12Nɛjagazi ni biinikpola hina
ɔɔ gaaguu ra bar
di ra kanni kara,
13di kpa ba siwee, nonibee ani naapezi
di ra ŋɔ wia
ra bagli wia la
n du ba biine,
14di ra ta wichɔgaa ɛɛi jina ni daraa bá biine,
di koozi wia
ra du saŋa maa.
15Ka hɛhchɔg daŋ chol ba ni kakpaŋ,
di chɔgi baa,
ba wàá dɔɔ
nyaagaa tamii maa.
16Kuna anumbɛl gɛɛ aniidaanɛɛrɛ du de,
Kɔraawiizi n kiiwe werge,
17nɛr la n na jigsi,
di ra kanni kara,
di ra kpu nɛnanaa,
18ni nɛr la n na fɛ wichɔgaa ɛɛi nfɛrɛ,
di hahzi ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa,
