your punishment is over.
I, the Lord, made you pay
double for your sins.”
3 Someone is shouting:
“Clear a path in the desert!
Make a straight road
for the Lord our God.
4Fill in the valleys;
flatten every hill
and mountain.
Level the rough
and rugged ground.
5Then the glory of the Lord
will appear for all to see.
The Lord has promised this!”
6 Someone told me to shout,
and I asked,
“What should I shout?”
We humans are merely grass,
and we last no longer
than wild flowers.
7At the Lord's command,
flowers and grass disappear,
and so do we.
8Flowers and grass fade away,
but what our God has said
will never change.
Your God Is Here!
9There is good news
for the city of Zion.
Shout it as loud as you can
from the highest mountain.
Don't be afraid to shout
to the towns of Judah:
“Your God is here!”
10 Look! The powerful Lord God
is coming to rule
with his mighty arm.
He brings with him
what he has taken in war,
and he rewards his people.
11 The Lord cares for his nation,
just as shepherds care
for their flocks.
He carries the lambs
in his arms,
while gently leading
the mother sheep.
Who Compares with God?
12Did any of you measure
the ocean by yourself
or stretch out the sky
with your own hands?
Did you put the soil
of the earth in a bucket
or weigh the hills and mountains
on balance scales?
13 Has anyone told the Lord
what he must do
or given him advice?
14Did the Lord ask anyone
to teach him wisdom
and justice?
Who gave him knowledge
and understanding?
15 To the Lord, all nations
are merely a drop in a bucket
or dust on balance scales;
all of the islands
are but a handful of sand.
16The cattle on the mountains
of Lebanon
would not be enough to offer
as a sacrifice to God,
and the trees would not
be enough for the fire.
17God thinks of the nations
as far less than nothing.
18 Who compares with God?
Is anything like him?
19Is an idol at all like God?
It is made of bronze
with a thin layer of gold,
and decorated with silver.
20 Or special wood may be chosen
because it doesn't rot—
then skilled hands
take care to make an idol
that won't fall on its face.
God Rules the Whole Earth
21Don't you know?
Haven't you heard?
Hasn't it been clear
since the time of creation?
22God is the one who rules
the whole earth,
and we that live here
are merely insects.
He spread out the heavens
like a curtain or an open tent.
23God brings down rulers
and turns them into nothing.
24They are like flowers
freshly sprung up
and starting to grow.
But when God blows on them,
they wilt and are carried off
like straw in a storm.
25The holy God asks,
“Who compares with me?
Is anyone my equal?”
26 Look at the evening sky!
Who created the stars?
Who gave them each a name?
Who leads them like an army?
The Lord is so powerful
that none of the stars
are ever missing.
The Lord Gives Strength
27You people of Israel say,
“God pays no attention to us!
He doesn't care if we
are treated unjustly.”
But how can you say that?
28Don't you know?
Haven't you heard?
The Lord is the eternal God,
Creator of the earth.
He never gets weary or tired;
his wisdom cannot be measured.
29The Lord gives strength
to those who are weary.
30Even young people get tired,
then stumble and fall.
31But those who trust the Lord
will find new strength.
They will be strong like eagles
soaring upward on wings;
they will walk and run
without getting tired.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi n niŋ tɛɛ u nɛra bɔsɔna wia
1Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Tɛɛ n nɛra bɔsɔna,
tɛɛ baa bɔsɔna.
2A du Jɛrusalɛm hina bɔkpega.
Ŋɔ ba be lugɔ
ba tɔɔrɔɔ dii werge
la tunnɔɔ.
N jaa gil ba wichɔgaarɛ tɛɛ baa.
N tɛr ba dignaa naa bunɛɛ,
dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia.”
3Ba daŋ nuu nɛbɛl n na sii
hɛribɔduma biini, di ra ŋɔ,
“Yaa Dɔɔri ra bau. Ií ra ɛɛ sirya ú ra ba!
Ií ra ɛɛ wia á ra deŋli
ni a ŋmɛnizi.
4Kɔraawiizi daŋ tɔ walli maa,
di kaa bul giŋgimee
ni bɔra la n la chiŋ.
U daŋ wa kuari ŋmɛninyirmanyirmazi la
á du kpantalaŋ.
5Denii Kɔraawiizi girme la jaa lii baaŋ,
newea maa wer nau.
Kɔraawiizi himmaanii ŋɔ guŋ.”
6Loobii bɛl ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ wia kpegzi ni!”
N ŋɔ, “Bɛɛ wiarɛ ń ŋɔ
kpegzi ninɛi?”
U ŋɔ, “Newee maa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ kooree,
ba wessi maa ɛɛ lugɔ fiiri.
7Di Kɔraawiizi wa heezoo du a ni,
a kooree ɔɔ yɔluu,
a fiiri chogli.
Wibii maa, newea
ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ kooree.
8Kooree ɔɔ yɔluu a fiiri chogli,
ka Kɔraawiizi la
yaa n na hum la
Wiŋɔɔlii lawaa,
ɔɔ haŋ du denii di hanna la
saŋaa saŋa maa.”
9Bolzeŋ Ziɔn hina, iin dɔɔ amaniyesuma ii lizi la,
ií tinni bizeŋ nyuu
di sii werge.
Ií gilɛɛ ra ɔm,
ií ŋɔ tɛɛ
Juda bola hina,
dí Kɔraawiizi la banna hum
labuu ra ba la.
10Ií ra nuu! Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ra bau ni fɔŋŋa.
U kpa fɔŋŋaa
di ra di kora.
Kinturgaa la un niŋ turgi u nɛra
du u benii.
11U ra binni u nɛraa lugɔ penɔɔni,
di ɔɔ kpa
a pebizi kpogli,
ka ra nɔɔni peniinazi la
n kpogli hizi nɛnnɛ.
12Anɛɛ mɛgzi muuni niiri u nopaal biinei?
Anɛɛ n tɛr u nonii
di mɛgzi chiŋ magai?
Anɛɛ n mɛgzi hɛri maa hɛɛhraa kuŋ biinei,
di mɛgzi bizenaa
ani giŋgimee maa tɔgzizi lai?
13Anɛɛ n zum Kɔraawiizi nfɛrɛi
gɛɛ ú wer bagluu wiai?
14Anɛɛ Kɔraawiizi pɛɛzi, ú chaani u siweei?
Anɛɛ n bagluu
ŋmɛnizi la n deŋleenei?
Anɛɛ n bagluu nunzuma
ni wia zɛɛzi zumaai?
15Wibii maa, a hɛssi naa maa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ dobii n toŋŋe u be,
a fukkɔɔ lugɔ nyɔɔ.
U mɛgzi muu baaŋ hɛrjigzii
a du fug alugɔ hɛɛhriikɔl.
16Lɛbanɔn kɔr daakpila la gba waa mbusu lizaa niŋ chemaa helle,
u sela waa kpil lugɔ ba kpaa
lizi mbusu di fuuh
tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi.
17Kɔraawiizi waa be, a hɛssi naa maa waa kummaa ɛɛwɛ.
A ɛɛ kumpɛɛrii,
a waa tɔna maa dɔɔwɛ.
18Anɛɛ ya jaa wer kpa mɛgzi Kɔraawiizɛi?
Beedee í kpau mɛgzɛi?
19Vugwaa, sɛɛhrii ɔɔ sɛɛuh,
luuri ge ɔɔ kaa ŋmɛɛri
saliŋ tɔ u ni,
di kuari saliŋhuŋŋu
yɔlɔzi laaluu.
20Nɛr la n wàá wer na saliŋ gɛɛ saliŋhuŋŋu,
ɔɔ nyiŋŋi daa la
n wàá wer
pɔɔh manannɛ,
di tɛɛ sɛɛhri la n zum huma nɛnnɛ,
ú sɛɛuh u chi nɛnnɛ,
wàá wer chol.
21Ii waa zummɛ, gɛɛ ii waa nuuwɛ,
di lii lugli laa?
Ii waa wia naa zɛɛ zummɛ lii durnya luglaa saŋa laa?
22Waabuu soge u koorikara ni chinchiŋ,
durnya nɛra maa ɛɛ
lugɔ huuhni u be.
U yaa chinne lugɔ patiisa,
di kaa yaau lugɔ
tanti dia.
23U ɔɔ giluu durnya naa koorizenaa tuu zɛɛ,
di gil ba bir pɛɛ.
24Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ kuna la baŋ duuwe
gɛɛ baŋ chɔɔzɛɛ,
a lunne waa
hɛri zuuwɛ nɛnnɛ,
ka Kɔraawiizi gil peu ta a ni a maa war,
vem kpaa kaali
alugɔ zɔga.
25Dɔɔrinaniinanii la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Anɛɛ ii wer kpaŋ mɛgzɛi?
N ni anɛɛ n mɛgzɛɛnɛi?”
26Ií lalli ii nyuuni binni chiŋ na.
Anɛɛ n ta
kuna naa maanɛi?
Kɔraawiizii ta a kuŋkpila naa maa,
di zum a maa maga
ni a sɔna.
U kpegzi n kannɛ, u dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge wia,
bɛl maa waa leuwe.
27Ee, Izrɛl hina! Ɛrɛɛ i ra nuumi di ra ŋɔ,
“Tɔɔrɔɔ naa yaa n na di naa,
Kɔraawiizi wɔɔ ra naa?
U baga waa hoo
yaa dɔgnya dii bee?”
28Ii waa zummɛ,
gɛɛ ii waa nuuwɛ
lugɔ Kɔraawiizi du denii di hanna laa?
Waabuu ta hɛri naa maa.
U ŋmɛnɛ maa waa kuuih dɔɔwɛ,
nɛr maa wàá wer zum
u nunzuma maga.
29Waabuu ɔɔ tɛɛ banla n kuuhwɛ fɔŋŋa,
di tɛɛ gɛrga fɔŋŋa.
30Haali biipɔllaa gba ɔɔ wa kuuuh,
di lɔɔzi naazi ra jiŋli,
di ra chogli.
31Ka banla n dɛlli Kɔraawiiziwaa,
daŋ kaa bir dɔɔ fɔŋŋafalii.
Ba daŋ yaa keeri di ra zaah alugɔ chigni,
ba danna chɔ,
ka ba wàá kuuh,
di ra vol,
ka ba bɔra wàá yɔɔri.

english_text:
The Lord Controls Human Events
1Be silent and listen,
every island in the sea.
Have courage and come near,
every one of you nations.
Let's settle this matter!
2Who appointed this ruler
from the east?
Who puts nations and kings
in his power?
His sword and his arrows
turn them to dust
blown by the wind.
3He goes after them so quickly
that his feet
barely touch the ground—
he doesn't even get hurt.
4Who makes these things happen?
Who controls human events?
I do! I am the Lord.
I was there at the beginning;
I will be there at the end.
5Islands and foreign nations
saw what I did and trembled
as they came near.
What Can Idols Do?
6Worshipers of idols
comfort each other,
saying, “Don't worry!”
7Woodcarvers, goldsmiths,
and other workers
encourage one another and say,
“We've done a great job!”
Then they nail the idol down,
so it won't fall over.
The Lord's Chosen Servant
8 Israel, you are my servant.
I chose you, the family
of my friend Abraham.
9From far across the earth
I brought you here and said,
“You are my chosen servant.
I haven't forgotten you.”
10Don't be afraid. I am with you.
Don't tremble with fear.
I am your God.
I will make you strong,
as I protect you with my arm
and give you victories.
11Everyone who hates you
will be terribly disgraced;
those who attack
will vanish into thin air.
12You will look around
for those brutal enemies,
but you won't find them—
they will be gone.
13I am the Lord your God.
I am holding your hand,
so don't be afraid.
I am here to help you.
14People of Israel, don't worry,
though others may say,
“Israel is only a worm!”
I am the holy God of Israel,
who saves and protects you.
15I will let you be like a log
covered with sharp spikes.
You will grind and crush
every mountain and hill
until they turn to dust.
16A strong wind will scatter them
in all directions.
Then you will celebrate
and praise me, your Lord,
the holy God of Israel.
The Lord Helps the Poor
17When the poor and needy
are dying of thirst
and cannot find water,
I, the Lord God of Israel,
will come to their rescue.
I won't forget them.
18I will make rivers flow
on mountain peaks.
I will send streams
to fill the valleys.
Dry and barren land
will flow with springs
and become a lake.
19I will fill the desert
with all kinds of trees—
cedars, acacias, and myrtles;
olive and cypress trees;
fir trees and pines.
20Everyone will see this
and know that I,
the holy Lord God of Israel,
created it all.
Idols Are Useless
21I am the Lord,
the King of Israel!
Come argue your case with me.
Present your evidence.
22Come near me, you idols.
Tell us about the past,
and we will think about it.
Tell us about the future,
so we will know
what is going to happen.
23Prove that you are gods
by making your predictions
come true.
Do something good or evil,
so we can be amazed
and terrified.
24You idols are nothing,
and you are powerless.
To worship you
would be disgusting.
25I, the Lord, appointed a ruler
in the north;
now he comes from the east
to honor my name.
He tramples kings like mud,
as potters trample clay.
26Did any of you idols predict
what would happen?
Did any of you get it right?
None of you told about this
or even spoke a word.
27I was the first to tell
the people of Jerusalem,
“Look, it's happening!”
I was the one who announced
this good news to Zion.
28None of these idols
are able to give advice
or answer questions.
29They are nothing,
and they can do nothing—
they are merely
a passing breeze.
translation_text:
Izrɛl hina hiini wia
1Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Muu baaŋ hɛrjigzi hina, ií gil kɔɔi ka keŋŋi digna di ra nuu n be.
Ií ɛɛ sirya di ba
seriya diiribɔr,
di wa ŋɔ ii hor!
Ií gil yaa maa chaali di zum unla hor n summɛ.
2Nɛbɛllɛ lii wiifurii keŋkere di ra ba.
Anɛɛ n lizuu di tɛu fɔŋŋa
ú wer yoo laal di kpegli nɛra,
haali u gil u wer kpegli
hɛssi hina ni ba koorai?
U kpa u tokobii kpuuzi baa,
u hoo ge yaari baa
alugɔ peu n lɔ nyɔɔ
ni zɔga yaari la.
3U duŋŋi baa di ra la, ka wiimaa wɔɔ ɛɛwɛ,
di ra chɔ alugɔ u naazi
n waa hɛri ra hel.
4Anɛɛ n ɛɛ keŋ di gil guŋ du denei?
Anɛɛ n yir newea maa
di lii lugli la,
ba ɛɛ u kipar lai?
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la n faa du nɛra be lugli la,
di haa du ba be
tuna saŋa labuu.
5Muuzeŋ baaŋ hɛrjigzi hina na gunnɛ ɔnsii lau baa,
hɛri naa tunazi hina maa
na guŋ, ba bɔra ra sa.
Ba chaali dɔŋa di ra ba.
6Bɛl maa ra hiini u dɔŋhiŋ
di ra du dɔŋa bɔkpega.
7Sɛɛhrii ra du salinluuri bɔkpega,
unla n kpa silii di ra lɔ saliŋ
ú vɔgli ge
ra du unla n na
lɔ lugbii bɔkpega.
Ba maa ŋɔ gunla baŋ margi ba kuŋ la wesso,
di kpaahzi a vug ú chi chigigi.
8Ama, ii Izrɛl hinawaa ɛɛ n balaarɛ,
ii ɛɛ banla miŋ lizɛɛ
lii n dammu
Abraham dee biini labuu.
9N lizi iabuu lii a hɛri tuna,
di yir ia lii bɔɔnɛɛ,
di ŋɔ ii be, ‘Ií ɛɛ n balaarɛ.’
Maa ia vɛɛwɛ,
ka lizi ia tɛɛ n hiŋ.
10Awia, ií gilɛɛ ra ɔm. N du ii benii.
Ií gilɛɛ gil ii bɔra huah.
Minuu ɛɛ ii Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi.
N daŋ tɛɛ ia fɔŋŋa di hiini ia.
N banonii daŋ ɔɔ lɛɛ ia
di lau ia kpogli nɛnnɛ.
11Banla maa n hah ia
daŋ di hiihzi di ŋmaabi.
Banla maa ni ia n dɔɔ kalu
daŋ siuzi ba wia tuŋ.
12Haali iin ninna nyiŋŋi ii dɔma bɔr,
ka ii wàá na baa.
Banla n niŋ lɔ ia laal la
wia daŋ tuŋ.
13Minuu Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la.
N lau ii nodigee kpogli
ka ŋɔ ii be, ‘Ií gilɛɛ ra ɔm.
N daŋ hiini ia.’ ”
14Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Izrɛl hina, haali
iiŋ gɛrgɛɛ alugɔ haalauri
di du tama la,
ií gilɛɛ ra ɔm.
N himmaanii niŋ hiini ia.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii, ii Lɛɛri,
Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii
labuu ŋɔ guŋ.
15Ií ra nuu! N na kuari iabuu ii ɛɛ lugɔ
milɔɔri daazi aŋhina dizi
n dɔɔ nyina,
a ɛɛ a falaa di ra di.
Ií daŋ purgi bizenaa,
di bul giŋgimee
a birgi nyɔɔ.
16Ií daŋ hɛlaa, peu kpaa,
vem lɔa yaari.
Ama, iawaa daŋ na bɔsɔna mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi wia,
di ra chɔli mìŋ́
Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la.
17Di nɛra waa di dɔgnya
di nyiŋŋi nii huhzi
bá nyɔɔ,
ba loobee hil,
mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi daŋ nuu ba wiisuŋŋaa,
mìŋ́ unla Izrɛl hina
n na hum la,
wàá gil baa ta.
18N daŋ gil niiri ra pal bizenaa la n hillɛ nyuuni,
bulli ge furgi walli.
N daŋ gil hɛribɔduma birgi polli,
bulli ra pal hɛri bɔhilaa.
19N daŋ gil hɛriŋkpola,
akeesia, mɛrtil
ani ɔlivi daazi
fur hɛribɔduma,
di gil daananaa
ge fur hɛrsɛb di tɔ kɔr.
20Denii nɛra jaa na di zum,
ba daŋ binni a wia biini
di zum a zɛɛ nɛnnɛ
lugɔ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ɛɛ guŋ,
di zum lugɔ mìŋ́ Izrɛl
Dɔɔrinaniinanii labuu gillɛ
a maa wer ɛɛ.”
21Kɔraawiizi, Izrɛl hina koori ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Ií wa lizi ii loobii,
di ŋɔ ii hor.
22Ií kpa ii vuga la ba, á ŋɔ yaa be
gunla n niŋ wa ɛɛ.
Ií gil a bagli yaa gunla wia n faa duwɛɛ,
ya wer binni a biini,
di zum gunla a tuna
n niŋ wa du,
gɛɛ a ŋɔ wia la n niŋ ŋmɛnɛ
wa ɛɛ tɛɛ yaa.
23Di a wetto ŋɔ yaa be wia la n niŋ wa ɛɛ,
denii ya jaa zum lugɔ a ɛɛ
vugaa di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa, wibii maa.
Ií gil a ɛɛ winanii gɛɛ wichɔgii bɛl
a tir yaa, ɔnsii lau yaa.
24Ka vuga waa kummaa ɛɛwɛ,
a wiɛɛlaa maa ɛɛ pɛɛrɛ.
Nɛr la maa n na kuari vuga,
n kii u wiarɛ.
25N du wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag nɛbɛllɛ bɔkpega, u ra ba,
unla n lii wiifurii
di ra yir n sɔŋ.
U ra fɛrgi koora alugɔ banna fɛrgi hɛɛhraa la,
alugɔ viimaari
n na fɛrgi chuuri la.
26U bɛlii vugrɛ faa luglɛɛ ŋɔ wii naa, ya wer zum,
lugɔ wibiirei?
Bɛl maa faa waa guŋ ŋɔwɛɛ,
nɛr maa faa waa
wiimaa nuuwɛ lii ii be.
27Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii faa felee lizi guŋ amaniye
tɛɛ Jɛrusalɛm hina, di ŋɔ,
‘Ií na, ii nɛraa gaa ba la, ba ra ba bolle.’
28Ka miŋ binni a vuga biini,
maa bɛl maa nawɛɛ, ú ŋɔ wia,
bɛl maa faa waa hoo ú bagli nɛra wia,
bɛl maa waa hoo
ú lizi wia la
min niŋ pɛɛzi la nuuzi.
29Ií ra nuu! A maa ɛɛ karaa,
a wiɛɛlaa ɛɛ pɛɛ,
a maa ɛɛ peure di ɛɛ daraa.”

english_text:
The Lord's Servant
1 Here is my servant!
I have made him strong.
He is my chosen one;
I am pleased with him.
I have given him my Spirit,
and he will bring justice
to the nations.
2He won't shout or yell
or call out in the streets.
3He won't break off a bent reed
or put out a dying flame,
but he will make sure
that justice is done.
4He won't quit or give up
until he brings justice
everywhere on earth,
and people in foreign nations
long for his teaching.
5 I am the Lord God.
I created the heavens
like an open tent above.
I made the earth and everything
that grows on it.
I am the source of life
for all who live on this earth,
so listen to what I say.
6 I chose you to bring justice,
and I am here at your side.
I selected you and sent you
to bring light
and my promise of hope
to the nations.
7You will give sight
to the blind;
you will set prisoners free
from dark dungeons.
8My name is the Lord!
I won't let idols or humans
share my glory and praise.
9Everything has happened
just as I said it would;
now I will announce
what will happen next.
Sing Praises to the Lord
10Tell the whole world to sing
a new song to the Lord!
Tell those who sail the ocean
and those who live far away
to join in the praise.
11Tell the tribes of the desert
and everyone in the mountains
to celebrate and sing.
12Let them announce
his praises everywhere.
13The Lord is marching out
like an angry soldier,
shouting with all his might
while attacking his enemies.
The Lord Will Help His People
14For a long time, I, the Lord,
have held my temper;
now I will cry out and groan
like a woman giving birth.
15I will destroy the mountains
and what grows on them;
I will dry up rivers and ponds.
16I will lead the blind on roads
they have never known;
I will guide them on paths
they have never traveled.
Their road is dark and rough,
but I will give light
to keep them from stumbling.
This is my solemn promise.
17Everyone who worships idols
as though they were gods
will be terribly ashamed.
God's People Won't Obey
18You people are deaf and blind,
but the Lord commands you
to listen and to see.
19No one is as blind or deaf
as his messenger,
his chosen servant,
20who sees and hears so much,
but pays no attention.
21The Lord always does right,
and so he wanted his Law
to be greatly praised.
22But his people were trapped
and imprisoned in holes
with no one to rescue them.
All they owned had been taken,
and no one was willing
to give it back.
23Why won't his people
ever learn to listen?
24Israel sinned and refused
to obey the Lord
or follow his instructions.
So the Lord let us be robbed
of everything we owned.
25He was furious with us
and punished our nation
with the fires of war.
Still we paid no attention.
We didn't even care
when we were surrounded
and scorched by flames.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi balii wia
1Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N huŋhunnii keŋ, unla miŋ chigɛ u har.
N lizuubuu tɛɛ n hiŋ,
u wia parimbuu werge.
N daŋ kpa n Duma du u ni,
ú gil wibii dii du
hɛssi maa biine.
2Wàá ra pogzi gɛɛ di ra kɔɔ
gɛɛ ba ra nuu
u loobii ŋmɛnizi biine.
3Di nɛr ɛɛwɔ lugɔ koorii n luuwe,
ka wàá kuu ha.
Di nɛr ge ɛɛwɔ lugɔ fintina n na lii nyɔɔzi,
ka wàá dimuu.
U daŋ gil wibii dii du de.
4Wàá kuuh maa,
u bɔra ge wàá huah
di ra ba saŋa la
un niŋ gil wibii dii wa du durnya.
Muu baaŋ hɛrjigzi hina danna
kpaŋ u baglaa,
siaahmu ni.”
5Kɔraawiizii ta chiŋ, di yaau, di ta hɛri ge,
di kuari kuna la maa
n du u biini,
di tɛɛ newea maa heeza
ni miibɔɔ.
Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ u balii be,
6“Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii yirii, di tɛi fɔŋŋa, í ra di wibii.
N daŋ lau i nonii kpogli,
di ra binni i ni.
N daŋ ga i be, di gil n ni nɛra maa ɛɛ nuukpaŋ,
di gil bɔchaaŋ ba
hɛssi hina maa be.
7I daŋ pilli nyuŋŋa siwee,
di lizi banla
baŋ tɔ diini biine,
di kaa lizi banla
n du bɔbiri werge biini.
8Minuu Kɔraawiizi, n sɔnnɛ guŋ!
Màá gil ba kpa girme
la n dɛgiŋ tɛɛ vug maa,
gɛɛ di kpa chɔlaa la ban niŋ
chɔliŋ tɛɛ vuga.
9Na, wia la miŋ felee ŋɔ la wa ɛɛ wibiire.
Wifalaarɛ n kaa ra
ŋɔ i be.
Mɔɔ ka a wa ɛɛ,
n daŋ ŋɔa tɛi.”
Kɔraawiizi chɔlaa yir
10Ií yir yirfalii tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi!
Durnya nɛra maa,
ií ra chɔluu.
Ií banla n du muugberzenaa biine di ra hum,
kuna la maa n du
muuni biine,
muuzeŋ baaŋ hɛrjigzi
ni banla maa n soge a biine la,
ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!
11Gil hɛribɔduma nɛra ni u bolzenaa maa yir yir di ra chɔluu,
haali bola la Kɛda ni u nɛra
n soge la gba.
Gil Sɛla hina yir yira ni bɔsɔna,
di ra chaasi bizenaa nyuuni.
12Gil ba maa ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi girme,
di aah siwii ra chɔluu
muuzeŋ baaŋ hɛrjigzi,
maa biine.
13Kɔraawiizi daŋ lii alugɔ laallɔkpeg,
alugɔ laallɔɔri bɔra
n ɔɔ ra nyurgi gunla.
U daŋ lɔ laal wile,
di bagli u dɔma u fɔŋŋa.
14Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“N siigɔɔrɛ birgi,
N lau n hinnɛ
di faa di kanyitti.
Ka filaŋkeŋwaa, n ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ haaŋ n na lul,
di ra hɛm di ra lɔ wile
di ra sigzi la.
15N daŋ chɔgi bizenaa ni giŋgimee maa,
di gil daazi
ni kooree hil.
N daŋ gil muuni maa hil,
di gil a gbatarni
maa ge hiihzi.
16N daŋ kpogli nyuŋŋa ga ŋmɛnizi la
baŋ waa zummɛ.
N daŋ gil bɔbiri birgi bɔchaaŋ,
di gil hɛri bɔchɔgaa
birgi bɔnanaa tɛɛ baa.
N daŋ ɛɛ guŋ, wibii maa.
Màá vɛɛ n nuuzi la
miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ la.
17Ama, banla n na tɔgzi vuga
di kpaa birgi
ba dɔɔra lawaa
daŋ bir har
di di hiihzi werge maa.”
Izrɛl hina n ɛɛ nyuŋŋa ni dignitaŋa hina wia
18Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Dignitaŋa hina, ií ra nuu!
Nyuŋŋa, ií binni nɛnnɛ na!
19Anɛɛ n nyuŋŋɛɛ kaali n baliiyɛi,
gɛɛ di taŋzi kaali
unla miŋ hummɛ lai?
Nɛr maa waa nyuŋŋɛɛ kaali unla n kpa u hiŋ tɛŋ
di ɛɛ n balii la.
20Izrɛl hina, ii na wikpila maanii miŋ ɛɛwɛ, ka ii baga lɛi a wia.
Ii dɔɔ dignaa,
ka ii waa wia ra nuu.”
21A par Kɔraawiizii,
dikuu u wideŋlaa wia,
u gillɔɔ u Gbɔg
dɔɔ sɔŋ ni girme.
22Ka na gunla a nɛra n duwɛɛ.
Ba kpegli baabuu,
di paagi ba kuna maa.
Ba fɔɔ baabuu du bɔɔni ni nɛra tɔi diini biine.
Ba waa hiini dɔɔwɛ.
Ba lauri baabuu yoma,
ka nɛr maa waa hoo,
ú ŋɔ,
“Ií gil ba bir kaali.”
23Ii biini, u bɛliirɛ niŋ nuu wii naanɛi?
Di lii filaŋkeŋ di hanna la,
ii daŋ keŋŋi digna
di ra nuu nɛnnɛaa?
24Anɛɛ n gillɛ ba kpegli Izrɛl hina, di paagi ba kunai?
Kɔraawiizi la baŋ faa ɛɛ
wichɔgaa di zuu u ni
werge la lɛiyaa?
Ba vɛɛ u ŋmɛnizi hiŋaarɛ,
ba waa u Gbɔg hiŋŋɛ.
25Awiarɛ u baaŋ faa fuuh ba ni werge,
u gil ba lɔ baa laal,
ba di tɔɔrɔɔ alugɔ baŋ du niŋ biini.
Ka ba waa a zɛɛ zummɛ.
U faa fuuh baa,
ka ba wàá wiimaa
hellee lii a biini.

english_text:
The Lord Has Rescued His People
1Descendants of Jacob,
I, the Lord, created you
and formed your nation.
Israel, don't be afraid.
I have rescued you.
I have called you by name;
now you belong to me.
2When you cross deep rivers,
I will be with you,
and you won't drown.
When you walk through fire,
you won't be burned
or scorched by the flames.
3I am the Lord, your God,
the Holy One of Israel,
the God who saves you.
I gave up Egypt, Ethiopia,
and the region of Seba
in exchange for you.
4To me, you are very dear,
and I love you.
That's why I gave up nations
and people to rescue you.
5Don't be afraid! I am with you.
From both east and west
I will bring you together.
6I will say to the north
and to the south,
“Free my sons and daughters!
Let them return
from distant lands.
7They are my people—
I created each of them
to bring honor to me.”
The Lord Alone Is God
The Lord said:
8Bring my people together.
They have eyes and ears,
but they can't see or hear.
9Tell everyone of every nation
to gather around.
None of them can honestly say,
“We told you so!”
If someone heard them say this,
then tell us about it now.
10My people, you are my witnesses
and my chosen servant.
I want you to know me,
to trust me, and understand
that I alone am God.
I have always been God;
there can be no others.
11I alone am the Lord;
only I can rescue you.
12I promised to save you,
and I kept my promise.
You are my witnesses
that no other god did this.
I, the Lord, have spoken.
13I am God now and forever.
No one can snatch you from me
or stand in my way.
The Lord Will Prepare the Way
14I, the Lord, will rescue you!
I am Israel's holy God,
and this is my promise:
For your sake, I will send
an army against Babylon
to drag its people away,
crying as they go.
15I am the Lord, your holy God,
Israel's Creator and King.
16I am the one who cut a path
through the mighty ocean.
17I sent an army to chase you
with chariots and horses;
now they lie dead,
unable to move.
They are like an oil lamp
with the flame snuffed out.
Forget the Past
The Lord said:
18Forget what happened long ago!
Don't think about the past.
19I am creating something new.
There it is! Do you see it?
I have put roads in deserts,
streams in thirsty lands.
20Every wild animal honors me,
even jackals and owls.
I provide water in deserts—
streams in thirsty lands
for my chosen people.
21I made them my own nation,
so they would praise me.
22I, the Lord, said to Israel:
You have become weary of me,
but not from worshiping me.
23You have not honored me
by sacrificing sheep
or other animals.
And I have not burdened you
with demands for sacrifices
or sweet-smelling incense.
24You have not brought
delicious spices for me
or given me the best part
of your sacrificed animals.
Instead, you burden me down
with your terrible sins.
25But I wipe away your sins
because of who I am.
And so, I will forget
the wrongs you have done.
26Meet me in court!
State your case and prove
that you are right.
27Your earliest ancestor
and all your leaders
rebelled against me.
28That's why I don't allow
your priests to serve me;
I let Israel be destroyed
and your people disgraced.
translation_text:
Izrɛl hina Lɛɛrikpaŋ wia
1Izrɛl hina, unla n ta ia la, ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Ií gilɛɛ ra ɔm. N lɛɛ iabuu.
N yir ii sɔnaa, di lizi ia,
ii ɛɛ n hora.
2Di niiri biinii ii ra zuu,
n daŋ du ii be,
di muunii ii ra gi,
ka a wàá di ia.
Di niŋ biinii ii ra vol,
ka wàá wer fuuh ia,
u ninlau gba wàá haahri ia.
3Dikuubɛɛwiai, minuu Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum,
Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la,
n ɛɛ ii Lɛɛri la.
N daŋ kpa Ijip hina chɛr ia,
di kaa kpa Itiopia
ni Sɛba hina jaa.
4Iiŋ ɛɛ kumpazi di dɔɔ girme n be
ni miŋ nɔŋŋi ia la wia,
n daŋ kpa nɛra char ia,
di kaa kpa hɛssi hina
char ii miibɔɔni.
5Ií gilɛɛ ra ɔm,
n du i benii.
N daŋ chaali ii dee la maa
lii wiifurii ni wiicholii,
di ba.
6N daŋ ŋɔ wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag nɛra be lugɔ
bá tɛɛ n nɛra ŋmɛnɛɛ bá kaali,
di ŋɔ wiifurii nodig wiikakag nɛra be lugɔ
bá gilɛɛ lau baa kpogli!
Ií gil n biibaala ni n biihaana maa lii bɔɔnɛɛzi
ni hɛri tunazi maa ba.
7N sɔŋ sag ba ninɛɛ, ba ɛɛ n nɛra la
miŋ tawɛɛnɛ,
nɛ́ra ra tɔgziŋ
dikuu ba wia.”
8Ií tɛɛ n nɛra la n dɔɔ siwee ka nyuŋŋi,
di dɔɔ digna
ka taŋzi la
ŋmɛnɛɛ bá ba.
9Gil hɛssi hina maa chaali.
Ba biini, u bɛliirɛ faa ŋɔ wia la
n faa ɛɛwɛ mɔɔ
ni annii n na
ɛɛ filaŋkennaanɛi?
Gil ba nyiŋŋi ba daansɛɛ hina ba,
bá wa di baa wibii,
ba dɔŋahina nuu
di sɛɛ lugɔ wibiire.
10Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Izrɛl hina,
iabuu n daansɛɛ hina,
di kaa ɛɛ n balaa la min lizɛɛ
ii wer zumiŋ di yardiŋ,
di kaa zum nɛnnɛ lugɔ
n bɛnnɛ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi.
Vug maa faa waa hoo ka n du de,
bɛl maa ge wàá ka
du de n har.
11N bɛnnɛ Kɔraawiizi,
Lɛɛri maa waa hoo
di min lɛi.
12N bagli iabuu wia la n niŋ wa ɛɛ.
Aŋ waa ɛɛ la, n lɛɛ ia,
di bagli ia lugɔ
minuu ɛɛ guŋ.
Hɛrduma bɛl maa vug lɛi du ii be, di ɛɛ guŋ.
Iabuu n daansɛɛ hina.
Minuu Kɔraawiizi.
Mìŋ́ ŋɔ guŋ.
13Wibii maa,
minuu Kɔraawiizi di lii
faala maa di hanna la.
Nɛr maa wàá wer lɛɛ u hiŋ lii
n nonee biini.
Wii la maa miŋ ɛɛwɛ,
nɛr maa wàá
wer biruu.”
Kɔraawiizi nɛsunaa dɔɔi ni Izrɛl hina wibii nyaai wia
14Kenne Kɔraawiizi, Izrɛl hina Lɛɛri
ni ba Dɔɔrinaniinanii la ŋɔ,
“N daŋ kuu ii wia di gil ba lɔ Babilɔn laal,
di kpegli baa.
Ba bɔsɔna chaasaa la
daŋ birgi wiraa.
15Minuu Kɔraawiizi, ii Dɔɔrinaniinanii la.
Izrɛl hina taari
ni ii koori.”
16Kenne Kɔraawiizi ra ŋɔ,
unla n faa gillɛ
muuzeŋ la peri,
ŋmɛnɛɛ chɔɔ u baaŋ la,
17unla n faa gillɛ a nii tɔ Ijip hina,
ba zagra, ba laal torkozi
ani ba laallɔɔra ni,
di di baa, ba ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka izi la.
Ba dimmoo lugɔ
baŋ dim fintina la.
18“Ií suuh wibinaa wia,
di gilɛɛ gil ii nfɛssi
haa du a ni.
19Ií ra nuu! N kaa ra ɛɛ wifaliirɛ filaŋkeŋ.
Waa ra ba la, ii wɔɔ nawɛɛa?
N na dau ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ hɛribɔduma,
di gil niiri ra pal de.
20Pir sela ra tɔgzimbuu,
hohobiazi ni kikiuzi ra tɔgziŋ,
dikuu miŋ gillɛ niiri ra pal hɛribɔduma biini
di tɛɛ n nɛra la
miŋ lizɛɛ tɛɛ n hiŋ,
ba nyɔɔ wia.
21N ma baabuu tɛɛ n hiŋ,
bá ra chɔliŋ bombombom!
22Izrɛl hina, ani a maa, ka ii waa sɛɛwɛ ii yir n sɔŋ.
N wia bazi iabuu.
23Ii waa kaa kpa peeza ba ií wa lizi mbusu di fuuah tɛŋ,
gɛɛ di kaa ra tɔgziŋ
ni mbusu lizaa.
Maa ia fittɛ ŋɔ ii kpa mbusuzi lizaa mia wa tɛŋ,
gɛɛ di gil
n wia bazi ia
dikuu daahɛgsɔɔhsuma
fuuih wia.
24Ii waa daahɛgsɔɔhsuma maa yauwɛ tɛŋ,
gɛɛ di kpa
ii mbusu lizaa
sela nuuri werge tɛŋ,
a su n siwii.
Ka i gillɔɔ ii wichɔgaa ɛɛ lugɔ buntɔga tɛŋ,
di gil n lɔgɔ lii
ii wichɔgaa wia.
25Ka minuu ra dinzi ii wichɔgaa
dikuu n himmaa wia.
Maa kaa ra liizaa
ŋmɛnɛ maa.
26Ií liiziŋ wia la iiŋ faa ɛɛwɛ,
yá di mmɔri.
Ií bagli wii la n gillɛ
ii hor du sum.
27Ii mɛɛlugli faa ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ,
ii sitɔɔra ge vɛɛŋ.
28Awia, n daŋ gil n Dia nabɔnzi di hiihzi,
N daŋ kpa Izrɛl hina
du ba dɔma nonee,
bá chɔgi baa,
di chagzi baa.”

english_text:
The Lord's Promise to Israel
1People of Israel,
I have chosen you
as my servant.
2I am your Creator.
You were in my care
even before you were born.
Israel, don't be terrified!
You are my chosen servant,
my very favorite.
3I will bless the thirsty land
by sending streams of water;
I will bless your descendants
by giving them my Spirit.
4They will spring up like grass
or like willow trees
near flowing streams.
5They will worship me
and become my people.
They will write my name
on the back of their hands.
6 I am the Lord All-Powerful,
the first and the last,
the one and only God.
Israel, I have rescued you!
I am your King.
7Can anyone compare with me?
If so, let them speak up
and tell me now.
Let them say what has happened
since I made my nation
long ago,
and let them tell
what is going to happen.
8Don't tremble with fear!
Didn't I tell you long ago?
Didn't you hear me?
I alone am God—
no one else is a mighty rock.
Idols Can't Do a Thing
The Lord said:
9Those people who make idols
are nothing themselves,
and the idols they treasure
are just as worthless.
Worshipers of idols are blind,
stupid, and foolish.
10Why make an idol or an image
that can't do a thing?
11Everyone who makes idols
and all who worship them
are mere humans,
who will end up
sadly disappointed.
Let them face me in court
and be terrified.
Idols and Firewood
12A metalworker shapes an idol
by using a hammer
and heat from the fire.
In his powerful hand
he holds a hammer,
as he pounds the metal
into the proper shape.
But he gets hungry and thirsty
and loses his strength.
13Some woodcarver measures
a piece of wood,
then draws an outline.
The idol is carefully carved
with each detail exact.
At last it looks like a person
and is placed in a temple.
14Either cedar, cypress, oak,
or any tree from the forest
may be chosen.
Or even a pine tree planted
by the woodcarver
and watered by the rain.
15 Some of the wood is used
to make a fire for heating
or for cooking.
One piece is made into an idol,
then the woodcarver bows down
and worships it.
16He enjoys the warm fire
and the meat that was roasted
over the burning coals.
17Afterwards, he bows down
to worship the wooden idol.
“Protect me!” he says.
“You are my god.”
18Those who worship idols are stupid and blind! 19They don't have enough sense to say to themselves, “I made a fire with half of the wood and cooked my bread and meat on it. Then I made something worthless with the other half. Why worship a block of wood?”
20How can anyone be stupid enough to trust something that can be burned to ashes? No one can save themselves like that. Don't they realize that the idols they hold in their hands are not really gods?
The Lord Won't Forget His People
21People of Israel,
you are my servant,
so remember all of this.
Israel, I created you,
and you are my servant.
I won't forget you.
22Turn back to me!
I have rescued you
and swept away your sins
as though they were clouds.
Sing Praises to the Lord
23Tell the heavens and the earth
to start singing!
Tell the mountains
and every tree in the forest
to join in the song!
The Lord has rescued his people;
now they will worship him.
The Lord Created Everything
24Israel, I am your Lord,
the source of your life,
and I have rescued you.
I created everything
from the sky above
to the earth below.
25 I make liars of false prophets
and fools of fortunetellers.
I take human wisdom
and turn it into nonsense.
26I will make the message
of my prophets come true.
They are saying, “Jerusalem
will be filled with people,
and the Lord will rebuild
the towns of Judah.”
27I am the one who commands
the sea and its streams
to run dry.
28 I am also the one who says,
“Cyrus will lead my people
and obey my orders.
Jerusalem and the temple
will be rebuilt.”
translation_text:
Izrɛl hinaa Kɔraawiizi lizi tɛɛ u hiŋ
1Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N balaa Izrɛl hina, miŋ lizɛɛ,
ií ra nuu!
2Kenne mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la
n ma ia ii maawaa hizi,
di ta ia la,
di ɔɔ ra hiini ia la,
ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ
ií gilɛɛ ra ɔm! N lizi iabuu,
ii ɛɛ n balaa
ni n nɛnɔŋŋaa.
3N daŋ bizi nii ta hɛri bɔhilii,
di gil u ra pal gɔŋa la ni
hɛrhilii maa biine.
N daŋ kpa n Duma di du ii dee maa ni werge maa,
di kissi ii naanna ge maa.
4Ba daŋ lul biizi ba hel nɛnnɛ
lugɔ daajaŋra n chigɛ
gɔŋa kɛraa.
5Nɛbɛl daŋ ba wa ŋɔ, ‘N ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi hotte.’
Bɛl ge ra yir u hiŋ Jekɔb.
Bɛl ge daŋ sɛbi u nonii ni, ‘Kɔraawiizi hotte miŋ.’
Ba daŋ kpa Izrɛl sɔŋ
di dau bahinaa.”
6Kenne Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ Izrɛl Koori ni ba Lɛɛri,
di ɛɛ Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la ŋɔ,
“Minuu lugli, minuu tuna.
Kɔraawiizi maa waa hoo,
di miŋ lɛi.
7Anɛɛ n niŋ wer kpa u hiŋ di mɛgzi mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizɛi?
Gil ú sii guŋ,
wibii maa.
Gil ú bagli gunla maa n faa ɛɛwɛ lii saŋa la miŋ faa soŋŋi faala hina la,
ni gunla n niŋ haa ba.
Ɛɛh, ú bagli wia la
n niŋ ba.
8Ií gilɛɛ gil ii bɔra ra sa, ií gilɛɛ ra ɔm.
Maa felee ŋɔ wii naa
tɛɛ ia saŋa maa?
Iabuu n daansɛɛ hina. Fɔŋŋa dɔɔri bɛl kaa du denii di miŋ lɛiyaa?
Akai, vug maa waa hoo
ii dɛlli u ni di miŋ lɛi.
Maa bɛl maa zummɛ.”
9Banla maa n na kuari vuga waa kummaa ɛɛwɛ,
kuna la banna tɔgzi
waa tɔna maa dɔɔwɛ.
Banla n na kuaraa ɛɛ nyuŋŋaa.
Ba waa wiimaa zummɛ,
ba daŋ di hiihzi guŋ wia.
10Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ nɛr ma vug
gɛɛ di sɛɛuh, ka waa tɔna
maa dɔɔwɛ tɛuwɛi?
11Nɛr la maa n na kuaraa daŋ di hiihzi,
banla n na kuaraa ɛɛ neweare.
Ií gil ba maa chaali seriya diiribɔr.
Ɔnsii daŋ lau baa
ba bɔra ra sa,
bá chol di di ŋmaabi.
12Luuri ɔɔ kpa lugbiirɛ
du niŋ,
di kpa silii luuu,
di kpa u fɔŋŋa kuaruu.
Di u wa ɛɛ guŋ,
lɔzi ɔɔ lawuubuu,
u fɔŋŋa tuŋ,
niinyɔgzi ge lawuu,
u bɔra ra yɔɔri.
13Sɛɛhri ɔɔ kpa daarɛ mɛgzuu,
di zum gunla un niŋ sɛɛuh,
di kpa siah sɛɛuh,
di kuaruu,
u du newee duula,
di du wer,
ú kpau chiŋŋi vug dia.
14Hɛriŋkpolaa ɔɔ teŋri,
gɛɛ di lizi daananaa aŋhina
lii kɔr biini di kuari vug
gɛɛ di chɔɔzi aŋhina
ka ra kpaŋ dooŋ
ú ba, á hel.
15A ɛɛ nindaazi tɛu
u ra chem di ra ŋmaani
ka ra ɔɔzi paanuu.
Di ɔɔ kaa kpa a daa yeŋ
di sɛɛh vug,
di ra kuaruu,
di ra sɛɛ u dɔɔra.
16A daazi yenne ɔɔ kpa
daali u diwee,
di ɔɔzi ol di di piŋ.
Di ɔɔ ŋmaani a niŋ ge ka ŋɔ,
“Niŋ naa ŋmaanaa
summɔ oo!”
17Ka jaa kpa a daazi anla n kawɛɛ
sɛɛh vug di ra sɛɛ
u dɔɔra ka ra kuaruu,
di suŋŋuu, di ra ŋɔ,
“Lɛɛŋ! Hinuu n dɔɔri.”
18A keŋ nɛra waa wiimaa zummɛ,
ba siwee ni
ba nfɛssi tɔɔgɔɔrɛ,
ba waa na,
ba waa wiimaa ge
zɛɛ zummɛ.
19Ba bɛl maa waa nfɛrɛ dɔɔwɛ,
bɛl maa waa nunzuma dɔɔwɛ
lugɔ ú wer chi di ŋɔ,
“N kpa a daa yenne
chem niŋ,
di ɔɔzi paanuu ni ol hee.
A dɛkkɔɔ miŋ kaa kpa u yeŋ di sɛɛh kunla Kɔraawiizi n kii u wiaa?
Gɛɛ di ra togni kunla
baŋ kpa daa kuariaa?”
20Hɔɔhrii u ra di, u nfɛrɛ ra daruu,
wàá wer lɛɛ u hiŋ gɛɛ di ŋɔ,
“Kunnaa miŋ kpoglee naa
wanna dar lɛiyaa?”
21Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Izrɛl hina, ií ra liizi wia naa nɛnnɛ,
dikuu iiŋ ɛɛ n balaa wia.
N ma iabuu, ii ɛɛ n balaarɛ,
Izrɛl hina, màá suuh
ii wia maa.
22N dinzi ii wichɔgaarɛ lugɔ baama,
di dinzi ii wichɔgaa ge
maa alugɔ kɔɔl.
Ií bir ba n be,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n lɛɛ iabuu.”
23Chiŋ, a chaasi ni bɔsɔna!
Durnya hɛribɔluŋe,
ií ra chaasi werge!
Bizenaa maa, ií ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna!
Kɔrni ni a daazi maa,
ií ge gba ra ɛɛ guŋ.
Kɔraawiizi lɛɛ u nɛra Izrɛl hinaa,
di bagli baa u girme.
24Ii Lɛɛri Kɔraawiizi
la n ma ia du ii
maawaa hizi la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Minuu Kɔraawiizi,
minuu ta kummaa,
N bɛnnɛ yaa chiŋ,
n bɛnnɛ yaa hɛri gba.
25Minuu ɔɔ chɔgi dɔgtɛɛkara wia,
di gil vugra ge birgi gɛnaa,
nunzunna zumaa birgi gɛnni wia.
26Ka ɔɔ gil n balii waa wiŋɔɔlii maa ɛɛ wibii,
di gil u wiŋɔɔlii maa
ɛɛ gunla uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ.
N ŋɔ Jɛrusalɛm wiarɛ lugɔ u daŋ bir su nɛra.
N daŋ bir ma Juda bola la
baŋ purgee la.
N daŋ kaa gil
a bir du a duula.
27N dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa ń gil muuzeŋ
ni gɔŋa maa hiihzi.
28Minuu ŋɔ Sairus be, ‘I ɛɛ n penɔɔnii.
I daŋ hiŋ n kipar
di ŋɔ bá bir ma Jɛrusalɛm,
di kaa ŋɔ bá chiŋŋi
mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Dia la
ge zɛɛ.’ ”

english_text:
Cyrus Obeys the Lord's Commands
1The Lord said to Cyrus, his chosen one:
I have taken hold
of your right hand
to help you capture nations
and remove kings from power.
City gates will open for you;
not one will stay closed.
2As I lead you,
I will level mountains
and break the iron bars
on bronze gates of cities.
3I will give you treasures
hidden in dark
and secret places.
Then you will know that I,
the Lord God of Israel,
have called you by name.
4Cyrus, you don't even know me!
But I have called you by name
and highly honored you
because of Israel,
my chosen servant.
5Only I am the Lord!
There are no other gods.
I have made you strong,
though you don't know me.
6Now everyone from east to west
will learn that I am the Lord.
No other gods are real.
7I create light and darkness,
happiness and sorrow.
I, the Lord, do all this.
8Tell the heavens
to send down justice
like showers of rain.
Prepare the earth
for my saving power
to sprout and produce justice
that I, the Lord, create.
The Lord's Mighty Power
The Lord said:
9 Israel, you have no right
to argue with your Creator.
You are merely a clay pot
shaped by a potter.
The clay doesn't ask,
“Why did you make me this way?
Where are the handles?”
10Children don't have the right
to demand of their parents,
“What have you done
to make us what we are?”
11I am the Lord, the Creator,
the holy God of Israel.
Do you dare question me
about my own nation
or about what I have done?
12I created the world
and covered it with people;
I stretched out the sky
and filled it with stars.
13I have done the right thing
by placing Cyrus in power,
and I will make the roads easy
for him to follow.
I am the Lord All-Powerful!
Cyrus will rebuild my city
and set my people free
without being paid a thing.
I, the Lord, have spoken.
The Lord Alone Can Save
14My people, I, the Lord, promise
that the riches of Egypt
and the treasures of Ethiopia
will belong to you.
You will force into slavery
those tall people of Seba.
They will bow down and say,
“The only true God is with you;
there are no other gods.”
15People of Israel,
your God is a mystery,
though he alone can save.
16Anyone who makes idols
will be confused
and terribly disgraced.
17But Israel, I, the Lord,
will always keep you safe
and free from shame.
Everyone Is Invited
18The Lord alone is God!
He created the heavens
and made a world
where people can live,
instead of creating
an empty desert.
The Lord alone is God;
there are no others.
19The Lord did not speak
in a dark secret place
or command Jacob's descendants
to search for him in vain.
The Lord speaks the truth,
and this is what he says
20to every survivor
from every nation:
“Gather around me!
Learn how senseless it is
to worship wooden idols
or pray to helpless gods.
21“Why don't you get together
and meet me in court?
Didn't I tell you long ago
what would happen?
I am the only God!
There are no others.
I bring about justice,
and have the power to save.
22“I invite the whole world
to turn to me and be saved.
I alone am God!
No others are real.
23 I have made a solemn promise,
one that won't be broken:
Everyone will bow down
and worship me.
24They will admit that I alone
can bring about justice.
Everyone who is angry with me
will be terribly ashamed
and will turn to me.
25I, the Lord, will give
victory and great honor
to the people of Israel.”
translation_text:
1Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ Sairus la uŋ lizɛɛ,
ú ɛɛ koori la be,
“N lau i nodigre
di gil i kpegli hɛssi
ni ba koora,
di paagi ba dɔŋkuna maa.
N daŋ pilli ba bola dominuuzenaa tɛi,
ba wàá ka wer karaa maa.
2N daŋ tɔ i see,
di bul bizenaa la maa
n du i ŋmɛnɛɛ,
di ŋmuuri ba danyɛ dominuuzenaa,
di kuugi a lugbidaazi maa.
3N daŋ tɛi daama la n du bɔbiri,
daama n la suahwɛ.
Denii i jaa zum lugɔ Kɔraawiizi
la Izrɛl hina n na hum
labuu yir i sɔŋ.
4N balii Izrɛl la miŋ lizɛɛ tɛɛ n hiŋ la wiarɛ
n yir i sɔŋ la,
di tɛi sɔnzeŋ,
haali hiŋ wan zummɛ gba.
5Minuu Kɔraawiizi, Dɔɔri waa kaa hoo di jaa n ni.
Di min lɛi,
Dɔɔri maa waa kaa hoo.
N daŋ tɛi fɔŋŋa,
haali hiŋ wan zummɛ gba.
6Guŋ gil durnya hina maa, di lii wiifurii
di ra la wiicholii,
nɛra wer zum lugɔ vug maa waa hoo
di mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi lɛi.
7Minuu ta bɔchaaŋ ni bɔbiri maa,
di gil bɔsɔna
ni tɔɔrɔɔ maa du de.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ɛɛ annii maa.
8Chinchiŋ, gil baamazi nɛɛ wideŋlaa alugɔ dooŋ,
di gil hɛri ge lɛɛa.
Kɔ́raawiizi nɛlɛɛi ni wideŋlaa su hɛri maa.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ta a maa.
9Wia daŋ huuzi unla maa ni u Taari n na di hɔɔzi.
Vii ni u maari
daŋ wer di hɔɔzia?
Chuuri daŋ wer pɛɛzi maari, ‘Bɛɛ i ra ɛɛ gunnɛi?
I nonee waa
huma zummɛa?’
10Wia daŋ huuzi unla maa n niŋ pɛɛzi u mɛɛ ni u maa,
‘Bɛɛ i lulɛi?’ ”
11Kenne Kɔraawiizi,
Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la,
n ta baa di dau wia la
n niŋ wa ɛɛ la ra ŋɔu,
“Ii daŋ wer pɛɛziŋ n biizi wiaa?
Ii daŋ wer bagliŋ gunla
min niŋ hum n humaa?
12Minuu ta hɛri
ni newea maa.
N fɔŋŋaa n kpa yaa chiŋ,
minuu dɔɔ chinchiŋwilaa
ni chiŋ kuna maa fɔŋŋa.
13Minuu kpa n wia du Sairus bampirii, ú hum n huma,
di kuari wia a deŋli.
U daŋ bir ma n bolzeŋ la,
di lɛɛ n nɛra la
baŋ lauri yoma la.
U daŋ ɛɛ guŋ, ka wàá ŋɔ kinturgaa maa wia.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa
Hiŋ labuu ŋɔ guŋ.”
14Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ,
“Ijip kuŋkuaraa ni Itiopia soochi kuna maa daŋ birgi ii kuna.
Saba nɛjaŋra la
daŋ ba ii be,
di wa birgi ii yoma.
Ba daŋ du baa yɔlɔzi, ba hiŋ ia ba.
Ba danna togni ia,
di ra sɛɛ ii dɔɔra,
di ra ŋɔ, ‘Wibii maa, Kɔraawiizi du ii benii,
dɔɔri maa waa kaa hoo.’ ”
15Izrɛl Lɛɛri Kɔraawiizi, wibii maa,
i ɛɛ Dɔɔri la n na suah i hinnɛ.
16Banla maa n na kuari vuga daŋ di hiihzi,
di ŋmaabi.
17Ama, Izrɛl hinawaa daŋ na lɛɛi la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ
Kɔraawiizi be.
Ba ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka di hiihzi di ŋmaabi,
di hanna la, saŋaa saŋa maa.
18Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ
waabuu ta chiŋ,
waabuu Kɔraawiizi,
waabuu unla n kuaruu kennaa uŋ duwɛɛ naa,
di gil u chi.
Wɔɔ kuarɛɛ ú chɔɔ pɛɛ,
u kuaruubuu nɛ́ra du u ni.
Waabuu ŋɔwɛɛ,
“Minuu Kɔraawiizi,
bɛl maa waa kaa hoo.
19N wiŋɔɔlii maa waa suahwɛ.
Maa hɛri naa
yemmaa suahwɛ ŋɔ wia.
Maa kaa ŋɔ Jekɔb naanna ge be lugɔ
bá ra nyiŋŋi n bɔr pɛɛpɛɛ.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi ra ŋɔ wia la n deŋleene,
di ra ŋɔ wibii bɛŋ.
20Hɛssi la maa hina n chɔwɛɛ,
ií chaali dɔŋa ba.
Banla maa n chigɛ ba daazi vuga, ɛɛ gɛnaarɛ,
di ra kuari vuga la n
wàá wer lɛɛ baa.
21Ií chaali dɔŋa
ya ŋɔ wia nuu dɔŋa be!
Anɛɛ n faa ŋɔwɛɛ lugɔ guŋ daŋ wa ɛɛ lai?
Anɛɛ n faa pilli guŋ ŋmɛnɛɛ
saŋa maa n bɛrɛɛ lai?
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi lɛi faa?
Kɔraawiizi maa waa hoo
di n bɛŋ lɛi.
Wideŋlaa hiŋ ni Lɛɛri maa waa hoo
di mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi bɛŋ lɛi.
22Durnya hina maa, ií ba n be
di wa na lɛɛi.
N bɛnnɛ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi,
bɛl maa waa kaa hoo.
23N himmaa sɔnnɛ n kpa hɛɛhzi,
n wiŋɔzi deŋloore,
a ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá bir pɛɛ,
Nɛr maa daŋ wa giŋŋi n see
di hɛɛhzi lugɔ
u daŋ sɛɛŋ dɔɔra.
24Nɛra maa daŋ ŋɔ n wia lugɔ
mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi bɛŋ benii
wideŋlaa ni fɔŋŋa du.
Banla maa n faa hahŋ,
daŋ ba n be,
di wa di hiihzi.”
25Kɔraawiizi benii Izrɛl hina maa ga, bá wia deŋli,
bá ra chɔli u sɔŋ.

english_text:
Babylonia's Gods Are Helpless
The Lord said:
1The gods Bel and Nebo
are down on their knees,
as wooden images of them
are carried away
on weary animals.
2They are down on their knees
to rescue the heavy load,
but the images are still taken
to a foreign country.
3You survivors in Israel,
listen to me, the Lord.
Since the day you were born,
I have carried you along.
4I will still be the same
when you are old and gray,
and I will take care of you.
I created you. I will carry you
and always keep you safe.
5Can anyone compare with me?
Is anyone my equal?
6Some people hire a goldsmith
and give silver and gold
to be formed into an idol
for them to worship.
7They carry the idol
on their shoulders,
then put it on a stand,
but it cannot move.
They call out to the idol
when they are in trouble,
but it doesn't answer,
and it cannot help.
8Now keep this in mind,
you sinful people.
And don't ever forget it.
The Lord Alone Is God
9I alone am God!
There are no other gods;
no one is like me.
Think about what happened
many years ago.
10From the very beginning,
I told what would happen
long before it took place.
I kept my word 11and brought
someone from a distant land
to do what I wanted.
He attacked from the east,
like a hawk swooping down.
Now I will keep my promise
and do what I planned.
12You people are stubborn
and far from being safe,
so listen to me.
13I will soon come to save you.
I am not far away
and will waste no time;
I take pride in Israel
and will save Jerusalem.
translation_text:
Babilɔn vuga wia
1Babilɔn vuga tunaa keŋ.
Ba faa ra kuari Bɛɛl ni Nɛbɔɔ,
ka filaŋkeŋ,
ba kpaabuu chug kauzi.
A ɛɛ buntɔgaa tɛɛ
sela la n kuuhwɛ.
2A vuga wàá wer lɛɛ a hiŋ,
ba kpeglaabuu di chia ra kaali.
Babilɔn vuga tunaa guŋ!
3“Ií ra nuu n be, Jekɔb naanna,
ii banla n ka Izrɛl hɛri la.
N binni iabuu guŋŋ di lii ii lulaa saŋa maa.
4N daŋ haa ra binni ia di ra la ii zɛŋaa saŋa.
Minuu Kɔraawiizi.
Minuu ma ia, n daŋ kpogli ia,
di hiini ia, di lɛɛ ia.
5Anɛɛ ii wer kpaŋ mɛgzɛi?
Anɛɛ n dɔŋhinɛi?
6Baŋhina lizi salinnɛ ba hure biine,
di mɛgzi saliŋhuŋŋa ge jaa.
Ba kpaa suŋŋi luuri u luu vug tɛɛ baa,
ba giŋŋi u see
di ra jaamuu.
7Ba lalluubuu sag ba baŋaazi, di chiu ra vol,
ka jaa wa kpau
baŋ bɔr la un niŋ chi.
U chi de,
u himmaa wàá ka wer lii de.
Nɛr la maa n suŋŋuu, ka wàá nuu
di lɛɛu lii u tɔɔrɔɔzi biine.
8Ií ra liizi keŋ, di gil a du ii nyuuni.
Nɛkpoŋlaa, ii gil
a du ii bampiree.
9Ií ra liizi wia la n faa ɛɛwɛ saŋa maa la.
N bɛnnɛ Kɔraawiizi,
bɛl maa waa kaa hoo.
N dɔŋ maa ge waa hoo.
10Lugli maanii aŋ zum wii tuna.
Wii la maa miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ
daŋ wa ɛɛ.
Wii la miŋ dauwɛ,
n daŋ ɛɛu.
11N daŋ yir baal bɛl lii wiifurii,
u daŋ ba alugɔ
kɔlaa n ɔɔ tuu kpa kuŋ la,
di ɛɛ wii la miŋ ta u jina.
Wii la maa miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ, n daŋ ɛɛu.
12Ií ra nuu n be, dignikpega hina,
ii banla ni wideŋlaa
n nɛɛwɛ la.
13N wideŋlaa ɛɛi ra dugluu,
a waa kaa du nɛɛ.
Min niŋ lɛɛ ia la wàá ka birgi.
N daŋ lɛɛ Jɛrusalɛm hina,
di gil Izrɛl hɛri
dɔɔ n girme.”

english_text:
Babylon Will Fall
The Lord said:
1 City of Babylon,
You are delicate
and untouched,
but that will change.
Surrender your royal power
and sit in the dirt.
2Start grinding grain!
Take off your veil.
Strip off your fancy clothes
and wade across rivers.
3You will suffer the shame
of going naked,
because I will take revenge,
and no one can escape.
4I am the Lord All-Powerful,
the holy God of Israel.
I am their Savior.
5Babylon, be silent!
Sit in the dark.
No longer will nations
accept you as their queen.
6I was angry with my people.
So I let you take their land
and bring disgrace on them.
You showed them no mercy,
but were especially cruel
to those who were old.
7You thought that you
would be queen forever.
You didn't care what you did;
it never entered your mind
that you might get caught.
8 You think that you alone
are all-powerful,
that you won't be a widow
or lose your children.
All you care about is pleasure,
but listen to what I say.
9Your magic powers and charms
will suddenly fail,
then you will be a widow
and lose your children.
10You hid behind evil
like a shield and said,
“No one can see me!”
You were fooled by your wisdom
and your knowledge;
you felt sure that you alone
were in full control.
11But without warning,
disaster will strike—
and your magic charms
won't help at all.
12Keep using your magic powers
and your charms
as you have always done.
Maybe—just maybe—
you will frighten somebody!
13You have worn yourself out,
asking for advice
from those who study the stars
and tell the future
month after month.
Go ask them how to be saved
from what will happen.
14People who trust the stars
are as helpless as straw
in a flaming fire.
No one can even keep warm,
sitting by a fire
that feeds only on straw.
15These are the fortunetellers
you have done business with
all of your life.
But they don't know
where they are going,
and they can't save you.
translation_text:
Babilɔn cholaa wia
1Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Babilɔn n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ suŋguru la
n waa baal zummɛ,
tuu ga so hɛri!
Izi i koorikara la ni
di ga so hɛri,
Babilɔn hina biihaaŋ!
Ba wàá ka yirii biipɔɔh,
ba wàá ka yirii
bunya hiŋ kunjɛgɛkɛ.
2Kpa nam di nam sau,
di wir i saata.
Kossi i wondoŋ, ka ka i naazi,
ka gi gɔŋa.
3I daŋ vol chakpal
di di hiihzi.
N daŋ turgii i nɛtɔɔraa la kim,
nɛr maa wàá wer laafiŋ.”
4Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii labuu lɛɛ yaa,
u sɔnnɛ Kɔraawiizi
Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ.
5Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ Babilɔn hina biihaaŋ benii,
“So bɔbiri biini di tɔ i nua.
Nɛr maa ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá
ka yirii hɛssi wiche.
6N baaŋ faa fuuh n nɛra ninɛɛ,
n faa vɛɛ baa,
di kpa baa du i nonee biini.
Ka i faa waa ba ni
sunne tama maa.
Haali i faa sunni
ba nɛzɛŋzii werge maa.
7I faa ɛɛ tamiirɛ lugɔ i daŋ ɛɛ wichee di hanna la.
I faa waa nfɛrɛ
ra fɛ wiimaa wia,
gɛɛ a wia laba.
8Filaŋkeŋ, jaa ra nuu, hìŋ́ unla n na di i hiŋ,
di ra fɛ lugɔ wiimaa
wàá wer huuzii la.
I ɔɔ ra ŋɔu i biini,
‘N bɛnnɛ, n dɔŋ waa hoo.
N ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá birgi luhaaŋ
gɛɛ n biini chɔgi,
dikuu biizi siu wia.’
9Ka ŋmɛnɛ bɛl, a wia anɛɛ naa maa
daŋ wa pirgii hɔpizikpaŋ,
í chol, í wia tuŋ.
Haali i ni i hiri la maa,
ka i daŋ birgi luhaaŋ,
i biizi ge siuzi.
10Hiŋ yardi biinikpola wiɛɛlaa wia,
i ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
‘Nɛr maa wanna na.’
Ka i nunzuma ni i sichaana faa dariibuu,
i ŋɔ i biini, ‘N bɛnnɛ,
n dɔŋ waa hoo.’
11Hɛhchɔg werge daŋ wa chol i ni,
hàá wer kpa i hiri
di biraa maa.
Dɔgnya werge daŋ ba,
hàá wer teŋaa ŋmɛnɛɛ,
hɛhchɔg la dee hiŋ waa nawɛɛ maa
daŋ wa pirgii.
12Haa ra ɛɛ i ziŋgaabo wiɛɛlaa
ni i hiri dii la,
hiŋ faa aah siwii di ra
ɛɛ lii i bichalli saŋa la.
Aŋhinabe, a daŋ hiinii,
aŋhinabe, i wia
daŋ dɔɔ ɔnsii.
13I bɔra yɔɔrɔɔrɛ, haali nɛkpila n birii liize gba!
Gil i nɛra la n zum chinchiŋwilaa wia,
di ɔɔ binnaa ka ra bagli gunla
n niŋ wa ɛɛ baagu maa biini la,
ba wa lɛɛi lii wia la
n niŋ wa huuzii biini.
14Wibii maa, ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ kooriihilaa,
niŋ daŋ fuuh baa.
Ba wàá wer lɛɛ bahinaa lii a niŋ be.
A niŋhɔla waa kunla
hin niŋ ŋmaani ɛɛwɛ.
15Gunnɛ nɛra naa i ni baa n hummɛ
i bichalli maa la
wer ɛɛ tɛi.
Bɛl maa daŋ leu, di ga u ŋmɛnɛɛ ra kaali.
Bɛl maa wàá wer lɛɛi.”

english_text:
The Lord Corrects His People
1People of Israel,
you come from Jacob's family
and the tribe of Judah.
You claim to worship me,
the Lord God of Israel,
but you are lying.
2You call Jerusalem your home
and say you depend on me,
the Lord All-Powerful,
the God of Israel.
3Long ago I announced
what was going to be,
then without warning,
I made it happen.
4I knew you were stubborn
and hardheaded.
5And I told you these things,
so that when they happened
you would not say,
“The idols we worship did this.”
6You heard what I said,
and you have seen it happen.
Now admit it's true!
I will show you secrets
you have never known.
7Today I am doing something new,
something you cannot say
you have heard before.
8You have never been willing
to listen to what I say;
from the moment of your birth,
I knew you would rebel.
The Lord Warns Israel
9I, the Lord, am true to myself;
I will be praised for not punishing
and destroying you.
10I tested you in hard times
just as silver is refined
in a heated furnace.
11I did this because of who I am.
I refuse to be dishonored
or share my praise
with any other god.
12 Israel, my chosen people,
listen to me.
I alone am the Lord,
the first and the last.
13With my own hand
I created the earth
and stretched out the sky.
They obey my every command.
The Lord Speaks to the Nations
14Gather around me, all of you!
Listen to what I say.
Did any of your idols
predict this would happen?
Did they say that my friend
would do what I want done
to Babylonia?
15I was the one who chose him.
I have brought him this far,
and he will be successful.
16Come closer and listen!
I have never kept secret
the things I have said,
and I was here
before time began.
It Is Best To Obey the Lord
By the power of his Spirit
the Lord God has sent me
17with this message:
People of Israel,
I am the holy Lord God,
the one who rescues you.
For your own good,
I teach you, and I lead you
along the right path.
18How I wish that you
had obeyed my commands!
Your success and good fortune
would then have overflowed
like a flooding river.
19Your nation would be blessed
with more people
than there are grains of sand
along the seashore.
And I would never have let
your country be destroyed.
20 Now leave Babylon!
Celebrate as you go.
Be happy and shout
for everyone to hear,
“The Lord has rescued
his servant Israel!
21He led us through the desert
and made water flow from a rock
to satisfy our thirst.
22 But the Lord has promised
that none who are evil
will live in peace.”
translation_text:
Izrɛl hina kpoŋaa wia
1Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Ií ra nuu, Jekɔb diahina,
banla banna yir Izrɛl,
ii lii Juda dee biini la,
ii banla n ɔɔ kpa n sɔŋ di ra hɛɛhzi,
di ra yiriŋ,
ka ii waa wibii
ni wideŋlaa wia ra ɛɛ la.
2Ii ra yir iihinaa bolzennaniinanii hina,
di dɛlli mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la
Izrɛl hina n na hum la ni.
N sɔnnɛ Kɔraawiizi
Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ.
3N faa bagli wia la n niŋ wa ɛɛu.
Kakpaŋ, n gil a ɛɛ.
4Ama, n zummɔɔ ii digna n kpekke,
ii baŋaazi diah du kpeg
alugɔ lugbii,
ii hilli ge gba
du kpeg alugɔ danyɛ.
5Awiarɛ n feli ŋɔ ii be, wia naa faala maa
mɔɔ ka a wa ɛɛ la,
n sii a wiarɛ.
Ii wàá ka wer ŋɔ lugɔ ii vugaa gillɛ guŋ ɛɛ,
ii vuga la n ɛɛ
lugbia ni daazi la.
6Ii nuu n wiŋɔɔlaarɛ, di kaa naa aŋ ɛɛwɛ.
Ii wàá sɛɛ dí wibiireaa?
Filaŋkeŋ, n daŋ ŋɔ wifalaa tɛɛ ia,
wisuahlaa la iiŋ
haa waa nuuwɛ.
7Miŋ ta a widizi, a waa birgee.
Di zinaa lɛi, ii haa waa
a wia nuuwɛ ŋmɛnɛ maa.
Awia, ii wàá wer ŋɔ,
‘Ɛɛh, yaa zumaabuu.’
8Akai, ii waa wiimaa nuuwɛ, ii waa wiimaa ge gba zummɛ,
ii waa felee nuu
a wia saŋa maa.
N zum ii wiarɛ lugɔ ii ɛɛ sɔsɔgɔ hinaa,
di ɛɛ dignikpega hina
lii saŋa la
baŋ lul ia la maa.
9Minna nyiŋŋi nɛra chɔli n sɔŋ wia, n di kanyittii,
maa sɛɛwɛ n kpa baaŋ chɔgi ia
di dim ii dee maa.
10N du iabuu niŋ biini,
ka a waa lugɔ gunla baŋ ɔɔ
du saliŋhuŋŋa niŋ biini,
u doŋa lii la.
N kpa tɔɔrɔɔrɛ ɛɛ ia na.
11Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi himmaa wiarɛ n ɛɛ guŋ.
A dɛkkɔ n sɔŋ n chɔkkɛɛ?
Màá gil kundumazi na
girme la nɛra
n niŋ vii tɛŋ.”
Izrɛl hina n na bahinaa wia
12Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Izrɛl hina miŋ lizɛɛ di tɛɛ n hiŋ la,
ií ra nuu n be!
N bɛnnɛ Kɔraawiizi.
Minuu lugli, minuu tuna.
13Minuu chiŋŋi hɛri naa zɛɛ,
n fɔŋŋaa n kpa yaa chiŋ.
Di n wa yiraa,
a maa ɔɔ bau kakpaŋ.
14Ií maa chaali di waa nuu!
Vug bɛliirɛ ŋmɛnɛ haa ŋɔ
keŋ wia naanɛi?
Baal la min lizɛɛ
lugɔ ú ɛɛ n kipar
di lɔ Babilɔn laal la
daŋ ɛɛ guŋ.
15N himmaanii ŋɔ u wia,
minuu yiruu,
minuu ba u ni.
Awia, wiimaa waa hoo
ú tɔu ŋmɛnɛɛ.
16Ií tuzi heliŋ di nuu wia la min niŋ ŋɔ,
di lii lugli la maa, n haa waa wiimaa ŋɔwɛɛ suah.
Wii la maa n ɛɛwɛ,
n du denii ka u ɛɛ.”
Filaŋkeŋ, Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa labuu
hum n ni u Duma.
17Kenne Kɔraawiizi, ii Lɛɛri,
Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la ŋɔ,
“Minuu Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum,
unla n na bagli ia wia la
n wesse tɛɛ ia,
di ra bagli ia
ŋmɛnizi la iin ninna hiŋ.
18Di ii faa ra hiŋ n nuuzi labuu, ii daŋ faa dɔɔ bɔsɔna
lugɔ muu n suwee
di ra pal guŋ sɛlɛlɛlɛ.
Ií wideŋlaa ge
daŋ faa ɛɛ lugɔ
muuzeŋ n na lɔ.
19Ii naanna daŋ faa ɛɛ lugɔ hɛɛhriichaa,
ii biizi du kpil
alugɔ hɛɛhriichaa.
Ií dɔma ŋmɛnɛ maa faa wàá chɔgi baa,
bá sɔŋ dim.”
20Ií lii Babilɔn!
Ií chɔ lii Babilɔn hina be!
Ií sii guŋ, di chaasi ni bɔsɔna!
Ií gil durnya hina maa nuu guŋ!
Ií ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi lɛɛ
u balii Izrɛl labuu.”
21Banla uŋ faa kpoglee ga hɛribɔduma la, niinyɔgzi faa waa baa kpuwɛɛ.
U faa gillɔɔ nii pal lii bii ni.
U faa peri a biirɛ,
nii pozi lii.
22Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Biinikpola hina waa, ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá dɔɔ bɔsɔna.”

english_text:
The Work of the Lord's Servant
1 Everyone, listen,
even you foreign nations
across the sea.
The Lord chose me
and gave me a name
before I was born.
2 He made my words pierce
like a sharp sword
or a pointed arrow;
he kept me safely hidden
in the palm of his hand.
3The Lord said to me,
“Israel, you are my servant;
and because of you
I will be highly honored.”
4I said to myself,
“I'm completely worn out;
my time has been wasted.
But I did it for the Lord God,
and he will reward me.”
5Even before I was born,
the Lord God chose me
to serve him and to lead back
the people of Israel.
So the Lord has honored me
and made me strong.
6 Now the Lord says to me,
“It isn't enough for you
to be merely my servant.
You must do more than lead back
survivors from the tribes
of Israel.
I have placed you here as a light
for other nations;
you must take my saving power
to everyone on earth.”
The Lord Will Rescue His People
7Israel, I am the holy Lord God,
the one who rescues you.
You are slaves of rulers
and of a nation
who despises you.
Now this is what I promise:
Kings and rulers will honor you
by kneeling at your feet.
You can trust me! I am your Lord,
the holy God of Israel,
and you are my chosen ones.
The Lord Will Lead His People Home
8 This is what the Lord says:
I will answer your prayers
because I have set a time
when I will help
by coming to save you.
I have chosen you
to take my promise of hope
to other nations.
You will rebuild the country
from its ruins,
then people will come
and settle there.
9You will set prisoners free
from dark dungeons
to see the light of day.
On their way home,
they will find plenty to eat,
even on barren hills.
10 They won't go hungry
or get thirsty;
they won't be bothered
by the scorching sun
or hot desert winds.
I will be merciful
while leading them along
to streams of water.
11I will level the mountains
and make roads.
12Then my people will return
from distant lands
in the north and the west
and from the city of Syene.
The Lord's Mercy
13Tell the heavens and the earth
to celebrate and sing;
command every mountain
to join in the song.
The Lord's people have suffered,
but he has shown mercy
and given them comfort.
14The people of Zion said,
“The Lord has turned away
and forgotten us.”
15The Lord answered,
“Could a mother forget a child
who nurses at her breast?
Could she fail to love an infant
who came from her own body?
Even if a mother could forget,
I will never forget you.
16A picture of your city
is drawn on my hand.
You are always in my thoughts!
17“Your city will be built faster
than it was destroyed—
those who attacked it
will retreat and leave.
18Look around! You will see
your people coming home.
As surely as I live,
I, the Lord, promise
that your city with its people
will be as lovely as a bride
wearing her jewelry.”
Jerusalem's Bright Future
19Jerusalem is now in ruins!
Nothing is left of the city.
But it will be rebuilt
and soon overcrowded;
its cruel enemies
will be gone far away.
20Jerusalem is a woman
whose children were born
while she was in deep sorrow
over the loss of her husband.
Now those children
will come and seek room
in the crowded city,
21and Jerusalem will ask,
“Am I really their mother?
How could I have given birth
when I was still mourning
in a foreign land?
Who raised these children?
Where have they come from?”
22 The Lord God says:
“I will soon give a signal
for the nations
to return your sons
and your daughters
to the arms of Jerusalem.
23The kings and queens
of those nations
where they were raised
will come and bow down.
They will take care of you
just like a slave
taking care of a child.
Then you will know
that I am the Lord.
You won't be disappointed
if you trust me.”
The Lord Is on Our Side
24Is it possible to rescue victims
from someone strong
and cruel?
25But the Lord has promised
to fight on our side
and to rescue our children
from those strong
and violent enemies.
26He will make those cruel people
dine on their own flesh
and get drunk from drinking
their own blood.
Then everyone will know
that the Lord is our Savior;
the powerful God of Israel
has rescued his people.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi balii wia
1Muuzeŋ baaŋ hɛssi, ií maa ra nuu n be,
ii banla maa n du bɔɔnɛɛzi,
ií maa ra nuu!
Kɔraawiizi yirimbuu, di n haa du n maa hia.
U dau n sɔnnɛ mɔɔ
ka ba luliŋ.
2U gillɔɔ n nua wiŋɔzi ɛɛ lugɔ tokobidiilii.
U kpa u noniire tɔ n ni.
U kuarimbuu lugɔ baŋ sazi hobii,
bá tau la.
3U ŋɔwɔɔrɛ tɛŋ, “Izrɛl, i ɛɛ n baliirɛ,
i benii ń ga na girme.”
4Ka n ŋɔ, “N wiɛɛlaa maa ɛɛ pɛɛrɛ.
N kuuhwɔɔ pɛɛ,
tɔna maa waa liwɛɛ.
Ama, n gil a maanii tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi,
di kaa yardi ge lugɔ
n kinturgaa du u benii.”
5Ka filaŋkeŋ, Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ wiarɛ tɛŋ.
Waabuu maŋ, di n haa du
n maa hia, ń wa ɛɛ u balii,
ú gil n bir Izrɛl hina maa, di ba u be,
bá wa dɔɔ nuukpaŋ.
N na girme Kɔraawiizi be,
n fɔŋŋa lii u benii.
6U ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“N balii, n dɔɔ wizenne ń tɛi.
A waa lugɔ Izrɛl hina la
n kawɛɛ bɛnnɛ,
n lizii í lɛɛ,
dí gil ba bir dɔɔ sɔŋ la
baŋ faa dɔɔwɛ la.
N daŋ gil i ɛɛ lugɔ bɔchaaŋ hɛssi hina maa be,
guŋ gil durnya hina
maa na lɛɛi.”
7Izrɛl Lɛɛri ni ba Dɔɔrinaniinanii
Kɔraawiizi la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ
di ra tɛɛ unla hɛssi hina maa n na gbɛlli,
di vɛɛu ta, u ɛɛ
koora maa balii la,
“Koora daŋ nai di izi chi,
kooribiizi nai di ra tognii.
A maa daŋ ɛɛ dikuu Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii
la wia n dɔɔ wibii,
u lizii la wia.”
Izrɛl hina bir kuari sogaa wia
8Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ,
“N nuuwɔɔ tɛɛ ia, saŋa la miŋ suŋ ii ni la,
di hiini ia ii na lɛɛi la.
N daŋ binni ia di guu ia,
di ga ii ni,
n ni nɛra maa ɛɛ nuukpaŋ.
N daŋ kaa gil ii bir la ga so
ii hɛri la baŋ chɔkkɛ la,
di bir ga dɔɔ ii kapɛttɛ
hɛssi iiŋ gillɛ ta la.
9Di ŋɔ banla baŋ tɔ diini be, ‘Ií wa lii!’
Ii banla ge n du bɔbiri biini,
‘Ií wa lii bɔchaaŋ!’
Ba daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ peeza, di ra di ŋmɛnikɛraa,
di kaa na diwee ge
giŋgimee n faa waa
kummaa dɔɔwɛ a nyuuni.
10Lɔzi ni niinyɔgzi ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka kpu baa,
hɛribɔduma wiliŋ ni wiinyɛgii
wàá ka kpu baa.
Unla n na ba sinyɛna la daŋ tɔ ba see,
di ra la bulli bɔra.
11N daŋ bul n bizenaa maa, á birgi ŋmɛnizi,
di dau ŋmɛnizenaa.
12Na! N nɛra daŋ lii bɔɔnɛɛ ba,
baŋhina lii wiicholii
ni wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag,
baŋhina ge lii Aswan ba.”
13Chiŋ ni hɛri, ií ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna!
Bizenaa, ií ra yir yira!
Kɔraawiizi daŋ du u nɛra bɔkpega,
di ra suŋ banla
n na di dɔgnya ni.
14Jɛrusalɛm hina faa ra ŋɔu,
“Kɔraawiizi gil yaabuu ta,
Kɔraawiizi suuh yaa wiarɛ.”
15Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Haaŋ daŋ wer suuh u bie la n na ɔzi wiaa?
Gɛɛ di vɛɛ u biilullii
sinyɛna naiyaa?
Haali di guŋ daŋ ɛɛ gba,
ka miŋwaa wàá
suuh ii wia!
16Na, n sɛbi Jɛrusalɛm sɔnnɛ dau n nopaala ni.
I wia du n bampiriire
saŋa maa.
17Nɛra la n niŋ bir mai la, ra yali siweere bá bir ba,
banla waa n purii la
daŋ kaali.
18Lalli i nyuu binni kɛraa na,
i nɛra maanii chaalɛɛ
di ra ba i be.
Miŋ du de saŋa maa wia,
ba daŋ du i be
di gil i du wer
alugɔ hiŋ du nonibisiga
gɛɛ haŋfalii n bɔkkɛ.
19Haali i dɔma n faa purii,
i hɛri maa chɔgi,
di birgi diŋgela la,
filaŋkeŋ i daŋ bir du jiga, i nɛra maa wàá na bɔr so,
ka i dɔma la n purii la,
chɔ kaali bɔɔnɛɛ.
20Biizi la baŋ lullɛ i dɔgnya dii saŋa,
danna ŋɔ i be,
‘Bɔr naa fattɔɔ,
nyiŋŋi bɔr tɛɛ yaa.’
21I daŋ bir pɛɛzi i hiŋ,
‘Anɛɛ n lul biizi naa tɛnnɛi?
N biizi maa faa siuzɔɔrɛ, ka ka n bɛŋ.
Ba lawiŋ yom kaali
hɛrduma bɛl.
Ka anɛɛ n jaa dɛɛzi banniinɛi?
N bɛnnɛ faa kawɛɛ,
ka lee bannii ge
kaa liiyɛi?’ ”
22Kenne Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la kaa ŋɔ,
“Na, n daŋ kamzi banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ la,
di lalli n tuuta bagli nɛra,
ba daŋ kpa i biibaala pɛgli,
di kpa i biihaana ge
sagzi ba baŋaazi di wa tɛi.
23Koora daŋ ɛɛ ii mɛɛwaa,
wichezi ɛɛ ii maawaa.
Ba daŋ ɔɔ giŋŋi ii sezi,
di ra lenni ii naazi.
Denii ii jaa zum lugɔ minuu Kɔraawiizi.
Banla maa n yardiŋ
ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá di hiihzi.”
24Anɛɛ n niŋ wer foozi kuna la laallɔɔri n kpegli u dɔma ka paagɛi?
Anɛɛ n niŋ wer foozi
biinikpola hiŋ yoma
uŋ laurɛɛ laal biini lii
u nonii biinei?
25Ama, kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ,
“Laallɔɔri kuŋfoozaa
ni biinikpola hina yoma
daŋ lii ba nonee biini.
N daŋ naa banla ni ia n na naa la,
ń lɛɛ ii biizi ta.
26N daŋ gil i dɔma la bir di ra hee dɔŋa,
di ra nyɔɔ ba himmaa
challi di dɛɛzi
alugɔ baŋ nyɔɔ siŋkpega.
Denii durnya nɛra maa jaa zum
lugɔ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii
i Lɛɛri, di gil ii dɔɔ iihinaa,
di kaa ɛɛ Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la
Jekɔb n na hum la.”

english_text:
The Lord's Power To Punish
1 The Lord says, “Children,
I didn't divorce your mother
or sell you to pay debts;
I divorced her and sold you
because of your sins.
2I came and called out,
but you didn't answer.
Have I lost my power
to rescue and save?
At my command oceans and rivers
turn into deserts;
fish rot and stink
for lack of water.
3I make the sky turn dark
like the sackcloth
you wear at funerals.”
God's Servant Must Suffer
4The Lord God gives me
the right words
to encourage the weary.
Each morning he awakens me
eager to learn his teaching;
5he made me willing to listen
and not rebel or run away.
6 I let them beat my back
and pull out my beard.
I didn't turn aside
when they insulted me
and spit in my face.
7But the Lord God keeps me
from being disgraced.
So I refuse to give up,
because I know
God will never let me down.
8 My protector is nearby;
no one can stand here
to accuse me of wrong.
9The Lord God will help me
and prove I am innocent.
My accusers will wear out
like moth-eaten clothes.
10None of you respect the Lord
or obey his servant.
You walk in the dark
instead of the light;
you don't trust the name
of the Lord your God.
11Go ahead and walk in the light
of the fires you have set.
But with his own hand,
the Lord will punish you
and make you suffer.
translation_text:
Izrɛl hina wichɔgaa ni Balii la n hiŋ Kɔraawiizi nua wia
1Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ,
“Lee hahvɛɛri hɔŋ la
miŋ kpawɛɛ vɛɛ ii maa duɛi?
Gɛɛ n kpa iabuu
turgi kimaa?
Akai! Ii himmaa wichɔgaa wiarɛ ii birgi yoma.
Ii wichɔgaa wiarɛ
n faa vɛɛ ii maa.
2Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ nɛr maa faa waa hoo de, saŋa la miŋ ballɛ lai?
Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ nɛr maa faa
waa n yiraa sɛɛwɛi?
N nonii siuwɔɔ, màá wer lɛɛ ia gɛɛ?
Gɛɛ maa fɔŋŋa dɔɔwɛ
min niŋ wer lɛɛ iai?
Ií na, n daŋ wer ŋɔ wikpaŋ, ka muuzeŋ hiihzi,
gɛɛ di gil muuni hiihzi,
a biine nyinni siu, di pɔɔh.
3N daŋ wer gil chiŋ biri,
di gil u ɛɛ lugɔ lubol.”
4Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la baglimbuu gunla min niŋ ŋɔ,
di du nɛra la bɔra
n huahwɛ bɔkpega.
Chɔɔzi maa, u ɔɔ lallimbuu,
di pilli n digna
n na nuu wia nɛnnɛ
alugɔ balii la unna bagli wia.
5Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la pilli n dignaa,
n sɛɛ tɛu, maa vɛɛwɛ.
6N bir n hattɛ tɛɛ nɛra ba viiriŋ,
di bir n taŋhuna
tɛɛ nɛra ba kpuzaa.
Maa n siwee kpawɛɛ suah banla n na ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ,
di puuzi nuuhaari
di ra du n ni la ni.
7Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ra hiinimbuu,
awia, màá di hiihzi.
N ɛɛ siryaa nɛnnɛ,
dikuu miŋ zummɛ lugɔ
màá di hiihzi wia.
8Nɛr la n niŋ tɛŋ bilii duglɔɔrɛ!
Anɛɛ n niŋ kaa wer
tɛŋ chɔgrɛi?
Á hiŋ gil ya zuu
seriya diiribɔr!
Anɛɛ n kpa wia ra chuginnɛi?
Á hiŋ gil ya bil dɔŋa!
9Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa labuu ra hiiniŋ!
Anɛɛ n niŋ kur ka ŋɔ
n cholloowei?
Ba maanii ra mɔɔri alugɔ wɛjɛ,
chau n mugzɛɛ.
10Ii biini u bɛliirɛ ra ɔm Kɔraawiizi,
di ra nuu u balii wiŋɔzɛi?
Gil unla n na vol bɔbiri biini,
ka waa niŋ dɔɔwɛ,
yardi Kɔraawiizi,
di dɛlli u ni.
11Too, ii banla maa n kpogli fintinazi
ni kacheela,
ií ra vol a nine ii himmaa
n choŋŋee la bɔchaaŋ.
Ama, kenne ii na lii n be.
Ii daŋ chɔɔ
di ra di tɔɔrɔɔ werge.

english_text:
The Lord Will Bring Comfort
1 If you want to do right
and obey the Lord,
follow Abraham's example.
He was the rock from which
you were chipped.
2God chose Abraham and Sarah
to be your ancestors.
The Lord blessed Abraham,
and from that one man
came many descendants.
3Though Zion is in ruins,
the Lord will bring comfort,
and the city will be as lovely
as the garden of Eden
that he provided.
Then Zion will celebrate;
it will be thankful
and sing joyful songs.
The Lord's Victory Will Last
4The Lord says:
You are my people and nation!
So pay attention to me.
My teaching will cause justice
to shine like a light
for every nation.
5Those who live across the sea
are eagerly waiting
for me to rescue them.
I am strong and ready;
soon I will come to save
and to rule all nations.
6Look closely at the sky!
Stare at the earth.
The sky will vanish like smoke;
the earth will wear out
like clothes.
Everyone on this earth
will die like flies.
But my victory will last;
my saving power never ends.
7If you want to do right
and obey my teaching
with all your heart,
then pay close attention.
Don't be discouraged
when others insult you
and say hurtful things.
8They will be eaten away
like a moth-eaten coat.
But my victory will last;
my saving power
will never end.
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
9Wake up! Do something, Lord.
Be strong and ready.
Wake up! Do what you did
for our people long ago.
Didn't you chop up
Rahab the monster?
10Didn't you dry up the deep sea
and make a road for your people
to follow safely across?
11Now those you have rescued
will return to Jerusalem,
singing on their way.
They will be crowned
with great happiness,
never again to be burdened
with sadness and sorrow.
The Lord Gives Hope
12I am the Lord, the one
who encourages you.
Why are you afraid
of mere humans?
They dry up and die like grass.
13I spread out the heavens
and laid foundations
for the earth.
But you have forgotten me,
your Lord and Creator.
All day long you were afraid
of those who were angry
and hoped to oppress you.
Where are they now?
14Everyone crying out in pain
will be quickly set free;
they will be rescued
from the power of death
and never go hungry.
15I will help them
because I am your God,
the Lord All-Powerful,
who makes the ocean roar.
16I have told you what to say,
and I will keep you safe
in the palm of my hand.
I spread out the heavens
and laid foundations
for the earth.
Now I say, “Jerusalem,
your people are mine.”
A Warning to Jerusalem
17 Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up!
You've drunk too much
from the cup filled
with the Lord's anger.
You have swallowed every drop,
and you can't walk straight.
18Not one of your many children
is there to guide you
or to offer a helping hand.
19You have been destroyed
by war and by famine;
I cannot comfort you.
20The Lord your God is angry,
and on every street corner
your children lie helpless,
like deer trapped in nets.
21You are in trouble and drunk,
but not from wine.
So pay close attention
22to the Lord your God,
who defends you and says,
“I have taken from your hands
the cup filled with my anger
that made you drunk.
You will never be forced
to drink it again.
23Instead I will give it
to your brutal enemies,
who treated you like dirt
and walked all over you.”
translation_text:
Jɛrusalɛm hina bampirii tigaa wia
1Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Ií ra nuu n be, ii banla maa n na nyiŋŋi wideŋlaa ɛɛi,
di kaa ra nyiŋŋi lɛɛi n be la.
Ií ra liizi bii la baŋ mɔŋ ia lii u ni la wia,
di ra liizi bia purgibɔr la
baŋ mɔŋ ia lii la wia.
2Ií ra liizi ii naabaal Abraham
ni Saara la n lul ia wia.
Abraham faa ɛɛ u bɛnnɛ, ka n yiruu,
di kissuu, di gil u dee
wazi werge maa.
3Wibii maa, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi daŋ kaa tig Jɛrusalɛm hina bampiree,
di suŋ u diŋgelli la ni.
N daŋ gil u hɛribɔdumazi du alugɔ Ɛdɛn kambol,
u du lugɔ
Kɔraawiizi kambol.
Bɔsɔna ni bampirsɔna daŋ du de,
ba ra yir yirsuma
di ra chɔliŋ.
4N nɛra, ií ra nuu n be!
N hɛri hina, ií ra nuu!
N daŋ du Gbɔgni, nɛ́ra ra hiŋaa,
n wibii dii ge ɛɛ bɔchaaŋ
tɛɛ hɛssi hina maa.
5N wideŋlaa ra dugluu,
n nɛlɛɛi saŋa ra hel.
N daŋ di kora hɛssi
hina maa ni, ni wibii.
Muuzeŋ baaŋ hɛssi hina maa ra kpaŋ n balaarɛ,
di dɔɔ n tamii lugɔ
n daŋ lɛɛ baa.
6Ií lalli ii nyuuni binni chiŋ,
di kaa binni hɛri ge.
A chiŋ daŋ leu kakpaŋ alugɔ nyɔɔzi,
hɛri ge mɔɔri alugɔ wɛjɛbinii,
u nɛra siuzi alugɔ nakɛɛhzi.
Ama, n nɛlɛɛi la waa daŋ haŋ du denii di hanna la,
n wideŋlaa ge
waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
7Ií ra nuu n be, ii banla n zum wideŋlaa,
n Gbɔg du ii bampiree la!
Ií gilɛɛ kaa ra ɔm nɛra la n na chagzi ia.
Ií gilɛɛ gil ii banchulli
ra lɔ dikuu banna chɔgi
ii sɔna wia.
8Ba wia daŋ tuŋ lugɔ chau n mugzi wɛjɛ,
gɛɛ sandule n di gonni.
Ama, n wideŋlaa lawaa daŋ du de di hanna la,
n nɛlɛɛi la ge du de
jimini maa.”
9N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, izi chiŋ di bagli i fɔŋŋa
gunla hiŋ faa ɛɛwɛ faala la.
Hiŋ lɛi faa tɔɔh
muuzeŋ biini sechɔgii Rahab
n chummɛ werge
di mɔnnuu laa?
10Hiŋ lɛi faa gillɛ muuzeŋ la
n luŋŋe werge nii hiihzi,
di dau ŋmɛnihilii u baaŋ,
i nɛra la hiŋ lɛɛwɛ lii
tɔɔrɔɔ biini gi laa?
11Awia, banla hiŋ turgi ba kim, di lɛɛ baa ha la, daŋ bir ba.
Ba daŋ bir ba
Bolzeŋ Ziɔn
di ra yir yira ni bɔsɔna.
Ba daŋ dɔɔ bɔsɔna la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
Ba daŋ dɔɔ bampirsɔna,
ka biinichɔg ni himaawaa
chɔ lii ba be,
saŋaa saŋa maa.
12Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Minuu ra tig ii bampiree.
Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ii kaa ra
ɔm neweai,
ba biibaala n ɛɛwɛ
lugɔ kooreei?
13Ii suuh Kɔraawiizi la n ta ia la wiarɛ.
Waabuu yaa chiŋ
di chiŋŋi hɛri zɛɛ.
Ɛrɛɛ ii gil ii bɔra ra sa hɔpizi biimaa,
ɔnsii lau ia dikuu
nɛra la n na sunni ia
baaŋfuuih,
banla n na nyiŋŋi
ii chɔgaa wiai?
Lee a nesunne baaŋfuuihchɔgii la duɛi?
14A ka tama banla
n na di dɔgnya
nɛra tɔi diini biine,
na bahinaa.
Ba wàá siuzi a diini biine,
gɛɛ di nyaa diwee.
15Minuu Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum,
unla n ɔɔ ra koozi muuzeŋ,
u nii ra lɔ di ra kɔɔ
werge maa la.
N sɔnnɛ Kɔraawiizi
Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ.
16Minuu kpa n wiŋɔzi du ii nuuzi,
di kpa nonii tɔ ii ni.
Minuu ta chiŋ, di chiŋŋi hɛri zɛɛ,
di ŋɔ Bolzeŋ Ziɔn hina be,
‘Iabuu n nɛra.’ ”
Jɛrusalɛm hina dɔgnya dii tunaa wia
17Jɛrusalɛm, izi dɔɔ!
Izi chi chiŋ!
I nyɔɔ Kɔraawiizi baaŋfuuih libee biini kunaa
alugɔ siŋ di ra jiŋli.
A tɔɔrɔɔ ni dɔgnya libee la maanii
i nyɔɔ, kpɛlɛŋŋ.
18Biibaala la maa hiŋ lullɛ, di dɛɛzi baa la,
bɛl maa waa kaa ka
ú lau i nonii
di baglii ŋmɛnɛɛ.
19Tɔɔrɔɔ werge bunɛɛrɛ huuzii,
anɛɛ n niŋ wer tig
i bampiriiyei?
A tɔɔrɔɔzii, chɔgaa, lɔchɔgii ani laal.
Anɛɛ n niŋ wer
tig i bampiriiyei?
20I biibaala maanii huahgɛɛ chɔɔgi a bol ŋmɛnikɛraa
lugɔ sidɛɛ n lau wiluu.
Kɔraawiizi baannɛ fuuh ba ni,
u hau ba ni gunla.
21Awia, hinla n na di dɔgnya, a nuu,
i dɛɛzɔɔrɛ,
ka haa siŋ nyɔɔwɛ!
22Kenne Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa,
di ɛɛ u nɛra Guuri,
i ra humuu la ŋɔ,
“Na, n na lɛɛ dɔgnya libee la n gillɛ i ra jiŋli labuu,
di ra lii i nonee biini.
I ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka nyɔɔ
lii n baaŋfuuih
libee hiŋ biini.
23N daŋ jaa kpau tɛɛ banla n faa ra sunnii,
di ɔɔ ŋɔ i be,
‘Chɔɔ hɛri ya ra vol i ni.’
I chɔɔ pi ba ra vol i ni
alugɔ ŋmɛnɛɛ la.”

english_text:
Jerusalem Can Celebrate
1 Jerusalem, wake up!
Stand up and be strong.
Holy city of Zion,
dress in your best clothes.
Those foreigners who ruined
your sacred city
won't bother you again.
2Zion, rise from the dirt!
Free yourself from the rope
around your neck.
Suffering Will End
3The Lord says:
My people, you were sold,
but not for money;
now you will be set free,
but not for a payment.
4Long ago you went to Egypt
where you lived
as foreigners.
Then Assyria was cruel to you,
5 and now another nation
has taken you prisoner
for no reason at all.
Your leaders groan with pain,
and day after day
my own name is cursed.
6My people, you will learn
who I am and who is speaking
because I am here.
A Message of Hope for Jerusalem
7 What a beautiful sight!
On the mountains a messenger
announces to Jerusalem,
“Good news! You're saved.
There will be peace.
Your God is now King.”
8Everyone on guard duty,
sing and celebrate!
Look! You can see the Lord
returning to Zion.
9Jerusalem, rise from the ruins!
Join in the singing.
The Lord has given comfort
to his people;
he comes to your rescue.
10The Lord has shown all nations
his mighty strength;
now everyone will see
the saving power of our God.
A Command To Leave Babylon
11 Leave the city of Babylon!
Don't touch anything filthy.
Wash yourselves. Be ready
to carry back everything sacred
that belongs to the Lord.
12You won't need to run.
No one is chasing you.
The Lord God of Israel
will lead and protect you
from enemy attacks.
The Suffering Servant
13The Lord says:
My servant will succeed!
He will be given great praise
and the highest honors.
14Many were horrified
at what happened to him.
But everyone who saw him
was even more horrified
because he suffered until
he no longer looked human.
15 My servant will make
nations worthy to worship me;
kings will be silent
as they bow in wonder.
They will see and think about
things they have never seen
or thought about before.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi daŋ lɛɛ Jɛrusalɛm
1Bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm, izi chiŋ!
Izi bagli i fɔŋŋa!
Bolzennaniinanii Jɛrusalɛm,
kpa i laala la n wesse di bɔg.
Nɛra la n waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ di doŋ,
wàá ka zuu i biini maa.
2Jɛrusalɛm, izi di zigli i nyɔɔ la ta,
ka ga so i koorikara ni.
Jɛrusalɛm, baŋ tɔi dia,
chaahzi yɔlɔzi la
n vɔɔzi i baŋaa la.
3Kenne Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔ,
“Ba faa yooibuu ka ba waa kummaa lɛɛwɛ,
ba wàá turgi kummaa
ka bir lɛɛi.”
4Dikuubɛɛwiai, kenne Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔ,
“N nɛra faa ga sogo Ijip hɛrii.
Denii Asiiria hina
faa wa sunni baa.
5Bɛɛ n dɔɔ bɔnnaa filaŋkennei?
Dikuu baŋ lauri n nɛra pɛɛpɛɛ di kaali wia,
banla n na di kora
ba ni ɔɔ ra ɛɛ baabuu chɛɛtɛ,
di ɔɔ ra gbɛlli n sɔŋ
hɔpizi biimaa.
6Dikuu guŋ wia, n daŋ gil n nɛra zum n sɔŋ.
A saŋa n niŋ wa hel,
ba daŋ jaa zum lugɔ
minuu Kɔraawiizi.
Minuu ŋɔ guŋ.”
7Na gunla nɛra la n ɔɔ ra vol bizenaa nyuuni,
di ra lizi amaniyesuma
la naazi n wesse,
banla n na sii bampirsɔna wia,
banla n na ŋɔ winanaa,
banla n na sii nɛlɛɛi wia,
banla n ŋɔ Bolzeŋ Ziɔn be,
“Kɔraawiizi la hinna hum la
di koraa.”
8Ií ra nuu! Nɛra la n na du i tau la ra chaasuu,
di ra yir yira ni bɔsɔna.
Di Kɔraawiizi wa bittɔ ba Bolzeŋ Ziɔn,
ba himmaa daŋ nau.
9Jɛrusalɛm diŋgelli,
ií maa ra yir yira ni bɔsɔna!
Kɔraawiizi tig u nɛra bampireere,
u mɔgli Jɛrusalɛmnɛ.
10Kɔraawiizi daŋ bagli u fɔŋŋananiinanii la,
hɛssi hina maa na,
hɛri tuna hina maa na
Kɔraawiizi la yaa
n na hum la nɛlɛɛi.
11Awia, ií lii de, ií lii de!
Ií gilɛɛ waa gbɔgzi
kundoŋ maa.
Ii banla n chigɛ Kɔraawiizi Dia hɛnni la,
ií lii de, di ɛɛ nɛnanaa.
12Ka ií gilɛɛ waa yali siwee di ra lii de,
gɛɛ di waa chɔ
dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi
daŋ tɔ ii see.
Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la,
daŋ tɔ ii har.
Balii la n na di dɔgnya wia
13Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Na, n balii danna ɛɛ nunzuma wia,
ba daŋ lalluu chiŋ,
di ra tɔgzuu werge.
14A faa tir nɛkpila maanii, baŋ wa nau,
gunla u duula
n faa bittɛ chum,
waa kaa li newee gba.
15Gunnɛ ú wia tir hɛrkpila maa hina,
koorizenaa nuuzi kpu.
Anla baŋ faa waa ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ baa la,
ba daŋ naa,
anla ge baŋ faa waa nuuwɛ,
ba daŋ zum a zɛɛ.”

english_text:
What God's Servant Did for Us
1 Has anyone believed us
or seen the mighty power
of the Lord in action?
2Like a young plant or a root
that sprouts in dry ground,
the servant grew up
obeying the Lord.
He wasn't some handsome king.
Nothing about the way he looked
made him attractive to us.
3He was hated and rejected;
his life was filled with sorrow
and terrible suffering.
No one wanted to look at him.
We despised him and said,
“He is a nobody!”
4He suffered and endured
great pain for us,
but we thought his suffering
was punishment from God.
5 He was wounded and crushed
because of our sins;
by taking our punishment,
he made us completely well.
6 All of us were like sheep
that had wandered off.
We had each gone our own way,
but the Lord gave him
the punishment we deserved.
7 He was painfully abused,
but he did not complain.
He was silent like a lamb
being led to the butcher,
as quiet as a sheep
having its wool cut off.
8He was condemned to death
without a fair trial.
Who could have imagined
what would happen to him?
His life was taken away
because of the sinful things
my people had done.
9 He wasn't dishonest or violent,
but he was buried in a tomb
among cruel, rich people.
10The Lord decided his servant
would suffer as a sacrifice
to take away the sin
and guilt of others.
Now the servant will live
to see his own descendants.
He did everything
the Lord had planned.
11By suffering, the servant
will learn the true meaning
of obeying the Lord.
Although he is innocent,
he will take the punishment
for the sins of others,
so that many of them
will no longer be guilty.
12 The Lord will reward him
with honor and power
for sacrificing his life.
Others thought he was a sinner,
but he suffered for our sins
and asked God to forgive us.
translation_text:
1Denii nɛra la ŋɔ,
“Anɛɛ n yardi yaa amaniye,
anɛɛ n na
Kɔraawiizi banonii lai?
2Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ u balii hel u be
alugɔ daapɔl n futtɛ
lugɔ lunni n lii hɛrhilii.
U faa waa bunɔɔŋ ɛɛwɛ,
waa kaa dɔɔ girme ge
ya ra kɛlli u ni,
gɛɛ u duula ge gil
ú wia ra par yaa.
3Nɛra binnuubuu pɛɛ, di vɛɛu ta.
U ra di dɔgnya
di zum bɔwiila wia.
Nɛra ɔɔ nau di bir ba siwee ta bɔduma.
Gunnɛ yaa ge gba
binnuu pɛɛ,
yaa wɔɔ ra tɔgzi.
4Wibii maa, u lizi yaa gɛrga
ni yaa biinichɔgrɛ yaa ni.
Ka yaa fɛwɔɔrɛ lugɔ Kɔraawiizii ra tɔɔruu,
di gil u di a dɔgnya.
5Ka yaa waa zummɛ lugɔ yaa dignikpega wiarɛ ba duu pira,
di lɔɔzuu dikuu yaa
wichɔgaa wia.
Waabuu na dignitɛraa la n gillɛ yaa dɔɔ alaanfia,
pira la baŋ duu wiarɛ
yaa nyaagi.
6Yaa maa leuzoore alugɔ peeza,
bɛl maa kpa
u kipar ŋmɛnɛɛ.
Waabuu Kɔraawiizi gil u turgi
yaa bɛl maa wichɔgaa kim.
7Ba tɔɔruubuu di sunnuu werge maa,
ka waa u nua haawɛ.
U siigɔɔrɛ lugɔ peezi baŋ tɛrgɛɛ ra la bá ga kpu
gɛɛ peezi n chigɛ banla
n na fuŋ u huna see.
8Ba tɔɔruubuu di diu seriya, ka kpuu.
Anɛɛ n niŋ kaa wer ŋɔ
u naanna wiai?
Ba lizuubuu nɛnyinee biini.
N nɛra wichɔgaa wiarɛ
ba kpuu.
