9U ni wichɔgɛɛra ni dɔɔna maanii ba kpau hug,
haali uŋ waa
wichɔgii maa ɛɛwɛ,
u wiŋɔzi waa
daraa maa dɔɔwɛ gba.”
10Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Ama, a faa parimbuu lugɔ ú di tɔɔrɔɔ di siu.
N kpaubuu lizi
bilchɔg mbusu.
Uŋ wette ɛɛ gunla, u daŋ dɔɔ dee,
ú miibɔɔ du jaŋ.
N daŋ ga u be di na n kipar.
11Di u wa di a dɔgnya naa maa wa tuŋ,
u daŋ bir na miibɔɔ,
di zum lugɔ wia la
uŋ ɛɛwɛ la dɔɔ tɔnaa.
N balii hiŋ wia n deŋlee la,
u daŋ gil nɛkpila maa
ge wia deŋli n be,
dikuu uŋ siuwɛ turgi
ba wichɔgaa kim wia.
12Awia, n daŋ tɛu sɔŋ nɛzenaa biini,
u daŋ dɔɔ girme dikuu
uŋ kpa u hiŋ tɛɛ siu, di sɛɛ ba kpuu,
dikuu uŋ du wichɔgɛɛra
biini la wia.
U turgi nɛkpila wichɔgaa kinnɛ
di suŋŋi Kɔraawiizi,
ú gil ba wichɔgaa tɛɛ baa.”

english_text:
A Promise of the Lord's Protection
1 Sing and shout,
even though you have never
had children!
The Lord has promised that you
will have more children
than someone married
for a long time.
2Make your tents larger!
Spread out the tent pegs;
fasten them firmly.
3You and your descendants
will take over the land
of other nations.
You will settle in towns
that are now in ruins.
4Don't be afraid or ashamed
and don't be discouraged.
You won't be disappointed.
Forget how sinful you were
when you were young;
stop feeling ashamed
for being left a widow.
5The Lord All-Powerful,
the Holy God of Israel,
rules all the earth.
He is your Creator and husband,
and he will rescue you.
6You were like a young wife,
brokenhearted and crying
because her husband
had divorced her.
But the Lord your God says,
“I am taking you back!
7I rejected you for a while,
but with love and tenderness
I will embrace you again.
8For a while, I turned away
in furious anger.
Now I will have mercy
and love you forever!
I, your protector and Lord,
make this promise.”
The Lord Promises Lasting Peace
9 I once promised Noah that I
would never again destroy
the earth by a flood.
Now I have promised that I
will never again get angry
and punish you.
10 Every mountain and hill
may disappear.
But I will always be kind
and merciful to you;
I won't break my agreement
to give your nation peace.
The New Jerusalem
11 Jerusalem, you are sad
and discouraged,
tossed around in a storm.
But I, the Lord,
will rebuild your city
with precious stones;
for your foundation
I will use blue sapphires.
12Your fortresses
will be built of rubies,
your gates of jewels,
and your walls of gems.
13 I will teach your children
and make them successful.
14You will be built on fairness
with no fears of injustice;
every one of your worries
will be taken far from you.
15I will never send anyone
to attack your city,
and you will make prisoners
of those who do attack.
16Don't forget that I created
metalworkers who make weapons
over burning coals.
I also created armies
that can bring destruction.
17Weapons made to attack you
won't be successful;
words spoken against you
won't hurt at all.
My servants, Jerusalem is yours!
I, the Lord, promise
to bless you with victory.
translation_text:
Ziɔn kɛrɛbɛl girme wia
1Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Hahbara, a yir yira ni bɔsɔna!
A yir werge ni bɔsɔna,
hinla hilula ŋmɛnɛ maa
n haa wɛɛ lɔwɛɛ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, haaŋ la u jaari
n faa vɛɛwɛ la,
daŋ haa lul biizi
kaali unla n haa du
u jaari dia.
2Awia, yaa i tanti dia u du kaŋ jaa,
tɛruu ú du war.
Gil u ŋmɛnni du jaŋ jaa,
di kpaahzi u daasiraa
a zuu hɛri nɛnnɛ.
3I daŋ yaa di la i nodig ni i nomɛɛl keŋkerezi maa.
I naanna daŋ bir lɛɛ hɛssi la
i dɔma n faa foozee la,
di bir ga so bolzenaa la maa
n chɔɔ diŋgelli la.
4Gilɛɛ ra ɔm. Hàá ka di hiihzi ŋmɛnɛ maa.
Gilɛɛ ra ɔm,
nɛr maa ŋmɛnɛ maa
wàá ka ŋmaabii.
I daŋ suuh i bichalli saŋa hiihzi la.
I ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka
liizi girme la
hiŋ faa nyaawɛ,
i luhanni saŋa la.
5I Taari ɛɛ i jaarii.
Waabuu Kɔraawiizi
Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la.
Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii labuu ɛɛ i Lɛɛri.
Waabuu ba ra hum
durnya maa biini la.
6Kɔraawiizi daŋ bir yirii, í ba u be,
gunla baal n ɔɔ vɛɛ
u bichalhaaŋ,
u biini chɔgi werge,
u bir yiruu la.”
Gunnɛ Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la ŋɔ.
7“N faa vɛɛibuu tama,
ka miŋ na i sinyɛna
werge wia, n daŋ bir kpai.
8Baaŋfuuih faa gillɔɔ
n lizi n siwee i ni tama guŋ,
ka n nɔŋŋaa n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ wia,
n daŋ bir na i sinyɛnaa.
Mìŋ́ i Lɛɛri Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.
9Gunla miŋ faa ŋɔ nua, Noowa saŋa la
lugɔ nii ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá
ka chɔgi durnya la,
guŋ dɔnnɛ niŋ kaa ɛɛ.
N kaa hɛɛhzuu di ra ŋɔ lugɔ n baaŋ ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka fuuh i ni,
ń kaa tɛr i digni.
10Haali bizenaa n niŋ zigli,
giŋgimee ge izi,
ka n nɔŋŋaa lawaa ŋmɛnɛ maa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ i be,
n nii bampirsɔna nuukpaŋ la
ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá tuŋ.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la n suŋ
i ni labuu ŋɔ guŋ.
11Jɛrusalɛm, tɔɔrɔɔ n wɛɛ ra gil, pechɔgaa ge ra ta i ni,
nɛr maa waa i bampirii
ra tig la,
na, n daŋ kpa binanaa la yoola n kpolle chiŋŋi i zɛɛ,
di bir mai.
12N daŋ kpa rubizi ma i diini la n jaŋŋɛ di la chiŋ,
di kpa binyɛgzaa
kuari i dominuuzenaa,
di kpa binanaa la yoola
n kpolle ma i koŋlaa.
13Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii niŋ bagli i biibaala wia,
bá dɔɔ bampirsɔna werge maa.
14Wideŋlaa daŋ gil i wer chi nɛnnɛ,
i dɔma wàá ka ra firii,
ɔnsii werge maa
wàá ka duglii,
i ra ɔm wiimaa.
15Di nɛr maa daŋ kaa wa fɔɔi ni laal,
amɔ, miŋ lɛi gillɛ guŋ ɛɛ.
Nɛr la maa ge n niŋ wa fɔɔi ni laal,
i daŋ kpegluu.
16Minuu ta luuri n ɔɔ viu niŋ u mazi,
u luu dɔŋkuŋ n dɛg
u huma humaa,
di kaa ta laallɔɔri u kpa a dɔŋkuŋ di ra kpu.
17Dɔŋkuŋ maa waa hoo,
bá wer kpau kpeglii.
Di ba kpa doŋa chugii,
i daŋ ɔɔ wer di baa wibii,
bá chol.
Kɔraawiizi balaa tɔnaa guŋ,
ba bilii dɔɔi lii n benii.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

english_text:
The Lord's Invitation
1 If you are thirsty,
come and drink water!
If you don't have any money,
come, eat what you want!
Drink wine and milk
without paying a cent.
2 Why waste your money
on what really isn't food?
Why work hard for something
that doesn't satisfy?
Listen carefully to me,
and you will enjoy
the very best foods.
3 Pay close attention!
Come to me and live.
I will promise you
the eternal love and loyalty
that I promised David.
4I made him the leader and ruler
of the nations;
he was my witness to them.
5You will call out to nations
you have never known.
And they have never known you,
but they will come running
because I am the Lord,
the holy God of Israel,
and I have honored you.
God's Words Are Powerful
6Turn to the Lord!
He can still be found.
Call out to God! He is near.
7Give up your evil ways
and your evil thoughts.
Return to the Lord our God.
He will be merciful
and forgive your sins.
8The Lord says:
“My thoughts and my ways
are not like yours.
9Just as the heavens
are higher than the earth,
my thoughts and my ways
are higher than yours.
10 “Rain and snow fall from the sky.
But they don't return
without watering the earth
that produces seeds to plant
and grain to eat.
11That's how it is with my words.
They don't return to me
without doing everything
I send them to do.”
God's People Will Celebrate
12When you are set free,
you will celebrate
and travel home in peace.
Mountains and hills will sing
as you pass by,
and trees will clap.
13Cypress and myrtle trees
will grow in fields
once covered by thorns.
And then those trees will stand
as a lasting witness
to the glory of the Lord.
translation_text:
Nɛra la niinyɔgzi n na kpu yiraa wia
1Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Ii banla maa niinyɔgzi n na kpu,
ií ba wa nyɔɔ nii.
Haali di ii waa kebee dɔɔwɛ gba,
ka ií ba di wa yau diwee di.
Ií ba di wa yau siŋ ni nail pɛɛpɛɛ,
a waa kim dɔɔwɛ.
2Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ii ra di kebee kuna la n wàá wer piŋ ia ninɛi?
Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ii ra kuuh kuna la
n wàá wer hiini ia ninɛi?
Ií ra nuu n be nɛnnɛ, di wer na diunanaa ra di,
ii bɔra sɔɔni ia.
3Ií keŋŋi digna di nuu n be nɛnnɛ.
Ií ba n be di wa na miibɔɔ.
N daŋ gil n ni ia dɔɔ nuukpaŋ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ,
di hiŋ nua la miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ
Koori Deevid lugɔ
n daŋ ɔɔ nɔŋŋuu ni wibii la.
4Na, n gillɔɔ u ɛɛ n daansɛɛ hiŋ tɛɛ hɛssi hina,
di kaa ɛɛ ba sitɔɔri
ni ba nabɔma.
5Wibii, i daŋ yir hɛssi hina bá chaali i be
di lii hɛssi la hiŋ waa zummɛ.
Hɛssi hina la ge n wɛɛ zummɛ daŋ hahzi ba,
di wa nuu wia lii i be.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la hinna hum la, n ɛɛ Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii wiarɛ bá ba i be,
dikuu miŋ gillɛ
i dɔɔ girme wia.”
6Aah siwii di ra nyiŋŋi Kɔraawiizi bɔr
saŋa naa hin niŋ
haa wer nau naa!
A yiruu di u haa duglɔɔ.
7Gil biinikpola hiŋ gil u ŋmɛnɛɛ la,
nɛchuma ge gil
u nfɛrchɔgaa la.
Gil u bir ba Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la be, ú suŋ u ni.
U gil nɛra wichɔgaarɛ
di ra tɛɛ baa.
8Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Gunla iinna fɛ, guŋ lɛi n na fɛ,
ii ŋmɛnizi ge waa
n ŋmɛnizi ɛɛwɛ.
9Gunla chiŋ n la chiŋ kaali hɛri la,
gunnɛ n ŋmɛnizi
kaali ii hora,
n nfɛrɛ ge kaali ii hora.
10Gunla dooŋ ni sɔsɔŋ
n ɔɔ lii chiŋ chol hɛri,
a waa ɔɔ kaa bir la de,
ka gil hɛri pɛssi
di lii kundee,
a hel di du bee tɛɛ a duuri,
di kaa lii diwee tɛɛ a diiri la,
11gunnɛ wiŋɔɔlii la maa n niŋ lii n nua,
wàá ka bir ba n be pɛɛ,
di waa n kipar ni wia la miŋ ŋɔ
ú ga ɛɛ la ɛɛwɛ.
12Nɛra daŋ tɔ ii see ii ra lii ni bɔsɔna,
bampirsɔna ge du ii be.
Bizenaa ni giŋgimee daŋ lau a hina huhzi,
ka ra yir bɔsɔna yira,
daazi maa ge
ra lɔ kpaa ii see.
13Daananaa daŋ lɛɛ sɔɔhri bɔr lii,
mɛrtil daazi lɛɛ
choŋgolli bɔr lii.
Guŋ daŋ ɛɛ girme werge tɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi,
di kaa ɛɛ daansɛɛ la n niŋ du de
saŋaa saŋa maa,
waa chɔgaa dɔɔwɛ.”

english_text:
All Nations Will Be Part of God's People
1The Lord said:
Be honest and fair!
Soon I will come to save you;
my saving power will be seen
everywhere on earth.
2I will bless everyone
who respects the Sabbath
and refuses to do wrong.
3Foreigners who worship me
must not say,
“The Lord won't let us
be part of his people.”
Men who are unable
to become fathers
must no longer say,
“We are dried-up trees.”
4 To them, I, the Lord, say:
Respect the Sabbath,
obey me completely,
and keep our agreement.
5Then you will be like monuments
in my temple with your names
written on them.
This will be much better
than having children,
because these monuments
will stand there forever.
6Foreigners will follow me.
They will love me and worship
in my name;
they will respect the Sabbath
and keep our agreement.
7 I will bring them
to my holy mountain,
where they will celebrate
in my house of worship.
Their sacrifices and offerings
will always be welcome
on my altar.
Then my house will be known
as a house of worship
for all nations.
8I, the Lord, promise
to bring together my people
who were taken away,
and let them join the others.
God Promises To Punish Israel's Leaders
9Come from the forest,
you wild animals!
Attack and gobble up
your victims.
10You leaders of Israel
should be watchdogs,
protecting my people.
But you can't see a thing,
and you never warn them.
Dozing and daydreaming
are all you ever do.
11You stupid leaders are a pack
of hungry and greedy dogs
that never get enough.
You are shepherds
who mistreat your own sheep
for selfish gain.
12You say to each other,
“Let's drink till we're drunk!
Tomorrow we'll do it again.
We'll really enjoy ourselves.”
translation_text:
Hɛssi hina maa lɛɛi wia
1Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ u nɛra benii,
“Ií ra hiŋ wideŋlaa ni wibii ŋmɛnizi.
N daŋ ba manaŋ
di wa lɛɛ ia,
nɛ́ra maa na gunla
n nɛlɛɛi n duwɛɛ.
2Nɛr la maa n na ɛɛ wia naa,
di lawaa kpogli nɛnnɛ,
di ra tɔgzi Heezaa Hɔpizii la, waa u kiizi ra chɔgi,
di ra vɛɛ wichɔgaa
maa ɛɛi, nuu sumaa.”
3Nɛr la maa n ɛɛ hɔɔhri Izrɛl hina biini, ka wa jaa ba ni di ra jaami Kɔraawiizi,
ú gilɛɛ waa ŋɔ,
“Kɔraawiizi daŋ bargiŋ
lii u nɛra biini, wibii maa.”
Gɛɛ baal la maa baŋ varɛɛ waa ŋɔ,
“Na, miŋwaa ɛɛ daakɔɔllɛ.”
4Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Banla maa baŋ varɛɛ ka ba ra tɔgzi n Heezaa Hɔpizii la,
di kaa ra ɛɛ n kipar wia,
di ra sɛɛ n ni nɛra
nuukpaŋ dɔɔi la nɛnnɛ,
5n daŋ tɛɛ baa bɔr n Dia la banna jaamiŋ biini,
á ɛɛ liize ni sɔŋ
di kaali ban niŋ faa lul
biibaala ni biihaana.
N daŋ tɛɛ baa sɔŋ la n niŋ du de di hanna la,
u ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá dinzi.
6Hɔɔhra la n kpa bahinaa tɛŋ,
di ra hum n bɛŋ,
di nɔŋŋiŋ, di ra jaamiŋ,
di ra tɔgzi n Heezaa Hɔpizii la, ba waa n kiizi ra chɔgi,
ka sɛɛ n ni n nɛra
nuukpaŋ dɔɔi
la wia nɛnnɛ,
7n daŋ kpogli baa ba n Bizennaniinanii Ziɔn nyuu,
di wa gil ba dɔɔ bɔsɔna
n Dia la biini.
N daŋ lɛɛ ba mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa
ni ba mbusuzi lizaa kuna
n mbusu lizibɔr la ni.
Ba daŋ yir n Dia wiijaami Dia,
hɛssi hina maa
wer zuu de di ra jaamiŋ.”
8Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la,
unla n chaali Izrɛl hina la
baŋ laurɛɛ kaali
hɛrdumazi la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“N daŋ haa chaali baŋhina
di wa jaa banla
miŋ teŋ chaalɛɛ la ni.”
Kɔraawiizi n kpa wia sag biinikpola hina ni wia
9Pir sela, ií maa ba!
Kɔr biini sela,
ií maa ba wa lauri baa di!
10Izrɛl tauduura la nyuŋŋɔɔrɛ,
ba waa wiimaa zummɛ.
Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nuuzihina n waa wozi,
ka ɔɔ chɔɔ di ra deezi,
di nɔŋŋi dɔɔ chɔɔi
werge maa.
11Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nuuzihina n na di werge,
a waa piŋ.
Ba kaa ɛɛu lugɔ penɔɔna n waa wia zɛɛ ra nuu.
Bɛl maanii ɔɔ ra ga
u bɛŋ ŋmɛnɛɛ,
di ra nyiŋŋi u bɛŋ tɔna.
12Ba ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ií ba ya nyɔɔ siŋ!
Ya nyɔɔ siŋkpega werge
a kukki yaa.
Kɛrɛ gba daŋ dɔɔ sideŋŋa,
di kaali zinaa.”

english_text:
God's Faithful People Suffer
1God's faithful people
are dragged off and killed,
and no one even cares.
Evil sweeps them away,
2but in death they find peace
for obeying God.
The Lord Condemns Idolatry
3You people are unfaithful!
You go to fortunetellers,
and you worship idols.
Now pay close attention!
4Who are you making fun of?
Who are you sneering at?
Look how your sins
have made fools of you.
5All you think about is sex
under those green trees
where idols are worshiped.
You sacrifice your children
on altars built in valleys
under rocky slopes.
6You have chosen to worship
idols made of stone;
you have given them offerings
of wine and grain.
Should I be pleased?
7You have spread out your beds
on the tops of high mountains,
where you sacrifice to idols.
8Even in your homes
you have placed pagan symbols
all around your huge beds.
Yes, you have rejected me,
sold yourselves to your lovers,
and gone to bed with them.
9You smear on olive oil
and all kinds of perfume
to worship the god Molech.
You even seek advice
from spirits of the dead.
10Though you tired yourself out
by running after idols,
you refused to stop.
Your desires were so strong
that they kept you going.
11Did you forget about me
and become unfaithful
because you were more afraid
of someone else?
Have I been silent so long
that you no longer fear me?
12You think you're so good,
but I'll point out the truth.
13Ask your idols to save you
when you are in trouble.
Be careful though—
it takes only a faint breath
to blow them over.
But if you come to me
for protection,
this land and my holy mountain
will always belong to you.
The Lord Helps the Helpless
14The Lord says,
“Clear the road!
Get it ready for my people.”
15 Our holy God lives forever
in the highest heavens,
and this is what he says:
Though I live high above
in the holy place,
I am here to help those
who are humble
and depend only on me.
16My people, I won't stay angry
and keep on accusing you.
After all, I am your Creator.
I don't want you to give up
in complete despair.
17Your greed made me furious.
That's why I punished you
and refused to be found,
while you kept returning
to your old sinful ways.
18I know what you are like!
But I will heal you, lead you,
and give you comfort,
until those who are mourning
19 start singing my praises.
No matter where you are,
I, the Lord, will heal you
and give you peace.
20The wicked are a restless sea
tossing up mud.
21 But I, the Lord, have promised
that none who are evil
will live in peace.
translation_text:
1Nɛr la wia n deŋlee ɔɔ siwuu,
ka nɛr maa baga wàá du de.
Banla n na hiŋ Kɔraawiizi ŋmɛnɛɛ ɔɔ siwuu,
ka nɛr maa wàá zum a zɛɛ,
lugɔ Kɔraawiizii lizuu lii hɛhchɔg biini,
ú na bɔsɔna.
2Banla n na hiŋ Kɔraawiizi nɛnnɛ ka siuzi
daŋ dɔɔ bampirsɔna di heezi.
3Ka iawaa, hila, sɛnsɛnna ani tuutuuzi biizi,
ií ba ɛŋ!
4Anɛɛ ii ra ɛɛ chɛɛtɛi,
di lɛgli nuuzuŋŋa
ra du u ninɛi?
Ii dee lɛi ɛɛ wichɔgɛɛraa?
Karkanna biizi lɛi iaa?
5Ii ɔɔ ra sɛmuu
vugkuaribɔr daalɔɔlii maa zɛɛ,
ka ɔɔ kpu ii biizi ra lizi mbusuzi
bia bɔɔni n dugli walli biine.
6A loglogbia la n du a gɔmbɔɔluŋe labuu ii kpa birgi vuga.
Aabuu ii ra tɔgzi,
di yiili sinni ra taa,
di lizi mbusuzi lizaa mia ra tɛɛa.
Iinna ɛɛ annii naa maa,
a parimbuu waa?
7Bizenaa nyuunii ii chɔɔribɔra, ii ra sɛm,
di ɔɔ tinni de di gaa
lizi ii mbusuzi.
8Ii chiŋŋi vugaa ii dominuuzi biine,
di sagzi aŋhina
ii dominuuzi daazi ni.
Ii vɛɛmbuu, ka nɔŋŋi vuga lugɔ ii sɛnna,
di lawaa ra sɛm.
Ii ɔɔ dilgi chɔɔ ii kunchɔɔrikuna ni,
di ra binni dɔŋa.
9Ii kpa ɔlivi nuu ni tulaalezii
di la ga tɛɛ vug Mɔlɛk la
ka jaamuu,
di faa hum ii nabɔnzi ba la bɔɔnɛɛzi werge maa,
haali di ga tuu lalaa bol gba
bá nyiŋŋi vugfalaa tɛɛ ia.
10Ii faa kuuhwɔɔ werge di vol ra nyiŋŋi vuga,
ka ii bɔra faa waa huahwɛ.
Ii fɛ lugɔ ii vugkuna la miŋ kiiwe la daŋ tɛɛ ia fɔŋŋa,
awia, ii waa kuuh maa.
11Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Anɛɛ ii faa ra ɔm werge
di kaaliŋ,
ii waa kaa ra liizi n wiai?
N faa siigi ii ninɛɛ birgi,
a wia lɛi ii faa waa
kaa ra ɔmiŋ?
12Filaŋkeŋwaa, n daŋ pilli ii wiɛɛlaa la iiŋ ŋɔ a deŋloore la
ii na lugɔ a bɛl maa
wàá wer hiini ia.
13Di ii kaa waa wii di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa,
ií gil ii vuga la n bar ia la
hiini ia.
Peu daŋ wa kpa a maa kaali.
Heeza bɛŋ gba daŋ wer
kpaa kaali.
Ama, nɛr la maa n yardiŋ daŋ so a hɛri,
n bizennaniinanii la
daŋ ɛɛ u hor.”
Sisɔna hina bampirii tigaa wia
14Denii Kɔraawiizi jaa ŋɔ,
“Ií kuari bɔr, ii pilli ŋmɛnɛɛ tɛɛ n nɛra!
Ií ligzi kuna la maa
n tɔ baa ŋmɛnɛɛ.
15Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii dɔɔ sɔnzeŋ kaali kummaa,
di du de saŋaa saŋa maa,
di kaa dɔɔ sɔnnaniinanii.
N du chiŋ bɔnaniinaniirɛ,
di kaa du banla maa biine
n chɔkkɛ dikuu
ba wichɔgaa wia,
ba sɔɔni siwee be,
di ɔɔ ra du baa bɔkpega.
16Maa nyiŋŋi lugɔ saŋa maa n ɔɔ ra pag nɛra ni,
gɛɛ n baaŋ ɔɔ ra fuuh
ba ni saŋa maa.
Di guŋ lɛi, ba daŋ chɔgi baa ba chɔɔ n be vɛlɛɛ.
Minuu ta baa.
17N baaŋ faa fuuhwoo dikuu ba kɛkɛluu ni ba wichɔgaa wia,
n tɛr ba digna di bir n har
kpu baa dikuu
a baaŋfuuih wia,
ka ba faa vɛɛ ka haa ra hiŋ
ba himmaa ŋmɛnizi.
18N faa na gunla ba manni n duwɛɛnɛ,
ka n daŋ chaa baa
di tɔ ba see,
di tig banla maa biine
n chɔkkɛ, ba ra wii
la bampiree.
19Ba daŋ jaa ra chɔli mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi.
Bɔsɔna du banla n duglɛɛ
ni banla n du bɔɔnɛɛ maa be.
N daŋ chaa baa.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.
20Ama, biinikpola hina lawaa waa heezaa dɔɔwɛ.
Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ muuzeŋ nii
n wàá wer chɔɔ bɔɔiih la.
A nii ɔɔ ra lɔu di paa
kpɛchɛgaa ni doŋa di ra ta.
21Biinikpola hina wàá dɔɔ bɔsɔna maa. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

english_text:
True Religion
1Shout the message!
Don't hold back.
Say to my people Israel:
You've sinned! You've turned
against the Lord.
2Day after day, you worship him
and seem eager to learn
his teachings.
You act like a nation
that wants to do right
by obeying his laws.
You ask him about justice,
and say you enjoy
worshiping the Lord.
3You wonder why the Lord
pays no attention
when you go without eating
and act humble.
But on those same days
that you give up eating,
you think only of yourselves
and abuse your workers.
4You even get angry
and ready to fight.
No wonder God won't listen
to your prayers!
5Do you think the Lord
wants you to give up eating
and to act as humble
as a bent-over bush?
Or to dress in sackcloth
and sit in ashes?
Is this really what he wants
on a day of worship?
6I'll tell you
what it really means
to worship the Lord.
Remove the chains of prisoners
who are bound unjustly.
Free those who are abused!
7 Share your food with everyone
who is hungry;
share your home
with the poor and homeless.
Give clothes to those in need;
don't turn away your relatives.
8Then your light will shine
like the dawning sun, and you
will quickly be healed.
Your honesty will protect you
as you advance,
and the glory of the Lord
will defend you from behind.
9When you beg the Lord for help,
he will answer, “Here I am!”
Don't mistreat others
or falsely accuse them
or say something cruel.
10Give your food to the hungry
and care for the homeless.
Then your light will shine
in the dark;
your darkest hour will be
like the noonday sun.
11The Lord will always guide you
and provide good things to eat
when you are in the desert.
He will make you healthy.
You will be like a garden
that has plenty of water
or like a stream
that never runs dry.
12You will rebuild those houses
left in ruins for years;
you will be known
as a builder and repairer
of city walls and streets.
13But first, you must start
respecting the Sabbath
as a joyful day of worship.
You must stop doing and saying
whatever you please
on this special day.
14Then you will truly enjoy
knowing the Lord.
He will let you rule
from the highest mountains
and bless you with the land
of your ancestor Jacob.
The Lord has spoken!
translation_text:
Nuuvɔɔi himmaa wia
1Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Ií sii wia naa. Ií gilɛɛ siigi,
ka lalli ii loobee lugɔ
banna huuh bensunozi,
di ra ŋɔ n nɛra Izrɛl hina be ba kpoŋaa
ni wichɔgaa banna ɛɛ la wia.
2Ba ra nyiŋŋimbuu hɔpizi biimaa,
di aah siwii
bá zum n ŋmɛnizi,
di kaa ɛɛ bahinaa lugɔ nɛra n na ɛɛ wideŋlaa,
ba waa mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la
nuuzi ra vɛɛ, ka guŋ lɛi.
Ba ɔɔ ŋɔ n bagli baa wibii ŋmɛnizi,
di kaa aah siwii lugɔ
n dugli baa.
3Ba ɔɔ pɛɛzimbuu, ‘Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ yaa vɔɔ nuuzi
ka haa guŋ nawɛɛi?
Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ yaa sɔɔni siwii
ka i baga waa hoonei?’
Ií na, haali iiŋ ɔɔ vɔɔ nuuzi la gba, ka ii kipar wiarɛ ii ra ɛɛ,
di kaa ra fini ii huŋhunna.
4Ii ɔɔ vɔɔ nuuzii ka ra ɛɛ dɔŋa wichɔgaa,
di ra lɔ kalu di ra naa.
Kennaa iinna vɔɔ nuuzi filaŋkennaa,
ii ɛɛ tamiirɛ lugɔ
n daŋ nuu ii wiisuŋŋaa?
5Ii ɔɔ vɔɔ nuuzii di ra tɔɔri iihinaa,
di kutti willi ii nyuuni lugɔ
kooree n ɔɔ willi gunla,
di kpa ii gbɔglɔnzi di laali
di so hɔɔhri biini.
Kenne baa vɔɔ nuaa?
Guŋ daŋ par
mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizia?
6A nuuvɔɔi naa dɔŋ lɛi ɛɛ n kipar la.
N kipar nuuvɔɔirɛ lugɔ
ii lizi banla baŋ kpa kara
daansɛɛ di tɔ dia,
di ra lɛɛ banla banna sunni,
bá dɔɔ bahinaa,
di chɔgi kunla maa n gillɛ
nɛra ɛɛ yoma.
7Di tɛɛ lɔzima diwee bá di,
di lɛɛ banla n waa diini
dɔɔwɛ di ra dau ii diini.
Di ii na nɛbɛl n na vol chakpal, ii tɛu laala ú laali,
di gilɛɛ ra vɛɛ
ii lulla ge hiinaa.
8Denii n ba wa hiini ia, ii wia chaani
alugɔ bɔchaaŋ n ballɛ
chɔɔzimpikke ni,
denii ii na alaanfia manaŋ,
ii wideŋlaa jaa tɔ ii see,
n girme ge tɔ ii har
di ra guu ia.
9Denii ii jaa wii tɛŋ, ń chɔ ii wile.
Ii daŋ yiriŋ n sɛɛ, di ŋɔ,
‘Minuu keŋ.’
Di ii wa gil nɛra sunnaa,
nɛzɔɔzaa, kara kannaa
ani nuuseei,
10di ɔɔ kpu iihinaa di ra tɛɛ lɔzima diwee,
di kaa ra hiini banla
banna sunni ge,
guŋwaa, ii daŋ ɛɛ alugɔ niŋ n na chaani bɔbiri,
ii hamuŋa ge ɛɛ
lugɔ wibaŋkanchirii.
11Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi daŋ tɔ ii see, di ra bagli ia ŋmɛnɛɛ saŋa maa,
haali di ii du hɛrhilii gba,
ka n daŋ tɛɛ ia
kunla maa iiŋ nyaawɛ,
di tɛɛ ia fɔŋŋa.
Ii daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ kambol la baŋ ɔɔ
mizi nii u sɔɔni nɛnnɛ,
di kaa ɛɛ lugɔ bule la
n waa hiihzaa dɔɔwɛ.
12Ii diŋgelbinaa la maanii ii nɛra bir ma,
di ma hɔŋzi a diini
zɛɛbinaa la ni.
Ba jaa ra yir ia nɛra la n bittɛ ma ba koŋlaa.
Banla n bittɛ kuari
ŋmɛnizenaa ni diini.
13Di ii waa Heezaa Hɔpizii la kiizi ra chɔg,
di gil ii himmaa
kipar wiɛɛlaa
n hɔpizinaniinanii naa hɔl,
di u wia ra par ia,
u ɛɛ hɔpizinaniinanii la
iinna tɔgzi,
di ra vɛɛ ŋmɛnɛɛ volaa dikuu iinna tɔgzuu wia,
di kaa ra vɛɛ ii himmaa
ŋmɛnizi hiŋaa ni ii kipar,
ni wiŋɔpɛɛri,
14guŋwaa, ii daŋ dɔɔ bɔsɔna, wibii maa, di lii mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi be.
N daŋ jaa gil ii dɔɔ sɔŋ
hɛri la miŋ ŋɔ nua
lugɔ n daŋ
tɛɛ ii naabaal Jekɔb la.
N daŋ dɛɛzi ia nɛnnɛ de.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi labuu ŋɔ guŋ.”

english_text:
Social Injustice Is Condemned
1The Lord hasn't lost
his powerful strength;
he can still hear
and answer prayers.
2Your sins are the roadblock
between you and your God.
That's why he doesn't answer
your prayers
or let you see his face.
3Your talk is filled with lies
and plans for violence;
every finger on your hands
is covered with blood.
4You falsely accuse others
and tell lies in court;
sin and trouble are the names
of your children.
5You eat the deadly eggs
of poisonous snakes,
and more snakes crawl out
from the eggs left to hatch.
You weave spider webs,
6but you can't make clothes
with those webs
or hide behind them.
You're sinful and brutal.
7 You hurry off to do wrong
or murder innocent victims.
All you think about is sin;
you leave ruin and destruction
wherever you go.
8You don't know how
to live in peace
or to be fair with others.
The roads you make are crooked;
your followers cannot find peace.
The People Confess Their Sins
9No one has come to defend us
or to bring about justice.
We hoped for a day of sunshine,
but all we found
was a dark, gloomy night.
10We feel our way along,
as if we were blind;
we stumble at noon,
as if it were night.
We can see no better
than someone dead.
11We growl like bears
and mourn like doves.
We hope for justice and victory,
but they escape us.
12How often have we sinned
and turned against you,
the Lord God?
Our sins condemn us!
We have done wrong.
13We have rebelled and refused
to follow you.
Our hearts were deceitful,
and so we lied;
we planned to abuse others
and turn our backs on you.
14Injustice is everywhere;
justice seems far away.
Truth is chased out of court;
honesty is shoved aside.
15Everyone tells lies;
those who turn from crime
end up ruined.
The Lord Will Rescue His People
When the Lord noticed
that justice had disappeared,
he became very displeased.
16 It disgusted him even more
to learn that no one
would do a thing about it.
So with his own powerful arm,
he won victories for truth.
17 Justice was the Lord's armor;
saving power was his helmet;
anger and revenge
were his clothes.
18Now the Lord will get furious
and do to his enemies,
both near and far,
what they did to his people.
19He will attack like a flood
in a mighty windstorm.
Nations in the west and the east
will then honor and praise
his wonderful name.
20 The Lord has promised to rescue
the city of Zion
and Jacob's descendants
who turn from sin.
21The Lord says: “My people,
I promise to give you my Spirit
and my message.
These will be my gifts to you
and your families forever.
I, the Lord, have spoken.”
translation_text:
Wichɔgaa, chɔgri sɛɛi ani lɛɛi wia
1A waa lugɔ Kɔraawiizi nonii siuwɔɔ, wàá wer lɛɛ ia. Akai!
Gɛɛ a waa lugɔ u digna
taŋzɔɔrɛ, waa kaa
ra nuu wia nɛnnɛ.
2Ka ii wichɔgaarɛ gillɛ
ii ni Kɔraawiizi la
iinna hum la bargi dɔŋa ni.
Ii wichɔgaarɛ gillɛ u bir har kpu ia,
waa kaa ra nuu ii be.
3Ii nonee ɛɛ nɛkpuura noneere,
wichɔgaa gil a doŋ.
Ii maa ni kara kannaa
ni biinikpola wiŋɔzi bɛŋ.
4Nɛr maa baga lɛi wibii dii wia,
ba ra kanni kara
seriya diiribɔr.
Ba ɔɔ dɛlli wiŋɔpɛɛrii hɔɔzi dii biini, di ra kanni kara.
Ba nfɛrchɔgaa gil ba ra ɛɛ
wichɔgaa bɛŋ.
5Ba wiɛɛlaa maa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ duŋkpola hala n teezee,
di kaa ɛɛ lugɔ
nandar kɛhkiah.
Di nɛr haŋ hee a hal bɛl maa, u ra siwuu.
Di bɛl maa ge kaa puri,
duŋkpola ɔɔ lii u biinii.
6Ba wiɛɛlaa maa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ baŋ kpa nandar kɛhkiah suah wɛjɛ.
Waa tɔna dɔɔwɛ lugɔ
bá kpau tɔ.
Wichɔgaa bɛnnɛ ɛɛ ba huma,
ba kaa gil kalu wia
ɛɛ ba siaahmu.
7Ba ɔɔ ra chɔu saŋa maa, bá ga ɛɛ wichɔgaa,
di ɔɔ ra yali siwee,
bá lɛɛ nɛra haahkɛ.
Wichɔgaa bɛŋ nfɛrɛɛ ba dɔɔ.
Bɔr la maa baŋ ɔɔ ga,
nɛkpui ni bolpuri wia
bɛnnɛ ba ɔɔ ra ɛɛ.
8Ba waa nuukpaŋ dɔɔi ŋmɛnɛɛ zummɛ,
ba waa seriya ge
ra di ni wibii.
Ba wiɛɛlaa ŋmɛnizi baŋ daurɛɛ golgoore,
nɛr la maa n na hiŋaa,
waa bampirsɔna wia zummɛ.
9Awia, a nɛra ŋɔ,
“Wibii ni wideŋlaa
nɛɛwɔɔ yaa be.
Yaa ra nyiŋŋi bɔchaaŋ
ka du bɔbiri.
Yaa ra nyiŋŋi ya ra vol bɔchaaŋ,
ka ra vol bɔbiri
werge biini.
10Yaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nyuŋŋa,
di largi koŋlaa ra vol,
di ra lɔɔzi naazi wibaŋa ni alugɔ hamuŋa.
Kpeglega ge biini,
yaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nɛsiwaa.
11Yaa ra uuhruu lugɔ lɔzi n lau amani,
yaa biine chɔgzi,
yaa ra wii
alugɔ kommazi,
di ra nyiŋŋi wibii dii,
ka guŋ waa hoo,
di ra kpaŋ saŋa la Kɔraawiizi
n niŋ wa lizi yaa
lii dɔgnya biini,
ka guŋ waa dugli.
12Kɔraawiizi yaa n na hum la,
yaa wichɔgaa kannɔɔ werge i be,
a ɔɔ biruu di yaa
daansɛɛ, yaa chol.
Yaa zum a wiarɛ,
di sɛɛ lugɔ yaa
ɛɛ wichɔgɛɛraa.
13Yaa dɔɔ dignikpegaa di ra vɛɛi,
di bir yaa hara kpui.
Yaa ra sunni nɛra, di ra du dɔm,
di kaa dɔɔ nfɛrchɔgaa ge
di ra kanni kara
werge maa.
14Yaa duŋŋi wibii dii lii yaa be,
yaa ni wideŋlaa ge du nɛɛ.
Wibii lɔ naarɛ yaa ŋmɛnizi,
biinihuŋŋu ge waa
bɔr nawɛɛ yaa be.
15Wibii waa kaa hoo yemmaa,
guŋ wia, tɔɔrɔɔ ɔɔ huuzi
nɛr la maa n na
vɛɛ wichɔgaa ɛɛirɛ.”
Kɔraawiizi na gunnɛ, u bɔra waa sɔɔnɛɛ,
dikuu wibii dii
n waa hoo wia.
16A tiruubuu un nawɛɛ lugɔ nɛr maa waa hoo,
ú di wibii di lɛɛ nɛra la
banna sunni la.
Awia, u himmaa faa izi chi, di kpa u fɔŋŋa lɛɛ baa,
u himmaa wideŋlaa
lawuu kpogli.
17U kpa wideŋlaare laali alugɔ kaali, di tɔ u see ni u har,
di kpa nɛlɛɛi hi
alugɔ kahuro,
di kpa wichɔgaa kinturgaa laali alugɔ banaaga,
di kpa siaahmu laali
alugɔ tagtazeŋ.
18U daŋ turgi u dɔma bɛl maa gunla n dɛkkɛ.
U baaŋfuuih daŋ du ba ni
dikuu gunla baŋ tɔɔri
u nɛra la wia.
Muuzenaa baana hɛssi hina
maanii ú turgi
gunla n dɛg baa.
19Nɛra la n du wiicholii ni wiifurii maa,
danna ɔm Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ
ni gunla u girme n duwɛɛ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, u daŋ bau fɔŋŋa ni
alugɔ nii n suwee
di ra pal gbuŋgbuŋgbuŋ la.
20Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ u nɛra benii,
“Mìŋ́ i Lɛɛri daŋ jaa
ba Jɛrusalɛm di wa lɛɛ
banla maa n gil
ba wichɔgaa ta la.
21N ni ia nuukpannɛ keŋ, n Duma la miŋ kpawɛɛ du ii ni la daŋ du ii ni di hanna la. N wiŋɔzi ge miŋ kpawɛɛ du ii nuuzi la daŋ du ii ni ii biizi ani ii naanna nuuzi, di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

english_text:
A New Day for Jerusalem
1Jerusalem, stand up! Shine!
Your new day is dawning.
The glory of the Lord
shines brightly on you.
2The earth and its people
are covered with darkness,
but the glory of the Lord
is shining upon you.
3Nations and kings
will come to the light
of your dawning day.
Crowds Are Coming to Jerusalem
The Lord said:
4 Open your eyes! Look around!
Crowds are coming.
Your sons are on their way
from distant lands;
your daughters are being carried
like little children.
5When you see this,
your faces will glow;
your hearts will pound
and swell with pride.
Treasures from across the sea
and the wealth of nations
will be brought to you.
6Your country will be covered
with caravans of young camels
from Midian and Ephah.
The people of Sheba
will bring gold and spices
in praise of me, the Lord.
7Every sheep of Kedar
will come to you;
rams from Nebaioth
will be yours as well.
I will accept them as offerings
and bring honor to my temple.
8What is that sailing by
like clouds
or like doves flying home?
9On those distant islands
your people are waiting
for me, the Lord.
Seagoing ships lead the way
to bring them home
with their silver and gold.
I, the holy Lord God of Israel,
do this to honor your people,
so they will honor me.
Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt
The Lord said:
10Jerusalem, your city walls
will be rebuilt by foreigners;
their rulers will become
your slaves.
I punished you in my anger;
now I will be kind
and treat you with mercy.
11 Your gates will be open
day and night
to let the rulers of nations
lead their people to you
with all their treasures.
12Any nation or kingdom
that refuses to serve you
will be wiped out.
13Wood from Lebanon's best trees
will be brought to you—
the pines, the firs,
and the cypress trees.
It will be used in my temple
to make beautiful the place
where I rest my feet.
14 The descendants of enemies
who hated and mistreated you
will kneel at your feet.
They will say, “You are Zion,
the city of the Lord,
the holy One of Israel.”
15You were hated and deserted,
rejected by everyone.
But I will make you beautiful,
a city to be proud of
for all time to come.
16You will drain the wealth
of kings and foreign nations.
You will know that I,
the mighty Lord God of Israel,
have saved and rescued you.
17I will bring bronze and iron
in place of wood and stone;
in place of bronze and iron,
I will bring gold and silver.
I will appoint peace and justice
as your rulers and leaders.
18Violence, destruction, and ruin
will never again be heard of
within your borders.
“Victory” will be the name
you give to your walls;
“Praise” will be the name
you give to your gates.
19 You won't need the light
of the sun or the moon.
I, the Lord your God,
will be your eternal light
and bring you honor.
20Your sun will never set
or your moon go down.
I, the Lord, will be
your everlasting light,
and your days of sorrow
will come to an end.
21Your people will live right
and always own the land;
they are the trees I planted
to bring praise to me.
22Even the smallest family
will be a powerful nation.
I am the Lord,
and when the time comes,
I will quickly do all this.
translation_text:
Ziɔn girme wia
1Jɛrusalɛm, izi chiŋ, di ra chaani lugɔ wiizi.
Kɔraawiizi girme
ra chaani i ninɛɛ.
2Na! Haali bɔbiri n haa tɔ hɛri naa ni u nɛra maa ni la,
ka Kɔraawiizi girme du
i benii di ra chaani i ni.
3Hɛssi hina ni koora maa daŋ ba i bɔchaaŋ la,
n na chaani i ni la biini.
4Lalli i nyuu chiŋ di binni na.
Ba maanii chaalɛɛ
di ra ba i be.
Ii biibaala la lii hɛhjaŋaa di ra ba,
ba kpa i biihaana genii
pɛgli ra ba.
5Di i wa na guŋ, i bɔra daŋ sɔɔni,
i bɔra ra pur.
Kɔkɔɔza daŋ zuu muugbessi di chi daama ba wa tɛi,
a hɛssi daama ba i be.
6Nyugmakpila daŋ wa su i hɛri maa.
Nyugmapɔla daŋ lii Midian
ni Efa hɛssi maa ba.
Siiba hina maa daŋ kpogli
saliŋ ni daahɛgsɔɔhsuma ba.
Ba danna bagli gunla
Kɔraawiizi n ɛɛwɛ,
di ra chɔluu.
7Ba daŋ chaali Kɛda peeza maa wa tɛi.
Nɛbayɔf pebala maa daŋ ɛɛ
i hora di ra hiinii.
Aabuu í kpa di lizi mbusu tɛŋ n mbusu lizibɔr la ni, ń lɛɛa.
N daŋ jaa gil n Dia la dɔɔ
girme werge maa.
8Bɛɛ kunaa waa kaali lugɔ baamazi
gɛɛ kommazi n zaahzɛɛ ra
la a daŋa naanɛi?
9A ɛɛ muugberzenaa n lii hɛhjaŋaa
di chi Kɔraawiizi nɛra
ra ba bolle.
Saliŋ ni saliŋhuŋŋaa a chi ra ba,
a wa chɔli Kɔraawiizi,
Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la sɔŋ.
Waabuu gillɛ hɛssi hina
maa ra tɔgzi u nɛra.
10Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Jɛrusalɛm, hɔɔhra daŋ lii hɛhjaŋa di wa bir ma i koŋlaa,
ba koorizenaa ge
birgi i balaa.
Haali mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi baaŋ n faa fuuhwe n tɔɔrii werge la,
ka n daŋ bir suŋ i ni,
di na i sinyɛna.
11I dominuuzenaa daŋ ɔɔ pilluu saŋaa saŋa maa,
a wàá tɔ hɔpizaa gɛɛ
hamuŋa gba,
guŋ gil hɛssi hina koora tɔ ba nɛra see
di chi ba daama zuu i biini.
12Hɛri gɛɛ kora la maa hina n niŋ vɛɛ i dɔɔra sɛɛi,
n daŋ chɔguu,
ú wia tuŋ nyaamm.
13Lɛbanɔn girme la daŋ ba i be,
ú kɔr daananaa irizi maa
wa kuari n Dia, ú du wer.
N daŋ gil n Dia du wer
di gil n naazi
chignibɔr dɔɔ girme.
14I dɔɔra la n faa ra sunnii la biibaala daŋ ba i be di wa giŋŋi i see.
Banla ge maa
n faa ra gbɛllii la
daŋ giŋŋi i see.
Ba danna yirii, ‘Kɔraawiizi bolnanii, Ziɔn,
Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la bol.’
15Jɛrusalɛm, baŋ faa vɛɛi ta, nɛr maa haih,
nɛr maa waa kaa ra ga i biini
di ra la ŋmɛnɛɛ la,
ka filaŋkeŋ, n daŋ gil i dɔɔ sɔŋ di du wer,
bɔsɔna du i biini
di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa.
16Hɛssi hina ni koora daŋ kpa ba daama di ba waa binni i ni nɛnnɛ,
alugɔ haaŋ n na ɔzi bie.
Denii i zum lugɔ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi
Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la,
Jekɔb n na hum labuu,
i Lɛɛri.
17N daŋ gil danyɛ ka tɛi saliŋ,
di gil lugbia
ka tɛi saliŋhuŋŋa,
di kaa gil daazi ge ka tɛi danyɛ,
di gil bia ka tɛi lugbia.
N daŋ gil bɔsɔna ɛɛ i nabɔma,
wideŋlaa ge ɛɛ i koori.
18Nɛr maa ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka nuu laal wia i hɛri biini,
gɛɛ bolpuraa ni hɛhchɔg
i hɛri biini.
N daŋ guui alugɔ koŋlii,
i ra chɔliŋ dikuu
miŋ mɔglii wia.
19A waa lugɔ wiizii niŋ ɔɔ kaa ra chaanii hɔpizaa saŋa,
gɛɛ baagu ra chaanii hamuŋa.
Akai, Kɔraawiizii ninna chaanii, saŋaa saŋa maa.
Kɔraawiizi la hinna hum
labuu niŋ ɛɛ i girme.
20I wiizi ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka chol
gɛɛ i baagu zuu biri.
Akai, Kɔraawiizii ninna chaanii, saŋaa saŋa maa,
i biinichɔg la jaa tuŋ.
21I nɛra maa wia daŋ deŋli,
bá dɔɔ a hɛri naa di hanna la.
Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ daa n himmaa n chɔɔzɛɛ,
ú du de di ra bagli n girme.
22Banla maa domeezi n waa kaŋ, daŋ wazi di du kaŋ,
di birgi hɛrzeŋ hina.
Di a saŋa wa hello lugɔ guŋ ɛɛ,
n daŋ gil guŋ ɛɛ manaŋ.
Minuu Kɔraawiizi.”

english_text:
The Good News of Victory
1 The Spirit of the Lord God
has taken control of me!
The Lord has chosen and sent me
to tell the oppressed
the good news,
to heal the brokenhearted,
and to announce freedom
for prisoners and captives.
2 This is the year
when the Lord God
will show kindness to us
and punish our enemies.
The Lord has sent me
to comfort those who mourn,
3especially in Jerusalem.
He sent me to give them flowers
in place of their sorrow,
olive oil in place of tears,
and joyous praise
in place of broken hearts.
They will be called
“Trees of Justice,”
planted by the Lord
to honor his name.
4Then they will rebuild cities
that have been in ruins
for many generations.
5They will hire foreigners
to take care of their sheep
and their vineyards.
6But they themselves will be
priests and servants
of the Lord our God.
The treasures of the nations
will belong to them,
and they will be famous.
7They were terribly insulted
and horribly mistreated;
now they will be greatly blessed
and joyful forever.
The Lord Loves Justice
8I, the Lord, love justice!
But I hate robbery
and injustice.
My people, I solemnly promise
to reward you
with an eternal agreement.
9Your descendants will be known
in every nation.
All who see them will realize
that they have been blessed,
by me, the Lord.
Celebrate and Shout
10 I celebrate and shout
because of my Lord God.
His saving power and justice
are the very clothes I wear.
They are more beautiful
than the jewelry worn
by a bride or groom.
11The Lord will bring about
justice and praise
in every nation on earth,
like flowers blooming
in a garden.
translation_text:
Lɛɛi amaniyesuma wia
1Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la Duma izimbuu werge,
dikuubɛɛwiai, u lizimbuu
ń lizi amaniyesuma
tɛɛ nyaara.
U humimbuu ń tig banla biine
n chɔkkɛ la bampiree,
di ŋɔ hindɔɔi wia tɛɛ yoma
ni banla baŋ tɔ dia,
2di ŋɔ nɛr maa be lugɔ saŋa la
Kɔraawiizi n niŋ
hiini baa la helloo
ani u baaŋ n niŋ fuuh
ú turgi ba dɔma
ba kim la wia,
di tig banla
n na wii bampiree.
3Di ŋɔ bɔsɔna wia,
di tig banla maa n du Ziɔn,
di ra wii la bampiree,
di lizi ba gbɔglɔŋ laala char bɔsɔna laala,
bá wiraa birgi bɔsɔna,
bá dɔgnya dii birgi chɔlaa.
Ba daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ daazenaa
Kɔraawiizi n chɔɔzɛɛ,
bá ra ɛɛ wideŋlaa.
Ba ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi,
dikuu u wiɛɛlaa wia.
4Ba daŋ bir ma ba diŋgelbinaa la,
di bir kuari kunla maa
n faa chɔkkɛ.
A bolzenaa la n faa purgee
saŋa maa labuu bá bir ma.
5Hɔɔhraa niŋ waa dɛɛzi ii sela,
di birgi ii patta,
di ra par
ii grepu daazi kooni.
6Ba danna yir iawaa Kɔraawiizi kizeehina,
ba daŋ ɔɔ bagli ii wia lugɔ
ii ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi huŋhunnaa.
A hɛssi la daama biinii ii ra di,
di lɛɛ a maa dɔɔ.
7Baŋ faa ra gbɛlli ia, ii ra di hiihzi la,
ka filaŋkeŋwaa, ii daŋ jaa na
daama la iiŋ faa dɔɔwɛ la
naa bunɛɛ,
ii bɔra sɔɔni ii hɛri wia.
Ii daŋ dɔɔ daama werge,
di dɔɔ bɔsɔna
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
8Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“N na nyiŋŋi seriya dii ni wibiire,
ka hah foozaa
ni wichɔgaa ɛɛi.
Dikuu n wibii wia, n daŋ ɛɛ baa winanaa,
di gil n ni baa ɛɛ
nuukpaŋ la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
9Ba naanna la daŋ dɔɔ sɔŋ hɛssi maa hina be.
Nɛra maanii ninna tɔgzi baa,
banla ge maa n niŋ na baa daŋ sɛɛ lugɔ
baabuu ɛɛ nɛra la
Kɔraawiizi n kissee.”
10N bɔra sɔɔnimbuu werge Kɔraawiizi wia,
n bɔra ra pur Kɔraawiizi la
minna hum la wia.
U bɔgimbuu lɛɛi bɔmbɔga,
di bɔgiŋ ni
wideŋlaa tagtazeŋ,
alugɔ haŋfalii jaari n ɔɔ bɔg lugɔ Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ la,
gɛɛ lugɔ haŋfalii n ɔɔ bɔg
di du u dignikuna
ni u baŋaakuna n wesse werge la.
11Gunla baŋ ɔɔ duu kuna bee kambol,
a lii di ra hel la,
gunnɛ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la gil wideŋlaa ni chɔlaa
lii, hɛssi maa hina na.

english_text:
Jerusalem Will Be Saved
1Jerusalem, I will speak up
for your good.
I will never be silent
till you are safe and secure,
sparkling like a flame.
2Your great victory will be seen
by every nation and king;
the Lord will even give you
a new name.
3You will be a glorious crown,
a royal headband
for the Lord your God.
4Your name will no longer be
“Deserted and Childless,”
but “Happily Married.”
You will please the Lord;
your country
will be his bride.
5Your people will take the land,
just as a young man
takes a bride.
The Lord will be pleased
because of you,
just as a husband is pleased
with his bride.
6Jerusalem, on your walls
I have stationed guards,
whose duty it is
to speak out day and night,
without resting.
They must remind the Lord
7and not let him rest
till he makes Jerusalem strong
and famous everywhere.
8The Lord has given his word
and made this promise:
“Never again will I give
to your enemies
the grain and grapes
for which you struggled.
9As surely as you harvest
your grain and grapes,
you will eat your bread
with thankful hearts,
and you will drink your wine
in my temple.”
10People of Jerusalem,
open your gates!
Repair the road to the city
and clear it of stones;
raise a banner to help
the nations find their way.
11 Here is what the Lord has said
for all the earth to hear:
“Soon I will come to save
the city of Zion
and to reward you.
12Then you will be called,
‘The Lord's Own People,
The Ones He Rescued!’
Your city will be known
as a good place to live
and a city full of people.”
translation_text:
Ziɔn sɔŋfalii wia
1Ziɔn, i wia, màá siigi,
Jɛrusalɛm, i wia, màá siigi.
Di i wideŋlaa waa haŋ waa chaani,
alugɔ chɔzimpikke,
i lɛɛi ge waa chaani
alugɔ kacheel n na lau lɛi,
màá siigi.
2Denii hɛssi maa hina jaa na i wideŋlaa la,
koorizenaa maa ge
na i girme la.
Ba daŋ yirii sɔŋfalii bɛl
Kɔraawiizi himmaa n niŋ tɛi.
3I daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ koorikahuro n wesse werge,
Kɔraawiizi la
hinna hum la nonii biini.
4Ŋmɛnɛ maa, ba wàá ka yirii ‘Bol la baŋ vɛɛwɛ ta’,
gɛɛ di kaa yir
i hɛri ‘Diŋgela’.
Ka ba daŋ jaa ra yirii, ‘Hɛpziba’,
di kaa yir i hɛri
‘Unla n yuuwɛ’,
dikuubɛɛwiai, i wia daŋ par Kɔraawiizi,
ú kpai ɛɛ u haaŋ.
5Gunla biipɔllii n ɔɔ kpa toloori la,
gunnɛ i taari kpai la.
Too, gunla haŋfalii ge jaari bɔra n ɔɔ sɔɔni u haŋfalii wia la,
gunnɛ Kɔraawiizi
bɔra sɔɔni i wia.
6Jɛrusalɛm, n soŋŋi tauduuraa i koŋlaa nyuuni,
ba ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá siigi
hɔpizaa saŋa gɛɛ hamuŋa saŋa.
Banna yir Kɔraawiizi di ra liizuu u nuuzi la uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ baa la wia,
bá gilɛɛ waa heezi.
7Ií gilɛɛ waa gil Kɔraawiizi ra heezi,
di waa gillɛ Jɛrusalɛm
bir chi nɛnnɛ,
di ɛɛ durnya maa kunchɔlii.
8Kɔraawiizi kpa u fɔŋŋazeŋ labuu
di hɛɛhzi lugɔ
u ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka kpa i mia
gɛɛ i diwee dɛɛzi i dɔma.
Hɛrduma maa hina ge ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka nyɔɔ
siŋ la hiŋ kuuhwɛ na.
9Ka banla n niŋ ɔɔ kum a mia la,
baabuu niŋ ɔɔ dia
ka chɔli Kɔraawiizi.
Banla ge n ɔɔ chaali grepu nɔna a wa lii siŋ la,
baabuu niŋ ɔɔ nyɔɔa,
Kɔraawiizi Dia diŋŋee la biini.
10Ií lii, ií ga dominuuzenaa la lii,
di kuari ŋmɛnɛɛ
tɛɛ nɛra la n bittɛ ra ba la.
Ií tɔɔgi a ŋmɛnɛɛ bɔɔni,
di wigzi u bia maa,
ú du wer.
Ií baŋ tuuta a hɛssi hina maa na.
11Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ
ra tɛɛ hɛri naa
yɛmmaa hina,
“Ŋɔ Ziɔn hina be lugɔ ba Lɛɛri ra bau,
di kpogli u kinturgaa.”
12Ba danna yir baa ‘Kɔraawiizi nɛnanaa,’
di yir baa
‘Nɛra la Kɔraawiizi n lɛɛwɛ,’
ka ra yir Jɛrusalɛm ge, ‘Bolzeŋ la Kɔraawiizi n nɔŋŋɛɛ,’
di kaa ra yiruu
‘Bolzeŋ la baŋ
wàá ka vɛɛ ta.’

english_text:
The Lord's Victory over the Nations
1 Who is this coming
from Bozrah in Edom
with clothes stained red?
Who is this hero marching
in his glorious uniform?
“It's me, the Lord!
I have won the battle,
and I can save you!”
2What are those red spots?
Your clothes look stained
from trampling on grapes.
3 “I alone trampled the grapes!
None of the nations helped.
I trampled nations in my anger
and stained my clothes
with their blood.
4I did this because I wanted
to take revenge—
the time had come
to rescue my people.
5 No one was there to help me
or to give support;
my mighty arm won the battle,
strengthened by my anger.
6In my fury I trampled on nations
and made them drunk;
their blood poured out
everywhere on earth.”
The Lord's Goodness to His People
7I will tell about the kind deeds
the Lord has done.
They deserve praise!
The Lord has shown mercy
to the people of Israel;
he has been kind and good.
8The Lord rescued his people,
and said, “They are mine.
They won't betray me.”
9It troubled the Lord
to see them in trouble,
and his angel saved them.
The Lord was truly merciful,
so he rescued his people.
He took them in his arms
and carried them all those years.
10Then the Lord's people
turned against him and made
his Holy Spirit sad.
So he became their enemy
and attacked them.
11But his people remembered
what had happened
during the time of Moses.
Didn't the Lord bring them
and their leaders
safely through the sea?
Didn't he give them
his Holy Spirit?
12 The glorious power of the Lord
marched beside Moses.
The Lord will be praised forever
for dividing the sea.
13He led his people across
like horses running wild
without stumbling.
14His Spirit gave them rest,
just as cattle find rest
when led into a valley.
The name of the Lord was praised
for doing these things.
A Prayer for Mercy and Help
15Please, Lord, look down
from your holy and glorious
home in the heavens
and see what's going on.
Have you lost interest?
Where is your power?
Show that you care about us
and have mercy!
16 Our ancestors Abraham and Jacob
have both rejected us.
But you are still our Father;
you have been our protector
since ancient times.
17Why did you make us turn away
from you, our Lord?
Why did you make us want
to disobey you?
Please change your mind!
We are your servants,
your very own people.
18For a little while,
your temple belonged to us;
and now our enemies
have torn it down.
19We act as though you
had never ruled us
or called us your people.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi Kinturgaa ni u Nɛlɛɛi Hɔpizii wia
1Anɛɛ n lii Ɛdɔm hɛri
bolzeŋ Bɔzra di ra ba naanɛi?
Anɛɛ n laali kuŋaahma
a du wer werge,
di vol ra ba fɔŋŋa ni
werge naanɛi?
“Minuu Kɔraawiizi, di ra ŋɔ wideŋlaa,
di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge n lɛɛ ia.”
2Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i laala aah lugɔ
nɛr la n na fɛrgi
grepu nɔna,
a nii ra liiyɛi?
3Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ,
“N bɛnnɛ fɛrgi hɛssi hina gunla baŋ ɔɔ fɛrgi grepu nɔna, a nii ra lii la,
nɛr maa waŋ hiinee.
Awiarɛ n kpa baaŋfuuih fɛrgi n dɔma,
ba challi yaari n laala ni,
a maa aah gunla.
4A hɔl la min niŋ turgi n nɛra kim la du n bampiriire.
Bina la min niŋ
lɛɛ baa la helloo.
5N faa binnɔɔrɛ, ka maa hiini maa nawɛɛ.
N nua faa kpuwɔɔrɛ,
nɛr maa n waŋ hiinee wia.
Awia, n himmaa banoniire n faa kpa di kpegli n dɔma,
n himmaa baaŋfuuih
gil n du kpeg.
6N kpa baaŋfuuihchɔgiirɛ fɛrgi hɛssi hina,
ba challi waari hɛri.”
Chɔlaa ni wiisuŋŋaa wia
7N daŋ ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia,
di yir yira chɔluu,
dikuu wia la maa
uŋ ɛɛwɛ tɛɛ yaa wia,
di chɔluu dikuu uŋ suŋ Izrɛl hina ni,
di nɔŋŋi baa
werge maa wia.
8U ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ba ɛɛ n nɛraa, wibii maa,
ba ŋmɛnɛ maa
wàá ka dariŋ.”
Awia, u birgi ba Lɛɛrii.
9Ba dɔgnya dii gillɔɔ u biini chɔgi,
u lɛɛ baa.
A waa lugɔ mɛlika gɛɛ u balii bɛllɛ lɛɛ baa,
u himmaanii lɛɛ baa.
U nɔŋŋaa ni u nɛsunaa dɔɔi la wia,
u lɛɛ baabuu ta,
u faa ra binni ba ninɛɛ
biŋkpila maa n bɛrɛɛ.
10Ka ba faa wa vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi wia,
u Dumnaniinanii biini
chɔgi werge maa.
A wia, u faa birgi ba dɔm,
di lɔ baa laal.
11Denii u nɛra faa liizi
Moosis ni u nɛra wia,
lee unla n faa kpogli baa
ni u penɔɔni
gi muuzeŋ la duɛi?
Lee unla n faa kpa
u Dumnaniinanii du u nɛra ni,
12unla n kpa u banonii
du Moosis nodig,
unla n faa bargi muuzeŋ nii ba sibɔɔ,
ú na sɔŋ la
n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ,
13di faa kpogli baa gi a muuzeŋluŋ la duɛi?
Ba waa jiŋlɛɛ
alugɔ zagu n na chɔ
bɔr la n chaanɛɛ,
waa naazi ra lɔɔzi la.
14Ba faa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nauna baŋ tigaa ra kaali lɛl,
a waa tɔɔrɔɔ maa ra di la,
gunnɛ Kɔraawiizi Duma
tɛɛ baa heezaa.
Kenne u tɔ u nɛra see,
nɛ́ra maa wer u sɔŋ tɔgzi.
15Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lii chiŋ
i sogni bɔnaniinanii la
n dɔɔ girme werge la
di binni yaa na.
Hiŋ faa aah siwii yaa wia la tunnɔɔ gɛɛ?
Haa kaa nɔŋŋi yaa gɛɛ di ra suŋ yaa ni.
16Gunla maa an duwɛɛ, ka hinuu yaa mɛɛ.
Haali di yaa naabaala Abraham ni Jekɔb
vɛɛ yaa ta gba,
ka hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii yaa mɛɛ.
Hinuu yaa Lɛɛri faala maa
di wa lii ni zinaa.
17Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bɛɛ n baani i gil yaa gil i ŋmɛnizi ka ra juuri,
di dɔɔ dignikpega werge,
yaa waa kaa ra ɔmiinɛi?
Bir ba, dikuu i balaa wia,
dizi la n ɛɛ
i kapɛttɛ kuna la.
18I nɛnanaa faa dɔɔ i Dia labuu tama.
Ama, filaŋkeŋwaa, yaa dɔma
jaa purguubuu nyaamm.
19Yaa jaa duu lugɔ i ŋmɛnɛ maa n haa waa kora diwee yaa ni,
yaa jaa du lugɔ haa
yaa lizɛɛ yaa ɛɛ i nɛra.

english_text:
1Rip the heavens apart!
Come down, Lord;
make the mountains tremble.
2Be a spark that starts a fire
causing water to boil.
Then your enemies will know
who you are;
all nations will tremble
because you are nearby.
3Your fearsome deeds
have completely amazed us;
even the mountains shake
when you come down.
4 You are the only God
ever seen or heard of
who works miracles
for his followers.
5You help all who gladly obey
and do what you want,
but sin makes you angry.
Only by your help
can we ever be saved.
6We are unfit to worship you;
each of our good deeds
is merely a filthy rag.
We dry up like leaves;
our sins are storm winds
sweeping us away.
7No one worships in your name
or remains faithful.
You have turned your back on us
and let our sins melt us away.
8You, Lord, are our Father.
We are nothing but clay,
but you are the potter
who molded us.
9Don't be so furious
or keep our sins
in your thoughts forever!
Remember that all of us
are your people.
10Every one of your towns
has turned into a desert,
especially Jerusalem.
11Zion's glorious and holy temple
where our ancestors praised you
has been destroyed by fire.
Our beautiful buildings
are now a pile of ruins.
12When you see these things,
how can you just sit there
and make us suffer more?
translation_text:
1Hoi, yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, haa yaa chiŋ, di tuu baa?
Di i wa ballɔ,
bizenaa danna zigli i sibɔɔ!
2Tuu alugɔ niŋ, daazi ra fuuh,
niiri ge ra bɔr.
Denii i dɔma zum i fɔŋŋa,
a hɛssi hina maa
bɔra ra sa i see.
3I faa tuuwoo di wa ɛɛ nuukpuuri wia la yaa n waa tami,
i bizenaa nai,
ɔnsii werge lawaa,
a ra zigli i see.
4Di haŋ lii faala maa,
nɛr maa digna
haa waa nuuwɛ,
nɛr maa siwee ge haa waa Kɔraawiizi maa nawɛɛ,
di hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la
n hummɛ ra tɛɛ
banla n dɔɔ
i tamii la bɛn lɛi.
5I ɛɛ siryaa í hiini banla wideŋlaa ɛɛi n na pur ba bɔra,
ba ra hiŋ i ŋmɛnizi.
Ka yaa haa vɛɛwɔɔ ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa,
i baaŋ na fuuh yaa ni.
Awia, ɛrɛɛ ya ɛɛ
di na lɛɛiyɛi?
6Yaawaa maa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ kundoŋa,
haali yaa wideŋlaa maa gba
ɛɛ lugɔ yakɔssi n doŋŋe.
Yaa ɔɔ waruu lugɔ paŋhoori,
yaa wichɔgaa kpa
yaa kaali alugɔ peu.
7Nɛr maa waa i sɔnna yir,
gɛɛ di ra ɛɛ ania
ú lawii kpogli nɛnnɛ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, i bir i hattɛ kpu yaa,
di gil yaa wichɔgaa
ra chɔgi yaa.
8Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hinuu haa yaa mɛɛ.
Yaabuu chuurii, i ɛɛ maari.
Yaa maa ɛɛ
i nonee kummaalaarɛ.
9Gilɛɛ gil i baaŋ fuuh di ga bɛri,
di gilɛɛ ra liizi yaa
wichɔgaa la ge
saŋaa saŋa maa.
Jaande maa, zum lugɔ
yaa ɛɛ i nɛraa,
di suŋ yaa ni.
10I bolzennanaananaa la maanii purgee di birgi lugɔ hɛribɔduma.
Jɛrusalɛm gba puroore
di birgi diŋgela.
11Hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Dia la n waa doŋa maa dɔɔwɛ, di dɔɔ girme,
yaa naabaala ɔɔ faa zuu de
di ra chɔlii la gba maanii
niŋ fuuh, u zuu hɛri.
Yaa kunnanaa maanii
chɔkkɛ nyaamm.
12Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, haali annii naa maa gba n ɛɛwɛ, ka i daŋ haa vɛɛ yaa hiinaa di ra tɔɔri yaa?
I daŋ siigi ka haa tɛr
yaa digna di ga bɛriaa?

english_text:
The Lord Will Punish the Guilty
1 I, the Lord, was ready
to answer even those
who were not asking
and to be found by those
who were not searching.
To a nation that refused
to worship me,
I said, “Here I am!”
2 All day long I have reached out
to stubborn and sinful people
going their own way.
3They keep making me angry
by sneering at me,
while offering sacrifices
to idols in gardens
and burning incense
to them on bricks.
4They spend their nights
hiding in burial caves;
they eat the meat of pigs,
cooked in sauces
made of stuff unfit to eat.
5And then they say to others,
“Don't come near us!
We're dedicated to God.”
Such people are like smoke,
irritating my nose all day.
6I have written this down;
I won't keep silent.
I'll pay them back
just as their sins deserve.
7I, the Lord, will make them pay
for their sins and for those
of their ancestors—
they have disgraced me
by burning incense
on mountains.
8Here is what the Lord says:
A cluster of grapes
that produces wine
is worth keeping!
So, because of my servants,
I won't destroy everyone.
9I have chosen the people
of Israel and Judah,
and I will bless them
with many descendants.
They will settle here
in this land of mountains,
and it will be theirs.
10 My people will worship me.
Then the coastlands of Sharon
and the land as far
as Achor Valley
will turn into pastureland
where cattle and sheep
will feed and rest.
11What will I, the Lord, do
if any of you reject me
and my holy mountain?
What will happen to you
for offering food and wine
to the gods you call
“Good Luck” and “Fate”?
12Your luck will end!
I will see to it that you
are slaughtered with swords.
You refused to answer
when I called out;
you paid no attention
to my instructions.
Instead, you did what I hated,
knowing it was wrong.
13I, the Lord God, will give
food and drink to my servants,
and they will celebrate.
But all of you sinners
will go hungry and thirsty,
overcome with disgrace.
14My servants will laugh and sing,
but you will be sad
and cry out in pain.
15I, the Lord God, promise
to see that you are killed
and that my chosen servants use
your names as curse words.
But I will give new names
to my servants.
16I am God! I can be trusted.
Your past troubles are gone;
I no longer think of them.
When you pray for someone
to receive a blessing,
or when you make a promise,
you must do it in my name.
I alone am the God
who can be trusted.
The Lord's New Creation
17 I am creating new heavens
and a new earth;
everything of the past
will be forgotten.
18Celebrate and be glad forever!
I am creating a Jerusalem,
full of happy people.
19 I will celebrate with Jerusalem
and all its people;
there will be no more crying
or sorrow in that city.
20No child will die in infancy;
everyone will live
a very long life.
Anyone a hundred years old
will be considered young,
and to die younger than that
will be considered a curse.
21My people will live
in the houses they build;
they will enjoy grapes
from their own vineyards.
22No one will take away
their homes or vineyards.
My chosen people will live
to be as old as trees,
and they will enjoy
what they have earned.
23Their work won't be wasted,
and their children won't die
of dreadful diseases.
I will bless their children
and their grandchildren.
24I will answer their prayers
before they finish praying.
25 Wolves and lambs
will graze together;
lions and oxen
will feed on straw.
Snakes will eat only dirt!
They won't bite or harm anyone
on my holy mountain.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_text:
Seriya dii ni nɛlɛɛi wia
1Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Banla n faa waa n bɔr a nyiŋŋi, baabuu naŋ.
Banla n faa waa n wia ra pɛɛzi,
baabuu n bagli n wia tɛɛ.
N ŋɔwɔɔrɛ tɛɛ hɛri la hina n waa
n sɔnna yir,
ń lɛɛ baa la be,
‘Minuu keŋ.’
2N yaa n noneere chɔɔzi guŋŋ bɔr wa duani,
ń lɛɛ banla n na vɛɛ n wiŋɔzi,
ka ra hiŋ ŋmɛnizi la n waa wer
ni ba nfɛssi.
3Ba kuttɔɔrɛ di ra gbɛlliŋ,
di ra fuuh n baaŋ
ni mbusuzi la banna lizi kambola biine,
ni daahɛgsɔɔhsuma
banna fuuh birkissizi
mbusu lizibɔra ni,
di ra tɛɛ vuga.
4Ba ra la bɔra la banna hug lalaa hamuŋzi,
di ga suahzi ra ɛɛ
ba wiɛɛlaa,
di ra hee pereku ola,
ba viini suugi
kuŋkiilaa baŋ kpuwɛɛ
tɛɛ vuga yoma.
5Ka ba ɔɔ ra ŋɔ, ‘Gilɛɛ wàá gbɔgzi yaa.
I daŋ chɔgi yaa nanni.’
Guŋ nɛra ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nyɔɔzi, di ra zuu n miibɔɔni,
di ɛɛ niŋ n na lau
waa dinzaa dɔɔwɛ.
6Ií na, n sɛbi ba wichɔgaa kinturgaare dau n see.
Màá siigi di maa baa turgee
ba wichɔgaa kim,
a su a maga.
7N daŋ tɔɔri baa dikuu ba ni
ba naabaala maa
wichɔgaa wia.
Ba gbɛllimbuu dikuu baŋ fuuh daahɛgsɔɔhsuma ba vuga kuaribɔra la wia.
N daŋ turgi baa
a kim a su.”
8Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Gunla grepu nɔna n ɔɔ haa dɔɔ nii,
ba wàá sɛɛ chɔgaa la,
gunnɛ màá chɔgi Izrɛl hina,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n haa dɔɔ
nɛnanaarɛ ba biini.
9N daŋ gil Jekɔb ni Juda naanna baŋhina ka,
di dɔɔ n bizenaa hɛri.
Banla min niŋ lizi labuu niŋ di a kapɛttɛ
di so de ra humiŋ.
10Sarɔn lɛl labuu niŋ ɛɛ ba peeza diiribɔr,
Akɔ Waluu ge ɛɛ
ba nauna heezibɔr.
Banla n nyiŋŋiŋ ni
ba bampiree labuu
ń ɛɛ guŋ tɛɛ.
11Ama, ii banla waa n vɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi,
di suuh n binanii nyuu
jaamibɔr wia la,
ka kuari diiribɔr tɛɛ ba vug Gaad,
di kaa yiili sinni koozi
dɔŋa ni tɛɛ
ba vug Mɛni lawaa,
12ii zum lugɔ ii ni tokobii.
Ba daŋ gurgi ia
di teŋri ii nyuuni.
Dikuubɛɛwiai, n yir iabuu, ka ii waa sɛɛwɛ,
di ŋɔ wia tɛɛ ia
ka ii waa nuuwɛ.
Ii ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ n sibɔɔ,
di lizi wia la n wanna par.”
13Awia, kenne Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔ,
“N balaa danna di diwee,
ka lɔzi ra kpu ia,
n balaa danna nyɔɔ nii,
ka niinyɔgzi ra kpu ia.
N balaa bɔra daŋ sɔɔni,
ka iawaa di hiihzi.
14N balaa danna yir yira
ni bɔsɔna,
ka iawaa ra chɛɛhgi
ni biinichɔg werge maa.
15N nɛra la miŋ lizɛɛ daŋ kpa ii sɔŋ
di ra see nuuzi.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la daŋ kpuuzi ia,
ka bir tɛɛ n balaa sɔŋfalii.
16Nɛr la maa n niŋ kissi u dɔŋhiŋ hɛri naa biini,
mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi n ɛɛ wibii
maa hiŋ la sɔŋ biinii
ú ɛɛ guŋ,
nɛr la maa ge n niŋ du gbɔg,
mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi n ɛɛ wibii
maa hiŋ la sɔŋ biinii
ú hɛɛhzi guŋ.
Dikuubɛɛwiai, n daŋ suuh tɔɔrɔɔzi la maa n bɛrɛɛ,
n siwee wàá kaa ra naa.”
Chiŋfalii ni hɛrfalii wia
17Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ií na! N daŋ kaa ta
chiŋfalii ni hɛrfalii.
Nɛr maa wàá ka ra liizi
faala hora la wia kɔrai.
18Awia, ií gil ii bɔra ra pur saŋa maa,
dikuu kuna la min niŋ
ta la wia.
N daŋ kaa ta Jɛrusalɛm ú ɛɛ bɔsɔna bɔr,
ń nɛra ge ɛɛ bɔsɔna hina.
19N bɔra daŋ sɔɔni werge
dikuu Jɛrusalɛm
ni n nɛra la wia.
Wiraa waa ka du de
gɛɛ nɛra yirgi
ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa.
20Biifulli ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka siu,
ba nabɔnzi ge daŋ ɔɔ di
ba binni maga ka haa siu.
Di nɛr wa di binni kalfa ka siu,
biipɔlliirɛ bá yiruu.
Banla ge n waa binni kalfa
helle ka siu, amɔ, ba ɛɛwɔɔ
lugɔ baŋ see baa nua.
21A guŋ saŋa, nɛra daŋ ma diini di ra zuu,
di chɔɔzi daazi
di ra di a nɔna.
22Nɛra wàá ka ma diini, bá dɔŋahina lɛɛa ra zuu,
gɛɛ di duu kuna
nɛbɛl wa lɛɛa ra di.
A guŋ saŋa, n nɛra daŋ ɔɔ bini
gunla daa n ɔɔ bini la.
Banla miŋ lizɛɛ tɛɛ n hiŋ la
danna di ba huma tɔna.
23Ba kuuhni wàá ɛɛ pɛɛ.
Biizi la ge ban niŋ lul
wàá dɔɔ nyuchɔgii.
Ba ni ba naanna daŋ ɛɛ nɛra
Kɔraawiizi n kisseere.
24Awia, mɔɔ ka ba yiriŋ, di n teŋ sɛɛwɔ,
ban niŋ haa ra ŋɔ wia,
di n teŋ nuuwɔ.
25Munu ni pebii daŋ kpau di ra di,
bunyiŋ ra di koorii
alugɔ navarga,
nyɔɔ ge ɛɛ hɛrikuŋ diwee.
Kummaa wàá ka du u dɔŋ pira
gɛɛ di chɔguu
n bizennaniinanii la nyuu.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

english_text:
True Worship
1 The Lord said:
Heaven is my throne;
the earth is my footstool.
What kind of house
could you build for me?
In what place will I rest?
2I have made everything;
that's how it all came to be.
I, the Lord, have spoken.
The people I treasure most
are the humble—
they depend only on me
and tremble when I speak.
3You sacrifice oxen to me,
and you commit murder;
you sacrifice lambs to me
and dogs to other gods;
you offer grain to me
and pigs' blood to idols;
you burn incense to me
and praise your idols.
You have made your own choice
to do these disgusting things
that you enjoy so much.
4You refused to answer
when I called out;
you paid no attention
to my instructions.
Instead, you did what I hated,
knowing it was wrong.
Now I will punish you
in a way you dread the most.
The Lord Will Help Jerusalem
5If you tremble
when the Lord speaks,
listen to what he says:
“Some of your own people hate
and reject you because of me.
They make fun and say,
‘Let the Lord show his power!
Let us see him
make you truly happy.’
But those who say these things
will be terribly ashamed.”
6Do you hear that noise
in the city and those shouts
coming from the temple?
It is the Lord shouting
as he punishes his enemies.
7 Have you ever heard of a woman
who gave birth to a child
before having labor pains?
8Who ever heard of such a thing
or imagined it could happen?
Can a nation be born in a day
or come to life in a second?
Jerusalem is like a mother
who gave birth to her children
as soon as she was in labor.
9The Lord is the one
who makes birth possible.
And he will see that Zion
has many more children.
The Lord has spoken.
10If you love Jerusalem,
celebrate and shout!
If you were in sorrow
because of the city,
you can now be glad.
11She will nurse and comfort you,
just like your own mother,
until you are satisfied.
You will fully enjoy
her wonderful glory.
12The Lord has promised:
“I will flood Jerusalem
with the wealth of nations
and make the city prosper.
Zion will nurse you at her breast,
carry you in her arms,
and hold you in her lap.
13I will comfort you there
like a mother
comforting her child.”
14When you see this happen,
you will celebrate;
your strength will return
faster than grass can sprout.
Then everyone will know
that the Lord provides help
for his servants,
but he is angry
with his enemies.
15The Lord will come down
like a whirlwind
with his flaming chariots.
He will be furiously angry
and punish his enemies
with fire.
16The Lord's fiery sword
will bring justice
everywhere on this earth
and execute many people.
A Threat and a Promise
17Some of you get yourselves ready and go to a garden to worship a foreign goddess. You eat the meat of pigs, lizards, and mice. But I, the Lord, will destroy you for this.
18I know everything you do and think! The time has now come to bring together the people of every language and nation and to show them my glory 19by proving what I can do. I will send the survivors to Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Meshech, Tubal, Javan, and to the distant islands. I will send them to announce my wonderful glory to nations that have never heard about me.
20They will bring your relatives from the nations as an offering to me, the Lord. They will come to Jerusalem, my holy mountain, on horses, chariots, wagons, mules, and camels. It will be like the people of Israel bringing the right offering to my temple. 21I promise that some of them will be priests and others will be helpers in my temple. I, the Lord, have spoken.
22 I also promise that you will always have descendants and will never be forgotten, just as the new heavens and the new earth that I create will last forever. 23On the first day of each month and on each Sabbath, everyone will worship me. I, the Lord, have spoken.
24 My people will go out and look at the dead bodies of those who turned against me. The worms there never die, the fire never stops burning, and the sight of those bodies will be disgusting to everyone.
translation_text:
Seriya dii ni tamii wia
1Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Chinne n kara, hɛri genii n naazi chignibɔr,
awia, lee dia la hin niŋ
ma tɛŋ la duɛi?
N heezi bɔttɛ lee?
2Miŋ lɛi ta kuna naa maa,
a du dee?”
Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ!
Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ,
“N ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi banla n sɔɔni siwiire,
ba ɔɔ nuu n wiŋɔzii,
ba bɔra ra sa.
3Ka banla waa n kpa ba himmaa ŋmɛnizi
di ra nyiŋŋi wia la miŋ kiiwe,
di ba bɛl kpa nabal lizi mbusu tɛŋ,
guŋ ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ uŋ kpu newee,
unla maa ge n kpu pebii
lizi mbusu tɛŋ, ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ
uŋ ku nuahiŋ baŋaa,
unla maa ge n kpa mia di wa lizi mbusu tɛŋ,
ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ uŋ kpa
pereku chal di waari
n mbusu lizibɔr ni,
unla maa ge n fuuh
daahɛgsɔɔhsuma tɛŋ, ɛɛwɔɔ
lugɔ unna kuari vuga.
4Awia, n ge kipattɛ,
ń kpa hɛhchɔg ta ba ni,
di gil wii la baŋ kiiwe
chol ba ni,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n yir baabuu, ka nɛr maa waa sɛɛwɛ,
di ŋɔ wia tɛɛ baa,
ka ba vɛɛ nuui.
Ba ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ n sibɔɔ,
di lizi wia la
n wanna par.”
5Ii banla bɔra n na sa Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii wia,
ií ra nuu,
“Ii lulla la n hah ia,
di vɛɛ ia ta
dikuu n sɔŋ wia la,
ŋɔwɔɔrɛ chɛɛtɛ ni,
‘Gil Kɔraawiizi bagli u girme, yá na.
Ú gil ya na ii bɔsɔna!’
Ka ba daŋ di hiihzi.
6Ií ra nuu! A bolzeŋ maanii tɔ kɔɔi!
Ií ra nuu kɔɔi
Kɔraawiizi Dia la biini.
Kɔraawiizii ra turgi u dɔma
ba wichɔgaa kim.
7N bolzennaniinanii la ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ haaŋ n lullɛ manaŋ,
mɔɔ ka hilula lɔu.
8Anɛɛ ŋmɛnɛ n haa nuu kennei?
Gɛɛ anɛɛ ŋmɛnɛ
n haa na gunnɛi?
Ba daŋ wer lul
hɛri bɛl nɛra hɔpizikpaŋaa?
Ka Bolzeŋ Ziɔn waa,
hilula daŋ haŋ waa lɔu,
di u teŋ lul biizi.”
9Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“N daŋ gil u lul,
di wàá lulaa?
Di u lulaa wa hello, màá gil u lul huhzi.
10Ii banla maa n nɔŋŋi Jɛrusalɛm,
ií gil ii nuu maa bɔra sɔɔni.
Ii banla gba n wiiwe di ra tɛu la,
ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni
u wia werge maa.
11Ii daŋ di u daama suma
gunla bie n ɔɔ ɔzi
u maa il di piŋ la.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum labuu ŋɔ guŋ.”
12Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ,
“N daŋ gil bampirsɔna suu alugɔ muu,
hɛssi maa ge daama suu
alugɔ gɔŋ n suwee.
U daŋ gil u biizi ɔzi,
di lau baa kpogli,
di kpa baa sag u naazi.
13Gunla haaŋ n ɔɔ tig u bie bampirii la,
gunnɛ ń tig ii bampiree
Jɛrusalɛm wia.
14Di ii wa na guŋ, ii bɔra daŋ sɔɔni,
ii dɔɔ alaanfia nɛnnɛ.
Nɛra la maa n ɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi balaa daŋ na n hiinaa,
ka n baaŋ daŋ fuuh
n dɔma waa ni werge maa.”
15Na, Kɔraawiizi ra bau ni niŋ,
u torkozi ra chɔ
manamanaŋ alugɔ vem.
U baaŋ daŋ ba tɔɔrɔɔ ni ninlau ni
di wa chɔgi banla maa
n vɛɛ u wia la.
16Kɔraawiizi daŋ kpa niŋ ni tokobi
di di nɛra maa seriya.
Banla ge n niŋ chol
u seriya dii biini
daŋ du kpil, ú kpu baa.
17Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Banla baŋ lizi ba doŋa ha, ka ba wer zuu ba vuga kɔrni biini, di ra hee perekuzi, massi ani kuŋkiilaa la waa wia daŋ tuŋ nyaamm.
18N zum ba nfɛssi ni ba wiɛɛlaa maanii. Awia, n daŋ chaali durnya mɔɔrizi ni hɛssi maa nɛra, bá wa na n girme.
19N daŋ ɛɛ wii bɛl bagli baa bá zum, ka bir hum ba banla n niŋ haa dɔɔ miibɔɔ la baŋhina, bá la Taasis, Libia ani Lidia hina la n dɔɔ sɔŋ hozi tai biini ni Tubal, Giris ani muu baaŋ hɛssi la maa n haa waa n wia nuuwɛ gɛɛ di na n girme werge wia la be. Ba daŋ ga ŋɔ n girme wia tɛɛ a hɛssi naa hina maa. 20Ba daŋ kpogli i nɛra maa lii a hɛssi biine, di ba n bizennaniinanii la nyuu Jɛrusalɛm, bá ɛɛ lugɔ sunzaa tɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi. Ba daŋ tinni zagra, kauzi ani nyugmazi, baŋhina ge zuu torkozi ni anla zagra n na tɛrgi di ba. Ba daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ Izrɛl hina n kpa ba mbusu lizaa mia kuna du kuna baŋ lizi a doŋa ha biine, di ra ba Kɔraawiizi Dia la. 21N daŋ kpa baŋhina birgi n kizeehina ni Levi dee.” Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.
22Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Gunla chiŋfalii ni hɛrfalii min niŋ ta á du n be di hanna la la, gunnɛ ii naanna ni ii sɔŋ du n be, di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa. 23Baagufalii lugli hɔpizii maa ni Heezaa Hɔpizii maa, newea maa daŋ ɔɔ ba n be, di wa giŋŋi ra jaamiŋ. 24Di ba wa ɛɛ guŋ ka bir di ra lii, ba daŋ na banla n vɛɛ n wia la n birgi lalaa chɔɔgi. Sandule la n ninna di baa la ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá siu, niŋ la ge n ninna fuuh baa la ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá dim. Newea maa danna kɔɔ baa.”

english_text:
1My name is Jeremiah. I am a priest, and my father Hilkiah and everyone else in my family are from Anathoth in the territory of the Benjamin tribe. This book contains the things that the Lord told me to say. 2 The Lord first spoke to me in the thirteenth year that Josiah was king of Judah, 3 and he continued to speak to me during the rule of Josiah's son Jehoiakim. The last time the Lord spoke to me was in the fifth month of the eleventh year that Josiah's son Zedekiah was king. That was also when the people of Jerusalem were taken away as prisoners.
The Lord Chooses Jeremiah
4The Lord said:
5“Jeremiah, I am your Creator,
and before you were born,
I chose you to speak for me
to the nations.”
6I replied, “I'm not a good speaker, Lord, and I'm too young.”
7“Don't say you're too young,” the Lord answered. “If I tell you to go and speak to someone, then go! And when I tell you what to say, don't leave out a word! 8I promise to be with you and keep you safe, so don't be afraid.”
9The Lord reached out his hand, then he touched my mouth and said, “I am giving you the words to say, 10and I am sending you with authority to speak to the nations for me. You will tell them of doom and destruction, and of rising and rebuilding again.”
11The Lord showed me something in a vision. Then he asked, “What do you see, Jeremiah?”
I answered, “A branch of almonds that ripen early.”
12“That's right,” the Lord replied, “and I always rise early to keep a promise.”
13Then the Lord showed me something else and asked, “What do you see now?”
I answered, “I see a pot of boiling water in the north, and it's about to spill out toward us.”
14The Lord said:
I will pour out destruction
all over the land.
15Just watch while I send
for the kings of the north.
They will attack and capture
Jerusalem and other towns,
then set up their thrones
at the gates of Jerusalem.
16I will punish my people,
because they are guilty
of turning from me
to worship idols.
17Jeremiah, get ready!
Go and tell the people
what I command you to say.
Don't be frightened by them,
or I will make you terrified
while they watch.
18My power will make you strong
like a fortress
or a column of iron
or a wall of bronze.
You will oppose all of Judah,
including its kings and leaders,
its priests and people.
19They will fight back,
but they won't win.
I, the Lord, give my word—
I won't let them harm you.
translation_text:
1Baal bɛllɛ ba faa ra yir Hilkia, u ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ di lii Anatɔf n du Bɛnjamin hɛri. U biibaal Jɛrɛmia wiŋɔzii keŋ. 2Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ wiarɛ tɛu Juda Koori Amɔn biibaal Jɔsia kora dii binni fidaahorohiŋ biini. 3Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ wia tɛu di lii Juda Koori Jɔsia biibaal Jɛhɔyakim kora dii saŋa guŋŋ di ga hel Koori Jɔsia biibaal Zɛdɛkia kora dii binni fidikpaŋ, baaguzi anuehiŋ biini. A saŋaa ba faa lauri Jɛrusalɛm hina kaali hɛrduma la.
Kɔraawiizi n yir Jɛrɛmia wia
4Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ mìŋ́ Jɛrɛmia be,
5“Mɔɔ ka n mai di du i maa hia, n zumiibuu.
N liziibuu tɛɛ n hiŋ,
mɔɔ ka ba lulii,
N liziibuu í ɛɛ n dɔgtɛɛ
tɛɛ hɛssi hina maa.”
6Denii n ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa, n ɛɛ bichalaa, maa wiŋɔzi zummɛ.”
7Ka Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be, “Gilɛɛ ŋɔ lugɔ bichalaa hiŋ. A dɛkkɔɔ í la nɛr la maa be minna humii, di ga ŋɔ gunla maa miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ la. 8Gilɛɛ ra ɔm baa, dikuubɛɛwiai, n du i benii, n daŋ lɛɛi. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”
9Denii Kɔraawiizi tɛr u nonii di gbɔgzi n nua, ka ŋɔ n be, “Filaŋkeŋwaa, n kpa n wiŋɔzii di du i nua. 10Na, n liziibuu zinaa, í dɔɔ hɛssi hina ni kossi maa fɔŋŋa, í wer kpuzaa, di purgaa, di chɔgaa di wigzaa, di kaa maa gɛɛ di gil a chi lugɔ kunduulaa.”
11Kɔraawiizi pɛɛziŋ, “Jɛrɛmia, bɛɛ i ra na naanɛi?”
N ŋɔ, “Daa bɛl banna yir almɔn kelle n na.”
12Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “I nawɔɔrɛ nɛnnɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, n na nyiŋŋuu ń na lugɔ n wiŋɔzi su a magaa.”
13Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ n be, “Bɛɛ i ra na naanɛi?”
N bir ŋɔ, “N na viire wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag, uŋ hɔŋŋɛ di ra bɔr, di kuli ba yaa be.”
14Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ n be, “Hɛhchɔg daŋ lii wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag di wa chol nɛra la maa n du hɛri naa ni. 15N na nyiŋŋuu ń chaali kossi la maa n du wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag.
Ba koora daŋ ba di wa chiŋŋi ba koorikassi,
Jɛrusalɛm dominuuzenaa.
Ba daŋ wa bar u koŋlaa
ani Juda bolzenaa maa.
16N daŋ tɛr n nɛra digna,
dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia.
Ba vɛɛmbuu ta,
ka lizi mbusuzi ra tɛɛ vuga,
di ra jaami kuna la
ba himmaa n kuarɛɛ.
17Izi ɛɛ sirya di ga ŋɔ ba be gunla maa miŋ ŋɔ i be naa. Gilɛɛ gil ba wia dɔɔi ɔnsii, i bɔra ra sa. Di guŋ lɛi, n himmaa daŋ kpa ɔnsii ni bɔsai ha i ni, ba see. 18Zinaa n gillɔɔ i ɛɛ lugɔ bolzeŋkpeg, di du kpeg lugɔ lugbii ligii ani danyɛ koŋlii, í wer chi yoo Juda koora, ba nabɔnzi, ba kizeehina ani a hɛri hina maa. 19Ba daŋ wa fɔɔi ni kalu, ka ba wàá wer kpeglii, dikuubɛɛwiai, n du i benii, n daŋ lɛɛi. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

english_text:
Israel's Unfaithfulness
1The Lord told me 2to go to Jerusalem and tell everyone that he had said:
When you were my young bride,
you loved me and followed me
through the barren desert.
3You belonged to me alone,
like the first part of the harvest,
and I severely punished
those who mistreated you.
4Listen, people of Israel,
5and I, the Lord, will speak.
I was never unfair
to your ancestors,
but they left me
and became worthless
by following worthless idols.
6Your ancestors refused
to ask for my help,
though I had rescued them
from Egypt
and led them through
a treacherous, barren desert,
where no one lives
or dares to travel.
7I brought you here to my land,
where food is abundant,
but you made my land filthy
with your sins.
8The priests who teach my laws
don't care to know me.
Your leaders rebel against me;
your prophets
give messages from Baal
and worship false gods.
The Lord Accuses His People
9I will take you to court
and accuse you
and your descendants
* 10of a crime that no nation
has ever committed before.
Just ask anyone, anywhere,
from the eastern deserts
to the islands in the west.
11You will find that no nation
has ever abandoned its gods
even though they were false.
I am the true and glorious God,
but you have rejected me
to worship idols.
12Tell the heavens
to tremble with fear!
13You, my people, have sinned
in two ways—
you have rejected me, the source
of life-giving water,
and you've tried to collect water
in cracked and leaking pits
dug in the ground.
14People of Israel,
you weren't born slaves;
you were captured in war.
15Enemies roared like lions
and destroyed your land;
towns lie burned and empty.
16Soldiers from the Egyptian towns
of Memphis and Tahpanhes
have cracked your skulls.
17It's all your own fault!
You stopped following me,
the Lord your God,
18and you trusted the power
of Egypt and Assyria.
19Your own sins will punish you,
because it was a bitter mistake
for you to reject me
without fear of punishment.
I, the Lord All-Powerful,
have spoken.
20Long ago you left me
and broke all ties between us,
refusing to be my servant.
Now you worship other gods
by having sex
on hilltops or in the shade
of large trees.
21You were a choice grapevine,
but you have become
a wild, useless vine.
Israel Is Stained with Guilt
22The Lord said:
People of Israel,
you are stained with guilt,
and no soap or bleach
can wash it away.
23You deny your sins
and say, “We aren't unclean.
We haven't worshiped Baal.”
But think about what you do
in Hinnom Valley.
You run back and forth
like young camels,
as you rush to worship one idol
after another.
24You are a female donkey
sniffing the desert air,
wanting to mate
with just anyone.
You are an easy catch!
25Your shoes are worn out,
and your throat is parched
from running here and there
to worship foreign gods.
“Stop!” I shouted,
but you replied, “No!
I love those gods too much.”
26You and your leaders
are more disgraceful
than thieves—
you and your kings,
your priests and prophets
27worship stone idols
and sacred poles
as if they had created you
and had given you life.
You have rejected me,
but when you're in trouble,
you cry to me for help.
28Go cry to the gods you made!
There should be enough of them
to save you,
because Judah has as many gods
as it has towns.
Israel Rebels against the Lord
29The Lord said to Israel:
You accuse me of not saving you,
but I say you have rebelled.
30I tried punishing you,
but you refused
to come back to me,
and like fierce lions
you killed my prophets.
31Now listen to what I say!
Did I abandon you in the desert
or surround you with darkness?
You are my people,
yet you have told me,
“We'll do what we want,
and we refuse
to worship you!”
32A bride could not forget
to wear her jewelry
to her wedding,
but you have forgotten me
day after day.
33You are so clever
at finding lovers
that you could give lessons
to a prostitute.
34You killed innocent people
for no reason at all.
And even though their blood
can be seen on your clothes,
35you claim to be innocent,
and you want me to stop
being angry with you.
So I'll take you to court,
and we'll see who is right.
36When Assyria let you down,
you quickly ran to Egypt,
but you'll find no help there,
37and you will leave
in great sadness.
I won't let you find help
from those you trust.
translation_text:
Izrɛl hina n vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi wia
1Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be, 2“Izi la ga sii tɛɛ Jɛrusalɛm hina, di ŋɔ,
‘N na liizi gunla ii wia n faa dɔɔ wibii ii toloo saŋaa,
gunla iiŋ faa nɔŋŋiŋ saŋa la
yaa n luglɛɛ kpa dɔŋa,
ii hiŋiŋ hɛribɔduma biini,
hɛri la baŋ waa kummaa
duuwe u biini la.
3Izrɛl hina, ii faa ɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi nɛnanaananaarɛ,
di ɛɛ lugɔ
n lugli pattikuna.
Banla maa n faa ra tɔɔri ia la di bilchɔgrɛ,
aŋ faa tɛr ba dignaa,
ka kpa hɛhchɔg ta ba ni.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.’ ”
4Ií ra nuu Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii,
Izrɛl hina dizi maa
n ɛɛ Jekɔb naanna.
5Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ,
“Bɛɛ wichɔgiirɛ ii mɛɛwaa na n ni,
guŋ gil ba bir har kpunnɛi?
Ba ra kuari vuga la n waa tɔna dɔɔwɛɛ,
guŋ gil ba ge
himmaa nyaa tɔna.
6Ba waa wette pɛɛzi,
‘Lee Kɔraawiizi la n lizi
yaa lii Ijip hɛri la duɛi,
unla n kpogli
yaa ga hɛribɔduma biini,
hɛri la n dɔɔ hɛɛhriichaa werge,
hɛrhilii ni bɔbiri werge la,
bɔr la nɛr maa n waa zuu,
haali nɛr maa n wàá sɛɛ
ga de gba lai?’
7N kpogli iabuu ba hɛri la n summɛ biini,
ii wa di u daanɔna
ni diunanaa.
Ka ii ba wa lawuu chɔgi,
di gil n kapɛttɛ kuna maa
birgi kuŋkiilaa.
8N kizeehina waa pɛɛzɛɛ,
‘Lee Kɔraawiizi duɛi?’
Banla n na bagli n Gbɔgni la,
wan zummɛ.
Sitɔɔra la gba vɛɛ n nua di ra gbɛlliŋ,
N dɔgtɛɛzi kpa
vug Baal sɔŋ di ra ŋɔ wia,
di ra kuari vuga la
n waa tɔna dɔɔwɛ.
9Awia, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi
daŋ kpa wia chug ia.
N daŋ kpa wia chug,
ii ni ii naanna maa.
10Izi gi di la Saiprɔs n du wiicholii muuzeŋ baambaaŋ hɛri nua,
di ga chi ka binni na,
di hum bá la Kɛda hɛri
n du wiifurii,
di ga pessi na,
i daŋ na lugɔ a keŋ
ŋmɛnɛ maa haa waa ɛɛwɛ.
11Hɛri maa hina ŋmɛnɛ maa waa sɛɛwɛ gil ba vuga kuaraa,
haali aŋ waa
tɔna maa dɔɔwɛ gba.
Ka n nɛra kpa n girme
chɛr vuga la
n waa tɔna maa dɔɔwɛ.
12Awia, n ŋɔ chiŋ benii lugɔ ú zigli ni ɔnsii werge,
a tiruu, ú nua kpu.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.
13Wichɔgaa anɛɛrɛ n nɛra ɛɛ,
Ba vɛɛ miŋ
unla n na tɛɛ bule la
n dɔɔ miibɔɔrɛ,
ka ki ba himmaa kɔlɔnzi,
kɔlɔnzi la n pergee,
nii wàá wer chɔɔ a biine.
14Izrɛl hina, ii ɛɛ balaarɛ
gɛɛ ba lul iabuu yomai?
Ka ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ii dɔma
wa lauri ia gunnɛi?
15Ii dɔma ra pogzi
ii ninɛɛ alugɔ bunyinzi.
Ba gillɔɔ ii hɛri birgi hɛribɔduma,
ii bola purgi chɔɔgi,
di birgi diŋgelli.
16Haali Mɛmfis ni Tapanɛs hina laallɔɔra,
gba faa fir iabuu
di gbaari ii nyuuni,
ii di hiihzi.
17Ii himmaa lɛi gillɛ wia naa wa huuzi ia,
dikuu iiŋ vɛɛ mìŋ́
Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum wia,
haali miŋ faa tɔ ii see laa?
18Filaŋkeŋ, bɛɛ wiarɛ ii la Ijip hɛri,
ií ga nyɔɔ Muu Naal niiyɛi?
Bɛɛ wiarɛ ii la Asiiria hɛri ge
ií ga nyɔɔ
Muu Yufretis niiyɛi?
19Ii daŋ di tɔɔrɔɔ, dikuu ii biinikpola wia,
iiŋ bir har kpuŋ la genii
niŋ tɛɛ ia bilchɔg.
Ii daŋ na gunla aŋ kpolle di chum,
dikuu iiŋ vɛɛ
mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la
iinna hum la ta wia,
ii waa kaa dɔɔ wibii n be.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ labuu ŋɔ guŋ.
20Izrɛl hina, faala maa,
ii vɛɛ n dɔɔra sɛɛirɛ,
di vɛɛ n nua hiŋaa
ni n jaamaa.
Ka ra kuari vuga la n na tɛɛ lulaa,
giŋgimiizeŋ maa nyuu
ni daazeŋ maa zɛɛ.
21Ii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ grepu daa la n wesse,
n kpa ia chɔɔzi, ií nɔŋ nɔnnanaa.
Ka bɛɛ wiarɛ ii bir har kpuŋ,
di birgi lugɔ daachɔgaa
n waa tɔna dɔɔwɛi?
22Haali di ii kpa biikoo
gɛɛ fanfanni werge gba,
di sɔ lugɔ i bɔra lii nɛnnɛ,
dikuu ii wichɔgaa wia,
ka ii haa dɔɔ bilchɔgrɛ n be.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa labuu ŋɔ guŋ.
23Ii daŋ wer ŋɔ lugɔ ii waa doŋŋe,
ii waa vug Baala kuarɛaa?
Na gunla iiŋ ɛɛwɛ waluu biini,
ií binni ii wiɛɛlaa hiŋ na.
Ii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nyugmaniina,
n chɔwɛɛ di ra bar.
24Ii kaa ɛɛu lugɔ pir kauniina
n mani hɛribɔduma.
Di u waa deezi,
anɛɛ n niŋ wer lawuuwɛi?
U bal la maa n na nyiŋŋi u deezuu,
waa ɔɔ kaa di dɔgnya,
dikuu uŋ teŋ ɛɛ sirya wia.
25Izrɛl hina, ií gilɛɛ chɔ ra nyiŋŋi vuga,
ií naapezi di tuŋ,
ií loobee ge maa hil.
Ka ii ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, ‘Yaa wàá ka wer bir har,
yaa nɔŋŋi hɛrdumazi vugaa,
a bɔttɛ ya nyiŋŋi.’
26Gunla ŋmɛɛŋ n ɔɔ di hiihzi di ba wa lawuu la,
gunnɛ Izrɛl hina ni ba koora,
ba nabɔnzenaa,
Kɔraawiizi kizeehina ni Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛzi maa,
di hiihzi.
27Ba ŋɔ daa benii,
‘Hinuu yaa mɛɛ,’
di kaa ŋɔ bii ge be,
‘Hinuu yaa maa.’
Ba bir hattɛ kpuŋ,
ka di ba wa du
siaahmu biini waa,
ba ɔɔ ŋɔ dí n wa lɛɛ baa.
28Lee vuga la iiŋ kuarɛɛ tɛɛ iihinaa la duɛi?
Di ii wa du siaahmu biini,
ií gil a ba wa lɛɛ ia,
di a daŋ wer.
Juda hina, ii vuga kpillɔɔ
gunla iiŋ dɔɔ
bolzenaa kpila la.
29Bɛɛ wiarɛ ii ra pag n ninɛi?
Ii ɛɛ dignikpega hinaa.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.
30N tɛr ii dignaa,
ka guŋ waa ia hiinee,
di gil ii wia deŋli.
Ii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bunyinzi lɔzi n na kpu,
di lau n dɔgtɛɛzi kpu.
31Izrɛl hina, ií ra nuu gunla mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi n na ŋɔ.
N ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ hɛribɔduma tɛɛ ia
gɛɛ hɛri la n biree
di chum wergei?
Ka bɛɛwiarɛ ii ŋɔ ii wàá ka bir ba n be,
ka ra ɛɛ ii kiparɛi?
32Toloori haa suuh
u baŋaa kuŋ,
nonibisig ani u gbitti dui wia
gɛɛ haŋfalii n suuh u
bɔmbɔga laalaa?
Ka n nɛra waa suuh n wiarɛ,
hɔpizikpila n waa
maga dɔɔwɛ gba.
33Ii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ baala ni haana
n zum dɔŋa
nyiŋŋaare werge!
Haali hahchɔgaa gba
helli di ra lii ii be.
34Nyaara ni banla n waa chɔgri dɔɔwɛ,
