nuu dɔɔ wiarɛ.
U ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, ‘Ii waa wibii ni nɔŋŋaa dɔɔwɛ,
ii waa zummɛ
mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi
n du de gba.
2Nuuseei, kara kannaa, nɛkpui,
ŋmɛɛri ani sɛnsɛŋ bɛnnɛ
du ii be.
Di ɔɔ ŋɔ nuuzi ka vɛɛ a hiŋaa,
di ɔɔ ra kpu nɛra
di ra hiŋzi dɔŋa ni.
3A guŋ wia, a hɛri ra hiluu,
nɛra ni kuna la maa
n du u ni la siuzi,
sela, zumbizi
ani muuzeŋ biini
nyinni maa ra siuzi.’ ”
4Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Nɛr maa gilɛɛ ra tɛɛ
u dɔŋhiŋ bilchɔg
gɛɛ di wàá pag u dɔŋhiŋ ni,
dikuubɛɛwiai, ii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ
nɛra la n na pag
n kizeehina ninɛɛ.
5Ii ɔɔ ra lɔɔzi naazii bɔchaaŋ ni hamuŋa maa,
n dɔgtɛɛzi jaa ii ni
di ra lɔɔzi naazi.
Awia, n daŋ chɔgi Izrɛl la n ɛɛ ii maa la.
6N nɛra wia chɔkkɔɔ dikuu
baŋ waa nunzuma
dɔɔwɛ wia.
Dikuu n kizeehina n vɛɛŋ wia,
n gba vɛɛ baabuu lugɔ
ba waa kaa ɛɛ n kizeehina.
Baŋ vɛɛ n Gbɔgni wia,
n gba daŋ vɛɛ ba biizi.
7Gunla n kizeehina n na wazi la,
gunnɛ ba wichɔgaa ɛɛi
n be ra wazi,
ba ɔɔ kpa ba girmee
di ra chɛr hiihzi.
8Ba ga n nɛra wichɔgaa ɛɛi ninɛɛ di ra birgi dɔɔna,
di ra nyiŋŋi ba ra ɛɛ
wichɔgaa saŋa maa.
9N kizeehina daŋ di tɔɔrɔɔ alugɔ n nɛra.
N daŋ tɛr ba maa digna,
di turgi baa bá wiɛɛlaa kim.
10Ba daŋ ɔɔ di, ka ba wàá piŋ,
di ra sɛm, ka ba wàá wazi,
dikuu baŋ vɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi,
ka ra sɛm
11ni simbinii ani u falii nyɔɔi wia,
anla n ɔɔ kpu ba nfɛssi,
ba waa kaa ra zum
12n nɛra wia zɛɛzi la.
Ba ɔɔ jaa la vuga la baŋ sɛɛhwɛ benii
di gaa pɛɛzi bá zum
ba wia zɛɛzi,
daarɛ ɔɔ bagli baa a zɛɛzi.
Ba kpa bahinaarɛ tɛɛ vuga,
ba waa wibii dɔɔwɛ tɛŋ.
13Ba ɔɔ ra lizi mbusuzii bizenaa nyuuni,
di ra fuuh daahɛgsɔɔhsuma
di ra lizi mbusuzi
giŋgimee nyuuni
ni daazenaa la n dɔɔ
bɔsɔna nɛnnɛ zɛɛzi.
Awiarɛ ba biihambizi birgi sɛnsɛnna,
ba biibaala haana ra sɛm la.
14Màá tɛr ba biihaana digna
di ba birgi sɛnsɛnna
gɛɛ di tɛr ba biibaala digna
di ba sɛmmɔ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, ba baala himmaa
ra chɔɔ sɛnsɛnnaa,
ba ni vuga kuaribɔra sɛnsɛnna
kpau ra lizi mbusuzi,
nɛra la n waa wia
zɛɛ zummɛ daŋ siu.
15Izrɛl hina, haali iin na sɛm gba,
ka ií gilɛɛ gil Juda hina
waa di bilchɔg.
Ií gilɛɛ waa la Gilgal,
ií gilɛɛ waa la bol la
banna yir Bɛf Avɛn la.
Di gilɛɛ wa kpa
mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ
di ra ŋɔ nuuzi.
16Izrɛl hina kpoŋŋoo
lugɔ nalor n kpoŋŋe.
Ɛrɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi jaa ɛɛ di dɛɛzi baa
alugɔ pebizi n du
kooree biini di ra dei?
17Izrɛl hina kpa bahinaarɛ tɛɛ vuga,
ií suuh ba wia!
18Saŋa la baŋ haŋ wa nyɔɔ siŋ werge,
ba sɛnsɛŋ ɔɔ nyaŋŋuu,
ba koora nɔŋŋi hiihzi wiɛɛlaa werge
kaali girme wiɛɛlaa.
19Vem daŋ wa paa baa kaali,
hiihzi kpu baa dikuu
mbusuzi la baŋ lizɛɛ
ra tɛɛ vuga la wia.”

english_text:
Israel and Judah Will Be Judged
The Lord said:
1Listen, you priests!
Pay attention, Israel!
Listen, you members
of the royal family.
Justice was your duty.
But at Mizpah and Mount Tabor
you trapped the people.
2At the place of worship
you were a treacherous pit,
and I will punish you.
3Israel, I know all about you,
and because of your unfaithfulness,
I find you unacceptable.
4Your evil deeds are the reason
you won't return to me,
your Lord God.
And your constant craving for sex
keeps you from knowing me.
5Israel, your pride
testifies to your guilt;
it makes you stumble,
and Judah stumbles too.
6You offer sheep and cattle
as sacrifices to me,
but I have turned away
and refuse to be found.
7You have been unfaithful
to me, your Lord;
you have had children
by prostitutes.
So at the New Moon Festival,
you and your crops
will be destroyed.
The Lord Warns Israel and Judah
8Give a warning on the trumpet!
Let it be heard in Gibeah,
Ramah, and sinful Bethel.
Benjamin, watch out!
9I, the Lord, will punish
and wipe out Israel.
This is my solemn promise
to every tribe of Israel.
10Judah's leaders are like crooks
who move boundary markers;
that's why I will flood them
with my anger.
11Israel was brutally crushed.
They got what they deserved
for worshiping useless idols.
12Now I, the Lord,
will fill Israel with maggots
and make Judah rot.
13When Israel and Judah saw
their sickness and wounds,
Israel asked help from Assyria
and its mighty king.
But the king cannot cure them
or heal their wounds.
14So I'll become a fierce lion
attacking Israel and Judah.
I'll snatch and carry off
what I want,
and no one can stop me.
15Then I'll return to my temple
until they confess their guilt
and worship me,
until they are desperate
and beg for my help.
translation_text:
Izrɛl hina seriya dii wia
1Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “N kizeehina, ií ra nuu!
Izrɛl hina,
ií keŋŋi digna nɛnnɛ!
Kooridiire, ií ra nuu!
Seriya naabuu ń di ia.
Ii faa ɛɛ sidɛɛrɛ Mizpa,
di faa ɛɛ asau baŋ yaazɛɛ
Bizeŋ Tabɔ nyuu.
2Dignikpega hina ra kpuuzi nɛraa werge.
N daŋ tɛrgi ba maa digna.
3N zum Izrɛl hina wiimaanii,
ba wiimaa waa suahwɛ n ni.
Izrɛl hina jaa birgi sɛnsɛnnaa,
di chɔg n be.
4Dikuu ba wiɛɛlaa wia,
ba wàá ka wer bir ba
mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la
banna hum la be.
Ba bampiree lau sɛnsɛnnɛ werge,
ba waa kaa zum lugɔ n du denii.
5Izrɛl hina barabara ra di ba himmaa daansɛɛrɛ.
Ba wichɔgaa gil ba ra
lɔɔzi naazi di ra chogli,
Ba ni Juda hina kpau
di ra chogli.
6Di ba wa kpa ba nauna ni peeza ba,
bá wa lizi mbusu n be,
ba wàá naŋ,
dikuu miŋ lii ba be wia.
7Ba waa wibii dɔɔwɛ n be,
sɛnsɛŋ biizii ba ra lul.
Awia, filaŋkennaa, ba Baagufalaa Hɔpizizenaa dii
daŋ chɔgi ba ni
ba kooni maa nyaamm.
8Ií huuh bensunoniina lii bolzeŋ Gibia!
Ií huuh bensuno
lii bolzeŋ Rama!
Ií lɔ laal wile lii Bɛf Avɛn!
Ií tɔ see, Bɛnjamin dee baala!
9Izrɛl hɛri daŋ chɔɔ pɛɛ
di lii hɔpizii la min niŋ
tɛr ba digna la.
N daŋ sii gunla n niŋ ɛɛ
Izrɛl hina dizi biini,
wibii maa.
10Juda sitɔɔra ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ ŋmɛɛna,
di ra tuzi hɛssi
magbɔɔni bia.
N daŋ kpa n baaŋ la
di tɛr ba digna alugɔ niizeŋ
n ɔɔ wa chɔgi bɔr guŋ la.
11Ba ra sunni Izrɛl hinaa,
di ra fini baa seriya dii biini,
dikuu baŋ faa aah siwii di ra
nyiŋŋi hiinaa vuga be wia.
12N daŋ kpu Izrɛl hina,
di tuŋ Juda hina ge.
13Izrɛl hina n wa na ba wiila,
Juda hina ge na ba ŋmɛra la,
denii Izrɛl hina bir la Asiiria
koorizeŋ be di gaa
nyiŋŋi hiinaa.
Ka waa wette chaa baa,
gɛɛ di gil ba ŋmɛra tuŋ.
14N daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ bunyiŋ
Izrɛl ni Juda hina be.
N daŋ chuuri baa ka kaali.
N daŋ lauri baa kaali,
ka nɛr maa wàá wer
mɔgli baa ha.
15Ka ń jaa bir kaali n duuribɔr,
guŋŋ di ga hel saŋa la
ban niŋ sɛɛ chɔgri.
Denii bá jaa aah siwii di nyiŋŋi n bɔr,
ba dɔgnya hiŋ dii biini.”

english_text:
The Lord's People Speak
1Let's return to the Lord.
He has torn us to shreds,
but he will bandage our wounds
and make us well.
2In two or three days
he will heal us
and restore our strength
that we may live with him.
3Let's do our best
to know the Lord.
His coming is as certain
as the morning sun;
he will refresh us like rain
renewing the earth
in the springtime.
The Lord Speaks to Israel and Judah
4People of Israel and Judah,
what can I do with you?
Your love for me disappears
more quickly than mist
or dew at sunrise.
5That's why I slaughtered you
with the words
of my prophets.
That's why my judgments blazed
like the dawning sun.
6 I'd rather for you to be faithful
and to know me
than to offer sacrifices.
7At a place named Adam,
you betrayed me
by breaking our agreement.
8Everyone in Gilead is evil;
your hands are stained
with the blood of victims.
9You priests are like a gang
of robbers in ambush.
On the road to Shechem
you murder and commit
other horrible crimes.
10I have seen a terrible thing
in Israel—
you are unfaithful
and unfit to worship me.
11People of Judah,
your time is coming too.
The Lord Wants To Help Israel
I, the Lord, would like to make
my nation prosper again
translation_text:
Izrɛl hina n waa sɛɛwɛ bá gil ba wichɔgaa wia
1Izrɛl hina ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Ií gil ya bir
la Kɔraawiizi be.
U tɔɔri yaabuu,
ka u daŋ chaa yaa.
U du yaabuu pira,
ka u daŋ vɔɔzi yaa ŋmɛra.
2U daŋ bir gil ya dɔɔ alaanfia hɔpizaa anɛɛ har,
hɔpizaa ahoro hɔl,
ú bir lɛɛ yaa,
ya du u be.
3Ií gil ya zum lugɔ Kɔraawiizi du denii,
ií gil ya fir yaa hinaa
di zumuu.
Gunla wiizi n haŋ du de di ra fur la,
gunnɛ ú ba.
U daŋ ba yaa be alugɔ sazau dooŋ,
di ba alugɔ yuuliŋ dooŋ n ɔɔ
wa sɔɔni hɛri nɛnnɛ la.”
4Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Izrɛl hina, bɛɛ ń kpa ia ɛɛi?
Juda hina, bɛɛ ń kpa ia ɛɛi?
Ii nɔŋŋaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ chɔɔzinkɔɔl,
di ɛɛ lugɔ chɔɔzinŋmɛnii
n waa ɔɔ birgi ka hil la.
5Awiarɛ n kpa n amaniye tɛɛ n dɔgtɛɛzi,
bá wa di ia seriya,
di kpu ia la.
Wii la minna nyiŋŋi ii be la
chaanɔɔrɛ nɛnnɛ.
6Nɛsunaa dɔɔi wiarɛ n na nyiŋŋi kaali mbusu lizaa,
di ra nyiŋŋi lugɔ
n nɛra zumiŋ kaali
mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa.
7Ba chɔgi n ni baa nuukpaŋ labuu lii Andama hɛri,
ba faa waa wibii dɔɔwɛ
n be de.
8Biinikpola hina ni nɛkpuura
bɛnnɛ su bolzeŋ
Giliad biini maa.
9Kɔraawiizi kizeehina ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ ŋmɛɛna
n ɔɔ ga suah ŋmɛnikɛraa,
di ra so nɛra saga.
Haali ba ra kpu nɛra ŋmɛnɛɛ la n chɔɔwɛ
di ra la bolzeŋ Sɛkɛm,
di kutti ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa la
n ɛɛ hiihzi wia.
10N na wichumaa
Izrɛl hina biini.
Ba ra kuari vugaa
di chɔg bahinaa
mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi be.
11N dau saŋaa ń tɛr
Juda hina gba digna,
dikuu wia la
banna ɛɛ la wia.”

english_text:
1and to heal its wounds.
But then I see the crimes
in Israel and Samaria.
Everyone is deceitful;
robbers roam the streets.
2No one realizes
that I have seen their sins
surround them like a flood.
3The king and his officials
take great pleasure
in their sin and deceit.
4Everyone burns with desire—
they are like coals in an oven,
ready to burst into flames.
5On the day their king
was crowned,
his officials got him drunk,
and he joined
in their foolishness.
6Their anger is a fire
that smolders all night,
then flares up at dawn.
7They are flames
destroying their leaders.
And their kings are powerless;
none of them trust me.
8The people of Israel
have mixed with foreigners;
they are a thin piece of bread
scorched on one side.
9They don't seem to realize
how weak and feeble they are;
their hair has turned gray,
while foreigners rule.
10I am the Lord, their God,
but in all of their troubles
their pride keeps them
from returning to me.
No Help from Foreign Nations
The Lord said:
11Israel is a senseless bird,
fluttering back and forth
between Egypt and Assyria.
12But I will catch them in a net
as hunters trap birds;
I threatened to punish them,
and indeed I will.
13Trouble and destruction
will be their reward
for rejecting me.
I would have rescued them,
but they told me lies.
14They don't really pray to me;
they just howl in their beds.
They have rejected me for Baal
and slashed themselves,
in the hope that Baal
will bless their crops.
15I taught them what they know,
and I made them strong.
Now they plot against me
16and refuse to obey.
They are more useless
than a crooked arrow.
Their leaders will die in war
for saying foolish things.
Egyptians will laugh at them.
translation_text:
1Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ, “Saŋa la mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi n ɔɔ wàá nyiŋŋi n chaa n nɛra Izrɛl hina,
di gil bá kaa dɔɔ daama la,
ba wichɔgaa ni ba biinikpola
bɛnnɛ n na na.
Ba ra fini dɔŋaa,
di kuugi dominuuzi
zuu diini ra ŋmɛɛ,
di ra ŋmɛɛ nɛra bol biini,
ŋmɛnizenaa biine.
2Ba waa zummɛ
lugɔ n na liizi
ba wichɔgaa maanii.
Ba wichɔgaa tɔ ba ninɛɛ,
N ɔɔ ra naabuu
saŋa maa.
3Ba kpa biinikpolaa di ra dar koori,
di kpa kara di ra dar
ba nabɔnzi.
4Ba maa ɛɛ sɛnsɛnnaa,
ba wiɛɛlaa ɛɛ lugɔ niŋ n du
paanuu ɔɔzi bɔr
di ra lau zagzagzag,
a paanuɔɔzi waa kaa
dɔɔ lugɔ u kuaruu du
di ra la saŋa la
un niŋ ŋmir a paanuu sau
á wa izi la.
5Yaa koori hindii hɔpizii hɔl,
u ni a nabɔnzi maa
nyɔɔ sinnɛ dɛɛzi,
di birgi chɛɛtɛ kuna.
6Ba wiɛɛlaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ paanuu ɔɔzi bɔr,
ba suah ta ba koori jina.
Ba baana ra lau niŋ hamuŋa maa,
di ra lau alugɔ
ninlau chɔɔzi ni.
7Ba maa kpa ba baaŋfuuihchɔgaarɛ
kpu ba nabɔnzi,
di kpuuzi ba koora maa kpaŋkpaŋa,
ka bɛl maa wan
suŋŋɛɛ lugɔ ń hiinuu.
8Izrɛl hina koozi hɛssi la n bar baa la hina ninɛɛ.
Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ baŋ ɔɔzi
paanuu ka waa biiwɛ nɛnnɛ.
9Hɔɔhra ni dɛllaa gillɔɔ ba nyaa fɔŋŋa,
ka ba waa guŋ zummɛ.
Ba hɔpizaa waa kaa du kpil,
ka ba waa zummɛ.
10Izrɛl hina barabara ra di ba daansɛɛrɛ,
ka annii maa waa gillɛ
ba bir ba mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la be
gɛɛ di nyiŋŋi n bɔr gba.
11Izrɛl hina ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ komma,
ba daraa waa kpol,
ba nyaa nfɛrɛɛ,
di ra yir Ijip hina,
di chɔ ra la Asiiria hina be
bá wa hiini baa.
12Di ba ra kaali, n daŋ ta asau tɔ ba ni,
di tɛr baa ha alugɔ zumbizi.
Di n wa nuuwɔ banna chaali,
n daŋ lau baa.
13Tɔɔrɔɔrɛ huuzi baa,
dikuu baŋ leuwe
lii n be wia!
Ba daŋ kpu baa,
dikuu ba dignikpega wia!
N na nyiŋŋuu ń lɛɛ baa,
ka ba ra ŋɔ kara wiŋɔzi
di ra du n ni.
14Ba wanna suŋŋi ni biinihuŋŋu,
ka chogli di ra wii
alugɔ nɛra la n waa
mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi zummɛ.
Di ba suŋŋi mia ni siŋ,
ba ɔɔ ra mɔnni bahinaarɛ
alugɔ vugkuara,
ka bir har kpuŋ.
15N dɛɛzi baabuu, di tɛɛ baa fɔŋŋa,
ka ba ta n wichɔgaa ɛɛi jina.
16Ba waa bittɛ ba mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la be,
ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ
hoo la n kuwee.
Ba sitɔɔra daŋ siu laal biini,
dikuu ba barabara
wiŋɔzi wia.
Dikuu keŋ wia, ba daŋ ɛɛ baa chɛɛtɛ,
Ijip hɛri biini.”

english_text:
Israel Rejects the Lord
The Lord said:
1Sound a warning!
Israel, you broke our agreement
and ignored my teaching.
Now an eagle is swooping down
to attack my land.
2Israel, you say, “We claim you,
the Lord, as our God.”
3But your enemies
will chase you for rejecting
our good agreement.
4You chose kings and leaders
without consulting me;
you made silver and gold idols
that led to your downfall.
5City of Samaria, I'm angry
because of your idol
in the shape of a calf.
When will you ever
be innocent again?
6Someone from Israel built
that idol for you,
but only I am God.
And so it will be smashed
to pieces.
7If you scatter wind
instead of wheat,
you will harvest a whirlwind
and have no wheat.
Even if you harvest grain,
enemies will steal it all.
8Israel, you are ruined,
and now the nations
consider you worthless.
9You are like a wild donkey
that goes its own way.
You've run off to Assyria
and hired them as allies.
10You can bargain with nations,
but I'll catch you anyway.
Soon you will suffer abuse
by kings and rulers.
11Israel, you have built
many altars where you offer
sacrifices for sin.
But these altars have become
places for sin.
12My instructions for sacrifices
were written in detail,
but you ignored them.
13You sacrifice your best animals
and eat the sacrificial meals,
but I, the Lord,
refuse your offerings.
I will remember your sins
and punish you.
Then you will return to Egypt.
14Israel, I created you,
but you forgot me.
You and Judah built palaces
and many strong cities.
Now I will send fire to destroy
your towns and fortresses.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi n jugmi Izrɛl hina dikuu vuga kuaraa wia
1Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ Izrɛl hina be, “Ií huuh bensunoniina!
Ii dɔma ra tuu n hɛrii
alugɔ chigni n lii chiŋ
di ra tuu!
N nɛra chɔgi n ni baa nuukpaŋ labuu,
di ra di n Gbɔgni mmɔri.
2Izrɛl hina wiiwoo ra duŋ, di ra ŋɔ,
‘Kɔraawiizi la yaa
n na hum, yaa zumiibuu!’
3Ka ba vɛɛ kunla n wessene,
ba dɔma danna duŋŋi baa.
4Ba tɔ ba koora di maa zummɛ,
di ligzi nabɔnzi di maa sɛɛwɛ.
Ba kpa ba saliŋhuŋŋa ni salinnɛ
kuari vuga tɛɛ bahinaa,
guŋ gil ba chɔg bahinaa.
5Bolzeŋ Samaria hina, ií kpa ii vug la n li nabii la ha!
N baaŋ na fuuh
ii ninɛɛ werge.
Ɛrɛɛ a birgi mag ka ii gil vuga kuaraai?
6Izrɛl hinuu la
n zum nonii humaa kuari a vug,
mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi lɛi.
Ba daŋ purgi bolzeŋ Samaria hina
vug la n li nabii la, burburbur.
7Ba duu peure,
di kum vem.
Di mia waa lullɛ,
a wàá dɔɔ sau.
Di a faa lullɔ gba,
ka hɔɔhraa niŋ dia.
8Izrɛl hina wia tunnɔɔ.
Filaŋkeŋ, ba du
hɛrdumazi biinee
alugɔ nɛra la
n waa tɔna dɔɔwɛ.
9Ba la Asiiria hɛrii
alugɔ kawee la n kpoŋŋe
di ra gaagi u bɛŋ.
Izrɛl hina la Asiiria hina benii
di gaa nyiŋŋi hiinaa.
10Haali baŋ kpa bahinaa tɛɛ hɛrdumazi hina gba,
ka n daŋ jaa
chaali baa filaŋkeŋ.
Ba bɔra danna wii, ba ra kɔgi,
dikuu koorizeŋ n na
sunni baa wia.
11Gunla Izrɛl hina n na ma
mbusu lizibɔra, bá ra lizi
wichɔgaa mbusuzi la,
gunnɛ ba wichɔgaa
ɛɛi ra nyaŋŋi.
12N sɛbi n Gbɔgni wikpoglaa kpilaa tɛɛ baa,
ka a ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ
wihɔɔhra ba be.
13Ba ɔɔ lizi mbusu kunaa ra tɛŋ,
di hee a ola,
ka ba wia waa
mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi bɔra sɔɔnɛɛ.
N daŋ liizi ba wichɔgaa wia filaŋkeŋ,
di tɛr ba digna dikuu a wia.
Ba daŋ bir kaali Ijip hɛri.
14Izrɛl hina suuh mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la n ta baa la wiarɛ,
ka ma kooridiini.
Juda hina ma koŋliikpegaa
bar ba bola kpila.
Ka n daŋ kpa niŋ du ba bolzenaa ni,
ú fuuh a koŋliikpega.”

english_text:
Israel Will Be Punished
1Israel, don't celebrate
or make noisy shouts
like other nations.
You have been unfaithful
to your God.
Wherever grain is threshed,
you behave like prostitutes
because you enjoy
the money you receive.
2But you will run short
of grain and wine,
3and you will have to leave
the land of the Lord.
Some of you will go to Egypt;
others will go to Assyria
and eat unclean food.
4You won't be able to offer
sacrifices of wine
to the Lord.
None of your sacrifices
will please him—
they will be unclean
like food offered to the dead.
Your food will only be used
to satisfy your hunger;
none of it will be brought
to the Lord's temple.
5You will no longer be able
to celebrate the festival
of the Lord.
6Even if you escape alive,
you will end up in Egypt
and be buried in Memphis.
Your silver treasures
will be lost among weeds;
thorns will sprout in your tents.
7 Israel, the time has come.
You will get what you deserve,
and you will know it.
“Prophets are fools,” you say.
“And God's messengers
are crazy.”
Your terrible guilt
has filled you with hatred.
8Israel, the Lord sent me
to look after you.
But you trap his prophets
and flood his temple
with your hatred.
9 You are brutal and corrupt,
as were the men of Gibeah.
But God remembers your sin,
and you will be punished.
Sin's Terrible Results
10 Israel, when I, the Lord,
found you long ago
it was like finding
grapes in a barren desert
or tender young figs.
Then you worshiped Baal Peor,
that disgusting idol,
and you became as disgusting
as the idol you loved.
11And so, Israel, your glory
will fly away like birds—
your women will no longer
be able to give birth.
12Even if you do have children,
I will take them all
and leave you to mourn.
I will turn away,
and you will sink down
in deep trouble.
13Israel, when I first met you,
I thought of you as palm trees
growing in fertile ground.
Now you lead your people out,
only to be slaughtered.
Hosea's Advice
14Our Lord, do just one thing
for your people—
make their women unable
to have children
or to nurse their babies.
The Lord's Judgment on Israel
15Israel, I first began
to hate you because
you did evil at Gilgal.
Now I will chase you
out of my house.
No longer will I love you;
your leaders betrayed me.
16Israel, you are a vine
with dried-up roots
and fruitless branches.
Even if you had more children
and loved them dearly,
I would slaughter them all.
Hosea Warns Israel
17Israel, you disobeyed my God.
Now he will force you to roam
from nation to nation.
translation_text:
Izrɛl hina dignitɛraa wia
1Hozia ŋɔ Izrɛl hina be,
“Ií gilɛɛ ra di
ii hɔpizizenaa
alugɔ vugkuara.
Ii bir hattɛ kpu Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la,
di nyaa wibii u be.
Ii yoo iihinaarɛ a hɛri maa biini
alugɔ sɛnsɛnna
di tɛɛ vug Baal,
di ra nyiŋŋi mia la
iin tamɛɛ lugɔ u turgi ia la.
2Ka a wàá birgi, ii wàá ka na mia ni ɔlivi nuu nɛnnɛ.
Ii wàá na siŋ gba kɔrai.
3Izrɛl hina wàá ka du Kɔraawiizi hɛri la,
a dɛkkɔɔ bá bir kaali Ijip hɛri
di gaa di diwee la n doŋŋe
Kɔraawiizi be, Asiiria hɛri.
4Ba wàá ka lizi siŋ tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi be,
gɛɛ ba mbusu lizaa sela
kaa paruu.
Guŋ mbusuzi daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ nɛra n na wii lee diwee tɛɛ baa,
banla maa n niŋ dia
daŋ doŋ Kɔraawiizi be.
A diwee daŋ ɛɛ ba himmaa horaa,
a wàá zuu
Kɔraawiizi Dia biini.
5Di Kɔraawiizi diuzenaa dii hɔpizaa la wa hello,
ɛrɛɛ bá dia di chɔluuwɛi?
6Haali di ba chɔwɔɔ lii a hɛhchɔg biini gba,
ka Ijip hina daŋ chaali baa,
Mɛmfis hina ge hug baa.
Kooree daŋ lɛɛ ba saliŋhuŋŋa bɔr,
sɔɔhri ge lii ba bola.
7Ba dignitɛraa hɔpizaa ra bau,
gunla n dɛg bɛl maa
hɔpizaa duglɔɔrɛ.
Izrɛl hina daŋ zum guŋ.
Dikuubɛɛwiai, ba wichɔgaa kannɔɔ werge,
ba chumaa ge nyaŋŋi,
ba ra yir Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛrɛ gɛnii,
di ra yir nɛr la n zum
u wia nɛnnɛ chugla hiŋ.
8Kɔraawiizi hum mìŋ́ u dɔgtɛɛrɛ,
ń wa karfi u nɛra
Izrɛl hina.
Ka bɔr la maa minna la,
ba ɔɔ hembuu bá lawiŋ
lugɔ zumbee.
Haali Kɔraawiizi Dia biini gba,
nɛra ɛɛ a dɔgtɛɛ dɔmaa.
9Ba zuu dɔŋa wichɔgaa ɛɛi biinii werge
alugɔ Gibia saŋa la.
Kɔraawiizi daŋ liizi ba biinikpola wia,
di tɛr ba digna
dikuu a wia.”
10Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Miŋ faa luglɛɛ na Izrɛl hina la,
a faa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ
miŋ na grepuzi
hɛribɔduma biini.
Miŋ faa na ii naabaala,
a faa ɛɛwɔɔ
alugɔ fig lugli nɔna.
Ka baŋ wa ba Bizeŋ Pɛɔ,
ba faa luglɔɔrɛ
di ra kuari vug Baal,
di chum lugɔ
a vug la ban nɔŋŋɛɛ la.
11Izrɛl hina girme daŋ lii ba ni kaali
alugɔ zumbee n zaahwɛ kaali,
biizi lulaa wàá ka du de,
haana wàá ka kpogli hizi,
ba hizi ge wàá ka chi.
12Haali di ba ra dɛɛzi biizi gba,
ka n daŋ gil
ba maa siuzi.
Di n wa bir har kpu baa,
wia daŋ huuzi
baa werge maa!
13N nawɔɔrɛ Izrɛl
n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ Taaya,
di du hɛrnanii.
Ka Izrɛl hina daŋ kpa ba biizi
lii tɛɛ nɛkpuuri.”
14Denii Hozia ŋɔ,
“Kɔraawiizi, bɛɛ
ń suŋŋii tɛɛ baai?
Gil ba haana fir,
di gil ba nyaa ilanii.”
15Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Ba wichɔgaa ɛɛi faarɔɔrɛ ba chɔɔribɔr Gilgal,
n faa hah baa de.
Dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia,
n daŋ duŋŋi baa n hɛri.
Màá ka nɔŋŋi baa,
ba sitɔɔra maa
ɛɛ nɛkpoŋlaare.
16Izrɛl hina ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ
daa lunne n hillɛ,
waa kaa ra nɔŋ.
Ba wàá ka lul biizi,
haali di ba ra lul biizi di nɔŋŋi baa gba,
ka n daŋ kpuuzi baa.”
17Kɔraawiizi la minna hum la daŋ vɛɛ baa,
dikuu baŋ waa
nuuwɛ tɛu wia.
Ba danna juuri hɛssi biine.

english_text:
1You were a healthy vine
covered with grapes.
But the more grapes you grew,
the more altars you built;
the better off you became,
the better shrines you set up
for pagan gods.
2You are deceitful and disloyal.
So you will pay
for your sins,
because the Lord will destroy
your altars and images.
3“We don't have a king,”
you will say.
“We don't fear the Lord.
And what good are kings?”
4Israel, you break treaties
and don't keep promises;
you turn justice
into poisonous weeds
where healthy plants should grow.
5All who live in Samaria tremble
with concern for the idols
at sinful Bethel.
The idol there was the pride
of the priests,
but it has been put to shame;
now everyone will cry.
6It will be taken to Assyria
and given to the great king.
Then Israel will be disgraced
for worshiping that idol.
7Like a twig in a stream,
the king of Samaria
will be swept away.
8 The altars at sinful Bethel
will be destroyed
for causing Israel to sin;
they will be grown over
with thorns and thistles.
Then everyone will beg
the mountains and hills
to cover and protect them.
The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
9 Israel, you have never
stopped sinning
since that time at Gibeah.
That's why you
will be attacked at Gibeah.
10Your sins have doubled,
and you are rebellious.
Now I have decided
to send nations to attack
and put you in chains.
11Once you were obedient
like a calf
that loved to thresh grain.
But I will put a harness
on your beautiful neck;
you and Judah must plow
and cultivate the ground.
12 Plow your fields,
scatter seeds of justice,
and harvest faithfulness.
Worship me, the Lord,
and I will send my saving power
down like rain.
13You have planted evil,
harvested injustice, and eaten
the fruit of your lies.
You trusted your own strength
and your powerful forces.
14So war will break out,
and your fortresses
will be destroyed.
Your enemies will do to you
what Shalman did to the people
of Beth-Arbel—
mothers and their children
will be beaten to death
against rocks.
15Bethel, this will be your fate
because of your evil.
Israel, at dawn your king
will be killed.
translation_text:
1Hozia ŋɔ, “Izrɛl hina faa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ grepu daa
n nɔnnɛ werge.
Gunla banna nyɛɛli la,
gunnɛ ba ma mbusu lizibɔra
di ra jaa.
Gunla ba hɛri n na lii diwee werge la,
gunnɛ ba bɔg ba vuga la
n ɛɛ bia di ra jaa.
2Ba wia waa wibii dɔɔwɛ,
awia, a dɛkkɔɔ bá di
ba chɔgri tɔɔrɔɔ.
Kɔraawiizi daŋ purgi ba mbusu lizibɔra,
di chɔgi ba vuga la n ɛɛ bia la.
3Denii ba ŋɔ, ‘Yaa waa koori dɔɔwɛ
dikuu yaa n waa
Kɔraawiizi ɔmmɛ wia.
Ka di yaa faa dɔɔ koori gba,
bɛɛ ú faa wer ɛɛ
tɛɛ yaai?’
4Ba ɔɔ ŋɔ nuukpilaa,
di hɛɛhzi kanni karazi,
di ɛɛ nuukpaŋ.
Wibii dii birgi kara di ra jaa,
lugɔ toguu n lii koo.
5Ɔnsii daŋ lau nɛra la n du bolzeŋ Samaria
dikuu Bɛf Avɛn hina vug la
n lii nabii la wia.
U hina daŋ wii dikuu u wia,
guŋ himmaanii ú
kizeehina ɛɛ
ni banla n faa di suma u wessi wia la,
dikuu baŋ kpau lii ba be
di kaali hɛrduma wia.
6Ba daŋ kpau kaali Asiiria hɛri,
ú ɛɛ girme kinturgaa
tɛɛ koorizeŋ la.
Ba daŋ ŋmaabi Izrɛl hina,
hiihzi kpu baa
dikuu ba vuga la
n ɛɛ daazi wia.
7Ba daŋ lauri bolzeŋ Samaria hina ni ba koori kaali
lugɔ daabee n zaali nii nyuu
di ra kaali.
8Ba daŋ chɔgi giŋgimee nyuuni vuga kuaribɔra la baŋ ɔɔ ra ɛɛ biinikpola wia la.
Izrɛl hina wichɔgaarɛ guŋ.
Sɔɔhri ni kooree daŋ lii
tɔ ba mbusu lizibɔra maa.
Denii bá ŋɔ bizenaa be, ‘Ií tɔ yaa ni!’
Di ŋɔ giŋgimee be,
‘Ií chogli yaa ni!’ ”
9Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ, “Izrɛl hina haa waa wichɔgaa ɛɛi gillɛ
di haŋ lii Gibia saŋa la maa.
Laal faa waa wichɔgɛɛra
ni cholle Gibiaa?
10Di a wa pariŋ, n daŋ tɛr ba digna,
di gil hɛssi nɛra chaali
wa lɔ ba laal,
di tɛrgi ba digna dikuu
ba wichɔgaa werge wia.
11Izrɛl hina ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nalor la baŋ dɛɛzɛɛ nɛnnɛɛ,
u nɔŋŋi mia fɛrgaa,
awia, n daŋ kpa daa
du u baŋaa u ra par.
N daŋ kpogli Izrɛl hina,
a dɛkkɔɔ Juda hina ra par,
Izrɛl hina ge dɛkkɔɔ
banna bugli hɛri.
12Ií duu wideŋlaa tɛɛ iihinaa,
di tɔrgi nɔna la n dɔɔ
nɔŋŋaa la n waa tuŋ,
di gil ii bampiree pɛssi lugɔ hɛri la baŋ buglee,
dikuubɛɛwiai, saŋa la
iin niŋ nyiŋŋi mìŋ́
Kɔraawiizi la helloo,
mɔɔ ka n ba
wa kissi ia werge.
13Ka a ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ iin duu biinikpola,
di kum wichɔgaa,
di di kara nɔna,
dikuu iin dɛlli ii himaa fɔŋŋa
ni ii laallɔɔrakpila ni wia.
14Guŋ wia, laal daŋ chol ii ni,
bá purgi ii bola diikpega la
n baraa la,
alugɔ a hɔl la Koori Salman n faa puri
bolzeŋ Bɛf Aabɛl
laal biini la,
di lauri maawaa
ni ba biizi
vaari hɛri ba siuzi.
15Ee, Bɛtɛl hina, gunnɛ niŋ ɛɛ ii be,
dikuu ii biinikpola
n kannɛ werge wia.
Di a guŋ hɔpizii wa hello,
ba daŋ kpu Izrɛl koori.”

english_text:
God's Love for His People
1 When Israel was a child,
I loved him, and I called
my son out of Egypt.
2But as the saying goes,
“The more they were called,
the more they rebelled.”
They never stopped offering
incense and sacrifices
to the idols of Baal.
3I took Israel by the arm
and taught them to walk.
But they would not admit
that I was the one
who had healed them.
4I led them with kindness
and with love,
not with ropes.
I held them close to me;
I bent down to feed them.
5But they rejected me,
and so must return to Egypt;
now Assyria will rule them.
6War will visit their cities,
and their plans will fail.
7My people are determined
to reject me for a god
they think is stronger,
but he can't help.
8 Israel, I can't let you go.
I can't give you up.
How could I possibly destroy you
as I did the towns of Admah
and Zeboiim?
I just can't do it.
My feelings for you
are much too strong.
9Israel, I won't lose my temper
and destroy you again.
I am the Holy God—
not merely some human,
and I won't stay angry.
10I, the Lord, will roar like a lion,
and my children will return,
trembling from the west.
11They will come back,
fluttering like birds from Egypt
or like doves from Assyria.
Then I will bring them
back to their homes.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
Israel and Judah Compared
12Israel is deceitful to me,
their loyal and holy God;
they surround me with lies,
and Judah worships
other gods.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi n nɔŋŋi Izrɛl hina
1Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Saŋa la Izrɛl n faa ɛɛwɛ lugɔ bichala la, n faa nɔŋŋuubuu,
di yiruu lugɔ n biibaal
di lii Ijip hɛri.
2Ka saŋa la miŋ haŋ wàá yiruu la,
a guŋ saŋaa u ɔɔ chɔ
ra lii n be.
N nɛra ɔɔ ra lizi mbusuzii ra tɛɛ vug Baala,
di fuuh daahɛgsɔɔhsuma
ra tɛɛ vuga.
3Minuu bagli baa volaa,
di ɔɔ kpa baa pɛgli,
ka ba waa zummɛ
lugɔ minuu dɛɛzi baa.
4N faa kpa nɔŋŋaa ni winanaarɛ
tɔ ba see.
N faa lizi tɔɔrɔɔ la n lugɔ nau baŋaa daa labuu ba ni,
di bugni tɛɛ baa diwee.
5Ba waa sɛɛwɛ bá bir ba n be,
awia, a dɛkkɔɔ baŋ bittɛ
kaali Ijip hɛri,
Asiiria hina di kora ba ni.
6Ba dɔma daŋ kpa tokobizi la n na nyɛgzi, di zuu ba bolzenaa biine,
di chɔgi ba
dominuuzenaa lugbidaazi,
di gil ba jinazi maa tuŋ.
7N nɛra siwii aahwɔɔ lugɔ bá bir har kpuŋ.
Haali di ba yiriŋ gba,
ka màá lɛɛ baa.
8Izrɛl hina, ɛrɛɛ ń ɛɛ gil ia tai?
Ɛrɛɛ ń ɛɛ di vɛɛ iai?
Ɛrɛɛ ń ɛɛ kpu ia alugɔ bolzeŋ Adma hinai?
Gɛɛ di ɛɛ ia alugɔ
bolzeŋ Zɛbɔyim hinai?
N bampirii wàá sɛɛ ń ɛɛ guŋ,
N nɔŋŋi iabuu werge.
9Màá kpa n baaŋ la tɔɔri ia
gɛɛ di bir kpu Izrɛl hina.
Dikuubɛɛwiai, n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizii, maa newee ɛɛwɛ.
Minuu ii Dɔɔrinaniinanii la,
n du ii biinii.
Màá ba ii be ni baaŋfuuih.
10Ba daŋ hiŋ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi,
n daŋ wii alugɔ bunyiŋ.
Di n wa wiiwo,
n biizi daŋ lii wiicholii
ba ni bɔsai.
11Ba daŋ ba ni bɔsai
alugɔ zumbizi n lii Ijip hɛri,
alugɔ kommazi
n lii Asiiria hɛri.
N daŋ soŋŋi baa ba bola.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”
Izrɛl hina wichɔgaa wia
12Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Izrɛl hina kpa karaa di bariŋ,
di ra dariŋ.
Juda hina haa ra diŋ mmɔri,
haali mìŋ́ Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii
wia n dɔɔ wibii gba.”

english_text:
1All day long Israel chases
wind from the desert;
deceit and violence
are found everywhere.
Treaties are made with Assyria;
olive oil is taken to Egypt.
Israel and Judah Condemned
2The Lord also brings charges
against the people of Judah,
the descendants of Jacob.
He will punish them
for what they have done.
3 Even before Jacob was born,
he cheated his brother,
and when he grew up,
he fought against God.
4 At Bethel, Jacob wrestled
with an angel and won;
then with tears in his eyes,
he asked for a blessing,
and God spoke to us there.
5God's name is the Lord,
the Lord God All-Powerful.
6So return to your God.
Patiently trust him,
and show love and justice.
7Israel, you enjoy cheating
and taking advantage
of others.
8You say to yourself, “I'm rich!
I earned it all on my own,
without committing a sin.”
The Lord Is Still the God of Israel
9 Israel, I, the Lord,
am still your God,
just as I have been
since the time
you were in Egypt.
Now I will force you
to live in tents once again,
as you did in the desert.
10I spoke to the prophets—
often I spoke in visions.
And so, I will send my prophets
with messages of doom.
11Gilead is terribly sinful
and will end up ruined.
Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal
on altars made of stones,
but those stones will be scattered
in every field.
12 Jacob escaped to Syria
where he tended sheep
to earn himself a wife.
13 I sent the prophet Moses
to lead Israel from Egypt
and to keep them safe.
14Israel, I will make you pay
for your violent crimes
and for insulting me.
translation_text:
1Izrɛl hina wiɛɛlaa maa,
di lii chɔɔzi di ra la hamuŋa,
ɛɛ wipɛɛrii di ra chɔg wia.
Wibii nyaai ni naari wia ra wazuu ba biini.
Ba gillɔɔ ba ni Asiiria hina
ɛɛ nuukpaŋ,
di chi ɔlivi nuu
di ra la Ijip hɛri.
2Kɔraawiizi ni Juda hina dɔɔ wiarɛ,
u daŋ tɛr Izrɛl hina digna
dikuu ba wiɛɛlaa wia,
di bir turgi baa a kim.
3Ba naabaal Jekɔb ni u cheeŋ Ɛsau faa yoowoo,
di ba faa haa du ba maa hia,
uŋ wa hel baal,
u ni Kɔraawiizi yoo.
4U ni mɛlika yoowoo u kpegluu,
u wii di suŋŋi a mɛlika
lugɔ u suŋ u ni.
U ga nau Bɛtɛl,
u nuu ŋɔ wia de.
5Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hinnɛ faa,
waabuu Kɔraawiizi la ban ninna jaami!
6Awia, Jekɔb naanna, a dɛkkɔɔ ii yarduu,
di bir ba Kɔraawiizi la
iinna huma la be,
di dɔɔ nɔŋŋaa ni wibii,
di ɔɔ nuu ra tɛu saŋa maa.
7Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Izrɛl hina wia nyaa wibiire lugɔ Keenan hina,
di nɔŋŋi nɛra finaa,
di ɔɔ kpa kuna la
n waa dɛkkɛ,
di ra mɛgzi kuna.
8Izrɛl hina ra ta baraa di ra ŋɔ,
‘Yaa ɛɛ daama hinaa werge,
yaa birgi dɔɔnaa.
Yaa daama hiŋ wia, nɛra maa wàá wer ŋɔ lugɔ
wibii nyaai wiarɛ yaa dɔɔ daama.’
9Ka minuu Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la,
unla n faa lizi ia
lii Ijip hɛri la.
N daŋ kaa gil ii gaa zuu tanti diini biine
gunla iiŋ faa du a biine,
di lii saŋa la miŋ faa ba ii be,
hɛribɔduma biini la.
10N ŋɔ wiarɛ tɛɛ n dɔgtɛɛzi,
di pilli wikpila tɛɛ baa,
di ga ba be
ta sɛɛliizi tɛɛ ia.
11Giliad hina dɔɔ biinikpolaa.
U nɛra ɛɛ nɛjagazii!
Ba kpa nabalaa di ra lizi mbusuzi Gilgal biini.
Ba mbusuzi lizibɔra
daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ baŋ chaali bia,
di dauri kulululu,
koo biini.”
12Hozia ŋɔ, “Yaa naabaal Jekɔb faa chɔwɔɔrɛ la Mɛsɔpɔtemia hɛri,
di ga hum ú na haaŋ,
di nɔɔni peeza ú turgi
a haaŋ kim.
13Kɔraawiizi faa gillɔɔ
u dɔgtɛɛ Moosis kpogli
Izrɛl hina lii Ijip hɛri,
di faa ga u be di binni baa.
14Ka Izrɛl hina faa fuuh Kɔraawiizi baannɛ werge,
u daŋ gil
bá bilchɔg di baa,
dikuu ba nɛkpui wia,
di bir turgi baa a kim,
dikuu banna gbɛlluu wia.”

english_text:
Israel Is Doomed
The Lord said:
1When your leaders spoke,
everyone in Israel trembled
and showed great respect.
But you sinned by worshiping Baal,
and you were destroyed.
2Now you continue to sin
by designing and making
idols of silver
in the shape of calves.
You are told to sacrifice
to these idols—
yes, even to kiss them.
3And so, all of you will vanish
like the mist or the dew
of early morning,
or husks of grain in the wind
or smoke from a chimney.
4I, the Lord, have been your God
since the time
you were in Egypt.
I am the only God you know,
the only one who can save.
5 I took care of you
in a thirsty desert.
6I fed you till you were satisfied,
then you became proud
and forgot about me.
7Now I will attack like a lion,
ambush you like a leopard,
8and rip you apart like a bear
robbed of her cubs.
I will gnaw on your bones,
as though I were a lion
or some other wild animal.
9Israel, you are done for.
Don't expect help from me.
10 You wanted a king and rulers.
Where is your king now?
What cities have rulers?
11 In my anger, I gave you a king;
in my fury, I took him away.
Israel's Terrible Fate
The Lord said:
12Israel, your terrible sins
are written down
and stored away.
13You are like a senseless child
who refuses to be born
at the proper time.
14 Should I, the Lord, rescue you
from death and the grave?
No! I call death and the grave
to strike you like a plague.
I refuse to show mercy.
15No matter if you prosper
more than the other tribes,
I, the Lord, will wipe you out,
just as a scorching desert wind
dries up streams of water.
I will take away
your precious treasures.
16Samaria will be punished
for turning against me.
It will be destroyed in war—
children will be beaten
against rocks,
and pregnant women
will be ripped open.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi baaŋ n fuuh Izrɛl hina ni wia
1Di Ɛfram diahina haŋ wa ŋɔ wia,
nɛra bɔra ɔɔ ra sau.
Kɔraawiizi faa tɛɛ baabuu nabɔmuu Izrɛl biini,
ka ba faa kuu vug Baal
jaamaa wia di di bilchɔg
di siu.
2Ba jaa ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ werge maa,
di kpa ba saliŋhuŋŋa
kuari vuga ra tɛɛ bahinaa.
Ba kuaraabuu nɛnnɛ maa,
nɛra la n zum
nonii huma nɛnnɛɛ kuaraa.
Kenne ba ra ŋɔ nɛra naa wia,
“Ba kpa neweare
di ra lizi mbusuzi,
di ra jaami vuga la
baŋ kuarɛɛ lugɔ nabizi.”
3Awia, ba daŋ ɛɛ alugɔ chɔɔzinkɔɔl,
alugɔ chɔɔzinŋmɛnii
n ɔɔ feli diizaa,
alugɔ peu n na kpa zɔga pila,
alugɔ nyɔɔzi n ga chum
di ra lii.
4Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Minuu Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum,
unla n lizi ia lii Ijip hɛri la.
Ii wàá zum Kɔraawiizi maa di min lɛi,
Lɛɛri maa waa hoo
di miŋ lɛi.
5Minuu faa binni ia hɛribɔduma la biini,
hɛri la n wenzee
di ra haahri werge la biini.
6Minuu faa tɛɛ ia diwee ii di piŋ,
iiŋ wa piŋŋɛ,
ii jaa ra jigsi, di suuh n wia.
7A wia, n daŋ pig ia alugɔ bunyiŋ,
di chɔɔ ii ŋmɛnikɛraa
guu ia alugɔ amani.
8N daŋ pig ia lugɔ amani la biizi n leuwe,
di kaari ii hizi,
di di ia alugɔ bunyiŋ,
gunla sechɔgii
n ɔɔ chuuri sel la.
9Izrɛl hina, n daŋ kpu ia.
Anɛɛ n niŋ wer hiini iai?
10Ii koori du lee ú wer lɛɛ iai?
Ii bola nabɔnzi maa du lee,
banla wia iiŋ ŋɔwɛɛ,
‘Tɛɛ yaa koori
ni sitɔɔra lai’?
11Awia, n faa kpa baaŋ tɛɛ ia koori,
di kpa n baaŋfuuihchɔgaa
di kpau kaali.
12N kpa Izrɛl bilchɔgrɛ dau,
di sɛbi ba wichɔgaa dau.
13Izrɛl hina dɔɔ tamiirɛ lugɔ ba dɔɔ miibɔɔ,
ka ba waa nunzuma dɔɔwɛ.
Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bie la
banna nyiŋŋi lulaa,
ka waa sɛɛ ú lii.
14N daŋ lɛɛ baa lii ŋmam fɔŋŋa biini.
N daŋ lɛɛ baa lii siu be.
Siu, lee i wiilchɔgaa la duɛi?
Ŋmam, lee i chɔgaa la duɛi?
Màá suŋ ba ni,
15haali Izrɛl hina
n na hel nɛnnɛ
ba lulla biini gba,
ka mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil
peu lii wiifurii hɛribɔduma,
di wa ta ba ni,
bá bulli ni ba kɔlɔnzi hil.
Bá paa ba kundɔɔlaa maa
lii ba diini.
16A dɛkkɔɔ bolzeŋ Samaria hina di ba bilchɔg tɔna,
dikuu baŋ di Kɔraawiizi la
banna hum la mmɔri wia.
Ba daŋ kpa tokobi kpu baa,
di lauri ba bichalli vaari hɛri,
di yalli ba haana la
n kpogli hizi la hizi.”

english_text:
Turn Back to the Lord
1Israel, return! Come back
to the Lord, your God.
Sin has made you fall.
2Return to the Lord and say,
“Please forgive our sins.
Accept our good sacrifices
of praise instead of bulls.
3Assyria can't save us,
and chariots can't help.
So we will no longer worship
the idols we have made.
Our Lord, you show mercy
to orphans.”
The Lord Promises To Forgive
4Israel, you have rejected me,
but my anger is gone;
I will heal you and love you
without limit.
5I will be like the dew—
then you will blossom like lilies
and have roots like a tree.
6Your branches will spread
with the beauty
of an olive tree
and with the aroma
of Lebanon Forest.
7You will rest in my shade,
and your grain will grow.
You will blossom
like a vineyard
and be famous as the wine
from Lebanon.
8Israel, give up your idols!
I will answer your prayers
and take care of you.
I am that glorious tree,
the source of your fruit.
9If you are wise, you will know
and understand what I mean.
I am the Lord, and I lead you
along the right path.
If you obey me,
we will walk together,
but if you are wicked,
you will stumble.
translation_text:
Wichɔgaa gilaa ta n niŋ ba kissaa ni wia
1Izrɛl hina,
ií bir ba Kɔraawiizi la
iinna hum la be.
Ii wichɔgaarɛ hur ia ta!
2Ií kpa wiisuŋŋaa naa
di bir ba Kɔraawiizi be.
Ií ga ŋɔ u be,
“Jaande maa, gil yaa
wichɔgaa tɛɛ yaa,
ka suŋ yaa ni di lɛɛ yaa,
ya wer chɔlii gunla
yaa n ŋɔ nua la.
3Asiiria hina wàá wer lɛɛ yaa,
yaa wàá tinni laal zagra.
Yaa ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka ŋɔ vuga la
yaa himmaa n kuarɛɛ be
lugɔ aabuu yaa dɔɔra,
dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu
ɔɔ ra suŋ lalbiizi ni.”
4Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“N daŋ bir n nɛra ni ba n be,
di nɔŋŋi baa ni n biini maa,
dikuubɛɛwiai, n baaŋ
wàá kaa ra fuuh ba ni.
5N daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ ŋmɛnii tɛɛ Izrɛl hina,
bá du wer alugɔ fiiri.
Ba lunne daŋ zuu hɛri nɛnnɛ alugɔ
Lɛbanɔn hɛriŋkpol daazi,
6bá biizi wazi.
Bá wessi ɛɛ alugɔ ɔlivi nuu daa,
di ra sɔɔhri sumaii lugɔ
Lɛbanɔn hɛriŋkpol daa.
7Ba daŋ kaa so n na guu baa.
Izrɛl hina daŋ nyɛɛli
alugɔ mia n lɛɛwɛ nɛnnɛ,
di lul biizi alugɔ grepu daazi n nɔnnɛ nɛnnɛ,
di dɔɔ sɔŋ
alugɔ Lɛbanɔn siŋ.
8Izrɛl hina ni vuga wàá ka dɔɔ wiimaa.
N daŋ nuu ba wiisuŋŋaa
di ra binni ba ni.
N daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ daananii n lɔɔwɛ di biri nɛnnɛ, di tɔ ba ni.
N benii bá kissaa maa lii.”
9Anɛɛ dɔɔ nunzumai? U daŋ zum wia naa zɛɛ.
Anɛɛ n na pessi wiai?
U daŋ zum a zɛɛ.
Kɔraawiizi ŋmɛnizi maa deŋloore,
nɛra la wia n deŋleere
ra vol a ni,
ka mmɔri diire waa ra
lɔɔzi naazii di ra jiŋli a biine.

english_text:
1I am Joel the son of Pethuel.
And this is the message
the Lord gave to me.
Locusts Cover the Land
2Listen, you leaders
and everyone else
in the land.
Has anything like this
ever happened before?
3Tell our children!
Let it be told
to our grandchildren
and their children too.
4Swarm after swarm of locusts
has attacked our crops,
eating everything in sight.
5Sober up, you drunkards!
Cry long and loud;
your wine supply is gone.
6 A powerful nation
with countless troops
has invaded our land.
They have the teeth and jaws
of powerful lions.
7Our grapevines and fig trees
are stripped bare;
only naked branches remain.
8Grieve like a young woman
mourning for the man
she was to marry.
9Offerings of grain and wine
are no longer brought
to the Lord's temple.
His servants, the priests,
are deep in sorrow.
10Barren fields mourn;
grain, grapes, and olives
are scorched and shriveled.
11Mourn for our farms
and our vineyards!
There's no wheat or barley
growing in our fields.
12Grapevines have dried up
and so has every tree—
figs and pomegranates,
date palms and apples.
All happiness has faded away.
Return to God
13Mourn, you priests who serve
at the altar of my God.
Spend your days and nights
wearing sackcloth.
Offerings of grain and wine
are no longer brought
to the Lord's temple.
14Tell the leaders and people
to come together
at the temple.
Order them to go without eating
and to pray sincerely.
15 We are in for trouble!
Soon the Lord All-Powerful
will bring disaster.
16Our food is already gone;
there's no more celebrating
at the temple of our God.
17Seeds dry up in the ground;
no harvest is possible.
Our barns are in bad shape,
with no grain
to store in them.
18Our cattle wander aimlessly,
moaning for lack of pasture,
and sheep are suffering.
19I cry out to you, Lord.
Grasslands and forests are eaten
by the scorching heat.
20Wild animals have no water
because of you;
rivers and streams are dry,
and pastures are parched.
translation_text:
1Wia la Kɔraawiizi n pillɛɛ bagli Pɛtuɛl biibaal Jowɛllɛ keŋ.
Lotorozi wia
2Ií ra nuu, ii banla n ɛɛ nabɔnzi,
ií ra nuu, nɛra la maa
n du Juda hɛri.
Wii naa dɔŋ haa ɛɛwɔ ii saŋa
gɛɛ ii naabaala saŋaa?
3Ií ŋɔ a wia tɛɛ ii biizi,
di gil ii biizi ge ŋɔa
tɛɛ ba biizi,
ba ge biizi wa ŋɔa tɛɛ
banla n niŋ wa hiŋ ba ni.
4Kuna la lotorozi kpila werge n diwee ka ka,
lotorokpega ɔɔ bau
wa dia.
Anla a ge n wa diwee ka ka,
a jigzi ɔɔ wa diabuu.
Anla a jigzi la n diwee ka ka,
lotorozi aŋhina ɔɔ wa diabuu.
5Sinnyɔɔra, ií izi di ra wii!
Ií ra lɔɔgi wile,
ii banla n na nyɔɔ siŋ,
dikuu iiŋ wàá ka
na siŋfalii nyɔɔ wia.
6Lotorozi lugɔ laallɔkpega ballɔɔ á wa chɔgi yaa hɛri maa,
a dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa werge maa,
a waa maga dɔɔwɛ,
a nyina ra diu lugɔ
bunyiŋ nyina.
7A chɔgi yaa grepu daazii,
di hee yaa fig daazi.
A po a hɛga maanii ha,
ka ka a kela, a huuhzi chi.
8Ií ra wii alugɔ toloori la n su haaŋ
ka u haa waa baal zummɛ,
di nigni gbɔglɔŋ di ra wii,
dikuu u bichaljaari la
un niŋ vii yuu n siuwɛ wia.
9Mbusuzi lizaa mia gɛɛ siŋ
waa hoo bá kpa ba
Kɔraawiizi Dia.
Kɔraawiizi kizeehina ra wiiu,
dikuu baŋ waa kuna dɔɔwɛ,
bá kpa lizi mbusuzi
Kɔraawiizi be wia.
10A kooni maanii chɔkkɛ,
a hɛri maa hil,
mia maa chɔgi,
grepu nɔna maa hil,
ɔlivi daazi ge maa hil.
11Patta, ií gil ii bɔra huah,
grepu patta,
ií ra lɔɔgi wile,
ií gil ii biine chɔgi dikuu huuti ni baali wia,
dikuubɛɛwiai, pattikuna
maanii chɔkkɛ.
12A grepuzi daazi maanii hillɛ,
fig daazi maa yɔl,
pomegranet, abɛ, huu daazi
ani kooni daazi maanii hillɛ.
Wibii maa, newea
bɔsɔna tunnɔɔ.
Wichɔgaa gilaa ta wia
13Kɔraawiizi kizeehina,
ií kpa gbɔglɔnzi tɔɔgi
di ra wii,
ii banla n na hum
mbusu lizibɔr la!
Ií zuu Kɔraawiizi Dia la di ra wii hamuŋa maa!
Mia gɛɛ siŋ waa hoo
ii kpa ra lizi mbusuzi
Kɔraawiizi Dia.
14Ŋɔ bá vɔɔ nua,
chaali nɛra maa!
Chaali nabɔnzi
ni nɛra la maa n du a hɛri,
di ba Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la Dia,
di wa wii tɛu.
15Gooŋga! Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizii la duglɔɔrɛ!
Hɔpizii la Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa
Maa Hiŋ n niŋ gil chɔgaa ba.
Ɔnsii werge daŋ du de
a hɔl hiŋ.
16Yaa chigɔɔ haa nuuzi di ra binni,
ka yaa pattikuna
maa chɔgi.
Bɔsɔna ge waa kaa hoo
Kɔraawiizi la yaa
n na hum la Dia biini.
17Kunduulaa maanii siuwɛ
dikuu a hɛri n hillɛ wia.
Mia waa hoo bá kaa du buugazi biine,
awia, a buugazi
maanii purgee.
18Nauna ra wiiu,
dikuu kooree n waa hoo
á di wia,
haali peeza gba
ra di dɔgnya.
19Kɔraawiizi, hinuu n wii ra tɛɛ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, kooree ni
daazi maanii hillɛ,
alugɔ niŋ n fuuah la.
20Haali pir sela maa wii ra tɛɛ hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi,
dikuubɛɛwiai, muuni
ni gɔŋa maanii hiihzɛɛ,
niŋ ge fuuh sela diiribɔra maa.

english_text:
Locusts and an Enemy Army
1Sound the trumpet on Zion,
the Lord's sacred hill.
Warn everyone to tremble!
The judgment day of the Lord
is coming soon.
2It will be dark and gloomy
with storm clouds overhead.
Troops will cover the mountains
like thunderclouds.
No army this powerful
has ever been gathered before
or will be gathered again.
3Fiery flames surround them;
no one escapes.
Before they invaded,
the land was like Eden;
now only a desert remains.
4 They look like horses
and charge like cavalry.
5They roar over mountains
like noisy chariots,
or a mighty army
ready for battle.
They are a forest fire
that feasts on straw.
6The very sight of them
is frightening.
7They climb over walls
like warriors;
they march in columns
and never turn aside.
8They charge straight ahead,
without pushing each other;
even arrows and spears
cannot make them retreat.
9They swarm over city walls
and enter our homes;
they crawl in through windows,
just like thieves.
10 They make the earth tremble
and the heavens shake;
the sun and moon turn dark,
and stars stop shining.
11 The Lord God leads this army
of countless troops,
and they obey his commands.
The day of his judgment
is so terrible
that no one can stand it.
The Lord's Invitation
12The Lord said:
It isn't too late.
You can still return to me
with all your heart.
Start crying and mourning!
Go without eating.
13Don't rip your clothes
to show your sorrow.
Instead, turn back to me
with broken hearts.
I am merciful, kind, and caring.
I don't easily lose my temper,
and I don't like to punish.
14I am the Lord your God.
Perhaps I will change my mind
and treat you with mercy.
Then you will be blessed
with enough grain and wine
for offering sacrifices to me.
15Sound the trumpet on Zion!
Call the people together.
Show your sorrow
by going without food.
16 Make sure that everyone
is fit to worship me.
Bring adults, children, babies,
and even bring newlyweds
from their festivities.
17 Tell my servants, the priests,
to cry inside the temple
and to offer this prayer
near the altar:
“Save your people, Lord God!
Don't let foreign nations
make jokes about us.
Don't let them laugh and ask,
‘Where is your God?’ ”
The Lord Will Bless the Land
18The Lord was deeply concerned
about his land
and had pity on his people.
19In answer to their prayers
he said,
“I will give you enough grain,
wine, and olive oil
to satisfy your needs.
No longer will I let you
be insulted by the nations.
20An army attacked from the north,
but I will chase it
into a scorching desert.
There it will rot and stink
from the Dead Sea
to the Mediterranean.”
The Lord works wonders
21and does great things.
So tell the soil to celebrate
22and wild animals
to stop being afraid.
Grasslands are green again;
fruit trees and fig trees
are loaded with fruit.
Grapevines are covered
with grapes.
23People of Zion,
celebrate in honor
of the Lord your God!
He is generous and has sent
the autumn and spring rains
in the proper seasons.
24Grain will cover
your threshing places;
jars will overflow
with wine and olive oil.
The Lord Will Rescue His People
25I, the Lord your God,
will make up for the losses
caused by those swarms
and swarms of locusts
I sent to attack you.
26My people, you will eat
until you are satisfied.
Then you will praise me
for the wonderful things
I have done.
Never again will you
be put to shame.
27Israel, you will know
that I stand at your side.
I am the Lord your God—
there are no other gods.
Never again will you
be put to shame.
The Lord Will Work Wonders
The Lord said:
28 Later, I will give my Spirit
to everyone.
Your sons and daughters
will prophesy.
Your old men
will have dreams,
and your young men
will see visions.
29In those days I will even give
my Spirit to my servants,
both men and women.
30I will work wonders
in the sky above
and on the earth below.
There will be blood and fire
and clouds of smoke.
31 The sun will turn dark,
and the moon
will be as red as blood
before that great
and terrible day
when I appear.
32 Then I, the Lord will save everyone who faithfully worships me. I have promised there will be survivors on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and among them will be my chosen ones.
translation_text:
Lotorozi n kpillɛ lugɔ laallɔɔra wia
1Ií huuh bensunoniina la Bizeŋ Ziɔn nyuu,
ií lɔ kpɛlŋa
n bizennaniinanii la nyuu.
Ií gil Juda hina maa bɔra ra sa,
dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi
Hɔpizii la ra bau,
u duglɔɔrɛ.
2U hɔpizii hiŋ daŋ biri,
di ɛɛ biinichɔg hɔpizii,
di ɛɛ baamazi ni
bɔbiri werge hɔpizii.
U daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ lotorozi n tɔ bizenaa nyuuni,
di ɛɛ lugɔ laallɔkpega,
a ŋmɛnɛ maa ge wàá dɔɔ dɔŋ,
di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa.
3A daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ niŋ n fuuh kuna a see,
ka a har chɔɔ alugɔ nindiu.
A see hɛri ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ Ɛdɛn kambol la,
ka a harbɔɔ ge hɛri
ɛɛ lugɔ hɛribɔduma.
4A duula ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ zagra,
di ra chɔ alugɔ laal zagra.
5A gbɔgza ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ laal torkozi,
a zaahzi ra gilli bizenaa.
Di ra pogzi alugɔ niŋ n na di kooree,
di chi nɛnnɛ ge
alugɔ laallɔɔra n ɛɛ sirya,
bá lɔ laal.
6Di hɛssi maa hina wa naa, ɔnsii werge ɔɔ lau baabuu,
ba siwee maa
chogli wogliwogli.
7A ɔɔ pig nɛraa lugɔ laallɔɔra,
di ra tinni koŋlaa
alugɔ laallɔɔra.
A ɔɔ deŋli a seere ra la,
a waa bɛɛwɛ ra ga yemmaa.
8A bɛl maa waa u dɔŋhiŋ na gargi.
A ɔɔ taau lii kunla maa
n niŋ teŋaa be,
kummaa waa hoo
ú wer teŋaa ŋmɛnɛɛ.
9A hahzoore di pig a bolzeŋ,
di ra chɔ koŋlaa ni.
Di ra zuu diini biine,
di ga a tokorozi zuu
alugɔ ŋmɛɛna.
10A ɔɔ ra bau hɛri ra zigli,
chiŋ ge ra sa,
A tɔ wiizi ni baagu, bɔr biri,
chinchiŋwilaa ge waa
kaa ra chaani.
11Kɔraawiizi ra pogzi u laallɔɔra ninɛɛ.
Banla n na sɛɛ u wia
kpillɔɔ werge, di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa.
U Hɔpizii hiŋ chummɔɔ werge.
Anɛɛ n niŋ pirei?
Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ bá gil ba wichɔgaa ta wia
12Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Haali filaŋkeŋ gba,
ií bir ba n be ni ii biine maa,
ni nuuvɔɔi ni wiraa
ani biinichɔg.”
13Ií gil ii biine chɔgi,
gunnɛ bɔ iiŋ piili ii bɔmbɔga.
Ií bir ba Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la be,
dikuu unna ɛɛ nɛra nɛnnɛ,
di ra na ba sinyɛna wia.
U baaŋ pɛssɔɔrɛ, u nɔŋŋaa ge waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ,
ka u ɔɔ kaa gil nɛra ge
wichɔgaarɛ ra tɛɛ baa.
14Aŋhinabe, Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la daŋ bir u nfɛrɛ,
di kaa kissi ia,
di tɛɛ ia pattikuna werge.
Denii ii jaa wer kpa mia
ni siŋ di ra lizi mbusuzi u be.
15Ií huuh bensunoniina Bizeŋ Ziɔn nyuu,
di gil ba vɔɔ nua,
ka yir a nɛra maa, bá chaali.
16Ií chaali a nɛra,
di lizi ba doŋa ha,
bá ɛɛ nɛnanaananaa Kɔraawiizi be.
Chaali nabɔnzi
ni bichalli maa,
haali banla gba n ɛɛ biifulli.
Ií gil haŋfalaa ni ba janna maa
lii ba diini ba.
17A dɛkkɔ Kɔraawiizi kizeehina la n na humuu,
u Dia dominua ni
mbusu lizibɔr la baambaaŋ,
di ra wii, di ra suŋŋuu.
Gil ba ra ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi, suŋ i nɛra ni,
di gilɛɛ gil i nɛra
ɛɛ chɛɛtɛ kuna,
banla n waa Jus hina
ɛɛwɛ la be.
Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ hɛssi hina ra ŋɔ,
‘Lee Kɔraawiizi la
iinna hum la duɛi?’ ”
Kɔraawiizi n gillɛ a hɛri kaa bir du sum
18Denii Kɔraawiizi faa kaa gil u hɛri wia tiruu,
u suŋ u nɛra ni.
19Kɔraawiizi faa bir ŋɔ u nɛra be,
“N daŋ tɛɛ ia mia, siŋfalaa ani ɔlivi nuufalaa,
á kukki ia.
Hɛrdumazi hina wàá
ka gbɛlli ia.
20N daŋ duŋŋi lotorozi la n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ laallɔkpega, di lii wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag ba la,
á kaali bɔɔnɛɛ
di ga du hɛribɔduma.
N daŋ duŋŋi a sitɔɔra ga du Muuzensiwii la,
anla ge n tɔ a har la ge ga
zuu Muuzeŋ Mɛditerenɛn.
Anla n siuzɛɛ la danna sɔɔhri.
N daŋ kpua, dikuu gunla
maa aŋ ɛɛ ia la wia.
21Awia, kooni, ií gilɛɛ ra ɔm,
ií gil i bɔra sɔɔni di ra pur,
dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ wizenaare werge tɛɛ ia.
22Pir sela, ií gilɛɛ ra ɔm,
dikuu ii diiribɔra n na fur kooree,
daazi ge ra nɔŋ wia.
Fig ni grepu
daazi ra nɔnuu.
23Bolzeŋ Ziɔn hina, ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni ia werge maa,
dikuu Kɔraawiizi la
iinna hum la wia.
U tɛɛ iabuu sazaudooŋ,
di tɛɛ ia yuulindooŋ
gba nɛnnɛ.
24Ii pilli maanii niŋ suugi mia,
sinni ni ɔlivi nuu kuaribɔra maa ge
suugi di taali.
25N daŋ gil ii bir na kuna la maa
a lotorozi n faa chɔkkɛ,
binni la maa n bɛrɛɛ la.
Minuu faa gillɛ a ba ii be la.
26Ii daŋ na diwee werge, di di piŋ,
di chɔli Kɔraawiizi la
iinna hum la,
dikuubɛɛwiai, u ɛɛ nuukpuuri wiarɛ werge ii be.
N nɛra ŋmɛnɛ maa
wàá ka di hiihzi.
27Izrɛl hina, ii daŋ zum lugɔ n du ii benii,
di zum ge lugɔ n bɛnnɛ ɛɛ
Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum,
bɛl maa waa kaa hoo.
N nɛra ŋmɛnɛ maa ge
wàá ka di hiihzi.”
Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizii wia
28Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ, “Di guŋ wa ɛɛwɔ tuŋ,
n daŋ kpa n Duma
du nɛra maa ni.
Ii biibaala ni ii biihaana maa daŋ ŋɔ wia n fɔŋŋa biini,
ii bazɛŋzi danna deezi,
ii biipɔllaa ge
ra na wia lugɔ deeza biini.
29Haali n daŋ kpa n Duma
du n balaa gba ni,
baala ni haana maa ni.
30N daŋ ɛɛ nuukpuuri wia
chiŋ ni hɛri maa biine,
nɛkpui, niŋ ani nyɔɔzi
daŋ tɔ bɔr maa.
31Wiizi daŋ bir biri,
baagu ge bir aah
lugɔ chal mɔɔ,
ka mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi
Hɔpizii la wia
n dɔɔ ɔnsii werge la jaa ba.
32Nɛr la maa n niŋ yir Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ, ú lɛɛu,
u daŋ lɛɛu.
Baŋhina daŋ na lɛɛi lii Jɛrusalɛm biini,
banla miŋ lizɛɛ
daŋ na bahinaa.”

english_text:
The Lord Will Judge the Nations
1At that time I, the Lord, will make Judah and Jerusalem prosperous again. 2Then in Judgment Valley I will bring together the nations that scattered my people Israel everywhere in the world, and I will bring charges against those nations. They divided up my land 3and gambled to see who would get my people; they sold boys and girls to pay for prostitutes and wine.
4 You people of Tyre and Sidon and you Philistines, why are you doing this? Are you trying to get even with me? I'll strike back before you know what's happened. 5You've taken my prized possessions, including my silver and gold, and carried them off to your temples. 6You have dragged the people of Judah and Jerusalem from their land and sold them to the Greeks.
7But I'll make the people of Judah determined to come home, and what happened to them will happen to you. 8I'll hand over your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, who live far away. I, the Lord, have spoken!
Judgment in Judgment Valley
9Say to the nations:
“Get ready for war!
Be eager to fight.
Line up for battle
and prepare to attack.
10 Make swords out of plows
and spears out of garden tools.
Strengthen every weakling.”
11Hurry, all you nations!
Come quickly.
Ask the Lord to bring
his warriors along.
12You must come now
to Judgment Valley,
where the Lord will judge
the surrounding nations.
13 They are a field of ripe crops.
Bring in the harvest!
They are grapes piled high.
Start trampling them now!
If our enemy's sins were wine,
every jar would overflow.
14Crowds fill Decision Valley.
The judgment day of the Lord
will soon be here—
15no light from the sun or moon,
and stars no longer shine.
16 From the heart of Jerusalem
the Lord roars like a lion,
shaking the earth and sky.
But the Lord is a fortress,
a place of safety
for his people Israel.
God Will Bless His People
17I am the Lord your God.
And you will know I live on Zion,
my sacred hill,
because Jerusalem will be sacred,
untouched by foreign troops.
18On that day, fruitful vineyards
will cover the mountains.
And your cattle and goats
that graze on the hills
will produce a lot of milk.
Streams in Judah
will never run dry;
a stream from my house
will flow in Acacia Valley.
19Egypt and Edom were cruel
and brutal to Judah,
without a reason.
Now their countries will become
a barren desert,
20but Judah and Jerusalem
will always have people.
21I, the Lord, live on Mount Zion.
I will punish the guilty
and defend the innocent.
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi daŋ di hɛssi hina seriya wia
1Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Saŋa bɛl daŋ wa hel,
ń kaa gil Juda
ni Jɛrusalɛm bir nyɛɛli.
2N daŋ chaali hɛssi maa hina,
di kpa baa ba
Jɛhɔsafat Waluu la.
Denii ń wa di baa seriya
dikuu gunla baŋ ɛɛ
n nɛra Izrɛl hina la wia.
Ba duŋŋi baabuu ba yaari hɛhjaŋa,
ka kpa n hɛri bɔnni.
3Ba ta kunaa bá na unla n niŋ dɔɔ n nɛra
bá ɛɛ u yoma.
Ba yoo biibaala ni biihaanaa,
di turgi sɛnsɛnna ni siŋ kim.
4Taaya, Saidɔn ani Filisti hɛssi maa, beedee ii ra nyiŋŋi ii ɛɛi? Ii ra nyiŋŋuu ií turgiŋ wiibɛl kim gɛɛ? Di gunnɛ, n daŋ bir turgi ia manaŋ, 5dikuubɛɛwiai, ii chigɔ n saliŋhuŋŋa, n saliŋ ani n daama kunaa ga du ii vuga diini biine. 6Ii yoo Juda ni Jɛrusalɛm hinaa tɛɛ Giris hina, guŋ gil ba du nɛɛ ni ba himmaa hɛri.
7Awia, n daŋ lizi baa lii hɛssi la iiŋ yoo baa tɛɛ la biine. N daŋ ɛɛ ia gunla iiŋ ɛɛ baa la. 8N daŋ gil ba yoo ii biibaala ni ii biihaana tɛɛ Juda hina, ba ge bir yoo baa tɛɛ Saba hina, bɔr la n waa duglɛɛ tama maa la. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.
9Ií sii guŋ tɛɛ hɛssi hina.
Ií ɛɛ laal sirya!
Ií du a laallɔɔra bɔkpega!
Ií gil ba maa lii ga pig baa!
10Ií kpa ii para luu tokobizi,
di kpa ii daazi kɛuraa kizizi
luu kandaazi.
Ií gil banla gba n waa fɔŋŋa dɔɔwɛ ŋɔ,
‘N kpekkoo!’
11Hɛssi la maa n du kɛraa, ií ba manaŋ,
ií ba manaŋ
wa chaali de.”
Hoi, n Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil i laallɔɔra tuu ba!
12“Du hɛssi hina bɔkpega,
gil ba chaali
Jɛhɔsafat Waluu.
Denii ń so
di hɛssi hina maa seriya.
13Ba ɛɛ biinikpola hinaa,
ií ŋmɛnni baa dau lugɔ
banna kum mia la.
Ií fɛrgi baa lugɔ gunla baŋ ɔɔ fɛrgi grepuzi
n su a kuaribɔr,
guŋŋ a nii waa lii la.”
14Nɛkpila werge du
a Seriya Dii Waluu la biini.
Denii Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizii la
ba manaŋ.
15Wiizi ni baagu daŋ biri,
chinchiŋwilaa ge
wàá kaa ra chaani.
16Kɔraawiizi daŋ wii lugɔ bunyiŋ lii Bolzeŋ Ziɔn,
di pozi lugɔ dooŋ lii Jɛrusalɛm,
guŋ gil chiŋ ni
hɛri maa zigli.
Ama, Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ suahribɔttɛ tɛɛ u nɛra,
di ɛɛ diikpeg tɛɛ Izrɛl hina.
17Awia, ii daŋ zum lugɔ minuu Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum.
N du Bolzeŋ Ziɔnnɛ,
n bizennaniinanii la nyuu.
Jɛrusalɛm daŋ ɛɛ bolzennaniinanii,
hɔɔhra wàá ka wer
kpegluu maa.
18Di a saŋa wa hello, grepu daazi daŋ tɔ bizenaa nyuuni,
nauna su giŋgimee
maa nyuuni,
Juda gɔŋa maa suugi niiri.
Gɔŋ pal lii Kɔraawiizi Dia la biini
di ga pɛssi Akeesia Waluu.
19Ijip hɛri daŋ birgi diŋgela,
Ɛdɔm hɛri ge
birgi hɛribɔduma,
dikuu gunla baŋ kpu Juda hina,
di kpuuzi banla n waa
wichɔgii maa ɛɛwɛ wia.
20Ka nɛra daŋ du Juda ni Jɛrusalɛm,
jiminizi maa.
21Miŋ faa waa gillɛ tɛɛ baa dikuu baŋ kpu nɛra wia la,
n daŋ jaa gil tɛɛ baa.

english_text:
1 I am Amos. And I raised sheep near the town of Tekoa when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel.
Two years before the earthquake, the Lord gave me several messages about Israel, 2 and I said:
When the Lord roars
from Jerusalem,
pasturelands and Mount Carmel
dry up and turn brown.
Judgment on Syria
3 The Lord said:
I will punish Syria
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They dragged logs with spikes
over the people of Gilead.
4Now I will burn down the palaces
and fortresses of King Hazael
and of King Benhadad.
5I will break through
the gates of Damascus.
I will destroy the people
of Wicked Valley
and the ruler of Beth-Eden.
Then the Syrians will be dragged
as prisoners to Kir.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
Judgment on Philistia
6 The Lord said:
I will punish Philistia
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They dragged off my people
from town after town
to sell them as slaves
to the Edomites.
7That's why I will burn down
the walls and fortresses
of the city of Gaza.
8I will destroy the king of Ashdod
and the ruler of Ashkelon.
I will strike down Ekron,
and that will be the end
of the Philistines.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
Judgment on Phoenicia
9 The Lord said:
I will punish Phoenicia
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They broke their treaty
and dragged off my people
from town after town
to sell them as slaves
to the Edomites.
10That's why I will send flames
to burn down the city of Tyre
along with its fortresses.
Judgment on Edom
11 The Lord said:
I will punish Edom
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They killed their own relatives
and were so terribly furious
that they showed no mercy.
12Now I will send fire to wipe out
the fortresses of Teman
and Bozrah.
Judgment on Ammon
13 The Lord said:
I will punish Ammon
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
In Gilead they ripped open
pregnant women,
just to take the land.
14Now I will send fire to destroy
the walls and fortresses
of Rabbah.
Enemies will shout and attack
like a whirlwind.
15Ammon's king and leaders
will be dragged away.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_text:
1Baal bɛllɛ ba faa ra yir Emɔs, u ɛɛ penɔɔni di lii Tɛkua. U wiŋɔzii keŋ. Izrɛl wia la Kɔraawiizi n faa pillɛɛ bagluu binni anɛɛ mɔɔ, ka hɛri faa zigli werge labuu keŋ. A saŋa di Uzziaa faa Juda koori, Koori Jehoas biibaal Jeroboam ge faa di Izrɛl kora.
2Emɔs faa ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Kɔraawiizi baaŋ ra fuuuh,
u ra pogzi Bizeŋ Ziɔn nyuu,
di ra pogzi lugɔ dooŋ,
Jɛrusalɛm biini.
Sela diiribɔra maanii hillɛ,
Bizeŋ Kamɛl ge
nyuu kooree maa yɔl.”
Kɔraawiizi daŋ di Izrɛl hina dɔŋahina seriya
3Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ,
“Bolzeŋ Damaskus hina
ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ digiidigii.
Awia, n daŋ haŋ tɛr ba dignaa,
dikuu baŋ tɔɔri Giliad hina
sikpegii ni werge wia.
4Awia, n daŋ gil niŋ fuuh kooridia la
Koori Hazɛl n mawɛɛ
ni Koori Bɛn Hadad
diikpega la.
5N daŋ chɔgi bolzeŋ Damaskus domininuuzeŋ la,
di lalli nɛra la n soge
Avɛn Waluu ni
Bɛf Ɛdɛn koori.
Ba daŋ lauri Siiria hina
kaali Kir hɛri.”
6Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ,
“Bolzeŋ Gaza hina ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ digiidigii,
awia, n daŋ haŋ
tɛr ba dignaa,
dikuu baŋ lauri hɛri bɛl nɛra maa,
di yoo tɛɛ Ɛdɔm hina wia.
7N daŋ kpa niŋ du bolzeŋ Gaza koŋlaa ni,
ú fuuh u diikpega maa.
8N daŋ lizi bolzenaa Asdɔd
ni Askɛlɔn koora.
N daŋ tɛr bolzeŋ Ɛkrɔn hina digna,
guŋŋ Filisti hina la maa
n kawɛɛ la wa siuzi.”
9Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ,
“Bolzeŋ Taaya hina ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ digiidigii,
awia, n daŋ haŋ
tɛr ba dignaa,
dikuu baŋ lauri hɛri bɛl nɛra maa,
di yoo tɛɛ Ɛdɔm hina,
di chɔgi ba ni baa
nuukpaŋ la wia.
10N daŋ kpa niŋ du
bolzeŋ Taaya hina koŋlaa ni,
ú diikpega maa fuuh.”
11Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ,
“Ɛdɔm hina ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ digiidigii,
awia, n daŋ haŋ
tɛr ba dignaa,
dikuu baŋ dau ba lulla Izrɛl hina luge,
di kpu baa,
ba waa ba ni sunne wia.
Ba baaŋfuuih waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ,
ba waa gillɛ u sɔɔni.
12Awia, n daŋ kpa niŋ
du bolzeŋ Tɛman ni,
di fuuh bolzeŋ
Bɔzra diikpega.”
13Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ,
“Ammɔn hina ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ digiidigii,
awia, n daŋ haŋ
tɛr ba dignaa,
dikuu baŋ faa lɔ laal, di ra nyiŋŋi hɛri ba jaa,
haali di yalli
Giliad hina haana la
n kpogli hizi la, hizi wia.
14N daŋ kpa niŋ
di du bolzeŋ Raba koŋlaa ni,
di fuuh u diikpega.
Ba daŋ lɔ wile, laal hɔpizii,
a laal du kpeg
alugɔ dooŋ pekpeg.
15Ba daŋ lau ba koori ni u nabɔnzi
kaali hɛrduma.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

english_text:
Judgment on Moab
1 The Lord said:
I will punish Moab
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They made lime from the bones
of the king of Edom.
2Now I will send fire to destroy
the fortresses of Kerioth.
Battle shouts and trumpet blasts
will be heard as I destroy Moab
3with its king and leaders.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
Judgment on Judah
4The Lord said:
I will punish Judah
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They have rejected my teachings
and refused to obey me.
They were led astray
by the same false gods
their ancestors worshiped.
5Now I will send fire on Judah
and destroy the fortresses
of Jerusalem.
Judgment on Israel
6The Lord said:
I will punish Israel
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They sell honest people for money,
and the needy are sold
for the price of sandals.
7They smear the poor in the dirt
and push aside
those who are helpless.
My holy name is dishonored,
because fathers and sons sleep
with the same young women.
8They lie down beside altars
on clothes taken
as security for loans.
And they drink wine in my temple,
wine bought with the money
they received from fines.
9 Israel, the Amorites were there
when you entered Canaan.
They were tall as cedars
and strong as oaks.
But I wiped them out—
I destroyed their branches
and their roots.
10I had rescued you from Egypt,
and for forty years I had led you
through the desert.
Then I gave you the land
of the Amorites.
11 I chose some of you
to be prophets
and others to be Nazirites.
People of Israel,
you know this is true.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
12But you commanded the prophets
not to speak their message,
and you pressured the Nazirites
into drinking wine.
13And so I will crush you,
just as a wagon full of grain
crushes the ground.
14No matter how fast you run,
you won't escape.
No matter how strong you are,
you will lose your strength
and your life.
15Even if you are an expert
with a bow and arrow,
you will retreat.
And you won't get away alive,
not even if you run fast
or ride a horse.
16You may be brave and strong,
but you will run away,
stripped naked.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_text:
1Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ,
“Moab hina ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ digiidigii,
awia, n daŋ haŋ
tɛr ba dignaa.
Ba faa waa Ɛdɔm koori hoga tɔgzɛɛ,
dikuu baŋ fuuah,
a birgi hɔɔhri wia.
2N daŋ du Moab hɛri niŋ,
di fuuh bolzeŋ
Kɛriɔf diikpega.
Moab hina daŋ siu laal kɔɔi biini,
saŋa la laallɔɔra
n ninna chaasi,
ka bensunozi ge ra wii la.
3N daŋ kpu Moab koori
ni a hɛri sitɔɔra maa.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”
4Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ,
“Juda hina ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ digiidigii,
awia, n daŋ haŋ
tɛr ba dignaa,
dikuu baŋ vɛɛ n Gbɔgni hiŋaa,
di kaa vɛɛ n widaulaa
gba hiŋaa wia.
Vuga la himmaa ba naabaala n faa ra kuari la,
dar baabuu ba leu.
5Awia, n daŋ kpa niŋ du Juda,
ú fuuh diikpega la
n du Jɛrusalɛm la.”
Kɔraawiizi n di Izrɛl hina seriya wia
6Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ,
“Izrɛl hina ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ digiidigii,
awia, n daŋ haŋ
tɛr ba dignaa,
dikuu baŋ yoo nɛra la wia n deŋlee di lɛɛ saliŋhuŋŋa wia.
Di kpa nyaara la ge
n di kima yoo,
haali a kima n wàá wer
yau gawa gba.
7Ba ɔɔ ra fɛrgi nyaaraa,
alugɔ hɛɛhraa,
di vɛɛ wibii dii
tɛɛ nɛsunne.
Mɛɛ ni u biibaal maa ɔɔ kpau haannɛ,
a gunna chɔgi n
Sɔnnaniinanii la.
8Ba ɔɔ chɔɔgi talma laala ninɛɛ,
bá vuga kuaribɔra.
Di ra nyɔɔ siŋkpega la baŋ foozee lii ba kindiire be,
n Dia biini.
9N nɛra, ii wiarɛ n kuu
dim Amɔri hina,
haali baŋ faa ɛɛ nɛjaŋra lugɔ hɛriŋkpol daazi,
di du kpeg lugɔ
daazeŋ gba.
10N lizi iabuuu lii Ijip hɛri,
di tɔ ii see hɛribɔduma biini,
binni tokkoanɛɛ,
di wa kpa Amɔri hina hɛri
tɛɛ ia.
11N kaa lizi ii biibaala baŋhina ba ɛɛ n dɔgtɛɛzi,
di gil ii biipɔllaa baŋhina ge
birgi Nazirizi.
Izrɛl hina, guŋ waa wibii ɛɛwɛa?
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ!
12Ka ii gillɔɔ a Nazirizi nyɔɔ siŋ.
Di ŋɔ n dɔgtɛɛzi ge
gilɛɛ ka lizi n amaniye.
13Awia, filaŋkeŋ, n daŋ taagi ia ha
gunla mia n ɔɔ
su torko di ga bɛri,
u naazi ɔɔ tuu la.
14Banla n gbaŋŋɛ chɔi biini wàá lii,
banla ge n kpekke la
bɔra daŋ huah.
Laallɔɔra gba wàá piri.
15Hotaara gba daŋ bir har.
Laallɔɔra la ge
n na chɔ werge wàá lii.
Banla n tinni zagra ge gba,
wàá na bahinaa.
16A hɔl hiŋ, laallɔɔra la n dɔɔ bampiree werge,
daŋ kpa ba dɔŋkuna ha,
ka chɔ ra nyiŋŋi
ba nyuuni bɔr.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

english_text:
1People of Israel,
I rescued you from Egypt.
Now listen to my judgment
against you.
2Of all nations on earth,
you are the only one
I have chosen.
That's why I will punish you
because of your sins.
The Work of a Prophet
3Can two people walk together
without agreeing to meet?
4Does a lion roar in the forest
unless it has caught
a victim?
Does it growl in its den
unless it is eating?
5How can anyone catch a bird
without using a net?
Does a trap spring shut
unless something is caught?
6Isn't the whole city frightened
when the trumpet
signals an attack?
Isn't the Lord the one who brings
disaster on a city?
7Whatever the Lord God
plans to do,
he tells his servants,
the prophets.
8Everyone is terrified
when a lion roars—
and ordinary people
become prophets
when the Lord God speaks.
Samaria Is Doomed
9Here is a message
for the leaders
of Philistia and Egypt—
tell everyone to come together
on the hills of Samaria.
Let them see the injustice
and the lawlessness
in that city.
10The Lord has said
that they don't even know how
to do right.
They have become rich
from violence and robbery.
11And so the Lord God has sworn
that they will be surrounded.
Enemies will break through
their defenses
and steal their treasures.
12The Lord has promised
that only a few from Samaria
will escape with their lives
and with some broken pieces
of their beds and couches.
It will be like when a shepherd
rescues two leg bones
and part of a sheep's ear
from the jaws of a lion.
The Altars at Bethel
13The Lord God All-Powerful
told me to speak this message
against Jacob's descendants:
14 When I, the Lord, punish Israel
for their sins,
I will destroy the altars
at Bethel.
Even the corners of the altar
will be left in the dirt.
15I will tear down winter homes
and summer homes.
Houses decorated with ivory
and all other mansions
will be gone forever.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_text:
1Izrɛl hina, ií ra nuu Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii naa uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ di ra du ii ni naa. Iabuu u kpogli lii Ijip hɛri la.
2Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Ii bɛnnɛ n lizi
lii durnya nɛra maa biini.
Awia, n daŋ tɛr ii digna,
dikuu ii wichɔgaa wia.
3Nɛra banɛɛ daŋ wer kpau vol,
di ba waa nuukpaŋ dɔɔwɛa?
4Bunyiŋ ɔɔ ra pogzuu kɔr biini,
di waa kuŋ lauwɛaa?
U ɔɔ ra uuhruu, ú chɔɔribɔr
di waa kumbɛl lauwɛaa?
5Sidɛɛ haa lau zumbee,
di ba wɔɔ hewee lɛiyaa?
Sidɛɛ ɔɔ tau,
di kummaa wɔɔ fɛrɛɛa?
6Ba haa lɔ kantimantɔ bolzeŋ,
di a bol hina bɔra waa saa?
Di hɛhchɔg chol bolzeŋ ni,
Kɔraawiizi lɛi ba u nii?
7Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la
haa waa wiimaa ɛɛwɛ,
di waa a widee lizɛɛ
bagli u balaa dɔgtɛɛzi.
8Di bunyiŋ pozoo,
anɛɛ n wàá ɔmɛi?
Di Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔ wia,
anɛɛ n wàá lizi u amaniyei?
9Ií ŋɔ Asdɔd ni Ijip koori diikpega be,
‘Ií chaali giŋgimee la
n bar bolzeŋ Samaria la nyuuni,
di na gunla a bolzeŋ
n na koozi
ani nɛsunnaa la
n su de.’ ”
10Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“A nɛra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ,
di foozi kuna wa su ba diini,
ba wia waa wibii dɔɔwɛ.”
11Awia, kenne mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔ,
“Gunnɛ ba dɔma ba, di wa gor ba hɛri,
di purgi ba diikpega,
ka paagi ba
diizenaa kuna.”
12Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Gunla penɔɔni n ɔɔ wer,
lɛɛ peezi la bunyiŋ
n lauwɛ di ra di,
naazi anɛɛ gɛɛ u digni bɛŋ la,
gunnɛ bolzeŋ Samaria hina la,
n chɔɔgi bá karnanaa ni la,
tama wa ka.”
13Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“A nuu n be, di karfi Jekɔb dee.
14A hɔl la min niŋ tɛrgi Izrɛl hina digna,
dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia la,
n daŋ chɔgi mbusu lizibɔra la
n du Bɛtɛl la,
di purgi mbusu lizibɔra
maa nyigzi ta.
15N daŋ chɔgi waari saŋa
ni wem saŋa diini la,
di purgi diini la
baŋ kpa bala nyina bɔg la,
di chɔgi diizenaa maa.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

english_text:
The Women of Samaria
The Lord said:
1You women of Samaria
are fat cows!
You mistreat and abuse
the poor and needy,
then you say to your husbands,
“Bring us more drinks!”
2I, the Lord God, have sworn
by my own name
that your time is coming.
Not one of you will be left—
you will be taken away
by sharp hooks.
3You will be dragged through holes
in your city walls,
and you will be thrown
toward Harmon.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
Israel Refuses To Obey
The Lord said:
4Come to Bethel and Gilgal.
Sin all you want!
Offer sacrifices the next morning
and bring a tenth of your crops
on the third day.
5Bring offerings to show me
how thankful you are.
Gladly bring more offerings
than I have demanded.
You really love to do this.
I, the Lord God, have spoken!
How the Lord Warned Israel
6 I, the Lord, took away the food
from every town and village,
but still you rejected me.
7Three months before harvest,
I kept back the rain.
Sometimes I would let it fall
on one town or field
but not on another,
and pastures dried up.
8People from two or three towns
would go to a town
that still had water,
but it wasn't enough.
Even then you rejected me.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
9I dried up your grain fields;
your gardens and vineyards
turned brown.
Locusts ate your fig trees
and olive orchards,
but even then you rejected me.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
10I did terrible things to you,
just as I did to Egypt—
I killed your young men in war;
I let your horses be stolen,
and I made your camp stink
with dead bodies.
Even then you rejected me.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
11 I destroyed many of you,
just as I did the cities
of Sodom and Gomorrah.
You were a burning stick
I rescued from the fire.
But even then you rejected me.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
12Now, Israel, I myself
will deal with you.
Get ready to face your God!
13I created the mountains
and the wind.
I let humans know
what I am thinking.
I bring darkness at dawn
and step over hills.
I am the Lord God All-Powerful!
translation_text:
Izrɛl hina n waa bittɛ ba Kɔraawiizi be wia
1Emɔs kaa ŋɔ,
“Samaria haana,
ií ra nuu wii naa,
ii banla n na pɔl lugɔ
Basan hɛri nauna la
n na di nɛnnɛ,
banla n na tɔɔri gɛrga,
di ra sunni nyaara,
di ra nyiŋŋi ii janna
ra tɛɛ ia siŋ la!
2Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa,
di ɛɛ naniinanii la hɛɛhzɔɔrɛ,
di ŋɔ,
‘Saŋa bɛl daŋ wa hel,
bá kpa gɔrgazi lauri ia di ra tɛrgi,
ii bɛl maa daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ nyiŋ,
gɔrga n lauwɛ.
3Ba daŋ tɛrgi ia guŋŋ
di ga kpa ia
ga koŋlii bɔperii,
di ha bossee.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.’ ”
4Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Izrɛl hina,
ií la bɔnaniinanii la
n du Bɛtɛl la,
di ga ɛɛ wichɔgaa!
Ií la Gilgal di ga ɛɛ wichɔgaa
ni ii fɔŋŋa maa,
di ii ra nyiŋŋi guŋ.
Ií kpa ii mbusuzi lizaa sela
di ra ba chɔɔzi maa,
di kpa ii kuna bɔra fizi bɔkpaŋkpaŋa,
di ra ba hɔpizaa
ahoro maa biini.
5Ií kpa paanuu la n dɔɔ yiisi
di lizi mbusu ra tɛɛ
mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ,
di ra jigsi dikuu ii sunzaazi wia!
Wia naa dɔŋaa ii ɔɔ nɔŋŋi ɛɛi.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.
6Minuu faa gillɛ lɔzi chol
ii bolzenaa maa biine,
diwee nyaa bol maa biini,
ka ii waa sɛɛwɛ bir ba n be.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.
7Minuu faa gillɛ dooŋ chi,
saŋa la ii pattikuna
n na nyiŋŋi dooŋ werge la.
Minuu faa gillɛ dooŋ ba
bolzeŋ bɛl, ka gil bɛl,
di gil u ba koo bɛl,
ka gil bɛl, u hil.
8Niinyɔgzi faa lau nɛra, ba ra bɛɛli,
di ra gaagi bolzenaa,
di ra nyiŋŋi nii bá nyɔɔ,
ka ba waa nii nawɛɛ, a kukki baa,
ka ii waa bittɛ ba n be.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.
9N faa gillɔɔ peu la n na haahri,
wa chɔgi ii pattikuna.
Lotorozi di ii kambola, ii grepu daazi kooni,
fig ni ɔlivi daazi maa.
Ka ii waa sɛɛwɛ bir ba n be.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.
10N faa kpa wiilchɔgaarɛ ta ii ni,
alugɔ unla miŋ faa kpawɛɛ
ta Ijip hina ni la.
N faa kpu ii biipɔllaa laal biini,
ka lauri ii zagra kaali.
Lalaa sɔɔh lii ii chɔɔribɔra maa biine,
di su ii miibɔɔni,
ka ii waa bittɛ ba n be.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.
11N faa kpu ii baŋhinaa,
gunla miŋ faa kpu
Sɔdɔm ni Gɔmɔra hina la.
Ii banla n kawɛɛ lii a laal biini
ɛɛ lugɔ daa la
baŋ lizɛɛ niŋ biini,
ka ii waa bittɛ ba n be.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.
12Awia, Izrɛl hina,
n daŋ tɛr ii digna,
dikuu guŋ wia,
ií ɛɛ sirya ń di ia seriya.”
13Kɔraawiizii ta bizenaa ni peu,
di ɔɔ gil newee zum u nfɛrɛ,
di gil hɔpizaa birgi hamuŋa,
di ra vol bizenaa nyuuni.
U sɔnnɛ Kɔraawiizi
Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ!

english_text:
Turn Back to the Lord
1Listen, nation of Israel,
to my mournful message:
2You, dearest Israel, have fallen,
never to rise again—
you lie deserted in your own land,
with no one to help you up.
3The Lord God has warned,
“From every ten soldiers
only one will be left;
from a thousand troops,
only a hundred will survive.”
4The Lord keeps saying,
“Israel, turn back to me
and you will live!
5Don't go to Gilgal or Bethel
or even to Beersheba.
Gilgal will be dragged away,
and Bethel will end up
as nothing.”
6Turn back to the Lord,
you descendants of Joseph,
and you will live.
If you don't, the Lord
will attack like fire.
Bethel will burn to the ground,
and no one can save it.
7You people are doomed!
You twist the truth
and trample on justice.
8 But the Lord created the stars
and put them in place.
He turns darkness to dawn
and daylight to darkness;
he scoops up the ocean
and empties it on the earth.
9God destroys mighty soldiers
and strong fortresses.
Choose Good Instead of Evil!
The Lord said:
10You people hate judges
and honest witnesses;
11you abuse the poor and demand
heavy taxes from them.
You have built expensive homes,
but you won't enjoy them;
you have planted vineyards,
but you will get no wine.
12I am the Lord, and I know
your terrible sins.
You cheat honest people
and take bribes;
you rob the poor of justice.
13Times are so evil
that anyone with good sense
will keep quiet.
14If you really want to live,
you must stop doing wrong
and start doing right.
I, the Lord God All-Powerful,
will then be on your side,
just as you claim I am.
15Choose good instead of evil!
See that justice is done.
Maybe I, the Lord All-Powerful,
will be kind to what's left
of your people.
Judgment Is Coming
16This is what the Lord has sworn:
Noisy crying will be heard
in every town and street.
Even farmers will be told
to mourn for the dead,
together with those
who are paid to mourn.
17Your vineyards will be filled
with crying and weeping,
because I will punish you.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
When the Lord Judges
18You look forward to the day
when the Lord comes to judge.
But you are in for trouble!
It won't be a time of sunshine;
all will be darkness.
19You will run from a lion,
only to meet a bear.
You will escape to your house,
rest your hand on the wall,
and be bitten by a snake.
20The day when the Lord judges
will be dark, very dark,
without a ray of light.
What the Lord Demands
21 I, the Lord, hate and despise
your religious celebrations
and your times of worship.
22I won't accept your offerings
or animal sacrifices—
not even your very best.
23No more of your noisy songs!
I won't listen
when you play your harps.
24But let justice and fairness
flow like a river
that never runs dry.
25 Israel, for forty years
you wandered in the desert,
without bringing offerings
or sacrifices to me.
26Now you will have to carry
the two idols you made—
Sakkuth, the one you call king,
and Kaiwan, the one you built
in the shape of a star.
27I will force you to march
as captives beyond Damascus.
I, the Lord God All-Powerful,
have spoken!
translation_text:
Wichɔgaa gilaa ta wia
1Izrɛl hina, ií ra nuu maaraa yira naa minna yir, dikuu ii wia naa.
2“Izrɛl hɛri la n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ toloori cholloo,
wàá ka izi maa.
U chɔɔ hɛrii, ba vɛɛu ta,
nɛr maa waa hoo,
ú lalluu.”
3Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Izrɛl hina bolzeŋ la maa
laallɔɔra kagboŋ n niŋ la laal,
kalfa bɛnnɛ niŋ ka.
Di laallɔɔra kalfa genii,
fi bɛnnɛ niŋ ka.”
4Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ tɛɛ Izrɛl hina,
“Ií ba n be di wa na miibɔɔ.
5Ií gilɛɛ waa la Bɛtɛl,
di gilɛɛ waa la Gilgal,
di gilɛɛ waa la
bolzeŋ Bɛɛsiba,
dikuubɛɛwiai, ba daŋ lauri Gilgal hina
kaali hɛrduma,
Bɛtɛl hina ge dim.”
6Emɔs ŋɔ,
“Ií la Kɔraawiizi be, di ga na miibɔɔ.
Di ii waa laŋŋɛ,
u daŋ tuu ba Joosɛf diahina
ni alugɔ niŋ.
A niŋ daŋ fuuh Bɛtɛl hina,
nɛr maa wàá wer dinzuu.
7Hinla maa n waa wibii ŋmɛnɛɛ ra hiŋ,
ka ra fini nɛra, wiarɛ huuzii.
8Kɔraawiizii ta chinchinwilaa,
ba ra yir aŋhina Kuzenibalaa,
aŋhina ge Belimbetia.
U ɔɔ giluu hamuŋa birgi hɔpizaa,
di gil hɔpizaa birgi hamuŋa.
U ɔɔ ɛɛ muuzenaa niirii,
di bizaa ta hɛri ni.
U sɔnnɛ Kɔraawiizi.
9U ɔɔ kpu nɛkpegaa,
di chɔgi ba diikpega.
10Ii hah nɛra la
n na di wibiire.
11Ii fir nyaaraa,
di foozi ba mia.
Guŋ wia, ii wàá zuu diizenaa la
iiŋ kpa bia ma la biine
gɛɛ di nyɔɔ grepu
koonanaa la iiŋ pattɛ la siŋ.
12N zum gunla ii wichɔgaa n chummɛnɛ,
di zum a maga.
Ii sunni nɛra la n waa bilchɔg maa dɔɔwɛɛ, di lɛɛ kuna,
ka gil nyaara di bilchɔg,
seriya diiribɔr.
13Awia, nunzunna ɔɔ tɔɔgi ba nuuzii, a saŋa hiŋ,
dikuubɛɛwiai, a guŋ saŋa waa wer.
14Ií ra nyiŋŋi winanaa ɛɛi, ka gil wichɔgaa,
gunnɛ niŋ gil ii dɔɔ miibɔɔni.
A guŋ ge daŋ gil Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ du ii be,
gunla iiŋ ŋɔwɛɛ lugɔ
u du ii benii la.
15Ií hah wichɔgaa ka nɔŋŋi winanaa,
di gil ba ra di wibii
seriya diiribɔra.
Aŋhinabe, Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ
daŋ suŋ Joosɛf dee la
n kawɛɛ la ni.”
16Awia, Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Ba danna lɔɔgi wilee ŋmɛnizi maa,
di ra wii ni biinichɔg
bossibaana maa.
Ba daŋ yir koola, bá wa wii,
ka liwiire ge ra chɛɛhgi.
17Ba danna wii grepu
daazi kooni maa biine,
dikuu min niŋ ga
ii biini wa kaali wia.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”
Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizii wia
18Emɔs ŋɔ,
“Wia daŋ huuzi nɛr la maa
n na nyiŋŋi lugɔ
Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizii la hel.
Bɛɛwiarɛ i ra nyiŋŋi u helei?
A hɔl daŋ ɛɛ bɔbiri,
wàá ɛɛ bɔchaaŋ.
19A daŋ ɛɛu lugɔ
nɛr n chɔwɛɛ lii bunyiŋ be,
di ga chem amani ni,
gɛɛ nɛr n zuu dia,
di kpa u nonii sag koŋlii ni,
hɛrikuŋ dumuu.
20Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizii la daŋ ɛɛ bɔbirii, bɔr waa chaani,
u daŋ ɛɛu limpiriŋ,
bɔchaaŋ kilakila maa wàá du de.”
21Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“Maa ii hɔpizizenaa ra nyiŋŋi,
n kii a wiarɛ,
maa chigɛ ra guua.
22Haali iiŋ ɔɔ lizi mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa
ni mbusuzi lizaa mia gba,
ka màá lɛɛa.
Iiŋ ɔɔ kpa dɔŋa be chaalaa
mbusu lizaa sela la n pɔllɛ
di waa tɛŋ la,
ka màá lɛɛa.
23Ií gil ii kɔɔi yira la yiraa!
Maa nyiŋŋi n nuu
ii janjalanzi wiraa.
24Ií ɔɔ ra di wibii saŋa maa
lugɔ gɔŋ n na pal,
di gil ii wia deŋli saŋaa saŋa maa
lugɔ muu la n na pal,
waa hiihzaa dɔɔwɛ la.
25Izrɛl hina, binni tokkoanɛɛ la biini,
iiŋ du hɛribɔduma la,
ii faa lizi mbusuzi lizaa
ni sunzaazi kunaa tɛŋŋ?
26Dikuu iinna jaami ii vuga maa koori Sakuf
ni vug Kaiwan la iinna tɔgzi
ii daŋ kpaa chi,
27di n wa duŋŋi ia
bɛri Damaskus ni,
