Ka a ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ u chɔgi ii maa biine waarɛ. 6Ka gunla iiŋ ɛɛ nuukpaŋ di tɛr u digni dikuu u wichɔgaa wia la mɛgzɔɔrɛ. 7A wesso iin niŋ gil tɛu filaŋkeŋ di duu bɔkpega, u biínichɔg la gilɛɛ waa du kaŋ werge, di siili u ni. 8N na fɔrgi iabuu, ií kaa nɔŋŋuu gunla iiŋ faa nɔŋŋuu la. 9N faa sɛbi a hɔnnɛ tɛɛ ia, ń wer ɛɛ ia na, di ii daŋ sɛɛ tɛŋ ani wiimaa bɔr, gɛɛ ii wàá sɛɛ tɛnnɛi? 10Too. Nɛr la maa iin niŋ gil wia tɛɛ, n gba daŋ gil tɛɛ a hiŋ. Kristo ɛɛ n daansɛɛ hinnɛ. Di a hiŋ ɛɛŋ wii bɛl lugɔ min niŋ gil tɛu, n daŋ gil tɛu dikuu ii wia, 11Sitaani gilɛɛ wa na u ŋmɛnɛɛ di wer chɔgi yaa wia. Yaa zum u nɛdaraa wiarɛ.
Pɔɔl biinichɔg wia Troas biini wia
12Miŋ faa la Troas ń ga lizi Kristo amaniyesuma la, n na ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ de lugɔ ń hum n Dɔɔri, 13ka n bampirii faa waa kpaŋ ɛɛwɛ, dikuu miŋ faa waa n dɔŋhiŋ Taitus la nawɛɛ de wia. Awia, n gil baabuu ka la Masɛdɔnia hɛri.
14Ama, Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ jaannɛ. U ɔɔ kpegli u dɔmaa, di kpa yaa ra vol u bɔsɔna volaa la biini, dikuu yaa ni Kristo n kpauwɛ wia, di ɔɔ gil yaa zumuu, u zumaa du yaa ni alugɔ daahɛgsɔɔhsuma aŋhina, nɛ́ra wer nuu a sɔɔh bɔr maa. 15Yaa ɛɛ daahɛgsɔɔhsumaa Kɔraawiizi be dikuu Kristo n du yaa ni wia. Banla unna lɛɛ ani banla n leuwe ra siuzi maa daŋ nuu a sɔɔh. 16Baŋhina daŋ nuu a sɔɔh siuzi, baŋhina ge nuu a sɔɔh na miibɔɔ. Anɛɛ n wer huma naanɛi? 17Nɛkpila ɔɔ kpa Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii lugɔ kumbɛl di yoo ra di. Yaa ni baa waa kpaŋ ɛɛwɛ. Yaa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi huŋhunnaa. U benii yaa na a wiŋɔzi. U benii yaa ra ŋɔa ani biinihuŋŋu, Yeesu Kristo fɔŋŋa biini.

english_text:
God's New Agreement
1Are we once again bragging about ourselves? Do we need letters to you or from you to tell others about us? Some people do need letters telling about them. 2But you are our letter, and you are in our hearts for everyone to read and understand. 3 You are like a letter written by Christ and delivered by us. But you are not written with pen and ink or on tablets made of stone. You are written in our hearts by the Spirit of the living God.
4We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God. 5We don't have the right to claim that we have done anything on our own. God gives us what it takes to do all we do. 6 He makes us worthy to be the servants of his new agreement that comes from the Holy Spirit and not from a written Law. After all, the Law brings death, but the Spirit brings life.
7 The Law of Moses brought only the promise of death, even though it was carved on stones and given in a wonderful way. Still the Law made Moses' face shine so brightly the people of Israel could not look at it, even though it was a fading glory. 8So won't the agreement the Spirit brings to us be even more wonderful? 9If something that brings the death sentence is glorious, won't something that makes us acceptable to God be even more glorious? 10In fact, the new agreement is so wonderful that the Law is no longer glorious at all. 11The Law was given with a glory that faded away. But the glory of the new agreement is much greater, because it will never fade away.
12This wonderful hope makes us feel like speaking freely. 13 We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away. 14The people were stubborn, and something still keeps them from seeing the truth when the Law is read. Only Christ can take away the covering that keeps them from seeing.
15When the Law of Moses is read, they have their minds covered over 16 with a covering that is removed only for those who turn to the Lord. 17The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free. 18 So our faces are not covered. They show the bright glory of the Lord, as the Lord's Spirit makes us more and more like our glorious Lord.
translation_text:
1Yaa n na ŋɔ wia kennaa naa, amɔ, yaa kaa ra chɔli yaa hinaarɛ, di ra nyiŋŋi ii sɛɛ tɛɛ yaa gɛɛ? Baŋhina ɔɔ nyiŋŋi hɔnaa, á hɔna bagli ba huma wia gunla aŋ wesse. Ii wàá ra nyiŋŋi a guŋ hɔna yaawaa be, dikuu yaa n zum dɔŋa wia. Gunnɛ yaa wàá ra nyiŋŋi a guŋ hɔna ii ge be la. 2Ii himmaanii ɛɛ yaa hɔna, di ra bagli hunnanaa la yaa n hummɛ. Yaa bampireere ba sɛbi ia du, nɛ́r maa wer naa ra karmi. 3Ii ɛɛ Kristo hɔnaa uŋ gillɛ yaa hiinuu sɛbi. Iŋki lɛi ba kpa sɛbaa. Kɔraawiizi Dumaa ba kpa sɛbaa. Bii ni lɛi ba sɛbaa. Ii bampiree biinee ba sɛbaa.
4Yaa dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi tamiirɛ guŋ, dikuu Kristo wia. 5A waa ɛɛwɛ lugɔ yaa wiimaa du denii yaa n niŋ tami u ni. Di yaa dɔɔ wiimaa yaa n niŋ ɛɛ u tamii, amɔ, Kɔraawiizi benii u lii.
6Waabuu gillɛ yaa wer u nuukpaŋfalii dɔɔi huma humaa. U nuukpaŋfalii naa waa Gbɔg la baŋ sɛbɛɛ dau wia ɛɛwɛ. U Dumnanii wiarɛ. Gbɔg la baŋ sɛbɛɛ dau la ra kpuu. U Dumnanii la ge ra tɛɛ nɛra miibɔɔ.
7Moosis Gbɔg la, Kɔraawiizi faa sɛɛh a nambazii a chɔɔ bii ni. Uŋ faa kpaa tɛɛ Moosis la, u gillɔɔ u na u girme. U girme n chaani Moosis siwee ni la, u siwee ge bir ra nyɛgzi werge maa. A faa waa nyɛgzɛɛ werge guŋ di ra la, ka a faa ra tunuu. Anna tuŋ la, ka Izrɛl hina faa waa wette ba binni u siwee dikuu unna nyɛgzi la wia. Too. Di wia la n faa ra kpu labuu dɔɔ girme guŋ, 8amɔ, Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii wia wàá dɔɔ girme werge kaali guŋ? 9Di wia la n faa ra tɛɛ nɛra chɔgri, faa dɔɔ girme werge guŋ, anla n ɛɛ wideŋlaa wia wàá dɔɔ girme werge maa kaali guŋŋ? 10Wia la n faa dɔɔ girme werge la, ka filaŋkeŋ a waa kaa dɔɔ girme, dikuubɛɛwiai, a falaa girme la kaalaabuu werge. 11A binaa la n na tuŋ la, a faa ballɔɔ ani girme. Ka a falaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la, dɔɔ girmee kaalaa.
12Yaa n dɔɔ a falaa la tamii naa, yaa dɔɔ bampiriire werge. 13Moosis la siwee n faa ra nyɛgzi werge ka ra dim tama tama la, u faa kpa saata bɛllɛ tɔ u siwee hiŋ ni, Ízrɛl hina gilɛɛ na guŋ. 14Izrɛl hina siwee faa tɔwɔɔrɛ. Filaŋkennaa gba, a haa tɔwɔɔrɛ. Banna karmi nuukpambinii wia la, ka a haa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ saata la haa tɔ ba siweere, dikuubɛɛwiai, di ba waa Kristo wia sɛɛwɛ, wàá wer lii ba siwee. 15Banna karmi Moosis hɔna la, saata la tɔ ba nfɛssii haali zinaa.
16Ka unla maa n niŋ binni u Dɔɔri, u Dɔɔri hiŋ daŋ lizi saata la u siwee. 17Kɔraawiizi Dumaa ɛɛ u Dɔɔri la. Di Kɔraawiizi Duma du de, kummaa wàá wer tɔ bɔr. 18Awia, yaawaa maa, kummaa waa yaawaa siwee ra tɔ. Yaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ digee. U girme la ra chaani yaa ni, yaa ge ra chaani. U girme la ra birgi yaa gunla u ge n duwɛɛ la, yaa ɔɔ kaa du wer di haa vɛɛ du wer ra jaa. Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi Duma la benii a lii.

english_text:
Treasure in Clay Jars
1God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up. 2We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted. 3If there is anything hidden about our message, it is hidden only to someone who is lost.
4The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like. 5We are not preaching about ourselves. Our message is that Jesus Christ is Lord. He also sent us to be your servants. 6 The Scriptures say, “God commanded light to shine in the dark.” Now God is shining in our hearts to let you know that his glory is seen in Jesus Christ.
7We are like clay jars in which this treasure is stored. The real power comes from God and not from us. 8We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up. 9In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again. 10-11We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us. 12This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
13In the Scriptures it says, “I spoke because I had faith.” We have this same kind of faith. So we speak 14because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you. 15All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him.
Faith in the Lord
16We never give up. Our bodies are gradually dying, but we ourselves are being made stronger each day. 17These little troubles are getting us ready for an eternal glory that will make all our troubles seem like nothing. 18Things that are seen don't last forever, but things that are not seen are eternal. This is why we keep our minds on the things that cannot be seen.
translation_text:
Daama n du golaa biine wia
1Kɔraawiizi suŋ yaa ninɛɛ di tɛɛ yaa huma naa. Awia, a waa yaa bɔra ra huah. 2Yaa vɛɛ wia la baŋ ɔɔ suah ra ɛɛ, a dɔɔ hiihzi labuu. Yaa waa nɛra ra fugzi. Yaa waa Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii ra bir di ra kanni u nua. Yaa ra ŋɔ wibiire a chaani nɛnnɛ, nɛ́r maa wer zum u biini lugɔ yaa wiŋɔzi dɔɔ wibiire, Kɔraawiizi siibɔɔ. 3Di amaniyesuma la yaa n na lizi la suahwɔɔ baŋhina be, banla n leuwe ra siuzi benii a suah la. 4Sitaani la n dɔɔ durnya naa, ba ra tɔgzuu lugɔ Kɔraawiizi la tɔ ba nfɛssii. Waa nyiŋŋi amaniyesuma la n lii Kristo la n dɔɔ girme werge du alugɔ Kɔraawiizi n duwɛɛ la be wia wer chaani ba ni, bá zumuu. 5Yaa himmaa biine wia lɛi yaa ɔɔ ra ŋɔ. Yeesu Kristo wiarɛ yaa ra ŋɔ. U ɛɛ yaa maa Dɔɔrii, yaa ge ɛɛ ii balaa dikuu u wia. 6Kɔraawiizi la n faa ŋɔ bɔ́r chaani, bɔbiri la maa chaani la, waabuu chaani yaa ge biine, di chaani yaa siwee yaa wer zum u girmezeŋ la yaa n nawɛɛ Kristo ni la.
7Wia naa maa yaa n zummɛ naa, a maa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ baŋ ɔɔ kpa kunnanii du vii biini. Yaabuu a vii. Yaa waa kpeg. Ka u kpa u huma labuu tɛɛ yaa, yaa wer ra humaa. U ɛɛ gunnɛ, ú bagli lugɔ fɔŋŋazeŋ la lii u benii. Waa yaa be liwɛɛ. 8Yaa ɔɔ ra di tɔɔrɔɔ kpila maanii, ka a waa ɔɔ wer gɛrgi yaa wa tuŋ. Wia ɔɔ ra tir yaa, ka a waa ɔɔ wer ra chɔg yaa biine ga tuŋ. 9Nɛra ɔɔ ra ɛɛ yaa wichɔgaa, ka Kɔraawiiziwaa waa yaa gillɛ ta. Ba lɔɔzi yaa dau. Ka ba waa wette bá kpu yaa. 10Yaa sɛɛwɔɔ ya siu Yeesu siu, nɛ́ra wer na u miibɔɔ yaa ni. 11Yaa n haa dɔɔ miibɔɔ naa, siu biinii yaa ɔɔ haa du dikuu Yeesu wia la, ka nɛ́ra wer na u miibɔɔ yaa bɔrahɔnsiwaa la biini. 12A ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ yaawaa ra siwuu, ka iawaa ra na miibɔɔ yaa siu la biini.
13Ba faa sɛbɔɔrɛ, “N yardɔɔrɛ. Awiarɛ n ŋɔ a wia.” A guŋ yardaa yaa ge dɔɔ ra ŋɔ wia la. 14Yaa zummɔ lugɔ unla n lalli yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo siu biini la daŋ lalli yaa ge gba, yáa ni ia maa wer chi u be. 15Ii wiarɛ yaa ra ɛɛ a maa. Di nɛra ra sɛɛ Kɔraawiizi nɛsunaa la, ba wa du kaŋ ra jaa, jaaŋ la Kɔraawiizi n niŋ wa na de la daŋ wa du kaŋ jaa, ú na girme nɛnnɛ.
16Awia, a huma waa yaa bɔra ra huah. Yaa bɔrahɔna ra gɛrguu, ka yaa biine ra du kpeg hɔpizibii maa. 17Tɔɔrɔɔ tama naa n dɔɔ tunaa yaa ra di naa, ka u daŋ gil ya ŋmɛnɛ na girme u du kaŋ, di siili tɔɔrɔɔ naa ni werge maa wa bɛri, di du de di ra la. 18Kuna la yaa siwee n na na lɛi yaa ra binni. Ka anla yaa siwee n waa na la, aabuu yaa ra binni. Kuna la yaa n na na la daŋ ŋmɛnɛ tuŋ. Ka anla yaa n waa na lawaa daŋ du de, di hanna la.

english_text:
1 Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever. 2While we are here on earth, we sigh because we want to live in that heavenly home. 3We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.
4These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die. 5God is the one who makes all this possible. He has given us his Spirit to make us certain he will do it. 6So always be cheerful!
As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord. 7But we live by faith, not by what we see. 8We should be cheerful, because we would rather leave these bodies and be at home with the Lord. 9But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him. 10 After all, Christ will judge each of us for the good or the bad that we do while living in these bodies.
Bringing People to God
11We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are. 12We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
13If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good. 14We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died. 15And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
16We are careful not to judge people by what they seem to be, though we once judged Christ in this way. 17Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new. 18God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
19What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace. 20We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God. 21Christ never sinned! But God treated him as a sinner, so Christ could make us acceptable to God.
translation_text:
Yaa Kɔraawiizi bol dui wia
1Bɔrahɔna naa yaa n dɔɔwɛ naa ɛɛ yaa durnya biini diinii. Di ba chɔgaa tuŋ, ka yaa dɔɔ diinii Kɔraawiizi be um mawɛɛ. A daŋ ɔɔ du u be di ra la. Yaa Kɔraawiizi be bɔrahɔnaa a diini. 2Awia, yaa ɔɔ ra himuu dikuu yaa n ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi yaa Kɔraawiizi be bɔrahɔna la werge maa, ú kpa laali yaa wia. 3Di yaa wa naa, yaa wàá ka nyaa bɔrahɔna. 4Yaa n du bɔrahɔna naa biine naa, yaa ɔɔ ra himuu anna tɔɔri yaa. A waa lugɔ a lizaarɛ yaa ra nyiŋŋi werge. Ka anla laalaarɛ yaa ra nyiŋŋi werge. Denii anla n waa siu la, á lɛɛ anla n na siu la bɔr. 5Kɔraawiizii gillɛ yaa wer dɛg guŋ, di kpa u Dumnanii tɛɛ yaa, di ra bagli lugɔ u daŋ tɛɛ yaa u miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la.
6Awia, yaa ɔɔ dɔɔ bampiriire, dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa zummɔ lugɔ di yaa du yaa bɔrahɔna naa biine, yaa durnya biini diinii yaa du. Yaa waa hoo yaa Dɔɔri be, 7dikuubɛɛwiai, siwee lɛi yaa ɔɔ kpa zum yaa ŋmɛnɛɛ. Yardaa yaa ɔɔ kpa zumuu. 8Awia, yaa ɔɔ dɔɔ bampiriire di ra binni lugɔ di yaa gil bɔrahɔna naa n ɛɛ yaa diini naa, ka la ga du yaa Dɔɔri be, u gunnɛ bɔ. 9Awia, di yaa du bɔrahɔna naa biine gɛɛ di yaa du yaa Dɔɔri be, ka yaa ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋuu yáa wia maa wer paruu, 10dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa maa daŋ wa chi Yeesu Kristo seriya diiribɔr, bɛ́l maa na u wiɛɛlaa kinturgaa. Di a faa wesso gɛɛ di a faa waa wer genii, ka u daŋ na a maa kinturgaa.
Yaa ni Kɔraawiizi dammunaa dikuu Kristo wia
11Too. Yaa n zum kafɔŋ la n niŋ wa lau banla n niŋ chi yaa Dɔɔri be la wiarɛ yaa ra suŋŋi nɛra la. Ama, Kɔraawiizi teŋ tɛɛ yaabuu wibii. N na nyiŋŋi ii ge maa wer tɛɛ yaa wibii, ii biine. 12Yaa waa ŋɔ ya kaa chɔli yaa hinaa. Yaa ra nyiŋŋuu ya tɛɛ ia bɔr, ií wer chi de chɔli yaa banla n na chɔgi yaa la be. Ba ra binni wia la newea n na maŋkuri labuu, di nyiŋŋi sɔna ra tɛɛ bahinaa. Ba waa bampiree wia ra binni. 13Di ba ŋɔ yaa ra chugluu, Kɔraawiizi wiarɛ yaa ra chugli. Di ba ŋɔ yaa dɔɔ nfɛrɛ genii, ii hiinaa wiarɛ yaa dɔɔ nfɛrɛ la. 14Nɔŋŋaa la Kristo n nɔŋŋi yaa labuu ɔɔ gil yaa aah siwii. Gunla yaawaa n nawɛɛ, di nɛkpaŋ lɛɛ nɛr maa siu di siu, a ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nɛr maa siuwɔɔ. 15U lɛɛ ba siurɛ siu, bá gilɛɛ kaa du ba himmaa dui, ka jaa du unla n siuwɛ, Kɔraawiizi lalluu tɛɛ baa la dui.
16Awia, filaŋkeŋ, yaa waa kaa ra binni nɛra gunla newea n na binni baa, di ra maŋkuri baa la. Yaa faa ra binni Kristo gbaa guŋ, ka yaa waa kaa ra binnuu guŋ. 17Nɛr la maa ni Kristo n kpauwɛ, u birgi nɛfaliirɛ. U wibinaa la tunnɔɔ, ka u wia maa birgi wifalaa. 18Kɔraawiizi benii wia naa maa lii. Waabuu kuari yaa wia, yaa nuu wer dɔɔ nuukpaŋ dikuu Kristo wia, di kaa tɛɛ yaa huma naa, ya nyiŋŋi nɛra ra tɛu bá nuu wia wer kuari, bá wer dɔɔ nuukpaŋ. 19Kɔraawiizi faa ra kuari u ni durnya wiarɛ Kristo huma la biini. Waa baa ra pɛɛzi ba wichɔgaa wia. U kpa u wiŋɔzi labuu tɛɛ yaa, yá ra bagli gunla uŋ kuari ba maa wia la. 20Yaa ɛɛ Yeesu Kristo dɔgtɛɛzii durnya naa biini. Yaa n na suŋŋi ia naa, Kɔraawiizii ra suŋŋi ia la, ií gil ii nuu wia kuari. 21U gillɔɔ unla n waa wichɔgaa maa dɔɔwɛ la lɛɛ yaa chɔgri du u hiŋ ni, ka yáa ge wer lɛɛ Kɔraawiizi wideŋlaa du yaa hinaa ni, yaa wia deŋli dikuu yaa ni Kristo n kpauwɛ wia.

english_text:
1We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace. 2 In the Scriptures God says,
“When the time came,
I listened to you,
and when you needed help,
I came to save you.”
That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
3We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems. 4But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times. 5 We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food. 6But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real. 7We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
8Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not. 9We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed, 10and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
11Friends in Corinth, we are telling the truth when we say there is room in our hearts for you. 12We are not holding back on our love for you, but you are holding back on your love for us. 13I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us.
The Temple of the Living God
14Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same? 15Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't? 16 Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says,
“I will live with these people
and walk among them.
I will be their God,
and they will be
my people.”
17 The Lord also says,
“Leave them and stay away!
Don't touch anything
that isn't clean.
Then I will welcome you
18 and be your Father.
You will be my sons
and my daughters,
as surely as I am God,
the All-Powerful.”
translation_text:
1Yaa ni Kɔraawiizi n na hum huma naa, yaa gba ra suŋŋi iabuu, ii gilɛɛ gil Kɔraawiizi nɛsunaa la un suŋ ii ni la bir pɛɛ. 2Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,
“N nuuwɔɔ tɛɛ ia, saŋa la miŋ suŋ ii ni la,
di hiini ia,
ii na lɛɛi.”
Too. Ií ra nuu ɛŋ. Zinaa ɛɛ u nɛsunaa hɔpiziirɛ, di kaa ɛɛ u nɛlɛɛi hɔpizii.
Pɔɔl tɔɔrɔɔzi wia
3Yaa n na hum huma naa, yaa ɔɔ ra dazuu ya gilɛɛ waa ɛɛ wii la maa n niŋ bir ɛɛ wichɔgii, nɛ́ra gilɛɛ wer gbɛlli yaa huma. 4Yaa ra ɛɛ wiimaanii gunla an dɛkkɛ Kɔraawiizi huŋhunna n ninna ɛɛ. Wikpega ɔɔ huuzi yaabuu, ka yaa kpa kanyitti kpoglaa. Yaa zum tɔɔrɔɔ, witittii ani siaahmu wiarɛ, 5aabuu banna lɔɔzi yaa, banna tɔ yaa dia, banna du dɔm. Yaa hum humkpegaa kuuh. Saŋa bɛl, yaa wàá na dɔɔ chɔɔ, saŋa bɛl ge, yaa wàá na diwee di. 6Yaa ɔɔ ra dazi doŋa maa gilɛɛ waa pɛli yaa, di ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi nunzuma, di ɔɔ haa vɛɛ ra di kanyitti, di ɔɔ ra hiini nɛra, di dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii la yaa ni, di nɔŋŋi nɛra ani biinihuŋŋu, 7di ra ŋɔ wibii wia, di ɔɔ ra ɛɛ wia maa Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa biini, di ɔɔ kpa yaa nomɛɛla ni yaa nodige lau wideŋlaa, di ra yoo Sitaani. 8Nɛra baŋhina ra tɔgzi yaabuu, baŋhina ge ra gbɛlli yaa, baŋhina ra zɔɔzi yaa, baŋhina ge ra chɔli yaa. Ba ra yir yaa kara hina, ka yaa ɛɛ wibii hina, 9di ra yir yaa nɛdumazi, ka baŋhina ge zum yaa wia nɛnnɛ. Yaa ɔɔ du siu biinii, ka dɔɔ miibɔɔ. Ba ra tɔɔri yaabuu, ka ba waa yaa kpuwɛɛ. 10Biinichɔg ɔɔ du yaa be, ka yaa bɔra sɔɔni. Yaa ɛɛ nyaara, ka wer ra hiini nɛra werge maa. Yaa waa kummaa dɔɔwɛ, ka dɔɔ kummaa ge.
11Ee, Kɔrint hina, yaa biine maanii yaa pilli tɛɛ ia. Ii wia du yaa bampireere werge maa. 12Yaawaa biine waa luŋ. Ka iawaa biine du luŋ yaa be. Ii waa yaa wia kpawɛɛ du ii bampiree. 13N na ŋɔ wia naabuu alugɔ n ni n biizii. Yaa nɔŋŋi iabuu. Ií ge bir ii bampiree di nɔŋŋi yaa.
Ií gilɛɛ ra hiŋ banla n waa yardɛɛ
14Ií gilɛɛ gil ii ni banla n waa Kɔraawiizi yardɛɛ kpau ɛɛ kpaŋ. Wideŋlaa ni wichɔgaa waa wiimaa dɔɔwɛ. Bɔchaaŋ ni bɔbiri daŋ wer kpauwaa? 15Kristo ni Sitaani daŋ wer ɛɛ kpaŋaa? Unla n sɛɛ Kristo wia ni banla n waa sɛɛwɛ wàá wer ɛɛ kpaŋ. 16Kɔraawiizi Dia ni vugkuari bɔr daŋ wer kpawuu naa? Yaa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi himmaa la jaami bɔttɛ. Ba faa sɛbi u wiŋɔzi, dí, yaa Dɔɔri ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N daŋ wa du ba be, di ɔɔ ra vol ba biini. N daŋ ɛɛ ba Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bá ge ɛɛ n nɛra.
17Awia, n ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, ‘Ií lii a nɛdumazi biini
du ii bɛŋ,
di gilɛɛ ra gbɔgzi
kunla maa n doŋŋe.
Denii ń wer lɛɛ ia du n be,
18n daŋ ɛɛ ii mɛɛ,
ií ge ɛɛ n biizi.’
Gunnɛ yaa Dɔɔri la n ɛɛ Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la ŋɔ.
Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hinnɛ ŋɔ guŋ.”

english_text:
1My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him.
The Church Makes Paul Happy
2Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone. 3I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die. 4I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
5 After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears. 6But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us. 7Of course, we were glad to see Titus, but what really made us glad is the way you cheered him up. He told how sorry you were and how concerned you were about me. And this made me even happier.
8I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while. 9Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us. 10When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
11Just look what God has done by making you feel sorry! You sincerely want to prove you are innocent. You are angry. You are shocked. You are eager to see that justice is done. You have proved that you were completely right in this matter. 12When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us. 13And we were greatly encouraged.
Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about. 14We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true. 15Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him. 16It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
translation_text:
1Awia, n nɛnɔŋŋaa, Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ nua tɛɛ yaa kennaa, a dɛkkɔɔ yaa n ninna lizi doŋa maa yaa bɔrahɔna ni yaa biine maa ra ha, di ra ɛɛ ania ya wer dɔɔ winanaa wa tuŋ, di ɔɔ ra ɔm Kɔraawiizi wiimaa biini.
Pɔɔl bɔsɔna wia
2Ií pilli ii bampiree tɛɛ yaa. Yaa waa ii bɛl maa ɛɛwɛ wichɔgaa. Yaa waa bɛl maa chɔkkɛ. Yaa waa kaa dar nɛr maa ge. 3Maa ia ra jugmi. N faa ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ ii du yaa bampireere. Di siurɛ gɛɛ miibɔɔrɛ, ka yaa ni iabuu. 4N dɔɔ ii tamiirɛ werge maa, di ra chɔli ia werge gba. Ii sɔɔni n bɔraa werge maa wa bɛri. Ba ra tɔɔri yaa, ka n bɔra sɔɔniŋ werge maa.
5Yaa n faa ba Masɛdɔnia hɛri la, yaa biine faa waa kpaŋ ɛɛwɛ. Tɔɔrɔɔ faa huuzi yaabuu bɔr maa. Naari la nɛra n na naa yaa la du de. Wia kaa du yaa biine di ra tir yaa, yaa ra fɔŋ. 6Ama, Kɔraawiizi la n ɔɔ tig biinichɔg hiŋ bampirii la, u tig yaa bampireere Taitus balaa la biini. 7U balaa la bɛŋ wia lɛi tig yaa bampiree. U wa bagli yaabuu gunla uŋ wa na ia, u himmaa bampirii tig, guŋ kaa tig yaa ge bampiree. U bagli yaabuu lugɔ ii ra kɛlli n ninɛɛ werge, di ŋɔ lugɔ ii biine chɔkkɔɔ dikuu gunla miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ la wia, di kaa ŋɔ lugɔ ii aah siwiire dikuu n wia. N bɔra kaa sɔɔniŋ jaa.
8Miŋ faa sɛbi hɔŋ tɛɛ ia, ii biine chɔgi la, a faa tirimbuu. Ka a waa kaa tiriŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii biinichɔg la faa waa birgee. 9N bɔra sɔɔnimbuu. Miŋ chɔg ii biine wia lɛi n bɔra sɔɔni. Ka ii biinichɔg la gillɔɔ ii bampiree bir. Biinichɔg la dee Kɔraawiizi n na nyiŋŋi labuu. N chɔgi ii biinee, ka ii gilɛɛ wa chol bɔna dikuu yaa n gillɛ wia. 10Biinichɔg la dee Kɔraawiizi n na nyiŋŋi la ɔɔ bir bampiriire, Kɔ́raawiizi wer lɛɛ a nɛra. A guŋ waa biinichɔg ɛɛwɛ. Ka durnya biinichɔgwaa ra kpu nɛttɛ. 11Ií na gunla biinichɔg la dee Kɔraawiizi n na nyiŋŋi la n gillɛ ii siwii aah, ii ra kazi bɔra ií wia wer lii nɛnnɛ, di huuhzi ii biine, ii baana fuuh wichɔgaa ni, ii ra ɔm, di bir ra kɛlli yaa ni werge, di kaa aah siwii werge maa, haali di turgi wichɔgaa la kim. Ii lii a biinii. Ii waa wichɔgii maa dɔɔwɛ a wii biini. 12Min sɛbi hɔŋ la, unla n ɛɛ wichɔgaa la wia lɛi n sɛbuu, unla uŋ ɛɛ wichɔgaa la gba wia lɛi. N sɛbuubuu ií wer zum nɛnnɛ Kɔraawiizi be gunla iin nɔŋŋi yaa. 13A wia du yaabuu bɔkpega.
Yaa kaa dɔɔ bɔsɔna werge dikuu Taitus bɔsɔna wia. Ii maa duubuu bɔkpega nɛnnɛ. 14N faa ŋɔ ii wiarɛ tɛu, di tɛɛ ia sɔŋ. Too. Ii wan duwɛɛ hiihzi. Gunla maa yaa n ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ ia ɛɛ wibiire. Too. Gunla yaa n ŋɔ ii wia tɛɛ Taitus di tɛɛ ia sɔŋ la, a gba ɛɛ wibii. 15U jaa dɔɔ ii bilaa werge, di ra liizi gunla iin lɛɛu du ii be, di ra fɔŋ di ra hiŋ gunla maa um bagli ia la. 16N bɔra sɔɔnɔɔrɛ min dɔɔ ii tamii wiimaa biini.

english_text:
Generous Giving
1 My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace. 2Although they were going through hard times and were very poor, they were glad to give generously. 3They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to. 4They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people. 5And they did more than we had hoped. They gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, just as God wanted them to do.
6Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun. 7You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
8I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown. 9You know our Lord Jesus Christ treated us with undeserved grace by giving up all his riches, so you could become rich.
10A year ago you were the first ones to give, and you gave because you wanted to. So listen to my advice. 11I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving. 12It doesn't matter how much you have. What matters is how much you are willing to give from what you have.
13I am not trying to make life easier for others by making life harder for you. But it is only fair 14for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share, 15 just as the Scriptures say,
“Those who gathered
too much
had nothing left.
Those who gathered
only a little
had all they needed.”
Titus and His Friends
16I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do. 17When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you. 18With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news. 19The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help. 20We don't want anyone to find fault with the way we handle your generous gift. 21 But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
22We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much. 23Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ. 24Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.
translation_text:
Bɔkpega dui dikuu bunya wia
1Yaabalaa, yaa ra nyiŋŋuu ii zum gunla Kɔraawiizi n hiini Yeesu hiŋra la n du Masɛdɔnia hɛri, ba wer dɔɔ bunya werge la. 2Tɔɔrɔɔ werge maa ɛɛ baabuu na, ka ba bɔra n sɔɔni baa werge maa la, ba wettoo lizi kebee werge, bá kpa sunzi nɛra. Ba faa ɛɛ nyaaraa werge, 3ka n wettoo ŋɔ ba wia lugɔ ba lizi gunla maa baŋ wettee, di bir lizi jaa gba. Ba himmaa kipattɛ guŋ. 4Ba suŋŋi yaabuu werge lugɔ ya lɛɛ ba kebee la, bá ge gba wer ɛɛ winanaa la di ge wa hiini ba dɔŋa hina Kɔraawiizi biinanaa la. 5Ba winanaa la kaali gunla yaa n faa binnɛɛ labuu, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba hiŋ Kɔraawiizi kipattɛ, di kpa bahinaa tɛɛ ba Dɔɔri ni yaa mɔɔ, ka haa lizi kebee la.
6Awiarɛ yaa suŋŋi Taitus, ú la ii ge gba be ga tuŋ hunnanii la uŋ faa faarɛɛ ii be la. 7Iin dɔɔ yarda werge ani wibaglaa ni nunzuma, di ɔɔ aah siwii werge di kaa nɔŋŋi yaa ge naa, ií ɛɛ ania di wer dɔɔ winanii naa ge gba werge.
8Maa ŋɔ ń fir ia ii ra hiŋ kennaa miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ naa. Ka baŋhina n ɛɛ ania werge, di ɛɛ winanaa naa, n na nyiŋŋuu ń zum ii dɔnnɔŋŋaa la gunla un duwɛɛ, di u dɔɔ wibii gɛɛ waa wibii dɔɔwɛ.
9Ii zum gunla yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo n suŋ yaa ni di hiini yaa labuu. U faa dɔɔwɔɔ ka gil a maa ta dikuu ii wia, ka birgi nyaari, ka ií ge wer dɔɔ werge dikuu u nyaari la wia.
10Awia, n daŋ bagli ia gunla min nawɛɛ. Iabuu felee ŋɔ winanaa naa wia, di faari ra kɛɛ a kebee diila maa. 11Filaŋkeŋ, a dɛkkɔɔ lugɔ iin tuŋ a huma. Gunla iin faa aah siwii ŋɔ ií kɛɛa la, ií kaa aah siwii guŋ, di sissi a kebee ii kebidɔɔlaa biini. 12Di ii bampiree teŋ tɛɛ ia lugɔ ií tɛɛ kebee la, gunla maa iin dɔɔwɛ iin niŋ tɛɛ, guŋ daŋ par Kɔraawiizi. Waa ŋɔ ií tɛɛ di kaali gunla iin dɔɔwɛ.
13Maa ŋɔwɛɛ lugɔ ií kpa ii kummaa tɛɛ baa ka birgi nyaara ra di dɔgnya. Ka a wesso ií maa n dɔɔwɛ mɛgzi. 14Di ii dɔɔwɔ filaŋkeŋ, ii daŋ wer hiini banla n waa dɔɔwɛ. Di ŋmɛnɛbɛl ba ge wa dɔɔwɔ, ka ii ge nyaa, bá ge wer hiini ia, ií maa wer ɛɛ kpaŋ. 15Gunnɛ ba faa sɛbi Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini di ŋɔ, “Unla n paa diwee werge la waa diwee ka ka, unla ge n paa tama, waa diwee nyaawɛ.”
Baŋ hum Taitus bolzeŋ Kɔrint wia
16N na jaami Kɔraawiizi ani uŋ gillɛ Taitus dɔɔ ii wia u bampirii gunla yaa ge n dɔɔ ii wia yaa bampiree la. 17Wii naa yaa n na suŋŋi ŋɔ ií ɛɛ naa paruubuu werge. U himmaa kipattɛ ú la ii be. 18Yaa kaa hum yaa dɔŋhiŋ la Yeesu hiŋra maa n du bɔr maa n na chɔli amaniyesuma huma naa biini labuu tɛɛ ia. 19Yeesu hiŋra la lizuubuu ŋɔ ú du yaa la ya ga hum hunnanii naa, di kpa ii sunzaa la ga tɛɛ baa. U guŋ daŋ gil yaa Dɔɔri himmaa na girme, di kaa bagli gunla u wia n du yaa bampiree werge la. 20Yaa waa nyiŋŋi nɛr maa wer na bɔr ŋɔ yaa wichɔgaa wia, dikuu gunla yaa n kpogli ii kebee naa n ɛɛ sunzinanii naa wia. 21Yaa ra nyiŋŋuu a wia maa wer deŋli nɛra be, di kaa wer deŋli Kɔraawiizi ge be.
22Yaa kaa hum yaa dɔŋhiŋ bɛllɛ jaa banla ni. Baal naa, yaa ɛɛubuu na saŋakpila maa, di zum lugɔ ɔɔ aah siwiire ra hum huma la maa. U dɔɔ ii tamiirɛ werge. Awiarɛ u siwii kaa aah werge huma naa wia. 23Taitus ge, u ni yaabuu ra hum huma naa biini, di ra hiini ia. Banla n jaa u ni ge ɛɛ yaa dɔŋahina di lii Yeesu hiŋra la n du ɛŋ biini. Kristo ra na girmee dikuu ba wia. 24Awia, ií gil ba zum lugɔ nɔŋŋaa la iin nɔŋŋi nɛra la ɛɛ nɔŋŋaa himmaanii, Yeésu hiŋra la maa zum lugɔ yaa faa waa barabara ra ta, di ra ŋɔ ii wia la.

english_text:
The Money for God's People
1I don't need to write you about the money you plan to give for God's people. 2I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give. 3This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
4Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more. 5So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
6Remember this saying,
“A few seeds make
a small harvest,
but a lot of seeds make
a big harvest.”
7 Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give. 8God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others. 9 The Scriptures say,
“God freely gives his gifts
to the poor,
and always does right.”
10 God gives seed to farmers and provides everyone with food. He will increase what you have, so you can give even more to those in need. 11You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
12What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God. 13The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else. 14Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much. 15Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!
translation_text:
Yeesu hiŋra dɔŋa hiinaa wia
1A waa kaa ɛɛ wizeŋ min niŋ kaa sɛbi kebee la iin niŋ sunzi Kɔraawiizi biinanaa la wia. 2N zummɔ lugɔ a wia teŋ aah ii siwiire. N ŋɔ ii wiarɛ ra tɛɛ Masɛdɔnia hina di ra chɔli ia, di ra ŋɔ lugɔ Akaaya hina teŋ ɛɛ siryaa diila maa gba. Gunla iiŋ aah siwii la gillɔɔ bakpila maa ge aah siwii dikuu a wia. 3N hum yaa dɔŋa hinaa ii be filaŋkeŋ, nɛ́r maa gilɛɛ wer di ra ŋɔ lugɔ yaa ta barabaraa di ra ŋɔ ii wia, ka wibii waa hoo a biine. N ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ ii teŋ ɛɛ a maa siryaa tuŋ. Awiarɛ n hum baa, ií wer ɛɛ sirya la tuŋ. 4Ka di n ni Masɛdɔnia hɛri hina wa ballɔ, di ii haa waa ɛɛwɛ tuŋ, di ii waa hiihzi diwee, ka yaawaa daŋ di hiihzi dikuu tamii la yaa n dɔɔwɛ ii ni la wia. 5Awiarɛ n binni lugɔ a dɛkkɔɔ min suŋŋi yaa dɔŋahina, bá tɔ see ra la ii be ga lɛɛ ii sunzaa la iiŋ faa ŋɔ nua lugɔ ii daŋ sunzi baa la maa wa tuŋ, di yaa wa tɔ har ra ba, á jaa du de. Denii a wàá ka ɛɛ firaa, ka á ɛɛ kipar sunzaa.
6Ií ra liizi lugɔ nɛr la n dɔɔ kpossii di duu tama, tamaa ú bir na. Ka unla n duuwe werge, u daŋ na werge. 7Gunla maa an du ii bampiree lugɔ ii tɛɛ, ií ra tɛɛ guŋ ani biinihuŋŋu. Ií gilɛɛ gil a ɛɛ firaa sunzaa ii be. Nɛr la n na sunzi nɛra ani biinihuŋŋu, u wiarɛ ra par Kɔraawiizi. 8Kɔraawiizi daŋ wer hiini ia werge maa, ií ɔɔ wer dɔɔ kunla maa iin niŋ dɔɔ di kaa jaa, ií wer dɔɔ ra hum hunnanaa. 9Ba faa sɛbɔɔrɛ Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini, di ŋɔ,
“U bɔnni u kunaa ra tɛɛ nyaara.
U winanaa
wàá tuŋ maa.”
10Kɔraawiizi la n ɔɔ tɛɛ ia kuna bee ií wer duu la, u daŋ kaa tɛɛ ia diwee ii di, di kaa gil ii na bee werge maa, di gil ii winanaa ge wer jaa. 11U daŋ hiini ia ií na kummaa ra jaa, ka ií ge wer dɔɔ bunya ra hiini nɛra. Di yaa hum huma naa tuŋ, Kɔraawiizi daŋ na jaaŋ nɛkpila be,
12dikuubɛɛwiai, iinna hiini nɛra naa, Kɔraawiizi biinanaa la daŋ jaa dɔɔ kuna la baŋ waa dɔɔwɛ la. Ka a bɛŋ lɛi niŋ lii a biini. Kɔraawiizi daŋ na jaaŋ werge maa lii nɛkpila be. 13Ii huma naabuu niŋ bagli lugɔ ii hiŋaa dɔɔ wibiire. Nɛkpila daŋ tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ, dikuu iinna hiŋ amaniyesuma hiŋaa ŋmɛnizi nɛnnɛ wia ani iiŋ hiini ba ni nɛr maa werge wia. 14Ba ge daŋ suŋŋi wiizi tɛɛ ia ani nɔŋŋaa ni, dikuu baŋ nawɛɛ Kɔraawiizi n du ii bampiree werge, di hiini ia wia. 15Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ jaannɛ. U ge sunzaa la un sunzi yaa la, yaa waa kaa zum gunla yaa n niŋ bagli u bagla gba.

english_text:
Paul Defends His Work for Christ
1Do you think I am a coward when I am with you and brave when I am far away? Well, I ask you to listen, because Christ himself was humble and gentle. 2Some people have said we act like the people of this world. So when I arrive, I expect I will have to be firm and forceful in what I say to them. Please don't make me treat you that way. 3We live in this world, but we don't act like its people 4or fight our battles with the weapons of this world. Instead, we use God's power that can destroy fortresses. We destroy arguments 5and every bit of pride that keeps anyone from knowing God. We capture people's thoughts and make them obey Christ. 6And when you completely obey him, we will punish anyone who refuses to obey.
7You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do. 8Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag. 9And I am not trying to scare you with my letters. 10Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.” 11Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
12We won't dare compare ourselves with those who think so much of themselves. But they are foolish to compare themselves with themselves. 13We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work. 14We are not bragging more than we should. After all, we did bring the message about Christ to you.
15We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal. 16Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done. 17 The Scriptures say, “If you want to brag, then brag about the Lord.” 18You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.
translation_text:
Pɔɔl n bagli u huma wia
1Mìŋ́ Pɔɔllɛ ra fɔrgi ia ni Yeesu Kristo sisɔna ni u kanyitti ni. Ba ŋɔ n wiarɛ lugɔ di n haŋ wa du ii be anna ɔm iabuu, ka di yaa waa kaa waa na dɔŋa, n ɔɔ biruu dɔɔ bampirii. 2N na fɔrgi iabuu filaŋkeŋ, di n wa ba ii be, ń gilɛɛ waa bagli fɔŋŋa ii ni alugɔ min niŋ bagli banla n kpa yaa ra yir nɛra la n na ɛɛ ba wia, ba bɔrahɔna fɔŋŋa biini la. 3Yaa bɔrahɔnaa yaa kpa ra ɛɛ wia. Ka laal la yaa n na yoo la, yaa bɔrahɔna fɔŋŋa biini lɛi yaa ra yoo a laal. 4Yaa laal kuna waa newea hora ɛɛwɛ. A dɔɔ kpegzii Kɔraawiizi be, di wer ra purgi diikpega. 5Newea nunzuma wia la banna tɔgzi, di ra di nɛra hɔɔzi ni baglaa la maa banna tɔgzi werge, ka ra vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi zumaa la ɛɛ diikpega la yaa n niŋ wer purgi labuu. Yaa kaa dɔɔ fɔŋŋa ya gil nɛra nfɛssi gba wer sɛɛ Kristo dɔɔra. 6N ɛɛ siryaa, di ii wa sɛɛwɔ tuŋ, ń tɛr nɛr la maa n vɛɛwɛ digni.
7Ii siwee waa na gɛɛ? Di nɛr la maa zummɔ lugɔ u ɛɛ Yeesu Kristo hiŋrii, ú kaa fɛ nfɛrɛ di zum gunla uŋ ɛɛ u hiŋri la, gunnɛ yaa gba ɛɛ u hiŋra. 8Di n na chɔli n hiŋ werge ani fɔŋŋa la yaa n dɔɔwɛ ii ni la, ka guŋ wàá ɛɛŋ hiihzi. Yaa Dɔɔri tɛmbuu a fɔŋŋa ń wer bagli ia. Wan tɛɛwɛ guŋ ń wa chɔgi ia. 9Ka maa nyiŋŋi ii ŋɔ n wia lugɔ n ɔɔ sɛbi hɔnaa ra ɔnzi nɛra. 10Ba ra ŋɔ, “U wettoo ra sɛbi hɔŋkpega. Ka di i wa nau, gɛrgii. Di u ra ŋɔ wia ge, u ŋɔ ra huhzi.” 11Nɛr la maa n na ŋɔ guŋ, ú zum lugɔ gunla yaa n sɛbɛɛ hɔna la biine la, gunnɛ ya ɛɛ saŋa la yaa n niŋ wa na dɔŋa la.
12Yaa wàá kpa yaa hinaa mɛgzi banla n na tɔgzi bahinaa la. Yaa wàá kpa yaa nyuuni lɔ baa. Baabuu ɔɔ binni ba dɔŋahina wiɛɛlaazii, di ra ŋɔ dí ba horaa wesse. Banna ɛɛ kennaa, ba waa nfɛrɛ dɔɔwɛ. 13Yaawaa wàá chɔli yaa hinaa ani wii la maa n waa hoo anla Kɔraawiizi n gillɛ yaa ɛɛ la biini. Gunla maa um mɛgzɛɛ tɛɛ yaa, yaa daŋ ɛɛ guŋ bɛŋ. Ii gba du huma la un tɛɛ yaa la biinii. 14Yaa n kpa ii wia birgi yaa wia la, yaa waa huma la Kɔraawiizi n mɛgzɛɛ tɛɛ yaa la ni bɛrɛɛ. U kpa ii wiarɛ tɛɛ yaa. Yaabuu felee ba ii be, di wa lizi amaniyesuma la tɛɛ ia. 15Yaa waa yaa hinaa ra chɔli ani huma la baŋhina n ɛɛwɛ, ka a waa hoo anla Kɔraawiizi n mɛgzɛɛ tɛɛ yaa la biini. Ka yaa dɔɔ tamiirɛ lugɔ di ii wa yardi Kɔraawiizi nɛnnɛ, Kɔraawiizi daŋ kaa lizi huma aŋhina tɛɛ yaa jaa a ni werge, dikuu ii wia, 16ya wer la see di gaa lizi amaniyesuma la ra tɛɛ banla n du see la, di gilɛɛ ra chɔli yaa hinaa dikuu huma la nɛbɛl n teŋ ɛɛwɛ mɔɔ, ka yaa ba waa lɛɛa u be la wia. 17Awiarɛ ba sɛbi Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini, di ŋɔ, “Ií gilɛɛ ra chɔli iihinaa. Gil nɛr la maa n na jigsi, ú ra jigsi dikuu uŋ zummɛ lugɔ minuu Kɔraawiizi wia.” 18Nɛr la n na chɔli u hiŋ, waa lɛi Kɔraawiizi tɛɛ wibii. Ka unla Kɔraawiizi n na chɔli, waabuu ú tɛɛ wibii.

english_text:
Paul and the False Apostles
1Please put up with a little of my foolishness. 2I am as concerned about you as God is. You were like a virgin bride I had chosen only for Christ. 3 But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way. 4We told you about Jesus, and you received the Holy Spirit and accepted our message. But you let some people tell you about another Jesus. Now you are ready to receive another spirit and accept a different message. 5I think I am as good as any of those super apostles. 6I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
7Was it wrong for me to lower myself and honor you by preaching God's message free of charge? 8I robbed other churches by taking money from them to serve you. 9 Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden. 10As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this. 11And it isn't because I don't love you. God himself knows how much I do love you.
12I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing. 13Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ. 14And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light. 15So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve.
Paul's Sufferings for Christ
16I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little. 17When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord. 18Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I. 19And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool. 20In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face. 21I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way.
If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do. 22Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Jews? So am I. Are they from the family of Abraham? Well, so am I. 23 Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
24 Five times my own people gave me 39 lashes with a whip. 25 Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea. 26 During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
27I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm. 28Besides everything else, each day I am burdened down, worrying about all the churches. 29When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
30If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am. 31God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever! 32 The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me. 33But I escaped by being let down in a basket through a window in the city wall.
translation_text:
Pɔɔl ni nɛra baŋhina n na yir bahinaa Yeesu huŋhunna wia
1N na nyiŋŋuu ii di kanyitti tama ka nuu gɛnii wiŋɔzi. Ií ɛɛ ania ka diŋ kanyitti, 2dikuubɛɛwiai, n bɔra ra wiiu dikuu ii wia. Kɔraawiizii gillɛ n dɔɔ bɔwii guŋ. N gillɔɔ ii ɛɛ bakpaŋ bɛŋ hahjiga, di ra nyiŋŋi n wer kpa ia tɛɛ ii jaari Kristo alugɔ toloori la n waa baal zummɛ. 3Ka n na fɔŋuu Sítaani gilɛɛ wa na ŋmɛnɛɛ di wer bir ii nfɛssi lugɔ ii wàá ka nɔŋŋi Kristo nɛnnɛ ani biinihuŋŋu. Maa nyiŋŋi u wer dar ia alugɔ hɛrikuŋ la n faa fugzi Haawa, di wer daruu la. 4Ií ɔɔ ra di kanyittii di nuu ra tɛɛ banla n ba ii be di waa bagli Yeesu wia, a kur wia la yaa n faa bagli ia la ni. Di kunduma izi ii ni, ka waa Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii la n faa zuu ii ni la ɛɛwɛ, di baŋhina kaa ra bagli amaniyesuma aŋhina wia, a kur anla yaa n faa bagli ia la ni, ka ií ɔɔ haa ra di kanyittii, di nuu ra tɛɛ baawaa. 5Ii ra tɔgzi baabuu kaali Kɔraawiizi huŋhunna gba. Ɛrɛɛ bɔirɛ ba bɔnnɛi? 6N wiŋɔzi nyaa yomaa, ka a waa zumaa waa nyaawɛ. Wia la maa yaa n zummɛ ge, yaa gillɔɔ a chaani nɛnnɛ, ií wer zum a maa nɛnnɛ.
7Gɛɛ miŋ faa sɔɔni siwii, ka ií faa wer nuu amaniyesuma pɛɛpɛɛ n be la, wichɔgaarɛ n faa ɛɛ guŋ gɛɛ? Ii hiinaa wiarɛ n faa sɔɔni siwii la, ka nɛ́ra wer di ra kpa ia tɔgzi. 8Yeesu hiŋra la n du yeŋa la kebeere n lɛɛ. Baabuu tɛŋ kebee ka ń wer hum ia. 9Miŋ faa du ii be la, n faa waa kebee dɔɔwɛ, ka maa guŋ wia kuuwɛ tɔɔri ii bɛl maa. Ka Yeesu hiŋra la n faa lii Masɛdɔnia hɛri ba la, faa hiinimbuu ani kuna la miŋ faa waa dɔɔwɛ. N faa ɛɛ aniaa ń gilɛɛ tɔɔri ia wiimaa wia. N daŋ ɔɔ haa ɛɛ guŋ ra la.
10N na ŋɔ ii benii ani wibii la Kristo n gillɛ n dɔɔ la. Wii naa minna ɛɛ di wer ra chɔli n hiŋ dikuu u wia naa, màá gil u ɛɛi Akaaya biini maa. 11Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ n ɛɛ gunnɛi? Maa ia nɔŋŋɛɛrɛ gɛɛ? Aa! N nɔŋŋi iabuu gɛɛ. Kɔraawiizi gba zummɔ. 12Ka n daŋ ɔɔ ɛɛ guŋ, nɛ́ra la n na nyiŋŋi ba ta barabara ŋɔ lugɔ ba ni yaa ɛɛ kpannɛ la, gilɛɛ wer na bɔr di wer ra ŋɔ guŋ. 13Nɛra naa dizi waa Kristo huŋhunna himmaa ɛɛwɛ ka ra dar nɛra, di ra hum a huma, di ra yir bahinaa u huŋhunna, di ra fugzi nɛra. 14Mhmm. Sitaani gba ɔɔ weruu birgi u hiŋ di li mɛlikananiinanii bɛl, di ge wer ra fugzi nɛra. 15Awia, di u balaa ra yir bahinaa banla n na ɛɛ wideŋlaa di wer ra fugzi nɛra, a waa witittii ɛɛwɛ. Ka Kɔraawiizi daŋ turgi baa ani gunla ba huma n duwɛɛ.
Pɔɔl n na ta barabara u tɔɔrɔɔ dii wia
16Too. N kaa ra ŋɔ ii benii. Ií gilɛɛ waa yiriŋ gɛnii, dikuu wia naa min niŋ ŋɔ naa wia. Di n gɛnnɔ gba, ka ií ra nuu n be, ń ge gba wer chɔli n hiŋ tama. 17Wia naa min niŋ ŋɔ naa, yaa Dɔɔri lɛi ŋɔ ń ŋɔa. N himmaa chugla wiŋɔzii n na nyiŋŋi n ŋɔ, dikuu nɛra hinchɔlaa naa wia. 18Bakpila n na chɔli bahinaa ani ba bɔrahɔna wia kennaa, n gba daŋ chɔli n hiŋ, 19dikuubɛɛwiai, nunzunnaa ia. Ii ɔɔ weruu ra tɛɛ gɛnaa sisɔna, di gil ii bɔra sɔɔni, ii ra nuu ba be. 20Baŋhina ɔɔ kpa iabuu birgi ba yoma, di ra foozi ia, di ra di ia, di ra bagli fɔŋŋa ii ni, di ra chɛ ii liizi, ka ii ra tɛɛ baa sisɔna. 21Yaawaa ɛɛ gɛrgaa. Yaawaa waa ia tɔɔrɛɛ guŋ. Ka di wichɔgaarɛ yaa ɛɛ ia guŋ, amɔ, ii gaafura.
Ka wii la maa baŋ dɔɔ barabara, di wer ra chɔli bahinaa dikuu u wia la, n gba dɔɔ barabaraa lugɔ ń ge gba wer chɔli n hiŋ, dikuu a wii wia. Too. N gɛnni wiŋɔzi labuu n ŋɔ la. 22Ba ɛɛ Jus hinaa gɛɛ? N gba ɛɛ bɛllɛ. Ba ɛɛ Izrɛl hinaa gɛɛ? N gba ɛɛ bɛllɛ. Ba ɛɛ Abraham naannaa gɛɛ? N gba ɛɛ u naana bɛllɛ. 23Ba ɛɛ Kristo balaarɛa? Ií ra nuu chugla hiŋ wiŋɔzi. N kaali baabuu. N hum u humaa kuuh werge maa kaali baa, di kaa du nɛra tɔi diini biine werge maa di kaali baa. Ba lɔɔzimbuu saŋakpila maa. Maa kaa zum a maga gba. N kaa du siu biini saŋakpilakpila. 24Jus hina faa viirimbuu saŋazi anue. Saŋa kpaŋ maa, nua butokko ni kpɔrgɔ ni kabɛllɛ ba ɔɔ viiriŋ. 25Baŋhina lɔɔzimbuu ni daazi saŋazi buhoro maa. N bia ge lɔɔzaa bukakpaŋ. N faa kaa zuu muugbera u wa purgi ŋmɛnɛɛ, a saŋa bɛl n kaa zuu bɛl u ge kaa puri, a guŋ buhoro. A saŋa hiŋ bɛl, n wa ta nii biinii hamuŋa ni guŋŋ hɔɔ wa pizi, bɔr kaa wa biri. 26N gaagɔɔrɛ werge di na siaahmu deekpila maa. N na siaahmu nii n suwee biini, ŋmɛɛna be, n himmaa nɛra be ani banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ ge be. Siaahmu huuzimbuu bola biine, bɔdumazi ani muuzeŋ biini. N kaa na siaahmu banla n waa Yeesu hiŋra himmaa ɛɛwɛ be. 27N zum kuuhni ni dɔgnya. Maa dɔɔ nawɛɛ ra chɔɔ saŋakpila maa, di zum lɔzi ni niinyɔgzi. Diwii maa waa n nua zuuwɛ hɔpizikpila maa biine. N zum waarii. Maa ɔɔ dɔɔ laala nɛnnɛ ń tɔ n hiŋ.
28Annii maa ɛɛ baŋgia wikpoglaare. Biini hor ge gba du de, dikuubɛɛwiai, Yeesu hiŋra la n du bɔr maa wia du n bampiriire, n na fɔŋ ba wia hɔpizibii maa. 29Di bɛl maa waa kpeg nɛnnɛ, a guŋ ɔɔ tirimbuu n ge gba gɛrgi. Di ba dar bɛl maa u leu ŋmɛnɛɛ, n baaŋ ɔɔ ra fuuh u wiarɛ.
30Di a wesso minna chɔli n hiŋ, n gɛrgaa wiarɛ ń na chɔli. 31Yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi zummɔ lugɔ maa kara ra kanni. Ií ra tɛu sɔŋ saŋa maa di ra la. 32Miŋ faa du Damaskus la, nabɔma la ba koori Arɛtas n gillɛ u dɔɔ fɔŋŋa de la, faa ra nyiŋŋuu u lawiŋ, di gil ba ra daaziŋ a bol maa, bá lawiŋ. 33Ka ba gil n zuu kɛɛgɔ biini, ba kpaŋ ga tokoro bɛl n du koŋlii la n bar bol la ni, di gil n zeeli tuu hɛri. N lii di lɛɛ n hiŋ u be.

english_text:
Visions from the Lord
1I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me. 2I know about one of Christ's followers who was taken up into the third heaven 14 years ago. I don't know if the man was still in his body when it happened, but God certainly knows.
3As I said, only God really knows if this man was in his body at the time. 4But he was taken up into paradise, where he heard things too wonderful to tell. 5I will brag about that man, but not about myself, except to say how weak I am.
6Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say. 7Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
8Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away. 9But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am. 10Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong.
Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
11I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles. 12When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle. 13You missed out on only one blessing the other churches received. That is, you didn't have to support me. Forgive me for doing you wrong.
14I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children. 15So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much? 16You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you. 17Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you? 18I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
19Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
20I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob. 21I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
translation_text:
Pɔɔl winaalaa lugɔ deeza biini ni a pillaa wia
1Hinchɔlaa waa tɔna maa dɔɔwɛ. Ka n daŋ haa chɔli n hiŋ. N jaa ba wia la min nawɛɛ lugɔ deeza biini yaa Dɔɔri bagliŋ la ninɛɛ. 2Yeesu hiŋri bɛllɛ du de, binni fidaanaazuu zinaa, Kɔraawiizi n toou zuu u be chinchiŋ himmaa la. 3Di u ni u bɔrahɔnnɛ zuu de gɛɛ u duma bɛnnɛ zuu de, maa zum. Kɔraawiizi bɛnnɛ zummɛ. 4Ka kenne n zum. Minuu a hiŋ. Kɔraawiizi kpambuu ga zuu u be, n nuu wiŋɔzi aŋhina n kaali newee ŋɔi. Kɔraawiizi wàá gil newee ŋɔa. 5Di n ŋɔ ń chɔli nɛr, waabuu ń chɔli. Ka miŋwaa wàá chɔli n hiŋ ani wiimaa, di n gɛrgaa wia lɛi. 6Di n na nyiŋŋi ń chɔli n hiŋwaa, a wàá ɛɛ gɛnni wiŋɔzi, dikuubɛɛwiai, a maa ɛɛ wibiire. Ka màá ŋɔ. Maa nyiŋŋi nɛr maa kpa wiimaa tɔgziŋ, di anla un nawɛɛ ani anla un nuuwɛ bɛŋ lɛi.
7Kɔraawiizi faa waa nyiŋŋi n ge ra tɔgzi n hiŋ werge, dikuu wikpilakpila uŋ gillɛ n chɔɔ ra na deeza biini wia. Awia, u gillɔɔ wii bɛl du n ni di lii Sitaani be, u ra tɔɔriŋ alugɔ sɔɔh n du n ni, ń gilɛɛ wer ra tɔgzi n hiŋ werge. 8Buhoro maanii n suŋŋi wiizi, ú lizuu n ni. 9Ka waa sɛɛwɛ ú lizuu. U ŋɔ, “N hiinaa naa min niŋ suŋ i ni di hiinii naa daŋ kukkii. Nɛra gɛrgaa biinii ń fɔŋŋa wer du wer werge wa tuŋ.” Awia, n daŋ gil n bɔra sɔɔniŋ dikuu n gɛrgaa wia di chɔlaa, ka Krísto fɔŋŋa wer du n ni. 10Awia, di n gɛrgɔɔ, di nɛra ra gbɛlliŋ, di n na di dɔgnya di ra di tɔɔrɔɔ, di ra na siaahmu dikuu Kristo wia, u guŋ parimbuu, dikuubɛɛwiai, di n gɛrgɔɔ, denii ń kaa dɔɔ fɔŋŋa nɛnnɛ.
Kɔrint hina wia n tir Pɔɔl
11N ɛɛ gɛnni wiarɛ. Ka iabuu gillɛ n ɛɛ guŋ. Iabuu niŋ faa chɔliŋ. Maa kummaa ɛɛwɛ, ka nɛra la iinna tɔgzi di kaali Kɔraawiizi huŋhunna la bɛl maa wam bɔwɛɛ wiimaa biini. 12Miŋ faa du ii be la, n faa ɛɛ wiɛɛlaa la n gillɛ ii zum lugɔ n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi huŋhunnii, di ɛɛa ani kanyitti. Witittaa, wizenaa ni nuukpuuri wiarɛ n faa ɛɛ la. 13Ii ni Yeesu hiŋra n du yeŋa la, maa ia ɛɛwɛ ii ɛɛ kpaŋaa? Maa ii be binnɛɛ ń na n diwee. Guŋ bɛnnɛ maa ɛɛwɛ. Di wichɔgaarɛ n ɛɛ ia guŋ, amɔ, ii gaafura.
14Minna ɛɛ sirya ń ba ii be filaŋkennaa, n buhoro balaarɛ niŋ ɛɛ guŋ. Màá binni ii be ii tɛŋ diwee. Ii kuna lɛi n na nyiŋŋi. Ii himmaanii n na nyiŋŋi. Biizi lɛi niŋ nyiŋŋi dau ra tɛɛ ba mɛɛ ni ba maa. Ba mɛɛ ni ba maarɛ niŋ nyiŋŋi ra tɛɛ baa. 15Di n kebee maa ani n fɔŋŋa maa gba tunnɔ dikuu ii wia, ka n bɔra daŋ sɔɔni. Ii wia n du n bampirii werge maa wiarɛ ii ge lizi n wia ii bampiree gɛɛ?
16Baŋhina daŋ sɛɛ lugɔ maa ia duwɛɛ tɔɔrɔɔ dikuu n diwee wia. Ka ba daŋ ŋɔ lugɔ n ŋmurgi iabuu di wer dar ia gunla. 17Banla miŋ faa hum ii be la, ii daŋ wer ŋɔ ba bɛl maa wia lugɔ u dar iabuu lɛɛ ii kebeea? 18Miŋ faa suŋŋi Taitus ú la ii be, di gil yaa dɔŋhiŋ duu la la, a Taitus dar iabuu lɛɛ ii kebee gɛɛ? N nuu manni waa kpaŋ ɛɛwɛa? Yaa maa wiɛɛlaa waa kpaŋ ɛɛwɛa?
19Yaa n na ŋɔ wia kennaa, ii ra binnuu lugɔ yaa ra ŋɔabuu di ra nyiŋŋi yaa hor wer du sum ii be gɛɛ? Yaa ɛɛ Kristo hiŋraa di ra ŋɔa Kɔraawiizi be. N biinɔŋŋaa, ii hiinaa wiarɛ yaa ra ŋɔ a maa, ií wer lau nɛnnɛ, 20dikuubɛɛwiai, n na fɔŋuu lugɔ ń gilɛɛ wa ba ii be, ií wia wa chɔg n biini, ń ge wia wa chɔg ii biine, ń wa na lugɔ ii ra di dɔŋa hɔɔzii, di dɔɔ bɔwii, baaŋfuuih dumazi, bɛnsɔnnyiŋŋaa ni nɛgbɛllaa, nɛzɔɔzaa, barabara ani basabasa wia. 21Maa nyiŋŋi n kaa wa ba ii be ń Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi wa duŋ hiihzi, dikuu ii wia. Di n wa ballɔ, di wichɔgɛɛra kpila du ii be, ba biine haa waa chɔkkɛ dikuu sɛnsɛŋ wia ni wichɔgaa naa dee baŋ ɛɛwɛ naa wia, n ge biini daŋ chɔgi.

english_text:
Final Warnings and Greetings
1 I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.” 2During my second visit I warned you that I would punish you and anyone else who doesn't stop sinning. I am far away from you now, but I give you the same warning. 3This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful! 4Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
5Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed. 6I hope you will discover we have not failed. 7We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
8All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it. 9Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better. 10I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
11Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other.
Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you. 12Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.
13I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will bless you and be kind to you! May God bless you with his love, and may the Holy Spirit join all your hearts together.
translation_text:
Pɔɔl karfaazi tuna wia
1Ii be balaa buhoro hinnɛ keŋ. “Di n wa ballɔ, bɛl maa daŋ nyiŋŋi u daansɛɛ hina banɛɛ gɛɛ bahoro, ka ú wiŋɔzi wer ɛɛ wibii.” 2N faa ŋɔ ii benii n bunɛɛ balaa la biini, di kaa ra ŋɔ ii be miŋ waa hoo ii be filaŋkennaa, ii banla n faa ɛɛ wichɔgaa ani ii banla maa n kawɛɛ, di n kaa waa ba ii be, màá gil ia. 3Ii faa ra nyiŋŋuu ií zum nɛnnɛ lugɔ Kristo du n ninɛɛ di ra ŋɔ wia la. Too. Ii daŋ zum. Wàá nyaa fɔŋŋa ii be. U daŋ bagli ia u fɔŋŋa. 4Baŋ faa kpuu daakaŋlii ni la, u gɛrgaarɛ faa. Ka u jaa dɔɔ miibɔɔrɛ Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa biini. Yaa gba nuu maa gɛrgɔɔrɛ. Kaa filaŋkeŋ, yaa nuu wettoo na miibɔɔ Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa biini, di wer du ii be ani a fɔŋŋa.
5Ií pessi iihinaa di zum lugɔ ii yarduubuu nɛnnɛ gɛɛ ii wɔɔ yardɛɛi? Ií ɛɛ iihinaa na. Ii waa zummɛ lugɔ Yeesu Kristo du ii biineewaa? Di ii waa nɛfugze ɛɛwɛ, amɔ, u du ii biinee. 6N na tamuu lugɔ ii daŋ zum yaa n waa nɛfugze ɛɛwɛ. 7Ama, yaa ra suŋŋi Kɔraawiizii lugɔ ii gilɛɛ dɔɔ wichɔgaa maa. Yaa n na nyiŋŋi ya wer lii dɔɔ wibii ii be wia lɛi yaa ra suŋŋuu guŋ. Ii winanaa ɛɛirɛ yaa ra nyiŋŋi. Di guŋ gillɔ ba ra ŋɔ lugɔ yaa waa wibii dɔɔwɛ, ka gunnɛ yaa ra nyiŋŋi. 8Yaa wàá wer yoo wibii. Yaa daŋ hiinuubuu. 9Di ii dɔɔ fɔŋŋa ka yaa gɛrgi, yaa bɔra daŋ sɔɔni. Yaa kaa ra suŋŋi wiizi lugɔ ú kuari ii wia maa, á du wer wa tuŋ. 10Awiarɛ n na sɛbi wia naa miŋ waa hoo ii be naa, ń gilɛɛ waa jugmi ia saŋa la min niŋ wa ba ii be la. N Dɔɔri tɛmbuu fɔŋŋa. Ka ii hiinaa wiarɛ u tɛŋ a fɔŋŋa, ń wer hiini ia, ií wer lau nɛnnɛ. Ii chɔgaa wia lɛi u tɛŋ a fɔŋŋa.
11Too. Yaabalaa, ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni, di gil Kɔraawiizi kuari ii wia maa á du wer wa tuŋ, di sɔɔni ii bampiree, di gil ii maa dɔɔ nuukpaŋ nɛnnɛ, di du dɔŋa be pɛrɛtɛ. Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ nɔŋŋaa ni bampirsɔna hiŋ la daŋ ɔɔ du ii be.
12Ií ra jaami dɔŋa nɛnnɛ. 13Kɔraawiizi biinanaa maa ra jaami iabuu.
14Yáa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo nɛsunaa, u hiinaa ni Kɔraawiizi nɔŋŋaa ani u Duma nuukpaŋ dɔɔi la du ii maa ni.

english_text:
1-2From the apostle Paul and from all the Lord's followers with me.
I was chosen to be an apostle by Jesus Christ and by God the Father, who raised him from death. No mere human chose or appointed me to this work.
To the churches in Galatia:
3I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! 4Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world. 5God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen.
The Only True Message
6I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message, 7when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ. 8I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven. 9I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
10I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ.
How Paul Became an Apostle
11My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach. 12It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
13 You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it. 14 I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us. 15 But even before I was born, God had chosen me by his gift of undeserved grace and had decided 16to show me his Son, so I would announce his message to the Gentiles. I didn't talk this over with anyone. 17I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
18 Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for 15 days. 19The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother. 20And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
21Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia. 22But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person. 23They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy. 24And because of me, they praised God.
translation_text:
1Mìŋ́ Pɔɔllɛ ra sɛbi hɔnnaa ń tɛɛ ia. N ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi huŋhunni bɛllɛ, ka newee be lɛi a lii. Newee lɛi humiŋ. Yeesu Kristo ni yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n lalluu siu biini labuu humiŋ. 2N ni Yeesu hiŋra la maa n du n be bɔnnaa la ra jaami ii banla maa n ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra, di du Galesia hɛri la.
3Yáa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo hiini ia, di tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna. 4Yaa Dɔɔri la sɛɛ yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kipattɛ, di siu dikuu yaa wichɔgaa wia, ú wer lɛɛ yaa durnya ni u wichɔgaa fɔŋŋa biini. 5Ií gil u sɔŋ dɔɔ girme di hanna la, saŋaa saŋa maa. Ami.
Amaniyesumakpaŋ wia
6A tirimbuu werge maa, miŋ nuuwɛ lugɔ ii teŋ vɛɛ amaniyesuma labuu, ka bir a hiŋ duma bɛl. Kristo n faa suŋ ii ni di hiini ia la, Kɔraawiizi yir iabuu ii ba u be. Ka ii bir vɛɛu manamanaŋ kennaa. 7Maa sɛɛwɛ lugɔ amaniyesuma maa kaa du denii, di kaa jaa anla yaa n na lizi la ni. Ka baŋhina du ii benii di lawaa ra birgi, di ra bugmi ia. 8Di n himmaa wa lizi amaniyesuma maa tɛɛ ia a kur anla miŋ felee lizi tɛɛ ia la ni, Kɔ́raawiizi seeŋ nua. Di Kɔraawiizi mɛlika bɛl ge gba wa liwɔɔ di wa ɛɛ guŋ, Kɔ́raawiizi see u ge gba nua. 9Ií gil n kaa ŋɔ gunla miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ la ií nuu nɛnnɛ. Di nɛr la maa wa lizi amaniyesuma tɛɛ ia, a kur anla iiŋ faa sɛɛwɛ la ni, Kɔ́raawiizi see a hiŋ nua.
10Miŋ ŋɔ wia naa kennaa, neweare n na tɔgzi gɛɛ Kɔraawiizii n na tɔgzɛi? Neweare n ŋɔ ń wia par gɛɛ Kɔraawiizɛi? Di n vii haa ra nyiŋŋi n wia par nɛra, n vii wàá wer ɛɛ Kristo balii.
Gunla Pɔɔl n wa birgi Kɔraawiizi huŋhunni wia
11Yaabalaa, ií gil n kali ia nɛnnɛ ií zum. Amaniyesuma la miŋ faa lizɛɛ tɛɛ ia la, newea wiŋɔzi lɛi. 12Newee be lɛi n zumuu. Newee lɛi bagliŋ. Yeesu Kristoo kpa a maa bagliŋ, n wer zumaa.
13Ii faa ra nuu n wiarɛ saŋa la miŋ faa ra hiŋ Jus hina hiŋaa la, di faa nuu gunla miŋ faa aah siwii werge maa, di ra tɔɔri Yeesu hiŋra, di ra nyiŋŋi n chɔgi ba wia maa la. 14N tɔ n saara galga maa seere Jus hina hiŋaa la biini, dikuu miŋ faa ra tɔgzi yaa naana wiazi werge maa wia. 15Ka Kɔraawiizi la n felee liziŋ tɛɛ u hiŋ, di ba haa wan lullɛ gba la suŋ n ninɛɛ, di yiriŋ n ba u be. 16Denii a paruu lugɔ ú gil n zum u Biibaal nɛnnɛ, ń wer bagli u wia tɛɛ banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ la. Uŋ wa liziŋ gunla, n ni nɛr maa waa dɔŋa nawɛɛ, yá ŋɔ a wia mɔɔ. 17Maa kaa la banla n feliŋ ɛɛ u huŋhunna Jɛrusalɛm la be gba. N izoore la Lɔrbizi hɛri di ga du de mɔɔ, ka jaa bir ba Damaskus.
18Binni ahoro n wa bɛrɛɛ, n jaa izi la Jɛrusalɛm, ń wer zum Pitta la banna yir Sifas la. Hɔpizaa fidaanuere n faa du u be a saŋa. 19U bɛnnɛ n na. Maa Kɔraawiizi huŋhunna la bɛl maa nawɛɛ, di Sifas la ni yaa Dɔɔri niwee Jems bɛŋ lɛi. 20Wibii maanii n sɛbi guŋ. Kɔraawiizi zummɔ lugɔ wibiire n na ŋɔ. Kara lɛi. 21Denii n izi de di la Siiria ni Silisia hɛssi. 22Yeesu Kristo hiŋra la n du Juda hɛri la faa wan zummɛ siwee ni. Ba siwee faa haa waa n ni chaanɛɛ, 23ka ra nuu n wia lugɔ unla n faa ra tɔɔri baa labuu jaa ra bagli nɛra hiŋaa la uŋ faa ra nyiŋŋi u chɔgi la. 24Ba ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi dikuu n wia.

english_text:
1 Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus. 2But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
3Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised. 4We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves. 5But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
6 Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message. 7They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews. 8God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
9James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews. 10They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do.
Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
11When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong. 12He used to eat with Gentile followers of the Lord, until James sent some Jewish followers. Peter was afraid of the Jews and soon stopped eating with Gentiles. 13He and the others hid their true feelings so well that even Barnabas was fooled. 14But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said:
Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
15We are Jews by birth and are not sinners like Gentiles. 16 But we know that God accepts only those who have faith in Jesus Christ. No one can please God by simply obeying the Law. So we put our faith in Christ Jesus, and God accepted us because of our faith.
17When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't! 18But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first. 19It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God.
I have been nailed to the cross with Christ. 20I have died, but Christ lives in me. And I now live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave his life for me. 21I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
translation_text:
Yeesu huŋhunna n lɛɛ Pɔɔl wia
1Denii binni fidaanaazu n kaa wa bɛri, n kaa kuari la Jɛrusalɛm. N ni Banabas kpauwɔɔ la, di ga lau Taitus jaa yaa ni di la de. 2Kɔraawiizii faa bagliŋ lugɔ ń na la. N la ga bagli baa gunla maa miŋ ɔɔ lizi amaniyesuma la di ra tɛɛ banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ la. Ba nabɔnzi benii n feli la ga bagli ba bɛŋ mɔɔ, ń nuu ba be lugɔ n baglɔɔrɛ nɛnnɛ gɛɛ pɛɛpɛɛrɛ n faa aah siwii ra bagli a wia gunlai? 3Ba faa zummɔ lugɔ Taitus la ɛɛ Giris hinuurɛ, u hɛŋ waa teŋŋe. Ka ba faa waa nyiŋŋi bá firuu lugɔ bá teŋ u hɛŋ. 4Baŋhina faa du de di ra dar nɛra lugɔ ba ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋraa. Ba ba wa suahzi zuu yaa biini, bá zum yaa hinaa dɔɔi Yeesu Kristo hiŋaa biini, di faa ra nyiŋŋi ya kaa birgi yoma. 5Ka yaa waa sɛɛwɛ bá fir yaa tama maa, bá gilɛɛ wer bir Kɔraawiizi wibii lii amaniyesuma la biini, ka ú haa wer dɔɔ wibii tɛɛ ia.
6Banla banna yir nabɔnzi la faa du de. Ka maa ba wia kpawɛɛ su siwii. Kɔraawiizi waa yaa newea nabɔmuu ra binni. Ba wam baglɛɛ wiimaa, 7ka sɛɛ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi humimbuu ń lizi amaniyesuma la di ra tɛɛ banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ gunla uŋ faa hum Pitta ge ú lizaa tɛɛ Jus hina la. 8Kɔraawiizi la n na hum Pitta bampirii biini, u wer di ra hum Jus hina be la, waabuu ra hum n ge bampirii biini, n wer ra hum banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ be la. 9Awia, baŋ wa zummɛ lugɔ Kɔraawiizii ra hiiniŋ la, banla banna yir ba nabɔnzi la, Jems, Sifas ani Jɔɔn la, ba kpa n ni Banabas di birgi ba dɔŋahina, di gil yaa maa dɔɔ nuukpaŋ lugɔ yaawaa danna bagli banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ, ka bá ge ra bagli Jus hina la. 10Wikpaŋ bɛnnɛ ba ŋɔ, dí ya ɔɔ ra liizi ba nyaara wia, di ra hiini baa. Gunnɛ n gba faa ra nyiŋŋi.
Pɔɔl n hau Pitta ni Antiɔk wia
11Denii Sifas ba Antiɔk, n pɛɛzuu wii bɛl, dikuubɛɛwiai, u hor faa waa sum. 12Uŋ faa du yaa be saŋa la banla Jems n hummɛ la n faa haa waa ballɛ mɔɔ la, u ni banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ la ɔɔ faa kpawuu ra di. Ka banla Jems n hummɛ la n wa ballɛ, u bargi u hiŋ banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ la be. Waa kaa sɛɛ ú ni baa ra di, dikuu unna ɔm banla n na tɔgzi Moosis Gbɔgni hiŋaa ni hɛŋ teŋaa wia la. 13Uŋ ɛɛ gunla, Jus hina la maa n kawɛɛ la gba hiŋ u wiɛɛlaa la. Ba nfɛrɛ tɛɛ baa lugɔ guŋ waa deŋlee ka ba ra ɛɛ guŋ, di wer dar Banabas gba, u ni baa maa ra ɛɛ guŋ.
14Miŋ wa na guŋ, di zum lugɔ ba wiɛɛlaa n waa deŋlee, ba waa amaniyesuma la ŋmɛnɛɛ ra hiŋ gunla n dɛkkɛ, n izi di ŋɔ Sifas be, ba maa see, “Hiŋ ɛɛ Jus hinuu ka ra chɔg ba Gbɔgni, di ra hiŋ banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ ge hiŋaa la, ka bɛɛ n baani i kaa ŋɔ bánla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ, jaa ra hiŋ Jus hina hiŋaa naanɛi?
15Yaabuu ɛɛ Jus hinaa. Ba lul yaabuu guŋ. Yaa waa banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ, yaa ra yir baa wichɔgɛɛra la ɛɛwɛ. 16Ka yaa zummɔ lugɔ nɛr n ɔɔ ra hiŋ Gbɔgni la wia lɛi u wia wer deŋli Kɔraawiizi be. Ka uŋ yardi Yeesu Kristo wiarɛ u wia wer deŋli Kɔraawiizi be. Awiarɛ yaa gba faa yardi Yeesu Kristo la. Yaa n faa ra nyiŋŋi yaa wia deŋli u be la, yaa waa Gbɔgni hiŋaa la binnɛɛ, ka yardi Yeesu Kristo. Nɛr maa waa hoo ú wia n niŋ wer deŋli Kɔraawiizi be, dikuu unna hiŋ Gbɔgni la wia.
17Too. Yaa n faa yardi Yeesu, yaa wia wer deŋli Kɔraawiizi be la, yaa birgi banla n waa Gbɔgni la ra hiŋ la baŋhinaa, di birgi lugɔ wichɔgɛɛra la baŋhina. Di gunnɛ, amɔ, Kristoo gillɛ nɛra ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa? Akai! 18Ka di n na nyiŋŋi n kaa tɔgzi Gbɔgni la miŋ faa gil a hiŋaa la, n daŋ birgi wichɔgɛɛri, 19dikuubɛɛwiai, Gbɔgni labuu gillɛ n zum wia di gil a hiŋaa. N siuwɔɔ Gbɔgni hiŋaa la be ka ń wer dɔɔ miibɔɔ Kɔraawiizi be. 20Baŋ faa kpaahzi Yeesu Kristo mari daakaŋlii la ni la, n nuu maanii faa siuwɛ de. N miibɔɔbinii la tunnɔɔ. Ka Kristo jaa du n biini n na nyiŋ. Minna nyiŋ naa, yarda la miŋ yardi Kɔraawiizi Biibaal labuu gillɛ n wer dɔɔ a miibɔɔ. U Biibaal la faa nɔŋŋimbuu werge maa, di siu dikuu n wia. 21Màá sɛɛ gil Kɔraawiizi nɛsunaa ni u hiinaa bir pɛɛ. Di nɛr faa wetto gil u wia deŋli Kɔraawiizi be dikuu Gbɔgni hiŋaa la wia, amɔ, Kristo faa siuwɔɔ pɛɛ.”

english_text:
Faith Is the Only Way
1You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you? 2I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him? 3How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you? 4Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing? 5God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
6 The Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith. 7 And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham. 8 Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him. 9This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
10 Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.” 11 No one can please God by obeying the Law. The Scriptures also say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.”
12 The Law isn't based on faith. It promises life only to people who obey its commands. 13 But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse. 14And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit.
The Law and the Promise
15My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement. 16That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ. 17 What I am saying is that the Law cannot change or cancel God's promise made 430 years before the Law was given. 18 If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
19What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people. 20There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him.
Slaves and Children
21Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law. 22But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.
23The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith. 24In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God. 25But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
26All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus. 27And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes. 28Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman. 29 So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
translation_text:
Gbɔg gɛɛ yarda hiŋaa wia
1Ee, Galesia hina! Gɛnaarɛ ia. Yaa faa bagli iabuu Yeesu Kristo wia, di gil u siu daakaŋlii la ni wia wer chaani ii be. Ka beedee n dar ia ii kaa ra leu filaŋkennei? 2Iiŋ faa na Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii u be la, iiŋ hiŋ Gbɔgni wiarɛ ii nau gɛɛ iin nuu amaniyesuma la di sɛɛ wiarɛ, ii nauwɛi? Ií bagliŋ bɛl. 3Ii gɛnnɔɔ werge. Di ii faari Kristo hiŋaa naa u Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biini, bɛɛ wiarɛ ii kaa ŋɔ ií tunaa ii himmaa fɔŋŋa biinei? 4Amɔ, tɔɔrɔɔ la maa iin diwee Kristo hiŋaa naa biini naa, pɛɛpɛɛrɛ ii di a tɔɔrɔaa? Maa sɛɛwɛ. 5Kɔraawiizi n ɔɔ kpa u Dumnanii ra tɛɛ ia di ra ɛɛ wizenaa ii baambaaŋ la, u ɛɛ gunnɛ ra tɛɛ ia dikuu iinna hiŋ Gbɔgni la wia gɛɛ u ɛɛ gunnɛ ra tɛɛ ia dikuu iiŋ faa nuu amaniyesuma la di sɛɛ la wiai?
6Ií binni yaa naabaal Abraham wia biini. Ba faa sɛbɔɔrɛ, dí, “Abraham yardi Kɔraawiizii. Kɔraawiizi kuu guŋ wia di gil u wia deŋli u be.” 7Awia, ií zum lugɔ banla n yardi Kɔraawiizi, baabuu Abraham biizi himmaa la. 8Kɔraawiizi faa feloore bagli Abraham amaniyesuma naa, di ŋɔ, “N daŋ ŋmɛnɛ kissi banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ, bá nuu suma dikuu i wia.”
Denii ba sɛbi guŋ du Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba faa wettoo zum lugɔ Kɔraawiizi daŋ ŋmɛnɛ kuu banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ la n yarduu wia di gil ba na hiinaa lii u be. 9Awia, nɛra la n yardi Kɔraawiizi lugɔ Abraham n faa yarduu la, baabuu Kɔraawiizi gil ba ra nuu suma la gunla uŋ gillɛ Abraham nuu suma la.
