10Banla ge n ɔɔ binni lugɔ ba Gbɔgni hiŋaa la daŋ lɛɛ baa la, baabuu du Kɔraawiizi nuuseelii la biinii, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Nɛr la maa n waa wette ra hiŋ gbɔg la n du hɔnnaa biini naa, n daŋ seeu nua.” 11Yaa wetto zum lugɔ Gbɔgni hiŋaa wàá wer gil nɛr maa wia deŋli Kɔraawiizi be. U guŋ waa aana dɔɔwɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, dí, “Nɛr la wia n deŋlee, yardaa niŋ ɛɛ u miibɔɔ.”
12Nɛr la n na nyiŋŋi ú hiŋ Gbɔgni la, yarda lɛi niŋ lɛɛ a hiŋ. Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ kaa ra bagli, dí, “Nɛr la n wette hiŋ Gbɔgni la maa, waabuu, niŋ na miibɔɔ a hiŋaa biini.”
13Yeesu Kristo lɛɛ yaabuu lii Kɔraawiizi nuuseelii la uŋ see banla maa n waa wette hiŋ Gbɔgni la maa biini. Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Nɛr la maa baŋ kpawɛɛ sag daa ni di kpu, Kɔraawiizi seeubuu nua.”
Awia, Kristo n sag daa ni la, Kɔraawiizi nuuseelii labuu u kpa chi di siu, di wer lɛɛ yaa Kɔraawiizi nuuseelii la biini la. 14U ɛɛ gunnɛ, bánla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ wer kuu Yeesu Kristo wia di nuu suma, di lii suma la uŋ faa ŋɔ nua lugɔ u daŋ gil Abraham wa nuu la biini. Kɔraawiizi Duma la uŋ faa ŋɔ nua lugɔ u daŋ kpa tɛɛ nɛra labuu u ŋɔ ya na, dikuu yaa n yardi Yeesu Kristo wia la.
Gbɔg ni nua ŋɔi wia
15Yaabalaa, ií gil n kpa yaa newea wii bɛl di mɛgzi wia naa minna bagli naa. Di i ni nɛbɛl ɛɛ nuukpaŋ bɛl di gil u du kpeg i bɛl maa wàá wer vɛɛu, ii wàá wer biruu ge. 16Too. Kɔraawiizi n faa ŋɔ nua la, Abraham ni u naana bɛllɛ u ŋɔ a nua tɛɛ. Uŋ ŋɔ u naana bɛl wia naa, waa nɛkpila wia ŋɔwɛɛ, nɛkpannɛ u ŋɔ. Kristo wiarɛ u faa ŋɔ la. 17Awia, ií ra nuu n be. Kɔraawiizi n kuari nuukpaŋ dɔɔi la, binni kalfaanaazu ni tokko ni kpɔrgɔ wa bɛrɔɔrɛ mɔɔ, ka u kaa ŋɔ Gbɔgni la wia di bagli Moosis. Nuukpaŋ dɔɔi la n feli Gbɔgni la werge maa naa, a Gbɔgni wàá wer gil ú bir pɛɛ. A wàá wer chɔgi Kɔraawiizi nua la uŋ felee ŋɔ la. 18Di yaa Kɔraawiizi kapɛttɛ dii faa ra lii Gbɔgni hiŋaa la biinii, amɔ, waa nua la Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔwɛɛ la ge ni ra lii. Ka guŋ lɛi a du. Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ a ra lii u nua la uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ Abraham la biini.
19Amɔ, bɛɛwiarɛ Gbɔgni ge lii naanɛi? A liwɔɔrɛ á wer bagli yaa wia la n waa wer. Kɔraawiizi kpaabuu jaa u nua la uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ la ni, á du de mɔɔ ka Abraham naana la uŋ faa ŋɔ a nua tɛɛ la ba. Gbɔgni la n faa liwɛɛ la, Kɔraawiizi mɛlikazii faa ba a ni di wa bagli sitɔɔri hiŋ bɛl, u ge kpa bagli nɛra. 20A sitɔɔri n faa du de la, nɛkpaŋ lɛi kpa Gbɔgni wia la ba. Ka Kɔraawiizi bɛnnɛ du de saŋa la uŋ faa ŋɔ nua lawaa.
21Amɔ, Gbɔgni ni Kɔraawiizi nua la uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ Abraham la ra yoo dɔŋaa gɛɛ? Akai! Di gbɔg bɛl faa du de ban niŋ hiŋ di wer na miibɔɔ, amɔ, Kɔraawiizi daŋ faa gil ba wia deŋli u be, dikuu gbɔg la hiŋaa wia. 22Ka Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ ra tɛɛ durnya maa chɔgrii, ka yárda wa wer ɛɛ ŋmɛnɛɛ bá kpa di lii wia biini, di na nua la Kɔraawiizi n faa ŋɔwɛɛ la. Banla n dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo yarda labuu niŋ na di lii Kɔraawiizi nuuŋɔɔlii hiŋ biini.
23Saŋa la yarda la wia n haa waa liwɛɛ la, yaa faa haa du Gbɔgni la noneere, ka yarda la wia haa wa lii. 24Gbɔgni la faa ɛɛ yaa binnii mɔɔ ka Kristo ba, yá jaa yarduu ka Kɔ́raawiizi wer gil yaa wia deŋli u be. 25Yarda n liwɛɛ naa, Gbɔgni la waa kaa ɛɛ yaa binni di dɔɔ yaa fɔŋŋa.
Kɔraawiizi biibaala wia
26Ii maa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biizii, dikuu iiŋ yardi Yeesu Kristo wia. 27Ii banla maa baŋ faa sɔ Kɔraawiizi nii ii ni Kristo kpau la, ii lɛɛ Kristoo di du ii ni gunla. 28Awia, a waa kaa ɛɛ lugɔ Jus hinuurɛ keŋ, unla n waa Jus hinuu ɛɛwɛ genii keŋ. A waa kaa ɛɛ lugɔ baliirɛ keŋ, unla n dɔɔ u hiŋ genii keŋ. A waa kaa ɛɛ lugɔ baallɛ keŋ, haaŋ genii keŋ. Ii maa du Yeesu Kristo biinii, di ɛɛ kpaŋ. 29Di ii ɛɛ Kristo hora, ii ɛɛ Abraham naannaa, di ɛɛ banla n niŋ wer na u kapɛttɛ di di gunla Kɔraawiizi n faa ŋɔ nua la.

english_text:
1Children who are under age are no better off than slaves, even though everything their parents own will someday be theirs. 2This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set. 3This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
4But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law, 5 so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children. 6 Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father. 7You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised.
Paul's Concern for the Galatians
8Before you knew God, you were slaves of gods that are not real. 9But now you know God, or better still, God knows you. How can you turn back and become the slaves of those weak and pitiful powers? 10You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years. 11I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
12My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me 13when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick. 14My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself. 15Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me. 16Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
17Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention. 18It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you. 19My children, I am in terrible pain until Christ may be seen living in you. 20I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled.
Hagar and Sarah
21Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says? 22 In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free. 23The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
24All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave. 25Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
26 But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave. 27 The Scriptures say about her,
“You have never had children,
but now you can be glad.
You have never given birth,
but now you can shout.
Once you had no children,
but now you will have
more children than a woman
who has been married
for a long time.”
28My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was. 29 But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today. 30 The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.” 31My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
translation_text:
1N wiŋɔzi hiŋ zɛɛrɛ keŋ. Nɛzeŋ bie daŋ ŋmɛnɛ di u mɛɛ kapɛttɛ la maa. Ka di u haa ɛɛ bichala, u wia ni u mɛɛ balaa wia haa ɛɛ kpannɛ, 2dikuubɛɛwiai, u kebee ni u kuna ni u wia maa du nɛra baŋhina noneere. A nɛra danna binni a ni mɔɔ, di ra binni u ge gba ni, ka ú haa waa hel binni la maga u mɛɛ n dauwɛ lugɔ u daŋ wa hel guŋ, ka haa di u kapɛttɛ la. 3Gunnɛ yaa ge gba faa du. Yaa faa haa waa helle ka du de, di ra hiŋ durnya wia, a dɔɔ yaa. 4Ka Kɔraawiizi saŋa n wa helle, u hum u Biibaal durnya, haaŋ bɛl luluu u du de, di ra sɛɛ Gbɔgni la dɔɔra, 5ka ú ŋmɛnɛ wa wer lɛɛ durnya lii a Gbɔgni biini, ya gilɛɛ kaa ɛɛ balaa, ka Kɔraawiizi wer ra dɛɛzi yaa, yá ɛɛ u biizi. 6Iiŋ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biizi la, u hum u Biibaal Dumaa u du ii ni yaa maa biine di ra yir Kɔraawiizi, “Mmɛ! Mmɛ!” 7Awia, ii bɛl maa waa kaa ɛɛ balii. I ɛɛ u biere. Hiŋ ɛɛ u bie la, Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil í wer na u kapɛttɛ gba di.
Galesia hina wia n tir Pɔɔl wia
8Saŋa la ii faa waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ, ka ra hum kundumazi la n waa Kɔraawiizi ɛɛwɛ la, di ra sɛɛ a dɔɔra. 9Ka filaŋkennaa, iiŋ wette di zum Kɔraawiizi naa, gɛɛ iiŋ ɛɛ u zunna naa, ɛrɛɛ a kaa ɛɛ ii ŋɔ ií kaa bir a hiŋ durnya wiazi lai? A waa fɔŋŋa ni hiinaa maa dɔɔwɛ, ka ii ŋɔ á kaa dɔɔ iai? 10Ii ra tɔgzi hɔpizizenaa, baagufalaa, saŋazi ani binni aŋhinaa. 11Ii wia tirimbuu. Amɔ, huma la miŋ hummɛ ii be la, pɛɛpɛɛrɛ n humaawaa?
12N na fɔrgi iabuu, yaabalaa. N faa gil Gbɔgni tɔgzaarɛ ka birgi gunla iin duwɛɛ la. Awia, ií ge gil a tɔgzaa filaŋkeŋ, ka birgi gunla miŋ ge n duwɛɛ naa. Miŋ faa du ii be la, ii faa waŋ ɛɛwɛ wichɔgaa. 13Ii zummɔ lugɔ miŋ faa waa kpeg wiarɛ n faa du ii be, di wer di ra lizi amaniyesuma la ra tɛɛ ia lugli la. 14N gɛrga la wia faa kpolloo ii be, ka ii faa waŋ gbɛllɛɛ dikuu a wia. Ii faa waŋ vɛɛwɛ ka lɛɛŋ dau ii be lugɔ Kɔraawiizi mɛlikaa miŋ gɛɛ Yeesu Kristoo miŋ. 15Ii bɔra faa sɔɔni iabuu werge. Ka ɛrɛɛ a bir du filaŋkennei? Di ii faa wetto, ii daŋ faa lizi ii siwee gba tɛŋ. N zum ii wiarɛ guŋ. 16Ka ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ minna ŋɔ wibii ra tɛɛ ia, ii jaa kpaŋ birgi ii dɔm filaŋkennei?
17Banla minna ŋɔ ba wia naa, ba aah siwiire ií ni ba wer du sum, ka bá wer dar ia. Ba ra nyiŋŋi ba lau iabuu bargi ii bɛŋ, ka ií wer aah siwii dikuu ba ge wia. 18Di nɛra ra aah siwii ani wibii, bá ni ba dɔŋahina wer du sum, guŋ wesso. Ka ií ra ɛɛ guŋ saŋa maa di ra la. Ií gilɛɛ waa ɛɛ guŋ saŋa la miŋ du ii be la bɛŋ. 19N biinɔŋŋaa, n lul iabuu di du Yeesu Kristo hiŋaa biini. Ka lulaa hiwiila kaa lɔŋ dikuu ii wia, n aah siwii ií wer du Kristo duula. 20Oo! N vii wetto du ii be filaŋkeŋ, n daŋ vii wer bir n nua. Ii wia tirimbuu werge maa. Maa kaa zum ii wia siwee filaŋkeŋ.
Haga ni Saara wia
21Ii banla n na nyiŋŋi ií ra hiŋ Gbɔgni la, ii waa nuuwɛ gunla Gbɔgni la n na bagliaa? 22Ba faa sɛbi Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biinii lugɔ Abraham lul biibaala banɛɛrɛ. Yoŋhaaŋ labuu lul bɛl. Haaŋ la n dɔɔ u hiŋ la ge lul bɛl. 23Abraham ni yoŋhaaŋ la lul ba biere ba himmaa fɔŋŋa biini. Ka unlawaa, Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ nua tɛu lugɔ u daŋ lul la wiarɛ u wer lul u bie.
24Too. N bagli ia ba wia, ií wer kpa mɛgzi Kɔraawiizi ni newea nuukpaŋ dizi anɛɛ la. Yoŋhaaŋ la sɔnnɛ faa Haga. Waabuu ya kpa ra mɛgzi nuukpaŋ la baŋ ɛɛwɛ Bizeŋ Sinaai, bɔr la baŋ faa na Gbɔgni la. U biizi ɛɛ yoma. 25Haga la ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ Bizeŋ Sinaai la n du Lɔrbizi hɛri la, di kaa ɛɛ lugɔ Jɛrusalɛm, dikuubɛɛwiai, Jɛrusalɛm ni u hina maa ɛɛ yomaa. 26Ka Jɛrusalɛmzi la du anɛɛrɛ. Unla n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi hor du de. Waabuu dɔɔ u hinnɛ. Waabuu yaa ge maa la. 27Ba faa sɛbɔɔrɛ,
“Gil i bɔra sɔɔni,
hìŋ́ haaŋ la n waa lullɛ la,
gil i bɔra sɔɔni, i ra chaasi,
dikuubɛɛwiai, haaŋ la u jaari
n faa vɛɛwɛ la daŋ haa dɔɔ biizi
kaali unla n haa du
u jaari dia la.”
28Yaabalaa, Abraham bie Aizik la un lullɛ dikuu Kɔraawiizi nuuŋɔɔlii la wia la, u ni yaa wia ɛɛ kpannɛ. 29Gunla bie la baŋ lullɛ ba himmaa vaaŋ ni n faa ra tɔɔri bie la baŋ lullɛ Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biini la, gunnɛ a kaa wa ɛɛ filaŋkennaa. 30Ií ra nuu gunla baŋ faa sɛbɛɛ di ŋɔ, “Duŋŋi yoŋhaaŋ la ni u biibaal la. A waa wer yoŋhaaŋ biibaal ni haaŋ la n dɔɔ u hiŋ la biibaal n kpauwɛ di ra di ba mɛɛ kapɛttɛ.” 31Awia, yaabalaa, yaa waa yoŋhaaŋ biizi ɛɛwɛ. Haaŋ la n dɔɔ u hiŋ la biizii yaa.

english_text:
Christ Gives Freedom
1Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
2I, Paul, promise you that Christ won't do you any good if you get circumcised. 3If you do, you must obey the whole Law. 4And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace. 5But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ. 6If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
7You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth. 8And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you. 9 A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough, 10but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
11My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised. 12I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
13My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love. 14 All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself. 15But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves.
God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
16If you are guided by the Spirit, you won't obey your selfish desires. 17 The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should. 18But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
19People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds. 20They worship idols, practice witchcraft, hate others, and are hard to get along with. People become jealous, angry, and selfish. They not only argue and cause trouble, but they are 21envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
22God's Spirit makes us loving, happy, peaceful, patient, kind, good, faithful, 23gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways. 24And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires. 25God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit. 26But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_text:
Hindɔɔi lawaa nɛnnɛ wia
1Yaa maa dɔɔ yaa hinaarɛ. Kristo lɛɛ yaabuu ha, yaa waa kaa ɛɛ yoma. Awia, ii gilɛɛ ra binni iihinaa dɔɔi la pɛɛ, ka lau guŋ nɛnnɛ. Ií gilɛɛ gil ba kpa yoma wia di kaa ra vɔɔzi ia.
2Ií gil mìŋ́ Pɔɔl ŋɔ ii be. Di ii gillɔ ba teŋri ii hɛna, ii wàá wer na tɔna maa Kristo hiŋaa naa biini. 3Ií gil n kaa ŋɔ nɛr la maa n gillɛ ba teŋ u hɛŋ la be, di i gillɔ ba teŋ i hɛŋ, amɔ, i daŋ hiŋ Gbɔgni la maa. Di i ra nyiŋŋii, di haa nyiŋŋii, ka i danna hiŋaa. 4Ii banla n kpa Gbɔgni hiŋaa ŋɔ ií gil ii wia deŋli Kɔraawiizi be la, ii lau iihinaarɛ bargi Kristo be. Ii waa kaa hoo u nɛsunaa dɔɔi la biini. 5Yaa zummɔ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi Dumaa niŋ gil yaa wia deŋli Kɔraawiizi be, dikuu yaa n yarduu wia. Awia, yaa ra kpaŋ gunnɛ ani tamii. 6Yeesu Kristo hiŋaa naa biini, di ba teŋ i hɛŋ, di ba waa i hɛŋ teŋŋe, ka a waa wizeŋ maa ɛɛwɛ. Wii la n ɛɛ wizeŋ, waabuu Kɔraawiizi yarda la n ɔɔ hum nɛra biine, di gil ba nɔŋŋi dɔŋa la.
7Ii faa ra hiŋuu nɛnnɛ. Ka bɛɛ n baani ii waa kaa ra hiŋ wibii naanɛi? Bɛɛ n teŋ ia ŋmɛnɛɛi? 8Kɔraawiizi la n yir ia ii ba u be la be lɛi nfɛrɛ naa lii. 9“Yiisi tama daŋ wer fuu paanuu kpila maa.” Awia, ií ra dazi nfɛrɛ naa dee ni. 10Ka n dɔɔ ii tamiirɛ dikuu yaa Dɔɔri la yaa maa n na hiŋ la wia lugɔ ii wàá ka dɔɔ nfɛrduma bɛl maa wia naa biini. Nɛr la maa n na koozi ia, haali di u ɛɛ nɛzeŋ gba, Kɔraawiizi daŋ kpa u wichɔgaa kim turguu.
11Yaabalaa, di n vii ra ŋɔ lugɔ nɛra ra teŋri ba hɛna, ba vii waa kaa ra tɔɔriŋ kennaa. Di n vii waa kaa ra bagli Kristo siwaa daakaŋlii la ni wia, baŋhina vii wàá ra vɛɛ n wiŋɔzi di ra leuzi ŋmɛnɛɛ kennaa. 12Nɛra la n na koozi ia di ŋɔ ií teŋri ii hɛna la, bá vii vari bahinaa.
13Yaabalaa, Kɔraawiizi yir iabuu ií wer dɔɔ iihinaa. Ka ii gilɛɛ kuu guŋ wia di ŋɔ ii daŋ jaa wer ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa la maa ii bɔrahɔna n na nyiŋŋi ii ra ɛɛ la. Akai. Ií kpa dɔnnɔŋŋaa di ra hum dɔŋa, 14dikuubɛɛwiai, Gbɔgni la maa du widaulikpaŋ biinii. Waabuu hiŋ nɔŋŋi i dɔŋhiŋ gunla hin nɔŋŋi i hiŋ la. 15Ka di ii ni ii dɔŋahina ra naa, di ii waa tau ra du, ii daŋ chɔgi dɔŋa ni.
Miibɔɔ ni Duma wia
16Ií ra ɛɛ ii wiimaa Kɔraawiizi Duma fɔŋŋa biini. Denii ii wàá kaa ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa la ii bɔrahɔna n na nyiŋŋi la. Gunnɛ miŋwaa ŋɔ. 17Ii bɔrahɔna la ɔɔ izuu ra yoo Kɔraawiizi Duma la n du ii biine la, Kɔraawiizi Duma ge ra yoo ii bɔrahɔna. A wàá wer dɔɔ nuukpaŋ maa. Awia, ii waa ɔɔ wer ra ɛɛ wii la iinna nyiŋŋi. 18Ka di Kɔraawiizi Duma kipattɛ ii ra sɛɛ, Gbɔgni la wàá ka dɔɔ ii fɔŋŋa.
19Newea bɔrahɔŋ wiɛɛlaarɛ sɛnsɛŋ wia ni a dee maa, 20vuga kuaraa, hiri dii ni tagbizi ɛɛi, dɔŋhahzi, hɔɔzi dii, bɔwii, baaŋfuuih dumazi, bɛnsɔnnyiŋŋaa, nuukpaŋ vɛɛi dɔŋa ni, dɔmbargaa dɔŋa be, 21zoma, sindɛɛza ani basabasa wia ni a dee maa. N faa karfi iabuu wia naa wia. Ka ií gil n kaa karfi ia. Banla maa n na ɛɛ wia naa, wàá wer du Kɔraawiizi Kora biini di di u suma la.
22Mannizi la Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii n hiini nɛra ba wer dɔɔ genii nɛnɔŋŋaa, bɔsɔna dɔɔi, bampirsɔna dɔɔi, kanyitti dii, nɛhiinaa, winanaa ɛɛi, wibii dɔɔi, 23sisɔna dɔɔi ani hinlawaa. Annii bɛl maa waa gbɔg chɔgaa dɔɔwɛ. 24Banla n ɛɛ Yeesu Kristo hora la kpa ba bɔrahɔŋ wichɔgaa ni ba nfɛrchɔgaa maanii di kpu daakaŋlii la ni. 25Di ii dɔɔ miibɔɔfalii di lii Kɔraawiizi Duma fɔŋŋa biini, amɔ, ií nuu ra tɛu di ra hiŋ u nua. 26Ya gilɛɛ ra nyiŋŋi zenni dɔŋa ni, di ra nuu dɔŋa nuuzi, di ra ɛɛ dɔŋa bɔwii.

english_text:
Help Each Other
1My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself. 2You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
3If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong. 4Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others. 5We each must carry our own load.
6Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
7You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant. 8If you follow your selfish desires, you will harvest destruction, but if you follow the Spirit, you will harvest eternal life. 9Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up. 10We should help people whenever we can, especially if they are followers of the Lord.
Final Warnings
11You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
12Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ. 13They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised. 14But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
15It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
16If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
17 On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
18My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
translation_text:
Winanaa ɛɛi tɛɛ nɛr maa wia
1Yaabalaa, di ii dɔŋhiŋ bɛl ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa, ba wa lawuu a wichɔgaa ɛɛi biini, ií banla n dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi Duma nɛnnɛ la, daŋ lɛɛu u wichɔgaa la ɛɛi biini. Ií ɔɔ ra ɛɛ guŋ ka ra dazi, di gilɛɛ waa nyɛg u ni, wíchɔgaa gilɛɛ waa ɛɛ ii ge ra na, ii ge wa sɛɛa. 2Ií lɛɛ dɔŋa bunni di ra chi ra di dɔŋa tɔɔrɔɔ. Di ii wetto ra ɛɛ guŋ, ii ra hiŋ Kristo widaulii la maanii nɛnnɛ la.
3Di nɛr la maa ra yir u hiŋ nɛzeŋ, u ra dar u hinnɛ. Waa nɛr maa ɛɛwɛ. 4A dɛkkɔ nɛr maa n na binni u himmaa wiɛɛlaa ni, di gilɛɛ kpaa bɔ babalaa wiɛɛlaa, di nyiŋŋi sɔŋ a tɛɛ u hiŋ. Ií gil u sɔŋ dɔɔi la lii u bɛmbɛŋ wiɛɛlaa biini, 5dikuubɛɛwiai, nɛr maa ni u bunnii un niŋ chi.
6Di nɛr ra bagli ia Yeesu Kristo wia, ii daŋ hiinuu ni ii kunnanaa maa.
7Gilɛɛ ra dar i hiŋ. Hàá wer dar Kɔraawiizi. Wia la hiŋ duuwe, aabuu í kum. 8Di i kuu i bɔrahɔŋ wia di duu wichɔgaa, i daŋ kum chɔgaa lii i bɔrahɔŋ wia biini. Di i kuu i duma wia di duu winanaa, i daŋ kum miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ lii Kɔraawiizi Duma la be.
9Ya gilɛɛ gil winanaa ɛɛi kuuhni ra biri yaa siwee, ka ya haa vɛɛ ra ɛɛa. Di yaa haa vɛɛwɔ ra ɛɛa, di saŋa bɛl wa hello, yaa daŋ na tɔna a biini. 10Awia, di yaa wa na ŋmɛnɛɛ lugɔ ya ɛɛ winanaa, ya ra ɛɛ guŋ. Ka ii dɔŋahina Yeesu hiŋra wiarɛ kpolle.
Karfaa tuna ni jaamaa wia
11N himmaanii sɛbɛɛ ɛŋ. Na gunla n sɛbaa n kannɛ werge.
12Nɛra la n na fir ia di ra ŋɔ lugɔ ií teŋri ii hɛna la, nɛra wiarɛ ba ra ɛɛ guŋ, bá wia vii wer par baa, á nɛra ge gilɛɛ kuu baŋ sɛɛ Yeesu Kristo ni u siwaa daakaŋlii la ni wia di ra tɔɔri baa. 13Banla n gillɛ ba teŋri ba hɛna la, ba himmaa waa Gbɔgni la maa ra hiŋ. Ka ba ra nyiŋŋi ba teŋri ii ge hɛna nɛ́ra ra chɔli baa dikuu a wia.
14Miŋwaa wàá sɛɛ chɔli n hiŋ ani wiimaa, ka ra chɔli yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo siwaa daakaŋlii la ni la bɛŋ. U siwaa la gillɔɔ durnya wia birgi wipɛɛri n be. A siuwɔɔ di gil n ge siu di wer lii a durnya wia fɔŋŋa biini.
15Yeesu Kristo ge hiŋaa biini naa, di i teŋ i hɛŋ, di haa i hɛŋ teŋŋe, ka u guŋ lɛi ɛɛ wizeŋ. Wii la n ɛɛ wizeŋ, waabuu lugɔ yaa n birgi nɛfalaa. 16Banla maa n ninna hiŋ gunla miŋ baglɛɛ ani banla maa n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi nɛra di ɛɛ Jus hina himmaa la, Kɔ́raawiizi tɛɛ baa bampirsɔna di suŋ ba ni.
17Filaŋkeŋ, nɛ́r maa gilɛɛ kaa ra tɔɔriŋ. N dɔɔ pɛlaa dikuu yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo wia.
18Yáa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo hiini ia, yaabalaa. Ami.

english_text:
1 From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus.
To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
2I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
3Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven! 4Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people. 5God was kind and decided that Christ would choose us to be God's own adopted children. 6God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
7-8 Christ sacrificed his life's blood to set us free, which means our sins are now forgiven. Christ did this because of God's gift of undeserved grace to us. God has great wisdom and understanding, 9and by what Christ has done, God has shown us his own mysterious ways. 10Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
11God always does what he plans, and this is why he appointed Christ to choose us. 12He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him. 13Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God. 14The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised.
Paul's Prayer
15I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people. 16So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers. 17I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God. 18My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
19I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used 20 when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven. 21There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well. 22 God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything. 23The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
translation_text:
1Mìŋ́ Yeesu Kristo huŋhunni Pɔɔllɛ a sɛbi hɔnnaa ń tɛɛ ia. A par Kɔraawiizii u tɛŋ a huma.
N na jaami ii banla n du Ɛfɛsus, di ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biinanaa di ra hiŋ Yeesu Kristo ani wibii la. 2Yáa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo hiini ia, di tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna.
Suma nuui lii Kristo be wia
3Ií ra tɛɛ yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ. U hiini yaabuu ni winanaa la maa n lii u Dumnanii be, di gil yaa ra di suma u be, dikuu yaa ni Kristo n kpauwɛ wia. Yaa ni Kristo n kpauwɛ la, yaa nuu maanii du Kɔraawiizi be, u bɔr, di ra di suma la.
4Kɔraawiizi faa feloore lizi yaa tɛɛ u hiŋ, saŋa la uŋ faa haa waa durnya gba tawɛɛ la, di ŋɔ u daŋ gil yáa ni Kristo kpau, ya wer ɛɛ u biinanaa di gilɛɛ dɔɔ doŋa maa u be, ka nɔŋŋi dɔŋa ge. 5Uŋ faa felee lizi yaa tɛɛ u hiŋ la, u ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ u daŋ ŋmɛnɛ wa kpa yaa birgi u himmaa biizi, dikuu Yeesu Kristo wia. U kipar wiarɛ u dau yaa wia guŋ, 6ya ŋmɛnɛ wer chɔli u nɛsunaa dɔɔi ni u hiinaa la n wesse werge la. U Biinɔŋŋii hiŋ wiarɛ ú suŋ yaa ni di hiini yaa la. 7Uŋ siuwɛ tɛɛ yaa la, u challɛ yau yaa ha, Kɔraawiizi wer gil yaa wichɔgaa tɛɛ yaa, dikuu un suŋ yaa ni werge maa wia, 8di haa hiini yaa werge, yá wer dɔɔ sichaana ni nunzuma. 9Gunla maa uŋ faa dau Yeesu Kristo wia u kipar biini, faa suahwɔɔ yaa be. Ka u jaa pilli a maanii tɛɛ yaa, yá wer zum gunla maa am paruu u dau u wia saŋa maa, 10a wa ɛɛ saŋa la un dauwɛ la. U faa dau u wiarɛ lugɔ u daŋ wa gil chiŋ ni hɛri kummaa kaa birgi kpaŋ, di sɛɛ Kristo dɔɔra.
11Yaa ni Kristo n niŋ wa kpau la wiarɛ u lizi yaa tɛɛ u hiŋ. Kɔraawiizi la n ɔɔ ra dau gunla wiimaa n niŋ wa ɛɛ la, waabuu felee lizi yaa tɛɛ u hiŋ guŋ, 12nɛ́ra wer chɔli u zenni lii yaa banla n felee dɔɔ Kristo tamii la wia biini.
13Baŋ faa bagli ia wibii di lii amaniyesuma la n dɔɔ lɛɛi ii be la biini, ii gba sɛɛwɔɔ tɛu, Kɔraawiizi kpa u Dumnanii la tɛɛ ia gunla uŋ faa ŋɔ nua la. U Dumnanii la gillɔɔ ii birgi Kɔraawiizi hora. 14U Dumnanii labuu ya feli dɔɔ mɔɔ lii kapɛttɛ la Kɔraawiizi n dauwɛ tɛɛ yaa, ka ya ŋmɛnɛ wa dɔɔ a maa, saŋa la Kɔraawiizi n niŋ wa lɛɛ u kuna la maa ha tuŋ, di na sɔŋ tɛɛ u hiŋ ni u zenni la.
Pɔɔl wiisuŋŋaa wia
15Awia, miŋ nuuwɛ gunla iin dɔɔ yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo yarda, di nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizi biinanaa la maa la, 16n jaa ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizii jaaŋ saŋa la maa minna suŋŋuu di ra tɛɛ ia la. 17Yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n dɔɔ girme werge maa la, ú hiini ia ií wer zum u wia ra jaa saŋa maa, á birgi nunzuma ni sichaana tɛɛ ia, 18di pilli ii siwee, ií wer zum tamii la dee Kɔraawiizi n yir ia ií wer dɔɔ la ani gunla u biizi kapɛttɛ n kannɛ werge di ɛɛ kunnaniinanii bɛl werge maa la, 19di kaa zum fɔŋŋa la dee Kɔraawiizi n dɔɔwɛ, ú hiini yaa banla n yarduu, gunla aŋ ɛɛ fɔŋŋazeŋ werge maa wa bɛri la. Ií liizi gunla uŋ faa ɛɛ Kristo u fɔŋŋa biini, di zum lugɔ a fɔŋŋa himmaanii ú kpa hiini yaa. 20U lalluubuu lii siu biini di kpau la u be, u ga so u nabɔmbɔr u be de, 21di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge maa kaali fɔŋŋa dɔɔra lugɔ tinnanni ni vuga dee maa, di dɔɔ nyuu kaali nɛr maa n du de filaŋkennaa ani banla n niŋ haa wa du de durnya naa harbɔɔ la. 22Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ kummaa sɛɛ u dɔɔra, di gil u ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra la maa nyuu, 23ba ge ɛɛ u bɔrahɔŋ. Unla n kannɛ werge di wer su durnya naa maa gba la, ka waabuu du Yeesu hiŋra la biine.

english_text:
From Death to Life
1 In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God. 2You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God. 3Once we were also ruled by the selfish desires of our bodies and minds. We had made God angry, and we were going to be punished like everyone else.
4-5But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you. 6God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven. 7God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done. 8You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own. 9It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about. 10God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are.
United by Christ
11Don't forget that you are Gentiles. In fact, you used to be called “uncircumcised” by those who take pride in being circumcised. 12At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God, 13and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
14Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body 15 to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace. 16 On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body. 17 Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God. 18And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
19You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God. 20You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone. 21Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord. 22And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
translation_text:
Yaa dɔɔ miibɔɔrɛ dikuu yaa ni Yeesu Kristo n kpauwɛ wia
1Ii faa ɛɛ kunsiwaarɛ. Ii wichɔgaa kpa iabuu birgi guŋ. 2Ii faa ra hiŋ durnya naa ni u wichɔgaa wiarɛ, di ra hiŋ unla n ɛɛ kunchɔgaa yaa siwee n waa na la dɔɔri. Waabuu ɔɔ ra hum dignikpega hina bampiree biini. Yaa maa ni a dignikpega hinaa faa. 3Yaa maanii faa ra hiŋ baa, di ra ɛɛ wia la maa yaa bɔrahɔŋ n tɛɛ yaa ŋɔ ya ra ɛɛ la, di ra hiŋ yaa kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa ni yaa nfɛrchɔgaa. Yaa ni durnya maa ninɛɛ Kɔraawiizi baaŋ faa du, dikuu yaa machɔgaa la wia.
4Ka Kɔraawiizi n nɔŋŋi yaa werge maa la, u wer suŋ yaa ni werge, 5di lalli yaa siu la yaa n siuwɛ dikuu yaa wichɔgaa la wia biini, yáa ni Kristo maa wer kpau dɔɔ miibɔɔ. Kɔraawiizi n suŋ ii ni wiarɛ ii wer na lɛɛi u be. 6Un lalli yaa ni Yeesu Kristo maa siu biini la, u tɛɛ yaabuu sognibɔra u be, dikuu yaa ni Yeesu Kristo n kpauwɛ wia. 7A maanii u ɛɛ tɛɛ yaa dikuu Yeesu Kristo wia, ú wer kpa yaa wia bagli nɛra la n niŋ haa wa du de ni saŋa maa hina, bá na gunla un suŋ yaa ni di hiini yaa werge maa dikuu yaa ni Yeesu Kristo n kpauwɛ la wia la. U nɛsunaa la kannɔɔ werge. Waa maga dɔɔwɛ.
8Kɔraawiizi n lɛɛ ia ha la, ii winanaa ɛɛi wia lɛi u lɛɛ ia ha. U nɛsunaa ni ii yarda wiarɛ u lɛɛ ia ha. Pɛɛpɛɛrɛ u lɛɛ ia ha, di tɛɛ ia miibɔɔ la. 9Yaa hunnanaa biini lɛi a lii, nɛ́r maa gilɛɛ kuu guŋ wia ra chɔli u hiŋ. 10Kɔraawiizii ma yaa. Um ma yaa la, hunnanaa humaa wiarɛ u ma yaa, yá wer humaa Yeesu Kristo fɔŋŋa biini. U feloore dau a hunnanaa tɛɛ yaa saŋa maa, ya ŋmɛnɛ wer humaa.
Yaa ɛɛ kpannɛ Yeesu Kristo wia
11Awia, ií ra liizi gunla iiŋ faa duwɛɛ la. Ii waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ, awia, ii waa ii hɛna teŋree. Banla n teŋri ba hɛna la faa ra gbɛlli iabuu dikuu guŋ wia. Ka ba hor la ɛɛ bɔrahɔŋ mɔnnaa bɛnnɛ. 12Ii faa waa Kristo wia zummɛ. Ii faa waa wiimaa dɔɔwɛ Jus hina wia biini. Ii faa waa Kɔraawiizi nua la uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ kuari u ni u nɛra nuukpaŋ dɔɔi wia zummɛ. Ii faa waa tamii maa dɔɔwɛ ka du de. Ii faa waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ ú wer hiini ia. 13Ka filaŋkeŋ, ii banla n faa du bɔɔnɛɛ bɔɔnɛɛ la, Kɔraawiizi kuu ii ni Yeesu Kristo n kpauwɛ la wiarɛ, di kpa ia dugli u be. Yeesu chal wiarɛ guŋ wer ɛɛ.
14U gillɔɔ yaa dɔɔ nuukpaŋ, di gil yaa banla n faa bargi dɔŋa be birgi kpaŋ. Gunla yaa n faa hah dɔŋa la faa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ koŋlii, di teŋ yaa baaŋ. U jaa purgi a maanii ta. 15U himmaa bɔrahɔŋ ninɛɛ u ɛɛ gunla, di lizi Moosis Gbɔgni hiŋaa la yaa be, á widaulaa gilɛɛ kaa ra bargi yaa, ka ú wer kpa yaa maa birgi kuŋfalii ni kuŋkpaŋ, dikuu yaa maa nuu n kpauwɛ wia. Gunnɛ u ɛɛ di gil yaa dɔɔ nuukpaŋ. 16Wia la maa n faa bargi yaa, yaa hah dɔŋa la, u chɔgi a maanii ha daakaŋlii la ni, di gil yaa maa birgi kpaŋ, di kaa kuari yaa ni Kɔraawiizi wia tɛɛ yaa gunla, 17ka wa bagli ii banla n faa du bɔɔnɛɛ ani banla n faa duglɛɛ la maa lugɔ nuukpaŋ jaa du denii. 18U wiarɛ yaa maa wer hel yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi be. Yaa maa dɔɔ u Dumnanii. U Dumnanii la ɔɔ giluu yaa wer ra hel u be. 19Awia, ii waa kaa ɛɛ hɔɔhra. Ii ɛɛ bol biizii, di ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi nɛra. 20U gillɔɔ ii ɛɛ u dia koŋlaa. U huŋhunna ni u dɔgtɛɛzi ɛɛ u zɛɛ. Yeesu Kristo ge ɛɛ binanii la baŋ kpawɛɛ chiŋŋi a dia zɛɛ. 21Banla maa ba nuu n kpauwɛ la choŋŋi u ni, dia la ra hel di ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Dia, dikuu yaa Dɔɔri la wia. 22Ii gba du denii di ɛɛ dia la Kɔraawiizi n na ma ú ɛɛ u duuribɔr la, dikuu u Duma n du ii ni la wia.

english_text:
Paul's Mission to the Gentiles
1Christ Jesus made me his prisoner, so I could help you Gentiles. 2You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you. 3In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways. 4 As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ. 5No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets. 6And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
7God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news. 8I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured. 9 God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind. 10Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
11God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done. 12Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith. 13This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you.
Christ's Love for Us
14I kneel in prayer to the Father. 15All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him. 16God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers 17and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love. 18 I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep. 19I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
20-21I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
translation_text:
Pɔɔl n hum huma tɛɛ nɛra la n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ wia
1Awiarɛ n suŋŋi wiizi ra tɛɛ ia. Mìŋ́ Pɔɔllɛ du nɛra tɔi dia dikuu minna hiŋ Yeesu Kristo, di ra bagli u wia ra tɛɛ ii banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ wia.
2Ii daŋ faa nuu gunla Kɔraawiizi n suŋ n ni, di hiiniŋ werge ni u fɔŋŋa ka ń wer hiini ia. 3U himmaanii pilli u wisuahlii tɛŋ. N faa feloore sɛbi guŋ wia bagli ia. 4Di ii karmi gunla miŋ faa sɛbɛɛ la, ii daŋ zum lugɔ n zum Kristo wisuahlii wiarɛ. 5Kɔraawiizi faa waa u wolo wia pillɛɛ tɛɛ faala hina la. Ka filaŋkeŋ, u Duma bagli u wiarɛ tɛɛ nɛnanaa la n ɛɛ u huŋhunna ni u dɔgtɛɛzi la, 6di gil ba zum lugɔ banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ daŋ jaa di suma Jus hina wia biini, bá ni baa ɛɛ kpaŋ di wer ra di suma Kɔraawiizi nua la uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ la biini. Yeesu Kristoo gillɛ Kɔraawiizi nua la uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ la wer ɛɛ, bá maa wer di suma la dikuu amaniyesuma la wia.
7Amaniyesuma huma labuu Kɔraawiizi lizi tɛŋ. Un suŋ n ni werge wiarɛ u tɛŋ a huma, di hiiniŋ werge u fɔŋŋa ni. 8N ɛɛ biijagaa u biizi maa biini. Ka minuu u lizi ŋɔ ń lizi amaniyesuma la tɛɛ banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ, bá ge wer zum sunnanii la n waa maga dɔɔwɛ, di du Kristo wia biini la.
9Kɔraawiizi la n ta kummaa la, u bɛnnɛ faa zum wisuahlii naa guŋŋ wa hel zinaa. Ka filaŋkeŋ, u ŋɔ ń pilli gunla un dawuu ni u ŋmɛnizi, tɛɛ nɛra bá zum. 10Mɛlikazi ni kundizi la maa n du Kɔraawiizi be gba daŋ binni Yeesu hiŋra wia, di jaa zum gunla maa Kɔraawiizi nunzuma n faa ra hum la. 11A maanii u dau saŋa maa la ka á wer ɛɛ filaŋkennaa, yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo n ballɛ naa.
12Yaa n yardi Yeesu, u ni yaa kpau la, yaa jaa dɔɔ bampiriire lugɔ yaa n niŋ hel Kɔraawiizi be. Yaa waa kaa ra ɔm. 13Awia, n na suŋŋi iabuu. Ií gilɛɛ gil ii bɔra huah ia dikuu tɔɔrɔɔ naa miŋ kuu ii wia di ra di naa wia, ka zum lugɔ ii ra na sɔnnɛ n tɔɔrɔɔ naa biini.
Yeesu Kristo nɔŋŋaa wia
14Awia, n na giŋŋi n Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi seere. 15Waabuu ɛɛ banla maa n du chiŋ ni hɛri maa mɛɛ. U benii ba ge mɛɛwaa lɛɛ ba sɔŋ ni ba fɔŋŋa di ra di. 16N na suŋŋuubuu ani un dɔɔ girmezeŋ himmaa la, ú gil u Duma hiini ia ni fɔŋŋa werge maa ii biine, 17ií wer dɔɔ yarda nɛnnɛ, Krísto wer na duuribɔr du ii bampiree, di ra suŋŋuu, ií bampiree wer du u ni, di lawuu nɛnnɛ.
18N na suŋŋuubuu ií ni Kɔraawiizi biinanaa la maa wer zum Kristo nɔŋŋaa la, gunla un duwɛɛ, u kanni, u wassi ani u luŋzi maa. 19U nɔŋŋaa la un nɔŋŋi yaa la kaali yaa zumaarɛ. Ka n na suŋŋi Kɔraawiizii ií wer zumuu nɛnnɛ, di wer dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi himmaa ii biine werge maa di wa tuŋ.
20Ií ra tɛɛ unla n na hum u huma yaa biine ani fɔŋŋa ni di wer ra ɛɛ wia a kaali gunla maa yaa n niŋ faa fɛ, di suŋŋuu la gba sɔŋ. 21Ií gil u na girme dikuu Yeesu hiŋra ni Yeesu Kristo wia, saŋaa saŋa maa. Ami.

english_text:
Unity with Christ
1As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own. 2 Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other. 3Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace. 4All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people. 5We have only one Lord, one faith, and one baptism. 6There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
7Christ has generously divided out his gifts to us. 8 As the Scriptures say,
“When he went up
to the highest place,
he led away many prisoners
and gave gifts to people.”
9When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth. 10This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
11Christ chose some of us to be apostles, prophets, missionaries, pastors, and teachers, 12so his people would learn to serve and his body would grow strong. 13This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
14We must stop acting like children. We must not let deceitful people trick us by their false teachings, which are like winds that toss us around from place to place. 15Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head 16 of the body. Christ holds it together and makes all of its parts work perfectly, as it grows and becomes strong because of love.
The Old Life and the New Life
17As a follower of the Lord, I order you to stop living like stupid, godless people. 18Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right, 19and they are so greedy they do all kinds of indecent things.
20-21But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him. 22 You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits. 23Let the Spirit change your way of thinking 24 and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy.
Rules for the New Life
25 We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth. 26 Don't get so angry that you sin. Don't go to bed angry 27and don't give the devil a chance.
28If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
29Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
30Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.
31Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude. 32 Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ.
translation_text:
Bɔrahɔŋ kpaŋri wia
1Mìŋ́ Pɔɔl n du nɛra tɔi dia dikuu yaa Dɔɔri wia la, n na suŋŋi iabuu, ií ra hiŋ gunla an dɛkkɛ banla Kɔraawiizi n yittɛ n ninna hiŋ la. 2Ií ra kpa iihinaa fugzi, di dɔɔ sisɔna ni kanyitti dɔŋa ni, di ɔɔ gil ra tɛɛ dɔŋa dikuu iin nɔŋŋi dɔŋa wia, 3di aah siwii, ií ni ii dɔŋahina wia kuari saŋa maa, ii gilɛɛ chɔgi nuukpaŋ dɔɔi la Kɔraawiizi Duma n tɛɛ ia la.
4Yeesu bɔrahɔŋ ɛɛ kpaŋkpaŋ bɛnnɛ, u Dumnanii ge ɛɛ kpaŋkpaŋ, tamii la yaa maa n dɔɔwɛ la kaa ɛɛ kpaŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi yir yaa maanii. 5Yaa maa Dɔɔri ɛɛ kpannɛ. Yarda la yaa maa n dɔɔwɛ u ni ani yaa Kɔraawiizi nii sɔi la ge gba ɛɛ kpaŋ. 6Yaa maa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi gba ɛɛ kpaŋ. Waabuu ɛɛ yaa maa Dɔɔri di ra hum yaa maa biine, di du yaa maa ni.
7Ka yaa bɛl maa na hiinaare u be, dikuu un suŋ yaa ni wia. Kristo bɔnnaarɛ u bɔnni, yaa maa na. 8Ba sɛbɔɔrɛ Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini, di ŋɔ,
“U kaali chinne.
Banla un lauwɛ la
hiŋuu kaali.
U kaa sunzi
nɛraa kuna.”
9Baŋ ŋɔ lugɔ uŋ kaali chiŋ la, u zɛɛrɛ lugɔ u feloore tuu hɛri. 10Nɛr la n tuuwe la, a hiŋ liwɔɔrɛ kaali chiŋ, di du chinchiŋ himmaa, di kaa su bɔr maa.
11Uŋ kaali chiŋ la, u bɔnni nɛra wiɛɛlaa fɔŋŋazii. U tɛɛ baŋhina fɔŋŋa bá ɛɛ u huŋhunna, di tɛɛ baŋhina fɔŋŋa, bá ɛɛ u dɔgtɛɛzi, di kaa tɛɛ baŋhina fɔŋŋa, bá ra lizi amaniyesuma la. Baŋhina ge, u tɛɛ fɔŋŋa bá ra bagli u wia, di ra hiini nɛra u hiŋaa biini. 12A wiɛɛlaa fɔŋŋazi maanii u bɔnni tɛɛ u biinanaa, bá wer hum u huma nɛnnɛ wa tuŋ, di hiini dɔŋa, Krísto bɔrahɔŋ la wer du kpeg nɛnnɛ, 13ka yáa maa ŋmɛnɛ wer dɔɔ nuukpaŋ dɔŋa ni nɛnnɛ hiŋaa naa biini, di kaa wer zum Kɔraawiizi Biibaal la nɛnnɛ ga tuŋ, di wer hel werge lugɔ nabɔnzi, di dirmi u hiŋaa biini. Kristo labuu yaa kpa ra mɛgzi yaa hinaa la, di zum gunla yaa n niŋ hel.
14Waa nyiŋŋi ya haa ɛɛ lugɔ biifulli u hiŋaa biini. Di yaa waa dirmɛɛ nɛnnɛ, ka baŋhina ba waa bagli yaa bagliduma maa, yaa daŋ sɛɛ manaŋ tɛɛ baa alugɔ kuŋ peu n ɔɔ wer lalluu chiŋ, di wer hau bɔr la maa unna nyiŋŋi la. Nɛra baŋhina daŋ wer kpa nfɛrɛ di kanni kara alugɔ wibiire, di wer dar nɛra.
15Kɔraawiizi ra nyiŋŋi ya lau wibiire, di ŋɔa ra tɛɛ dɔŋa ani nɔŋŋaa ni, ka ya wer hel nɛnnɛ di wer du gunla Kristo n duwɛɛ la. Waabuu yaa Nyuu. 16Yaa ge ɛɛ u bɔrahɔŋ. U gillɔɔ u kpuŋe lauri dɔŋa nɛnnɛ, u yeŋa maa ge hiini dɔŋa, á bɔrahɔŋ wer hel u maga maa. Dɔnnɔŋŋaarɛ ɔɔ gil Kristo bɔrahɔŋ wer ra hel guŋ di wer du kpeg.
Miibɔɔfalii dikuu Yeesu Kristo wia
17N wiŋɔkpeg bɛllɛ keŋ minna ŋɔ ii be ani yaa Dɔɔri sɔŋ. Ií gilɛɛ kaa ra hiŋ gunla banla n waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ n na hiŋ la. Wipɛɛrii ba fɛ ra hiŋ. 18Ba siwee tɔɔgɔɔrɛ. Ba ɛɛ nfɛrnyaara ni dignikpega hinaa. Awia, ba waa Kɔraawiizi miibɔɔ wia zummɛ. 19Wiimaa waa kaa tir baa. Ba jaa kutti ra hiŋ ba kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa, di ra ɛɛ sɛnsɛŋ wia ni wikuna dee maa ra nyaŋŋi.
20Ka iawaa, guŋ lɛi Kristo bagli ia ií ra hiŋ. 21Di ii nuuwɔ tɛɛ Yeesu, saŋa la baŋ faa bagli ia wibii lii u wia biini la, di zum u hiŋaa, ii wàá hiŋ guŋ. 22Ka ii daŋ lizi ii miibɔɔbinii la maa ha, gunla maa iiŋ faa ra hiŋ la. Ii kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa dar iabuu, di chɔgi ii miibɔɔbinii la. Awia, ií lizuu ha, 23di gil Kɔraawiizi kuari ii biine ni ii nfɛssi maa, á birgi a falaa. 24U daŋ tɛɛ ia miibɔɔfalii bɛl dee uŋ kuarɛɛ tɛɛ ia, ií wia maa wer deŋli nɛnnɛ, ií wer ɛɛ winanaa bɛŋ alugɔ u wibii wiŋɔzi n na bagli la. Awia, ií kpa miibɔɔfalii la du iihinaa ni.
25Ií lizi daraa maa ii ni ha, ka ŋɔ wibii bɛŋ ra tɛɛ dɔŋa, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii maa du bɔrahɔŋkpaŋ biinii, di ɛɛ kpaŋ.
26Di i baaŋ fuuhwo, gilɛɛ gil u ɛɛ baanchɔgii, í ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa. Gil u sɔɔni manaŋ. A waa dɛkkɛ hiŋ na baaŋ guŋŋ wiizi wa chol, di u haa waa sɔɔnɛɛ. 27Gilɛɛ gil Sitaani na bɔr darii. 28I faa ra ŋmɛɛu gɛɛ? Gilɛɛ kaa ra ɛɛ guŋ, ka kpa i nonee la di ra hum hunnanaa, í wer na ra di, ka wer na aŋhina ge ra tɛɛ nyaara bá ge ra di.
29Ií gilɛɛ gil wiŋɔkuna maa waa lii ii nuuzi, ka gil ii wiŋɔzi ɔɔ ɛɛ anla n dɛkkɛ, di dɔɔ tɛɛ hiinaa banla n na nuu be, bá wer lau nɛnnɛ. 30Ií gilɛɛ chɔg Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii biini. Kɔraawiizii gillɛ u du ii biine di ra bagli lugɔ ii ɛɛ u horaa un niŋ ŋmɛnɛ wa lɛɛ ha la.
31Ií gil nyɛgzi, nuukpol, baaŋfuuih, naari, basabasa wia, dɔŋgbɛllaa ani miisɔɔh wia maa, 32ka ra ɛɛ dɔŋa winanaa di ra na ba sinyɛna. Di ba ɛɛ ia wichɔgaa, ií gil tɛɛ baa alugɔ Kɔraawiizi n kuu Kristo wia di gil ii wichɔgaa tɛɛ ia la.

english_text:
1Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children. 2 Let love be your guide. Christ loved us and offered his life for us as a sacrifice that pleases God.
3You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy. 4Don't use dirty or foolish or filthy words. Instead, say how thankful you are. 5Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God.
Living as People of Light
6Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things. 7So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
8You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light 9and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful, 10as you try to please the Lord. 11Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are. 12It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark. 13But the light will show what these things are really like. 14Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say,
“Wake up from your sleep
and rise from death.
Then Christ will shine on you.”
15Act like people with good sense and not like fools. 16 These are evil times, so make every minute count. 17Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do. 18Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life. 19 When you meet together, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, as you praise the Lord with all your heart. 20Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything.
Wives and Husbands
21Honor Christ and put others first. 22 A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord. 23A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body. 24Wives should always put their husbands first, as the church puts Christ first.
25 A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it. 26He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water. 27Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.
28In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself. 29None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church, 30because we are each part of his body. 31 As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.” 32This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church. 33So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
translation_text:
Bɔchaaŋ biini dui wia
1Ii ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biinɔŋŋaarɛ. Awia, ií du u duula. 2A wesso iin dɔɔ dɔŋa bila, di ra ɛɛ dɔŋa nɛnnɛ lugɔ Kristo n dɔɔ yaa bila di siu tɛɛ yaa, di lizi mbusu lizaa la sɔɔh n summɛ tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, a paruu la.
3Ka sɛnsɛŋ wia, wikuna ani kɛkɛluu dɔŋa kuna ni, ii gilɛɛ ra ŋɔ a wia gba. A dɛkkɔɔ banla n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biinanaa n gil annii maa. 4Ií gilɛɛ ra ŋɔ wiŋɔkuna, gɛnni wiŋɔzi ani wiŋɔjagazi. A guŋ waa dɛkkɛ. Ií gilaa, ka ra jaami Kɔraawiizi ani u huma.
5Ií zum nɛnnɛ lugɔ banla n na sɛm di ra ɛɛ wikuna di dɔɔ kɛkɛluu, wàá na bɔr Kristo ni Kɔraawiizi Kora biini. Kɛkɛluu ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ vuga tɔgzaa. 6Ií gilɛɛ gil nɛr maa ŋɔ wipɛɛri di wer ra dar ia. Wia naa wiarɛ Kɔ́raawiizi baaŋ wa fuuh, ú hau dignikpega hina ni. 7Awia, ií gilɛɛ gil ii ni baa ra kpau.
8Ii wia maa faa ɛɛ bɔbirii. Ka filaŋkeŋ, a ɛɛ bɔchaannɛ dikuu yaa Dɔɔri wia. Awia, ií ra hiŋ gunla bɔchaaŋ hina n ninna hiŋ la. 9Bɔchaaŋ wiarɛ winanaa, wideŋlaa ani wibii wia. 10Ií zum wia la iin niŋ ɛɛ, á par Kɔraawiizi, 11ka gil bɔbiri wia. A waa tɔna maa dɔɔwɛ. Ií pilli a wolli nɛ́ra zum a zɛɛ. 12Wia la baŋ ɔɔ suahzi ra ɛɛ la chummɔɔ werge. A baglaa gba dɔɔ hiihzi. 13Ka di bɔchaaŋ wa chaani kummaa ni, u duula ɔɔ lii chaannɛ. 14Bɔchaannɛ ɔɔ gil kummaa chaani. Awia, ba ɔɔ ŋɔu,
“Hinla n siuwɛ chɔɔ, izi!
Kristo bɔchaaŋ
daŋ chaani i ni.”
15Awia, ií ra hiŋ ka ra du tau. Ií gilɛɛ gɛŋ ka ɔɔ dɔɔ nfɛrɛ nɛnnɛ. 16Wichɔgaa du denii werge filaŋkeŋ. Awia, ií ɛɛ ania ra hum ii huma filaŋkennaa iiŋ haa ra na bɔr ií humaa naa. 17Ií gil ii nfɛrnyaai la, ka zum gunla Kɔraawiizi kipar n duwɛɛ nɛnnɛ. 18Ií gilɛɛ ra nyɔɔ siŋ werge ra dɛɛzi. U gunna chɔgi nɛraa. Ka ií gil Kɔraawiizi Dumawaa du ii ni werge, 19di gil u wiŋɔzi ni u yira du ii bampiree, di ɔɔ ŋɔa ra tɛɛ dɔŋa, di ra yir u yira ani yira la n na bagli u wia la, di ra darguu. Ií kpa bɔsɔna yiraa ra tɛɛ ii Dɔɔri ani ii biine maa, 20di ɔɔ ra yir yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo sɔŋ ni, di ra tɛɛ yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ ani wiimaa.
Haana ni janna wia
21Ií maa ra sɛɛ dɔŋa dɔɔra dikuu iinna ɔm Kristo wia. 22Haana, ií ra sɛɛ ii janna dɔɔra alugɔ iinna sɛɛ ii Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi dɔɔra la, 23dikuubɛɛwiai, baal ɛɛ u haaŋ nyuurɛ alugɔ Kristo n ɛɛ u hiŋra maa nyuu la, u hiŋra ɛɛ u bɔrahɔŋ un lɛɛwɛ ha. 24A dɛkkɔ haana n na sɛɛ ba janna dɔɔra wiimaa biini alugɔ Kristo hiŋra n na sɛɛ u dɔɔra la.
25Baala, ií nɔŋŋi ii haana nɛnnɛ gunla Kristo n nɔŋŋi u hiŋra di siu dikuu ba wia la. 26U siuwɔɔ tɛɛ baa, ú wer gil ba wer ɛɛ u bɛŋ hora, di gil ba doŋa maa wer lii ba ni dikuu u wiŋɔzi la baŋ nuuwɛ, ni nii la baŋ sɔ baa la wia. 27U ɛɛ gunnɛ ú wer kpa u hiŋra birgi u hahnaniinanii la n waa bɔdoŋa ni bɔchɔgii maa dɔɔwɛ, ka du kpeg di du wer werge maa wa tuŋ la. 28Gunnɛ a kaa dɛg baala ge n nɔŋŋi ba haana gunla baŋ nɔŋŋi ba himmaa bɔrahɔŋ la. Baal la maa n dɔɔ haaŋ di nɔŋŋuu guŋ, u himmaanii u nɔŋŋi la. 29Anɛɛ n niŋ sɛɛ hah u hinnɛi? Nɛr maa ɔɔ ra binni u hiŋ ninɛɛ di ra dɛɛzi u hiŋ gunla Kristo n na binni u hiŋra ge ni la. 30Yaa maa du u bɔrahɔŋ biinii. 31Ba faa sɛbɔɔrɛ,
“Awia, a wesso baal n gil u maa ni u mɛɛ, ka la u haaŋ be, bá nɛra banɛɛ kpau ɛɛ bɔrahɔŋkpaŋ.”
32Wisuahliizeŋ bɛllɛ la. Miŋwaa be, Kristo ni u hiŋra wiarɛ ba bagli guŋ. 33Ka ií bɛl maa ɛɛ ania di nɔŋŋi u haaŋ lugɔ u hiŋ. Háaŋ ge ra tɔgzi u jaari.

english_text:
Children and Parents
1 Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says, 2 “Obey your father and your mother, 3and you will have a long and happy life.”
4 Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord.
Slaves and Masters
5 Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ. 6Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do. 7Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people. 8You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
9 Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites.
The Fight against Evil
10Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong. 11 Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks. 12We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world. 13So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
14 Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor. 15 Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet. 16Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one. 17 Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
18Never stop praying, especially for others. Always pray by the power of the Spirit. Stay alert and keep praying for God's people. 19Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news. 20I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should.
Final Greetings
21-22 I want you to know how I am getting along and what I am doing. This is why I am sending Tychicus to you. He is a dear friend, as well as a faithful servant of the Lord. He will tell you how I am doing, and he will cheer you up.
23I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower! 24May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_text:
Biizi ni mɛɛwaa ni maawaa wia
1Biizi, ií nuu ra tɛɛ ii maawaa ni ii mɛɛwaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, u guŋ deŋloore yaa Dɔɔri hiŋaa naa biini. 2Ba faa sɛbɔɔrɛ, di ŋɔ, “Ií ra tɔgzi ii mɛɛwaa ni ii maawaa,” di kaa sɛbi nuuŋɔɔlii bɛl jaa u ni, u ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi widaulii n dɔɔ nuuŋɔɔlii lugli. 3Waabuu keŋ, “Di ii ra ɛɛ guŋ, Kɔraawiizi daŋ hiini ia, di tɛɛ ia miibɔɔjaŋ durnya naa biini.”
4Mɛɛwaa, ii gilɛɛ ra tɔɔri ii biizi, á ɛɛ baa baaŋ. Ií ra kpogli baa nɛnnɛ, di ra bagli baa ŋmɛnizi ani wia la maa n wesse yaa Dɔɔri be.
Yoma ni Dɔɔra wia
5Balaa, ií nuu ra tɛɛ ii dɔɔra la n du durnya naa biini, di ra ɔm baa, di ra hum baa ani biinihuŋŋu alugɔ Kristoo ii ra hum la. 6Ií gilɛɛ ra hum fɔŋŋa ni saŋa la iiŋ wa du nɛra baaŋ dikuu sɔŋ wia, ka ɔɔ ra hum nɛnnɛ gunla Kristo balnanaa n ninna hum, di ra ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kipar la ani ii biine maa. 7Ií kpa bɔsɔna ra hum. A nɛra lɛi ii hum ra tɛɛ. Ii Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizii ii hum ra tɛɛ. 8Waabuu niŋ turgi bɛl maa ani hunnanii la maa uŋ hummɛ. Di baliirɛ, di nɛr la n dɔɔ u hinnɛ, ka ba maanii nin na ba hunnanaa kinturgaa Kɔraawiizi be.
9Dɔɔra, ií ra ɛɛ ii balaa ge guŋ, di gilɛɛ ra ɔnzi baa. Ií zum lugɔ ii ni baa maa dɔɔri ɛɛ kpannɛ. Waabuu Kɔraawiizi. Waabuu waa baŋhina ra tɔgzi ra kaali baŋhina.
Kɔraawiizi laal kuna wia
10Ií ɔɔ gil yaa Dɔɔri fɔŋŋa du ii ni, ií wer dɔɔ kpegzi ii hiŋaa biini, di lii u fɔŋŋazeŋ la biini. 11Sitaani dɔɔ daraarɛ werge maa. Awia, ií kpa Kɔraawiizi laal kuna maa laali, 12dikuubɛɛwiai, newea lɛi yaa ra yoo. Vuga ni tinnanchɔgaa la maa n dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge ni bɔbiri naa koora ni kunchɔgaa la yaa n waa na, ka a dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge maa, di du kpil la, aabuu yaa ra yoo. 13Awia, a dɛkkɔ iiŋ kpa Kɔraawiizi laal kuna la maa laali nɛnnɛ, di kunchɔgaa la wa ŋɔ á yoo ia, ií wer chi nɛnnɛ di yooa guŋŋ ga tuŋ, ka haa wer chi.
14Kenne ií ɛɛ di wer chi. Ií kpa wibii kirsi, di kpa wideŋlaa di tɔ ii sezi ni ii hara, 15di kpa amaniyesuma la n dɔɔ bampirsɔna baglaa la du ii naazi. 16Denii ií lau yarda di kpa teŋ ii bampiree. U daŋ wer bir hobee la maa Sitaani n kpawɛɛ choŋŋi niŋ, ka kpa ta ia la. 17Denii ií kpa ii miibɔɔ lɛɛi la hi lugɔ kahuro, di kaa kpa Kɔraawiizi Duma tokobi kpogli. Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔliirɛ a tokobi. 18Ií ɔɔ ra suŋŋi wiizi werge maa u Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biini, di ra fɔrguu saŋa maa.
Ií ra kazi ii bɔra di ra ɛɛ sirya, ií wer suŋŋi wiizi tɛɛ u biinanaa la maa,
19ani n ge gba ń wer zum wiŋɔzi la n wesse saŋa la maa min niŋ bagli u wia, di wer dɔɔ bampirii ń wer pilli u wisuahlii la lii amaniyesuma la biini. 20Miŋ ɛɛ amaniyesuma bagli wiarɛ ba tɔŋ dia. Awia, ií ra suŋŋi wiizi ń haa wer dɔɔ bampirii, di ra lizaa gunla an dɛkkɛ min niŋ lizaa.
Pɔɔl nɛra jaamaa tuna
21Too. Tichikus la n ɛɛ yaa nɛnɔŋŋii, di kaa ra hum yaa Dɔɔri huma ani wibii la, waabuu niŋ kpa n wia maa bagli ia. 22Awiarɛ n humuu, ú wer bagli ia yaa wia, di wer du ia bɔkpega.
23Yáa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo tɛɛ ii ni yaabalaa la maa bampirsɔna, nɛnɔŋŋaa ni yarda, 24di hiini ii banla maa n nɔŋŋi yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo ani nɔŋŋaa himmaa la.

english_text:
1 From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus.
To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
2I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
3Every time I think of you, I thank my God. 4And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy. 5This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it. 6God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
7You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail. 8God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
9I pray that your love will keep on growing and you will fully know and understand 10how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day, 11Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God.
What Life Means to Paul
12My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news. 13 The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ. 14Now most of the Lord's followers have become brave and are fearlessly telling the message.
15Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help. 16They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him. 17But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail. 18But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad.
I will keep on being glad, 19because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe. 20I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
21If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more. 22I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful. 23It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better. 24-25But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith. 26Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
27Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
28Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen, 29and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him. 30 You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
translation_text:
1Yeesu Kristo balaa Pɔɔl ni Timotii ra sɛbi hɔnnaa ya tɛɛ ia. Yaa ra jaami Yeesu hiŋra nabɔnzi, ba huŋhunna ani banla ni Yeesu Kristo n kpauwɛ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biinanaa di du Filipai la.
2Yáa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo hiini ia di tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna.
Jaantɛɛi ni wiisuŋŋaa wia
3N na liizi ii wiarɛ saŋa maa di ra jaami n Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi dikuu ii wia, 4di ɔɔ suŋŋuu ra tɛɛ ia. Miŋ ɔɔ suŋŋuu ra tɛɛ ia la, n bɔra ɔɔ ra sɔɔnimbuu, 5dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa ni iabuu kpauwɛ ra hum amaniyesuma naa huma guŋŋ di wa lii zinaa. 6N kaa dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi yardaa gunla uŋ wette di faari u hunnanii ii biine la, u daŋ haa wer di ra humaa guŋŋ ii wa birgi nɛnanaa di wa tuŋ, saŋa la Yeesu Kristo Hɔpizii la n niŋ wa hel la.
7Màá ŋɔ ii wia guŋŋ? Ii maa wia du n bampiriire werge maa. Di ba tɔmbuu dia gɛɛ di n wettoo dɔɔ n hiŋ di vol ra lizi amaniyesuma la, di ra di nɛra wibii lii wiŋɔzi la biini, ka n ni ii maanii Kɔraawiizi ra hiini la. 8Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ n daansɛɛ hinnɛ lugɔ n na kɛlli ii ninɛɛ werge maa dikuu nɔŋŋaa la Yeesu Kristo n kpawɛɛ du n bampirii la wia.
9Anna suŋŋuubuu lugɔ ú gil ii ge wer dɔɔ nɛnɔŋŋaa werge di ra jaa di kaa dɔɔ zumaa ni nfɛrɛ di jaa a ni, 10ií wer zum wia la maa n dɛkkɛ. Denii ií wer dɔɔ biinihuŋŋu. Wiimaa wàá ka du de bá kpa chug ia Kristo hɔpizii la biini. 11Ii daŋ wer dɔɔ mananaa werge maa Yeesu Kristo fɔŋŋa biini, nɛ́ra ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ di ra chɔluu dikuu ii wia.
Pɔɔl yɔlɔzi dui n gillɛ amaniyesuma yaari wia
12Yaabalaa, n na nyiŋŋi ii zum lugɔ wia la maa n faa ɛɛŋ la, winanaa lii a maa biinii, amaniyesuma wia wer yaari. 13Baŋ vɔɔziŋ di tɔ dia bɔnnaa naa, koori soojazi ni nɛra la maa n du ɛŋ, ba maa zum n wiarɛ di zum lugɔ minna hum Kristo wiarɛ ba kuu tɔŋ dia. 14Yaabalaa Yeesu hiŋra maa ge jaa yardi Kɔraawiizi nɛnnɛ n dia tɔi naa wia biini, di jaa dɔɔ bampirii di ra bagli Kɔraawiizi wia nɛnnɛ. Ba waa kaa ra ɔm.
15Baŋhina dɔɔ bɔwiirɛ di ra ŋɔ a wia. Baŋhina ra ŋɔa bá wer koozi yaa. Ka baŋhina ge ra ŋɔ Kristo wia ani biinihuŋŋu. 16Ban nɔŋŋiŋ di kaa zum lugɔ amaniyesuma humaa Kɔraawiizi liziŋ ń hum di di u dɔma wibii la wiarɛ ba ra ŋɔ Kristo wia la. 17Banla ge, ba himmaa sɔnnyiŋŋaa wiarɛ ba ra ŋɔ Kristo wia. Ba waa biine huuhzɛɛ ka ra ŋɔa di ra nyiŋŋi ba duŋ tɔɔrɔɔ di jaa n yɔlɔzi vɔɔi naa ni. 18Ka pɛɛrɛ. Di ba ra dar nɛra di ra ŋɔa, gɛɛ ba ra ŋɔabuu ani biinihuŋŋu, ka Kristo wiarɛ ba ra ŋɔ, n bɔra sɔɔni. U daŋ haa sɔɔni di ra la, 19dikuubɛɛwiai, n zummɔ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi daŋ lɛɛŋ dikuu ii wiisuŋŋaa ni Yeesu Kristo Duma hiinaa la wia.
20N na ɛɛ tamiirɛ ani n biini maa lugɔ hiihzi wàá diŋ maa. N daŋ haa wer dɔɔ bampirii nɛnnɛ filaŋkeŋ gunla miŋ faa dɔɔ bampirii la, Krísto wer na girme n bɔrahɔŋ wia biini. Di ba gillɔ n du de di dɔɔ miibɔɔ gɛɛ di ba kpuŋ, ka Kɔraawiizi daŋ haa na girme a maa biini, 21dikuubɛɛwiai, di n dɔɔ miibɔɔ, n wiimaanii haŋ Kristo. Di n wa siuwɔ ge n di tɔnaa.
22Ka di n haa du de, n daŋ haa wer hum huma a haa wer dɔɔ hiinaa werge. Awia, maa zum unla maa n wesse n be min niŋ lizi. 23N na nyiŋŋi werge maa lugɔ n siu di wer du Kristo be. U gunnɛ bɔ werge maa miŋ haa du ɛŋ. 24Ka di n haa du ɛŋ, n daŋ haa wer hiini ia. U gunnɛ ɛɛ wizeŋ. 25Awia, n zummɔ lugɔ n daŋ haa du ii maa be di wer hiini ia, ií wer la see di wer dɔɔ bɔsɔna Yeesu hiŋaa naa biini. 26Denii ií wer dɔɔ wikpila ii kpa di ra chɔliŋ di kaa ra chɔli Yeesu Kristo ani gunla uŋ hiiniŋ n wer bir ba ii be la.
27Ka ií ɔɔ du de ni mananaa gunla an dɛkkɛ banla n sɛɛ amaniyesuma la n niŋ du de la, di n wa ballɔ di wa du ii be gɛɛ maa hoo ii be, ka ń wer nuu ii wia lugɔ ii maa wettoo dɔɔ bampirkpaŋ di ra hiŋ nɛnnɛ, di kaa ɛɛ nuukpaŋ di kpau ra hum, Yeesu Kristo amaniyesuma la iin sɛɛwɛ la wer la see, 28di ka dɔɔ bampirii ge ii waa ii dɔma ra ɔm tama maa. Ii bampirii dɔɔi la biinii bá chi zum lugɔ baabuu ba waa kpu ka iawaa na lɛɛi Kɔraawiizi be.
29Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ ii wer sɛɛ Kristo wia di kaa wer di tɔɔrɔɔ dikuu u wia. Wizenne u ɛɛ tɛɛ ia ií wer di a tɔɔrɔɔ la. 30Ii gba ra yoo laal la dee iiŋ faa na miŋ faa ra yoou, di kaa nuu n wia filaŋkeŋ lugɔ a laallɛ n haa ra yoo la.

english_text:
True Humility
1Christ encourages you, and his love comforts you. God's Spirit unites you, and you are concerned for others. 2Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person. 3Don't be jealous or proud, but be humble and consider others more important than yourselves. 4Care about them as much as you care about yourselves 5and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
6Christ was truly God.
But he did not try to remain
equal with God.
7Instead he gave up everything
and became a slave,
when he became
like one of us.
8Christ was humble.
He obeyed God and even died
on a cross.
9Then God gave Christ
the highest place
and honored his name
above all others.
10 So at the name of Jesus
everyone will bow down,
those in heaven, on earth,
and under the earth.
11And to the glory
of God the Father
everyone will openly agree,
“Jesus Christ is Lord!”
Lights in the World
12My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved. 13God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
14Do everything without grumbling or arguing. 15 Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world, 16as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
17Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you. 18In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me.
Timothy and Epaphroditus
19I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you. 20I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does. 21The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus. 22But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news. 23I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me. 24And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
25I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me, 26but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick. 27In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
28Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer. 29Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve. 30He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
translation_text:
Yeesu Kristo sisɔna ni u zenni wia
1Iiŋ wette ra du dɔŋa bɔkpega Kristo hiŋaa naa biini, di wer dɔɔ nɔŋŋaa la n wette ra tig bampiree, di dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii ge ii biine, ú wer hiini ia, di kaa ra suŋ nɛra ni la, 2iin dɔɔ annii naa maa naa, amɔ, ií ɛɛ wii bɛl ra jaa ń bɔra sɔɔniŋ werge maa di wa tuŋ. N na nyiŋŋuu lugɔ ii ɔɔ gil ii maa dɔɔ nuukpaŋ, ií nfɛssi ni ii dɔnnɔŋŋaa ni ii jina maa wer ɛɛ kpaŋ. 3A waa wer ii bɛl maa n ɛɛ wiimaa dikuu u bɛŋ sɔnnyiŋŋaa ani zenni wia. Ií kpa iihinaa fugzi di ɔɔ kpa ii dɔŋahina di bɔ iihinaa. 4Ií gilɛɛ ra binni ii bɛmbɛŋ wia biini, ka ɔɔ ra binni ii dɔŋahina wia biini ií wer hiini baa.
5Ii manni la iin dɔɔwɛ ii balaa ni la, ií gil u ɛɛ lugɔ Yeesu Kristo manni la un dɔɔwɛ yaa ni la.
6U faa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizii di du Kɔraawiizi ge duula.
Ka u faa waa guŋ
kpawɛɛ su siwii
7di gil Kɔraawiizi duula la ka kpa u hiŋ
birgi balii di wa du
yaa newea duula.
8Uŋ jaa ɛɛ newee la,
u kpa u hinnɛ fugzi
di sɛɛ u Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi nua
di gil ba kpuu.
Siuchumaa u siu
daakaŋlii la ni.
9Awia, Kɔraawiizi jaa tɛubuu nabɔmuu werge maa di wa bɛri,
di tɛu sɔŋ
kaali kummaa sɔŋ.
10Awia, Yeesu Kristo sɔnzeŋ werge la wia,
nɛr maa daŋ ŋmɛnɛ
wa giŋŋi u see
di kpa nabɔmuu di ra tɛu,
kuna la maa n du chiŋ
ani newea maa
n du durnya biini
ani banla maa n siuzɛɛ
daŋ kpa nabɔmuu di ra tɛu
11di sɛɛ lugɔ
waabuu ɛɛ ba maa Dɔɔri,
ya Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi wer na girme.
Yaa ɛɛ fintinazii di ra chaani durnya
12Awia, n nɛnɔŋŋaa, gunla iiŋ faa ɔɔ ra hiŋ n nua saŋa la miŋ faa du ii be la, a kaa ɛɛ wizenne werge maa lugɔ miŋ waa hoo ii be naa, ka ií haa ra hiŋ guŋ di kpa siaahmu ra hum ni ɔnsii ni bɔsai maa ií wer na ii lɛɛi di wa tuŋ Kɔraawiizi be, 13dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizii ɔɔ du ii biinee di ra hum ii wer sɛɛ u kipar la di wer a humuu nɛnnɛ gunla iin ninna humuu á paruu la.
14Wia la maa iinna ɛɛ, ii gilɛɛ ra nuumi di ra ŋmuuri wia ka ra ɛɛa, 15dikuubɛɛwiai, a wessoo iiŋ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biizi la n waa wichɔgaa maa dɔɔwɛ ka dɔɔ biinihuŋŋu bɛŋ, ii wiimaa deŋli. Filaŋkeŋ hina dɔɔ wichɔgaarɛ werge, ba waa ŋmɛnizi ra hiŋ. Ka iawaa du ba biini di ra chaani alugɔ chinchiŋwilaa n du chiŋ di ra chaani hamuŋa la. 16Ií gil Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii la n dɔɔ miibɔɔ la du ii bampiree nɛnnɛ di ra la ń wer chɔli ia Kristo hɔpizii la biini alugɔ maa kuuhwɛ pɛɛ, ń huma la maa miŋ hummɛ ii be la wa lii tɔna tɛŋ. 17Di ba ŋɔ bá kpuŋ ka n bɔra daŋ sɔɔni. N chal daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ mbusu lizaa niitaalii, ii Kɔraawiizi yarda ge ɛɛ lugɔ mbusu lizaa. Di ba kpuŋ ka ií mbusu lizaa la wer kuari nɛnnɛ, u guŋ daŋ sɔɔni n bɔra. Ii bɔsɔna daŋ ɛɛ n gba bɔsɔna. 18Gunnɛ ií ge gil n bɔsɔna sɔɔni ii ge bɔra la.
Timoti ni Ɛpafrɔdaitɔs wia
19Di n Dɔɔri Yeesu sɛɛwɔ, n daŋ hum Timoti ii be filaŋkeŋ, ú wa na ia ka ba di wa ŋɔ ii wia tɛŋ, ń wer dɔɔ bɔkpega u amaniye la biini. 20N nuu bɛnnɛ dɔɔ nfɛrkpaŋ werge ii wia. Awia, n zummɔ lugɔ ii wia daŋ du u bampirii ani wibii, ú binni ii wia ni nɛnnɛ. 21Di Timoti bɛŋ lɛi, banla maa ra binni bahinaa wiazii. Ba waa Yeesu Kristo wia ra binni. 22Ii gba zum gunla u wia n dɔɔ wibiire. N nuu kpauwɔɔ ra hum amaniyesuma huma naa alugɔ biibambie ni u mɛɛ. 23Awia, di n wa zum gunla ban niŋ dawiŋ ɛŋ, n daŋ humuu ii be. 24Di n Dɔɔri sɛɛwɔ, a wàá birgi ka n ba ii be.
25N kaa binni lugɔ a dɛkkɔ miŋ hum yaa dɔŋhiŋ Ɛpafrɔdaitɔs ii be. U hiinimbuu di ra hum huma naa di ra naa Kɔraawiizi naari. Waabuu ii faa hum n be ú waa hiiniŋ la. N ge kaa ŋɔ ń humuubuu ii be, 26dikuubɛɛwiai, u ra kɛlli ii ninɛɛ werge maa. A kaa tiruu werge lugɔ ii nuu u wiila la wiarɛ. 27U faa wiiwɔɔ werge di faa ra nyiŋŋi u siu gba, ka Kɔraawiizi na u sinyɛna di suŋ n nuu maa ni. Di u faa siuwɔ, n daŋ faa dɔɔ biinichɔg di kaa jaa n biinichɔg la ni. 28Awiarɛ n faa ra nyiŋŋi werge maa lugɔ n humuu ii be, ií nau di gil ii bɔra sɔɔni, ií wia gilɛɛ kaa zuu n nyuu werge. 29Awia, ií lɛɛu ani bɔsɔna dikuu yaa Dɔɔri la iinna hiŋ la wia. Ií ra tɔgzi nɛra naa dizi. 30Kristo huma wiarɛ u kuu di faa kpa u miibɔɔ chɛr siu la, ú wer lɛɛ ii naazi di ba wa hiiniŋ.

english_text:
Being Acceptable to God
1Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
2Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you. 3But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done, 4although I could. Others may brag about themselves, but I have more reason to brag than anyone else. 5 I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses. 6 And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
7But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless. 8Nothing is as wonderful as knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. I have given up everything else and count it all as garbage. All I want is Christ 9and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ. 10All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did, 11so that somehow I also may be raised to life.
Running toward the Goal
12I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize. 13My friends, I don't feel I have already arrived. But I forget what is behind, and I struggle for what is ahead. 14I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done. 15All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you. 16But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
17 My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you. 18I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again 19that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
20But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ 21 has power over everything, and he will make these poor bodies of ours like his own glorious body.
translation_text:
Wideŋlaa himmaa wia
1Yaabalaa, n wiŋɔzi la n kawɛɛrɛ keŋ. Ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni ia yaa Dɔɔri fɔŋŋa biini. Miŋ ɔɔ ŋɔ wia naa ra tɛɛ ia naa, ka a waa n bɔra ra huah. A daŋ hiini ia.
2Ií ra du vazi tau. Banla n na maŋkuri hɛŋ teŋaa di ra ŋɔ dí nɛr maa chɔgi u bɔrahɔŋ mɔɔ ka hiŋ Kɔraawiizi la wiarɛ n ŋɔ ií ra du tau la, bá gilɛɛ wer dar ia. 3Yaa banla n ɔɔ ra jaami Kɔraawiizi u Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biini, di ɔɔ ra tɛɛ Yeesu Kristo ge sɔŋ, yaa waa bɔrahɔŋ wiazi la a maŋkuri la, yaabuu zum teŋaa himmaa la.
4Di bɔrahɔŋ wia daŋ faa wer lɛɛ yaa, minuu niŋ faa dɔɔ tamii werge.
Di nɛr maa ŋɔwɔɔ lugɔ u wia uŋ ɛɛwɛ dɔɔ tamiirɛ, ka mìŋ́ dɔɔ tamii kaali a hiŋ. 5N ɛɛ Izrɛl hinuurɛ. N hɔpizaa ŋmantannaazi hinnɛ ba teŋ n hɛŋ. Bɛnjamin dee biinii n lii. Awia, n ɛɛ Hibru hinuu himmaanii, di faa ɛɛ nɛra la bɛl n na hiŋ Gbɔgni la hina hiŋaa la di ɛɛ Farisii. 6A wia faa ɛɛ siaahmu wiarɛ n be werge maa. Awia, n izi di ra tɔɔri Yeesu hiŋra. Di ba kaa ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi Gbɔgni hiŋaa ge, n wia maa deŋloore. Maa u kii bɛl maa chɔkkɛ.
7Ka wia la maa min niŋ faa kurgi á ɛɛ tɔna wii tɛŋ Kɔraawiizi hiŋaa biini la, a maanii n yir wipɛɛri dikuu Kristo wia. 8Wibii maa, kummaa ani wiimaanii n vɛɛ di ra yiraa wipɛɛri ka ń wer zum n Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo. U zumaa labuu ɛɛ wizeŋ kaali kummaa. N kuu u wiarɛ di gil wiimaa ha di ra yiraa wijagazi ka ra nyiŋŋi n wer lau Kristo nɛnnɛ, 9ya wer kpau Kɔ́raawiizi ŋɔ lugɔ n wia maa deŋloore. Wàá ŋɔ guŋ dikuu miŋ hiŋ Gbɔgni la wia. Miŋ yardi Kristo wiarɛ ú ŋɔ guŋ. A wideŋlaa dee ɔɔ lii Kɔraawiizi benii u ra tɛɛ banla maa n yardi Yeesu.
10N wiimaanii ń wer zum Kristo, di wer zum fɔŋŋa la uŋ izi siu biini dɔɔ la, ni u tɔɔrɔɔ dii, ń nuu maa wer kpau di ra di tɔɔrɔɔ, ń wa wer birgi di wa du gunla uŋ faa duwɛɛ ka siu la, 11ka ń vii ŋmɛnɛ wer izi siu biini gunla u ge n izee la.
Huma humaa siaahmu ni wia
12A waa ɛɛwɛ lugɔ n teŋ wettoo ɛɛ annii maa di ɛɛ nɛnanii di wa tuŋ. Akai. N haa aah siwiire di ra nyiŋŋi n wer ɛɛ wia la maa Yeesu Kristo n faa liziŋ ń ɛɛ la. 13Yaabalaa, maa binni lugɔ n tuŋ wiimaanii. Kenne n na ɛɛ. Aŋ suuh harbɔɔ wiarɛ ka kpa nfɛrkpaŋ di ra la see ń wer na anla ge n haa du see la 14di aah siwii ń wer hel a tuna di na kinturgaa. Kɔraawiizi yirimbuu ń ba wa du u be dikuu Yeesu Kristo wia. Awiarɛ n aah siwii ń wer na guŋ la.
15A wessoo yaa banla maa n dirmɛɛ Kɔraawiizi wia biini la n na fɛ guŋ nfɛrɛ. Di ii baŋhina ge waa guŋ sɛɛwɛ, Kɔraawiizi daŋ haa chaani ii siwee. 16Ama gunla maa yaa n wette zum, ya lau guŋ di ra la see.
17Yaabalaa, ií ra chanzi gunla minna hiŋ di zum banla ge n na hiŋ gunla yaa n bagli ia la, 18dikuubɛɛwiai, nɛkpila waa gunna hiŋ. N ɔɔ bagli ba wiarɛ saŋa maa di ra tɛɛ ia di kaa ra bagli ia filaŋkennaa di wii ra ŋɔ, Ba ɛɛ Kristo ni u daakaŋlii wia dɔmaa. 19Ba tuna daŋ ɛɛ chɔgaarɛ. Ba kpa ba hizi wiarɛ di kaali Kɔraawiizi. Wia la n niŋ faa ɛɛ baa hiihzi, aabuu ba jaa ra chɔli werge. Ba nfɛssi maanii du durnya wia biini.
20Ka durnya naa lɛi yaa bol. Yaawaa bolle Kɔraawiizi bol la. Yaa n du ɛnnaa, yaa ra kpaŋ yaa Lɛɛri la n niŋ ŋmɛnɛ lii de ba labuu. Waabuu yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo. 21Di u wa ballɔ, u daŋ birgi yaa bɔrahɔnchunzi naa á du wer lugɔ u himmaa bɔrahɔŋ n wesse werge maa la. U fɔŋŋa biinii ú ɛɛ guŋ. U dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa lugɔ ú wer gil kummaa sɛɛ u dɔɔra.

english_text:
1Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy.
Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
2Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other. 3And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
4Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad. 5Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here. 6Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God. 7Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand.
