19Kɔraawiizi n felee nɔŋŋi yaa, di bagli yaa dɔnnɔŋŋaa wiarɛ yaa wer nɔŋŋuu. 20Nɛr la maa n niŋ ŋɔ lugɔ u nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizii ka hah u dɔŋhiŋ, karaa u ra kanni. Di waa wette ú nɔŋŋi u dɔŋhiŋ la u siwee n na na la, ɛrɛɛ ú ɛɛ nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizi la u siwee n waa na lai? 21Kɔraawiizi widauliirɛ keŋ. Dí nɛr la maa n nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizi, ú nɔŋŋi u dɔŋahina jaa.

english_text:
Victory over the World
1If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children. 2If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children. 3 We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
4Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory. 5No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God.
Who Jesus Is
6Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful. 7In fact, there are three who tell about it. 8They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
9We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son. 10If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar. 11 God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son. 12And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life.
Knowing about Eternal Life
13All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life. 14We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him. 15And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
16Suppose you see one of our people commit a sin that isn't a deadly sin. You can pray, and this person will be given eternal life. But the sin must not be one that is deadly. 17Everything that is wrong is sin, but not all sins are deadly.
18We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
19We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
20We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
21Children, you must stay away from idols.
translation_text:
Yaa durnya kpeglaa wia
1Hinla maa n yardɛɛ lugɔ Yeesu ɛɛ Kristoo, i ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biere. Di i nɔŋŋi nɛr, i daŋ nɔŋŋi u bie gba jaa. 2Di yaa nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizi di ra hiŋ u nua, yaa zummɔ lugɔ yaa nɔŋŋi u biizi gbaa. 3Hinla maa n nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizi, i danna hiŋ u nua. U nuuzi la ge waa kpol alugɔ á ɛɛ yaa tɔɔrɔɔ, 4dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi biilullii bɛl maa wettoo kpegli wiimaa n du durnya di ra fir yaa. Yarda la yaa n yardi Kɔraawiizi labuu gillɛ yaa wer kpegli durnya wiimaa. 5Anɛɛ n niŋ wer kpegli durnya wia naanɛi? Nɛr la n yardɛɛ lugɔ Yeesu ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Biibaallɛ la, waabuu niŋ wer kpegli a durnya wia.
6A Yeesu Kristo ni nii ni challɛ ballɛ. U ni nii bɛŋ lɛi ballɛ. Ba wɔɔ sɔwɛɛ nii bɛŋ. Ba kpuubuu jaa. Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii ra di u daansɛɛrɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, u ɛɛ wibii hinnɛ. 7Kuna ahoroo ra di guŋ daansɛɛ. 8Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii, Yeesu nii sɔi ani u chal. A maa daansɛɛ ɛɛ kpannɛ. 9Yaa ɔɔ ra sɛɛ newea daansɛɛrɛ. Ka Kɔraawiizi daansɛɛ labuu ɛɛ wizeŋ kaali a maa. U daansɛɛ la uŋ diwee u Biibaal wia labuu keŋ. 10Hinla maa n sɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Biibaal wia, Kɔraawiizi daansɛɛ du i biinii, i wer zum Kɔraawiizi wia nɛnnɛ. Hinla maa n waa Kɔraawiizi daansɛɛ ra sɛɛ, i ra yiruubuu kara hiŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, haa u daansɛɛ la uŋ diwee u Biibaal wia la sɛɛwɛ. 11A daansɛɛrɛ keŋ. Kɔraawiizi tɛɛ yaabuu u miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la. A miibɔɔ du u Biibaal la benii. 12Hinla maa Kɔraawiizi Biibaal n du i ni dɔɔ a miibɔɔrɛ. Ka hinla maa Kɔraawiizi Biibaal n waa i ni duwɛɛ, haa waa u miibɔɔ dɔɔwɛ.
Miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ wia
13N sɛbi wia naabuu tɛɛ ii banla n yardi Kɔraawiizi Biibaal, ií zum lugɔ iabuu dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ labuu. 14Yaa yarduubuu lugɔ di yaa suŋŋuu kunla maa n paruu, ɔɔ nuu tɛɛ yaa. 15Di yaa zummɔ lugɔ ɔɔ nuú tɛɛ yaa, yaa daŋ zum lugɔ kunla yaa n suŋŋɛɛ la, u daŋ tɛɛ yaa.
16Di ii wa na ii dɔŋhiŋ bɛl n na ɛɛ wichɔgii bɛl, ii daŋ suŋŋi wiizi tɛu ú na miibɔɔ. Di waa wichɔgaa la un niŋ siu dikuu a ɛɛi wia la ra ɛɛ, ii daŋ suŋŋi tɛu. Wichɔgii bɛl dee du de, di nɛr ɛɛu, u daŋ siu dikuu u wia. Maa ŋɔ lugɔ ií suŋŋi wiizi wichɔgii naa dɔŋ wia. 17Wii la maa n waa deŋlee, u ɛɛ wichɔgiirɛ, ka aŋhina ge waa ɛɛwɛ lugɔ iin niŋ siu dikuu a wia.
18Yaa zummɔ lugɔ nɛr la maa n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biilullii, waa ɔɔ ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa. Kɔraawiizi Biibaal la ɔɔ ra du u taurɛ, Sitaani gilɛɛ wer ɛɛu wiimaa. 19Yaa kaa zum lugɔ yaa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biilullaarɛ. Ka banla n waa Kɔraawiizi biilullaa ɛɛwɛ la ge maa du Sitaani nonee biini. 20Yaa zummɔ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi Biibaal ba durnyaa di wa pilli yaa siwee, ya wer zum unla n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi himmaa. Yaa du a Kɔraawiizi ninɛɛ, di kaa du u Biibaal Yeesu Kristo ni. Kɔraawiizi himmaanii la. U ra tɛɛ yaabuu miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.
21N biizi, ií ra dazi, di gilɛɛ ra hiŋ kundumazi la n waa Kɔraawiizi himmaa ɛɛwɛ.

english_text:
1From the church leader.
To a very special woman and her children. I truly love all of you, and so does everyone else who knows the truth. 2We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
3I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love.
Truth and Love
4I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do. 5 Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do. 6Love means we do what God tells us. And from the beginning, he told you to love him.
7Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ. 8So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward. 9Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you. 10 If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them. 11Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds.
Final Greetings
12I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
13Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
translation_text:
1Mìŋ́ nabɔma labuu sɛbi hɔnnaa ń tɛɛ haaŋ la Kɔraawiizi n lizɛɛ tɛɛ u hiŋ ani u biizi la miŋ nɔŋŋɛɛ dikuu n ni baa maa n ɛɛ kpaŋ, Kɔraawiizi wibii biini wia la. N bɛŋ lɛi nɔŋŋi baa guŋ. Ka banla n zum Kɔraawiizi wibii maanii nɔŋŋi baa guŋ, 2dikuu a wibii n du yaa maa bampiree wia. A wibii daŋ haa du de di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa. 3N na jaami ia. Yáa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ani u Biibaal Yeesu Kristo hiini ii maa di suŋ ii ni, di tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna, di gil ii dɔɔ wibii ani nɛnɔŋŋaa.
Wibii ni nɔŋŋaa wia
4N bɔra sɔɔnɔɔrɛ werge ani miŋ wa zum i biizi baŋhina wia lugɔ ba ra hiŋ wibiire, gunla yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ ya ra hiŋ la. 5Ka filaŋkeŋ, n na suŋŋiibuu í ra hiŋ u widaulii naa. Widaulifalii lɛi. U faa dawuubuu saŋa maa ya ra hiŋ. Waabuu keŋ, ií nɔŋŋi dɔŋa. 6Di yaa ra hiŋ u widaulaa, yaa daŋ nɔŋŋi dɔŋa. U widauliirɛ lugɔ ií nɔŋŋi dɔŋa, gunla iin nuuwɛ lugli la. Awia, ií ra ɛɛ wiimaa ni nɔŋŋaa.
7Nɛfugze kpilakpila maa liwɔɔrɛ filaŋkeŋ. Baabuu waa sɛɛwɛ lugɔ Yeesu Kristo ba durnyaa lugɔ newee. Nɛr la maa n na hɔɔ guŋ, u ɛɛ a nɛfugzi bɛllɛ, di ɛɛ Kristo haahri. 8Ií ra du tau nɛnnɛ, yaa huma la gilɛɛ waa bir pɛɛ, ka ií wer na a tɔna maa wa tuŋ. 9Nɛr la maa n na bagli Kristo wia, ka kaa ra bagli wia lii u himmaa nfɛrɛ biini di ra jaa, Kɔraawiizi waa hoo a hiŋ ni. Nɛr la maa n zum Kristo baglaa la, di ɔɔ ra bagli guŋ maga bɛŋ, Kɔraawiizi ni u Biibal Yeesu du a hiŋ ninɛɛ. 10Di nɛr la maa wa ba ii be di ŋɔ ú bagli ia, ka waa Kristo wia ra bagli guŋ, ii gilɛɛ lɛɛ a hiŋ dau ii be, di gilɛɛ waa jaamuu. 11Nɛr la maa n na maŋkuri a hiŋ guŋ, u ge gba du u wichɔgaa hiŋ biinii.
12N dɔɔ wikpilaa min niŋ ŋɔ ii be, ka màá sɛbaa dau hɔŋ ni. N na nyiŋŋuu ń ba ii be ya wer na dɔŋa, ń ŋɔ a wia tɛɛ ia. Denii yaa bɔra sɔɔni yaa werge maa.
13Ii niwee la Kɔraawiizi n lizɛɛ tɛɛ u hiŋ la, u biizi ra jaami ia werge.

english_text:
1 From the church leader.
To my dear friend Gaius.
I love you because we follow the truth, 2dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit. 3It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth. 4Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth.
Working Together
5Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before. 6They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve. 7When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower. 8We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
9I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us. 10So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
11Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
12Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true.
Final Greetings
13I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. 14I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
15I pray that God will bless you with peace!
Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
translation_text:
1Mìŋ́ nabɔma labuu sɛbi hɔnnaa ń tɛɛ n dammunanii Geyus la miŋ nɔŋŋɛɛ, dikuu yaa maa n ɛɛ kpaŋ Kɔraawiizi wibii naa biini wia.
2N nɛnɔŋŋii, n na suŋŋi Kɔraawiizii ú hiinii, i wer dɔɔ alaanfia nɛnnɛ, í wiimaa ge wer lii siwee alugɔ i ni Kɔraawiizi baambaaŋ wia n lii siwee gunla. 3Yaabalaa baŋhina ballɔɔ di wa ŋɔ i wia tɛŋ, dí i ra hiŋ wibiire. I wiimaa ra bagli gunnɛ. Awia, n bɔra sɔɔnɔɔrɛ werge. 4Saŋa la maa miŋ ɔɔ ra nuu n biizi wia lugɔ ba ra hiŋ wibiire la, a gunnɛ a sɔɔni n bɔra kaali wiimaa.
5N nɛnɔŋŋii, gunla hiŋ ɔɔ lɛɛ yaa dɔŋahina Yeesu hiŋra di gaa dau, haa ɔɔ zum baa ka wer lɛɛ baa di ra hiini baa la, i ra hiŋ ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ nɛnnɛ. 6Ba ŋɔ i wiarɛ tɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra bɔnnaa, di tɛi sɔŋ ani gunla hiŋ nɔŋŋi baa la. Awia, di ba waa nyiŋŋi ba kpa ba ŋmɛnɛɛ kaali, i daŋ kaa hiini baa gunla maa hin niŋ ɛɛ, á par Kɔraawiizi, 7dikuubɛɛwiai, Yeesu wiarɛ ba kuu lii ra vol guŋ. Ba waa kebee ra lɛɛ nɛra la n waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ la be. 8Awia, a wesso yaa n niŋ ɔɔ ra hiini nɛra naa dɔŋa. Di yaa wetto ra hiini dɔŋa guŋ, yaa maa kpauwɔɔ Kɔraawiizi wibii la huma biini.
9N faa sɛbi wia aŋhinaa tɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra de, ka Diɔtrɛfɛs la waa yaa wia ra sɛɛ. U ra nyiŋŋi nabɔmuurɛ. 10Awia, di n wa ballɔ, n daŋ kpa u wia di ŋɔ gunla unna ŋɔ wia pɛɛpɛɛ, di kpa wichɔgaa di ra chugiŋ. A bɛŋ wichɔgaa lɛi u ra ɛɛ. Waa ɔɔ sɛɛ ú lɛɛ yaabalaa ra dau. Di baŋhina ge du de di ra nyiŋŋi ba lɛɛ baa dau, ka waa ɔɔ gil ba lɛɛ baa dau, ka ɔɔ ra duŋŋi baa Yeesu hiŋra wiijaami dia la biini.
11N nɛnɔŋŋii, gilɛɛ ra hiŋ banla n na ɛɛ wichɔgaa. A ɛɛ winanaa bɛŋ. Nɛr la n na ɛɛ winanaa, u ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biilulliirɛ. Nɛr la ge n na ɛɛ wichɔgaa haa waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ. 12Dimitrius lawaa ɛɛ nɛnaniirɛ. Nɛra maa ra ŋɔ u wia guŋ. Wibii la unna hiŋ la ge ra di u daansɛɛrɛ guŋ. Yaa ge gba ra di u daansɛɛ guŋ. I zummɔ lugɔ yaa wiŋɔzi ɛɛ wibiire.
13N dɔɔ wikpilakpila maanii di ra nyiŋŋi n ŋɔ i be. Ka maa nyiŋŋi n sɛbaa dau hɔŋ ni. 14N na nyiŋŋuu lugɔ n ba i be di wa nai filaŋkeŋ, ya wer na dɔŋa di ŋɔ a wia.
15Kɔ́raawiizi tɛi bampirsɔna.
I dammuzi la n du bɔnnaa la ra jaamii. Jaami yaa ge dammuzi maa tɛɛ yaa.

english_text:
1 From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James.
To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.
2I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love!
False Teachers
3My dear friends, I really wanted to write you about God's saving power at work in our lives. But instead, I must write and ask you to defend the faith that God has once for all given to his people. 4Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
5 Don't forget what happened to those people the Lord rescued from Egypt. Some of them did not have faith, and he later destroyed them. 6You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment. 7 We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
8The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels. 9 Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
10But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings. 11 Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
12These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit. 13Their shameful deeds show up like foam on wild ocean waves. They are like wandering stars forever doomed to the darkest pits of hell.
14 Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said:
Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels 15to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
16These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want.
More Warnings
17My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ. 18 They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God. 19And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
20Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray. 21And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life. 22Be helpful to all who may have doubts. 23Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds.
Final Prayer
24-25Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
translation_text:
1Mìŋ́ Juud la n ɛɛ Yeesu Kristo balii, di kaa ɛɛ Jems niwee labuu ra sɛbi hɔnnaa, di ra jaami ii banla yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi n yittɛ ii ba u be, di wa ɛɛ u nɛnɔŋŋaa, Yeesu Kristo ge ra binni ii ni la. 2Kɔ́raawiizi suŋ ii ni, di tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna, di nɔŋŋi ia werge ra jaa.
Baglikara hina wia
3N nɛnɔŋŋaa, n faa ra nyiŋŋuu werge maa lugɔ n sɛbi hɔŋ bɛl tɛɛ ia, á hɔŋ bagli ia yaa lɛɛi wia maa ani gunla yaa maa n ninna hiŋ la. Denii n bir binni lugɔ a dɛkkɔɔ min niŋ sɛbi hɔnnaa, di ŋɔ ii be lugɔ ií maa ra naa ii hiŋaa naa naari. Kɔraawiizi faa bagli u biinanaarɛ gunla ban niŋ hiŋ. Gunla uŋ faa ŋɔwɛɛ la waa birgaa dɔɔwɛ. 4N na fɔrgi iabuu, dikuubɛɛwiai, nɛra baŋhina suahzɔɔrɛ zuu ii biini. Ba waa Kɔraawiizi ra hiŋ, ka ra ŋɔ lugɔ nɛra daŋ wer ra ɛɛ wikuna, dikuu Kɔraawiizi n na suŋ nɛra ni wia. Ba kaa ra hɔɔ yaa Nabɔma Yeesu Kristo wia. U bɛnnɛ ɛɛ yaa Dɔɔri. Ba sɛbi nɛra naa wiarɛ Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini saŋa maa, di ŋɔ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi daŋ di baa seriya, bá chol.
5Ii teŋ zum wia naa min niŋ ŋɔ naabuu, ka n ŋɔ ń liizi iabuu lugɔ Kɔraawiizi faa lɛɛ Jus hina la maanii, di kpa baa lii Ijip hɛri. Ka baŋhina waa u wia sɛɛwɛ, u bir kpu baa. 6U mɛlikazi aŋhina gba du denii uŋ vɔɔzi yɔlɔzi, di tɔa bɔbiri biini, á du de ú Hɔpizizeŋ la wa hel. Denii ú dia seriya, á chol. Aŋ vɛɛ huma la uŋ kpawɛɛ tɛɛa di kaa gil a duuribɔr la wiarɛ u vɔɔzaa yɔlɔzi la. 7Nɛra la n faa du Sɔdɔm ni Gɔmɔra ani boljigzi la n du a kɛraa la faa ra sɛmuu, di ra ɛɛ wikuna dizi n chummɛ werge. Awiarɛ Kɔraawiizi faa kpa niŋ di du ba ni, ú tɔɔri baa di hanna la, nɛ́ra zum lugɔ Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra tɔɔri nɛchɔgaarɛ dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia.
8Ka gunla faala hina la n faa ɛɛwɛ Kɔraawiizi tɔɔri baa la, gunnɛ nɛchɔgaa la n du ii biini haa vɛɛ ra ɛɛ la. Ba waa nfɛrɛ dɔɔwɛ, di kpa ba bɔrahɔŋ ra ɛɛ wikuna, di kaa ra vɛɛ nabɔnzi nuuzi, di ra gbɛlli mɛlikazi. 9Kɔraawiizi mɛlikazi maa nabɔma Maikil la ni Sitaani n faa ra di hɔɔzi alugɔ unla n niŋ kpa Moosis bɔrahɔŋ la, a Maikil faa waa bampirii dɔɔwɛ ú wer hau u ni di chagzuu, ka ŋɔ, “Yaa Dɔɔrii niŋ jugmii.” 10Ka nɛra naa ɔɔ ra gbɛlli wia la baŋ waa a biini zummɛɛ. Ba waa nfɛrɛ dɔɔwɛ di ɛɛ lugɔ sela. Wia la ba ni sela maa n zummɛ labuu ba ra ɛɛ manaŋ, a ra chɔgi baa. 11Wia daŋ wa huuzi baa. Ŋmɛnɛɛ la Keen n faa hiŋŋɛ labuu ba ge ra hiŋ la. Gunla Balaam la ge n faa aah siwii dikuu kebee wia di ɛɛ wichɔgaa la, gunnɛ ba ge kuu kebee wia di ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa la. Gunla Kɔra la n faa dɔɔ sikpegii di vɛɛ nabɔnzi la, gunnɛ ba ge gba dɔɔ sikpegii di ra ɛɛ la, Kɔ́raawiizi wa kpu baa gunla uŋ faa kpu Kɔra la.
12Iiŋ ɔɔ chaali di ŋɔ ií di ii Dɔɔri diwee la, nɛra la du ii biinii lugɔ doŋa di ra chɔgi ia. Ba waa hiihzi ka ra di, di ra binni ba bɛŋ wia. Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ baama la n waa dooŋ dɔɔwɛ, peu taau ra kaali la, di kaa ɛɛ kumpɛɛri ni kunsiwaa lugɔ daazi aŋhina nɔnaa saŋa n ɔɔ wa hel ka a waa nɔŋ, ka du de pɛɛ ba wigzaa a siuzi jaa la, 13di kaa ɛɛ lugɔ muuzeŋ nii peu n ta u ni, u izi ra chogli, di ra izi fufuudoŋa la. Ba wichɔgaa ɔɔ ra liiu guŋ di ra du baa hiihzi. Ba kaa ɛɛ lugɔ chinchiŋwilaa n kpuzɛɛ di ra la á ga chol, di zuu bɔbiri, á du de di ra la la.
14Andama naanatɛɛ ge naanatɛɛ bie Ɛnɔk la faa ŋɔ ba wiarɛ Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa biini saŋa maa, di ŋɔ, “Ií nuu ɛŋ, yaa Dɔɔri daŋ ba ni u mɛlikananaa kpila maa, 15di wa di nɛra maa seriya. Banla n ɛɛ wichɔgɛɛra di vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi nua labuu ú di seriya bá chol, ú tɔɔri baa dikuu ba wichɔgaa la baŋ vɛɛu ka ɛɛ la ni ba wiŋɔzi la maa baŋ ŋɔwɛɛ di gbɛlluu la wia.” 16Nɛra naa ɔɔ nuumuu ra du dɔŋa, di ra ɛɛ wii la maa ba kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa n tɛɛ baa bá ra ɛɛ la, di ɔɔ ra chɔli bahinaa, di kaa ra du nɛra ge nyuuni, bá wer na ba kipar ba be.
Karfaazi ni baglaazi wia
17Ka n biinɔŋŋaa, ií ra liizi wia la yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo huŋhunna la n faa ŋɔwɛɛ u fɔŋŋa biini la. 18Ba faa ŋɔ ii benii “Di durnya tuna wa hello, baŋhina daŋ lii di ra ɛɛ ia chɛɛtɛ, di ra ɛɛ wia la ba kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa n tɛɛ baa bá ra ɛɛ la.” 19Nɛra naa dizi ra chɔgi nuukpaŋ dɔɔirɛ, di ra bargi ia dɔŋa ni. Durnya wiarɛ ba ra hiŋ. Kɔraawiizi Duma waa hoo ba ni.
20Ka, n nɛnɔŋŋaa, iáwaa aah siwii di du iihinaa bɔkpega ii hinnaniinanii naa biini. Ií ɔɔ ra suŋŋuu u Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biini, 21di gilɛɛ waa ɛɛ wiimaa di ra lizi iihinaa Kɔraawiizi nɔŋŋaa la biini, ka ɔɔ ra hiŋuu ani tamii la yaa n na ɛɛ yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo la lugɔ u daŋ wa suŋ yaa ni, yá wer na u miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la.
22Ií ra na banla n na aani la sinyɛna, di ra hiini baa, 23di kaa lɛɛ baŋhina lugɔ baŋ ɔɔ too kuŋ niŋ biini, á niŋ gilɛɛ waa diu la. Baŋhina ge, ii danna na ba sinyɛna, di ra hiini baa ka ra dazi, bá wichɔgaa la gilɛɛ waa buu ia.
Chɔlaa wiisuŋŋaa wia
24Too. Ií ra kpa Kɔraawiizi girme. Waabuu dɔɔ fɔŋŋa un niŋ wer hiini ia, ií gil wichɔgaa ɛɛi wer kpa ia ba u be, ií wer na u girme di chi u be, wichɔgaa maa wàá pɛli ia, ií bɔra sɔɔni ia werge maa. 25U bɛnnɛ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi. Waabuu lɛɛ yaa ha dikuu yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo wia. Ií ra tɔgzuu di ra tɛu sɔŋ, di ra sɛɛ u fɔŋŋa ni u dɔɔra. A maanii u dɔɔ saŋa maa la. U daŋ haa dɔɔa saŋa maa di ra la. Ami.

english_text:
1This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John. 2And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
3God will bless everyone who reads this prophecy to others, and he will bless everyone who hears and obeys it. The time is almost here.
4 From John to the seven churches in Asia.
I pray that you
will be blessed
with kindness and peace
from God, who is and was
and is coming.
May you receive
kindness and peace
from the seven spirits
before the throne of God.
5 May kindness and peace
be yours
from Jesus Christ,
the faithful witness.
Jesus was the first
to conquer death,
and he is the ruler
of all earthly kings.
Christ loves us,
and by his blood
he set us free
from our sins.
6 He lets us rule as kings
and serve God his Father
as priests.
To him be glory and power
forever and ever! Amen.
7 Look! He is coming
with the clouds.
Everyone will see him,
even the ones who stuck
a sword through him.
All people on earth
will weep because of him.
Yes, it will happen! Amen.
8 The Lord God says, “I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful!”
A Vision of the Risen Lord
9I am John, a follower together with all of you. We suffer because Jesus is our king, but he gives us the strength to endure. I was sent to Patmos Island, because I had preached God's message and had told about Jesus. 10On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet. 11The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
12When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands. 13 There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest. 14 His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire. 15 His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall. 16He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.
17 When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said:
Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last, 18and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead. 19Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things. 20I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
translation_text:
1Wia naa n du hɔnnaa biini naa, Kɔraawiizi pillaabuu bagli Yeesu Kristo, ú bagli u balaa, bá wer zum wia la n niŋ wa ɛɛ filaŋkeŋ. Yeesu Kristo gillɔɔ u mɛlika bɛl ba u balii Jɔɔn be di wa bagluu a wia. 2Jɔɔn bagli wia la maa un nawɛɛ. Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii ni Yeesu Kristo ge baglaa daansɛɛrɛ u di, di sɛbi a wia dau. 3Nɛr la n niŋ karmi hɔnnaa nɛra nuu, nuu sumaa. Banla ge n niŋ nuu banna karmuu di ra sɛɛ wia la a hɔŋ n baglɛɛ la, ba ge gba nuu sumaa. Saŋa la a wia n niŋ wa ɛɛ la ra dugluu.
Chɛchizi aniidaanɛɛ jaamaa wia
4Mìŋ́ Jɔɔnnɛ sɛbi wia naa tɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra la n ɔɔ chaali dɔŋa bola aniidaanɛɛ, Eesia hɛri la. Kɔraawiizi la n du de filaŋkeŋ, di faa du de saŋa maa la, unla n niŋ haa wa ba la, ú hiini ia di tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna. Dunzi aniidaanɛɛ la n ɔɔ du u be u sognibɔr 5ani Yeesu Kristo n faa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi daansɛɛ hiŋ ni wibii, di kaa ɛɛ unla n felee izi lii lalaa biini, di kaa ɛɛ durnya koora maa nabɔma la, bá maa hiini ia, di tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna. Ií ra tɛɛ unla n nɔŋŋi yaa di siu, ú chal wer lɛɛ yaa ha, yaa wer lii yaa wichɔgaa biini la sɔŋ. 6U gillɔɔ yaa kpau ɛɛ u kora hina di ɛɛ u kizeehina, di ra hum u Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi. Awia, ií ra tɛu sɔŋ. Waabuu niŋ dɔɔ fɔŋŋa saŋaa saŋa maa. Ami.
7Ií ra nuu ɛŋ. U daŋ ba.
Baama ninɛɛ ú ga ba.
Nɛruu nɛr maa daŋ nau unna ba.
Banla n faa kpa kandaa di yag u loŋŋi la,
ba gba daŋ nau.
Durnya dee maa daŋ nau
di ra lɔɔgi wile.
Too. Ú ra ba! Ami.
8Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi la n ɔɔ du de filaŋkeŋ, di faa du de saŋa maa la, unla n niŋ haa wa ba di ɛɛ Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la, u ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Minuu lugli, minuu tuna.”
Yeesu nai lugɔ deeza biini wia
9Mìŋ́ ii dɔŋhiŋ Jɔɔn n na sɛbi hɔnnaa, n ni ii maa ɛɛ kpannɛ di ra di tɔɔrɔɔ, di ra hum Kɔraawiizi Kora wia, di ra di kanyitti dikuu yaa ni Yeesu n kpauwɛ wia. Ba faa kpambuu ga ta nii baaŋ hɛri bɛl, ba ra yir de Patmɔs, dikuu miŋ faa bagli Kɔraawiizi wia di kaa di Yeesu daansɛɛ la wia. 10Yaa Dɔɔri hɔpizii Alaadi bɛl hɔllɛ n faa du de. Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii izi n ni, n nuu loobii bɛl n har lugɔ bensunoniina. 11U ŋɔ, “Wia naa hinna na naa, sɛbaa du hɔŋ biini di tili Yeesu hiŋra la n chaalɛɛ du bola aniidaanɛɛ la, banla n du Ɛfɛsus, Simirna, Pɛgamum, Tayataira, Sadis, Filadɛlfia ani Laudisia la.”
12N bir ń na nɛr la n ŋɔ wia n be la. Mim bittɛ, n na saliŋ fintina daazi aniidaanɛɛ, 13di na nɛbɛl lugɔ “Newee Biibaal” n chigɛ a fintina daazi baambaaŋ. Tagtajaŋ la un laalɛɛ hel u naapezi. Saliŋ belenti ge vɔɔ u bampirii. 14U nyuhuna huuhzi alugɔ gonni. U siwee ge ra nyɛgzi lugɔ ninlau. 15U naazi ge aah lugɔ baŋ kpa danyɛ du ninzeŋ u aah la. U loobii ge ra gbɔgzi lugɔ gɔnzeŋ nii n na chuuri. 16Chinchiŋwilaa aniidaanɛɛ du u nodig. Tokobii bɛl n dɔɔ nuuzi anɛɛ di ra di werge ra lii u nua. U siwee paga ge chaani werge alugɔ wiizi n na lɔ fɔŋŋa ni.
17Miŋ wa nau la, n chol u see lugɔ min siuwɛ. U kpa u nodig sag n ni, ka ŋɔ, “Gilɛɛ ra ɔm. Minuu tɔ see di kaa tɔ har. 18Minuu unla n na nyiŋ la. N faa siuwɔɔ ka filaŋkeŋ, n kaa dɔɔ miibɔɔrɛ di ra nyiŋ saŋa maa! N dɔɔ siu ni lalaa bol saafiibee.
19Awia, sɛbi wia la hiŋ nawɛɛ, wia la n du de filaŋkeŋ ani anla n niŋ wa ɛɛ wia naa harbɔɔ la. 20Chinchiŋwilaa aniidaanɛɛ naa n du n nodig ni saliŋ fintina daazi aniidaanɛɛ naa, n daŋ pilli a zɛɛ tɛi. Chinchiŋwilaa aniidaanɛɛ naa ɛɛ mɛlikazi la n na binni Yeesu hiŋra la n chaalɛɛ bola aniidaanɛɛ biini labuu. Fintina daazi naa ge ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra la.”

english_text:
The Letter to Ephesus
1This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus:
I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
2I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars. 3You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
4But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to. 5Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand. 6But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
7 If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden.
The Letter to Smyrna
8 This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna:
I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
9I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
10Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
11 If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death.
The Letter to Pergamum
12This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum:
I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
13I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
14 I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral. 15Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans. 16Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
17 If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. I will also give each one a white stone with a new name written on it. No one will know that name except the one who is given the stone.
The Letter to Thyatira
18This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira:
I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
19I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before. 20 But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols. 21I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
22I am going to strike down Jezebel. Everyone who does these immoral things with her will also be punished, if they don't stop. 23 I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
24Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands. 25But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
26 I will give power over the nations to everyone who wins the victory and keeps on obeying me until the end. 27-28I will give each of them the same power my Father has given me. They will rule the nations with an iron rod and smash those nations to pieces like clay pots. I will also give them the morning star.
29If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_text:
Amaniye tɛɛ Ɛfɛsus Yeesu hiŋra wia
1U kaa ŋɔ, “Jaa sɛbi wia naa tɛɛ mɛlika la n na binni Yeesu hiŋra n chaalɛɛ Ɛfɛsus la, di ŋɔ,
‘Unla n kpogli chinchiŋwilaa aniidaanɛɛ u nodig, di ra vol saliŋ fintina daazi aniidaanɛɛ la baambaaŋ, waabuu ra ŋɔ wia naa. 2N zum ii huma, ii kuuhni ani ii kanyitti dii wiarɛ, di zum lugɔ ii waa nɛchɔgaa wia ra sɛɛ. Ii faa ɛɛ banla n faa ra yir bahinaa Kɔraawiizi huŋhunna, ka ba waa u huŋhunna ɛɛwɛ labuu di na, di zum lugɔ ba ɛɛ kara hinaa. 3Ii kaa dɔɔ kanyitti di di tɔɔrɔɔ guŋŋ dikuu n wia, ka ii bɔra waa huahwɛ.
4Ama, ka wii naabuu du de wanna par. Gunla iiŋ felee nɔŋŋiŋ la, ii waa kaa nɔŋŋiŋ guŋ. 5Awia, ií ra liizi gunla aŋ faa duwɛɛ la, di gil ii biine chɔgi dikuu ii wichɔgaa wia, ka kaa kpa ii lugli wiɛɛlaa la. Di guŋ lɛi, di ii waa sɛɛwɛ ii biine chɔgi dikuu ii wichɔgaa wia, n daŋ ba ii be di wa lizi ii fintina la lii u duuribɔr la. 6Ama, iiŋ hah banla banna yir Nikolatan hina huma la, u guŋ wesso. N gba hah ba huma labuu.
7Nɛr la maa n dɔɔ digna di ra nuu wia, ú ra nuu wia la Kɔraawiizi Duma n na ŋɔ Yeesu hiŋra be la. Nɛr la n wette di kpegli Sitaani, n daŋ gil u di miibɔɔ daa la n du Kɔraawiizi bɔnanii biini la nɔna.’ ”
Amaniye tɛɛ Simirna Yeesu hiŋra wia
8“Kaa sɛbi wia naa tɛɛ mɛlika la n na binni Yeesu hiŋra la n du Simirna la.
‘Unla n tɔ see di kaa tɔ har, unla n faa siuwɛ ka bir izi siu biini di dɔɔ miibɔɔ la, waabuu ra ŋɔ wia naa. 9N zum ii tɔɔrɔɔ dii ani ii nyaari wiarɛ, ka ii ɛɛ dɔɔnaa. N kaa zum gunla banla n na yir bahinaa Jus hina ka ɛɛ Sitaani hiŋra la n na gbɛlli ia. 10Ií gilɛɛ ra ɔm tɔɔrɔɔ la iin niŋ wa di la. Ií ra nuu ɛŋ. Sitaani daŋ gil ba lauri ii baŋhina tɔ dia, bá wer ɛɛ ia di na. Ba daŋ tɔɔri ia guŋŋ hɔpizaa fi. Di siurɛ gba, ka ií haa vɛɛ di ra hiŋiŋ ka ń wa tɛɛ ia miibɔɔ, ú ɛɛ ii tɔna.
11Nɛr la n dɔɔ digna ra nuu wia, ú ra nuu wia la Kɔraawiizi Duma n na ŋɔ Yeesu hiŋra be la. Nɛr la n wette kpegli Sitaani, siu bunɛɛhiŋ la wàá dɔɔ fɔŋŋa u ni.’ ”
Amaniye tɛɛ Pɛgamum Yeesu hiŋra wia
12“Kaa sɛbi wia naa tɛɛ mɛlika la n na binni Yeesu hiŋra la n du Pɛgamum ge la.
‘Unla n dɔɔ tokobizeŋ la n dɔɔ nuuzi anɛɛ di ra di werge la, waabuu ra sɛbi wia naa. 13N zum ii duuribɔttɛ. Sitaani sognibɔttɛ ii du la, ka ii haa vɛɛ di ra hiŋiŋ. Saŋa la baŋ faa kpu Antipas la n di n daansɛɛ ni wibii ii be Sitaani sognibɔr la, ka ii waa hɔɔwɛ lugɔ ii wanna hiŋ, ka haa vɛɛ di ra hiŋiŋ.
14Ama, wia aŋhinaa du de, a wanna par. Baŋhina du ii biinii di ra hiŋ Balaam baglaa. Waabuu faa gillɛ Balak dar Izrɛl hina ba hee ola la baŋ kpuwɛɛ tɛɛ vuga, di kaa ra sɛm la. 15Banla n na hiŋ Nikolatan hina baglaa gba du ii benii. 16Awia, ií gil ii biine chɔgi dikuu ii wichɔgaa wia. Di guŋ lɛi, n daŋ ba ii be manaŋ di wa kpa tokobi la n du n nua la di yoo ia.
17Nɛr la maa n dɔɔ digna di ra nuu wia, ú ra nuu wia la Kɔraawiizi Duma n na ŋɔ Yeesu hiŋra be la. Nɛr la n niŋ wer kpegli Sitaani, n daŋ tɛu paanuu dee bɛl nɛra n waa u wia zummɛ ú hee, di kaa tɛu bihuŋŋu bɛl miŋ sɛbi sɔŋfalii bɛl di du u ni. Nɛr maa waa a sɔŋ zummɛ di unla min niŋ kpau tɛɛ la lɛi.’ ”
Amaniye tɛɛ Tayataira Yeesu hiŋra wia
18“Kaa sɛbi wia naa tɛɛ mɛlika la n na binni Yeesu hiŋra la n du Tayataira ge la.
‘Unla n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Biibaal di kaa dɔɔ siwee alugɔ ninlau, di dɔɔ naazi a ra nyɛgzi lugɔ danyɛ la, waabuu ra ŋɔ wia naa. 19N zum ii wiɛɛlaa, ii nɛnɔŋŋaa, ii Kɔraawiizi yarda, ii huma iinna hum ani ii kanyitti diire. Ii filaŋkeŋ wiɛɛlaa wesso kaali ii lugli wiɛɛlaa gba.
20Ama, wii naabuu du de wanna par. Haaŋ la n na yir u hiŋ n dɔgtɛɛ bɛl, u sɔŋ di Jɛzɛbɛl la, ii giluubuu u du ii be di ra bagli ia, di ra dar n balaa ba ra sɛm di ra hee ola la baŋ kpuwɛɛ tɛɛ vuga. 21N tɛubuu hɔpizaa ú gil u biini chɔgi dikuu u wichɔgaa wia, ka waa sɛɛwɛ. 22Ií ra nuu ɛŋ. N daŋ duu wiila, ú ni banla u ni baa n na sɛm la chɔɔ di ra wii. Di ba waa sɛɛwɛ bá biine chɔgi dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia, di gil u huma la, ba maa daŋ di tɔɔrɔɔ werge maa. 23N daŋ kpu u biizi. Denii Yeésu hiŋra maa zum lugɔ minuu ra pigzi newea biine la. N daŋ turgi ii bɛl maa gunla uŋ hummɛ. 24Ka ii banla n kawɛɛ ii waa u baglaa la sɛɛwɛ, ii waa wia la banna yir Sitaani wolo wia la zummɛ la, màá ka chug ia bunni maa. 25Ama, wia la iin lauwɛ nɛnnɛ di ra hiŋ la, ií haŋ lawaa guŋŋ ń na ba.
26Nɛr la n wette kpegli Sitaani, di wer hum n huma guŋŋ di wa hel a tuna la, n daŋ tɛu fɔŋŋa durnya nɛra ni.
27U daŋ kpa lugbii daŋkpala di ra binni ba ni,
di chɔgi baa alugɔ
baŋ ɔɔ purgi vii gunla.
N Mɛɛ tɛmbuu a fɔŋŋa. 28N ge daŋ tɛu chɔɔziŋ chinchiŋwilii la. 29Nɛr la maa n dɔɔ digna di ra nuu wia, ú ra nuu wia la Kɔraawiizi Duma n na ŋɔ Yeesu hiŋra be la.’ ”

english_text:
The Letter to Sardis
1This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Sardis:
I have the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. Listen to what I say.
I know what you are doing. Everyone may think you are alive, but you are dead. 2Wake up! You have only a little strength left, and it is almost gone. So try to become stronger. I have found that you are not completely obeying God. 3 Remember the teaching you were given and heard. Hold firmly to it and turn from your sins. If you don't wake up, I will come when you least expect it, just as a thief does.
4A few of you in Sardis have not dirtied your clothes with sin. You will walk with me in white clothes, because you are worthy. 5 Everyone who wins the victory will wear white clothes. Their names will not be erased from the book of life, and I will tell my Father and his angels that they are my followers.
6If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
The Letter to Philadelphia
7 This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia:
I am the one who is holy and true, and I have the keys that belonged to David. When I open a door, no one can close it. And when I close a door, no one can open it. Listen to what I say.
8I know everything you have done. And I have placed before you an open door no one can close. You were not very strong, but you obeyed my message and did not deny you are my followers. 9 Now you will see what I will do with those people who belong to Satan's group. They claim to be God's people, but they are liars. I will make them come and kneel down at your feet. Then they will know that I love you.
10You obeyed my message and endured. So I will protect you from the time of testing everyone in all the world must go through. 11I am coming soon. So hold firmly to what you have, and no one will take away the crown you will be given as your reward.
12 Everyone who wins the victory will be made into a pillar in the temple of my God, and they will stay there forever. I will write on each of them the name of my God and the name of his city. It is the new Jerusalem my God will send down from heaven. I will also write on them my own new name.
13If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
The Letter to Laodicea
14 This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Laodicea:
I am the one called Amen! I am the faithful and true witness and the source of God's creation. Listen to what I say.
15I know everything you have done, and you are not cold or hot. I wish you were either one or the other. 16But since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth. 17You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
18Buy your gold from me. It has been refined in a fire, and it will make you rich. Buy white clothes from me. Wear them and you can cover up your shameful nakedness. Buy medicine for your eyes, so you will be able to see.
19 I correct and punish everyone I love. So make up your minds to turn away from your sins. 20Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together. 21Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.
22If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_text:
Amaniye tɛɛ Sadis Yeesu hiŋra wia
1U kaa ŋɔ, “Kaa sɛbi wia naa di tɛɛ mɛlika la n na binni Yeesu hiŋra la n du Sadis ge la.
‘Unla n dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi dunzi aniidaanɛɛ ni chinchiŋwilaa aniidaanɛɛ la, waabuu ra ŋɔ wia naa. N zum ii wiɛɛlaarɛ. Nɛra zumɔɔ lugɔ ii dɔɔ miibɔɔrɛ, ka ii siuwɔɔ. Ii hiŋaa la fɔŋŋa la iin dɔɔwɛ la ra tunuu. Ií ra duu bɔkpega, ú gilɛɛ waa tuŋ kɔrai. 2Ií ra du tau, di ra kuari wia la n haa kawɛɛ di ra nyiŋŋi a siuzi la, á wer chi nɛnnɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, maa ii wiɛɛlii bɛl maa nawɛɛ uŋ wesse werge di wa tuŋ n Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi be. 3Awia, ií ra liizi gunla baŋ faa bagli ia ani wia la iin nuuwɛ la, di ra hiŋ ba nuuzi guŋ, di gil ii biine chɔgi dikuu ii wichɔgaa wia. Di ii waa sɛɛwɛ ii du tau, n daŋ ba alugɔ ŋmɛɛŋ n ɔɔ ba di wa pirgi ia. Ii waa zum saŋa la min niŋ wa ba ii be.
4Ama, ii dɔɔ nɛra tama de baŋ waa gillɛ wichɔgaa doŋ ba wɛjɛzi. N daŋ tɔ baa wɛjɛhuŋŋa, n ni baa ra vol. Ba dɛg gunnɛ. 5Nɛr la n wette kpegli Sitaani, n daŋ tɔu wɛjɛhuŋŋu. Màá dinzi u sɔŋ miibɔɔ hɔŋ la biini maa. N daŋ ŋɔ u wia lugɔ n nuubuu n Mɛɛ ni u mɛlikananaa la be. 6Nɛr la maa n dɔɔ digna di ra nuu wia, ú ra nuu wia la Kɔraawiizi Duma n na ŋɔ Yeesu hiŋra be la.’ ”
Amaniye tɛɛ Filadɛlfia Yeesu hiŋra wia
7“Kaa sɛbi wia naa tɛɛ mɛlika la n na binni Yeesu hiŋra la n du Filadɛlfia ge la.
‘Unla n ɛɛ naniinanii, di ɛɛ wibii hiŋ, di dɔɔ Deevid saafiibii la, di u pilli dominua, nɛr maa wàá wer tɔu, di u kaa tɔu, nɛr maa wàá wer pilluu labuu ra ŋɔ wia naa. 8N zum ii wiɛɛlaarɛ. Ií ra nuu ɛŋ. N pilli ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ tɛɛ ia. Nɛr maa wàá wer tɔu, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii fɔŋŋa waa kaŋ, ka ii wer ra hiŋ n nua. Ii waa n wia hɔɔwɛ di gil n hiŋaa. 9Ií ra nuu ɛŋ. Sitaani hiŋra la n na kanni kara di ra yir bahinaa Jus hina, ka ba waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ la, n daŋ gil ba wa giŋŋi ii see di ra jaami ia. Denii bá zum lugɔ n nɔŋŋi iabuu. 10Iin nuuwɛ tɛŋ di di kanyitti la, n ge daŋ lɛɛ ia tɔɔrɔɔ la n niŋ jaa ba durnya maa nɛra be di wa ɛɛ baa na la biini.
11N daŋ ba manaŋ. Ií lau wia la iin zummɛ la chigigi nɛ́r maa gilɛɛ wa wer dar ia di lɛɛ ii lii tɔna ii be. 12Nɛr la n wette kpegli Sitaani, n daŋ gil u ɛɛ ligii bɛl n Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Dia biini. Wàá ka lii de maa. N daŋ sɛbi n Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ di du u ni, di kaa sɛbi n Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi bol sɔŋ di du u ni. Jɛrusalɛmfalii la n niŋ wa lii n Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi be di tuu ii be la sɔnnɛ ń sɛbi du u ni, di kaa sɛbi n sɔŋfalii di du u ni. 13Nɛr la n dɔɔ digna di ra nuu wia, ú ra nuu wia la Kɔraawiizi Duma n na ŋɔ Yeesu hiŋra be la.’ ”
Amaniye tɛɛ Laudisia Yeesu hiŋra wia
14“Kaa sɛbi wia naa tɛɛ mɛlika la n na binni Yeesu hiŋra la n du Laudisia ge la.
‘Unla n ɛɛ Ami, di ɛɛ daansɛɛ hiŋ la wia n dɔɔ wibii, kummaa ge Kɔraawiizi n faa tawɛɛ lii u fɔŋŋa biini la, waabuu ra ŋɔ wia naa. 15N zum ii wiɛɛlaarɛ. Ii waa sɛɛwɛ ií hiŋ nɛnnɛ. Ii waa kaa vɛɛ ge, ka ɛɛ lugɔ nii n waa wenzee, waa kaa sɔɔni ge, ka ɛɛ hɔlɔhɔlɔ. Di ii daŋ hiŋ, ií hiŋ. Di ii daŋ vɛɛ ge, ií vɛɛ. 16Ka iiŋ waa hiŋ, ii waa kaa vɛɛ ge ka ɛɛ lugɔ nii la n ɛɛ hɔlɔhɔlɔ naa, n daŋ puuzi ia ha. 17Ii ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ ii jaa nau di birgi dɔɔna. Ii waa kummaa nyaawɛ. Ka ii waa zummɛ lugɔ ii ɛɛ nyaaraa, ii wia dɔɔ sinyɛna werge. Ii waa kummaa dɔɔwɛ. Ii nyuŋŋɔɔrɛ. Ii waa laala gba dɔɔwɛ ií laali. 18Ií gil n ŋɔ ii be. A wesso iin nyiŋŋi saliŋ la miŋ du niŋ, di lizi u doŋa maa ha la di yau n be, di kaa yau wɛjɛhuŋŋa ií wer tɔ iihinaa, hiíhzi gilɛɛ waa di ia dikuu iiŋ waa kummaa tɔwɛɛ wia, di kaa nyiŋŋi tagzi n be di yau di du ii siwee, ií wer di ra na.
19Banla min nɔŋŋɛɛ, baabuu n ɔɔ jugmi di tɛrgi ba digna. Awia, ií aah siwii di gil ii biine chɔgi dikuu ii wichɔgaa wia. 20Ií ra nuu ɛŋ. Mìŋ́ chigɛ ii dominua di ra lɔ kɔkɔ. Di nɛr la maa wa nuu n loobii di pilliŋ, n daŋ zuu u be n nuu di.
21Nɛr la maa n wette kpegli Sitaani, n daŋ gil u so n be n sognibɔr la. Gunnɛ n ge faa kpegli Sitaani, di wa so n Mɛɛ be u sognibɔr la. 22Nɛr la maa n dɔɔ digna di ra nuu wia, ú ra nuu wia la Kɔraawiizi Duma n na ŋɔ Yeesu hiŋra be la.’ ”

english_text:
Worship in Heaven
1After this, I looked and saw a door that opened into heaven. Then the voice that had spoken to me at first and that sounded like a trumpet said, “Come up here! I will show you what must happen next.” 2 Right then the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven I saw a throne and someone sitting on it. 3The one who was sitting there sparkled like precious stones of jasper and carnelian. A rainbow that looked like an emerald surrounded the throne.
4Twenty-four other thrones were in a circle around that throne. And on each of these thrones there was an elder dressed in white clothes and wearing a gold crown. 5 Flashes of lightning and roars of thunder came out from the throne in the center of the circle. Seven torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were burning in front of the throne. 6 Also in front of the throne was something that looked like a glass sea, clear as crystal.
Around the throne in the center were four living creatures covered front and back with eyes. 7The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle. 8 Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and their bodies were covered with eyes. Day and night they never stopped singing,
“Holy, holy, holy is the Lord,
the all-powerful God,
who was and is
and is coming!”
9The living creatures kept praising, honoring, and thanking the one who sits on the throne and who lives forever and ever. 10At the same time the 24 elders knelt down before the one sitting on the throne. And as they worshiped the one who lives forever, they placed their crowns in front of the throne and said,
11 “Our Lord and God,
you are worthy
to receive glory,
honor, and power.
You created all things,
and by your decision they are
and were created.”
translation_text:
Kɔraawiizi Bol jaamaa wia
1Denii n binni di ga na dominua bɛl n pillɛɛ Kɔraawiizi bol, di nuu unla n felee ŋɔ wia la loobii lugɔ bensunoniina la. U ŋɔ, “Tinni ra ba ɛŋ, ń baglii wia la n niŋ wa ɛɛ wia naa harbɔɔ.” 2Denii Kɔraawiizi Duma izi n ni, n binni di koorikara bɛl chigɔ Kɔraawiizi bol, nɛbɛl ge so u ni. 3Nɛr la n soge de la ra nyɛgzi pilpilpil lugɔ binanaa la banna yir jaspɛr ni karnɛliɔn la. Kɔraawiizi kizee bɛl bar u kara la, u ge lugɔ binanii la banna yir ɛmɛrald n na nyɛgzi gunla. 4N kaa na koorikassi tokko ni anaazu n bar u kara la wa kaali. Nabɔnzi tokko ni banaazu tɔ wɛjɛhuŋŋa, di hi saliŋ kahurozi di so kassi la ni. 5Kara la n du a baambaaŋ la ra lizi kuna aŋhina lugɔ dooŋ n na nyɛgzi, pilpilpil, di kaa ra gbɔgzi gbigbigbi lugɔ dooŋ. Nine aniidaanɛɛ ge du kara la see di ra chaani. Kɔraawiizi dunzi aniidaanɛɛ labuu.
6A kara see paga ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ muuzeŋ n ɛɛ yelemm di chɔɔ lugɔ digii. Kunnyinee anaazu du u sognibɔr la di baruu. A dɔɔ siweere a sezi ni a harbɔɔni maa. 7A kunnyinee bɛl ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bunyiŋ, bɛl ɛɛ lugɔ nabii, bɛl siwee li newee siwee, bɛl ge ɛɛ lugɔ chig n na zaah. 8Bɛl maa dɔɔ keeri anumbɛl, siwee tɔ a bɔra maa ni a keeri biine gba. A ɔɔ du u be saŋa maa, di yir yira di ra ŋɔ,
“Kunnaniinaniirɛ
yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi la.
Waa doŋa maa dɔɔwɛ.
Fɔŋŋa maanii u dɔɔ di faa du de
di haa du de filaŋkeŋ.
U daŋ haa wa ba.”
9Gunnɛ kunnyinee la ɔɔ ra ɛɛ di ra jaami unla n soge koorikara la ni, di ɛɛ unla n niŋ ɔɔ ra nyiŋ di ra la la. Saŋa la maa aŋ ɔɔ ŋɔ á jaamuu, di kpau girme di tɔgzuu gunla, 10nabɔnzi tokko ni banaazu la ɔɔ chɔɔ unla n soge koorikara la ni di ra nyiŋ saŋa maa la seere, di ra jaamuu di ɔɔ pilli ba saliŋ kahurozi di ra dauraa u see, di yir yira di ra ŋɔ,
11“Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi,
girme, zenni ani fɔŋŋa ɛɛ i horaa,
dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu ta kummaa.
I kipar wiarɛ
i taa, a du de.”

english_text:
The Scroll and the Lamb
1 In the right hand of the one sitting on the throne I saw a scroll that had writing on the inside and on the outside. And it was sealed in seven places. 2I saw a mighty angel ask with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?” 3No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
4I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it. 5 Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop crying and look! The one who is called both the ‘Lion from the Tribe of Judah’ and ‘King David's Great Descendant’ has won the victory. He will open the scroll and its seven seals.”
6 Then I looked and saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb looked as if it had once been killed. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, sent out to all the earth.
7The Lamb went over and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat on the throne. 8 After he had taken it, the four living creatures and the 24 elders knelt down before him. Each of them had a harp and a gold bowl full of incense, which are the prayers of God's people. 9 Then they sang a new song,
“You are worthy
to receive the scroll
and open its seals,
because you were killed.
And with your own blood
you bought for God
people from every tribe,
language, nation, and race.
10 You let them become kings
and serve God as priests,
and they will rule on earth.”
11 As I looked, I heard the voices of a large number of angels around the throne and the voices of the living creatures and of the elders. There were millions and millions of them, 12and they were saying in a loud voice,
“The Lamb who was killed
is worthy to receive power,
riches, wisdom, strength,
honor, glory, and praise.”
13Then I heard all beings in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and in the sea offer praise. Together, all of them were saying,
“Praise, honor, glory,
and strength
forever and ever
to the one who sits
on the throne
and to the Lamb!”
14The four living creatures said “Amen,” while the elders knelt down and worshiped.
translation_text:
Hɔŋ la ni a Pebii wia
1Denii n binni di na lugɔ unla n soge koorikara ni la kpogli hɔŋ bɛl u nodig. A hɔŋ keŋkerezi anɛɛhiŋ maa ninɛɛ ba sɛbi. U bɔra la baŋ kpa kel margi ge du aniidaanɛɛ. 2N kaa na mɛlikakpeg bɛl n na ŋɔ wia fɔŋŋa ni, “Anɛɛ n dɛg hɔnnaa kel naa bɔra aniidaanɛɛhiŋ lallaa, á hɔŋ pilli tɛɛ yaai?” 3Nɛr maa waa hoo chiŋ, hɛri ani hɛri zɛɛ gba maa un niŋ pilli a hɔŋ di binni u biini. 4Denii n jaa ra wii werge maa, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba waa nɛr maa nawɛɛ u dɛg hɔŋ la pillaa, ú wer binni u biini. 5Denii Nabɔma la bɛl ŋɔ n be, “Gilɛɛ ra wii. Na! Unla n lii Juda dee biini, ba ra yiruu bunyiŋ di kaa ra yiruu Deevid naana la, u wettoo kpegli u dɔma. Awia, waabuu dɛg hɔŋ la kel bɔra aniidaanɛɛ la lallaa.”
6Denii n kaa binni, di Pebii bɛl n chigɛ koorikara la bɔr baambaaŋ, kunnyinee ni nabɔnzi la baruu. U li peezi baŋ kpuwɛɛ. Nyigzi aniidaanɛɛ lii u nyuu. U dɔɔ siwee ge aniidaanɛɛ. A siwee ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi dunzi aniidaanɛɛ la uŋ hummɛ a la durnya maa biini labuu. 7A pebii ga lɛɛ hɔŋ la koori la hiŋ nodig. 8Uŋ wa lɛɛ hɔŋ la, kunnyinee anaazu la ni nabɔnzi tokko ni banaazu la chɔɔ u see di ra jaamuu. Ba maa ni ba janjalanzi ni ba saliŋ hɛnnii. Daahɛgsɔɔhsuma la baŋ ɔɔ fuuh a ra sɔɔhri sumaii la du a hɛnni biini. Kɔraawiizi biinanaa suŋŋaa la baŋ ɔɔ suŋŋuu labuu daahɛgsɔɔhsuma la. 9Ba yir yirfalii bɛl keŋ, di ŋɔ,
“I dɛg hɔŋ la bɔpɛglaa la lallaarɛ,
dikuubɛɛwiai,
ba faa kpuibuu.
I chal la wiarɛ i wer turgi
nɛra wichɔgaa kim,
di lɛɛ baa ha lii
nɛdeere dee maa
n du hɛri naa
yenne yemmaa biine,
10di gil ba ɛɛ yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Kora hina
ni u Kizeehina.
Ba daŋ dɔɔ
durnya maa.”
11N kaa ŋɔ n binni di bɔr maa ra gbɔgzi werge maa, dikuubɛɛwiai, mɛlikazi kpilakpila maa ballɔɔ di wa bar koorikara la ni kunnyinee ni nabɔnzi la maa chem. A du kagboŋa kagboŋ kpila maa, 12di ra ŋɔ bɔkpega ni,
“Pebii la baŋ faa kpuwɛɛ la dɛkkɔ
nɛr maa n kpa fɔŋŋa
daama, nunzuma, kpegzi,
girme, sɔŋ ani chɔlaa
maa ra tɛu.”
13N kaa nuu kuna la maa Kɔraawiizi n tawɛɛ chiŋ, kuna la maa n du hɛri ni muu biini maa n na ŋɔ,
“Ií ra chɔli unla n soge koorikara la ni ani Pebii la,
di ra tɛɛ baa sɔŋ ni girme
ani fɔŋŋa maa,
di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa.”
14Kunnyinee anaazu la ŋɔ, “Ami.” Nabɔnzi la ge chɔɔ di ra jaami.

english_text:
Opening the Seven Seals
1At the same time I saw the Lamb open the first of the seven seals, I heard one of the four living creatures shout with a voice like thunder. It said, “Come out!” 2 Then I saw a white horse. Its rider carried a bow and was given a crown. He had already won some victories, and he went out to win more.
3When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come out!” 4 Then another horse came out. It was fiery red. And its rider was given the power to take away all peace from the earth, so people would slaughter one another. He was also given a big sword.
5 When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come out!” Then I saw a black horse, and its rider had a balance scale in one hand. 6I heard what sounded like a voice from somewhere among the four living creatures. It said, “A liter of wheat will cost you a whole day's wages! Three liters of barley will cost you a day's wages too. But don't ruin the olive oil or the wine.”
7When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come out!” 8 Then I saw a pale green horse. Its rider was named Death, and Death's Kingdom followed close behind. They were given power over one fourth of the earth, and they could kill its people with swords, famines, diseases, and wild animals.
9When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of everyone who had been killed for speaking God's message and telling about their faith. 10They shouted, “Master, you are holy and faithful! How long will it be before you judge and punish the people of this earth who killed us?”
11 Then each of those who had been killed was given a white robe and told to rest for a little while. They had to wait until the complete number of the Lord's other servants and followers would be killed.
12 When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood. 13 The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm. 14 Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.
15 The kings of the earth, its famous people, and its military leaders hid in caves or behind rocks on the mountains. They hid there together with the rich and the powerful and with all the slaves and free people. 16 Then they shouted to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us! Hide us from the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb. 17 That terrible day has come! God and the Lamb will show their anger, and who can face it?”
translation_text:
Kumpɛglaa la wia
1Denii n na Pebii la n lalli kel bɔmargaa aniidaanɛɛ la bɛl. Uŋ wa lalluu la, n nuu kunnyinee la bɛl loobii alugɔ dooŋ n na gbɔgzi. U ŋɔ, “A ba!” 2N binni di zaghuŋŋu bɛl liwɔɔ. Nɛr la n tinnuu la kpogli hoo. Ba kpa koorikahuro tɛu, u kaali di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa di kpegli nɛra, di haŋ kpegli baa ra la.
3Denii Pebii la kaa pilli kuŋpɛglaa nɛɛhiŋ la. Uŋ wa pillɛɛ, n nuu kunnyinii nɛɛhiŋ n ŋɔwɛɛ, “A ba!” 4Zagu bɛl kaa lii, u maa aah yorotototo. Ba tɛɛ nɛr la n tinnuu la fɔŋŋa, ú chɔg nuukpaŋ dɔɔi durnya maa biini, nɛ́ra ra kpuuzi dɔŋa. Tokobizeŋ bɛllɛ ba kpa tɛu u la.
5Pebii la lalli kumpɛglaa horohiŋ la. Uŋ wa lalluu, n nuu kunnyinii horohiŋ la n ŋɔwɛɛ, “A ba!” N binni di zagdoŋ bɛl liwɔɔ. Nɛr la n tinnuu la kpogli kunla baŋ kpawɛɛ ra zum tɔgzi la bɛl. 6N nuu gbɔga bɛl lugɔ loobii di lii kunnyinee anaazu la baambaaŋ, uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ, “Hɔpizibir kinturgaa maanii bá kpa yau mia libikpaŋ. Baali libizi ahoro ge guŋ. Ka nuu ni siŋ lawaa, gilɛɛ chɔgi aawaa.”
7Denii Pebii la kaa lalli kumpɛglaa naazuhiŋ la. Uŋ wa lalluu, n nuu kunnyinii naazuhiŋ la n ŋɔwɛɛ, “A ba!” 8N binni di zaghulahula bɛl liwɔɔ. Nɛr la n tinnuu la ge sɔnnɛ Siu. Bɛl ge hiŋ u ni. U ge sɔnnɛ Lalaa Bol. Ba gil bá bargi hɛri bɔra anaazu. Baŋ barguu bɔra anaazu la, ba tɛɛ baa fɔŋŋa, bá kpa tokobizi, lɔchɔgii, wiilchɔgii ani sechɔgaa di kpu a bɔra anaazu la bɛl nɛra.
9Denii Pebii la kaa lalli kumpɛglaa nuehiŋ la. Uŋ wa lalluu, n binni Kɔraawiizi mbusu lizibɔr zɛɛ di na lalaa la baŋ faa kpuwɛɛ, dikuu bam bagli Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii di di u daansɛɛ tɛu la wia. 10Ba lɔɔgi wile werge maa, di ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la wia n dɔɔ wibii, saŋa bɛɛ í di banla n du durnya biini naa seriya, di turgi yaa kpui la kimɛi?” 11Denii ba tɛɛ bɛl maa wɛjɛhuŋŋu ú tɔ, di ŋɔ bá haa heezi tama mɔɔ, ka bá dɔŋa Kɔraawiizi yoma ni babalaa la ban niŋ haa kpu alugɔ baŋ faa kpuuzi baa la wa jaa ba ni, bá maga su.
12Denii n na Pebii la n kaa lalli kumpɛglaa numbɛlhiŋ la. Un lalluu la, hɛri ra zigli werge maa, wiizi bir biri alugɔ wɛjɛdoŋ, baagu bir aah lugɔ chal, 13chinchiŋwilaa ge lii chiŋ di chogli hɛri alugɔ nɔŋhuuri la pezeŋ n zigli daa a chogli hɛri la, 14chiŋ maa kaali lugɔ bam piŋŋi kalaŋ. Bizenaa ni muuzeŋ baaŋ hɛrjigzi maa tugzi lii a bɔra. 15Durnya kora ni nɛzenaa, soojazi nabɔnzi, dɔɔna, fɔŋŋa dɔɔra, nɛdee maa, banla n ɛɛ yomaa ani banla n dɔɔ bahinaa maa maa chɔ ga suahzi bia bɔɔni ni giŋgimee bɔra, 16di ra ŋɔ giŋgimee ni bia la be, “Ií ra chogli yaa ni di tɔ yaa ni, únla n soge koorikara ni la gilɛɛ wa wer na yaa, Pébii la gilɛɛ wer tɔɔri yaa dikuu u baaŋfuuih la wia, 17dikuubɛɛwiai, ba Hɔpizizeŋ la ban niŋ zum Kɔraawiizi baaŋ n niŋ fuuh ba ni la helloo. Anɛɛ n niŋ wer lɛɛ u hiŋ u baaŋ hiŋ biinei?”

english_text:
The 144,000 Are Marked for God
1-2 After this I saw four angels. Each one was standing on one of the earth's four corners. The angels held back the four winds, so that no wind would blow on the earth or on the sea or on any tree. These angels had also been given the power to harm the earth and the sea. Then I saw another angel come up from where the sun rises in the east, and he was ready to put the mark of the living God on people. He shouted to the four angels, 3 “Don't harm the earth or the sea or any tree! Wait until I have marked the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
4Then I heard how many people had been marked on the forehead. There were 144,000, and they came from every tribe of Israel:
512,000 from Judah,
12,000 from Reuben,
12,000 from Gad,
612,000 from Asher,
12,000 from Naphtali,
12,000 from Manasseh,
712,000 from Simeon,
12,000 from Levi,
12,000 from Issachar,
812,000 from Zebulun,
12,000 from Joseph, and
12,000 from Benjamin.
People from Every Nation
9 After this, I saw a large crowd with more people than could be counted. They were from every race, tribe, nation, and language, and they stood before the throne and before the Lamb. They wore white robes and held palm branches in their hands, 10as they shouted,
“Our God, who sits
upon the throne,
has the power
to save his people,
and so does the Lamb.”
11The angels who stood around the throne knelt in front of it with their faces to the ground. The elders and the four living creatures knelt there with them. Then they all worshiped God 12and said,
“Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom,
thanks, honor, power,
and strength belong to our God
forever and ever! Amen!”
13One of the elders asked me, “Do you know who these people are that are dressed in white robes? Do you know where they come from?”
14 “Sir,” I answered, “you must know.”
Then he told me:
“These are the ones
who have gone through
the great suffering.
They have washed their robes
in the blood of the Lamb
and have made them white.
15And so they stand
before the throne of God
and worship him in his temple
day and night.
The one who sits on the throne
will spread his tent
over them.
16 They will never hunger
or thirst again,
and they won't be troubled
by the sun
or any scorching heat.
17 “The Lamb in the center
of the throne
will be their shepherd.
He will lead them to streams
of life-giving water,
and God will wipe all tears
from their eyes.”
translation_text:
Izrɛl hina kagboŋa kalfa ni tokkoanɛɛ ni banaazu la wia
1Denii n na mɛlikazi anaazu n chigɛ bɔr maa di lau peu liiri bɔrazi anaazu la, á gilɛɛ kaa ta hɛri, muu ani daa maa ni. 2N kaa na mɛlika bɛl n lii wiifurii di tinni ra ba, di kpogli unla n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi himmaa la piii la un niŋ kpa pii u kuna la. U ŋɔ mɛlikazi anaazu la baŋ tɛɛ fɔŋŋa lugɔ á chɔgi hɛri ni muuni la be ni bɔkpega, 3“Ií gilɛɛ chɔgi hɛri, muuni ani daazi la mɔɔ, ka ya wer pii Kɔraawiizi piii la du u balaa la hilli ni.” 4Banla um piiwɛ maga ɛɛ kagboŋa kalfa ni tokkoanɛɛ ni anaazu di lii Izrɛl dizi fidaanɛɛ la maa biini, 5Juda dee biini kagboŋa fidaanɛɛ, Rubin dee biini kagboŋa fidaanɛɛ, Gad dee biini kagboŋa fidaanɛɛ, 6Asɛ ge dee biini kagboŋa fidaanɛɛ, Naftali dee biini kagboŋa fidaanɛɛ, Manasɛ dee biini kagboŋa fidaanɛɛ, 7Simɛɔn dee biini kagboŋa fidaanɛɛ, Levi dee biini kagboŋa fidaanɛɛ, Isaka dee biini kagboŋa fidaanɛɛ, 8Zɛbulɔn ge dee biini kagboŋa fidaanɛɛ, Joosɛf dee biini kagboŋa fidaanɛɛ ani Bɛnjamin ge dee biini kagboŋa fidaanɛɛrɛ u pii.
Nɛkpila werge wia
9Denii n binni di nɛkpila werge maa du de, di lii nɛdee maa n du durnya yemmaa biini. Ba waa maga dɔɔwɛ gba. Nɛr maa wàá wer kur baa dikuu baŋ kpillɛ werge la wia. Ba maa tɔ wɛjɛhuŋŋa di kpogli daa paŋhoozenaa, di chi koorikara la ni Pebii la see, 10di ra ŋɔ fɔŋŋa ni,
“Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi la
n soge koorikara la ni,
ni Pebii la benii yaa na lɛɛi.”
11Mɛlikazi la maa ni nabɔnzi la ni kunnyinee anaazu la chi di bar koorikara la. Denii ba chɔɔ hɛri di ra jaami Kɔraawiizi, 12di ra ŋɔ,
“Ami.
Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi dɛkkɔɔ
nɛr maa n kpa chɔlaa, sɔŋ, nunzuma,
jaaŋ, girme, fɔŋŋa ani kpegzi maa
di ra tɛu saŋaa saŋa maa. Ami.”
13Denii nabɔma la bɛl pɛɛziŋ, “Nɛra naa n tɔ wɛjɛhuŋŋa naa, anɛɛwaarɛi? Lee ba liiyɛi?”
14N ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔri, bagliŋ ń zum.”
U ŋɔ, “Ba ɛɛ banla n di tɔɔrɔɔzenzeŋ ka lii labuu. Ba chag ba wɛjɛzii Pebii la chal biini, a lii di huuhzi guŋ. 15Awiarɛ,
ba chi Kɔraawiizi koorikara see
di ra humuu u Dia biini saŋa maa la,
unla n soge koorikara la ni la tɔ ba ni la.
16Ba wàá ka zum lɔzi ni niinyɔgzi wia.
Wiizi wàá ka lɔ ba ni.
Weŋ maa wàá ka kpu baa.
17Dikuubɛɛwiai,
Pebii la n du koorikara
la baambaaŋ
daŋ binni ba ni
alugɔ penɔɔni n na
binni u peeza ni la,
di tɔ ba see di bagli baa
bulli la n dɔɔ miibɔɔ.
Kɔraawiizi daŋ fiizi ba sinii maa di ha.”

english_text:
The Seventh Seal Is Opened
1When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour. 2I noticed that the seven angels who stood before God were each given a trumpet.
3 Another angel, who had a gold container for incense, came and stood at the altar. This one was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of God's people on the gold altar in front of the throne. 4Then the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, went up to God from the hand of the angel.
5 After this, the angel filled the incense container with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth. Thunder roared, lightning flashed, and the earth shook.
The Trumpets
6 The seven angels now got ready to blow their trumpets.
7 When the first angel blew his trumpet, hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down on the earth. A third of the earth, a third of the trees, and a third of all green plants were burned.
8When the second angel blew his trumpet, something like a great fiery mountain was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood, 9a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
10 When the third angel blew his trumpet, a great star fell from heaven. It was burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on a third of the springs of water. 11 The name of the star was Bitter, and a third of the water turned bitter. Many people died because the water was so bitter.
12 When the fourth angel blew his trumpet, a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were struck. They each lost a third of their light. So during a third of the day there was no light, and a third of the night was also without light.
13Then I looked and saw a lone eagle flying across the sky. It was shouting, “Trouble, trouble, trouble to everyone who lives on earth! The other three angels are now going to blow their trumpets.”
translation_text:
Kumpɛglaa aniidaanɛɛhiŋ la wia
1Pebii la n wa lalli bɔpɛglaa aniidaanɛɛhiŋ la, Kɔraawiizi bol maa ɛɛ guŋ surummm di birgi tama. 2Denii n na baŋ kpa bensunozi aniidaanɛɛ tɛɛ mɛlikazi aniidaanɛɛ la n chigɛ Kɔraawiizi be la. 3Mɛlika bɛl kaa ba di kpogli saliŋ nimbuurikuŋ di wa chi Kɔraawiizi mbusu lizibɔr la zɛɛ. Ba kpa daahɛgsɔɔhsuma werge maa tɛu, ú kpa jaa Kɔraawiizi biinanaa jaamaa la ni, di fuuh saliŋ mbusu lizibɔr la n du koorikara la zɛɛ la ni. 4Daahɛgsɔɔhsuma la n na fuuh, a nyɔɔzi lii mɛlika la nonii tinni di ra koozi Kɔraawiizi biinanaa jaamaa la ni Kɔraawiizi be. 5Denii mɛlika la paa niŋ la n du a bɔr di du daahɛgsɔɔhsuma kunla ni, di kpaa ha hɛri. Uŋ wa kpaa ha hɛri la, dooŋ a gbɔgzi gbigbigbi, di ra nyɛgzi bɔr maa malmalmal, hɛri ge ra zigli.
Bensunozi la wia
6Mɛlikazi aniidaanɛɛ la n kpogli bensunozi aniidaanɛɛ la ɛɛ sirya á huuh. 7Lugli mɛlika huuh. Uŋ huuhwɛ la, dobee ni niŋ n koozi chal ni lii chiŋ alugɔ baŋ kpaa ha hɛri, hɛri yeŋa ni a daazi ni a kooree maa fuuh. Di ba bargi hɛri maa bɔra ahoro, u bɔkpannɛ fuuhwe la, ka ka u bɔra anɛɛ la.
8Mɛlika nɛɛhiŋ huuh. Uŋ huuhwɛ, bizenzeŋ bɛl lii chiŋ alugɔ baŋ hau, u maa ra fuuh di wa zuu muuzeŋ biini. A muuzeŋ nii yeŋ birgi chal, 9a muu biini kunnyinee aŋhina siuzi, muugbessi ge n du u biini aŋhina chɔgi. Di ba bargi muuzeŋ maa bɔra ahoro, u bɔkpaŋ niirɛ birgi chal, u kunnyinee siuzi, u muugbessi ge chɔgi ka u bɔra anɛɛ waa ka.
10Mɛlika horohiŋ la ge huuh. Uŋ huuhwɛ, chinchiŋwiliizeŋ bɛl lii chiŋ di wa chol hɛri, u maa ra chaani lugɔ niŋ. Un cholle la, u chol gɔŋa ni polli ni. Di i bargi hɛri ni gɔŋa ni polli maa bɔra ahoro, a ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ a bɔkpaŋ ninɛɛ u chol ka ka bɔra anɛɛ la. 11A chinchiŋwilii sɔnnɛ Kunnyɛg. Un chol polli ni gɔŋa ni la, a bir du kpol, nɛkpila n nyɔɔ a nii siuzi dikuu am birgi niinyɛg la wia.
12Denii mɛlika naazuhiŋ ge huuh. Uŋ huuhwɛ, wiizi ɛɛ lugɔ baŋ lɔu u yeŋ biri. Baagu ni chinchiŋwilaa gba guŋ. Di ba bargi a maa fɔŋŋazi bɔra ahoro, a ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ a maa fɔŋŋa bɔkpannɛ ba lɔ a biri la. Hɔpizaa ni hamuŋa maa bɔkpaŋkpaŋaa biree guŋ. 13Denii n na chig bɛl n zaahwɛ di ra la chiŋ chiŋ, di ra ŋɔ fɔŋŋa ni, “Wiarɛ, wiarɛ, wia daŋ huuzi banla n du durnya naa biini, dikuu Mɛlikazi ahoro la n kawɛɛ n na nyiŋŋi a huuh bensunoniinazi naa wia.”

english_text:
1When the fifth angel blew his trumpet, I saw a star fall from the sky to earth. It was given the key to the tunnel that leads down to the deep pit. 2 As it opened the tunnel, smoke poured out like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air turned dark because of the smoke. 3 Locusts came out of the smoke and covered the earth. They were given the same power that scorpions have.
4 The locusts were told not to harm the grass on the earth or any plant or any tree. They were to punish only those people who did not have God's mark on their foreheads. 5The locusts were allowed to make them suffer for five months, but not to kill them. The suffering they caused was like the sting of a scorpion. 6 In those days people will want to die, but they will not be able to. They will hope for death, but it will escape from them.
7 These locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads they wore something like gold crowns, and they had human faces. 8 Their hair was like a woman's long hair, and their teeth were like those of a lion. 9 On their chests they wore armor made of iron. Their wings roared like an army of horse-drawn chariots rushing into battle. 10Their tails were like a scorpion's tail with a stinger that had the power to hurt someone for five months. 11Their king was the angel in charge of the deep pit. In Hebrew his name was Abaddon, and in Greek it was Apollyon.
12The first horrible thing has now happened! But wait. Two more horrible things will happen soon.
13 Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice speak from the four corners of the gold altar that stands in the presence of God. 14The voice spoke to this angel and said, “Release the four angels who are tied up beside the great Euphrates River.” 15The four angels had been prepared for this very hour and day and month and year. Now they were set free to kill a third of all people.
16By listening, I could tell there were more than 200,000,000 war horses. 17 In my vision their riders wore fiery-red, dark-blue, and yellow armor on their chests. The heads of the horses looked like lions, with fire and smoke and sulfur coming out of their mouths. 18One third of all people were killed by the three terrible troubles caused by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur. 19The horses had powerful mouths, and their tails were like poisonous snakes that bite and hurt.
20 The people who lived through these terrible troubles did not turn away from the idols they had made, and they did not stop worshiping demons. They kept on worshiping idols that were made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Not one of these idols could see, hear, or walk. 21No one stopped murdering or practicing witchcraft or being immoral or stealing.
translation_text:
1Denii mɛlika nuehiŋ huuh. Uŋ huuhwɛ, n na chinchiŋwilii bɛl n chiiri hɛri. Kɔraawiizi tɛubuu Sitaani Bɔɔluŋ la saafiibii. 2Uŋ wa pilluu, nyɔɔzi lii guŋ kuull alugɔ ninzenzeŋ nyɔɔzi n na lii la, wiizi bir biri, bɔr maa ɛɛ guŋ zuuu. 3Lotorozi lii nyɔɔzi la biini di zuu durnya. Kɔraawiizi tɛɛa fɔŋŋa alugɔ nuunzi n dɔɔ fɔŋŋa gunla. 4Ka Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ á gilɛɛ waa ɛɛ kooree, paŋhoori ani daazi wiimaa, ka ra tɔɔri nɛra la n waa Kɔraawiizi piii la dɔɔwɛ ba hilli la. 5U ŋɔ á gilɛɛ kpuuzi baa, ka tɔɔri baa baaguzi anue biini. A daŋ wii baa alugɔ nuuma n ɔɔ dum nɛr di ra wii gunla. 6A saŋa, nɛra danna nyiŋŋi bá siuzi, ka nyiŋŋuu huhzi. Ba danna kɛlli siu ni werge maa, ka ú chɔ ba be.
7A lotorozi li zagra la bam bɔkkɛ á ga yoo laal, di hi kuna aŋhina n na lii saliŋ kahurozi. A lotorozi siwee paga ge li newee siwee paga. 8A kaa dɔɔ nyuhuna lugɔ haana nyuhuna, di dɔɔ nyina alugɔ bunyiŋ nyina la, 9di dɔɔ lugbii pɛrɛtuzi di ra guu a hinaa. Di a ra nyiŋŋi a zaah, a keeri ɔɔ ra gbɔgzi alugɔ zagkpila ni a torkozi n na chɔ di ra la laal gunla. 10A kaa dɔɔ diŋre lugɔ nuunzi diŋre di ra dunzi. A diŋre biinii a fɔŋŋa du á wer tɔɔri nɛra baaguzi anue la biini. 11A koori ɛɛ mɛlika la n ɛɛ Sitaani Bɔɔluŋ hiŋ labuu. Hibru hina ra yiruubuu Abadɔn, Giris hina ge ra yiruu Apɔliɔn. U sɔŋ hiŋ zɛɛrɛ Chɔgri.
12Lugli wii la bɛrɔɔrɛ. Ka anɛɛ haa du u harbɔɔ di ra ba.
13Mɛlika numbɛlhiŋ ge huuh. Uŋ huuhwɛ la, n nuu loobii bɛl n lii saliŋ mbusu lizibɔr la n du Kɔraawiizi be la. Mbusu lizibɔr la n dɔɔ nyigzi anaazu la baambaannɛ loobii la lii, 14di ŋɔ mɛlika numbɛlhiŋ la n dɔɔ bensuno la be, “Pur mɛlikazi anaazu la baŋ vɔɔwɛ Muuzenzeŋ Yufretis la.” 15U puraa. Kɔraawiizi faa vɔɔzaabuu dau sáŋa naa wa hel. U faa dau bina, baagu, hɔpizii ani saŋa la himmaa un niŋ puraa á kpu nɛra labuu. Di ba bargi durnya maa nɛra bɔra ahoro, bɔkpannɛ á kpu la. 16A mɛlikazi dɔɔ soojazii ba tinni zagra. Ba bagli ba magaa n nuu. A du kagboŋa bɔra kagboŋ, a ge bɔra kalfaanɛɛ.
17Minna zagra la ni a hina n nai hiŋ biini la, zagra hina la kpogli ba laal pɛrɛtuzii, aŋhina aah lugɔ ninlau, aŋhina ɛɛ burgu, aŋhina ge kaa aah lugɔ susau. A zagra nyuuni li bunyinzi nyuuni, niŋ, nyɔɔzi ani jilbi sɔɔh ga a nuuzi ra lii, 18di kpuuzi durnya nɛra werge maa. Di ba bargi durnya maa nɛra bɔra ahoro, ba bɔkpannɛ niŋ, nyɔɔzi ani jilbi n ga a zagra nuuzi ra lii kpuuzi la. 19A zagra fɔŋŋa du a nuuzi ni a diŋre maa ninɛɛ. A diŋre ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ hɛrikuna di dɔɔ nyuuni, di ra dunzi.
20Too. Durnya bɔr la n kawɛɛ wiilchɔgaa naa n waa kpuwɛɛ la, ba haa vɛɛwɔɔ ra hum ba hunchɔgaa, di ra tɔgzi tinnanchɔgaa ni vuga. Saliŋ ni lugbia ni bia ni daazi kunaa a vuga. A waa na, a waa nuu ge, a waa kaa wer izi ra vol, ka ba ra tɔgzaa gunla. 21Ba haa vɛɛwɔɔ di ra kpu, di ra di hiri, di ra sɛm, di ra ŋmɛɛ.

english_text:
The Angel and the Little Scroll
1I saw another powerful angel come down from heaven. This one was covered with a cloud, and a rainbow was over his head. His face was like the sun, his legs were like columns of fire, 2and with his hand he held a little scroll that had been unrolled. He stood there with his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land. 3Then he shouted with a voice that sounded like a growling lion. Thunder roared seven times.
4After the thunder stopped, I was about to write what it had said. But a voice from heaven shouted, “Keep it secret! Don't write these things.”
5 The angel I had seen standing on the sea and the land then held his right hand up toward heaven. 6He made a promise in the name of God who lives forever and who created heaven, earth, the sea, and every living creature. The angel said, “You won't have to wait any longer. 7God told his secret plans to his servants the prophets, and it will all happen by the time the seventh angel sounds his trumpet.”
8 Once again the voice from heaven spoke to me. It said, “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel standing on the sea and the land.”
9When I went over to ask the angel for the little scroll, the angel said, “Take the scroll and eat it! Your stomach will turn sour, but the taste in your mouth will be sweet as honey.” 10I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. The taste was sweet as honey, but my stomach turned sour.
11Then some voices said, “Keep on telling what will happen to the people of many nations, races, and languages, and also to kings.”
translation_text:
Mɛlika ni hɔnjiga bɛl wia
1Denii n kaa na mɛlikakpeg bɛl n lii chiŋ di ra tuu. U kpa baama tɔ u hiŋ alugɔ wɛjɛ. Kɔraawiizi kizee bɛl ge chig u nyuu. U siwee ra chaani lugɔ wiizi, u naazi ge lugɔ nine. 2Hɔnjiga bɛl du u nonii di pilli. U kpa u nodig naa di chiŋŋi muuzeŋ ni di kaa kpa u nomɛɛl naa di chiŋŋi hɛri ni, 3ka ra pozi fɔŋŋa ni alugɔ bunyiŋ n na pogzi. Um pozee la, nazaazi aniidaanɛɛ sɛɛ, di ge ra pogzi di ra ŋɔ wia. 4A nazaazi n na ŋɔ wia la, n faa ra nyiŋŋi n sɛbi a wia dau, ka nuu loobii bɛl n lii chiŋ n ŋɔwɛɛ, “Gil wia la nazaazi aniidaanɛɛ la n ŋɔwɛɛ la du i bɛŋ biini. Gilɛɛ waa sɛbaa ra dau.”
5Denii mɛlika la min nawɛɛ un chigɛ muuzeŋ ni hɛri ni la lalli u nodig chiŋ, 6di hɛɛhzi Kɔraawiizi la n du de saŋa maa la, unla n ta chiŋ ni hɛri ani kuna la maa n du a biine, di ta muuzeŋ ni kuna la maa n du u ge biini la, di ŋɔ, “A saŋa wàá ka birgi. 7Di mɛlika niidaanɛɛhiŋ la wa huuhwɔ, a hɔpizaa la biini Kɔraawiizi wisuahlii maa u balaa dɔgtɛɛzi n faa baglɛɛ la, a maa daŋ wa ɛɛ tuŋ.”
8Denii n kaa nuu loobii la n faa ŋɔ wia tɛŋ lii chiŋ la. U ŋɔ, “La ga lɛɛ hɔŋ la n pillɛɛ di du mɛlika la n chigɛ muuzeŋ ni hɛri maa ni la nonee biini.” 9N la ga hel mɛlika la, di ŋɔ ú kpa hɔnjiga la tɛŋ. U ŋɔ, “Lɛɛ hee. U daŋ du sum lugɔ huuhnuu, i nua, ka bir du kpol i hia.” 10N lɛɛ a hɔnjiga u nonii biini di kpa hee. U du sum n nua lugɔ huuhnuu. Ka miŋ wa liluu tuŋ, u ga du nyɛg n hia biini. 11Denii ba ŋɔ n be, “Ŋɔ wia la n niŋ wa ɛɛ nɛdee kpila ni koora kpila maa di du ba ni.”

english_text:
The Two Witnesses
1 An angel gave me a measuring stick and said:
Measure around God's temple. Be sure to include the altar and everyone worshiping there. 2 But don't measure the courtyard outside the temple building. Leave it out. It has been given to those people who don't know God, and they will trample all over the holy city for 42 months. 3My two witnesses will wear sackcloth, while I let them preach for 1,260 days.
4 These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in the presence of the Lord who rules the earth. 5Any enemy who tries to harm them will be destroyed by the fire that comes out of their mouths. 6 They have the power to lock up the sky and to keep rain from falling while they are prophesying. And whenever they want to, they can turn water to blood and cause all kinds of terrible troubles on earth.
7 After the two witnesses have finished preaching God's message, the beast that lives in the deep pit will come up and fight against them. It will win the battle and kill them. 8 Their bodies will be left lying in the streets of the same great city where their Lord was nailed to a cross. And this city is spiritually like the city of Sodom or the country of Egypt.
9For three and a half days the people of every nation, tribe, language, and race will stare at the bodies of these two witnesses and refuse to let them be buried. 10Everyone on earth will celebrate and be happy. They will give gifts to each other, because of what happened to the two prophets who caused them so much trouble. 11 But three and a half days later, God will breathe life into their bodies. They will stand up, and everyone who sees them will be terrified.
12 The witnesses then heard a loud voice from heaven, saying, “Come up here.” And while their enemies were watching, they were taken up to heaven in a cloud. 13 At that same moment there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were frightened and praised the God who rules in heaven.
14The second horrible thing has now happened! And the third one will be here soon.
The Seventh Trumpet
15 At the sound of the seventh trumpet, loud voices were heard in heaven. They said,
“Now the kingdom
of this world
belongs to our Lord
and to his Chosen One!
And he will rule
forever and ever!”
16Then the 24 elders, who were seated on thrones in God's presence, knelt down and worshiped him. 17They said,
“Lord God All-Powerful,
you are and you were,
and we thank you.
You used your great power
and started ruling.
18 When the nations got angry,
you became angry too!
Now the time has come
for the dead
to be judged.
It is time for you to reward
your servants the prophets
and all your people
who honor your name,
no matter who they are.
It is time to destroy everyone
who has destroyed
the earth.”
19 The door to God's temple in heaven was then opened, and the sacred chest could be seen inside the temple. I saw lightning and heard roars of thunder. The earth trembled and huge hailstones fell to the ground.
translation_text:
Daansɛɛdiire banɛɛ wia
1Denii ba kpa lugbidaa bɛl baŋ kpawɛɛ ra mɛgzi kuna, u ɛɛ lugɔ daŋkpala. Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Izi kpa a daa di ga mɛgzi n Dia la ni mbusu lizibɔr la, di kur banla n na jaami de la.” 2U diŋŋee lawaa waa jaawɛ. Gilɛɛ waa mɛgzi de waa, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba giluubuu tɛɛ nɛra la n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ. Ba daŋ vol di ra fɛrgi Kɔraawiizi bolnanii la guŋŋ baaguzi tokkoanɛɛ ni anɛɛ. 3N daansɛɛ hina banɛɛ du denii. N daŋ tɛɛ baa fɔŋŋa bá ŋɔ wia la n niŋ wa ɛɛ hɔpizaa kagboŋ ni kalfaanɛɛ ni tokkoahoro biini. Ba daŋ tɔ gbɔglɔnzi ka ra ŋɔ a wia. 4Nɛra banɛɛ naa ɛɛ ɔlivi daazi anɛɛ la ni fintina daazi anɛɛ la n chigɛ hɛri maa Dɔɔri la be labuu. 5Di ba dɔma bɛl maa wa ŋɔ ú ɛɛ baa wichɔgaa, niŋ daŋ lii u daansɛɛ hina la nuuzii di kpuu. Awia, di nɛr la maa ŋɔ ú ɛɛ baa wichɔgaa, gunnɛ á ɛɛu ú siu. 6Nɛra banɛɛ naa daŋ dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa bá lau dooŋ, ú gilɛɛ ba saŋa la maa banna ŋɔ a wia la, di kaa dɔɔ fɔŋŋa bá lau niiri birgi chal, di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa bá kpa hɛhchɔg dee maa di ta nɛra ni saŋa la maa n par baa.
7Di ba wa di u daansɛɛ la tuŋ, sechɔgii daŋ tinni lii Bɔɔluŋ la di wa yoo baa, di kpegli baa di kpu baa. 8Ba daŋ chɔɔ ŋmɛnɛɛ bɛl n du bolzeŋ la biini. Ba daŋ wer yir a bol Sɔdɔm, di kaa wer yiruu Ijip.
